Noor-e-wehdat ka tukda humara Nabi.

Sab chamak waale ujlon mein chamka kiye,
Andhe shishon me chamkaa humara Nabi.

Jisne murdah dilon ko di umr-e-abad,
Hay woh jaan-e-maseehaa humara Nabi.

Ghamzado ko RAZA mujda di jiye key hay,
Bekaso ka sahaara humara Nabi.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: DIL KO UNSE KHUDA JUDAA NA KARE

shers.roman:
Dil ko unse Khuda judaa na kare,
Bekasi loot le Khuda na kare.

Is mein rouze ka sajdah ho ki tawaaf,
Hosh me jo na ho wo kya na kare.

Ye wohi hain keh baksh dete hain,
Kaun in jurmo par saza na kare.

Sab tabeebon ne de diya hay jawaab,
Aah ‘Eesa agar dawaa na kare.

Dil kahaan le chala haram sey mujhe,
Are tera bura Khuda na kare.

‘Uzr-e-ummeed-e-afw agar na sune,
Ru siyaah aur kya bahana kare.

Dil me roushan hay sham'-e- ‘ishq-e-Huzoor,
Kaash josh-e-hawas hawa na kare.

Hashr mein hum bhi sayr dekhenge,
Munkir aaj unse iltejaa na kare.

Zof maana magar ye zaalim dil,
Unke raste me to thakaa na kare.

Jab teri khu hay sabka jee rakhna,
Wahi achha jo dil buraa na kare.

Dil sey ik zouq-e-mai ka talab hoon,
Kaun kehta hay itteqa na kare.

Le RAZA sab chale Madine ko,
Mai na jaaun are Khuda na kare.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: MOMIN WOH HAY JO UNKI IZZAT PE MARE DIL SEY

shers.roman:
Momin woh hay jo unki izzat pe mare dil sey,
Ta’zim bhi karta hay najdi to mare dil sey.

Wallah woh sun lenge fariyaad ko pahonchege,
Itna bhi to ho koi jo aah kare dil sey.

Bichri hay gali kaisi bigri hay bani kaisi,
Pooch koi yeh sadmaa armaan bhare dil sey.

Kya usko giraaye dahar jis par tu nazar rakhhe,
Khaak usko uthaye hashr jo tere gire dil sey.

Behka hay kahaan majnoo le daali bano ki khaak,
Dam bhar na kiya khemah layla ne pare dil sey.

Sone ko tapaayein jab kuch meel ho ya kuch mail,
Kya kaam jahannum key dhurre ko khare dil sey.

Aata hay dar-e-wala yoon zowq-e-tawaaf aana,
Dil jaan sey sadqe ho sar gird phire dil sey.

Ey abre karam fariyad – fariyad jala dalaa,
us sozish-e-gham ko hay zid mere hare dil sey.

Dariyaa hay charhaa tera kitni hi urayein khaak,
Utrenge kahaan mujrim aay ‘afw tere dil sey.

Kya jaane yam-e-gham mein dil doob gaya kaisa,
Kis teh ko gaye armaan ab tak na tere dil sey.

Karta tu hay yaad unki gaflat ko zara roke,
Lillah RAZA dil sey haan dil sey arey dil sey.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ALLAH ALLAH KEY NABI SEY

shers.roman:
Allah Allah key Nabi sey,
Faariyaad hay nafs ki badi sey.

Din bhar khelon mein khaak urraayi,
Laaj aayi na zarron ki hansi sey.

Shab bhar sone hi sey garaz thi,
Taaron ne hazaar daant peese.

Imaan pe maut behtar ow nafs,
Teri naapaak zindagi sey.

-O- shahad numa-e-zehar dar jaam,
Gum jaawun kidhar teri badi sey.

Gahre pyaare pooraane dil soz,
Guzra mein teri dosti sey.

Tujh sey jo uthaaye maine sadme,
Aise na mile kabhi kisi sey.

Uff re khud kaam-e-be murawwat,
Parta hay kaam aadmi sey.

Tune hi kiya Khuda sey naadim,
Tune hi kiya khajil Nabi sey.

Kaise Aaqa ka hukm taala,
Ham mar mite teri khud-sari sey.

Aati na thi jab badi bhi tujh ko,
Hum jaante hay tujhe jabhi sey.

Had key laazim sitam key kattar,
Pathhar sharmaye tere jee sey.

Hum khaak mein mil chuke hain kab key,
Nikaala na ghubaar tere jee sey.

Hay zaalim mein niba hun tujh sey,
Allah bachaaye us ghari sey.

Jo tum ko na jaanta ho Hazrat,
Chaalain chaliye us ajnabi sey.

Allah key saamne woh gun the,
Yaaron mein kaisay muttaqi sey.

Rehzan ne loot li kamayi,
Fariyaad hay khizr-e-hashmi sey.

Allah kuwe mein khud gira hun,
Apni naalish karun tujhi sey.

Hain pusht panaah Ghaus-e-Aazam,
Kyoon darte ho tum RAZA kisi sey.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: YA ILAAHI RAHEM FARMAA MUSTAFA KEY WAASTE

shers.roman:
Yaa Ilaahi rahem farmaa, Mustafa key waaste,
Yaa Rasool’Allah karam ki'jiye Khuda key waaste.

Mushkilen hal kar Shah-e-Mushkil kusha key waaste,
Kar balaayen-e-rad shaheed-e-Karbala key waaste.

Sayyid-e-Sajjaad key sadqe me saajid rakh mujhe,
‘Ilm-e-haq deh Baaqir-e-’ilm-e-huda key waaste.

Sidq-e-saadiq ka tasadduq Saadiq-ul-islam kar,
Be ghazab raazi hoh Kaazim aur Raza key waaste.

Bahr-e-Ma'roof-o-Sirri ma'roof de be'khud sirri,
Jund-e-Haq me gin Junaid-e-baa safa key waaste.

Behre Shibli sher-e-Haq duniya key kutto sey bacha,
Ek ka rakh Abd-e-waahid be riya key waaste.

Bul Farah ka sadqa kar ghum ko farah de husn-o- sa'ad,
Bul Hassan aur bu Saeed-e-sa'ad-e-zaa keh waaste.

Qaadiri kar Qaadiri rakh Qaadiriyon me ut'ha,
Qadr-e-Abdul Qaadire qudrat numa key waaste.

Ahsan’al laahu lahum rizqan sey de rizq-e-Hassan,
Banda-e-Razzaaq Taajul asfiya key waaste.

Nasr Abi Saaleh ka sadqa saaleh-o- mansoor rakh,
De hayaat-e-deen Muhiy'ye jaan-fizaa key waaste.

Toor-e-irfaan-o-uloo-o-hamd-o-husna-o-bahaa,
De Ali Moosa Hassan Ahmed bahaa key waaste.

Bahr-e-Ibraheem mujh par naar-e-ghum gulzaar kar,
Bheek de aata Bhikhaari badsha key waaste.

Khanaa-e-dil ko Ziyaa de roo-e-imaan ko Jamaal,
Sheh Ziyaa Maula Jamaal-ul-Awliya key waaste.

De Muhammad key liye rozi kar Ahmad keh liye,
Khaan-e-Fazlullah sey hissa gadaa key waaste.

Deeno duniya ki mujhe Barkaat de Barkaat sey,
Ishq-e-Haq de ishqi-e-ishq intima key waaste.

Hubbe Ahle Bait de Aale Muhammad key liye,
Kar shaheed-e-ishq-e-Hamza peshwaa key waaste.

Dil ko aach'cha tann ko suthra jaan ko pur noor kar,
Ache pyaare Shamsud’deen badr-ul-ula key waaste.

Do jahaan me khaadim-e-Aale Rasool’Allah kar,
Hazrat-e-Aal-e-Rasool-e-muqtadaa key waaste.

Sadqa in a’yaan ka de che ‘ain iz ilm-o-amal,
‘Afw-o-’irfaan ‘aafiyat Ahmed RAZA key waaste.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ‘ARSH-E-HAQQ HAY MASNAD-E-RIF’AT RASOOL ALLAH KI

shers.roman:
‘Arsh-e-haqq hay masnad-e-rif’at Rasool Allah ki,
Dekhni hay hashr mein ‘izzat Rasool Allah ki.

Qabr mein lehraayenge taa hashr chashme Noor key,
Jalwah farmaa hogi jab tal’at Rasool Allah ki.

Kaafiron par taigh-waalaa sey giri barq-e-ghazab,
Abr aasaa chaa gayi haibat Rasool Allah ki.

Laa wa Rabbil ‘arsh jisko jo mila unse mila,
Bat-ti hay kaunain mein ne’mat Rasool Allah ki.

Woh jahannum mein gaya jo unse mustaghni huwa,
Hay Khaleelullah ko haajat Rasool Allah ki.

Sooraj ulte paaon palte chaand ishaare sey ho chaak
Andhe najdi dekh le qudrat Rasool Allah ki

Tujh sey aur Jannat sey kiya matlab wahabi door ho,
Hum RasoolAllah key Jannat Rasool Allah ki.

Zikr roke fazl kaate naqs ka jooyaan rahey,
Phir kahe mardak key hoon ummat Rasool Allah ki.

Najdi usne tujh ko mohlat di ki is ‘aalam mein hay,
Kaafir-o-murtad pe bhi rehmat Rasool Allah ki.

Hum bheekhaari woh kareem unka Khuda unse fuzoo,
Aur naa kehna nahin aadat Rasool Allah ki.

Ahl-e-Sunnat ka hay bera paar ashaabe Huzoor,
Najm hay aur naaw hay ‘itrat Rasool Allah ki.

Khaak hokar ishq mein aaraam sey sona mila,
Jaan ki akseer hay ulfat Rasool Allah ki.

Toot jaayenge gunahgaaro key fauran qaid-o-bandh,
Hashr ko khul jaayegi taaqat Rasool Allah ki.

Ya Rabb ek sa’at mein dhool jayein siyaahkaro key jurm,
Josh mein aajaaye ab rahmat Rasool Allah ki.

Hay gul-e-baagh-e-qudus rukhsaar zebaaye Huzoor,
Sarwe gulzaare qadam qaamat Rasool Allah ki.

Aay RAZA khud Saahib-e-Qur’an hay maddaah-e-Huzoor,
Tujh sey kab mumkin hay phir midhat Rasool Allah ki.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: QAAFILE NE SOO-E-TAIBAH KAMAR ARAYI KI

shers.roman:
Qaafile ne soo-e-Taibah kamar arayi ki,
Mushkil aasaan ilaahi meri tanhaayi ki.

Laaj rakh li tam’-e- ‘afw key saudaayi ki,
Ey mein qurban mere Aaqa barri Aaqayi ki.

Farsh taa arsh sab aayina zama’ir haazir,
Bass qasam khaaiye ummi teri daanaayi ki.

Shash jehat samt-e-muqabil shab-o-roz ek hi haal,
Dhoom “wannajm” mein hay aap ki beenaayi ki.

Paansau saal ki raah aisi hay jaise dogaam,
Aas hum ko bhi lagi hay teri shunwaayi ki.

Chaand ishare ka hila hukm ka baandha sooraj,
Waah kya baat Shaaha teri tawaanaayi ki.

Tang t-hehri hay RAZA jiske liye woos’ate ‘arsh,
Bass jagah dil mein hay us jalwah-e-harjaayi ki.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: PESH-E-HAQQ MUZHDA SHAFAA’AT KA SUNAATE JAAYENGE

shers.roman:
Pesh-e-Haqq muzhda shafaa’at ka sunaate jaayenge,
Aap rote jaayenge hum ko hansaate jayenge.

Dil nikal jaane ki jaa hay aah kin aankhon sey woh,
Hum sey pyaason key liye dariya bahaate jaayenge.

Kushtgaan-e-garmi-e-mehshar ko woh jaan-e-Maseeh,
Aaj daaman ki hawa de kar jilaate jayenge.

Gul khilega aaj yeh unki naseem-e-faiz sey,
Khoon rote aayenge hum muskuraate jayenge.

Haan chalo hasrat zado sunte hain woh din aaj hay,
Thi khabar jiski key woh jalwah dikhaate jaayenge.

Aaj ‘eid-e-aashiqaan hay gar Khuda chahe keh woh,
Aabroo-e-paywastah ka ‘aalam dikhaate jaayenge.

Kuch khabar bhi hay faqeero aaj woh din hay keh woh,
Ne’mate khuld apne sadqe mein lutaate jayenge.

Khaak uftaado bass unke aane hi ki der hay,
Khud woh girkar sajde mein tumko ut-haate jaayenge.

Wus’atein dee hay Khuda ne daaman-e-Mehboob ko,
Jurm khulte jaayenge aur woh chhupaate jaayenge.

Lo woh aaye muskuraate hum aseeron ki taraf,
Khirman-e-‘isyaan pe abb bijli giraate jayenge.

Aankh kholo ghamzado dekho woh giryaan aaye hain,
Lauh-e-dil sey naqsh-e-gham ko ab mitaate jaayenge.

Sokhtah jaanon pe woh pur-josh-e-rehmat aaye hain,
Aab-e-kausar sey lagi dil ki bujhaate jaayenge.

Aaftaab unka hi chamkega jab auron key charaagh,
Sar-e-sar-e-josh-e-balaa sey jhilmilaate jaayenge.

Paaye kubaan pul sey guzrenge teri aawaaz par,
“rabbe sallim” ki sadaa par wajd laate jaayenge.

Sarwar-e-Deen lijiye apne naa-tawaano ki khabar,
Nafs-o-shaytaan sayyida kab tak dabaate jaayenge.

Hashr tak daalenge hum paidaaish-e-Mawla ki dhoom,
Misle faaras najd key qal’-e- giraate jaayenge.

Khaak ho jaayein ‘adoo jal kar magar hum to RAZA,
Dum mein jab tak dum hay zikr unka sunaate jaayenge.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: CHAMAK TUJHSE PAATE HAIN SAB PAANE WAALE

shers.roman:
Chamak tujhse paate hain sab paane waale,
Mera dil bhi chamka de chamkane waale.

Barasta nahi dekh kar abr-e-rehmat,
Bado(n) par bhi barsa de barsane waale.

Madine key khitte Khuda tujhko rakhe,
Ghareebon faqeeron key t-hehrane waale.

Tu zinda hay wallah tu zinda hay wallah,
Mere chashm-e-‘aalam sey chup jaane waale.

Mein mujrim hoon Aaqa mujhe saath le lo,
Ke raste mein hain jaa bajaa thaane waale.

Haram ki zamee(n) aur qadam rakh key chalna,
Are sar ka mouqa hay aw jaane waale.

Chal uth jabah farsa ho saaqi key dar par,
Dar-e-jood aay mere mastaane waale.

Tera khaayein tere ghulamon sey uljhein,
Hain munkir ‘ajab khaane ghurrane waale.

Rahega yoon hi unka charchaa rahega,
Parre khaak ho jaayein jal jaane waale.

Ab aayi shafaa'at ki saa'at ab aayi,
Zara chain le mere ghabhraane waale.

RAZA nafs dushman hay dam mein na aana,
Kahaan tumne dekhe hain chandraane waale.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: AANKHEIN RO RO KEY SUJAANE WAALE

shers.roman:
Aankhein ro ro key sujaane waale,
Jaane waale nahin aane waale.

Koi din mein ye sara awjarh hay,
Arey-o-chhaaoni chhaane waale.

Zabah hote hain watan sey bichre,
Des kyoon gaatey hain gaane waale.

Arey bad-faal buri hoti hay,
Des ka jangla sunaane waale.

Sunlein aa’da mein bigarne ka nahin,
Woh salaamat hain banaane waale.

Aankhein kuch kehti hain tujh sey paighaam,
Aw dar-e-yaar key jaane waale.

Phir na karwat li Madine ki taraf,
Arey chal jhoote bahaane waale.

Nafs mein khaak huwa tu na mita,
Hay meri jaan key khaane waale.

Jeetey kya dekh key hain aay hurow,
Taybah sey khuld mein aane waale.

Neem jalwe mein do ‘aalam gulzar,
Waah waa rang jamaane waale.

Husn tera saa na dekha na sunaa,
Kehte hain agle zamaane waale.

Wahi dhoom unki hay maa shaa Allah,
Mit gaye Aap mitane wale.

Lab-e-sairaab ka sadqa paani,
aay lagi dil ki bujhaane waale.

Saath le lo mujhe mein mujhrim hun,
Raah mein parrte hain thane waale.

Ho gaya dhak sey kaleja mera,
Haaye rukhsat ki sunaane waale.

Khalq to kya keh hain khaaliq ko ‘azeez,
Kuch ‘ajab bhaate hain bhaane waale.

Kushta-e-dasht-e-Haram Jannat ki,
Khirkiyaan apne sirhaane waale.

Kyun RAZA aaj gali sooni hay,
Uth mere dhoom machaane waale.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: KYA MAHEKTAY HAIN MEHEKNEY WALEY

shers.roman:
Kya mahektay hain mehekney waley,
Boo pe chaltay hain bhatakney waley.

Jag-maga uthi meri gor ki khaak,
Tere qurbaan chamakney waley.

Mah-e-be daagh key sadqe jaaun,
Yoon damaktey hain damakney waley.

‘Arsh tak phaili hay taabe ‘aariz,
Kya jhalaktey hain jhalakney waley.

Gul-e-Taiba ki thana gaatey hain,
Nakhl-e-toobaa pey chahekney waley.

Aasiyo! thaam lo daaman un ka,
Woh nahin haath jhatakney waley.

Abr-e-rehmat key salaami rehna,
phaltey hain paude lachakney waley.

Arey yeh jalwa-gahe jaana hay,
Kuch adab bhi hay pharrakney waley.

Sunniyo! Un sey madad maange jaao,
Parrey bakte rahein bakney waley.

Sham-e-yaad-e-rukh-e-jaana na bujhe.
Khaak ho jaayen bharakney waley,

Maut kehti hay ki jalwa hay kareeb,
Ek zara so lein bilakney waley.

Koi un tez rawon sey keh do,
Kis key ho kar rahain thakney waley.

Dil sulagta hay bhalaa hay ey zabt,
Bujh bhi jaate hain dahekney waley.

Hum bhi kumhlane sey ghaafil thay kabhee,
Kya hansain ghunchey chatakney waley.

Nakhl sey chat key yeh kya haal huwa,
Aah-o-patte kharakne waley.

Jab gire moonh soo-e-may-khaana tha,
Hosh mein hay yeh bahakney waley.

Dekh aw zakhme dil aape ko sambhaal,
Phoot behte hain tapakne waley.

May kahaan aur kahaan mein zaahid,
Yoon chahaktey hain chahakne waley.

Kaf-e-dariya-e-karam mein hain RAZA,
Paanch fawaarey chalakne wale.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: RAAH PUR KHAAR HAY KYA HONA HAY

shers.roman:
Raah pur khaar hay kya hona hay,
Paoon afgaar hay kya hona hay.

Khushk hay khoon key dushman zaalim,
Sakht khoon kwhaar hay kya hona hay.

Hum ko bid kar wahi karna jis sey,
Dost bezaar hay kya hona hay.

Tan ki ab kaun khabar ley hay hayke,
Dil ka aazaar hay kya hona hay.

Meethe sharbat de Masihaa jab bhi,
Zid hay inkaar hay kya hona hay.

Dil keh teemaar humaara karta,
Aap beemar hay kya hona hay,

Par kate tang qafas aur bulbul,
Nou-gireftaar hay kya hona hay.

Chhup key logo sey kiye jis key gunaah,
Woh khabardaar hay kya hona hay.

Arey-o-mujrim be-parwaa dekh,
Sar pe talwaar hay kya hona hay.

Tere beemar ko mere ‘Eesa,
Ghash lagaataar hay kya hona hay.

Nafs-e-pur zor ka woh zor aur dil,
Zer hay zaar hay kya hona hay.

Kaam zindon key kiye aur humein,
Shawk-e-gulzar hay kya hona hay.

Haaye re neend musafir teri,
Kooch taiyaar hay kya hona hay.

Door jaanaa hay rahaa din thora,
Raah dushwar hay kya hona hay.

Ghar bhi jaana hay musafir key nahin,
Mat pe kya maar hay kya hona hay.

Jaan halkaan huwi jaati hay,
Baar saa baar hay kya hona hay.

Paar jaana hay nahin milti naaw,
Zor par dhaar hay kya hona hay.

Raah to taig par aur talwon ko,
Ghila-e-khaar hay kya hona hay.

Roshni ki humein ‘aadat aur ghar,
Teerah woh taar hay kya hona hay.

Beech mein aag ka dariya haail,
Qasd us paar hay kya hona hay.

Uss karri dhoop ko kyoon kar jhelein,
Shola zan naar hay kya hona hay.

Haaye bigri tu kahaan aakar naaw,
‘Ain manjdhaar hay kya hona hay.

Kal to deedar ka din aur yahaan,
Aankh bekaar hay kya hona hay.

Moonh dikhane ka nahin aur sahar,
‘Aam darbaar hay kya hona hay.

Unko rahem aaye to aaye warna,
Wohkarri maar hay kya hona hay.

Ley woh haakim key sipahi aaye,
Subh-e-izhaar hay kya hona hay.

Waan nahin baat bananay ki majaal,
Chaarah iqraar hay kya hona hay.

Saath waalon ne yahin chhor diya,
Bekasi yaar hay kya hona hay.

Aakhri deed hay aao mil lein,
Ranjh bekaar hay kya hona hay.

Dil hume tum sey lagana hi na tha,
Ab safar baar hay kya hona hay.

Jaane waalon pe yeh rona kaisa,
Banda naachaar hay kya hona hay.

Naz’a mein dhyaan nah bat jaaye kahin,
Yeh ‘abath pyaar hay kya hona hay.

Iska gham hay key har ik ki soorat,
Galley ka haar hay kya hona hay.

Baatein kuch aur bhi tum sey karte,
Par kahaan waar hay kya hona hay.

Kyoon RAZA kurrhte ho hanste uttho,
Jab woh Ghaffaar hay kya hona hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: KIS KEY JALWE KI JHALAK HAY YEH UJAALA KYA HAY

shers.roman:
Kis key jalwe ki jhalak hay yeh ujaala kya hay,
Har taraf deedah-e-hairat zadah taqta kya hay.

Maang man maanti moonh maangi muraadein lega,
Na yahan “naa” hay na mangta sey yeh kehna “kya hay”.

Pand karrwi lage naaseh sey na tarsh ho aay nafs,
Zahr-e-isiyan mein sitamgar tujhe meetha kya hay.

Hum hain unke woh hain terey to huwe hum tere,
Is sey barh kar teri simt aur waseela kya hay.

Unki ummat mein banaaya unhe rehmat bheja,
Yoon na farma key tera reham mein da’waa kya hay.

Sadqa pyaare ki haya ka keh na lo mujh sey hisaab,
Baksh be pooche lajaaye ko lajaana kya hay.

Zaahid unka mein gunehgaar woh mere shaafi’,
Itni nisbat mujhe kya kam hay to samjha kya hay.

Be-basi ho jo mujhe pursishe aa’mal key waqt,
Doston kya kahoon us waqt tamanna kya hay.

Kaash fariyaad meri sunke yeh farmayein Huzoor,
Haan koi dekho yeh kya shor hay ghowgha kya hay.

Kaun aafat zadah hay kis pe balaa tooti hay,
Kis musibat mein gireftaar hay sadma kya hay.

Kis sey kehta hay ki Lillaah khabar lijiye meri,
Kyoon hay betaab yeh be-chaini ka rona kya hay.

Uski be-chaini sey hay khaatir-e-aqdas pe malaal,
Bekasi kaisi hay poocho koi guzra kya hay.

Yoon malaik karein ma’arooz ki ek mujrim hay,
Us sey pursish hay bataa tune kiya kya kya hay.

Saamna qaher ka hay daftar-e-aa’mal hay pesh,
Dar raha hay key Khuda hukm sunaata kya hay.

Aap sey karta hay fariyaad key Yaa Shah-e-Rusul,
Banda bekas hay shahaa reham me waqfa kya hay.

Ab koi dum mein gireftaare balaa hota hoon,
Aap aa jayein to kya khauf hay khatka kya hay.

Sun key yah ‘arz meri bahr-e-karam josh mein aayay,
Yun malaaik ko ho irshaad t-haherna kya hay.

Kis ko tum maurid-e-aafaat kiya chaahte ho,
Hum bhi toh aa key zara dekhein tamaasha kya hay.

Unki aawaz pe kar utthu mein besaakhta shor,
Aur tarap kar yeh kahoon ab mujhe parwa kya hay.

Lo woh aaya mera haami mera gham-khwaar-e-umam!
Aa gayi jaan tan-e-be jaan mein yeh aana kya hay.

Phir mujhe daaman-e-aqdas me chupaalein Sarwar,
Aur farmaayein hatto is pe taqaaza kya hay.

Banda aazaad shudah hay yeh humare dar ka,
Kaisa lete ho hisaab iss pe tumhara kya hay.

Chhor kar mujh ko farishte kahe mahkoom hain hum,
Hukm-e-waala ki na ta’meel ho Zuhra kya hay.

Ye samaa(n) dekh key mehshar mein utthe shor key waah,
Chashm-e-bad door ho kya shaan hay rutbah kya hay.

Sadqe us rehm key us saayaa-e-daaman pe nisaar,
Apne bande ko musibat sey bachaaya kya hay.

Aay RAZA jaan-e-‘anaadil terey naghmon key nisaar,
Bulbul-e-baagh-e-Madinah tera kehna kya hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SARWAR KAHOON KEY MAALIK-O-MAULA KAHOON TUJHE

shers.roman:
Sarwar kahoon key Maalik-o-Maula kahoon tujhe,
Baagh-e-Khaleel ka gul-e-zeyba kahoon tujhe.

Hirmaan naseeb hun tujhe ummid gah kahoon,
Jaan-e-muraad-o-kaan-e-tamanna kahoon tujhe.

Gulzaar-e-quds ka gul-e-rangeen ada kahoon,
Darmaan-e-dard-e-bulbul-e-shayda kahoon tujhe.

Subh-e-watan pe shaam-e-gharibaan ko doon sharaf,
Beykas nawaaz geysuon waala kahoon tujhe.

Allah re tere jism-e-munawwar ki taabishein,
Aay jaan-e-jaa(n) mein jaan-e-tajallaa kahoon tujhe.

Bey daagh laalah ya qamar-e-bey kalaf kahoon,
Bey khaar gulban-e-chaman aara kahoon tujhe.

Mujrim hun apne ‘afw ka saamaan karoon shahaa,
Ya’ni shafi’ roz-e-jazaa ka kahoon tujhe.

Is murdah dil ko muzhdah hayaat-e-abad ka doon,
Taab-o-tawaan-e-jaan-e-masiha kahoon tujhe.

Tere toh wasf ‘ayb-e-tanaahi sey hain baree,
Hayran hoon mere shaah main kya kya kahoon tujhe.

Keh legi sab kuch unke thanaakhwaan ki khaamoshi,
Chup ho raha hay keh kay main kya kya kahoon tujhe.

Lekin RAZA ne khatm-e-sukhan is pe kardiya,
Khaaliq ka bandah khaalq ka Aaqa kahoon tujhe.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: MUZHDAH BAAD AAY ‘AASIYO, SHAAFI’ SHAH-E-ABRAAR HAY

shers.roman:
Muzhdah baad aay ‘aasiyo, shaafi’ shah-e-abraar hay,
Tahniyat aay mujrimo! Zaat-e-Khuda Ghaffaar hay.

‘Arsh saa farsh-e-zamin hay, farsh paa ‘arsh-e-bareen,
Kya niraali tarz ki naam-e-Khuda raftaar hay.

Chaand shaq ho peyr bolein jaanwar sajdey karein,
Baarak’Allah marja-e-a’alam yahi sarkaar hay.

Jin ko soo-e-aasmaan phayla key jal thal bhar diye,
Sadqah un haathon ka pyaare hum ko bhi darkaar hay.

Lab zulaal-e-chashmah-e-kun mein gundhey waqt-e-khameer,
Murdey zindah karna aay jaan tum ko kya dushwaar hay.

Gorey gorey paaun chamka do Khuda key wastey,
Noor ka tadka ho pyaare gor ki shab taar hay.

Tere hi daman pey har ‘aasi ki parti hay nazar,
Ek jaan-e-bey khata par do jahaan ka baar hay.

Josh-e-tufaan bahr-e-bey paayaan hawaa naaa saazgaar,
Nooh key Mawla karam kar dey to beyrra paar hay.

Rahmatul-lil-’aalameen teri duhaayi dab gaya,
Ab to Maula bey tarah sar par gunaah ka baar hay,

Hayraten hain aayinah daar-e-wafur-e-wasf-e-gul,
Un key bulbul ki khamoshi bhi lab-e-izhaar hay.

Goonj goonj utthey hain naghmaat-e-RAZA sey boostaan,
Kyoon na ho kis phool ki mid-hat mein waa minqar hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ‘ARSH KI AQL DANG HAY CHARKH MEIN AASMAAN HAY

shers.roman:
‘Arsh ki aql dang hay charkh mein aasmaan hay,
Jaan-e-muraad ab kidhar haaye tera makaan hay.

Bazm-e-sanaa-e-lutf mein meri ‘uroos fikr ko,
Saari bahaar-e-hasht khuld chhota sa ‘itr daan hay.

Arsh pe jaa key murgh-e-aql thak key gira ghash aa gaya,
Aur abhi manzilon pare pehla hi aastaan hay.

Arsh pe taazah cher chaar farsh mein tarfa dhoom dhaam,
Kaan jidhar lagaaiye teri hi daastan hay.

Ik tere rukh ki roshni chain hay do jahaan ki,
Ins ka uns usi sey hay jaan ki woh hi jaan hay.

Woh jo na the to kuch na tha woh jo na ho to kuch na ho,
Jaan hay woh jahaan ki jaan hay to jahaan hay.

Gaud mein ‘aalam-e-shabaab haal-e-shabaab kuch na pooch,
Gulbun-e-baagh-e-Noor ki aur hi kuch utthaan hay.

Tujh sa siyaahkaar kaun un sa shafi’ hay kahaan,
Phir woh tujhi ko bhool jaayein dil ye tera gumaan hay.

Pesh-e-nazar wo nau bahaar sajde ko dil hay be-qaraar,
Rokiye sar ko rokiye haan yahi imtehaan hay.

Shaan-e-Khuda na saath de unke kheraam ka woh baaz,
Sidrah sey taa zameen jise narm si ek uraan hay.

Baare jalaal utthaa liya garche kalejaa shaq huwa,
Yoon to ye maah-e-sabzah rang nazron mein dhaan paan hay.

Khauf na rakh RAZA zara tu to hay ‘abd-e-'Mustafa,
Tere liye amaan hay tere liye amaan hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: UTHAA DO PARDA DIKHAA DO CHEHRA

shers.roman:
Uthaa do parda dikhaa do chehra key Noor-e-Baari hijaab mein hay,
Zamaana taareek ho raha hay key mehr kab sey niqaab mein hay.

Nahin woh meethi nigaah waala Khuda ki rehmat hay jalwa farma,
Ghazab sey unke Khuda bachaaye jalaal-e-baari ‘etaab mein hay.

Jali-jali bu sey uski paida hay sozish-e-‘ishq-e-chashme-waala,
Kabaab-e-aahu me bhi na paaya mazah jo dil key kabaab mein hay.

Unheen ki bu maaya-e-saman hay unheen ka jalwa chaman chaman hay,
Unheen sey gulshan mehek rahe hain unheen ki rangat gulaab mein hay.

Teri julu mein hay maah-e-Taibah hilaal har marg-o-zindagi ka!,
Hayaat jaa(n) ka rikaab mein hay mamaate aa’da ka daab mein hay.

Siyaah libaasaan-e-daar dunya wa sabz-poshaan-e-‘arshe aa’laa,
Har ik hay unke karam ka pyaasa ye faiz unki janaab mein hay.

Woh gul hay lab-haaye naazuk unke hazaaron jharte hain phool jinse,
Gulaab gulshan mein dekhe bulbul yeh dekh gulshan gulaab mein hay.

Jali hay soz-e-jigar sey jaa(n) tak hay taalib-e-jalwa-e-mubaarak,
Dikha do wo lab key aab-e-haiwaa(n) key lutf jinke khitaab mein hay.

Khare hain Munkar Nakeer sar par na koi haami na koi yaavar!,
Bataa do aakar mere Payambar key sakht mushkil jawaab mein hay.

Khuda-e-qahhaar hay ghazab par khule hein bad-kaariyo(n) key daftar,
Bachaa lo aa kar shafi’-e-mehshar tumhaara bandah ‘azaab mein hay.

Kareem aisa mila key jiske khule hain haath aur bhare khazaane,
Batao aay mufliso! keh phir kyun tumhaara dil izteraab mein hay.

Gunaah ki taareekiyaan ye chaayien umand key kaali ghataaein aaein,
Khuda kay khursheed mehr farmaa key zarra bas izteraab mein hay.

Kareem apne karam ka sadqa la-eeme be qadr ko na sharmaa,
Tu aur RAZA sey hisaab lena RAZA bhi koi hisaab mein hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ANDHERI RAAT HAY GHAM KI GHATAA ‘ISYAAN KI KAALI HAY

shers.roman:
Andheri raat hay gham ki ghataa ‘isyaan ki kaali hay,
Dil-e-be-kas kaa is aafat mein Aaqa tu hi waali hay.

Na ho maayoos aati hay sadaa gor-e-gharibaan sey,
Nabi ummat ka haami hay khuda bando ka waali hay.

Utarte chaand dhalti chandni jo ho sake kar lay,
Andhera paakh aata hay ye do din ki ujaali hay.

Arey yeh bherriyon ka ban hay aur shaam aagayi sar par,
Kahaan soya musaafir haaye kitna laa ubaali hay.

Andhera ghar akeli jaan dum ghut-ta dil uktaata,
Khuda ko yaad kar pyaare wo saa’at aane waali hay.

Zameen tapti kateli raah bhaari bojh ghaayal paaon,
Museebat jhelnay waale tera Allah waali hay.

Na chonkaa din hay dhalne par teri manzil hui khoti,
Arey-o-jaane waale neend ye kab ki nikaali hay.

RAZA manzil to jaisi hay woh ik mein kya sabhi ko hay,
Tum usko rote ho yeh to kaho yaan haath khaali hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: GUNEHGAARON KO HAATIF SEY NAWEED-E-KHUSH MA’AALI HAY

shers.roman:
Gunehgaaron ko haatif sey naweed-e-khush ma’aali hay,
Mubarak ho shafaa’at key liye Ahmad saa waali hay.

Qaza haqq hay magar us shawq ka Allah waali hay,
Jo unki raah mein jaaye woh jaan Allah waali hay.

Tera qad-e-Mubarak gulban-e-rehmat ki daali hay,
Usey bo kar terey Rab ne binaa rahmat ki daali hay.

Tumhari sharm sey shaan-e-jalaal-e-Haqq tapkati hay,
Kham-e-garden hilaal-e-aasmaan-e-zuljalaali hay.

Zah-e-khud gum jo gum hone pe yeh dhoondhe ki kya paya,
Arey! Jab tak keh paana hay jabhi tak haath khali hay.

Mein ek mohtaaj-e-be-waq’at gadaa tere sag-e-dar ka,
Teri Sarkaar waala hay tera darbaar aali hay.

Teri bakhshish pasandi uzr joi tawbah khwaahi sey,
Umoom-e-be-gunaa hi jurm shaan-e-laa-oobali hay.

Abu Bakr-o-Umar Usman-o-Haidar jiske bulbul hain,
Tera sarwe sahi us gulbune khubi ki daali hay.

RAZA qismat ki khul jaayay jo geelaan sey khitaab aayay,
Ke tu adnaa sag-e-dargaah-e-khuddaam-e-ma’aali hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SOONA JUNGLE RAAT ANDHERI CHAAYI BADLI KAALI HAY

shers.roman:
Soona jungle raat andheri chaayi badli kaali hay,
Sone waalo jaagte rahiyo choron ki rakhwaali hay.

Aankh sey kaajal saaf churaa lain yaan woh chor balaa key hain,
Teri gatthrri taakee hay aur tu ne neend nikali hay.

Yeh jo tujh ko bulaata hay yeh thag hay maar hi rakhe gaa,
Haaye musaafir dam mein na aana mat kaisi matwaali hay.

Sona paas hay soona ban hay sona zehar hay utth pyaare,
Tu kehta hay neend hay meethi teri mat hi nirali hay.

Aankhain malna jhunjhlaa parrnaa laakhon jamaahi angraayi,
Naam pe utthne key larrta hay utthna bhi kuch gaali hay.

Jugnoo chamke pattaa kharke mujh tanhaa ka dil dharke,
Dar samjhaaye koi pavan hay ya agiyaa be taali hay,

Baadal garje bijli tarrpe dhak sey kaleja ho jaaye,
Ban main ghataa ki bhayanak soorat kaisi kaali kaali hay.

Paaon utthaa aur thokar khaayi kuch sambhlaa phir aondhe moon,
Meenh ne phislan kar di hay aur dhur tak khaayi naali hay.

Saathi saathi keh key pukaroon saathi ho to jawab aaye,
Phir jhunjhlaa kar sar de patkoon chal re Mowla waali hay.

Phir phir kar har jaanib dekhoon koi aas na paas kahin,
Haan ik tooti aas nay haaray jee say rafaaqat paali hay.

Tum to chaand ‘arab key ho pyaare tum to ‘ajam key sooraj ho,
Dekho mujh bekas par shab ne kaisi aafat daali hay.

Dunya ko tu kia jaanay yeh bis ki ghaanth hay harraafah,
Soorat dekho zaalim ki to kaisee bholi bhaali hay.

Shehad dikhaaye zehar pilaaye qaatil daaen shohar kush,
Iss murdaar pe kya lalchaaya dunya dekhi bhaali hay.

Woh to nihayat sasta sowda baich rahe hain jannat ka,
Hum muflis kya moal chukaayen apna haath hi khaali hay.

Mowla tere afw-o-karam hon mere gawaah safaayi key,
Warna RAZA sey chor pe teri digree to iqbaali hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: NABI SARWARE HAR RASOOL-O-WALI HAY

shers.roman:
Nabi sarware har Rasool-o-wali hay,
Nabi raaz daare ma’Allaahlee hay.

Woh naami ki naam-e-Khuda naam tera,
Raoof-o-Raheem-o-‘Aleem-o-‘Ali hay.

Hay baytaab jis key liye ‘arsh-e-aa’zam,
Woh us rehrawe laa-maqaan ki gali hay.

Nakeerayn karte hain ta’zeem meri,
Fida ho kar tujh par yeh izzat mili hay.

Talaa-tum hay kashti pen toofan-e-gham ka,
Yah kaisi hawaa-e-mukhaalif chali hay.

Na kyoon kar kahoon yaa habibi aghisni,
Isi naam sey har musibat tali hay.

Sabaa hay mujhe sar-sar-e-dasht-e-Taybah,
Isi sey kali mere dil ki khili hay.

Terey chaaron hum-dum hay yakjaan yakdil,
Abu Baqr Farooq ‘Usman ‘Ali hay.

Khuda ne kiya tujh ko aagaah sab sey,
Do ‘aalam mein jo kuch khafi-o-jali hay.

Karoon arz kya tujh sey aay ‘aalimussir,
Ke tujh par meri haalat-e-dil khuli hay.

Tamanna hay farmaiye roz-e-mehshar,
Yeh teri rihaayi ki chitthi mili hay.

Jo maqsad ziyaarat ka bar aaye phir to,
Na kuch qasd kijiye ye qasde dili hay.

Terey dar ka darbaan hay Jibril-e-aa’zam,
Tera madh khwaan har Nabi-o-Wali hay.

Shafaa’at karein hashr mein jo RAZA ki,
Siwaa terey kis ko yeh qudrat mili hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: NA ‘ARSH-E-AYMAN NA INNI ZAAHIBUN MEIN MEYHMAANI HAY

shers.roman:
Na ‘arsh-e-ayman na inni zaahibun mein meyhmaani hay,
Na lutf-e-udun yaa Ahmad naseeb-e-lan taraani hay.

Naseeb-e-dostaan gar unkey dar par maut aani hay,
Khuda yun hi karein phir to humesha zindgaani hay.

Ussi dar par tarapatey hain machltey hain bilaktey hain,
Uttha jaata nahin kya khoob apni naa-tawaani hay.

Har eik deewaro dar par mehr ne ki hay jabeen saayi,
Nigaar-e-masjid-e-aqdas mein kab sone ka paani hay.

Terey mangtaa ki khaamoshi shafaa’at khwaah hay us ki,
Zabaan-e-be zabaani tarjumaan-e-khasta jani hay.

Khule kya raaz-e-ehboob-o-Muhib mastaane ghaflat par,
Sharaab-e-qad ra’ yal Haq zayb-e-jaam-e-man ra aani hay.

Jahaan ki khaakroobi ne chaman aaraa kiya tujh ko,
Saba hum ne bhi un galiyo ki kuch din khaak chhani hay.

Shahaa kya zaat teri Haq numaa hay fard-e-imkaan mein,
Keh tujh sey koi awwal hay na tera koi saani hay.

Kahaan us ko shak-e-jaan-e-jinaan mein zar ki naqaashi,
Iram key taayire rang-e-pareeda ki nishaani hay.

Ziyabun fee thiyabin lab pe kalma dil mein gustakhi,
Salaam Islam mulhid ko keh tasleem-e-zabani hay.

Ye aksar saath unke shaana-o-miswaak ka rehna,
Bataataa hay ki dil reshon pein zaaid mehrbaani hay.

Isi Sarkaar sey dunia-o-deen milte hay saail ko,
Yahi darbaare ‘aali kanz-e-aamal-o-amaani hay.

Duroodein soorat-e-baala moohit-e-maah-e-Taybah hein,
Barasta ummat-e-‘aasi pen ab rahmat ka paani hay.

Ta’aala Allah istighna terey dar key gadaaon ka,
Keh unko aaar far-o-shaukat-e-saahib Qur’ani hay.

Woh sar garme shafaa’at hay araq afshaan hay peshani,
Karam ka itr sandal ki zameen rehmat ki ghaani hay.

Ye sar ho aur woh khaak-e-dar, woh khaak-e-dar ho aur ye sar,
RAZA woh bhi agar chaahein to ab dil mein ye thhaani hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SUNTEY HAIN KEH MEHSHAR MEIN

shers.roman:
Suntey hain keh mehshar mein sirf unki rasaai hay,
Gar unki rasai hay lo jab to ban aayi hay.

Machla hay keh rehmat ne ummeed bandhaayi hay,
Kya baat teri mujrim kya baat banaayi hay.

Sab ne saf-e-mehshar me lalkaar diya hum ko,
Aay bekason key Aaqa ab teri duhayi hay.

Yoon to sab unhi ka hay par dil ki agar poocho,
Yeh toote huwe dil hi khaas unki kamaayi hay.

Zaair gaye bhi kab key din dhalne pe hay pyaare,
Uth mere akele chal kya der lagayi hay.

Baazaare ‘amal mein to sauda nah bana apna,
Sarkaar-e-karam tujh mein ‘aibi ki samaayi hay.

Girte huwon ko muzda sajde me gire Maula,
Ro ro key shafaa’at ki tamheed utthaayi hay.

Aay dil ye sulagna kya jalna hay to jal bhi utth,
Dam ghutne laga zaalim kya dhooni ramaayi hay.

Mujrim ko na sharmawo ehbaab kafan dhak do,
Moonh dekh key kya hoga parde mein bhalaayi hay.

Ab aap hi sambhaalein to kaam apne sambhal jaayein,
Humne to kamayi sab khelon mein gawaayi hay.

Ey ‘ishq tere sadqe jalne sey chhutte saste,
Jo aag bujhaa degi woh aag lagaayi hay.

Hirs-o-hawas-e-bad sey dil tu bhi sitam kar le,
Tu hi nahin baygaana duniya hi paraayi hay.

Hum dil jaley hain kis key hat fitnon key parkaale,
Kyoon phoonk doo(n) ik uff sey kya aag lagayi hay.

Taiba na sahi afzal Makkah hi barraa zaahid,
Hum ‘ishq key bande hain kyoon baat barhaayi hay.

Matla’ mein yeh shak kya tha wallaah RAZA wallaah,
Sirf unki rasaai hay sirf unki rasaai hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: HIRZ-E-JAAN ZIKR-E-SHAFAA’AT KIJIYE

shers.roman:
Hirz-e-jaan zikr-e-shafaa’at kijiye,
Naar sey bachne ki soorat kijiye.

Unke naqshe paa pe ghairat kijiye,
Aankh sey chhup kar ziyaarat kijiye.

Unke husn-e-baa malaahat par nisaar,
Sheera jaan ki halaawat kijiye.

Unke dar par jaise ho mit jaaiye,
Naa-tawaano! Kuch to himmat kijiye.

Phair dije panja-e-dev-e-la’een,
Mustafa key bal pe taaqat kijiye.

Doob kar yaad-e-lab-e-shaadab mein,
Aab-e-kausar ki sabaahat kijiye.

Yaad-e-qaamat karte utthiye qabr sey,
Jaan-e-mehshar par qiyamat kijiye.

Un key dar par baitthiye ban kar faqeer,
Be-nawaao fikr-e-sarwat kijiye.

Jis ka husn Allah ko bhi bhaa gaya,
Aise pyaare sey mohabbat kijiye.

Hayy Baaqi jiski karta hay thanaa,
Marte dam tak uski midhat kijiye.

Arsh par jiski kamaane charh gayeen,
Sadqe us baazu pe quwwat kijiye.

Neem wa Taybah key phoolon par ho aankh,
Bulbulo! paas-e-nazaakat kijiye.

Sar sey girta hay abhi baare gunaah,
Kham zara farq-e-iraadat kijiye.

Aankh to utthti nahin kia dein jawaab,
Hum pe be pursish hi rehmat kijiye.

‘Uzr-e-badtar az gunaah ka zikr kya,
Be sabab hum par ‘inaayat kijiye.

Na’rah kijiye Yaa RasoolAllah ka,
Mufliso! saamaane daulat kijiye.

Hum tumhaare hoke kis key paas jaayein,
Sadqa shahzaadon ka rehmat kijiye.

Man ra aani qad ra al Haq jo kahein,
Kya bayaan uski haqiqat kijiye.

‘Aalim-e-‘ilm do aalam hain Huzoor,
Aap sey kya ‘arz haajat kijiye.

Aap sultan-e-jahaan hum be-nawaa,
Yaad hum ko waqt-e-ne’mat kijiye.

Tujh sey kya kya aay mere Taybah key chaand,
Zulmat-e-gham ki shikaayat kijiye.

Dar badar kab tak phirrain khasta kharaab,
Taiba mein madfan ‘inaayat kijiye.

Har baras wo qaafilon ki dhoom dhaam,
Aah suniye aur ghaflat kijiye.

Phir palat kar munh na us jaanib kiya,
Sach hay aur da’waa-e-ulfat kijiye.

Aqriba hubb-e-watan be himmati,
Aah kis kis ki shikaayat kijiye.

Ab to Aaqa munh na dikhane ka nahin,
Kis tarah raf’-e- nadaamat kijiye.

Apne haathon khud luta baitthe hain ghar,
Kis pe da’waa-e-bazaa’at kijiye.

Kis sey kahiye kya kiya kya ho gaya,
Khud hi apne par malaamat kijiye.

‘Arz ka bhi ab to moonh parta nahin,
Kia ‘ilaaj-e-dard-e-furqat kijiye.

Apni ek meetthi nazar key shahed sey,
Chaara-e-zahr-e-museebat kijiye.

De Khuda himmat keh yah jaan-e-hazeen,
Aap par waarein woh soorat kijiye.

Aap hum sey barh key hum par meherbaan,
Hum kare jurm Aap rehmat kijiye.

Jo na bhoola hum ghareebon ko RAZA,
Yaad uski apni ‘aadat kijiye.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: DUSHMAN-E-AHMAD PE SHIDDAT KIJIYE

shers.roman:
Dushman-e-Ahmad pe shiddat kijiye,
Mulhidon ki kya murawwat kijiye.

Zikr un ka cheriye har baat mein,
Cherna shaitaan ka aadat kijiye.

Mithle Faras zalzale ho najd mein,
Zikr-e-aayate wilaadat kijiye.

Ghaiz mein jal jaayein be-deeno key dil,
Ya RasoolAllah ki kasrat kijiye.

Kijiye charcha unhi ka subho shaam,
Jaane kafir par qayaamat kijiye.

Aap dargaah-e-Khuda mein hi wajih,
Haan shafaa’at baalo jaahat kijiye.

Haqq tumhein farma chukka apna Habib,
Abb shafaa’at bil-Mohabbat kijiye.

Izn kab ka mil chukka ab to Huzoor,
Hum gharibon ki shafa’at kijiye.

Mulhidon ka shak nikal jaaye Huzoor,
Jaanib-e-mah phir ishaarat kijiye.

Shirk thehre jis mein ta’zime Habib,
Uss bure mazhab pe la’nat kijiye.

Zalimo! Mehboob ka haqq tha yahi,
‘Ishq key badle ‘adaawat kijiye.

Wadduha Hujraat Alam Nashrah sey phir,
Momino! itmaame hujjat kijiye.

Baitthtay utthtay Huzoor-e-Paak sey,
Ilteja-o-iste’aanat kijiye.

Yaa RasoolAllah duhayi aap ki,
Goshmaale ahl-e-bid’at kijiye.

Ghaus-e-Aazam aap sey fariyad hay,
Zinda phir yeh paak millat kijiye.

Yaa Khuda tujh tak hay sab ka muntahaa,
Awliya ko hukm-e-nusrat kijiye.

Mere Aaqa Hazrate Ache Miyan,
Ho RAZA achha woh soorat kijiye.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SHUKR-E-KHUDA KEY AAJ GHARRI USS SAFAR KI HAY

shers.roman:
Shukr-e-Khuda key aaj gharri uss safar ki hay,
Jis par nithaar jaan falaah-o-zafar ki hay.

Garmi hay tapp hay dard hay kulfat safar ki hay,
Na shukr ye to dekh ‘azeemat kidhar ki hay.

Kis khaak-e-paak ki tu banee khaak-e-paa shifa,
Tujhko qasam janaab-e-maseeha key sar ki hay.

Aabe hayaat-e-ruh hay 'zarqa' ki boond boond,
Akseer a'zam-e-mase dil khaak dar ki hay.

Humko to apne saaye main aaram hi sey laaye,
Heele bahaane waalon ko ye raah dar ki hay.

Lut-te hain maare jaate hain yun hi suna kiye,
Har baar di wo aman key ghairat hadar ki aai.

Wo dekho jagmagati hay shab aur qamar abhi,
Pehron nahin key bast-o-chaharum safar ki hay.

Maah-e-Madīnah apni tajalli ataa kare,
Ye dhalti chandni to pehar do pehar Ki Hay.

Mann Zaara-Turbatee Wajabat Lahu Shafaa'ati,
Un par Durood jinse naveed in bushar ki hay.

Usske tufail Hajj bhi Khuda ne kara diye,
Asl-e-muraad haazri iss paak dar ki hay.

Ka'abe ka naam tak na liya Taybah hi kaha,
Poocha tha humse jisne key nuhzat kidhar ki hay.

Ka'aba bhi hay inhin ki tajalli ka aik zill,
Roushan inhin key aks sey Putli hajar ki hay.

Hote kahaan Khaleel-o-bina Ka'aba-o-Mina,
Low laak waale Saahibi sab tere ghar ki hay.

Maula Ali ne waari teri neend par Namaz,
Aur woh bhi Asr sabse jo aa’la khatar ki hay.

Siddeeq balke ghaar main jaan uss pe de chuke,
Aur hifz-e-jaan to jaan furuz-e-ghurar ki hay.

Haan tu ne unko jaan unhain pher di namaz,
Par woh to kar chuke the jo karni bashar ki hay.

Saabit hua key jumla faraiz furu'u hain,
Aslul usool bandagi uss taajwar ki hay.

Shar khair, shor sur, sharar door, naar nur,
Bushra key baargaah ye khairul bashar ki hay.

Mujrim bulaye aaye hain 'Jaaooka' hay gawah,
Phir rad ho kab ye shaan kareemon key dar ki hay.

Bad hain magar unhi key hain baaghi nahin hain hum,
najdi na aaye usko ye manzil khatar ki hay.

Tuf najdiyat na kufr na Islam sab pe haraf,
Kafir idhar ki hay na udhar ki adhar ki hay.

Haakim hakeem daado dawa dain ye kuch na dain,
Mardood ye muraad kis aayat khabar ki hay.

Shakl-e-bashar mein noor-e-Ilahi agar na ho,
Kya qadr uss khameera-e-maao madar ki hay.

Noor-e-Ilaah kya hay mahabbat Habeeb ki,
Jis dil main ye na ho wo jagah khouk-o-khar ki hay.

Zikre Khuda jo unse judaa chaaho najdiyo,
Wallāh zikre Haq nahin kunji saqqar ki hay.

Be unke waaste key Khuda kuch ‘ataa kare,
Haashaa ghalat ghalat ye hawas be-basar ki hay.

Maqsood ye hay Aadam-o-Nooh-o-Khaleel Se,
Tukhme karam main saari karaamat thamar ki hay.

Unki Nubuwwat unki ubuwwat hay sabko aam,
Ummul bashar aroos unhin key pisar ki hay.

Zaahir main mere phool Haqeeqat mein mere nakhl,
Uss gul ki yaad main ye sadaa bul bashar ki hay.

Pehle ho unki yaad keh paaye jila namaz,
Yeh kehti hay azaan jo pichle pehar ki hay.

Duniya mazaar hashr jahaan hain Ghafoor hain,
Har manzil apne chaand ki manzil Ghafar ki hay.

Un par Durood jinko hajar tak karain salaam,
Un par Salaam jinko Tahiyyat shajar ki hay.

Un par Durood jinko kasse be-kasan kahain,
Un par Salaam jinko khabar be-khabar ki hay.

Jinn-o-bashar salaam ko haazir hain assalaam,
Yeh bargaah maalik-e-jinn-o-bashar ki hay.

Shams-o-qamar salaam ko haazir hain assalaam,
Khubi unhin ki jyot sey shamso qamar ki hay.

Sab bahr-o-bar salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Tamlik unhin key naam to har bahr-o-bar ki hay.

Sang-o-shajar salaam ko haazir hain assalaam,
Kalme sey tar zabaan darakht-o-hajar ki hay.

Arzo athar salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Malja ye baargah dua-o-athar ki hay.

Shorida sar salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Raahat unhin key qadmon main shorida sar ki hay.

Khasta jiggar salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Marham yahin ki khaak to khasta jigar ki hay.

Sab khushk-o-tar salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Ye jalwa gaah maalik-e-har khushk-o-tar ki hay.

Sab karro far salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Topi yahin to khaaq pe har karro far ki hay.

Ahl-e-nazzar salaam ko hazir hain assalaam,
Ye gard hi to surma sab ahl-e-nazzar ki hay.

Aansu bahaa keh beh gaye kaale gunah key dher,
Haathi dubao jheel yahaan chashm-e-tar ki hay.

Teri qaza khaleefa-e-ahkaame zil jalaal,
Teri RAZA haleef qaza-o-qadar ki hay.

Yeh pyaari pyaari kyaari tere khaana baagh ki,
Sard uski aab-o-taab sey aatish saqar ki hay.

Jannat main aa key naar main jaata nahin koi,
Shukr-e-Khuda naweed najaat-o-zafar ki hay.

Mo'min hun mo'minon Pe Rauf-o-Raheem ho,
Saa-il hun saa-ilon ko khushi laa-nahar ki hay.

Daaman ka waasta mujhe uss dhoop sey bachaa,
Mujhko to shaaq jaaron main iss dopehr ki hay.

Maa donon bhai bete bhateeje azeez dost,
Sab tujhko soumpe milk hi sab tere ghar ki hay.

Jin jin muraadon key liye ahbaab ne kaha,
Peshe khabeer kya mujhe haajat khabar ki hay.

Fazle Khuda sey ghaib-e-shahadat hua unhe,
Iss par shahaadat aayat-o-wahi-o-athar ki hay.

Kehna na kehne waale the jab sey tu ittela'a,
Maula ko Qowl-o-Qaail-o-har khushk-o-tar ki hay.

Unn par kitaab utri bayaanan li-Kulli Shay,
Tafseel jis main maa abar wa maa ghabar ki hay.

Aage rahi ‘ataa wo baqadr-e-talab to kya,
‘Aadat yahaan ummeed sey bhi beshtar ki hay.

Be maange dene wale ki ne'mat me gharq hain,
Maange sey jo mile kise feham iss qadar ki hay.

Ahbaab iss sey barh key to shaayad na paayein arz,
Naa karda ‘arz ‘arz ye tarze digar ki hay.

Dandaan kaa naat khwaan hoon na paayaab hogi aab,
Naddi galey galey mere aab-e-guhar ki hay.

Dashte Haram main rehne de sayyaad agar tujhe,
Mitti azeez bulbul-e-be-baal-o-par ki hay.

Yaa Rabb RAZA na Ahmad-e-parina hoke jaay,
Ye baargah tere Habeeb-e-Abar ki hay.

Taufeeq de key aage na paida ho khu-e- bad,
Tabdeel kar jo khaslat-e-bad peshtar ki hay.

Aa kuch sunaa de ishq key bolon main aay RAZA,
Mushtaq tab-e- lazzat-e-soz-e-jigar ki hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: BHEENI SUHAANI SUBHA MEIN THANDAK JIGAR KI HAY

shers.roman:
Bheeni suhaani subha mein thandak jigar ki hay,
Kaliyaa(n) khilee(n) dilon ki hawa yeh kidhar ki hay.

Khubti huwi nazar mein adaa kis sahar ki hay,
Chubhti huwi jigar mein sadaa kis gajar ki hay.

Daalein hari hari hay to baalein bhari bhari,
Kishte amal pari hay yeh baarish kidhar ki hay.

Hum jaayein aur qadam sey lipat kar haram kahe,
Sounpa Khuda ko yeh azmat kis safar ki hay.

Hum gird’-e-ka’aba phirte the kal tak aur aaj woh,
Hum par nisaar hay yeh iraadat kidhar ki hay.

Kalak jabee(n) ki sajda-e-dar sey churaao gay,
Mujh ko bhi le chalo yeh tamanna hajar ki hay.

Dooba huwa hay shouq mein Zam Zam aur aankh sey,
Jhaale baras rahe hain yeh hasrat kidhar ki hay.

Barsa key jaane waalon pey gohar karoon nisaar,
Abr-e-karam sey arz yeh meezaab-e-zar ki hay.

Aaghoosh’-e-shouq khole hay jin key liye hateem,
Woh phir key dekhte nahin yeh dhun kidhar ki hay.

Haan haan rah-e-Madinah hay Ghaafil zara tu jaag,
Oh paaon rakhne waale yeh jaa(n) chashm-o-sar ki hay.

Waaroon qadam qadam pe keh har dam hay jaan-e-nao,
Yeh raah-e-jaa(n) fiza mere Maula key dar ki hay.

Ghariyaa(n) gini hay barso keh yeh sub gharri phiri,
Marmar key phir yeh sil mere seeney sey sar ki hay.

Allahu Akbar apne qadam aur ye khaak-e-paak,
Hasrat Malaaika ko jahaan waz’-e-sar ki hay.

Me’raaj ka samaa(n) hay kahaan pahonche zaairo!
Kursi sey oonchi kursi usi paak ghar ki hay.

Ushhaq-e-rouza sajde mein suwe haram jhuke,
Allah jaanta hay keh niyyat kidhar ki hay.

Yeh ghar yeh dar hay Uskaa jo ghar dar sey paak hay,
Muzhdah ho be-gharo keh salaa achhe ghar ki hay.

Mehboobe Rabb-e-Arsh hay is sabz qubba mein,
Pehlu mein jalwah-gah Ateeq-o-Umar ki hay.

Chaaye Malaika hain lagaataar hay durood!
Badle hain pahre badli mein baarish durar ki hay.

Sa’dayn ka qiraan hay pahluw-e-maah mein,
Jhurmut kiye hain taare tajalli qamar ki hay.

Sattar hazaar subh mein sattar hazaar shaam,
Yoon bandagiye zulf-o-rukh aattho(n) pahar ki hay.

Jo ek baar aaye dobarah nah aayenge,
Rukhsat hi baargah sey bas is qadar ki hay.

Tarpa karein badal key phir aana kahaan naseeb,
Bey hukm kab majaal parinde ko par ki hay.

Aay waye beikasiy-e-tamanna key ab ummeed,
Din ko nah shaam ki hay na shab ko sahar ki hay.

Yeh badliyaa(n) nah ho toh karoro(n) ki aas jaye,
Aur bargaah-e-marhamat-e-aam tar ki hay.

Ma’soomon ko hay ‘umr mein sirf ek baar baar,
Aasi parey rahein toh salaa umr bhar ki hay.

Zinda raheín to haazriy-e-baargaah naseeb,
Mar jaayein to hayaat-e-abad aysh ghar ki hay.

Muflis aur aisey dar sey phirey be-ghani huwe,
Cháandi har ik tarah to yahaan gadiya gar ki hay.

Jaanaa() pe takiya khaak nihaali hay dil nihaal,
Haan be-nawaao khoob yeh soorat guzar ki hay.

Hain chatr-o-takht saaya-e-deewaar-o-khaak-e-dar,
Shaaho(n) ko kab naseeb yeh dhaj kar-o-far ki hay.

Iss paak ko mein khaak yeh basar sar-ba-khaak hain,
Samjhe hain kuch yahi jo haqiqat basar ki hay.

Kyoon Taajdaaro! khwaab mein dekhi kabhi yeh shai,
Jo aaj jholiyon mein gadayaane dar ki hay.

Jaaru-kasho(n) mein chehre likhey hain mulook key,
Woh bhi kahaan naseeb faqat naam bhar ki hay.

Taibah mein mar key thande chaley jaao aankhein bandh,
Seedhi sarak yeh shahre shafaaát nagar ki hay.

Aasi bhi haín chaheetey yeh Taibah hay zaahido!
Makkah nahin key jaanch jahaan khair-o-shar ki hay.

Shaan-e-jamaal Taibah jaanaa(n) hay ‘nafa mahz!
Wus’at jalaal-e-Makkah mei sood-o-zarar ki hay.

Ka’bah hay beshak anjuman-aara dulhan magar,
Saari bahaar dhulhano(n) mein dulhaa key ghar ki hay.

Ka’abah dulhan hay turbat-e-at-har nayi dulhan,
Yeh rashk-e-aaftaab woh ghairat qamar ki hay.

Dono bani(n) sajeeli aneeli bani magar,
Jo pee key paas hay woh suhaagan kunwar ki hay.

Sar sabz-e-wasl yeh hay siyaa posh-e-ijr woh,
Chamki dupatto(n) sey hay jo haalat jigar ki hay.

Maa-o-shumaa toh kya keh Khaleel-e-Jaleel ko,
kal dhekna keh unse tamanna nazar ki hay.

Apna sharaf dua sey hay baaqi raha qubool,
Yeh jaanein unke haath mein kunji asar ki hay.

Jo chaahey unse maang key dono jahaa(n) ki khair,
Zar naa-khareedah ek kaneez unke ghar ki hay.

Roomi ghulaam din habshi baandiyaa(n) shabee(n),
Ginti kaneez zaado(n) mein shaam-o-sahar ki hay.

Itna ajab bulandiy’-e-Jannat pey kisliye,
Dekha nahin key bheekh yeh kis oonchey ghar ki hay.

‘Arsh-e-bari pe kyoon nah ho Firdous ka dimaagh,
Utri huwi shabeeh tere baam-o-dar ki hay.

Woh Khuld jis mein utregi abraar ki baraat,
Adnaa nichaawar us mere dulha key sar ki hay.

Amber zamee(n), abeer huwa mushk-e-tar ghubaar!
Adnaa si yeh shanaakht teri rahguzar ki hay.

Sarkar hum gawaaro(n) mei tarz-e-adab kahaan,
Humko toh bas tameez yahi bheekh bhar ki hay.

Maangenge maange jaayenge moonh maangi paayenge,
Sarkar mein nah laa hay nah hajat agar ki hay.

Uff be-hayaaiyaa(n) key yeh moonh aur tere Huzoor,
Haan tu kareem hay teri khu dar guzar ki hay.

Tujh sey chupaaun moonh toh karoon kiske saamne,
Kya aur bhi kisi sey tawaqqo nazar ki hay.

Jaaon kahaan pukarun kisey kis ka muh taku(n),
Kya pursish aur jaa bhi sag-e-be-hunar ki hay.

Baab-e-‘ataa toh yeh hay jo bahkaa idhar udhar,
Kaisi kharaabi uss nagharey dar-ba-dar ki hay.

Aabad ek dar hay tera aur tere siwa,
Jo baargah dekhiye ghairat khandar ki hay.

Lub waa hain aankhein bandh hain phayli hain jholiyaan,
Kitne maze ki bheek tere paak dar ki hay.

Ghera andheriyo ney duhaaee hay chaand ki,
Tanha hoon kaali raat hay manzil khatar ki hay.

Qismat mein laakh pech hon sau bal hazaar kaaj,
Yeh saari guthi ik teri seedhi nazar ki hay.

Aisi bandhi naseeb khule mushkilein khuli(n),
Dono jahaa(n) mein dhoom tumhari kamar ki hay.

Jannat nah dein, nah dein, teri rooyat ho khair sey,
Is gul key aagey kisko hawas barg-o-bar ki hay.

Sharbat nah dein, nah dein, to karey baat lutf sey,
Yeh shahad ho toh phir kisey parwa shakar ki hay.

Mein khaanah-zaad kohna hu surat likhi huwi,
Bando(n) kaneezo(n) mein mere maadar pidar ki hay.

Mangta ka haath utthte hi daata ki dayn thi,
Doori qubool-o-‘arz mein bas haath bhar ki hay.

Sanki wo dekh baada-e-shafaa’at ki de hawaa,
Yeh aabru RAZA tere damaan-e-tar ki hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: WOH SARWAR-E-KISHWAR-E-RISAALAT

shers.roman:
Woh sarwar-e-kishwar-e-risaalat jo arsh par jalwah gar huwe thay,
Naye niraale tarab kay saamaan ‘Arab key mehman kay liye thay.

Bahaar hay shaadiyaan mubaarak chaman ko aabaadiyan mubaarak,
Malak falak apni apni lay mein yeh ghar ‘anaa dil ka boltay thay.

Wahaan falak par yahaan zameen mein rachi thi shaadi machi thi dhoomein,
Udhar say anwaar hanstay aatay idhar say nafhaat utth rahay thay.

Yeh chhoott parrti thi unkay rukh ki kay ‘arsh tak chaandni thi chhatki,
Woh raat kya jagmaga rahi thi jagah jagah nasab aainay thay.

Nayi dulhan ki phaban main ka’aba nikhar kay sanwara sanwar kay nikhraa,
Hajar key sadqay kamar key ik til main rang laakhon baanaw key thay.

Nazar main dulhaa key pyaaray jalway hayaa say mehraab sar jhukaayae,
Siyaah parday kay munh par aanchal tajalliy-e-zaat-e-bahat say thay.

Khushi kay baadal umand kay aaye dilon kay taaoos rang laaye,
Woh naghmaa-e-na’at ka samaan tha Haram ko khud wajd aa rahe thay.

Yeh jhooma Meezaab-e-zar ka jhoomar ki aa raha kaan par dhalak kar,
Phuhaar barsi to moti jhar kar Hateem ki gaud mein bharey thay.

Dulhan ki khushboo say mast kapray naseem-e-gustaakh aanchlon say,
Ghilaaf-e-mushkeen jo ur raha tha ghazaal naaf-e-basa rahay thay.

Pahaariyon ka woh husn-e-Taz’een woh oonchi choti woh naaz-o-tamkeen,
Sabaa say sabzah main lehrein aateen dupattay dhaani chunay huye thay.

Nahaa kay nehron nay woh chamakta libaas aab-e-rawaan kaa pehna,
Kay maujein chhariyaan thi dhaar lachkaa habaab-e-taabaan kay thal tikey thay.

Puraana purdaagh malgajaa tha utthaa diya farsh chaandni kaa,
Hujoom-e-taare nigah say koson qadam-qadam farsh baadley thay.

Ghubaar ban kar nisaar jaayein kahaan ab uss rah guzar ko paayein,
Hamaaray dil hooriyon ki aankhein farishton kay par jahaan bichhe thay.

Khuda hee day sabr jaan-e-purgham dikhaaoon kyoon kar tujhay woh ‘aalam,
Jab unko jhurmat mein lay kay qudsi jina kaa dulha bana rahay thay.

Utaar kar unkay rukh ka sadqa yeh noor ka bat raha tha baara,
kay chaand suraj machal machal kar jabeen ki khairaat mangtay thay.

Wohi to ab tak chalak raha hay wohi to joban tapak raha hay,
Naahanay may jo gira tha paani katoray taaron nay bhar liye thay.

Bachaa jo talwon ka unkay dhowan banaa woh Jannat ka rang-o-rogan,
Jinhon nay dulhaa ki payi utran woh phool gulzaar-e-noor kay thay.

Khabar yeh tehweel-e-maher ki thi kay rut suhaani gharri phiray gee,
Wahaan ki poshaak zeb-e-tan ki yahaan ka joraa barhaa chukay thay.

Tajalliy-e-Haq ka sehra sar par salaat-o-tasleem ki nichaawar,
Do ruya qudsi parey jamaa kar kharey salaami kay waastey thay.

Jo hum bhi waan hotay khaak-e-gulshan lipat kay qadmon say letey utran,
Magar karein kya naseeb main to yeh naamuraadi kay din likhay thay.

Abhi na aaye thay pusht-e-zeen tak kay sar hui maghfirat ki shillak,
Sadaa shafaa’at nay di mubaarak! gunaah mastaana jhoomtay thay.

‘Ajab na tha rakhsh ka chamakna ghazaal-e-dam khurdah saa bharakna,
Shu’aaein bukkay urraa rahi theen tarapte aankhon pay saa’iqay thay.

Hujoom-e-ummeed hay ghataao muraadein day kar inhein hataao,
Adab ki baagein liye barhaao malaaika may yeh ghal-ghale thay.

Utthi jo gard-e-rah-e-munawar woh noor barsaa kay raaste bhar,
Ghiray thay baadal bharay thay jal thal umand kay jungle ubal rahay thay.

Sitam kya kaisi mat kati thi qamar woh khaak unkay rah guzar ki,
Utthaa na laaya kay maltay maltay yeh daagh sab dekhta mitey thay.

Buraaq kay naqsh-e-sum kay sadqe woh gul khilaaye kay saarey rastey,
Mehaktay gulban mehaktay gulshan hare bhare lahlaha rahe thay.

Namaaz-e-Aqsa mein tha yehi sir ‘ayaan ho ma’ni-e-awwal aakhir,
Kay dast basta hain pichey haazir jo saltanat aagay kar gaye thay.

Yeh unki aamad ka dab-daba tha nikhaar her shaiy ka ho raha tha,
Nujoom-o-aflaak jaam-o-meena ujaaltay thay khangaaltay thay.

Naqaab ultay woh mehr-e-anwar jalaal rukhsaar garmiyon par,
Falak ko haibat say tap charrhi thi tapaktay anjum kay aablay thay.

Yeh joshish-e-noor ka asar tha key aab-e-gohar kamar kamar tha,
Safaa-e-rah say phisal phisal kar sitaare qadmon pay laut tey thay.

Barhaa yeh lehra kay behr-e-wahdat key dhul gaya naam-e-raige kasrat,
Falak key teloon ki kiya haqeeqat yeh arsh-o-kursi do bulbule thay.

Woh zill-e-rehmat woh rukh key jalwe key taare chupte na khilne paate,
Sunehri zarbaft udi atlas yeh than sab dhoop chaaon key thay.

Chalaa woh sarve-e-chamaan khiraamaan na ruk saka sidrah say bhi daaman,
Palak jhapakti rahi woh kab kay sab aen-o-aan say guzar chuke thay.

Jhalak see ik qudsiyon par aayi hawa bhi daaman ki phir na paayi,
Sawaari dulha ki door pohonchi baraat main hosh hi gaye thay.

Thakay thay Rooh-ulAmeen key baazu chhuta woh daaman kahaan woh pehloo,
Rikaab chhooti ummeed tooti nigaah-e-hasrat key walwaley thay.

Rawish ki garmi ko jis ney socha dimaagh say ik bhabuka phoota,
Khir’ad key jungle mein phool chamka dahar dahar payr jal rahe thay.

Jilo mein jo murgh-e-aqal uray thay ‘ajab buray haalon girtay partay,
Woh sidrah hee par rahey thay thak kar charhaa thaa dam tewar aa gaye thay.

Qavi they murghan-e-waham kay par uray to urnay ko aur dam bhar,
Utthaayi seenay ki aisi tthokar kay khoon-e-andesha thoo’ktay thay.

Suna yeh itnay mein ‘arsh-e-Haq nay kay lay mubaarak ho taaj waaley,
Wohi qadam khair say phir aaye jo pehle taaj-e-sharaf tere thay.

Yeh sunkay baay khud pukaar uttha nisaar jaaon kahaan hain Aaqa,
Phir unkay talwon ka paaoon bosa yeh meri aankhon kay din phire thay.

Jhukaa tha mujre ko ‘arsh-e-aa’la gire they sajde may bazm-e-baala,
Yeh aankhein qadmon say mal raha tha woh gird-e-qurbaan ho rahay thay.

Ziyaaein kuch ‘arsh par yeh aayin kay saari qindeelen jagmagaayi,
Huzoor-e-khursheed kya chamaktay charaagh moonh apna dekhtay thay.

Yehi samaa(n) tha kay paik-e-rehmat khabar yeh laaya kay chaliye Hazrat,
Tumhaari khaatir kushaada hain jo kaleem per band rastaay thay.

Barh aay Muhammad qareen ho Ahmad qareeb aa sarwar-e-mumajjad,
Nisaar jaaon yeh kya nida thi yeh kya samaa(n) tha yeh kya mazay thay.

Tabaarakallah shaan teri tujhi ko zaiba hay bayniyaazi,
Kahin to woh josh-e-lan-tarani kaheen taqaazay wisaal kay thay.

Khirad say keh do kay sar jhukaa lay gumaan say guzray guzarnay waalay,
Pare hain yaan khud jaihat ko laalay kisay bataaye kidhar gaye thay.

Suraagh ain-o-mataa kahaan tha nishaan-e-kaif-o-ilaa kahaan tha,
Nah koi raahi nah koi saathi nah sang-e-manzil nah marhalay thay.

Udhar say payham taqaazay aana idhar tha mushkil qadam barhaana,
Jalaal-o-haibat ka saamna tha jamaal-o-rehmat ubhaartay thay.

Barhay to lekin jhi-jhaktay dartay hayaa say jhuktay adab say ruktay,
Jo qurb unhi ki ravish pay rakhtay to laakhon manzil kay faaslay thay.

Par unka barhna to naam ko tha haqeeqa’tan fail tha udhar ka,
Tanazzulon mein taraqi afza dana tadalla key silsilay thay.

Huwa nah aakhir kay aik bajra tamoojay bahr-e-hoo mein ubhra,
Danaa ki godi mein unko lekar fana kay langar uttha diye thay.

Kisay milay ghaat ka kinara kidhar say guzra kahaan utaara,
Bhara jo misl-e-nazar taraaraa woh apni aankhon say khud chupay thay.

Utthay jo Qasr-e-danaa kay parde koi khabar dey to kya khabar day,
Wahaan to jaa hee nahin duee ki na keh kay woh bhi na thay aray thay.

Woh baagh kuch aisa rang laaya kay guncha-o-gul ka farq utthaya,
Girah mein kaliyon ki baagh phoolay gulon kay tukmay lagay huay thay.

Muheet-o-markaz mein farq mushkil rahe na faasil khutoot-e-waasil,
Kamaanein hairat mein sar jhukaaye ‘ajeeb chakkar mein daaeray thay.

Hijaab utthnay mein laakhon parde har aik parday main laakhon jalway,
‘Ajab ghari thi kay wasl-o-furqat janam kay bichray galay milay thay.

Zabaanein sookhi dikha kay mojein tarap rahi thi kay paani paayein,
Bhanwar ko yeh zofay tashnagi tha kay halqay aankhon mein par gaye thay.

Wohi hay awwal wohi hay aakhir wohi hay baatin wohi hay zaahir,
Usi kay jalway usi say milnay usi say uski taraf gaye thay.

Kamaan-e-imkaan kay jhootay nuqto tum awwal akhir ki phair mein ho,
Muheet ki chaal say to poochho kidhar say aaye kidhar gaye thay.

Udhar say thi(n) nazr-e-shah namaaz’ein idhar say in’aam-e-khusravi mein,
Salaam-o-Rehmat kay haar gundh kar guloo-e-pur noor mein paray thay.

Zabaan ko intezaar guftan to gosh ko hasrat-e-shuneedan,
Yahaan jo kehna tha keh liya tha jo baat sun ni thi sun chukay thay.

Woh burj-e-bat-ha ka maah-paarah bahesht ki sair ko Sidhaara,
Chamak pay tha khuld ka sitaarah kay uss qamar kay qadam gaye thay.

Suroor-e-maqdam ki roshni thi keh taabishon say mah-e-‘arab ki,
Jinaan kay gulshan thay jhaar farshi jo phool thay sab kanwal banay thay.

Tarab ki naazish kay haan lachakiye adab woh bandish kay hil na sakiye,
Yeh josh-e-zideen tha keh paudey kashaa kash-e-arrah kay talay thay.

Khuda ki qudrat keh chand Haq kay karoron manzil mein jalwa kar kay,
Abhi na taaron ki chhaaon badli keh noor kay tarkay aa liye thay.

Nabi-e-Rehmat Shafi’-e-Ummat RAZA pay Lillaah ho ‘inaayat,
Isay bhi unn khil’atoon say hissa jo khaas rahmat kay waan bate thay.

Sanaa-e-Sarkaar hay wazifa qabool-e-Sarkaar hay tamanna,
Na shaa’iri ki hawas na parwah rawi thi kya kaisay qafiye thay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SACHI BAAT SIKHATAY YEH HAIN

shers.roman:
Sachi baat sikhatay yeh hain,
Seedhi raah chalatay yeh hain.

Hilti niyuw jamaatay yeh hain,
Tooti aas bandhaatay yeh hain.

Jalti jaan bujhaatay yeh hain,
Rowti aankh hansaatay yeh hain.

Rab hay mu’tee yeh hain Qaasim,
Rizq uss ka hay khilaatay yeh hain.

Us ki bakhshish in ka sadqa,
Detaa woh hay dilaatay yeh hain.

Inna a’ataina kal kowthar,
Saari kathrat paatay yeh hain.

Thanda thanda meetha meetha,
Peetay ham hain pilaatay yeh hain.

Naz’-e-e- rooh mein aasaani dain,
kalima yaad dilaatay yeh hain.

Marqad mein bandon ko thapak kar,
Meethi neend sulaatay yeh hain.

Maa jab iklotay ko choray,
Aa aa keh kar key bulaatay yeh hain.

Sallim sallim ki dhaaras say,
Pul say paar chalaatay yeh hain.

Apnay bharam say ham halkon ka,
Palla bhaari banaatay yeh hain.

Apni bani hum aap bigaarain,
Kaun banaaye banaatay yeh hain.

Rangay be rangon ka pardah,
Daaman dhak kay chupaatay yeh hain.

Raafi’ naafi’ shaafi’ daafi’,
Kya kya rahmat laatay yeh hain.

Faiz-e-jaleel khaleel say poocho,
Aag mein baagh lagaatay yeh hain.

In key haath mein har kunji hay,
Maalik-e-kul kehlaatay yeh hain.

Qasr-e-dana tak kis ki rasaai,
Jaate yeh hain aate yeh hain.

Keh do RAZA sey khush ho khush reh,
Muzda RAZA ka sunaatay yeh hain.

RUBAA’YAAT
Aatey rahein Ambiya qamaa qeela lahum,

Wal-khaatamu haqqukum key khaatam huwe tum.
Ya’ani jo huwa daftar-e-tanzeel tama'am,

Aakhir mein huwi mouhar key akqmaltu lakqum.
Shab lahya woh shaarib hay rukh-e-raushan din,

Gesu-o-woh shab-e-Qadr-o-Baara’at-e-Momin,
MuzgaanMuzragaan ki safein chaar hain do abru hain,

Wal-fajr key pehlu mein Layaalin ashrin.
Allah ki sar ta ba-qadam shaan hay yeh,

In saa nahin insaan woh insaan hain yeh,
Qur’an to imaan bataata hay inhein,

Imaan yeh kehta hay meri jaan hain yeh.
Bosa-gahe ashaab woh mouhar-e-saami,

Woh shaanah-e-chup mein uski ambar faami,
Yeah tuarfa kehi hay ka’ba jaan-o-dil mein,

Sange aswad naseeb rukn-e-shaami.
Kaa’be sey agar turbat-e-shah faazil hay,

Kyoon baayen taraf uske liye manzil hay,
Is fikr mein jo dil ki taraf dhyaan gaya,

Samjha ki woh jism hay yah markade dil hay.
Tum chaaho toh qismat ki museebat tal jaaye,

Kyoon kar kahun saa’at sey qayamat tal jaaye,
Lillaah utthaa do rukh-e-raushan sey niqaab,

Maula meri aayi huwi shaamat tal jaaye.
Yaan shibh-e-shabeeh ka guzarna kaisa!,

Be misl ki tamsaal sanwarnaa kaisa,
Unka muta’alliq hay taraqqi pey mudaam,

Yeh Shah ki tawazu’ ka taqaaza hi nahin,
Tasweer kheenche unko gawaara hi nahin,

Maana hay yeh maani keh karam kya maaney,
Kheenchna toh yahaan kisi sey thehra hi nahin.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ALAA YAA AYYUHAS-SAAQI-ADIR KA’-SAN WA NAA WILHAA

shers.roman:
Alaa yaa ayyuhas-saaqi-adir ka’-san wa naa wilhaa,
Keh bar yaad-e-shahe kausar bana saazeym mehfilhaa.

Balaa baareed hubb-e-shaikh najdi bar wahaabiya,
Keh ishq aasaan namood awwal wale uftaad mushkilhaa.

Wahaabi gar che ikhfaami kunad bughz-e-Nabi lekin,
Nihaa(n) key maanad aan raaz-e-kaz-o-saazand mehfilhaa.

Tawahhub gaah mulk-e-hind iqaamat raa namie shaayad,
Jaras fariyaad mee daarad keh bar bandeed mahmilhaa.

Salaa-e-majlisam dar gosh-e-aamad bee(n) bia bishinaw,
Jaras mastaana mee goyad keh bar bandeed mahmilha.

Magar daa(n) roo azin mehfil rah-e-arbaab-e-sunnat rau,
Keh saalik bey khabar nabood ze raah-o-rasm manzilha.

Darin jalwat biyaa az raah-e-khalwat taa Khuda yaabi,
Mataa maa talqa man tahwaa da’iduniya-wa-amhilhaa.

Dilam qurbaanat aay dood-e-charaag-e-mehfil-e-maulid,
Ze taab-e-ja’d-e-mushkeenat che khoo(n) uftaad dar dilha.

Ghareeq-e-behr-e-ishq Ahmadiem az farhat-e-maulid,
Kujaa daanand haal-e-maa sabaksaaraan-e-saahilha.

RAZA mast-e-jaam-e-ishq saaghar baaz mee khwaahad,
Alaa yaa ayyuhas-saaqi-adir ka’-san wa naa wilhaa.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SUBHA TAIBAH MEIN HUI BAT-TAA HAY BAARA NOOR KAA

shers.roman:
Subha Taibah mein hui bat-taa hay baara noor kaa,
Sadqah lenay noor kaa aaya hay taara noor kaa.

Baagh-e-Taiba mein suhaanaa phool phoola noor kaa,
Mast-e-boo hain bulbulein padhti hain kalma noor kaa.

Baarhwein key chaand kaa mujra hay sajdah noor kaa,
Baarah burjon sey jhukaa ek ik sitaarah noor kaa.

Un key qasr-e-qadr sey Khuld eik kamrah noor kaa,
Sidrah paayein baagh mein nanhaa saa pauda noor kaa.

Arsh bhi firdaus bhi uss shaah-e-waala noor kaa,
Yeh muthamman burj woh mushkuw-e-a’laa noor kaa.

Aayi bid’at chaayi zulmat rang badla noor kaa,
Maah-e-sunnat mehr-e-tal’at ley ley badla noor kaa.

Tere hi maathe rahaa aay jaan-e-sehra noor kaa,
Bakht jaaga noor kaa chamkaa sitaaraa noor kaa.

Mein gadaa tu baadshah bhar dey piyaalah noor kaa,
Noor din doonaa tera dey daal sadqah noor kaa.

Teri hi jaanib hay paanchon waqt sajdah noor kaa,
Rukh hay Qibla noor kaa abru hay ka’aba noor kaa.

Pusht par dhalkaa sar-e-anwar sey shamla noor kaa,
Dekhein Moosa Toor sey utraa sahifa noor kaa.

Taaj waaley dekh kar tera ‘imaama noor kaa,
Sar jhukaatey hain Ilaahi bol baala noor kaa.

Beeni pur noor par rakhshaan hay bukkah noor kaa,
Hay liwaa-ul-hamd par urtaa phareraa noor kaa.

Mus-haf-e-aariz pey hay khat-e-shafee’ah noor kaa,
Lo siyahkaaro Mubarak ho qabalah noor kaa.

Aab-e-zar banta hay ‘aariz par paseena noor kaa,
Mus-haf-e-i’jaaz par charhta hay sona noor kaa.

Pech karta hay fida hone ko lam’ah noor kaa,
Gird-e-sar phirne ko banta hay ‘imaamah noor kaa.

Haibat-e-’aariz sey tharraata hay sho’la noor kaa,
Kafsh-e-paa par gir key ban jaata hay guppha noor kaa.

Sham’a dil mishkaat tan seena zujaajah noor kaa,
Teri soorat key liye aaya hay soorah noor kaa

Mail sey kis darja suthraa hay woh putla noor kaa,
Hay gale mein aaj tak kora hi kurtaa noor kaa.

Tere aagey khaak par jhukta hay maatha noor kaa,
Noor ne paaya tere sajde sey seema noor kaa.

Tu hay saaya noor ka har uzw tukrra noor kaa,
Saaya ka saaya nah hota hay nah saaya noor kaa.

Kya bana naam-e-Khuda asraa kaa dulha noor kaa,
Sar pey sehra noor kaa bar mein shahaanah noor kaa.

Bazm-e-wahdat mein mazaa hoga dobala noor kaa,
Milne sham’a Toor sey jaata hay ikka noor kaa.

Wasf-e-rukh mein gaati hain hoorein taraana noor kaa,
Qudrati beenon mein kya bajta hay lehra noor kaa.

Yeh kitaab-e-kun mein aayaa turfa aayah noor kaa,
Ghair-e-qaayil kuch nah samjhaa koi Ma’na noor kaa.

Dekhne waalon ney kuch dekha nah bhaala noor kaa,
Man ra’ aa kaisaa yeh aaina dikhaaya noor kaa.

Subha kardi kufr ki saccha tha muzda noor kaa,
Shaam hi sey tha shab-e-teerah ko dharrka noor kaa.

Parti hay noori bharan umdaa hay daryaa noor kaa,
Sar jhuka aay kisht-e-kufr aataa hay ahlaa noor kaa.

Naariyon ka daur tha dil jal raha tha noor kaa,
Tum ko dekhaa ho gaya thanda kalejaa noor kaa.

Naskh adiyaan karke khud qabza bithaaya noor kaa,
Taajwar ney kar liya kaccha ‘ilaaqah noor kaa.

Jo gadaa dekho liye jaata hay tora noor kaa,
Noor ki sarkaar hay kya isme tora noor kaa.

Bheekh ley sarkaar sey laa jald kaasah noor kaa,
Maah-e-naw Taibah mein bat-ta hay maheenah noor kaa.

Dekh unke hote naa zebaa hay da’waa noor kaa,
Mehr likh dey yaan key zarron ko muchalka noor kaa.

Yaan bhi daagh-e-sajdah-e-Taibah hay tamghaa noor kaa,
Aay qamar kya tere hi maathey hay teekaa noor kaa.

Sham’a saa(n) eik eik parwaanah hay is baa noor kaa,
Noor-e-Haq sey lau lagaaye dil mein rishtah noor kaa.

Anjuman waaley hain anjum bazm-e-halqa noor kaa,
Chaand par taaron key jhurmat sey hay haalah noor kaa.

Teri nasl-e-paak mein hay bacha bacha noor kaa,
Tu hay ‘ain-e-noor tera sab gharana noor kaa.

Noor ki sarkaar sey paaya doshala noor kaa,
Ho mubarak tum ko Zun-Noorain jora noor kaa.

Kis key parde ney kiya aaina andha noor kaa.
Maangta phirta hay aankhein har nageenah noor kaa.

Ab kahaan woh taabishein kaisa woh tarrka noor kaa,
Mehr ney chhup kar kiya khaasaa-o-dhundlakaa noor kaa.

Tum muqaabil the to pehron chaand barhta noor kaa,
Tum sey chhut kar moonh nikal aaya zara saa noor kaa.

Qabr-e-Anwar kahiye yaa qasr-e-mo’alla noor kaa,
Charkh-e-atlas yaa koi saadah saa qubba noor kaa.

Aankh mil sakti nahin dar par hay pehra noor kaa,
Taab hay bey hukm par maarey parindah noor kaa.

Naza’a mein lautega khaak-e-dar pey shaida noor kaa,
Mar key awrhegi uroos-e-jaan dupatta noor kaa.

Taab-e-mehr-e-hashr sey chaunke nah kushta noor kaa,
Boondiyaan rehmat ki deney aayin cheenta noor kaa.

Waz’-e-waaze’ mein teri soorat hay ma’na noor kaa,
Yoon majaazan chaahein jis ko keh dein kalma noor kaa.

Ambiya ajzaa hain tu bilkul hay jumla noor kaa,
Is ‘ilaaqe sey hay un par naam sachha noor kaa.

Yeh jo mehr-o-mah pey hay itlaaq aataa noor kaa,
Bheekh tere naam ki hay isti’aarah noor kaa.

Surmagin aankhein hareem-e-Haq key woh mushkin ghazaal,
Hay fazaaye laa makaan tak jinka ramnaa noor kaa.

Taab-e-husn-e-garm sey khil jaayenge dil key kanwal,
Nau bahaarein laayega garmi ka jhalka noor kaa.

Zar-e-mehr-e-quds tak tere tawassut sey gaye,
Had-e-ausat ney kiya sughraa ko kubraa noor kaa.

Sabzah gardon jhukaa tha behr-e-paa bos-e-Buraaq,
Phir nah seedha ho saka khaayaa woh kora noor kaa.

Taab-e-sum sey chaundhiyaa kar chaand unhein qadmon phira,
Hans key bijli ney kahaa dekhaa chalaawaa noor kaa.

Deed-e-naqsh-e-sum ko nikli saat pardon sey nigaah,
Putliyaan bolein chalo aaya tamaashaa noor kaa.

Aks-e-sum ney chaand sooraj ko lagaye chaar chaand,
Par gayaa seem-o-zar-e-gardawn pey sikkah noor kaa.

Chaand jhuk jaata jidhar ungli utthaatey mahd mein,
Kya hi chaltaa thaa ishaaron par khilona noor kaa.

Eik seena tak mushaabeh eik wahan sey paaon tak,
Husn-e-Sibtain un key jaamon mein hay neemaa noor kaa.

Saaf shakl-e-paak hay donon key milney sey ‘iyaan,
Khat tawam mein likha hay yeh do warqah noor kaa.

Kaaf gesu haa dahan yaa abru aankhein ‘ain saad,
Kaaf-haa-yaa-‘ain-saad unkaa hay chehrah noor kaa.

Aay RAZA yeh Ahmad-e-Noori ka faiz-e-noor hay.
Ho gayi meri ghazal barrh kar qaseedah noor kaa.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: UMMATAAN-O-SIYAAH KAAREHAA

shers.roman:
Ummataan-o-siyaah kaarehaa,
Shaaf’-e-hashr-o-gham gusaarehaa.

Door az kooye saahib-e-kausar,
Chashm daarad che ashkbaarehaa.

Dar firaaq-e-tu Yaa RasoolAllah,
Seenah daarad che bey qaraarehaa.

Zulmat aabaad-e-gowr raushan shud,
Daagh-e-dil raast noor baarehaa.

Che kunad nafs pardah dar Mawlaa,
Choon tooyi garm-e-pardah daarehaa.

Sag-e-kooye Nabi-o-yak nak-hey,
Man-o-taa hashr jaan nisaarehaa.

Saufa yu’teeka rabbuka tardaa,
Haq namoodat che paasdaarehaa.

Daaram aay gul bayaad-e-zulf-o-rakht,
Sahar-o-shaam aah-o-zaarehaa.

Taa zeh lutf-e-tou bar RAZA har dam,
Marham-e-kuhnah dil figaarehaa.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: TERA ZARRAH MAHE KAAMIL HAY YAA GHAUS

shers.roman:
Tera zarrah mahe kaamil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Tera qatrah yam-e- saail hay Yaa Ghaus.

Koi saalik hay ya waasil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Woh kuch bhi ho tera saail hay Yaa Ghaus.

Qad-e-be saaya zille kibriyaa hay,
Tu us be saaya zil ka zil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Teri jaageer mein hay sharq taa gharb,
Qalamro mein Haram taa hil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Dil ishq-o-rukh husn aaina hain,
Aur in dono mein tera zil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Teri sham’a dil aara ki tab-o-taab,
Gul-o-bulbul ki aab-o-gul hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tera majnoon tera sehra tera najd,
Teri laila tera mohmal hay Yaa Ghaus.

Yeh teri champayi rangat Husaini,
Hasan key chaand subh-e-dil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Gulistaan zaar teri pankhari hay,
kali sau khuld ka haasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ugaal us ka udhaar abraar ka ho,
Jise teri ulash haasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ishaare mein kiya jis ney qamar chaak,
Tu us mah kaa mah-e-kaamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jise ‘arsh-e-dowam kehte hain aflaak,
Woh teri kursi manzil hay Yaa Ghaus,

Tu apne waqt ka Siddiq-e-Akbar,
Ghani-o-Haidar-o-Aadil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Wali kya mursal aayein khud Huzoor aayein,
Woh teri wa’z ki mehfil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jise maange nah paayein jaah waale,
Woh bin maange tujhe haasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Fuyooz-e-’aalam ummi sey tujh par,
‘Iyaan maazi-o-mustaqbil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jo qarnon sair mein ‘aarif nah paayein,
Woh teri pehli hi manzil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Malak mashghool hain us ki sanaa mein,
Jo tera zaakir-o-shaaghil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Nah kyoon ho teri manzil ‘arsh saani,
Key ‘arsh-e-Haq teri manzil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Wahin sey uble hain saaton samandar,
Jo teri neher ka saahil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Malaaik key bashar key jinn key halqe,
Teri zau maah-e-har manzil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Bukhaara-o-’Iraaq-o-Chisht-o-Ajmer,
Teri lau sham’-e-har mehfil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jo tera naam ley zaakir hay pyaarey,
Tasawwur jo karey shaaghil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jo sar dey kar tera sauda kharide,
Khuda dey aql woh aaqil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Kahaa tuney keh jo maango milegaa,
RAZA tujh sey tera saail hay Yaa Ghaus.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: JO TERA TIFL HAY KAAMIL HAY YAA GHAUS

shers.roman:
Jo tera tifl hay kaamil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Tufaili kaa laqab waasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tassawuf tere maktab ka sabaq hay,
Tasarruf par tera aamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Teri sair ilaa Allah hi hay fillah,
Keh ghar sey chalte hi moosil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tu noor-e-awwal-o-aakhir hay Mawlaa,
Tu khair-e-‘aajil-o-aajil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Malak key kuch bashar kuch jin key hain peer,
Tu sheikh-e-aali-o-saafil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Kitaab-e-har dil aasaar-e-tarruff,
Tere daftar hi sey naaqil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Futooh-ul-gaib agar raushan nah farmaaye,
Futoohaat-o-fusoos aafil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tera mansoob hay marfoo’ iss jaa,
Izaafat raf'a ki ‘aamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tere kaami mashaqqat sey bari hain,
Key bar tar nasab sey faa'il hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ahad sey Ahmad aur Ahmad sey tujh ko,
Kun aur sab kun makun haasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Teri i’zzat teri rif’at tera fadl,
Bifazlihi afzal-o-faazil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tere jalwe key aagey mintaqah sey,
Mah-o-khur par khat baatil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Siyaahi maayil us ki chaandni aayi,
Qamar kaa yoon falak maayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tilaaye meher hay taksaal baahar,
Key khaarij markaz haamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tu barzakh hay barang-e-noon-e-minnat,
Do jaanib muttasil waasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Nabi sey aakhaz aur ummat pey faaiz,
Udhar qaabil idhar faa’il hay Yaa Ghaus.

Natijah had-e-ausat gir key dey aur,
Yahaan jab tak key tu shaamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Alaa toobaa lakum hay woh key jin kaa,
Shabaana roz wird-e-dil hay Yaa Ghaus.

‘Ajam kaisa ‘arab hil kya Haram mein,
Jami har jaa teri mehfil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Hay sharh-e-ism-e-Al Qaadir tera naam,
Yeh sharha is matan ki haamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jabeen-e-jubbah farsaayi ka sandal,
Teri deewaar ki kahgil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Bajaa laaya woh amr-e-saari’yoo ko,
Teri jaanib jo musta’jil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Teri qudrat to fitriyaat sey hay,
Keh Qaadir naam mein daakhil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tasarruf waaley sab mazhar hain tere,
Tu hi is pardey mein faa’il hay Yaa Ghaus.

RAZA key kaam aur ruk jaayein haa shaa,
Tera saail hay tu baazil hay Yaa Ghaus.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: BADAL YAA FARD JO KAAMIL HAY YAA GHAUS

shers.roman:
Badal yaa fard jo kaamil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Tere hi dar sey mustakmil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jo teri yaad sey zaahil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Wo zikrullah sey ghaafil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Anas-sayyaaf sey jaahil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Jo tere fazl par saail hay Yaa Ghaus.

Sukhan hain asfiyaa tu maghz-e-ma’ani,
Badan hain auliya tu dil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Agar wo jism-e-’irfaan hain to tu aankh,
Agar woh aankh hain tu til hay Yaa Ghaus.

Uloohiyyat nabuwwat key siwaa tu,
Tamaam afzaal ka qaabil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Nabi key qadmon par hay juz-e-nabuwwat,
Keh khatm is raah mein haail hay Yaa Ghaus.

Uloohiyyat hi Ahmad ney nah paayi,
Nabuwwat hi sey tu ‘aatil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Sahaabiyat huyi phir tabei’iyat,
Bas aage Qaadiri manzil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Hazaaron taabei’ sey toh fuzoon hay,
Woh tabqa mujmalan faadhil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Raha maidaan-o-shehrstaan-e-’irfaan,
Tera ramna teri mehfil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Yeh Chishti Soharwardi Naqshbandi,
Har ek teri taraf maayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Teri chiriyaan hain tera daana paani,
Tera mela teri mehfil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Unhein tu Qaadri bai’at hay tajdeed,
Woh haan khaati jo mustabdil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Qamar par jaisey khur ka yoon tera qarz,
Sab ahl-e-noor par faazil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ghalat kar dam toh waahib hay nah muqriz,
Teri bakhshish tera naayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Koi kya jaane tere sar kaa rutba,
Key talwa taaj-e-ahl-e-dil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Mashaaikh mein kisi ko tujh pey tafzeel,
Ba hukm-e-auliya baatil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jahaan dushwaar ho wahm-e-musaawaat,
Yeh jur’aat kis qadar haayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tere khuddaam key aagey hay ik baat,
Jo aur aqtaab ko mushkil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Use idbaar jo mudbir hay tujh sey,
Woh zee Iqbaal jo muqbil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Khuda key dar sey hay matrood-o-makhzool,
Jo teraa taarak-o-khaazil hay Yaa Ghaus,

Sitam kori wahaabi raafzi ki,
Key hindu tak tera qaayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Woh kya jaanega fazl-e-Murtaza ko,
Jo tere fazl ka jaahil hay Yaa Ghaus.

RAZA key saamne ki taab kis mein,
Falak waar us pey tera zil hay Yaa Ghaus.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: TALAB KAA MOONH TO KIS QAABIL HAY YAA GHAUS

shers.roman:
Talab ka moonh toh kis qaabil hay Yaa Ghaus,
Magar teraa karam kaamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Duhaayi Yaa Muhiyuddin duhaayi,
Balaa Islaam par naazil hay Yaa Ghaus,

Woh sangee(n) bid’atein woh tezi-e-kufr,
Key sar par taigh dil par sil hay Yaa Ghaus,

‘Azooman qaatilan indal qitaalee,
Madad ko aa dam-e-bismil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Khuda raa naa khuda aa dey sahaara,
Hawaa bigri bhanwar haayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Jilaa dey dein jalaa dey kufr-o-ilhaad,
Key tu muhiyi hay tu qaatil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tera waqt aur parrey yoon deen par waqt,
Nah tu ‘aajiz hay nah tu ghaafil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Rahi haan shaamat-e-aamaal yeh bhi,
Jo tu chaahe abhi zaayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ghayuraa! apni ghairat ka tasadduq,
Wohi kar jo tere qaabil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Khudara marham-e-khaak-e-qadam dey,
Jigar zakhmi hay dil ghaayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Na dekhun shakl-e-mushkil tere aagey,
Koi mushkil si yeh mushkil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Woh ghera rishta-e-shirk-e-khafi ney,
Phansa zunnaar mein yeh dil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Kiye tarsaa-o-gabr aqtaab-o-abdaal,
Yeh mahaz Islaam ka saayil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tu kuwwat dey main tanha kaam besyaar,
Badan kamzor dil kaahil hay Yaa Ghaus.

‘Adoow bad deen mazhab waale haasid,
Tu hi tanha kaa zor-e-dil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Hasad sey unn key seeney paak kar dey,
Keh badtar dik sey bhi yeh sil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ghizaaye dik yahi khoon ustikhwaan gosht,
Yeh aatish deen ki aakil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Diya mujh ko unhein mehroom chora,
Mera kya jurm haq faasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Khuda sey lein laraayi woh hay mu’tii,
Nabi qaasim hay tu moosil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Ataayein muqtadir ghaffaar ki hain,
Abas bandon key dil mein ghil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Tere baba ka phir tera karam hay,
Yeh moonh warna kisi qaabil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Bharan waaley tera jhaala toh jhaala,
Tera cheenta mera ghaasil hay Yaa Ghaus.

Sanaa maqsood hay ‘arz-e-gharaz kya,
Gharaz ka aap toh kaafil hay Yaa Ghaus.

RAZA kaa khatima bil-khair hoga,
Teri rehmat agar shaamil hay Yaa Ghaus.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: KA’ABE KEY BADRUD-DUJAA

shers.roman:
Ka’abe key badrud-duja tum pe karoron durood,
Taibah key shamsudduha tum pe karoron durood.

Shaafa'-e-roz-e-jazaa tum pe karoron durood,
Daafa’-e-jumlah balaa tum pe karoron durood.

Jaan-o-dil-e-asfiya tum pe karoron durood,
Aab-o-gil-e-Ambiya tum pe karoron durood.

Laayei(n) to yeh doosraa dawsaraa jis ko mila,
Kooshak-e-’arsh-o-danaa tum pe karoron durood.

Aur koi ghaib kya tum sey nihaa(n) ho bhala,
Jab naa Khuda hi chupaa tum pe karoron durood.

Toor pe jo sham'a thaa chaand thaa saa’eer kaa,
Nayyar-e-faaraa(n) huwa tum pe karoron durood.

Dil karo thanda mera woh kaf-e-paa chaand saa,
Seeney pe rakh do zaraa tum pe karoron durood.

Zaat hui intikhaab wasf huwe laajawaab,
Naam huwa Mustafa tum pe karoron durood.

Ghaayat-o-’illat sabab bahr-e-jahaa(n) tum ho sab,
Tum sey banaa tum binaa tum pe karoron durood.

Tum sey jahaa(n) ki hayaat tum sey jahaa(n) kaa sabaat,
Asl sey hay zil bandhaa tum pe karoron durood.

Maghz ho tum aur post aur hain baahir key dost,
Tum ho daroon-e-saraa tum pe karoron durood.

Kya hain jo be-had hain laus tum toh ho ghais aur ghaus,
Cheentte mein hoga bhalaa tum pe karoron durood.

Tum ho hafeez-o-mughees kya hay woh dushman khabees,
Tum ho toh phir khauf kya tum pe karoron durood.

Woh shab-e-me'raj raaj woh saf-e-mehshar ka taaj,
Koi bhi aisaa huwa tum pe karoron durood.

Nuhta falaahal falaah ruhta faraahal-maraah,
‘Ud Liya’udal-hanaa tum pe karoron durood.

Jaan-o-jahaan-e-maseeh daad keh dil hay jareeh,
Nabzei(n) chattin dam chalaa tum pe karoron durood.

Uf woh rah-e-sanglaakh aah yeh paa shaakh shaakh,
Aay mere Mushkil Kusha tum pe karoron durood.

Tum sey khulaa baab-e-jood tum sey hay sab kaa wujood,
Tum sey hay sab ki baqaa tum pe karoron durood.

Khastah hoon aur tum ma’aaz basta hoon aur tum malaaz,
Aage jo shah ki RAZA tum pe karoron durood.

Garche hain behad kusoor tum ho ‘afuw-o-ghafoor,
Bakhsh do jurm-o-khataa tum pe karoron durood.

Mehr-e-Khuda noor noor dil hay siyah din hay door,
Shab mein karo chaandnaa tum pe karoron durood.

Tum ho shaheed-o-baseer aur main gunah par dileer,
Khol do chashm-e-hayaa tum pe karoron durood.

Cheent tumhaari sahar chhoot tumhari qamar,
Dil mein racha do ziya tum pe karoron durood.

Tum sey Khuda ka zuhoor uss sey tumhaara zuhoor,
Lim hay yeh woh In huwa tum pe karoron durood.

Be-hunar-o-be-tameez kis ko huwe hain ‘azeez,
Eik tumhaare siwaa tum pe karoron durood.

Aas hay koi nah paas ek tumhari hay aas,
Bas hay yahi aasraa tum pe karoron durood.

Taa-ram-e-aa'la ka arsh jis kaf-e-paa kaa hay farsh,
Aankhon pe rakh do zaraa tum pe karoron durood.

Kehne ko hain ‘aam-o-khaas eik tumhi(n) ho khalaas,
Band sey kar do rihaa tum pe karoron durood.

Tum ho shifaa-e-maraz khalq-e-Khuda khud gharaz,
Khalq ki haajat bhi kyaa tum pe karoron durood.

Aah woh raah-e-siraat bandon ki kitni bisaat,
Al madad aay rehnumaa tum pe karoron durood.

Be-adab-o-bad-lihaaz kar nah sakaa kuch hifaaz,
‘Afw pe bhoola raha tum pe karoron durood.

Law-teh-e-daaman keh sham'a jhonko(n) mein hay roz-e-jam'a,
Aandhiyon sey hashr utthaa tum pe karoron durood.

Seena keh hay daagh daagh keh do kare baagh baagh,
Taibah sey aa kar sabaa tum pe karoron durood.

Gesu-o-qad Laam Alif kar do balaa munsarif,
Laa key teh-e-taigh-e-Laa tum pe karoron durood.

Tum ney ba-rang-e-falaq jaib-e-jahaa(n) kar key shaq,
Noor ka tarrka kiya tum pe karoron durood.

Nawbat-e-dar hain falak khaadim-e-dar hain malak,
Tum ho jahaa(n) Baadshaa tum pe karoron durood.

Khilq tumhaari jameel khulq tumhaara jaleel,
Khalq tumhaari gadaa tum pe karoron durood.

Taibah key maah-e-tamaam jumlah Rusul key imaam,
Naw shah-e-milk-e-Khuda tum pe karoron durood.

Tum sey jahaa(n) ka nizaam tum pe karoron salaam,
Tum pe karoron sanaa tum pe karoron durood.

Tum ho jawaad-o-kareem tum ho rauf-o-raheem,
