Bheek ho daata ‘ataa tum pe karoron durood.

Khalq key haakim ho tum rizq key qaasim ho tum,
Tum sey milaa jo milaa tum pe karoron durood.

Naafe'-o-daafe' ho tum shaafe'-o-raafe' ho tum,
Tum sey bas afzoo(n) Khuda tum pe karoron durood.

Shaafi-o-naafi ho tum kaafi-o-waafi ho tum,
Dard ko kardo dawaa tum pe karoron durood.

Jaayein nah jab tak ghulaam khuld hay sab par haraam,
Milk toh hay aap ka tum pe karoron durood.

Mazhar-e-Haq ho tumhin muzhir-e-Haq ho tumhin,
Tum mein hay zaahir Khuda tum pe karoron durood.

Zor deh-e-naarsaa(n) takya gahe bekasaa(n),
Baadshah-e-maa-waraa tum pe karoron durood.

Barse karam ki bharan phoolein ni'am key chaman,
Aisi chaalaa do hawaa tum pe karoron durood.

Ik taraf a'daa-e-dee(n) eik taraf haasidee(n),
Bandah hay tanhaa shahaa tum pe karoron durood.

Kyoon kahoon be-kas hoon main kyoon kahoon be-bas hoon main,
Tum ho mein tum par fidaa tum pe karoron durood.

Gandey nikammey kameen mehnge ho(n) koree key teen,
Kaun humein paalta tum pe karoron durood.

Baat na dar key kahi(n) ghaat nah ghar key kahi(n),
Aise tumhei(n) paalna tum pe karoron durood.

Aiso(n) ko ne'mat khilaao doodh key sharbat pilaao,
Aiso(n) ko aisi ghizaa tum pe karoron durood.

Girne ko hoon rok lo ghotah lage haath do,
Aiso(n) par aisi ‘ataa tum pe karoron durood.

Apne khataawaaron ko apne hi daaman mein lo,
Kaun kare yeh bhalaa tum pe karoron durood.

Kar key tumhaare gunaah maangein tumhaari panaah,
Tum kaho daaman mein aa tum pe karoron durood,

Kar do 'aduw ko tabaah haasidon ko roo baraah,
Ahl-e-wilaa ka bhalaa tum pe karoron durood.

Hum ne khataa mein nah ki tum ne ‘ataa mein nah ki,
Koi kami Sarwaraa tum pe karoron durood.

Kaam ghazab key kiye us peh hay Sarkaar sey,
Bandon ko chashm-e-RAZA tum pe karoron durood.

Aankh ‘ataa kijiye us mey ziya dijiye,
Jalwah qareeb aa gaya tum pe karoron durood.

Kaam woh ley lijiye tum ko jo raazi kare,
Theek ho naam-e-RAZA tum pe karoron durood.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ZE ‘AKSAT MAAHE TAABAAN AAFREEDAND ZE BOOE TU GULSITAAN

shers.roman:
Ze aksat maahe taabaan aafreedand,
Ze booe tu gulsitaan aafreedand.

Nah az behre tu sirf imaan niyaanand,
Key khud behre tu Imaan aafreedand.

Saba ra mast az buyat bahr so,
Chunaan uftaan-o-khizaan aafreedand.

Baraaye jalwah yak gulbun-e-naaz,
Hazaaraan baagh-o-bustaan aafreedand.

Ze mehr tu misaale bar gariftand,
Wa zaan muhre sulaimaan aafreedand.

Chu angushte tu shud jowlaan deh barq,
Qamar raa behre qurbaan aafreedand.

Ze la’le nowsh khand jaanfazaa yat,
Zulaale aabe haiwaan aafreedand.

Nah ghaire kibriyaa jaan aafreenay,
Nah khud misle tu jaanaan aafreedand.

Paye nazzaarah mahboobe laahoot,
Jabeenat aainae saan aafreedand.

Binaa kar dand taa qasre Risaalat,
Turaa sham’-e- shabistaan aafreedand.

Ze mehr-o-charkh behre khawaane joodat,
‘Ajab qurs-o-namakdaan aafreedand.

Ze husnat taa bahaare taazah gul kard,
RAZAYAT ra ghazal khwaan aafreedand.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: WAZEEFA-E-QAADIRIYYA

shers.roman:
Saqanil hubbu ka’saatil wisaali,
Fa qultu li-khumrati nahwi ta‘aali.

Daad ishqam jaame wasl-e-kibriyaa,
Pas beguftam baadah am raa sooyam aa,

Assalaa aay fuzlah khooraan-e-Huzoor,
Shaah bar joodast-o-sahbaa dar wufoor,

Bakhsh kardan gar neh ‘azm-e-khusrawist,
Aakhir een nowsheedah khwaandan behr-e-cheest.

Sa’ at wa-mashat li-nahwi fee ku-usi,
Fa-himtu li-sukrati bai-nal-mawaali.

Shud dawaan dar jaamhaa sowyam rawaan,
Wa ilah sukram shudam dar sarwaraan,

Shukre to az zikr-o-fikr akbar bawad,
Sukr ko choon hukm khud bar mee rawad,

Sooe mey bar booye mey mardaan rawaan,
Baadah khud sowyat bapaaye sar dawaan.

Fa-qultu li-saa-i-ril Aqtaabi lummu,
Bi-haali wad-khuloo antum rijaali.

Guftam aay qutbaan ba’own shaan-e-man,
Jumlah daraaid taan mardaan-e-man,

Jama’ khwaanidi taa qawi dilhaa shawand,
Ham ze ‘awne haal-e-khud daadee kamand,

Warna taa baam-e-Huzoor to su’ood,
Haa shaa lillah taab-o-yaraaye key bood.

Wa hummoo wash-raboo antum junoodi,
Fa saaqil qawmi bil waafi malali.

Himmat aaraid wa khoraid aay lashkaram,
Saaqiyam daadah labaalab az karam,

Shukre Haq jaame to labreze mayst,
Har labaalab raa chakeedan darpayeast,

Taa bamaa ham aayad in shaa al-’azeem,
Aan naseeb-ul-ard min kaas-il-kareem.

Sharib-tum fud-lati mim-ba’di suk-ri,
Walaa nil-tum ‘uluwwi wa ittisaali.

Man shudam sarshaar wa soram mee chasheed,
Rakht taa qurb-o-‘uluwwam kay kasheed,

Fuzleh khowraanash shahaan-o-man gadaaye,
Rooye aanam ko keh khawaaham qatrah laaye,

Yallalay joode shaham guftah malaaye,
Mai talab laa nashenawi een jaa nah laaye.

Maqaamukum-ul-‘ulaa jam’an-wa-laakin,
Maaqami fawqakum maazaala ‘aali.

Jaay taan baala-o-lay jaayam bawad,
Fowq-e-taan az roz-e-awwal taa abad.

Jaat baalaatar ze wehme jaayehaa,
Jaayehaa khud hast behr-e-paayehaa.

Paayehaa che bawad keh sarhaa zere paat,
Paat ham kay choon furood aayee ze jaat.

Anaa fee hadrati taqree-bi wahdi,
Yusarrifuni wa hasbi Dhul-Jalaali.

Yakkah dar qurbam Khudaa gardaanadam,
Haal-o-kaafi aan jaleel waahidam,

Aayake mee gardaanadat aan yak na ghair,
Haale maa gardaan ze sharhaa sooay khair,

Taaje qurbash shaadmaan bar sar beneh,
Shay al-lillah qurbe khud maa raa bedeh.

An-al-baaziyyu ash-hab kullu Shaikhin,
Wa man dhaa fir-rijaali u’tiya mithaali.

Baaze ashab maa-o-shaikhaan choon hamaam,
Keest dar mardaan key choon man yaaft kaam,

Habbadhaa shahbaaze tairistaane qudus,
Aay shikaare panjah at murghaane qudus,

Shaadmaan bar qumri kawtar bizan,
Gah nagah bar khastah chughday ham figan.

Kasaani khil’atam bitiraazi-‘azmin,
Wa-tawwajani biteejanil-kamaali.

Khal’atam baa khowsh nigaare ‘azm daad,
Bar saram sad taaje daraayee nihaad,

Ya Rabb een khil’at humaayoon taa nushoor,
Hulla powshaa yak nazzer bar musht ‘owr,

Taaj raa az farqe khud me’raaj deh,
Bar saram az khaake raahat taaj neh.

Wa-atla’anee ‘ala sirrin qadeemin,
Wa qalladanee wa a’taanee su-aali.

Aagaham farmood bar raaze qadeem,
‘Uhdah daad-o-jumla kaamam aan kareem,

‘Ahdah az tu ‘ahd az tu maa ze to,
Maa bazille ne’mat-o-ham naaz to,

Yallalay wakh wakh zamaane khurmi est,
Sooe maa shud shahnah haala taras keest.

Wa wallanee ‘alal aqtaabi jam’an,
Fahukmi naa-fidhun fee kulli-hali.

Waaliyam kardah bar aqtaabe jahaan,
Pass bahr haal ast huke man rawaan,

Az surayyaa taa saraa amrat ameer,
Kaj roway bay hukm raa dar hukm geer,

Pesh azaan kaaftad sooway aatish niyaaz,
Narm narm az daste lutfat raast saaz.

Fa-law alqaitu sirri fee bihaarin,
Lasaaral kullu ghawran fiz-zawali.

Raaze khud gar afganam andar bihaar,
Jumla gum gerdad fird raftah bakhaar,

Nafs-o-shaitaan naz’-e- jaan gowr-o-nushoor,
Naama khawandan bar sare khanjar ‘uboor,

Na khudaaya haft daryaa dar raham,
Dast geer aay yam ze raazat kam zanam.

Walow alqaitu sirri fee jibaalin,
Ladukkat wakhtafat bainar-rimalii.

Raazam ar jalwah deham gardad jibaal,
Paarah paarah gashta pinhaan dar rimaal,

Aay ze raazat koohe kaah-o-kaahe kooh,
Kaahe be jaan raast sadde raah kooh,

Taa’atam kaah ast jurmam kooh waar,
Kooh raa kaah-o-beoarwar kaah zaar.

Walow alqaitu sirri fawqa naarin,
La-khamidat wantafat min sirri haali,

Par tawe raaz afganam gar bar aseer,
Sard-o-khamush gardad az raazam sa’eer,

Nayeraa man naare jurm afrokhatam,
Hum dile zaaram daronash sokhtam,

Zaare man az zor baa khud nawsh kun,
Naare man az noor khud khamowsh kun.

Walaw alqaitu sirri fawqa maitin,
La-qaama biqudratil mawla ta’aa-li.

Raaze khud bar murdah gar afganam,
Zindah barkheezad ba izne Zul karam,

Aay nigaahat zindah saaz murdaha,
Cheest peshat dar dile afsurdaha,

Een labaanat shahd baar jalwah kun,
Qum bafarmaa murdah am raa zindah kun.

Wa maa minha shuhurun aw duhurun,
Tamarru wa tanqadee illa ataalee.

Neest shehre neest dahre raa muroor,
Taa nayayad bar daram pesh az zuhoor,

Aay dare tu marja’-e- har dahar-o-shahr,
Bandagaanat raa che taras az daste dahr,

Har meh umram kun az mehrat bakhair,
Khaire makhsa man na binam haich dair.

Wa tukhbirunee bimaa ya’tee wa tajree,
Wa tu’limunee fa’aqsir ‘an jadalee.

Jumla goyad ba man az haal-o-saft,
Az jidaalam dast kowteh baayadat,

Aw hashallah zebad ein sheh raa jalaal,
Arz beyki darey-o-maah-o-saal,

Dar jidaalash key kujaa yaabi amaan,
Khud kaneezey ow zameen banda zamaan.

Muridee him wa tib washtah wa‘ghanni,
Waf’al maa tashaau filismu ‘aa-li.

Banda am khoush mee saraa bibaak-o-mast,
Har che khwahi kun keh nisbat bartar ast,

Ein sukhan raa bandah baayad bandah koo,
Bandah kun aay baadshaah bandah joo,

Shaad-o-paa koobaan rawad jaanam ze tan,
Bar mureedee him wa tib washtah wa ghann.

Muridee laa takhaf Allahu Rabbi,
‘Atanee rif’atan nil-tul manali.

Rab-e-man haq bandah az tar sey manaal,
Rifa’tum amad raseedam taa manaal,

Aay tura Allah Rab mahboob aab,
Turfa marbowbi-o-mahboobi ájab,

Rab-o-ab paakat namood az raib-o-áyb,
Az dilam barkash shahaa har áyb-o-raib,

Yaa azooman qaatilan faryaad ras.
Tabuooli fis-samaai wal ardi duqqat,

Wa shaa u sis-sa’aadati qad-bada-li.
Nowbatam dar khadree o ghabraa zedand,

Shud naqeeb mowkabam bahte buland,
Yaa Rab een shah raa mubarak der baaz,

Takht o bakht o taaj o baaj o saaz o naaz,
Baadshaaha shukr e sultaani khwaish,

Yak nigaahe bar gadaaye seena resh.
Bilaadullahi mulkee tahta hukmee,

Wa waqti qabla qalbi qad safaaee.
Mulke haq mulkam te farmaane man,

Waqte man shud saaf pesh az jaane man,
BaarakAllah wusat-e-sultani tu,

Shark taa gharb ane tu qurbane tu,
Teerah waqte kheerah bakhte seena resh,

Nazartu ilaa biladillahi jam’an,
Kakhardalatin ‘ala hukmit tisalee.

Dar nigaaham jumla mulke zuljalaali,
Daana khardil saan bahukme itesaali,

Wah ka tou mee baynee-o-maa dar gunaah,
Aah aah az kowree-e-maa aah aah,

Chashm deh taa zeen bulaaha waraheem,
Roowe to beenaim-o-bar paa jaan diheem.

Wa kullu waliyilahu qadamun wa inni,
‘Ala qada min Nabi badril kamali.

Har wali raa yak kadam daadan-o-maa,
Bar kadamhaaye Nabi badrul’ulaa,

Kaam jaanhaa to bagaame Mustafa,
Hayf bar khutowaat-e-dew aayim maa,

Gaam bar gaam sagey maa raa mabeen.
Dast deh barkash sooey raah mubeen.

Darastu’ilma hatta sirtu qutban,
Wa niltussa’da min mawlal mawali.

Dars kardam ‘ilm taa qutbe shudam,
Kard Mawlayay mawali as’adam,

Aay sa’eede boo sa’eed saa’de deen,
Saa’de charkhat bandah aay saa’de zameen,

Ney hameen saa’di key shaahaa sa’ad kun,
Sa’ad kun naa sa’ad maa raa sa’ad kun.

Rijaali fee hawaa jirihim siyaamun,
Wa fee zulumillayaali kallaali.

Dar tamuze rowz chaysham rozah daar,
Dar shabe teerah cho gohar noor baar,

Kare mardanat siyaam ast-o-qiyaam,
Kaame maa dar khorad-e-baam-o-khwaabe shaam,

Mard kun yaa khaak-e-raahat kun shataab,
Een bahaaim ra chunaan go kun turaab.

Ana al-Hasaniyyu wal mukhda’ maqami,
Wa aqdami ‘ala ‘unu-qir-rijali.

Az Hassan nasl-e-man-o-mikhda’ maqaam,
Paaye man bar gardane jumla kiraam,

Sarwaraa maa ham baraah uftaadah aim,
Paaimaalat raa sarey banhaadah aim,

Gul barahaa yak qadam gul kam badaan,
Hisbatal lillah mar-o-daaman kashaan.

Ana al Jeelee Muhyuddin laqabee,
Wa a’lami ‘ala ra’sil jibaali.

Mouldam jeelaan-o-naamam Muhyiddin,
Raaitam bar qalhaaye koh been,

Aay ze aayaat-e-Khuda raayaat-e-tu,
Mujizaat-e-Mustafa Ayaat-e-tu,

Jalwah deh az raaitat een aayatat,
Choon manee mahshoor zer-e-raayatat.

Wa Abdul Qaadir il mashooru ismee,
Wa jaddee saahibul aineeil kamaalee.

Naam mashoor ast Abdul Qaadiram,
Ayn-e-har fazl aanke jadde akbaram,

Aan-e-jaddat choon nabaashad aane tu,
Waarsi aay jaan-e-man qurbaan-e-tu,

Bar RAZAAYE naaqsat afshaan nawaal,
Yak chusheedan aab-e-az bahr ul kamaal.

Khufta dil taa chand nang-e-zestan,
Bar rukhash az bahr-e-fazl aab-e-bazan,

Tishna kaamey paa badaamay kardah ghash,
Behr-e-saail raa bigo khud roo barash,

Roo barash uw raa barash bedaar saaz,
Hosh bakhsh-o-nowsh bakhsh-o-jaan nawaaz.

Jaan nawaaza jaan fidaaye naam-e-tu,
Kaam-e-jaan deh aay jahaan dar kaam-e-tu,

Een dua az bandah aameen az malak,
Pozish az Baghdaad ijaabat az falak.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: KHUSHAA DILE KEH DIHINDASH WILAA-E-AAL-E-RASOOL

shers.roman:
Khushaa dile keh dihindash wilaaye Aal-e-Rasool,
Khushaa sare keh kunindash fidaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Gunaah-e-bandah bebakhsh aay Khudaaye Aal-e-Rasool,
Baraaye Aal-e-Rasool az baraaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Hazaar durj-e-sa’aadat bar aarad az sad fe,
Bahaaye har gohar-e-be-bahaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Siyah sapeed na shud gar rasheed misrash daad,
Siyah sapeed keh saazad ‘ataaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Izaa ru-oo zukirallah maayena bayni,
Man-o-Khudaaye man aanst adaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Khabar dihad tag-e-laa ilaaha illal Allah,
Fanaaye Aal-e-Rasool-o-baqaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Hazaar meher parad dar hawaaye au choo habaa,
Baroozane keh darakhshad ziyaa-e-Aal-e-Rasool.

Naseeb-e-past nasheenaa(n) bulandyast ein jaa,
Tawaaze’ ast dur-e-murtaqaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Baraa beh charkh-e-bareen-o-bibee(n) sataanah-e-au,
Garaa ba khaak-o-biyaa bar samaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Qabaaye sheh bagleem-e-siyaah khood nakhard,
Siyah galeem nabaashad gadaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Dawaaye talkh makhowr shehed naush-o-muzdah nayosh,
Bayaa mareez badaar-ush-shifaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Humein nah az sar afsar-e-key ham ze sar bar khaast,
Nashist har key bafarqash hamaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Basakhr-o-ta’nah sakhti zanad ba-’aariz-e-gul,
Basang-e-sakhrah-o-ze digar sabaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Dihad ze baagh-e-manaa gunchah haaye zar ba girah,
Dam-e-sawaal hayaa-o-ghanaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Ze charkh kaan-e-zar-e-sharqi maghribi aarand,
Badard mas bamas kimiyaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Jaras basalsala ish aancheh guft raahi raa,
Hamaan basilsilah aarad waraaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Rasool daan shawi az naam-e-au nami beeni,
Do harf-e-ma’rifa dar ibtidaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Bakhad matash nakhard baaj-o-taaj rang-o-farang,
Sapeed bakht siyaah saraaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Agar shab ast-o-khatar sakht wa rah nami daani,
Biband chashm-o-biya bar qafaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Ze sar nahand kulaah-e-ghuroor mudaiyaan,
Bajalwah madad aay kafsh-e-paaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Hazaar jaama-e-saaloos raa kataani deh,
Bataab aay mah-e-jeb qabaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Marow bamaikadah kaanjaa siyaah kaar anand,
Biya bakhaanaq-e-noor zaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Marow majlis-e-fisq-o-fujoor shayyaan daan,
Ba yaa anjuman-e-itqaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Marow badamageh ein darowgh baafaa(n) heach,
Biya ba jalwah-e-gah-e-dilkashaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Azaa(n) baanjuman-e-paak sabz poshaan raft,
Key sabz bood daraan bazm jaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Shikast sheesha bahijr-o-paree basheesha hunooz,
Ze dil nami rawad aa(n) jalwah haaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Shaheed-e-‘ishq nameerad key jaan ba jaanaan daad,
Tu murdi aikeh judaayi ze paaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Bago key waaye man-o-waaye murdah maandan-e-man,
Manaal harzeh key haihaat waaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Keh mee bard ze mareezaan-e-talkh kaamam nayaaz,
Ba’had shahed farosh-e-baqaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Sabaa salaam-e-aseeraan-e-basta baal rasaa(n),
Bataayraan-e-hawa-o-fazaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Khataa makun dilka? Pardah eisst doori neist,
Bagosh mee khurad aknoo(n) sadaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Magow key deedah gari ghubaar deedah bakhand,
Bakaar-e-tust kunoo(n) tootiyaae Aal-e-Rasool.

Mapech dar gham-e-’ayyaargaan-e-zamb shi’aar,
Agar adab nakunand az baraaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Har aanke niks kunad niks behr-e-nafs weist,
Gani ast hazrat-e-charkh etelaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Sipaas kun key bapaas-o-sipaas-e-bad manshaan,
Niyaaz-o-naaz nadarad sanaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Na sag bashowr-o-na shappar bakhamushii kaahad,
Ze qadr-e-badar-o-ziyaaye zukaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Tawaze shahe miskeen nawaaz raa naazam,
Ke hamchu bandah kunad bows paaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Manam ameer-e-jahangeer kajj kila yaani,
Kameena bandah-o-miskeen gadaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Agar misaal-e-khilafat dehad faqeere raa,
Ajab madaar ze faiz-o-sakhaaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Makeer khurdah key aa(n) kas na ahl-e-ein kaar ast,
Ke danad ahl-e-namudan ataaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Bibeen tafaawut-e-rah az kujaast taa ba kuja,
Tabarak Allah maa-o-sanaye Aal-e-Rasool.

Mara ze nisbat-e-malk ast umeed aanke ba hashar,
Nida kunand biyaa aay RAZAAYE Aal-e-Rasool.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: MUSTAFA JAAN-E-RAHMAT PE LAAKHON SALAAM

shers.roman:
Mustafa jaan-e-rahmat pe laakho(n) Salaam,
Sham’-e-bazm-e-hidaayat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mehr-e-charkh-e-nubuwat pe roushan Durood,
Gul-e-baagh-e-risaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shehreyaar-e-iram taajdaare Haram,
Nau bahaar-e-shafaa'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shab-e-asraa key dulhaa pe daaim Durood,
Naushah-e-bazm-e-Jannat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

‘Arsh ki zeb-o-zeenat pe ‘arshi Durood,
Farsh ki teeb-o-nuzhat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Noor-e-ain-e-lataafat pe altaf Durood,
Zaib-o-zain-e-nazaafat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sarw-e-naaz-e-qidam maghz-e-raaz-e-hikam,
Yakkah taaz-e-fazilat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Nukta-e-sirre wahdat pe yaktaa Durood,
Markaz-e-daur-e-kasrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Saahib-e-raj'at-e-shams-o-shaqq-ul-qamar,
Naaib-e-dast-e-qudrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiske zer-e-liwaa Aadam-o-man siwa,
Uss sazaa-e-siyadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

‘Arsh taa farsh hay jiske zere nagee(n),
Uski qaahir riyaasat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Asl-e-har bood-o-bahbood takhm-e-wujood,
Qaasim-e-kanze ne'mat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Fat-he-e-baab-e-nubuwat pe be-had Durood,
Khatm-e-daur-e-risaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sharq-e-anwaar-e-qudrat pe noori Durood,
Fatq-e-azhaar-e-qurbat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Be-saheem-o-qaseem-o-adeel-o-maseel,
Jouhar-e-fard-e-izzat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sir-e-ghaib-e-hidaayat pe ghaibi Durood,
‘Itr-e-jaib-e-nihaayat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Maahe laahoot-e-khalwat pe laakho(n) Durood,
Shahe naasoot-e-jalwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Kanz-e-har be-kaso benawaa par Durood,
Hirz-e-har raftah taaqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Partaw-e-isme zaat-e-ahad par Durood,
Nuskha-e-jaame’iyyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Matla'-e-har sa'aadat pe as'ad Durood,
Maqta’-e-har siyaadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Khalq key daadras sabke faryaad ras,
Kahf-e-roz-e-musibat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mujhse be-kas ki daulat pe laakho(n) Durood,
Mujhse be-bas ki quwwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sham’-e-bazm-e-danaa hoo mein gum kun anaa,
Sharh-e-matn-e-huwiyyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Intiha-e-dowi ibtidaa-e-yakee,
Jam'-e-tafreeq-o-kasrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Kasrat-e-ba’d-e-qillat pe aksar Durood,
Izzat-e-ba’d-e-zillat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Rabb-e-a’laa ki ne'mat pe a’laa Durood,
Haq Ta'aala ki minnat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Hum ghareebon key Aaqa pe be-had Durood,
Hum faqeeron ki sarwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Farhat-e-jaan-e-momin pe be-had Durood,
Ghaiz-e-qalb-e-zalaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sabab-e-har sabab muntahaa-e-talab,
‘Illate jumlah ‘illat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Masdar-e-mazhariyyat pe azhar Durood,
Mazhar-e-masdariyyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiske jalwe sey murjhaayi kaliya(n) khilin,
Uss ghul-e-paak mambat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Qad-e-be-saaya key saaya-e-marhamat,
Zill-e-mamdood-e-raafat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Taairaan-e-qudus jiski hain qamriyaa(n),
Us sahi sarwe qaamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Wasf jiska hay aayina-e-Haq numa,
Us Khuda saaz tal'at pe laakho(n) Salaam,

Jiske aage sar-e-sarwaraa(n) kham rahein,
Uss sar-e-taaj-e-rif'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Woh karam ki ghataa gesu-e-mushk saa,
Lakkah abr-e-raafat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Lailat-ul-qadr mey matla’il fajr-e-Haq,
Maang ki istiqaamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Lakht lakht-e-dil-e-har jigar chaak sey,
Shaanah karne ki haalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Door-o-nazdeek key sun-ne waaley woh kaan,
Kaan-e-la'l-e-karaamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Chashma-e-mehr mey mawj-e-noor-e-jalaal,
Us rag-e-haashimiyyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiske maathe shafaa'at ka sehra raaha,
Us jabeen-e-sa'aadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jinke sajde ko mehraab-e-ka’aba jhuki,
Unn bhawo(n) ki lataafat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Unki aankho(n) pe woh saaya afgan muzhah,
Zullahe qasr-e-rahmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ashkbaari-e-muzhgaa(n) pe barse Durood,
Silk-e-dur-e-shafaa'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ma'ani-e-qad ra-aa maqsad-e-maa taghaa,
Nargis-e-baagh-e-qudrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiss taraf utth gayi dam mey dam aa gaya,
Us nigaah-e-‘inayat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Nichee aankho(n) ki sharm-o-hayaa par Durood,
Oonchi beeni ki rif’at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jinke aage charaaghe qamar jhilmilaaye,
Un ‘izaaro ki tal’at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Unke khad ki suhoolat pe be-had Durood,
Unke qad ki rashaaqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis sey taareek dil jagmagaane lage,
Us chamak waali rangat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Chaand sey munh pe taabaa(n) darkhshaa(n) Durood,
Namak aagi(n) sabaahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shabnam-e-baagh-e-Haq ya’ni rukh ka araq,
Uski sachhi baraaqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Khat ki girde dahan woh dilara phaban,
Sabzah-e-nehr-e-rehmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Reesh-e-khush mu’tadil marham-e-reesh-e-dil,
Haalah-e-maah-e-nudrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Patli patli gul-e-quds ki pattiyaa(n),
Un labo(n) ki nazaakat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Wo dahan jiski har baat wahiy-e-Khuda,
Chashmah-e-‘ilmo hikmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiske paani sey shaadaab jaan-o-jinaa(n),
Uss dahan ki taraawat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis sey khaari kunwe sheera-e-jaa(n) bane,
Us zulaal-e-halaawat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Woh zabaa(n) jisko sab kun ki kunji kahein,
Uski naafiz hukoomat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Uski pyaari fasaahat pe be-had Durood,
Uski dilkash balaaghat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Uski baato(n) ki lazzat pe laakho(n) Durood,
Uske khutbe ki haibat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Woh du’a jis kaa joban bahaar-e-qubool,
Us naseem-e-ijaabat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jin key guchche sey lachche jharein noor key,
Un sitaaron ki nuzhat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiski taskee(n) sey rote huwe hans parein,
Us tabassum ki 'aadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis mey nehrein hain sheero shakar ki rawaa(n),
Us gale ki nazaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Dosh bar dosh hay jin sey shaan-e-sharaf,
Aise shaano(n) ki shaukat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Hajr-e-aswad-e-Ka'aba-e-jaan-o-dil,
Ya’ni mohr-e-nubuwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Roo-e- aainah-e-‘ilm-e-pasht-e-Huzoor,
Pushti-e-qasr-e-millat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Haath jis samt uttha ghanee kar diya,
Mouj-e-bahr-e-samaahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jisko baare do ‘aalam ki parwaa nahin,
Aisey baazoo ki quwwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ka'aba-e-deen-o-imaa(n) key dono sutoo(n),
Saa’idayn-e-risaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis key har khat mein hay mouj-e-noor-e-karam,
Us kaf-e-bahr-e-himmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Noor key chashme lehraayein dariyaa bahein,
Ungliyo(n) ki karamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

'Eid-e-mushkil kushaayi key chamkey hilaal,
Naakhunon ki bishaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Raf'-e- zikr-e-jalalat pe arfa' Durood,
Sharh-e-sadr-e-sadaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Dil samajh sey waraa hay magar yoon kahoon,
Ghunchah-e-raaz-e-wahdat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Kul jahaa(n) milk aur jaw ki roti ghizaa,
Uss shikam ki qanaa'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jo keh ‘azme shafaa'at pe khinch kar bandhi,
Us kamar ki himaayat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ambiya teh kare zaanu unke Huzoor,
Zaanuon ki wajaahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Saaq-e-asl-e-qadam shaakh-e-nakhl-e-karam,
Sham'-e-raah-e-isaabat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Khaayi Quraa(n) ne khaak-e-guzar ki qasam,
Us kaf-e-paa ki hurmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis suhaani ghari chamka taibah ka chaand,
Us dil afroz saa'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Pehle sajde pe rouz-e-azal sey Durood,
Yaadgari-e-ummat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Zar'-e- shaadaab-o-har zar'-e- pur sheer sey,
Barakaate razaa’at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Bhaiyon key liye tark pistaa(n) karein,
Doodh peeto ki nisfat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mahd-e-waala ki qismat pe sad-haa Durood,
Burj-e-maah-e-risaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Allah Allah woh bachpane ki phaban!,
Us Khuda bhaati soorat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Utthte booto(n) ki nashw-o-numa par Durood,
Khilte ghuncho(n) ki nikhat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Fazl-e-paidaaishi par hamesha Durood,
Khelne sey karaahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

I’tilaa-e-jibillat pe ‘aala Durood,
I’tidaal-e-tawiyyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Be-banaavat adaa par hazaaro(n) Durood,
Be-takalluf malaahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Bheeni bheeni mahak par mahakti Durood,
Pyaari pyaari nafaasat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Meethi meethi ‘ibaarat pe sheeree(n) Durood,
Achhi achhi ishaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Seedhi seedhi rawish par karoro(n) Durood,
Saadi saadi tabi'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Roz-e-garm-o-shab-e-teerah-o-taar mein,
Koh-o-sahraa ki khalwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis key ghere mein hain ambiyaa-o-malak,
Us jahaangeer-e-be'sat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Andhe sheeshe jhalaajhal damakne lagey,
Jalwah rezi-e-da’wat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Lutf-e-be-daari-e-shab pe be-had Durood,
‘Aalam-e-khwab-e-raahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Khandah-e- subh-e-’ishrat pe noori Durood,
Giryah-e-abr-e-rehmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Narmi-e-khoo-e-leenat pe daaim Durood,
Garmi-e-shaan-e-satwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiske aagey khinchi gardanein jhuk gayin,
Us Khuda daad shoukat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Kisko dekhaa yeh Moosa sey poochey koyi,
Aankho(n) waalon ki himmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Gard-e-mah dast-e-anjum mey rakhshaa(n) hilaal,
Badr ki daf'-e- zulmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shor-e-takbeer sey thar-tharaati zamee(n),
Jumbishe jaish-e-nusrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Na'rahaa-e-dileraa(n) sey ban goonjte,
Gurrish-e-kos-e-jura’at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Woh chaqaa chaaq khanjar sey aati sadaa,
Mustafa teri sawlat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Unke aagey woh Hamzah ki jaanbaaziya(n),
Sher-e-gurrane satvat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Al-gharaz unke har moo pe laakho(n) Durood,
Un ki har khoo-o-khaslat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Un key har naam-o-nisbat pe naami Durood,
Un key har waqt-o-haalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Unke Maula ki un par karoro(n) Durood,
Unke as-haabo ‘itrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Paarahaaye suhuf ghunchahaa-e-qudus,
Ahl-e-bait-e-nubuwat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Aab-e-tat-heer sey jis mein paude jame,
Uss riyaz-e-najaabat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Khoon-e-khair-ur-Rusul sey hay jinka khameer,
Un ki be lous teenat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Uss batul-e-jigar paarah-e-Mustafa,
Hajlah aara-e-‘iffat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis kaa aanchal nah dekha mah-o-meher ney,
Uss ridaa-e-nazaahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sayyida zaahira tayyibah taahirah,
Jaan-e-Ahmad ki raahat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Hasan-e-Mujtaba sayyidul askhiyaa,
Raakib-e-dosh-e-izzat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Awj-e-mehr-e-hudaa mawj-e-bahr-e-nadaa,
Rowh rooh-e-sakhaawat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shehd khwaare lu’aab-e-zabaan-e-Nabi,
Chaashni geer-e-‘ismat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Uss shaheed-e-balaa shaah-e-gulgoo(n) qabaa,
Be-kas-e-dasht-e-ghurbat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Durr-e-durj-e-najaf mehr-e-burj-e-sharaf,
Rang-e-roo-e-shahaadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ahl-e-Islaam ki maadaran-e-shafeeq,
Baanuwaan-e-tahaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jilwagiyyaan-e-bait-ush-sharaf par Durood,
Parwagiyyaan-e-‘iffat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Siyyema pahli maa(n) kahf-e-amn-o-amaa(n),
Haq guzaar-e-rafaaqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

‘Arsh sey jis pe tasleem naazil hui,
Us saraa-e-salaamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Manzillun min qqasab laaa nasab la sakhab,
Aise kooshak ki zeenat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Bint-e-Siddeeq aaraam-e-jaan-e-Nabi,
Us hareem-e-baraa-at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ya’ni hay soorah-e-noor jin ki gawaah,
Unki pur-noor soorat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jin mein rooh-ul-qudus be-ijaazat nah jaaye,
Un suraadiq ki ‘ismat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sham'-e- taabaan kaashaanah-e-ijtihaad,
Mufti-e-chaar millat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jaa(n)-nisaaran-e-Badr-o-Uhud par Durood,
Haq guzaaraan-e-bai'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Woh daso(n) jin ko Jannat ka muzda mila,
Uss mubaarak jamaa'at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Khaas uss saabiq-e-sair-e-qurb-e-Khuda,
Awhad-e-kaamiliyyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Saaya-e-Mustafa Maaya-e-Istafaa,
Izz-o-naaz-e-khilaafat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ya’ni uss afzal-ul-khalq ba’d ar-Rusul,
Thaani-yathnain-e-hijrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Asdaq-us-Saadiqeen sayyidul muttaqeen,
Chashm-o-gosh-e-wizaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Woh umar jis key a’da pe shaidaa saqar,
Uss Khuda dost Hazrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Faariq-e-Haqq-o-baatil imaam-ul-huda,
Taigh-e-masloole shiddat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Tarjumaan-e-Nabi ham-zabaan-e-nabi,
Jaan-e-shaan-e-‘adaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Zaahid-e-Masjid-e-Ahmadi par Durood,
Doulat-e-jaishe ‘usrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Durr-e-mansoor Quraa(n) ki silk-e-bahee,
Zouj-e-do noor-e-‘iffat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Yaani Usmaan saahib-e-kamees-e-huda,
Hullah powshe shahaadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Murtaza sher-e-Haq ashja-’ul ashja’i(n),
Saaqi-e-sheer-o-sharbat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Asl-e-nasl-e-safaa wajh-e-wasl-e-Khuda,
Baab-e-fasle wilaayat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Awwali(n) daaf’-e- ahle rafz-o-khurooj,
Chaarumi rukn-e-millat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sheer-e-shamsheer-zan shaah-e-khaibar-shikan,
Partaw-e-dast-e-qudrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Maahi-e-rafz-o-tafzeel-o-nasb-o-khurooj,
Haami-e-deen-o-sunnat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mo'mini(n) peshe fath-o-pase fath sab,
Ahl-e- khairo ‘adaalat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jis musalmaa(n) ne dekha unhe ik nazar,
Uss nazar ki basaarat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jinke dushman pe laanat hay Allah ki,
Un sab ahl-e-muhabbat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Baaqi-e-saaqiyaan-e-sharaab-e-tahoor,
Zain-e-ahl-e-’ibadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Aur jitne hain shehzaade uss shaah key,
Un sab ahl-e-makaanat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Unki baalaa sharaafat pe aa’la Durood,
Unki waala siyaadat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shafa'i Maalik Ahmad Imaam-e-Haneef,
Chaar baagh-e-imamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Kaamilaan-e-tareeqat pe kaamil Durood,
Haamilaan-e-shari’at pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ghouse a’azam imaamuttuqaa wannuqaa,
Jalwah-e-shaan-e-qudrat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Qutb-e-abdaal-o-irshaad-o-rushdur-rashaad,
Muhyi-e- Deen-o-millat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mard-e-khaile tareeqat pe behad Durood,
Farde ahl-e-haqeeqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Jiski mimbar bani gardan-e-awliyah,
Uss qadam ki karamat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Shah-e-barkaato barkaate peshiniyaa(n),
Nou bahar-e-tareeqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Sayyid aale Muhammad imaamur-rasheed,
Gul-e-rouz-e-riyaazat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Hazrat-e-Hamza shere Khuda wa Rasool,
Zeenat-e-Qaadriyat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Naam-o-kaam-o-tan-o-jaan-o-haal-o-maqaal,
Sab mein achhe ki soorat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Noor-e-jaa(n) itre-majmu'ah Aal-e-Rasool,
Mere Aaqa-e-ne'mat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Zaib-e-sajjaadah sajjaade noori nihaad,
Ahmad-e-Noor teenat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Be azaab-o-’itaab-o-hisaab-o-kitaab,
Ta abad Ahle Sunnat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Tere un dosto key tufail aay Khuda,
Banda-e-nang-e-khalqat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mere ustaad maa-baap bhai behen,
Ahl-e-wuld-o-‘ashirat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Ek mera hi rahmat mein da’waa nahin,
Shaah ki saari ummat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Kaash mahshar me jab unki aamad ho aur,
Bheje sab unki showkat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

Mujhse khidmat key qudsi kahein haa(n) RAZA,
Mustafa jaan-e-rahmat pe laakho(n) Salaam.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: AAY SHAAF’-E-TAR DAAMANAA(N) WE CHAARAH-E-DARD-E-NIHAA(N)

shers.roman:
Aay shaaf’-e-tar daamanaa(n) we chaarah-e-dard-e-nihaa(n),
Jaan-e-dil-o-rooh-e-rawaa(n) yani ‘shah-e-’arsh aastaa(n).

Aay masnadat ‘arsh-e-bareen we khaadimat rooh-e-amee(n),
Meher-e-falak maah-e-zamee(n) shaah-e-jahaan zayb-e-jinaa(n).

Aay marham-e-zakhm-e-jigar yaaqoot lab waala gohar,
Ghairat dehe shams-o-qamar rashk-e-gul-o-jaan-e-jahaa(n).

Aay jaann-e-man jaanaan-e-man ham dard ham darmaan-e-man,
Deen-e-man wa imaan-e-man amn-o-amaan-e-ummataa(n).

Aay muqtadaa shame' hudaa noor-e-Khuda zulmat zidaa,
Mehrat fida maahat gada noorat judaa az ein-o-aan.

‘Ain-e-karam zain-e-Haram maah-e-qadam anjum-e-khadam,
Waala hasham ‘aali hamam zer-e-qadam sad laa makaan.

Aainahaa hairaan-e-tu shams-o-qamar joyaan-e-tu,
Sayyaarahaa qurbaan-e-tu sham’at fidaa parwaanasaa(n).

Gul mast shud az booye to bulbul fidaaye rooye tu,
Sumbul nisaar mooye tu tooti bayaadat naghma khwaan.

Baad-e-saba joyaan tu baag-e-khuda az aan-e-tu,
Baala bala gardaan tu shaakh-e-chaman sarw chamaan.

Yaqoob garyaanat shudah ayyub hairanat shudah,
Saaleh hudi khwaanat shudah aye yakka taaz-e-laa makaan.

Khidrast gowyan al atash Moosa baayman gashta ghash,
Yaqoob shud beenaeash dar yaadat aye jaan-e-jahaan.

Dar hijr-e-tu sowzaan dilam parah jigar az ranj-o-gam,
Sad daagh seena az alam wa ze chashm daryaaye rawaan.

Beher-e-khuda marham bana az kaar-e-man bikusha girah,
Faryaad ras daade bidah daste bama uftaadgaan.

Mawla ze paaye uftaadah am daaram shaaha chashm-e-karam,
Meher-e-arab maah-e-ajam rahme bahaal-e-bandagaan.

Shakar bidah gowyak sukhan-e-talkh ast bar man jaan-e-man,
Baar-e-naqaab az rukh figan behre RAZAAYE khasta jaan.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: YAA KHUDA BEHER-E-JANAAB-E-MUSTAFA IMDAAD KUN

shers.roman:
Yaa Khuda beher-e-janaab-e-Mustafa imdaad kun,
Yaa RasoolAllah az beher-e-Khuda imdaad kun.

Yaa shafee al muznibeen Yaa rahmatalil aalameen,
Yaa amaan al khayaifeen Yaa multaja imdaad kun.

Hirz-e-man laa hirz-e-lahu Yaa kanza man laa kanza lahu,
Izza man laa izza lahu Yaa murtajaa imdaad kun.

Sarwat-e-be sarwataan aay quwwat-e-be quwwataan,
Aay panaah-e-be kasaan aye gamzidah imdaad kun.

Yaa mufeed al jood Yaa sir al wajood aay takham-e-bood,
Aay bahaar-e-ibtidaa-o-intihaa imdaad kun.

Aay mughees aay ghaus aay ghais aay ghiyaas nashaatein,
Aay ghani aay mughni aay saahib-e-hayaa imdaad kun.

Nemat-e-be mehnata aay minnat-e-be muntaha,
Rahmata be zahmata ain-e-ataa imdaad kun.

Nayyira nurulhuda badruduja shams ud duhaa,
Aay rukhat aaina zaat-e-khuda imdaad kun.

Aay gadayat jin-o-ins-o-hoor-o-gilmaan-o-malak,
Wey fidayat arsh-o-farsh arz-o-samaa imdaad kun.

Aay Quraishi Haashmi Taiybi tihaami abtahee,
Izz baitullah wa azraa-o-qubaa imdaad kun.

Yaa tabeeb ar rooh ya teeb al futooh aay be qubooh,
Mazhar-e-subbooh paak az ‘aibaha imdaad kun.

Aay ataa paash aay khataa posh aay afwo kesh aye kareem,
Aay saraapa raafat-e-Rabbul ‘ulaa imdaad kun.

Aay suroor-e-jaan ghamgeen aay paye ummat-e-hazeen,
Aay gham-e-tu zaamin-e-shaadi-e-maa imdaad kun.

Aay bihin itre ze aala joo naye ataar-e-quds,
Aay miheen dure ze durj-e-istafaa imdaad kun.

Aay key aalam jumla daadandat magar aib-o-qusoor,
Sarwar-e-be naqs shaah-e-be khata imdaad kun.

Banda-e-mawla-o-mawlaaye tamaami bandagaan,
Aay ze aalam besh-o-besh az tu khuda imdaad kun.

Aay ‘aleem aye aalim aye allaame a’lam aay alam,
Ilm tu mughnni ze arz-e-mudd'aa imdaad kun.

Aay badast-e-tu inaan-e-kun makun kun laa takun,
Wey bahikmat arsh wa mataht us saraa imdaad kun.

Sayyada Qalbul huda jalbun nadaa salbur rawaa,
Ghamzida ghamrur rida alhade imdaad kun.

Sarwara kahf ul waraa tan raa dawa jaan raa shifaa,
Aay naseem-e-daa manat eesa liqaa imdaad kun.

Aay baraye har dil maghshosh-o-chashme pur ghubaar,
Khaak kowyat kimiya-o-tootiya imdaad kun.

Jaan-e-jaan jaan-e-jahaan jaan-e-jahaan raa jaan-e-jaan,
Balke jaanaha khaak-e-nalainat shaaha imdaad kun.

Man alaiha faan aaqa aanche bar rooye zameen ast,
Dar tu faani dar tu gum bar tu fidaa imdaad kun.

Kullu shai haalikun illa wajhahu aay aan key khalq,
Dar to mustahlik tu dar zaat-e-Khuda imdaad kun.

Sahl kaare bashadat tasheel har mushkil az aanke,
Har che khwaahi mee kunad fauran tura imdaad kun.

Daar haan az man maraa be man sooye khud khwaan maraa,
Mudd'aa bakhsha dile be muddaa imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: MURTAZA SHER-E-KHUDA MARHAB KUSHAA KHAIBAR-E-KASHAA

shers.roman:
Murtaza sher-e-khuda marhab kushaa khaibar kashaa,
Sarwaraa lashkar kasha mushkil kusha imdaad kun.

Haidara azhdar dara zirghaam haayil manzara,
Sheher-e-irfaan raa dara raushan dura imdaad kun.

Zaighamaa ghaiz waghmaa zaigh-o-fitan raa raaghima,
Pehelwaan-e-haq ameer-e-laa fata imdaad kun.

Aay khuda raa teegh waaye andaam-e-Ahmad raa sipar,
Yaa Ali yaa bulhassan yaa bululaa imdaad kun.

Yaa yadullah ya qawi yaa zor-e-baazu-e-Nabi,
Man ze paa uftadadam aay dast-e-khuda imdaad kun.

Aay nigaar-e-raazdaar-e-qasrillah intajaa,
Aay bahaar-e-lala zaar-e-innama imdaad kun.

Aay tanat raa jaama pur zar jalwah baari ‘abaa,
Aay sarat raa taaj-e-gauhar hal ataa imdaad kun.

Aay rukhat raa ghaazah tatheer wa iz haab-e-najas,
Aay labat raa maaya-e-fasl ul qazaa imdaad kun.

Aay bajbaat hareer aiman ze shams-o-zamer yar,
Aay tura firdous mushtaaq-e-liqaa imdaad kun.

Aay bahazrat roz-e-hasrat ru banusrat-e-jaan basooz,
Shukr ein nusrat ba yak nazarat maraa imdaad kun.

Yaa taleeqal wajahi fee yaumin aboosin qamtareer,
Yaa baheej al qalbi fi yaumil alaa saa imdaad kun.

Aay waqahum Rabbuhum amanat ze sharre mustateer,
Mujrimam me joyam az kaifere waqaa imdaad kun.

Aay tanat dar raah-e-mawla khaak wa jaanat arsh-e-paak,
Bu turaab aay khaakiyaan raa peshwaa imdaad kun.

Aay shab-e-hijrat bajaye Mustafa bar rakht-e-khwaab,
Aay dam-e-shiddat fidaaye Mustafa imdaad kun.

Aay ‘adooye kufr-o-nasb-o-rafz-o-tafzeel-o-khurooj,
Aay uluwe sunnat-o-deen-e-huda imdaad kun.

Shamm’-e- bazm-o-taigh razm-o-kooh-e-azm-o-kaan-e-hazam,
Aay kaza waaye fuzoon tar az kaza imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: YAA SHAHEED-E-KARBALA YAA DAAFE’ KARB-O-BALA

shers.roman:
Yaa shaheed-e-Karbala yaa daafe' karb-o-bala,
Gul rukha shehzaada gulgon qaba imdaad kun.

Aay Hussain aay Mustafa raa rahat-e-jaan noor-e-ain,
Raahat-e-jaan noor-e-ainam deh biya imdaad kun.

Aay ze husn-e-khulq-o-hasn-e-khalq Ahmad nuskhahe,
Seena taa paa shakal-e-mehboob-e-khuda imdaad kun.

Jaan-e-husn imaan-e-husn aay kaan-e-husn aay shaan-e-husn,
Aay jamalat lam'-e- sham'-e- man ra’aa imdaad kun.

Jaan-e-zahra-o-shaheed-e-zahr raa zor-o-zaheer,
Zahrat az haar-e-tasleem-o-RAZA imdaad kun.

Aay bawaqe bekasaan-e-dahr raa zeba kase,
Wey bazaahir bekas-e-dasht-e-jafa imdaad kun.

Aay guloyat geh labaan-e-Mustafa raa bosa gaah,
Geh lab-e-tegh-e-e- laee raa hasrata imdaad kun.

Aay tan-e-tu geh sawaar-e-shahsawaar-e-arsh taaz,
Geh chunaan paamaal khail ashqiyaa imdaad kun.

Aay dil-o-jaanha fidaaye tishna kaamihaaye tu,
Aay labat sharh-e-razeena bil qazaa imdaad kun.

Aay key sowzat khaan maan-e-aab raa aatish zade,
Gar na boode giryaa arz-o-sama imdaad kun.

Hay che bahr-o-tiftagi kausar lab-o-ein tishnagi,
Khaak bar farq-e-furaat az lab maraa imdaad kun.

Abr gaw hargiz mubarad nahr go hargiz mareez,
Khud labat tasleem-o-faizat habbaza imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: BAAQI ASIYAAD YA SAJJAD YAA SHAAH-E-JAWWAD

shers.roman:
Baaqi asyaad Yaa Sajjad Yaa shaah-e-Jawaad,
Khizr-e-irshaad Aadam-e-aal-e-’abaa imdaad kun.

Aay ba qaid-e-zulm-o-sad qaidi ze band-e-gam kushaa,
Aay teh be daad-o-kaan-e-daad haa imdaad kun.

Baa qiraa yaa ‘aalim-e-saadaat yaa bahr ul ‘uloom,
Az ‘uloom-e-khud badaf’-e- jahl-e-maa imdaad kun.

Ja’far-e-Saadiq ba-haqq naatiq ba haqq waasiq tuyi,
Beher-e-haqq maa raa tareeq-e-haq numaa imdaad kun.

Shaan-e-hilman kaan-e-‘ilman jaan-e-silman as-salaam,
Moosa-e-kaazim-e-jahaan naazim-e-maraa imdaad kun.

Aay turaa zain az ibaadat wa ze-tozeen-e-’aabidaa(n),
Beher ein bey zeenat az zain-o-safaa imdaad kun

Zaamin saamin rizaa bar man nigaa hay az RAZA,
Khashm raa shaayaanam wa goyam rizaa imdaad kun.

Yaa shah-e-ma’roof maa raa rah sooye ma’roof deh,
Yaa sari amn az saqt dar doosra imdaad kun.

Yaa Junaid aay baadshaah-e-jund-e-‘irfaa(n) al-madad,
Shibliya aay shibl-e-sher-e-kibriyaa imdaad kun.

Shaikh ‘Abdul Waahid raaham soo-e-waahid numa,
Be-farah raa bil-farah tar toosiyaa! imdaad kun.

Bul Hasan hakaaryaa haalam Hasan kun be-riyaa,
Aay ‘Ali aay shaah-e-‘aali Murtaza imdaad kun.

Sarwar-e-makhzoom saifullah aay Khaalid baqarb,
Boo Sa’eedaa as’adaa sa’d-ul-waraa imdaad kun.

Aay toraa babrey choo ‘Abdul Qaadir Jeeli mazeed,
Bar sagaan-e-dar gahash lutf-e-numaa imdaad kun.

Wah che sher-e-sharzah raah-e-tust az bakht-e-sa’eed,
Dasht-e-zeegham lais sher-o-sheerzaa imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: YALALLEY KHUSH AAMADAM DAR KOOYE BAGHDAAD AAMADAM

shers.roman:
Yallaley khush aamadam dar kooye Baghdad aamadam,
Raqsam-o- jowshad zeher mowyam nidaa imdaad kun.

Turfa tar saazey zanam bar lab zadah muhr-e-adab,
Khaizad az har taar-e-jeeb-e-man sadaa imdaad kun.

Bosa gustakhaana cheedan khwaham az paaye sagash,
War na bakhshad pesh-e-sheh gareem shaaha imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: AAH YAA GHAUSAAH YAA GHAISAAH YAA IMDAAD KUN

shers.roman:
Aah Yaa Ghausaah Yaa Ghaisaah yaa imdaad kun,
Yaa hayaat al jood-e-yaa roohalmnaa imdaad kun.

Yaa wali yal auliya ibn-a-Nabi al Ambiyaa,
Aay key paayat bar raqaab-e-Auliyaa imdaad kun.

Dast bakhsh-e-hazrat hammaad zaib-e-dast-e-khud,
Az tu dastey khwahad ein bedast-o-paa imdaad kun.

Majmaa har do tareeq-o-marjaa-e-har do fareeq,
Faasilaan-o-wasilaa(n) raa muqtadaa imdaad kun.

Waashiyaa(n) bar bandah az har su hujoom aawardah and,
Yaa ‘azooman qaatilan indal waghaa imdaad kun.

Beher laa khaufun alayhim najjina mimma nakhaaf,
Baher laa hum yahzanoon ghamha zidaa imdaad kun.

Aay baamsaar-e-karam do qarn pesheen do haram,
Tu bamlke auliya choon eeliya imdaad kun.

Izzuna yaa hirzana yaa kanzana yaa fauzana,
Laithuna yaa ghaisana yaa ghausana imdaad kun.

Shaah-e-deen umr-e-sunan maah-e-zameen meher-e-zaman,
Gaah-e-keen beher-e-fitan barq-e-fanaa imdaad kun.

Tayyab-ul-akhlaaq-o- haq mushtaaq wa waasil-e-befiraaq,
Nayyar-ul-ashraaq wa lamma' usanaa imdaad kun.

Meherbaan tar barman az man az man aa ge tar ze man,
Chand gooyam sayyida jood an nida imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: YAA IBN-E-HAZA AL MURTAJAA YAA ABDA RAZZAQ IL WARA

shers.roman:
Yaa ibn-a-hazaal murtaja yaa abda Razzaq il wara,
Taake baashad rizqe maa ishq-e-shuma imdaad kun

Yaa abaa saaleh deen-o-islaah-e-quloob,
Faasidam gulzaar-o-dar josh hawa imdaad kun.

Jaan nasraa Yaa Muhiyodeen fansur wantasir,
Aay Ali aay sheher yaar-e-murtaza imdaad kun.

Sayyed-e-Moosa kaleem-e-toor-e-irfaan almadad,
Aay Hasan aye taajdaar-e-mujtaba imdaad kun.

Muntaqaa jo har ze jeelaan sayyad-e-Ahmad al amaan,
Be bahaa gohar bahauddin bahaa imdaad kun.

Bandah ra nimroode nafs andaakht dar naare hua,
Yaa baraheem abr-e-aatish gul kuna imdaad kun.

Aay Muhammad aay bhikaari aay gadaye Mustafa,
Maa gadayan-e-darat aay baa sakha imdaad kun.

Anajaa aye zindah jaawed aay qaazi jaya,
Aay jamaal-e-auliyaa yusuf liqaa imdaad kun.

Yaa Muhammad ya ilm waakhar ze-dast gaflatam,
Aay key har mooye tu dar zikr-e-khuda imdaad kun.

Aay banaamat sheerah jaan shud nabaat-e-kaalpi,
Ahmada nausheen laba sheereen adaa imdaad kun.

Shaah fadlullah ya zul fadl ya fadl -e-Ilaah,
Chashm dar fadl-e-tu bast ein benawa imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SHAAH-E-BARKAAT AYE ABUL BARKAAT AYE SULTAAN-E-JOOD

shers.roman:
Shaah-e-barkaat aay Abul Barkaat aay sultaan-e-jood,
BarakAllah aay Mubarak baadshaah imdaad kun.

Ishqie aay maqtool-e-ishq aay khoon bahayat ain-e-zaat,
Aay zijaan biguzishta jaanaan waasilaan imdaad kun.

Be khoodaa baa khuda aal-e-Muhammad Mustafa,
Sayyidaa haq waajida yaa muqtada imdaad kun.

Aay hareem-e-Taiba tauheed raa kooh-e-uhad,
Yaa jabl yaa Hamza yaa sher-e-khuda imdaad kun.

Aay saraapa chashm gashta dar shuhood-e-ain-e-hoo,
Zaan sabab kardand naamat ainyaa imdaad kun.

Yaa abulfadl aal-e-Ahmad hazrate Ache Miyaan,
Shaah samsudeen ziya al asfiyaa imdaad kun.

Wahi bar jad-e-tu laa ya’tal aulu-ul fadl aamdah ast,
Bandah be barg raa fadl-o-ghina imdaad kun.

Go na hijrat kardam az ism-o-ghayaa arzam baqurb,
Aakhir ein dar raaneem miskeen gada imdaad kun.

Aay key shamsi-o-karamat haaye tu misl-e-nujoom,
Aay ajab ham mehero ham anjum numa imdaad kun.

Man sarat kardam dame deegar ze sharq-e-kharq taab,
Aaftaaba dar shab-e-daajim biyaa imdaad kun.

Taajdaar-e-hazrat-e-Marehra Yaa Aal-e-Rasool,
Aay khuda khwaah-o-juda az maa adaa imdaad kun.

Aay shaahe waala ameem-e-aalaa azeem-ul-martaba,
Aay paye illa zabeeh-e-tegh-e-laa imdaad kun.

Naayil-e-jood az name zaan yam mara sairaab saaz,
Nau gul-e-jood az shamme jaanam faza imdaad kun.

Aay ajab ghaipe tora mashhood az ghaib-e-shuhood,
Deedah az khud basti-o-deedi khuda imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: BANDAH AMM WAL AMRU AMRUK AANCHE DAANI KUN BA MAN

shers.roman:
Bandah amm wal amru amruk aanche daani kun ba man,
Man namigooyam mara biguzaar yaa imdaad kun.

Khaana zaadaan-e-kareeman gar bashiddat mee zaneed,
Ein man wa eink sarm warne mara imdaad kun.

Dast-e-man bagirafti wa bar tust paasash baad azein,
Yaa tu daani yaa hamaan dast-e-tu yaa imdaad kun.

Gar badozakh mee rawam aakhir hami koweind khalq,
Kaan Rasooli mee rawad ghairat bara imdaad kun.

‘Aar baashad bar shabaane deh agar zaay’-e- shawad,
Yak rasan dar dasht yaa haami yal hummaa imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: YAA ILAHI ZEL EEN SHERAAN GIRAFTAM BANDAH RAA

shers.roman:
Yaa Ilaahi zel een sheraan giraftam bandah raa,
Az sagaan-e- shaan shumaarad daayimaan imdaad kun.

Be wasaayil aamdan sooye tu manzoore tu neest,
Zaan behre Mahboob tu gooyad RAZA imdaad kun.

Mazhar-e-aun and wa einjaa maghz harfi besh neest,
Yaani aay Rabb-e-Nabi-o-Auliya imdaad kun.

Neest aun az ghaire towbal ghaire tu khud hech neest,
Yaa Ilaah al Haq ilaykal muntaha imdaad kun.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: MUSTAFA KHAIR-UL-WARAA HO

shers.roman:
Mustafa khair-ul-waraa ho,
Sarwar-e-har do saraa ho.

Apne achchon ka tasadduq,
Hum bado(n) ko bhi nibaaho.

Kis key phir ho kar rahein hum,
Gar tumhin hum ko nah chaaho.

Bad hansei(n) tum un ki khaatir,
Raat bhar ro-ow karaho.

Bad karein har dam buraayi,
Tum kaho un kaa bhalaa ho.

Hum wohi naashustah roo hain,
Tum wohi behr-e-’ataa ho.

Hum wohi shaayaane rad hain,
Tum wohi shaan-e-sakhaa ho.

Hum wohi be-sharm-o-bad hain,
Tum wohi kaan-e-hayaa ho.

Hum wohi nang-e-jafaa hain,
Tum wohi jaan-e-wafaa ho.

Hum wohi qaabil sazaa key,
Tum wohi rahm-e-Khuda ho.

Charkh badl-e-dahr badle,
Tum badalne sey waraa ho.

Ab humein ho(n) sahw haa shaa,
Aisi bhoolo(n) sey judaa ho.

Umr bhar toh yaad rakkha,
Waqt par kyaa bhoolnaa ho.

Waqt-e-paidaaish nah bhoole,
Kaifa yansaa kyoon qaza ho.

Yeh bhi Maula ‘arz kardu(n),
Bhool agar jaao toh kya ho.

Woh ho jo tum par giraa(n) hay,
Woh ho jo hargiz nah chaaho.

Woh ho jis ka naam lete,
Dushmano(n) ka dil buraa ho.

Woh ho jis key rad ki khaatir,
Raat din waqf-e-du’a ho.

Mar mite(n) barbaad bande,
Khanah aabaad aag ka ho.

Shaad ho iblees mal’oo(n),
Gham kisey iss qahr ka ho.

Tum ko ho wallah tum ko,
Jaano dil tum par fidaa ho.

Tum ko gham sey haq bachaaye,
Gham ‘adoo ko jaa(n) gazaa ho.

Tum sey gham ko kya ta'alluq,
Be-kaso(n) key ghamzida ho.

Haq duroodein tum pe bheje,
Tum mudaam us ko saraa ho.

Woh ‘ataa de tum ‘ataa lo,
Woh wohi chaahe jo chaaho.

Bar to ouw paashad to bar maa,
Taa abad yeh silsilah ho.

Kyoon RAZA mushkil sey dariye,
Jab Nabi mushkil kusha ho.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: MILK-E-KHAAS-E-KIBRIYAA HO

shers.roman:
Milk-e-khaas-e-Kibriyaa ho,
Maalik-e-har maa siwaa ho.

Koi kyaa jaane key kyaa ho,
‘Aql-e-‘aalam sey waraa ho.

Kanz-e-maktoom-e-azal mein,
Dur-e-maknoon-e-Khuda ho.

Sab sey awwal sab sey aakhir,
Ibtidaa ho intihaa ho.

They waseeley sab Nabi tum,
Asl-e-maqsood-e-hudaa ho.

Paak karne ko wuzu they,
Tum Namaaz-e-jaanfizaa ho.

Sab bishaarat ki azaa(n) they,
Tum azaa(n) ka mudda’aa ho.

Sab tumhaari hi khabar they,
Tum mu-akhar mubtada ho.

Qurb-e-Haq ki manzilein they,
Tum safar ka muntahaa ho.

Qabl-e-zikr izmaar kya jab,
Rutbah saabiq aap ka ho.

Toor-e-Moosa charkh-e-‘Eesa,
Kya musaawi-e-danaa ho.

Sab jehat key daaire mein,
Shash jehat sey tum waraa ho.

Sab makaa(n) tum laa-makaa(n) mein,
Tan hain tum jaan-e-safaa ho.

Sab tumhaare dar key rastey,
Aik tum raah-e-Khuda ho.

Sab tumhaarey aagey shaaf’-e-,
Tum Huzoor-e-Kibriyaa ho.

Sab ki hay tum tak rasaai,
Baarga tak tum rasaa ho.

Woh kalas rozey ka chamkaa,
Sar jhukaao kajkulaa ho.

Woh dar-e-dawlat pey aaye,
Jholiyaa(n) phaylaao shaaho.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: AS SALAAM AAY AHMADAT SIHR-O-BARADAR AAMDAH

shers.roman:
As salaam aay Ahmadat sahru bar dar aamdah,
Hamzah sardaar-e-shaheedaan amm akbar aamdah.

Ja’far-e-koo mee parad subho masa baa qudsiyaan,
Baa tu ham maskan ba batan-e-paak maadar aamadah.

Bint-e-Ahmad raunaq-e-kaashaana-o-baanuway tu,
Gowsht-o-khoon-e-tu balahmash sheer-o-shakar aamadah.

Har do rehaan-e-Nabi gulhaaye tu zaan gul zameen,
Behr-e-gul chinat zameen-e-baagh bartar aamdah.

Mee chameedi gulbana dar baagh-e-Islaam-o-hanooz,
Ghuncha at nashiguft-o-ne nakhle deegar bar aamdah.

Narm narm az bazm daaman cheedah rafta baad-e-tund,
Yaa ali choon bar zabaan-e-sham'-e- muztar aamdah.

Maah-e-taabaan go mataab-o-mihr rakhshaan go markhash,
Baakhtar taa khaawar ismat noor gustar aamdah.

Hal mushkil kun ba rooye man dar rehmat kusha,
Aay banaam-e-tu muslam fathe khaibar aamadah.

Marhaba aye qaatil-e-marhab ameer al ashjaeen,
Dar zilaal-e-zulfiqarat shor-e-mahshar aamdah.

Seena amm raa mashriqstaan kun banoor-e-maarifat,
Aay key naam saaya at khursheed khaawar aamadah.

Ke rasad Mawla bamehr-e-taabnakat najam-e-shaam,
Go ba noor-e-suhbat -e-o-subah-e-anwar aamdah.

Naasibi raa bugz-e-tu sooye jahannam rah namood,
Raafzi az hubb-e-kaazib dar saqar dar aamadah.

Man ze haq me khwaaham aay khursheed-e-haq aan mihr tu,
Kaz ziyaaish aalam-e-imaan munawwar aamadah.

Behr-e-astar chaadar mahtaab-o-een zarreen parand,
Naa pazeeraye galeem bakht-e-qambar aamdah.

Tishna kaam-e-khud RAZAYE khasta raa ham jur'aa,
Shukre aan nemat key naamat shaah-e-kausar aamdah.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: AAY BADAUR-E-KHUD IMAAM-E-EHLE EEQAAN AAMADAH.

shers.roman:
Aay badaur-e-khud Imaam-e-ehle-e-eeqaan aamadah,
Jaan-e-ins-o-jaan-e-jaan-o-jaan-e-jaanaan aamadah.

Qaamat tu sarw-e-naaz joyebaar-e-maarifat,
Rooye tu khursheed aalamtaab-e-imaan aamadah.

Mooye zulf-e-ambreenat quwwat-e-rooh-e-huda,
Rang rooyat ghaazah deen-e-musalmaan aamadah.

Zang az dilha zewaayad khaak boosi darat,
Taabnaak az jalwah at miraat-e-ehsaan aamdah.

Sad lataayif mee kushayad yak nigaah-e-lutf-e-tu,
Dast-e-faizanat kaleed-e-baab-e-irfaan aamadah.

Naamat aal-e-Ahmad-o-Ahmad shaf’ee ul muznibeen,
Zaan dil az dast-e-gunah peshe tu naa laan aamadah.

Pur sadaa shud baagh-e-quds az nagmahaaye wasf-e-tu,
Taa bahaar-e-jannat az gulzaar-e-jeelaan aamadah.

Choon gul-e-aal-e-Muhammad rang-e-Hamzah bar furookht,
Booye aal-e-Ahmad andar baagh-e-irfaan aamadah.

Gulbune nowrasta at raa sabza charkh-e-kohan,
Farsh paa andaaz bazm-e-rifa'at-e-shaan aamadah.

Taa kasheedam naala Yaa Aal-e-Ahmad al ghayaas,
Be sar-o-saamaaneym raa turfa saamaan aamadah.

Dar panaah-e-saayae daamanat aay abr-e-karam,
Garmi-e-gham kushtaa baa sowz-e-ahzaan aamdah.

Dil fagaarye aabala paaye bashehre jood tu,
Az bayaabaan-e-balaa uftaan-o-khaizaan aamadah.

Tazah faryaade baraaward aay maseeha bar darat,
Kohna ranjoorey key az gham barlabash jaan aamadah.

Zeher nosh-e-jaam-e-gham dar hasrat-e-fihii shifaa,
Zey angabeen-e-rahmatat yak jur'a jowyaan aamadah.

Behre aan rangeen adaa gul barg chand Aal-e-Rasool,
Barkash az dil khaare aalaame key dar jaan aamadah.

Ahmad-e-Noori darein zulmaat-e-ranj-o-tishnagi,
Rahnumayam sooye tu aay aab-e-haiwaan aamdah.

Aay zulaale chashma kausar lab-e-sairaab tu,
Bar dar-e-paakat RAZA baa jaan-e-sowzaan aamadah.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ZAMEEN-O-ZAMAA(N) TUMHAARE LIYE

shers.roman:
Zameen-o-zamaa(n) tumhaare liye makeen-o-makaa(n) tumhaare liye,
Chuneen-o-chunaa(n) tumhaare liye, bane do jahaan tumhaare liye.

Dahan mein zabaan tumhaare liye badan mein hay jaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Ham aaye yahaan tumhaare liye utthein bhi wahaan tumhaare liye.

Farishte khidam Rasool-o-hisham tamaam-e-umam ghulaam-e-karam.
Wujood-o-’adam hudoos-o-qidam jahaan mein ‘iyaan tumhaare liye.

Kaleem-o-Najeeh, Maseeh-o-Safi, Khaleel-o-Razi, Rasool-o-Nabi,
Ateeq-o-Wasi Ghani-o-’Ali sanaa ki zabaan tumhaare liye.

Isaalat-e-kul imaamat-e-kul siyaadat-e-kul imaarat-e-kul,
Hukoomat-e-kul wilaayat-e-kul Khuda key yahaan tumhaare liye.

Tumhaari chamak tumhari dhamak tumhari jhalak tumhari mahak,
Zameen-o-falak simaak-o-samak mein sikkah nishaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Wo kanz-e-nihaan yeh noor-e-fashaan woh kun sey ‘iyaan yeh bazm-e-fakaan,
Yeh har tan-o-jaa(n) yeh baagh-e-jinaan yeh saaraa samaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Zuhoor-e-nihaa(n) qayaam-e-jahaa(n) rukoo’-e-mihaan sujood-e-shahaa(n),
Niyaazei(n) yahaaa(n) namazei(n) wahaa(n) yeh kis liye haan tumhaare liye.

Yeh shams-o-qamar yeh shaam-o-sahar yeh barg-o-shajar yeh baagh-o-samar,
Yeh taigh-o-sipar yeh taaj-o-kamar yeh hukm-e-rawaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Yeh faiz diye woh jood kiye key naam liye zamaana jiye,
Jahaa(n) ney liye tumhaare diye yeh ikramiyaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Sahaab-e-karam rawaana kiye key aab-e-ni’am zamaanah piye,
Jo rakhte they hum woh chaak siye yeh satr-e-badaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Sanaa kaa nishaa(n) woh noor fashaa(n) keh mehr-wa-shaa(n) ba aanhamah shaa(n),
Ba-saaya kashaa(n) mawaakib shaa(n) yeh naam-o-nishaa(n) tumhaare liye.

‘Ataa-e-arab jala-e-karab fuyooz-e-’ajab baghair-e-talab,
Yeh rehmat-e-Rab hay kis key sabab ba-Rabb-e-jahaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Zunoob-e-fanaa ‘uyoob-e-habaa quloob-e-safaa khutoob-e-rawaa,
Yeh khoob-e-’ataa kuroob-e-zudaa paye dil-o-jaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Nah jinn-o-bashar key aattho(n) paher malaaikah dar pey bastah kamar,
Nah jubbah-o-sar key qalb-o-jigar hain sajdah kunaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Nah Rooh-e-Amee(n) nah ‘Arsh-e-Baree(n) nah Lawh-e-Mubee(n) koi bhi kaheen
Khabar hi nahin jo ramzei(n) khulee(n) azal ki nihaa(n) tumhaare liye.

Jinaa(n) mein chaman, chaman mein saman, saman mein phaban, phaban mein
dulhan,

Sazaa-e-mihan pey aise minan yeh amn-o-amaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Kamaal-e-mihaa(n) jalaal-e-shihaa(n) jamaal-e-hisaa(n) mein tum ho ‘iyaan,

Key saare jahaa(n) mein roz-e-fakaan zil-e-aaina saa(n) tumhaare liye.
Yeh toor kujaa siphir to kya key ‘arsh-e-‘ulaa bhi door raha,

Jihat sey waraa wisaal milaa yeh rif’at-e-shaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Khaleel-o-Naji, Maseeh-o-Safi, sabhi sey kahi kaheen bhi bani,

Yeh be-khabari key khalq phiri kahaa(n) sey kahaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Bafowr-e-sadaa samaa(n) yeh bandha yeh sidrah uttha woh arsh ‘jhuka,

Sufoof-e-samaa ne sajdah kiya huwi jo azaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Yeh marhamtei(n) key kachi matei(n) nah chhorei(n) latei(n) nah apni gatei(n),

Qusoor karei(n) aur un sey bharei(n) qusoor-e-jinaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Fanaa badarat baqaa babarat ze har do jihat bagird-e-sarat,

Hay markaziyyat tumhaari sifat key dono(n) kamaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Ishaare sey chaand cheer diya chhupe huwe khur ko pher liya,

Gaye huwe din ko ‘asr kiya ye taab-o-tawaa(n) tumhaare liye.
Sabaa woh chale key baagh phale woh phool khile key din ho(n) bhale,

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: NAZAR IK CHAMAN SEY DO CHAAR HAY

shers.roman:
Nazar ik chaman sey do chaar hay nah chaman chaman bhi nisaar hay,
‘Ajab us key gul ki bahaar hay key bahaar bulbul-e-zaar hay.

Nah dil-e-bashar hi figaar hay key malak bhi us kaa shikaar hay,
Yeh jahaan key hazdah hazaar hay jise dekho us ka hazaar hay.

Nahin sar key sajdah kunaa(n) nah ho nah zubaan key zamzamah khwaa(n) nah ho,
Nah woh dil key us pey tapaa(n) nah ho nah wo seena jis ko qaraar hay.

Woh hay bheeni bheeni wahaan mehek key basaa hay ‘arsh sey farsh tak,
Woh hay pyaari pyaari wahaan chamak key wahaan ki shab bhi nahaar hay.

Koi aur phool kahaan khile nah jagah hay joshish-e-husn sey,
Nah bahaar aur pey rukh kare key jhapak palak ki to khaar hay.

Yeh saman yeh sosan-o-yaa saman yeh banafshah sunbul-o-nastaran,
Gul-o-sarw-o-laalah bharaa chaman wohi ek jalwah hazaar hay.

Yeh sabaa sanak woh kali chatak yeh zabaa(n) chehek lab-e-joo chhalak,
Yeh mehek jhalak yeh chamak damak sab usi key dam ki bahaar hay.

Wohi jalwah sheher ba-sheher hay wohi asl-e-‘aalam-o-dahr hay,
Wohi behr hay wohi lehr hay wohi paat hay wohi dhaar hay.

Woh nah thaa toh baagh mein kuch nah thaa woh nah ho to baagh ho sab fanaa,
Woh hay jaan, jaan sey hay baqaa wohi bun hay ban sey hi baar hay.

Yeh adab key bulbul-e-be-nawaa kabhi khul key kar nah sake nawaa,
Nah sabaa ko tez rawish rawaa nah chalakti nehron ki dhaar hay.

Ba-adab jhukaa lo sar-e-wilaa, key mein naam loon gul-o-baagh kaa,
Gul-e-tar Muhammad-e-Mustafa chaman un kaa paak diyaar hay.

Wohi aankh un ka jo moonh take wohi lab key mehw hown na’at key,
Wohi sar jo un key liye jhuke wohi dil jo un pey nisaar hay.

Yeh kisi ka husn hay jalwahgar key tapaa(n) hain khoobon key dil jigar,
Nahin chaak jayb-e-gul-o-sahar key qamr bhi seenah fagaar hay.

Wohi nazr-e-sheh mein zare nekoo jo ho unke ‘ishq mein zard roo,
Gul-e-khuld us sey ho rang joo yeh khazaan woh tazah bahaar hay.

Jise teri saff-e-ni’aal sey mile do niwaal-e-nawaal sey,
Woh bana key us key ugaal sey bhari saltanat ka udhaar hay.

Woh utthein chamak key tajalliyaan key mita dein sab ki ta’alliyaan,
Dil-o-jaan ko bakhshein tasalliyaan tera noor baarid-o-haar hay.

Rusul-o-Malak peh Durood ho wohi jaane un key shumaar ko,
Magar eik aisa dikhaa to do jo shafee’-e-roz shumaar hay.

Nah hijaab charkh-o-maseeh par nah kaleem-o-toor nihaa(n) magar.
Jo gaya hay ‘arsh sey bhi udhar wo ‘arab kaa naaqah sawaar hay.

Woh teri tajjali-e-dil nasheen key jhalak rahey hain falak zamee(n),
Tere sadqe mere mah-e-mubee(n) meri raat kyoon abhi taar hay.

Meri zulmatein hain sitam magar tera mah nah mehr keh mehr gar,
Agar ek cheent pare idhar shab-e-daaj abhi to nahaar hay.

Gunahe RAZA ka hisaab kyaa woh agar che laakhon sey hain siwaa,
Magar aay ‘afuw tere ‘afw ka nah hisaab hay nah shumaar hay.

Tere Deen-e-paak ki woh ziyaa key chamak uthi rah-e-istaafa,
Jo nah maane aap saqar gaya kahin noor hay kahin naar hay.

Koi jaan bas key mehek rahi kisi dil mein us sey khatak rahi,
Nahin us key jalwe mein yak rahi kahin phool hay kahin khaar hay.

Woh jise wahaabiya ney diya hay laqab shaheed-o-zabeeh ka,
Woh shaheed laila-e-najd thaa woh zabeeh-e-taigh-e-khiyaar hay.

Yeh hay dee(n) ki taqwiyat us key ghar yeh hay mustaqeem siraat-e-shar,
Jo shaqi key dil mein hay gaaw-khar toh zabaan pey choorhaa chamaar hay.

Woh Habeeb pyaara toh umr bhar kare faiz-o-jood hi sar basar,
Arey tujh ko khaaye tap-e-saqar tere dil mein kis sey bukhaar hay.

Woh RAZA key neze ki maar hay key ‘aduw key seene mein ghaar hay,
Kise chaarah joyi ka waar hay key yeh waar waar sey paar hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: IMAAN HAY QAAL-E-MUSTAFAAYI

shers.roman:
Imaan hay qaal-e-Mustafaayi,
Quraan hay haal-e-Mustafaayi.

Allah ki saltanat kaa doolha,
Naqsh-e-Timsaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Kul sey baala Rusul sey a’laa,
Ijlaal-o-jalaal-e-Mustafaayi

As-haab nujoom-e-rehnumaa hain,
Kashti hay aal-e-Mustafaayi.

Idbaar sey to mujhe bacha le,
pyaare iqbaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Mursal mushtaaq-e-Haq hain aur Haq,
Mushtaaq wasaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Khwaahaan-e-wasaal-e-kibriyaa hain,
Jooyaan-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Mahboob-o-muhib ki milk hay eik,
Kaunain hain maal-e-Mustafaayi.

Allah nah choote dast-e-dil sey,
Daamaan-e-khayaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Hain tere supurd sab ummeedein,
Aay jood-o-nawaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Raushan kar qabr be-kason ki,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Andher hay be tere mera ghar,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Mujh ko shab-e-gham daraa rahi hay,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Aankhon mein chamak key dil mein aaja,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Meri shab-e-taar din banaa dey,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Chamkaa dey naseeb-e-bad-naseebaa(n),
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Qazzaaq hain sar pey raah gum hay,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Chaaya aankhon tale andhera,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Dil sard hay apni lau lagaa dey,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Ghanghoor ghataaein gham ki chaayin,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Bhatka hoon tu raasta bataa jaa,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Faryaad dabaati hay siyaahi,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Mere dil-e-murdah ko jilaa dey,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Aankhein teri raah tak rahi hain,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Dukh mein hain andheri raat waale,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Taareek hay raat ghamzadon ki,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Ho dono jahaa(n) mein moonh ujaala,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Taareeki-e-gor sey bachaana,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Purnoor hay tujh sey bazm-e-’aalam,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Ham teerah dilon pey bhi karam kar,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Lillaah idhar bhi koi pheraa,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

Taqdeer chamak uthe RAZA ki,
Aay sham’-e-jamaal-e-Mustafaayi.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: ZARRE JHAR KAR TERI PEZAARO(N) KEY

shers.roman:
Zarre jhar kar teri pezaaro(n) key,
Taaj-e-sar bante hain sayyaro(n) key.

Hum sey choro(n) pey jo farmaayei(n) karam,
Khil'at-e-zar banein pushtaaro(n) key.

Mere Aaqa ka woh dar hay jiss par,
Maathe ghiss jaate hain sardaaro(n) key.

Mere Eesa tere sadqe jaaoo(n),
Toor be-toor hay beemaaro(n) key.

Mujrimo! chashm-e-tabassum rakkho,
Phool ban jaate hain angaaro(n) key.

Tere abru key tasadduq pyaare,
Band kurre hain giriftaaro(n) key.

Jaan-o-dil tere qadam par waarey,
Kyaa naseebay hain tere yaaro(n) key.

Sidq-o-‘adl-o-karam-o-himmat mein,
Chaar soo shohrey hain inn chaaro(n) key.

Behr-e-tasleem-e-‘Ali maidaa(n) mein,
Sar jhuke rehte hain talwaaro(n) key.

Kaisey Aaqaao(n) ka bandah hoon RAZA,
Bol baale meri Sarkaaro(n) key.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: SAR SOOYE RAUZA JHUKA PHIR TUJH KO KYA

shers.roman:
Sar sooye Rauza jhukaa phir tujh ko kya,
Dil tha saajid najdiyaa phir tujh ko kya.

Baithte uthte madad key waaste,
Yaa RasoolAllah kahaa phir tujh ko kya.

Ya gharaz sey chat key mahz zikr ko,
Naam-e-paak un ka japaa phir tujh ko kya.

Be-khudi mein sajdah-e-dar yaa tawaaf,
Jo kiya acha kiya phir tujh ko kya.

Un ko tamleek Malik ul Mulk sey,
Maalik-e-’aalam kahaa phir tujh ko kya.

Un key naam-e-paak par dil jaan-o-maal,
Najdiyaa sab taj diyaa phir tujh ko kya.

Yaa’ibaadi keh key ham ko shaah ney,
Apnaa bandah kar liya phir tujh ko kya.

Dev key bandon sey kab hay yeh khitaab,
Tu nah un kaa hay nah thaa phir tujh ko kya,

Laa ya’oodoon aage hoga bhi nahin,
Tu alag hay daaima phir tujh ko kya.

Dasht-e-gird-o-pesh-e-Taibah ka adab,
Makkah saa thaa yaa siwaa phir tujh ko kya.

Najdi marta hay keh kyoon ta’zeem ki,
Yeh hamaara Deen thaa phir tujh ko kya.

Dev tujh sey khush hay phir ham kya karein,
Ham sey raazi hay Khuda phir tujh ko kya.

Dev key bandon sey ham ko kya gharaz,
Ham hain ‘abd-e-Mustafa phir tujh ko kya.

Teri dozakh sey to kuch cheena nahin,
Khuld mein pohonchaa RAZA phir tujh ko kya.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: WOHI RAB HAY JISNE TUJH KO HAMATAN KARAM BANAAYA

shers.roman:
Wohi Rab hay jisne tujh ko hamatan karam banaaya,
Hamein bheek maangney ko tera aastaa(n) bataaya.

Tujhe hamd hay Khudaaya.
Tumhin haakim-e-baraayaa tumhin qaasim-e-’atayaa,

Tumhin daaf’-e-balaayaa tumhin shaaf’-e-khataaya.
Koi tum saa kaun aaya.

Woh kunwaari paak Maryam woh nafakhto feeh kaa dam,
Hay ‘ajab nishaan-e-a’azam magar Aamina ka jaaya.

Wohi sab sey afzal aaya.
Yahi boley sidrah waale chaman-e-jahaa(n) key thaaley,

Sabhi mein ney chaan daley tere paaye kaa nah paaya.
Tujhe yak ney yak banayaa.

Fa izaa faraghta fansab yeh mila hay tum ko mansab,
Jo gadaa bana chuke ab, uttho waqt-e-bakhshish aaya.

Karo qismat-e-’ataayaa.
Wa ilal ilaahi farghab karo ‘arz sab key matlab,

Key tumhin ko takte hain sab karo un par apnaa saaya.
Bano shaaf’-e-khataayaa.

Arey aay Khuda key bando! koi mere dil ko dhoondo,
Mere pass thaa abhi to abhi kya huwa Khudaayaa.

Naa koi gaya nah aaya.
Hamein aay RAZA tere dil kaa pataa chalaa ba-mushkil,

Dar-e-rozah key muqaabil woh hamein nazar toh aaya.
Yeh nah pooch kaisa paayaa.

Kabhi khandah zer lab hay kabhi giryaa saari shab hay,
Kabhi gham kabhi tarab hay nah sabab samajh mein aayaa.

Kabhi khaak par paraa hay sar-e-charkh zer-e-paa hay,
Kabhi pesh-e-dar khara hay sar-e-bandagi jhukaayaa.

Tu qadam mein ‘arsh paayaa.
Kabhi woh tapak key aatish kabhi woh tapak key baarish,

Kabhi woh hujoom-e-naalish koi jaane abr chaaya.
Bari joshishon sey aaya.

Kabhi woh chehek key bulbul kabhi woh mehek key khud gul,
Kabhi woh lehek key bilkul chaman-e-jinaa(n) khilaaya.

Gul-e-quds lehlahaayaa.
Kabhi zindagi key armaa(n) kabhi margh-e-nau ka khwaahaa(n),

Woh jiyaa key marg qurbaa(n) woh mawaa key zeest laaya.
Kahe rooh haa(n) jilaayaa.

Kabhi gum kabhi ‘iyaa(n) hay kabhi sard gah tapaa(n) hay,
Kabhi zer-e-lab faghaa(n) hay kabhi chup key dam nah thaayaa.

Rukh-e-kaam jaa(n) dikhaayaa.
Yeh tassawwuraat-e-baatil tere aage kya hain mushkil,

Teri qudratein hain kaamil unhein raast kar Khudaaya.
Mein unhein shafee’ laayaa.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: BAKAAR-E-KHAISH HAIRAANAM AGHISNI YA RASOOLALLAH

shers.roman:
Bakaar-e-khaish hairaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah
Pareshaanam pareshaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah

Nadaaram juz tu mal jaaye nadanam juz tu maa-waaye,
Tui khud saaz-o-saamaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Shahaa be-kas nawaazi kun tabeebaa charaah saazi kun,
Mareez-e-dard-e-’isyaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Naraftam raah beenaayaa(n) futaadam dar chahe ‘isyaa(n),
Biyaa aay habl-e-rahmaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Gunah bar sar balaa baarad dilam dard-e-hawa daarad,
Ke daanad juz tu dar maanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Agar raani-o-gar khwaani gulaamam anta sultaani,
Digar cheeze nameedaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Bakahf-e-rahmatam parwar ze qitmeeram mane kamtar,
Sag-e-dargaah-e-sultaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Gunah dar jaanam aatish zad qiyaamat shol’a mi kheezad,
Madad aay aab-e-haiwaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Choo margam nakhl-e-jaa(n) soozad bahaaram raa khizaan sowzad,
Na rezad-o-barg-e-imaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Choo mehshar fitna angezad balaaye be imaa(n) kheezad,
Bajoyam az tu dar maanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Pidar raa nafrate aayad pisar raa wahshat afzaayad,
Tu geeri zer-e-daamaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

‘Azeezaa(n) gashta door az man hama yaaraa(n) nufoor az man,
Daree(n) wahshat tura khwaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Gadaaye aamad aay sultaa(n) baa ummeed-e-karam naalaa(n),
Tahi daamaa(n) magir daanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Agar mi raanem az dar baman binumaa dar-e-deegar,
Kujaa naalam kiraa khwaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

Giraftaaram rihaayi deh maseehaa mowmiyaayi deh,
Shikastam rang-e-saamaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah

RAZA yat saail-e-be-par tooyi sultaan-e-laa tanhar,
Shahaa behre azee(n) khwaanam aghisni Yaa RasoolAllah.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: LAHAD MEIN ISHQ-E-RUKH-E-SHAH KAA DAAGH LE KEY CHALE

shers.roman:
Lahad mein ishq-e-rukh-e-shah kaa daagh ley key chale,
Andheri raat suni thi charaagh ley key chale.

Tere gulaamon ka naqsh-e-qadam hay raah-e-Khuda,
Woh kyaa behek sakey jo yeh suraagh ley key chale.

Jinaan banegi muhibbaan-e-chaar yaar ki qabr,
Jo apne seene mein ye chaar baagh le key chale.

Gaye, ziyaarat-e-dar ki, sad aah waapas aaye,
Nazar key ashk piche dil ka daagh le key chale,

Madeene jaan-e-jinaan-o-jahaa(n) hay wo sun lein,
Jinhein junoon-e-jinaa(n) sooye zaagh le key chale.

Tere sahaaab-e-sukhan sey na nam key nam sey bhi kam,
Baleegh behr-e-balaaghat balaagh le key chale.

Huzoor-e-Taibah sey bhi koi kaam barh kar hay,
Key jhoote heele makr-o-faraagh le key chale.

Tumhaare wasf-e-jamaal-o-kamaal mein jibraeel,
Muhaal hay key majaal-o-masaagh le key chale.

Gilah nahin hay mureed rasheed-e-shaitaa(n) sey,
Keh us key wusa’at-e-ilmi ka laagh le key chale.

Har eik apne bare ki barayi karta hay,
Har eik mugbachah mugh ka ayaagh le key chale.

Magar Khuda pe jo dhabba darogh ka thopa,
Ye kis la’ee(n) ki ghulaami ka daagh le key chale.

Wuqoo’-e-kizb key ma’ni durust aur qudoos,
Hiye ki phoote ‘ajab sabz baagh le key chale.

Jahaa(n) mein koi bhi kaafir saa kaafir aisaa hay,
Ke apne Rab pe safaahat ka daagh le key chale.

Pari hay andhe ko ‘aadat keh shorbe hi sey khaaye,
Bater haath nah aayi to zaagh le key chale.

Khabees behr-e-khabeesah khabeesah behr-e-khabees,
Ke saath jins ko baazo-o-kulaagh le key chale.

Jo deen kawwo(n) ko de baitthe un ko yaksaa(n) hay,
Kulaagh le key chale yaa ulaagh le key chale.

RAZA kisi sag-e-Taibah key paao(n) bhi choome,
Tum aur aah keh itnaa dimaagh le key chale.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: GHAZAL QATA’ BAND

shers.roman:
Ambiyaa ko bhi ajal aani hay,
Magar aisi keh faqat aani hay.

Phir usi aan key baad un ki hayaat,
Misle saabiq wohi jismaani hay.

Rooh toh sab ki hay zinda un kaa,
Jism-e-purnoor bhi roohaani hay.

Auro(n) ki rooh ho kitni hi lateef,
Un key ajsaam ki kab saani hay.

Paau(n) jis khaak pey rakh dein woh bhi,
Rooh hay paak hay nooraani hay.

Uski azwaaj ko jaaiz hay nikaah,
Us ka tarkah bate jo faani hay.

Yeh hain Hayyi abadi un ko RAZA,
Sidq-e-waa'da ki qazaa maani hay.

kalams.author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan Bareilvi
kalams.title: NAZM-E-MU’ATTAR

shers.roman:
HAMD
Hamdan laka yaa mufaddili ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Yaa dhal afdaal.
Yaa mun’imi yaa mujammili ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Antal muta’aal.
Mawlaai bimaa mananta bil-joodi ‘alaihi,

Min Dooni Suwaal.
Umnun wa ajib saaili ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Jud bilaa maal.
SALAWAAT

Baarad ze Khuda bar jadd-e-’Abdul Qaadir,
Mahmood Khuda Haamid ‘Abdul Qaadir.

Baaraan-e-Duroode key chakeedah ze rukhash,
Baarad basar Sayyid ‘Abdul Qaadir.

TAMHEED
Yaa Rabb keh damad sanaa-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Har harf kunad sanaa-e-’Abdul Qaadir.
Hamzah ba-radeef-e-alif aayad ya’ni,

RADEEF AL-ALIF
Yaa man bi-sanaahu jaa’ ’Abdul Qaadir,

Yaa man bi-shanaahu yaa’ ’Abdul Qaadir.
Idh anta ja’altahu kamaa kunta tashaau’,

Faj’alni kaifa shaa-a ’Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Rabii arbi-rjaa’ ’Abdul Qaadir,
Idh ‘awdna-l-’ataa’ ’Abdul Qaadir.

Ad-daaru wasee’atun wa dhud-daari kareemun,
Baunaa haythu baa’ ’Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-BAA
Dar hashr gah janaab-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Choon nashar kunii kitaab-e-’Abdul Qaadir.
Az Qaadiriyaan majoojud aagaa nah hisaab,

Mad-e-shumur az hisaab-e-’Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Allah Allah Rabb-e-’Abdul Qaadir,
Daarad wallah hubbi ’Abdul Qaadir.

Az wasf-e-Khudaaye to naseebat daadand,
Toobaa laka aay muhibb-e-’Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-TAA
Aay ‘aajiz to qudrat ’Abdul Qaadir,

Mohtaaj-e-darat dawlat ’Abdul Qaadir.
Az hurmat-e-een qudrat-o-dawlat bakhshaaye,

Bar ‘aajiz pur-haajat ’Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Tanzeel-e-mukammal ast ’Abdul Qaadir,
Takmeel-e-manzil ast ’Abdul Qaadir.

Kas neest juz oodar do kinaareen sair,
Khud khatm-o-khud awl ast ’Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Mimmaa laa ta’lamu ast ’Abdul Qaadir,

Mastoor-e-sutum-e-hoost ’Abdul Qaadir.
Meejo meego aanchah daani keh waraast,

Az justan-o-guftan owst ’Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II MUSTAZAAD

Mee guft dilam keh jaa(n)ast ’Abdul Qaadir,
Guftam ahsant.

Jaa(n) guft keh Deen-e-maa(n)ast ’Abdul Qaadir.
Guftam aamant.

Dee(n) guft hayaat-e-man az man-o-guftam,
Een jumlah sifaat.

Az-dhaat bigoo keh aa(n) ast ’Abdul Qaadir,
Gum shud man wa ant.

RUBAA’II
‘Aql-o-hisr sifaat-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Shabkoor-o-nujoom.
Wehm-o-idraak dhaat-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Wah shaariq-o-boom.
‘Ajzaa(n) keh bakuneh qatrah aab-e-naraseed,

Za’m aa(n) keh rasad.
Taa qa’reem-e-o-furaat-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Qudrat ma’loom.
RADEEF AL-THAA

Dee(n) raa asl Hadeeth ’Abdul Qaadir,
Ahl-e-Dee(n) raa mugheeth ’Abdul Qaadir,

Ow maa yantiqu ‘anil-hawaa een sharhash,
Quraan Ahmad, Hadeeth ’Abdul Qaadir

RADEEF AL-JEEM
Aay rif’at bakhsh-e-taaj-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Purnoor kun siraaj-e-’Abdul Qaadir,
Aa(n) taaj-o-siraaj baaz barkun ’Abdul Qaadir,

Bustaa(n) ze shahaa(n) khiraaj-e-’Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-HAA

Paak ast ze baak tarah ’Abdul Qaadir,
Wajab ast barii ze jarah ’Abdul Qaadir,

Jarhash keh tawaanad keh ze kalk-e-qudrat,
Ahmad matan ast-o-sharh ’Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Aay ‘aam kun salaah ’Abdul Qaadir,

In’aam kun falaah ’Abdul Qaadir,
Man sar taa paa junaah gashtam faryaad,

Aay sar taa paa najaah ’Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-KHAA

Aay zill-e-Ilaah Shaykh ’Abdul Qaadir,
Aay bandah panaah Shaykh ’Abdul Qaadir,

Mohtaaj-o-gadaayam-o-tu dhultaaj-o-kareem,
Shay al-Lillah Shaykh ’Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Maah-e-‘arbi aay rukh-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Noor-e-zarbi aay rukh-e-’Abdul Qaadir,
Imroz ze di di ze pari khoobtari,

Badre ‘ajabi aay rukh-e-’Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-DAAL

Dee(n) zaad keh zaad zaad ’Abdul Qaadir,
Dil daad keh daad daad ’Abdul Qaadir,

Ee(n) jaa(n) che kunam nazr sagash baad-o-maraa,
Jaa(n) baad keh baad baad ’Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-DHAAL
Sultaan-e-jahaa(n) ma’aadh ’Abdul Qaadir,

Tan maljaa-o-jaa(n) malaadh ’Abdul Qaadir,
Sahan aarad amaani-o-amaa(n) baarad baam,

Aa(n) raa keh dihad ‘iyaadh ’Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-RAA

Par aap bood kawthar-e-’Abdul Qaadir,
Khush taab bood gohar-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Dar zulmat-e-zimma aab-o-taab-e-daaram,
Aay hashr biyaa bar dar-e-’Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Yaa Rabb neem az darkhor-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Dil daadah maraa(n) az dar-e-’Abdul Qaadir,
Ee(n) nang mureedey ar naraftah ba-muraad,

Raftan madeh az khaatir-e-’Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Aay daaf’-e- zulm afsar ’Abdul Qaadir,
Aay daf’-e- zulm khanjar ’Abdul Qaadir,

Door az tu jahaa(n) ba-marg nazdeek biyaa,
Barkash ze dawaan kishwar ’Abdul Qaadir

RUBAA’II
His kun anwaar-e-badr-e-’Abdul Qaadir,

Bas kun ze asraar-e-sadr-e-’Abdul Qaadir
Khud qudrat-e-qadr naa muqaddar ze qadr,

Jowi miqdaar-e-qadr ’Abdul Qaadir
RADEEF AL-ZAA

Aay fazl-e-tu barg-o-saaz ’Abdul Qaadir,
Faiz-e-tu chaman tiraaz ’Abdul Qaadir,

Aan kun keh rasad qumri be baal-o-pare,
Dar saayah sarwenaaz ’Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-SEEN
Dard az dar-e-majlis ’Abdul Qaadir,

Door ast sag-e-bekas ’Abdul Qaadir,
Haal ee(n)-o-hawas aankeh choo meeram beburam,

Sar dar qadam-e-aqdas ’Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II MUSTAZAAD

Guftam taaj-e-roos ’Abdul Qaadir,
Sar kham gardeed.

Jaana rooh-e-nufoos ’Abdul Qaadir,
Bar khood baaleed.

Razman oow qalb-e-fawj dee(n) raa dil-o-naajast,
Zad nawbat-e-fath.

Bazman bazman aroos ’Abdul Qaadir,
Shaadaa(n) raqseed.

RADEEF AL-SHEEN
Baala ast buland farsh ’Abdul Qaadir,

Bar qadr buland ‘arsh ’Abdul Qaadir,
Aa(n) badr ‘areesh badr mah paarah ‘arsh,

RUBAA’II
Gustardah ba-’arsh farsh ‘AbdulQadir,

Aawardah ba-farsh ‘arsh ‘AbdulQadir,
Ee(n) kard keh kard kard shaahe keh fazowd,

Baalaa-o-furood ‘arsh ‘AbdulQadir.
RUBAA’II

‘Arsh-e-sharf ast farsh-e-‘AbdulQadir,
Farsh-e-sharf ast ‘arsh-e-‘AbdulQadir.

Ya’ni taa sar ba-paaye farsh namood,
Sar haa shudah farsh ‘arsh ‘AbdulQadir

RADEEF AL-SAAD
Fann gar che na shud bar nass Abdul Qaadir,

Jaan daarad muhr az fas Abdul Qaadir,
Gar naaqisam een nisbat-e-kaamil che khush ast,

Kaan bandah RAZA naaqis Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Bilkasr manam mukhlis Abdul Qaadir,
Sar bar qadam khalas Abdul Qaadir,

Bar kasr choo raham aarad fathash che ‘ajab,
Bilfath shawam mukhlis Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-DUAAD
Tamkeen-e-gulley az riyaaz-e-Abdul Qaadir,

Talween-e-namey az hiyaaz-e-Abdul Qaadir,
Noor-e-dil ‘aarifaan key shab-e-subh numaast,

Satray bood az biyaaz-e-Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-TAA

Eenjaa wajh-e-nishhat Abdul Qaadir,
Aanjaa sham’-e- siraat Abdul Qaadir,

Bakushaadah dowr daadah baad banaadah bajood,
Darwaazah salaa simaat Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-ZAA
Khoobaan choo gul bawa’z ‘Abdul Qaadir,

A’ayaan Rusul bawa’z Abdul Qaadir,
Parwanah sift jama’ keh khud jalwah numaast,

Sham’a juzw kul ba-wa’z ‘Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-’AYN

Khoor raatibah khoor ze sham’a ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Mah aazqah bar ze sham’a ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Ee(n) noor-o-soorat sheerat az subha ze cheest,
Doodest magar ze sham’a ‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Aa maa maguzaar ze sham’a ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Mehri binigar ze sham’a ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Kaareikeh ze khoor beh neem mah deedibee(n),

Dar neem nazr ze sham’-e- ‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Bar wahdat-e-ow raabi’ ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Yak shaahid-o-do saabi’ ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Anjaam-e-we aaghaaz-e-Risaalat baashud,
Eenk go ham taabe’ ‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II MUSTAZAAD
Waahid choo naham raabi’ ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Dar daaman-e-daal.
Zaaid choo sawm saabi’ ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Hum maskan-e-daal.
Ya’ni budlaaye haft-o-aawtaad chahaar,

Tawheed siraa.
Yak yak ba-yake taabi’ ‘Abdul Qaadir,

RADEEF AL-GHAYN
Me ne noor charaagh ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Me ne noore ze baagh ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Hum aab-e-rushd hast-o-hum maayah khuld,

Yaa Rabb cheh khoosh ast aayaagh ‘Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-FAA

‘Atfan ‘atfan ‘atoof ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Ra’fan ra’fan ra’oof ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Aay aankeh ba-dast-e-tust tasreef-e-umoor,
Isrif ‘annas-suroof ‘Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-QAAF
Kheerah ast khirad ze barq-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Teerah ast Huzoor-e-sharq-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
Khursheed bah partaw-e-suhaa justan cheest,

Aay justah ba-’aql-e-farq-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-GKAAF

Aakhreenam aay maalik ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Mamlook-o-makeen maalik ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Mapasand keh goyand baai(n) nisbat daband,
Kaa(n) bandah fulaa(n) haalik ‘Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-LAAM
Naamd ze salaf ‘adeel -e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Naayad ba-khalaf badeele ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Mithlish gar ze ahl-e-qurb joyi goyi,

‘Abdul Qaadir matheel-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Hashr ast-o-tooi kafeel ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Jaahat bah shah-e-jaleel,‘Abdul Qaadir,

Dardaa dar-e-daar-e-‘adl aamad mujrim,
Zoodaa zoodaa wakeel ‘Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-MEEM
Yaa Rabb ba-jamaal-e-naam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Yaa Rabb ba-nawaal-e-‘aam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,
Manigar ba-qusoor-o-naqs-e-maa qadriyaa(n),

Be-nigar ba-kamaal-e-taam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Har subh-e-rahat maraam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,
Har shaam-e-darat maqaam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Be-guzr ze saped-o-seeh-e-Qaadiriyaa(n)!
Az hurmat-e-subh-o-shaam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
‘Abdul Qaadir Kareem ‘Abdul Qaadir,

‘Abdul Qaadir ‘azeem ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Rahmaanat Rabb-o-rahmat-e-‘aalam aab,

Rahmat-e-rahmat raheem ‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Dar jood samar aay yam ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Sad bahr bebur aay yam ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Door az tu sag-e-tishnah lab-e-mii meerad,
Yak mawj-e-degar aay yam-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Siddeeq sift haleem ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Farooq namat hakeem ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Maanind-e-Ghani kareem ‘Abdul Qadir,

Dar rang-e-‘Ali ‘aleem.‘Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-NOON

Daste zadm aay zaaman ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Dar daaman-e- jaa(n) baaman ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Yaa Rabb choo khud ee(n) daaman gustardah tust,
Gustardah machee(n) daaman ‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Yaa Rabb qursey ze khwaan-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Daareem haqqey banaan-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,
Ee(n) nisbat bas keh ‘aajizaan-e-owyim,

Rahme bar ‘aajizaan-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Jood ast birs-e-shaan-e-'Abdul Qaadir,
Bood ast-o-bood azaan-e-'Abdul Qaadir,

Jannat ba-gadaa dehand-o-minnat nah nehand,
Wah sunnat-e-khaandaan-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.

RADEEF AL-WAAW
Khoobaan khoo bandne choo ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Sheereenaa(n) qandane choo ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Mahboobaa(n) yakdegar bah afzaaish-e-husn,

Chand-o-sad chandane choo ‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Khwaahi kaahi 'alluwi ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Naami saami sumuwwi ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Hushdaar keh baa Khudaaye khood mii jangi,
Mut ghayzan aay 'aduww-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Mah farsh kataa(n) dar daw-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Khoor shapparah saa(n) dar jaw-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,
Aashuftah mah-o-sheeftah mii gardad mehr,

Dar jalwah maah-e-naw-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
RADEEF AL-HAA

Hamdan laka aay Ilaah-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,
Aay maalik-o-baadshaah-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Aay khaak baraah-e-to sar-e-jumlah saraa(n),
Kun khaak maraa baraah-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Be-jaan-o-bajaanam shah ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Kas juz-e-tu nadaanam shah ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Bad boodam-o-bad kardam-o-bar neiki tu,

Nek ast gumaanam shah ‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Bahr-e-sar-e-Hoo tajliyah ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Hum tajliyah raa tahliyah ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Bar matan-e-mateen-e-ahdiyyat Ahmad,
Sharh ast baraa(n) munhiyah‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II
Az 'aarizah nest wajh-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Dhaati ast walaaye wajh-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,
Har kas shudah mahboob ba-wajh-e-sifte,

‘Abdul Qaadir ba-wajh-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Khoor noor setad az rah ‘Abdul Qaadir,
Hum idhn-e-tuloo' az shah-e-‘Abdul Qaadir,

Maa ast gadaaey dar-e-mehr-o-ee(n) jaa,
Mehr ast gadadey mah-e-‘Abdul Qaadir.

RUBAA’II MUSTAZAAD
Bar awj tarqi shudah ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Taa naam-e-Khuda.
Khaymah mustanzal zadah ‘Abdul Qaadir,

Naas and-o-hudaa.
Bil-jumlah ba-Quraan rashaad-o-irshaad,

Dar bad'-o-khitam.
Bismillah-o-Naas aamdah ‘Abdul Qaadir,

RADEEF AL-YAA
Aay Qaadir-o-aay Khudaaye 'Abdul Qaadir,

Qudrat dehe dasthaaye 'Abdul Qaadir,
Bar 'aajizi maa nazr-e-rahmat kun,

Rahm aay Qaadir baraaye 'Abdul Qaadir.
RUBAA’II

Jaa(n) bakhsh maraa bapaaye 'Abdul Qaadir,
