Rukh-e-Zaibā Pai Hazrat Kī Malāhat Nāz Kartī Hai

Nigāh-e-Nāz Sai Naqsha Badal Daitai HaiN Ālam Kā
Adā'e Sarwar-e-KhubāN Pai Nudrat Nāz Kartī Hai

Fidā’ī HoN Tou Kis Kā HoN Koī Daikhai Mairī Qismat
Qadam Par Jis HasīN Kī Jān-e-Tal'at Nāz Kartī Hai

Khudā Kai Fazl Sai Akhtar Mai Unn Kā Nām Laiwā HūN
Mai HūN Qismat Pai NāzāN Mujh Pai Qismat Nāz Kartī Hai

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: AYDHAN

shers.roman:
Bāgh-e-Taslīm-o-Razā Mai Gul Khilātai HaiN Hussain
Yā’nī Hangām-e-Musībat Muskurāt-e-HaiN Hussain

Barq-e-Ālam Souz kā Ālam Dikhāt-e-HaiN Hussain
Muskurā Kar Qil'ā Bātil Ka Girāt-e-HaiN Hussain

Marzī Moulā Kī Khātir Har Sitam Ko Seh Liyā
Kis Khushī Sai Bār-e-Gham Dil Par Uthā tāi HaiN Hussain

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: YĀ GHAUS AL MADAD

shers.roman:
PīroN Kai Āp Pīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad
Ahle Safā Kai Mīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Ranj-o-Alam Kasīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad
Ham Ājiz-o-Asīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Ham Kaisāi Jī Rahai HaiN Ye Tum Sai Kyā KahāiN
Ham HaiN Alam Kai Tīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Tīr-e-Nazar Sai Phair Do Sārai Alam kai Tīr
Kyā Ye Alam Kai Tīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Tairai Hī Hāth Lāj Hai Yā Pīr-e-Dastagīr
Ham Tujh Sai Dastagīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Idfa' Sharārash Shar Yā Ghausanal Abar
Shar Kai Sharar Khatīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Kis Dil Sai Ho BayāN-e-Bai Dād-e-ZālimāN
Zālim Barai Sharīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Ahle Safā Nai Pā’ī Tum Sai Rāh-e-Safā
Sab Tum Sai Mustanīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Sadqah Rasūl-e-Pāk Ka Jholī Mai Dāl Do
Hum Qādirī Faqīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

Dil Kī Sunā'e Akhtar Dil Kī ZubāN Mai
Kehtai Ye Behtai Nīr HaiN Yā Ghaus Al Madad

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MANQABAT SHARĪF - DAR-e-MADAH HAZRAT SAYYID SĀLĀR MASŪD GHĀZĪ

shers.roman:
Hazrat Masūd-e-Ghāzī Akhtar-e-Burj-e-Hudā
Bai KasoN Kā Hamnawā Woh SālikoN Kā Muqtadā

Sāqī Sahbā'e Ulfat Rāz Dān-e-Ma'arifat
Bādshah Aisā Woh Jis Kī Aik Dunyā Hai Gadā

Āsmān-e-Nūr Kā Aisā Darakhshandah Qamar
Jis Kī Tābish Sai Munawwar Sārā Ālam Ho Gayā

Nāib-e-Shah-e-ShahīdāN Woh Muhāfiz Nūr Kā
Jis Nai Sīnchā Hai Lahw Sai Gulshan-e-Dīn-e-Khudā

Istiqāmat Kā Woh Koh-e-Muhkam-o-Bālā TarīN
Jis Kai Āgai Koh-e-Āfāt-o-Masā’ib Jhuk Gayā

Sādgī Mai Bhī Hai Woh Sardār-e-KhūbāN Daikhiye
Kyā Muqaddas Zāt Hai Jis Kī Nirālī Har Adā

Nosha-e-Bazm-e-JināN Woh Banda-e-Rabb-e-JahāN
Hūr-o-GhilmāN Jis Kī Khidmat Par Muqarrar HaiN Sadā

Tairai Nūr-e-Faiz Sai Khairāt Dunyā Ko Milī
Ham Ko Bhī Hadd-e-Mu'azzam Ka Milai Sadqah Shahā

Yā Ilāhī! Tairai Bandai Kai Dar-e-Pur Nūr Par
Gardish-e-Ayyām Ka Mai Tujh Sai Kartā HūN Gilā

Yā Ilāhī! Bai Niyāz-e-Dahar Tū Kardai Mujhai
Dūr Kar Dai Mairai Dil Sai Ulfat-e-Har Mā Siwā

Allah Allah Yai Nasīb-e-Akhtar-e-ShīrīN Sukhan
Faiz-e-Moulā Sai Hai Woh Sālār Ka Midhat Sarā

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: JAMĀL-e-HAZRAT-e-AHMAD RAZĀ KĀ Ā’INĀ TUM HO

shers.roman:
TumhaiN Jis Nai Bhī Daikhā Keh Uthā Ahmad Razā Tum Ho
Jamāl-e-Hazrat-e-Ahmad Razā Kā Ā’inā Tum Ho

Nahī Hāmid Razā Ham Mai Magar Wajhai Shakībā’ī
Khudā Rakhai Tumhai Zindah Mairai Hāmid Numā Tum Ho

Tumhārai Nām Mai Tum Ko Buzurgī Kī Sanad Hāsil
Razā Wajhai Buzurgī Hai Razā'e Mustafā Tum Ho

Tumhārai Nām Mai YūN HaiN Razā-o-Mustafā Do Juz
Razā Wālai Yaqīnan Mustafā Kai Mustafā Tum Ho

Tumhārī Rif'atoN Kī Ibtidā Bhī Pā Nahī Saktā
Kai Uftādah ZamīN HūN Mai Bulandī Kā Samā Tum Ho

Hayāt-o-Maut Wābasta Tumhārai Dam Sai HaiN DonoN
Hamārī Zindagī Ho Aur Dushman Kī Qazā Tum Ho

Ye Nūrī Chehra Ye Nūrī Adā'e Sab Ye Kehtai HaiN
Shabīh-e-Ghaus Ho Nūrī MiyāN Ho Aur Razā Tum Ho

Razā Joyān-e-Rabb Thāmai Hu-e-HaiN Iss Liye Dāman
Razā Sai Kām Parrtā Hai Rāzā-e-Kibriyā Tum Ho

Janāb-e-Muftī-e-Āzam Kai Faizān-e-Tajjalī Sai
Shabistān-e-Razā Mai Khair Sai Akhtar Razā Tum Ho

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MANQABAT SHARĪF - DAR SHĀN-e-HUZŪR MUFTĪ- e-ĀZAM HIND

shers.roman:
Muftī-e-Āzam-e-Dīn-e-Khairul Warā
Jalwah-e-Shān-e-Irfān-e-Ahmad Razā

Dīd-e-Ahmad Razā Hai TumhaiN Daikhnā
Zāt-e-Ahmad Razā Kā Ho Tum Ā’inā

Kyā KahūN Haqq Kai Ho Kaisāi Tum Muqtadā
Muqtadāyān-e-Haqq Kartai HaiN Iqtidā

Unn Kī Midhat Ko Mai Kis Sai MāngūN ZabāN
Kyā Maqām-e-Surrayā Batā’e Sarā

Ahmad-e-Nūrī Kai HaiN Yai Mazhar Tamām
Yai HaiN Nūrī MiyāN Nūrī Har Har Adā

Nūr Ki Mai Ye Pilātai HaiN Rouz-o-Shab
Jis Ko Pīnā Ho Āye Ye Maikhāna Wā

ĀnkhoN Daikhā Na Inn Sā Na KānoN Sunā
Unn Kā Sāya SaroN Par Salāmat Rahai

Mūnh Sarātai RahaiN YūNhī Dushman Sadā
Unn Kai Hāsid Pai Woh Daikho Bijlī Girī

Woh Jalā Daikh Kar Woh Jalā Woh Jalā
Woh JalaiN gai Hamaisha Jo Tujh Sai JalaiN

Mar Kai Bhī Dil JaloN Ko Na Chain Āyegā
ĀshiqoN Kai Jigar Unn Sai Thandai RahaiN

DushmanoN Par RahaiN Ban Kai Shakl-e-Qazā
Za Dua ul Unāsiyyi Ajma’ihim

Istajib Rabbanā Yā Mujībad-Dua
Aur HoN Gai JinhaiN Tujh Sai Lālach Ho Kuch

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: CHAL DIYE TUM ĀNKH MAI ASHKON KĀ DARYĀ CHORH KAR

shers.roman:
Chal Diye Tum Ānkh Mai Ashko Kā Daryā Chorh Kar
Ranj-e-Furqat Ka Har Ek Sīnai Mai Shu’lā Chorh Kar

Lazzat Me Lai Gayā Woh Jām-o-Mīnā Chorh Kar
Mairā Sāqī Chal Diyā Khūd Me Ko Tishna Chorh Kar

Har Jigar Mai Dard Apnā Mīthā Mīthā Chorh Kar
Chal Diye Woh Dil Mai Apnā Naqsh-e-Wālā Chorh Kar

Jāma-e-MushkīN Liye Arsh-e-Mu’allā Chorh Kar
Farsh Par Āye Farishtai Bazm-e-Bālā Chorh Kar

Ālam-e-Bālā Mai Har Sū Marhabaā Kī Gūnj Thī
Chal Diye Jab Tum Zamānai Bhar Ko Sūnā Chorh Kar

Maut Ālim Sai Bandhī Hai Maut-e-Ālam Bai GumāN
Rūh-e-Ālam Chal Diyā Ālam Ko Murda Chorh Kar

Muttaqī Ban Kar Dikhā'e Iss Zamānai Mai Koī
Aik Mairai Muftī-e-Āzam Kā Taqwā Chorh Kar

Khwāb Mai Ā Kar DikhāoN Ham Ko Bhi Ae JāN Kabhī
Kaun Sī Dunyā Basā’ī Tum Nai Dunyā Chorh Kar

Aik Tum Dunyā Mai Reh Kar Tārik-e-Dunyā Rahai
Reh Kai Dunyā Mai Dikhā'e Koī Dunyā Chorh Kar

Uss Kā Aei Shāh-e-Zaman Sārā Zamāna Ho Gayā
Jo Tumhārā Ho Gayā Sārā Zamāna Chorh Kar

Rehnumā-e-Rāh-e-Jannat Hai Tairā Naqsh-e-Qadam
Rāh-e-Jannat Tai Na Hogī Tairā Rasta Chorh Kar

Misl-e-GardoN Sāya-e-Dast-e-Karam Hai Āj Bhī
Kaun Kehtā Hai Gaey Woh Bai Sahārā Chorh Kar

Ho Sakai Tou Daikh Akhtar Bāgh-e-Jannat Mai Ussai
Woh Gayā TāroN Sai Āgai Āshiyāna Chorh Kar

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: LA’L YAKTĀ'E SHAHAI AHMAD RAZĀ MILTĀ NAHĪ

shers.roman:
Zīnat-e-Sajjāda-o-Bazm-e-Qazā Miltā Nahī
La'l Yaktā'e Shah-e-Ahmad Razā Miltā Nahī

Woh Jo Apnāi Daur Ka Siddīq Thaā Miltā Nahī
Mahram-e-Rāz-e-Muhammad Mustafā Miltā Nahī

Ab Chirāgh-e-Dil Jalā Kar Ho Sakai Tou Dhūndiye
Par Taw-e-Ghaus-o-Razā-o-Mustafā Miltā Nahī

Ālam-e-Souz-e-daroN Kis Sai KahūN Kis Sai KahūN
Chārah sāz-e-Dard-e-Dil Dard-e-Āshnā Miltā Nahī

ĀlimoN Kā Mu'tabar Woh Paishwā Miltā Nahī
Jo Mujassam Ilm Thā Woh Kyā Huwā Miltā Nahī

ZāhidoN Kā Woh Musallam Muqtadā Miltā Nahī
Jis Pai NāzāN Zuhd Thā Woh Pārsā Miltā Nahī

Fard Afrād-e-ZamāN Woh Sheikh-e-Ashyākh-e-JahāN
Kāmilān-e-Dahar Kā Woh Muntahā Miltā Nahī

Istiqāmat Kā Woh Koh-e-Muhkam-o-Bālā TarīN
Jiss Kai Jānai Sai Zamāna Hill Gayā Miltā Nahī

Chār YāroN Kī Adā'e Jis Mai ThīN Jalwā Numā
Chār YāroN Kā Woh Roushan Ā’ina Miltā Nahī

Aik Shākh-e-Gul Nahī Sārā Chaman AndouhagīN
Mustafā Kā Andalīb-e-Khushnawā Miltā Nahī

Muftī-e-Āzam Ka Zarra Kyā Banā Akhtar Razā
Mehfil-e-Anjum Mai Akhtar Dūsrā Miltā Nahī

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MANQABAT SHARĪF - DAR SHĀN MUFASSIR-e- ĀZAM-e-HIND [FATHER OF HAZRAT]

shers.roman:
Hāmī-e-Dīn-e-Hudā Thai Shāh Jīlanī MiyāN
Bilyaqīn Mard-e-Khudā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Misl-e-Gul Hangām-e-Rukhsat Muskurātai Hī Rahai
Paikar-e-Sabr-o-Razā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Chal Basai Ham Ko Dikhā Kar Rāh Sīdhī Khuld Kī
Dīn-e-Haqq Kai Rahnumā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Hijr Kī La'ai Na Tāb Ākhirash Jā Hī Milai
Āshiq-e-Khairul Warā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Unn Kai Har Irshād Sai Har Dil Kī Hotī Thī Jilā
Mazhar-e-Shān-e-Khudā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Māl-o-Zarr Sab Kuch Nichāwarr Rāh-e-Haqq Mai Kar Gaye
Kaisāi Mukhlis Paishawā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Ham Ko Bin Daikhai Tumhai Ab Kaisai Chain Āye Huzūr
Tum Shakīb-e-Aqrabā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Sabr-o-Taslīm-o-Razā Kī Ab Hamai Taufīq Dai
Tairai Bandai Ae Khudā! Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

Shor Kaisā Hai Ye Barpā Ghaur Sai Akhtar Suno
Par Taw-e-Ahmad Razā Thai Shāh Jīlānī MiyāN

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MANQABAT SHARĪF - DAR SHĀN MUFASSIR-e-ĀZAM HIND

shers.roman:
Kis Kai Gham Mai Hā'e Tarpātā Hai Dil
Aur Kuch Zyādah Umand Āta Hai Dil

Dil Tairā Hargiz Behalnai Ka Nahī
Tū Abas Bīmār Behlātā Hai Dil

Hā'e Dil Kā Āsrā Hī Chal Basā
Tukrrai Tukrrai Ab Huwa Jātā Hai Dil

Koun Janai Rāz-e-Mehbūb-o-Muhibb
KyūN Liya Jātā Diya Jātā Hai Dil

JāN Bahaqq Taslīm Ho Jānā Tairā
Yād Kar Kai Mairā Bhar Ātā Hai Dil

Ae Ta' ālā Allah Shān-e-Auliyā
Unn Kai Istighnā Pai Bal Khātā Hai Dil

Tāb-e-HijrāN Ab Nahī Lātā Hai Dil
Khā Chukā Hai Bārhā Kitnai Faraib

Phir Bhī Dunyā Par Mitā Jātā Hai Dil
Tairai Pīchai Ho Chukā Barbād Mai

Rehnai Dai Ab Aur Kyā Bhātā Hai Dil
Chorh Dai HāN Aur Ghaflat Chorh Dai

KyūN Soey Douzakh Liye Jātā Hai Dil
Apnai Moulā Ko Manālai Bad Nasīb

ThokaraiN Dar Dar Kī KyūN Khātā Hai Dil
Apnai Akhtar Par Ināyat Kījiye

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: BAMOUQA-e-WAFĀT HASRAT ĀYĀT - KHĀL-e- MUHTARAM JANĀB UMĪD SAHIB RIDAWĪ

shers.roman:
Ye Idārah Jis Ko Kahiyai Gulistān-e-Ilm-o-Fan
Ho Gayā Rukhsat Sai Tairī Muwrid-e-Ranj-o-Mihan

Manzar-e-Islam Kai Thai Kārkun Tum Nāmwar
Kidmat-e-Islam Kī Thī Tum Ko Kyā Sachchī Lagan

Muftī-e-Āzam Kai Dilband-o-Jigar Pārai Thai Tum
Kaisai DaikhaiN Unn Ko Ghamgīn Hā'e Sab Ahle Sunan

Aik Woh HaiN Jo Marai Tou JāwidāN Ho Kar Marai
Aik Woh Zindah HaiN Goyā Na’sh-e-Bai Gour-o-Kafan

So Rahai HaiN Lahad Mai Kuch Iss Tarah Woh Chain Sai
Nāz Sai Bai Fikr Ho Kar Jaisai So Jaey Dulhan

Marzī-e-Moulā Hai Bando! Sabr Sai Kuch Kām Lo
Ye Duā Māngo Kai Unn Ko Bakhsh Dai Woh Zul Minan

Shiddat-e-Gham Sai A'izzā Iss Qadr Bujh Sai Gaye
Chānd Sai ChehroN Ko Akhtar Lag Gaya Jaisai Gahan

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MANQABAT SHARĪF DAR SHĀN HUZŪR MUJĀHID- e-MILLAT

shers.roman:
Dil Nai Kahā Mujāhid-e-Millat Ko Dhūndiye
Lai Kar Chirāgh Shāh-e-Wilāyat Ko Dhūndiye

Mai Nai Kahā Kai Sun Ae Dil Mubtalā'e Gham
Apnī Ye Kab Majāl Kai Pā Jā'e Unn Ko Ham

Ham Zair-e-ĀsmāN UnhaiN YūN Daikhtai Rahai
Woh Kab Kai ĀsmāN Kai Parai Khuld Mai Gaye

Tum Kyā Gai Mujāhid-e-Millat JahāN Gayā
Ālim Kī Maut Kyā Hai Ālam Kī Hai Fanā

Mai Rehlat-e-Mujāhid-e-Millat Ko Kyā KahūN
YūN Samjho Girr Gayā Koī Islām Kā SutūN

Har Sū Ye Keh Rahai HaiN Anādil Chaman Chaman
Ae Bulbul-e-Madīna KahāN Hai Tū Khush Dahan

Woh Yādgār-e-Hujjatul Islam Ab Nahī
AndohgīN Hai Āj ShabistāN-e-Ilm-e-Dīn

Nasrīn-e-Gulistān-e-Sadrush-Shariah Bū’ad
Buey Khodash Guzāshita Andar Chaman Rābū’ad

Khurshīd-e-Sunniyat Nai Chādar Jo Ourh Lī
Zulmat Mai Qāfilai Kī Woh Raftār Tham Gaī

Paik-e-Nidā-o-GhufrāN Unn Kī Wafāt Thī
Akhtar Khushī Manā’o Wisāl-e-Habīb Kī

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MANQABAT SHARĪF DAR SHĀN AHSAN AL ULAMĀ MĀREHARWĪ

shers.roman:
Haqq Pasand-o-Haqq Nawā-o-Haqq Numā Miltā Nahī
Mustafā Haider Hassan Ka Ā’ina Miltā Nahī

Khūbsūrat Khūb Sīrat Woh Amīn-e-Mujtabā
Ashraf-o-Afzal, Najīb-e-Zāhirah Miltā Nahī

Khush Bayān-o-Khushnawā-o-Khush Adā Miltā Nahī
Jo Mujassam Husn Thā Woh Kyā Huwā Miltā Nahī

Khush Bayān-o-Khushnawā-o-Khush Adā Miltā Nahī
Dil Nawāzī Karnai Walā Dilrubā Miltā Nahī

Paikar-e-Sidq-o-Safā Woh Sham e’ Rāh-e-Mustafā
Jo Mujassam Dīn Thā Woh Kyā Huwā Miltā Nahī

Shair Sīrat Shair Dil Haider Numā Miltā Nahī
HāJātāiN Kis Ko PukāraiN Kis Kī Jānib Rukh KaraiN

HāJātāiN Mushkil Mai HaiN Mushkil Kushā Miltā Nahī
Woh HaiN Unn Mai Jo KahaiN Ajsāmunā Arwāhunā

Sūrat-e-Rūh-e-RawāN Hai Barmalā Miltā Nahī
Dūb to Bahr-e-Fanā Mai Phir Ba’qā Miltā Nahī

Jo Ye Keh Kar De Gayā Apnā Patā Miltā Nahī
SunniyoN Kī Jān Thā Woh SayyidoN Kī Shān Thā

DushmanoN Kai Wāstai Paik-e-Razā Miltā Nahī
Woh Amīn-e-Ahle Sunnat Rāzdār-e-Murtazā

~Ashraf -o-~Afzal, ~Najīb-e-Bā Safā Miltā Nahī
Shibl-e-Sher-e-Karbalā Woh Dāfa-e-Karb-o-Balā

Woh Hamārā Ghamzuda Gham Āshnā Miltā Nahī
Aik Shākh-e-Gul Hī Kyā Ghamgīn Hai Sārī Fizā

Mustafā Kā Andalīb Khushnawā Miltā Nahī
Yād Rakhnā Ham Sai Sun Kar Midhat-e-Haider Hassan

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: AE NAQĪB-e-ĀLĀ HAZRAT

shers.roman:
Ae Naqīb-e-Āla Hazrat Mazhar-e-Haider Hassan
Ae Bahār-e-Bāgh-e-Zahrā Mairai Barkātī Chaman

Ae Tamāshā gāh-e-Ālam Chehrā-e-Tābān-e-Tū
Tū Kujā Behr-e-Tamāshā Mī Rawī Qurbān Tū

Istiqāmat Kā Woh Koh-e-Muhkam-o-Bāla Hassan
Ashraf-o-Afzal Najīb-e-Itrat-e-Zahrā Hassan

Tūr-e-Irfan-o-Ulū-o-Hamd-o-Husnā-o-Bahā
Zindah Bād Ae Par Taw-e-Mūsā-o-Aks-e-Mustafā

Ālam-e-Souz-e-daroN Kis Sai KahūN Kis Sai KahūN
Dil Shudah Zār-e-ChināN-o-JāN Shudah Zair-e-ChinūN

Thā Jo Apnai Dard Kī Hakmī Dawā Miltā Nahī
Chārah sāz-e-Dard-e-Dil Dīd-e-Āshnā Miltā Nahī

Gibta Fī Mārahraha Misbā'H ad dana Shams al Anām
Yā Zukāna Mustafānā Bā'dak ad 'Duniya Zalām

Zalla Man Azza Alaykum Mal'lakum Zallas 'Samā
Jūdukum Fāqal Jawādi Wa Bikum Jādat Samā

Khairukum Mala'Al Bawādi Sītukum Ammal Warā
Innamal Mayyitu Jahūlun Zu Hawā Lā Antum

Qadd Fanītum An Hawākum Lil Khulūdi Niltum
Qabla Mautim Muttum Bā'da Mautin Dumtum

Jasra Mautin Juztum Wa Bil Wisāl-e-Fuztum
Awna Dīnil Mustafā Yā Mahdu Yā Jūnar Ridā

Jud Alainā Yā Samā Al Jūdi Yā Jūdan 'Nadā
Aik Shama’ Anjuman Thī Jo Bil Ākhir Bujh Ga’ī

Ab Ujālai Ko Tarastī Hai Ye Bazm Ā Gahī
SouguwāroN Ko Shakībā’ī Kā SāmāN Kam Nahī

Ab Amīn-e-Qādrīyat Ban Gayā Tairā AmīN
Ilm-o-Ahle Ilm Kī Tauqīr Thā Shaiwah Tairā

JāNnashīN Mai Ho NumāyāN Jalwah-e-Zaibā Tairā
Ilm Kā Uss Āstānai Par Sadā Pehrah Rahai

Akhtar-e-Khasta Hai Bulbul Gulshan-e-Barkāt Kā
Dair Tak Mehakai Har Ek Gul Gulshan-e-Barkāt Kā

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: TEHNIYAT BATAQRĪB-e-SHADĪ ABDUL KARĪM SAHIB BARĀ'E HAJĪ SULAIMĀN IBRAHĪM

shers.roman:
Muz'jda Daitī Dil-e-Muztar Ko Sabā Āyī Hai
Chal SulaimāN Kai YahāN Anjuman Ārā’ī Hai

Chal Dikhā'e Woh Kis Kā Tujhai Dulhā Ban'nā
Uth Kai Kyā Khūb Ye Sāmān-e-Shakebā’ī Hai

Gham-e-Hastī Ko Bhulā Dai Ye Hai Bazm-e-Mastī
Jhūm Kar Tū Bhī Kai Fazā Sārī Hī Sehbā’ī Hai

Dil Bhī Ākhir Ye Pukār Utthā Kai Ae Bād-e-Sabā
ĀfarīN Kyā Tairī BātoN Kī Pazīrā’ī Hai

Ham Bhī Iss Māh-e-JabīN Ko Zarā DaikhaiN Tou Sahī
Mah'JabīnoN Kī Nazar Jis Kī Tamashā’ī Hai

Yā Khudā! Tāzah RahaiN Phūl Ye Sehrai Kai Sadā
Na Kabhī Jaey Jo Ye Fasl-e-Bahār Āyī Hai

Bulbul-e-Dīn-e-Nabī Jin Kā Tamannā’ī Hai
Jin Kī Khushbū Sai Mua'ttar Ho Dimāgh-e-Ālam

Kai Mujhai Qawm Sai Ilhād Kī Bū Āyī Hai
HamsafīroN Mai Ye Charchai HaiN Tairai Akhtar

Bulbul-e-Bāgh-e-Razā Khūb Nawā Pā’ī Hai
SEHRA BATAQRĪB-e-SHADĪ KHĀNAH ĀBAD AZĪZIĪ

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MUHAMMAD SAĪD NŪRĪ SALLAMAHU

shers.roman:
Kaisā Bāghou Bahār Hai Sehrā
Kis Qadar Khushgawār Hai Sehrā

Nūr Jān-e-Bahar Hai Sehrā
Ghairat Lālazār Hai Sehrā

Kis Kai Rukh Par Nisār Hai Sehrā
Kis Liye Tār Tār Hai Sehrā

Kyā Gahar Hai Bajā'e Gul Iss Mai
Kis Qadar Āb-e-Dār Hai Sehrā

Rehmat-e-Do JahāN Kai Jalwai HaiN
Gulshan-e-Naw Bahār Hai Sehrā

RazwīyoN Kī Bahār Hai Sehrā
SunniyoN Kā Qarār Hai Sehrā

NajdīyoN Ko KahāN Hai Tāb-e-Nazar
Ātish-e-Shu'la Bār Hai Sehrā

Sīna-e-Yār Kai Liye Thandak
Dil A'adā Mai Khār Hai Sehrā

Chashm-e-Bad'dūr KyūN Na Ho Tujh Sai
Tairai Rukh Kā Hisār Hai Sehrā

Gulshan-e-Faiz-e-Muftī-e-Āzam
Rashk-e-Sad Lālazār Hai Sehrā

Az Tufail-e-Shaī-e-Behr-e-Saīd
Zindagī Kī Bahār Hai Sehrā

Phūl Sehrai Kai Keh Rahai HaiN Suno
Mān Kai Dil Kī Pukār Hai Sehrā

HaiN Rafīq-o-Hassan Bhī Na'ara Zan
Wah Kyā Khushgawār Hai Sehrā

Rukh-e-Razīa Pai Tāzigī Hai Naī
Tāzigī Kā Nikhār Hai Sehrā

Fātima Sābira Kai Sadqai Mai
Bāqī-o-Pā’idār Hai Sehrā

Shāhida Par Bhī Kaif Tārī Hai
Kis Khusī Kā Khumār Hai Sehrā

Hai Zulaikhā Bhī Paikar-e-Hairat
Kyā Anokhā Nigār Hai Sehrā

Aur Attiyah Bhī Muskurātī Hai
Muskurātī Bahār Hai Sehrā

Sādiya Aur Zubaida Gātī HaiN
Wah Kyā Shāhkār Hai Sehrā

Ho Amān-o-Hamīd Ko Muz'jda
Rahmat-e-Kirdgār Hai Sehrā

KhaiNch Lā’ī Shamīm Har Dil Ko
Kis Qadar Khushgawār Hai Sehrā

Izn-e-Parwardigār Hai Sehrā
Rang-e-Tūba Hai Parda-e-Gul Mai

Kyā Behishtī Bahār Hai Sehrā
Bandish Khushguwār Bulbul-o-Gul

Do DiloN Kā Qarar Hai Sehrā
Nūr Mai Sab Nahā Ga’ī Mehfil

Nūr Kā Ābshār Hai Sehrā
Sab Lagātai HaiN Na'ara-e-Tehsīn

Wah Kyā Khushguwār Hai Sehrā
Chand Hai Chehra-e-Saīd, Akhtar

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: BATAQRĪB-e-SĀLGIRAH SALMĀ BINT AZĪM JĪ SALIH JĪ SĀKIN CALCUTTA

shers.roman:
Nasīm-e-Subh Woh Uth'lātī KyūN Idhar Āyī
Yai Kaisī Kaif-o-Masarrat Kī Ek Lehar Āyī

Har Aik Lab Pai Tabassum Ye Kaisā RaqsāN Hai
Azīm Jī Kai YahaN KyūN Hujūm YarāN Hai

Sunā Hai Sālgirah Hai Dulāri Baby Kī
Machī Hai Dhūm AzīzoN Mai Pyarī Baby Kī

Bafart-e-Sharam Nirāla Hī Iss Ka Ālam Hai
Pasīna-e-Rukh Pai Jo Behtā Hai Rashk-e-Shabnam Hai

Kuch Iss Adā Sai Huwī Hai Woh Anjuman Ārā
Kai Mah-o-Shān JahāN Mai Ho Jaisai Woh Yaktā

Woh Boltī Hai Tou Bulbul Koī Chehaktī Hai
Khirām Kartī Hai Tou Barq Sī Chamaktī Hai

Woh Kitnī Bhuli Hai Aur Kitnī Naik Hai Baby
Gharz kai Apnai Muhāsin Mai Aik Hai Baby

Duā Akhīr Mai Hai Bārgah-e-Rahmān Mai
Ilāhī! Rouz Taraqqī Kar Uss Kai ĪmāN Mai

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: KUCH AISĀ KARDE MERAY KIRDIGĀR ĀNKHON MEIN

shers.roman:
Kuch Aisā Karde Meray Kirdigār Ānkhon Mein
Ke Jalwāgar Rahay Woh Gul Ezār Ānkhon Mein

Wo Lala Rukh Ho Agar Jalwah Bār ĀnkhoN Mein
Bahār-E-Lala Ho Phir Pāyedār ĀnkhoN Mein

Nazar Yeh Kehtī Hai Be Ikhtiyār ĀnkhoN Mein
InhaiN Jo Dekhain Wohī Hai Hazār ĀnkhoN Mein

InhaiN Na Dekhā Tou Kis Kām Ki Hai Ye ĀnkheN
Ke Dekhnay Kī Hai Sārī Bahār ĀnkhoN Mein

Abhio Ho Rūkash-E-Arsh-E-BarīN Nazar Mein
Jo Āey Arsh NashīN Tājdār ĀnkhoN Mein

Nazar Hai Rashk-E-Nazar Iftikhār ĀnkhoN Mein
Jisay Karay Wo Nazar Ikhiyār ĀnkhoN Mein

Banā'e Dil Ko Wo Ghar Rah Guzār ĀnkhoN Mein
Nazar Ho KadmoN Pe Inkay Nisār ĀnkhoN Mein

Basay Hai Jab Se Madīnay Ke Khār ĀnkhoN Mein
Hua Hai Sehn-E-Chaman Khār Zār ĀnkhoN Mein

Guzar Ho Inkā Kabhī Be-Qarār ĀnkhoN Mein
Guhar Hon Nazr-E-Qadam Ashk Bār ĀnkhoN Mein

Khuch Ā’ī Jān Paey Intezār ĀnkhoN Mein
Karam Se Lījiye Ab Tou Qarār ĀnkhoN Mein

Karam Se Jalwah Karay Jab Nigār ĀnkhoN Mein
Khuch Āey Sārī Chaman Kī Bahār ĀnkhoN Mein

Phir ĀyeN Din Meray Akhtar Shab-E-Huzūrī Mein
Karam Se Jalwah Karay Jab Nigār ĀnkhoN Mein

Nigah-E-Muftī -E-Āzam Ki Hai Ye Jalwagarī
Chamak Rahā Hay Jo Akhtar Hazār ĀnkhoN Mein

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: CHĀND SE UNN KE CHEHRAY PAR

shers.roman:
Chānd se Unn ke Chehray par Gesu-e-Mushkfām do
Aik Anokhī hay Sahar jis se baham HaiN Shām do

Donu taraf HaiN Chehray ke, Zulf-e-Siyah Fām do
Do do Sahar HaiN Bīch mein, Pehlū mein Unn ke Shām do

Donu taraf HaiN Chehray par Gesu-e-Mushkfām do
Jam'a HaiN Aik Ān mein Ziddain-e-Sabah-o-Shām do

Unn ki Jabīn-e-Nāz par Zulf-e-Siyah bikhar Gaī
Shab ke Hasīn Parday mein Chamkay Mah-e-Tamām do

Talwon ke Unn se hay bandhi Shams-o-Qamar ki Roshni
HaiN ye Unhi ki TābisHaiN, HaiN ye Unhi ke Nām do

Pī ke Pila ke Maykasho Talchat Darūn-e-Jām do
Qatra do Qatra hi sahi, kuch tou Bara-e-Nām do

Sar ba darat Niha da Am, bar Khāk-e-Dar Fatada Amm
Bīmar-e-Hijr-e-Bā da Amm, Apni Nazar ka Jām do

Guncha-e-Dil Khilaiye, Jalwa-e-Rukh Dikhaiye
Jām-e-Nazar Pilaiye, Dour ChalaiN Mudām do

Farsh-e-Nazar pe ho Guzar, Pāmāl hun mein Sar ba Sar
Rehwar-e-Nāz ko Idhar Junbish Pa-e-Khirām do

Unn ki Amān mein raHaiN, Jinn ke Karam se mil gaey
Unn ke Chaman ke Pāsbān "Hussam" aur "Humām" do

Ye donu bay-khatar raHaiN, Islām ki Sipar raHaiN
Ā'da-e-Dīn par raHaiN, Shamshīr-e-BayNiyām do

Kashti Meri Hayat ki Ub tou Kinaray lag gaī
Kehti hay tum se Zindagī ub tou Ma-e-Dawam do

Maidan-e-Nāt-e-Shah-e-Dī(n), Akhtar hay pur Khatar Zamī(n)
Ye Majlis-e-Ghazal Nahīn, Munh ko zara Lagam do

woh abr-e-bahār āyā har shay pe nikhār āyā
Woh Abr-e-Bahār Āyā Har Shay Pe Nikhār Āyā

Lā Jald Mere Sāqī de Sāgar o Paymāna
Kyā Rāt Ke Pardey Se Chupkay Se Sahar Niklī

Yā Jān-e-Dilārā(n) Ne Zulfo(n) mein Kiyā Shāna
Yū(n) Thām Ke Dāman Ko Machla Hai Sar-e-Maḥshar

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: ZINDAGĪ YE NAHĪ HAY KISĪ KE LIYE

shers.roman:
Zindagī Ye Nahī Hay Kisī Ke Liye
Zindagī Hay Nabī Kī, Nabī Ke Liye

Na-Samajh Martay Hai Zindagī Ke Liye
Jīna Marna Hay Sab Kuch Nabī Ke Liye

Chandnī Chār Din Hay Sabhī Ke Liye
Hay Sadī Chānd Abdun-Nabī Ke Liye

"Anta Fīhim" Ke Dāman Mein Munkir Bhī Hai
Ham Rahay Ishrat-E-Dāimī Ke Liye

Aysh Kar Lo YahāN Munkiro Chār Din
Mar Ke Tarso Ge Iss Zindagī Ke Liye

Dāg-E-Ishq-E-Nabī Le Chalo Qabr Mein
Hay Chirāg-e-Lahad Roshnī Ke Liye

Naqsh-E-Pā-E-Sagān-E-Nabī Dekhiye
Ye Patā Hai Bohat Rahbarī Ke Liye

Maslak-E-Alā hazrat Salamat Rahay
Aik Pehchān Dīn-E-Nabī Ke Liye

Maslak-E-Alahazrat Pe Qā’im Raho
Zindagī Di Ga’ī Hay Issī Ke Liye

Sulh-E-Kullī Nabī Kā Nahī Sunnīyo!
Sunnī Muslim Hai Saccha Nabī Ke Liye

Wo Bulātay Hain, Ko’ī Ye Awāz De
Dam Mein Jā PohnchūN Mein Hāzirī Ke Liye

Aey Nasīm-E-Sabā Unn Se Keh De Shaha
Muztarib Hai Gadā Hāzirī Ke Liye

Jin Ke Dil Mein Hai Ishq-e-Nabī Kī Chamak
Wo Tarastay Nahī Chāndnī Ke Liye

Jin Ke Dil Mein Hai Jalway Teray Ishq Ke
Wo Hai Najm-E-ZamāN Roshnī Ke Liye

Akhtar-E-Qadrī Khuld Mein Chal Diyā
Khuld Wā Hay Har Ek Qādrī Ke Liye

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: ABR-E-KARAM GESŪ-E-MUHAMMAD

shers.roman:
Abr-E-Karam Gesū-E-Muhammad
Don Haram Abrū-E-Muhammad

Sab Kī Nazar Hai Sū-E-Ka'bah
Ka'bah Takay Hai Rū-E-Muhammad

Ka'bay Ko Kis Ne Banayā Qiblah
Ka'bay Kā Ka'bah Rū-E-Muhammad

Sajda-E-Sar Hai Sū-E-Ka'bah
Sajda-E-Dil Hai Sū-E-Muhammad

Sāray Chaman Mein Kis Kī Khushbū
Khushbū Hay Khushbū-E-Muhammad

Kis Kī Chamak Hai Paykar-E-Gul Mein
Gul Mein Khila Hai Rū-E-Muhammad

Dhāray Chalay Har Unglī Se Unkī
Dekho Wo Niklī Jū-E-Muhammad

Sab Se Anoka Mū-E-Muhammad
Sab Se Nirālī Kū-E-Muhammad

Kis Kā Mū Deta Hai Gawahī
Mū-E-Muhammad Mū-E-Muhammad

Zinda Hai Wallah Zinda Hai Wallah
Jān-E-Do Ālam Rū-E-Muhammad

Bhīnī Bhīnī Khushbū Lahkī
Khul Gaey Jab Gesū-E-Muhammad

Ye Rāh Mahkī Woh Rāh Mahkī
Khul Gaey Jab Gesū-E-Muhammad

Subh Rukh-E-Roshan Se Dobala;
Husn-E-Shab-E-Gesū-E-Muhammad

Shām-E-RangīN Subh-E-Dil-Āra;
Har Du Baham Dar Rū-E-Muhammad

Shām-E-Mu'ambar, Subh-E-Munawwar;
Har Du Baham Dar Rū-E-Muhammad

Akhtar-E-Khasta Chal De JināN Ko
Bāg-E-JināN Hai Kū-E-Muhammad

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: ʿURS-e-AMJAD ʿALĪ MEI(N) CHALE ĀYE

shers.roman:
ʿUrs-e-Amjad ʿAlī mei(n) Chale Āye
Majd-e-Amjad Kī Sawgāt Le Jāye(n)

Kis Qadr Pur Kashish Hai Ye Razvī Samā
Jalwah Farmā Hai Kyā Alā Hazrat Yahā

Bazm-e-Ṣadr al-Sharīʿah Kī Ye Dil Kashī
Be Khudī De Gayī Aur Khudī Le Gayī

Be Khudī mei(n) Huwe Dahr se Be Khabar
Be Khudī Apnī Hai Dīn mei(n) Muʿtabar

Ghulistān-e-Razā Hai Yahā Be Gumā(n)
Hai Bahār-e-Sharīʿat Yahā Be Khazā(n)

Naẓm Merī Wahā Gungunāyī Gayī
Mei(n) Bhī Ḥāzir Hū(n) Yū(n) Gāyibānah Sahī

Tum Ko Amjad Razā se Milā Maykadah
Ek Ālim Huwā Bādah Khwār-e-Razā

Rind Tere Duāgo Rahe(n) Ge Ṣadā
Jām-o-Paimānah Bhar De Merā Sāqiyā

Apne Akhtar Pe Bhī Ho Karam Kī Naẓar
Uss Ke Dāman Mei(n) Bhī Dālye Kuch Gohar

---------
Muṣṭafā Kī Ziyā Shamʿ-e-Amjad Alī

Pur Ziyā Ho Ṣadā Shamʿ-e-Amjad Alī
Shamʿ-e-Amjad Alī Se Ye Meḥfil Sajī

Anjuman Hai Razā Kī Khūd Amjad Alī
Shamʿ-e-Amjad Se Lo Jab Razā Kī Milī

Anjuman Anjuman Se Baham Ho Gayī(n)
Yak Zabā(n) Ho Ke Kehtī Hai Ye Anjuman

Khūb Phūle Phale Ye Razā Kā Chaman
Maslak-e-Alā Ḥazrat Salāmat Rahe

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: MAR KE JĪNE KĀ PĀŪ(N) MAZĀ KHAYR SE

shers.roman:
Mar Ke Jīne Kā Pāū(n) Mazā Khayr Se
Rāhe Ṭaibah Mei(n) Āye Qazā Khayr Se

Kījiye Mere Ḥaq Mei(n) Duā Khayr Se
Khak e Ṭaibah Mei(n) Ho Merī Jā Khayr Se

Mujh Ko Un Kā Ishārah Milā Khayr Se
Mei(n) Madīne Kī Jānib Chalā Khayr Se

Khūb Guzrenge Ṣubḥ o Masā Khayr Se
Un Ke Dar Pe Jo Bistar Jamā Khayr Se

ʿĀm Hai Un Kā Jūd o Sakhā Khayr Se
Un Ke Dar Pe Hai Shāh o Gadā Khayr Se

Woh Uthī Mawj e Baḥr e Atā Khayr Se
Yā Woh Dast e Karam Uth Gayā Khayr Se

Shām Se Hum Ko Ṭaibah Mei(n) Nīnd Āgayī
Zindagī Ka Sawerā Huwā Khayr Se

Khāk e Ṭaibah Ko Pākar Hū(n) Mei(n) Shādmā
Merā Akhtar Darakhshā Huwā Khayr Se

kalams.author: Huzoor Tajush Shariah Mufti Akhtar Raza Khan
kalams.title: RASŪLALLĀHĪ YĀ BADR AL-TAMĀMI

shers.roman:
RasūlAllāhī Yā Badr al-Tamāmi
Ilayka Afirru Min Sharriz Ẓalāmi

Yuqaṣṣiru ʿInda Ghamrika Kullu Baḥrin
Wa Yuqṣiru ʿAn Samāka Yadul Ghamāmi

Samāukum ʿAlāl Aqṭāri Dāmat
Wa Baḥrukum Yufīḍu ʿAlād Dawāmi

Agithnī Yā Giyāthī Anta Ḥirzī
Fa As ʿidnī Bi-Bardin Fī Ḍurāmī

Wa Kun Lī Khayra Jārin Fī Ḥayātī
Wa Man Dhā Artajī Yawmal Qiyāmi

Wa Kun Lī Khayra ʿAwnīn Fī Umūrī
Wa Nawilnī Yadal lil I ʿtiṣāmi

Fidākum Mahjatī Antum ʿImādī
ʿIsamī Dumtumu Khayral ʿIsāmi

Fidāka Abī wa Ummī Min Jamīlin
Yurīnāl Barqa Minhu Fī Ibtisāmi

Idhā Mal Laylu Ṣādafa Ibtisāman
Tajallat Ibratan ʿIndab tisāmi

Lahu Thagrun Ḥawā Durran Naḍidan
Tanāthara Fī Qawāliba Min Kalāmi

Ṣalātullahi Yaḥdūhā Salāmun
ʿAlā Man Dallanā Subulas Salāmi

Wa Raḥmatu Rabbinā Gamarat Ṭalālan
Bijāhil Muṣṭafā Khayril Anāmi

Wa Yasqī Ramsahu Dawman Gamāmun
Wa Yuzhiru Qabrahu Surujuz Ẓalāmī

Wa Dāma Li-Ālihi ʿAyshun Raḍīyyun
Wa Yarḍā Anhumu Rabbul Anāmi

Sa’altu Jiwārakum Yā Khayra Jārin
Wa Innī Artajī Naylal Marāmi

Fahal Lī Fī Madīnatikum Qarārun
Wa Hal Qurbun Yadūmu Ladal Maqāmi

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HAI PAAK RUTBAH FIKR SE US BE-NIYAAZ KA

shers.roman:
Hai Paak Rutbah Fikr Se Us Be-Niyaaz Ka
Kuch Dakhl ‘Aql Ka Hai, Na Kaam Imtiyaaz Ka
shers.english:
Free From Being Grasped, Is That All Independent One’s Divine Majesty,
Neither Can Intellect Grasp It, Nor Can It Be Fully Perceived In Reality

shers.roman:
Shah Rag Se Kyuñ Wisaal Hai, Aankhoñ Se Kyuñ Hijaab
Kya Kaam Is Jagah Khirad e Har-zah Taaz Ka
shers.english:
Why Is He So Close To The Jugular Vein, Yet Hidden From Our Eyes Totally?
What Purpose Does Our Worthless Intellect Have, At This Juncture, Really?

shers.roman:
Lab Band Awr Dil Meiñ Haiñ Jalwe Bharay Huwe
Allah Re Jigar Tere Aagaah e Raaz Ka
shers.english:
My Lips Are Sealed, Yet My Heart Is Filled With Rays of Luminosity,
Upon Your Awareness of The Secret, O My Heart! I Am In Ecstasy

shers.roman:
Ghash Aa Gaya Kaleem Se Mushtaaq e Deed Ko
Jalwa Bhi Be-Niyaaz Hai, Us Be-Niyaaz Ka
shers.english:
The Kaleem Who Was Eager To See, Fainted In A State of Ecstasy,
Even The Ray of The All Independent, Is All Independent, Entirely

shers.roman:
Har Shay Se Haiñ ‘Ayaañ Mere Saane’ Ki San’ateñ
‘Aalam Sab Aa-inoñ Meiñ Hai Aa-ina Saaz Ka
shers.english:
Everything Is Reflecting, How The Creator, Created It Distinctively,
The Entire Universe Is In The Reflections, Manifested By The Almighty

shers.roman:
Aflaak o Arz Sab Tere Farmaañ Pazeer Haiñ
Haakim Hai Tu Jahaañ Ke Nasheb o Faraaz Ka
shers.english:
The Skies And The Earth, Are All Abiding, By Your Commands Obediently,
The Descent And Ascent of The Universe, Is Under Your Divine Authority

shers.roman:
Is Bekasi Meiñ Dil Ko Mere T’eyk Lag Gayi
Shohra Suna Jo Rahmat e Bekas Nawaaz Ka
shers.english:
In This State of Loneliness, My Sinking Heart, Found A Sanctuary,
When I Heard About Him, Who Soothes The Lonely With His Mercy

shers.roman:
Maanind e Sham’a Teri Taraf Lau Lagi Rahe
De Lutf Mere Jaan Ko Sauz o Gudaaz Ka
shers.english:
Like A Lamp, May My Flame, Be Directed Towards You Constantly,
As I Glow Ardently In Your Love, Grant My Soul Spiritual Ecstasy

shers.roman:
Tu Be Hisaab Bakhsh, Ke Haiñ Be Shumaar Jurm
Deta Huñ Waasta Tujhe Shaah e Hijaaz Ka
shers.english:
My Sins Are Innumerable, So Forgive Me Without Accountability,
For The Sake of The King of Hijaz, I Beseech You, O’ Allah Almighty!

shers.roman:
Bande Pe Tere, Nafs e La’eeñ Ho Gaya Muheet
Allah Kar Ilaaj Meri Hirs o Aaz Ka
shers.english:
The Accursed Inner-self, Has Overwhelmed Your Servant Entirely,
O Allah! For My Greed and Materialism, Grant Me The Remedy

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Kar Na Mere Kaam Baneñ Ghaib Se Hasan
Banda Bhi Huñ To Kaise Bar’ay Kaar Saaz Ka
shers.english:
O Hasan! An Unseen Resolution To My Matters, How Can’t There Be?
When I Am A Humble Servant, of The Divine Benefactor, Allah Almighty

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: FIKR ASFAL HAI MERI, MARTABA AA’LA TERA

shers.roman:
Fikr Asfal Hai Meri, Martaba Aa’la Tera
Wasf Kya Khaak Likhay Khaak Ka Putla Tera
shers.english:
My Deliberation Is Inferior, Your Divine Grandeur Is All Exalted
What Can The Epitome of Dust, Write About Your Praise, All Exalted

shers.roman:
Toor Par Hee Nahiñ Mauqoof Ujaala Tera
Kaun Se Ghar Meiñ Nahiñ Jalwa e Zaiba Tera
shers.english:
Not Only Upon The Mount Toor, Was Your Radiance Manifested,
By Your Magnificent Brightness, Which House Is Not Illuminated?

shers.roman:
Har Jagah Zikr Hai Ay Waahid o Yakta Tera
Kaun See Bazm Meiñ Roshan Nahiñ Ik’ka Tera
shers.english:
O’ One And Only Creator! Indeed, Everywhere You Are Mentioned,
By The Lamp of Your Oneness, Which Assembly Is Not Illuminated?

shers.roman:
Phir Numaayaañ Jo Sar e Toor Ho Jalwa Tera
Aag Lene Ko Chalay Aashiq e Shaida Tera
shers.english:
If On The Peak of Mount Toor, Again Your Divine Ray Were Manifested,
To Acquire That Flame, Your Servants Will Proceed, Entirely Devoted

shers.roman:
Kheerah Karta Hai Nigaahoñ Ko Ujaala Tera
Kijiye Kaun See Aankhoñ Se Nazaara Tera
shers.english:
Your Divine Radiance, Causes The Vision, To Be Totally Subjugated,
With Which Eyes, Will I Be Able To See, Your Divine Vision, So Exalted?

shers.roman:
Jalwa e Yaar Niraala Hai Ye Parda Tera
Ke Galay Mil Ke Bhi Khulta Nahiñ Milna Tera
shers.english:
O Ray of The Beloved Creator! This Veil, You Have Uniquely Protected,
That Even After Embracing It, This Closeness To You, Is Not Revealed

shers.roman:
Kya Khabar Hai Ke ‘Alal ‘Arsh Ke Maa’na Kya Haiñ
Ke Hai Aashiq Ki Tarah ‘Arsh Bhi Jooya Tera
shers.english:
The True Meaning of ‘Upon The Arsh’, Cannot Be Really Comprehended,
For Even The ‘Arsh Is Searching For You, Like The Lover, Truly Devoted

shers.roman:
‘Arini’ Go e Sar e Toor Se Pooche Koyi
Kis Tarah Ghash Meiñ Giraata Hai Tajal’la Tera
shers.english:
Someone Ask, On The Peak of Toor, ‘Let Me See You’ To Him Who Stated,
How Your Divine Radiance, Caused Him To Faint, When It Was Manifested

shers.roman:
Paar Utarta Hai Koyi, Gharq Koyi Hota Hai
Kahiñ Paayaab Kahiñ Josh Meiñ Darya Tera
shers.english:
While Someone Reaches Safe And Sound, Someone Is Totally Engulfed,
Your Ocean Is Somewhere Shallow, And Somewhere Swelling Unrestricted

shers.roman:
Baagh Meiñ Phool Huwa, Sham’a Bana Mehfil Meiñ
Josh e Nayrang Dar e Aghosh Hai Jalwa Tera
shers.english:
A Flower Bloomed In The Garden, As A Lamp, The Assembly, It Illuminated,
In The Ecstatic Embrace of This Splendour, Your Divine Ray Manifested

shers.roman:
Naye Andaaz Ki Khalwat Hai Ye Ay Parda Nasheeñ
Aankheñ Mushtaaq Raheñ Dil Meiñ Ho Jalwa Tera
shers.english:
An Original Pattern of Secrecy This Is, O You Who Are Entirely Veiled!
Whilst The Eyes Are Seeking You, In The Heart, Your Ray Is Manifested

shers.roman:
Shah Nasheeñ Toot’ay Huwe Dil Ko Banaaya Us Ne
Aah Ay Deeda e Mushthaaq Ye Likha Tera
shers.english:
Into A Sacred Throne, My Broken Heart, He Has Converted,
Alas! My Yearning Eyes, But For You, This Has Been Fated

shers.roman:
Saat Pardoñ Meiñ Nazar, Awr Nazar Meiñ ‘Aalam
Kuch Samajh Meiñ Nahiñ Aata Ye Mu’amma Tera
shers.english:
From Sight You Are Hidden, But In Your Sight, The Universe Is Established
Your Divine Secret, Is So Veiled From Us, It Cannot Truly Be Comprehended

shers.roman:
Toor Ka ‘Dheyr Huwa Ghash Meiñ Par’ay Haiñ Moosa
Kyuñ Na Ho Yaar, Ke Jalwa Hai Ye Jalwa Tera
shers.english:
Mount Toor Turned Into A Pile of Dust, Whilst Moosa Lay There Fainted,
O Beloved Creator! Why Shouldn’t It Be So, For This Ray, You Manifested

shers.roman:
Chaar Azdaad Ki Kis Tarah Girah Baandhi Hai
Naakhun e ‘Aql Se Khulta Nahiñ ‘Uqdah Tera
shers.english:
In Only A Single Bond, How Were Four Total Opposites Knotted?
With The Might of Our Intellect, This Knot Cannot Be Unknotted

shers.roman:
Dasht e Ayman Meiñ Mujhe Khaak Nazr Aayega
Mujh Meiñ Ho Kar Nazar Aata Nahiñ Jalwa Tera
shers.english:
In The Desert of Ayman, How Will I See Anything, There Scattered?
When I Am Unable To See Your Ray, Which Within Me Is Manifested

shers.roman:
Har Sahar Naghma e Murghaan e Nawa Sanj Ka Shor
Goonjta Hai Tere Awsaaf Se Sahra Tera
shers.english:
Every Morning, As The Tunes of The Chirping Birds Vibrated,
Your Desert Is Echoing, With Your Pure Praises, Most Exalted

shers.roman:
Wahshi e ‘Ishq Se Khulta Hai Tu Ay Parda e Raaz
Kuch Na Kuch Chaak Girebaañ Se Hai Rishta Tera
shers.english:
O Veil of The Secrets! Only With Ardent Profound Love, You Are Lifted,
To The One Profoundly In Love, You Are Surely Somewhat Connected

shers.roman:
Sach Hai Insaan Ko Kuch Kho Ke Mila Karta Hai
Aap Ko Kho Ke Tujhe Paayega Jooya Tera
shers.english:
It Is True That Man Gains Something, By Losing Something Cherished,
Only After He Loses Himself, Will You Be Realised, By The Truly Devoted

shers.roman:
Hai Tere Naam Se Aabaadi o Sahra Aabaad
Shahr Meiñ Zikr Tera Dasht Meiñ Charcha Tera
shers.english:
By Your Sacred Name, The Towns And The Wilderness Have Truly Thrived,
In The Cities You Are Remembered, In The Wilderness, You Are Celebrated

shers.roman:
Barq e Deedaar Hee Ne To Ye Qiyaamat Tor’i
Sab Se Hai Awr Kisi Se Nahiñ Parda Tera
shers.english:
The Flash of Your Divine Vision, Has Caused This Condition, So Exhilarated,
Even Though Veiled From All, From None, Will Your Divine Vision Be Veiled

shers.roman:
Aamad e Hashr Se Ek ‘Eid Hai Mushtaaqoñ Ko
Usi Parda Meiñ To Hai Jalwa e Zayba Tera
shers.english:
For Those Who Are Yearning, With Joy, Judgement Day Will Be Celebrated,
It Is Within That Actual Veil, That, Your Divine Vision Is Being Manifested

shers.roman:
Saare ‘Aalam Ko To Mushtaaq e Tajal’li Paaya
Poochne Jaaiye Ab Kis Se T’hikaana Tera
shers.english:
I Found The Entire Universe Seeking Your Radiance, When Manifested,
Now, From Whom Can I Really Ask, Where Your Rays Will Be Manifested?

shers.roman:
Toor Par Jalwa Dikhaaya Hai Taman’naayi Ko
Kaun Kehta Hai Ke Apnoñ Se Hai Parda Tera
shers.english:
On Mount Toor, You Revealed Your Ray, To The One Who Requested,
Who Said, That, From Your Beloveds, You Are Completely Secreted

shers.roman:
Kaam Deti Hai Yahaañ Dekhiye Kis Ki Aankheñ
Dekhne Ko To Hai Mushtaaq Zamaana Tera
shers.english:
Whose Eyes Will Benefit Them Here, Is What Needs To Be Detected,
To See Your Divine Vision, The Entire Universe Is Yearning, Excited

shers.roman:
Maikadah Meiñ Hai Taraana To Azaañ Masjid Meiñ
Wasf Hota Hai Naye Rang Se Har Jaa Tera
shers.english:
If In The Spiritual Potion-Cellar, Are Tunes, In The Masjid Azaan Vibrated,
Everywhere, In A Different Way, Your Pure Praises Are Being Celebrated

shers.roman:
Chaak Ho Jaayeñge Dil, Jeyb o Girebaañ Kis Ke
De Na Ch’hupne Ki Jagah Raaz Ko Parda Tera
shers.english:
Whose Heart, Pocket And Collar, Will Be Totally Dissected?
Your Veil, Will Not Let The Secret Hide, Anywhere Undetected

shers.roman:
Be Nawa Muflis o Muhtaaj o Gada Kaun, Ke Meiñ
Saahib e Jood o Karam Wasf Hai Kis Ka Tera
shers.english:
More Than Me, Who Is A Beggar, More Destitute, Needy And Deserted?
Whose Attribute Is ‘The All Generous And Kind’? It Is Yours, Undisputed!

shers.roman:
Aafreeñ Ahle Muhab’bat Ke Diloñ Ko Ay Dost
Aik Koozay Meiñ Liye Baythay Haiñ Darya Tera
shers.english:
O Beloved Creator! Bless The Hearts of Those, Who Are Truly Devoted,
Gathering Your Ocean, Into A Small Vessel, They Are All Now Seated

shers.roman:
Itni Nisbat Bhi Mujhe Donoñ Jahaañ Meiñ Bas Hai
Too Mera Maalik o Maula Hai, Meiñ Banda Tera
shers.english:
At Least, In Both The Worlds, This Much I Am Connected,
You Are My Creator And Master, I Am Your Servant Devoted

shers.roman:
Ungliyaañ Kaanoñ Meiñ De-De Ke Suna Karte Haiñ
Khalwat e Dil Meiñ ‘Ajab Shor Hai Barpa Tera
shers.english:
They Heard, As Their Ears, With Their Fingers, They Congested,
In The Privacy of Their Heart, As Your Splendid Praises, Reverberated

shers.roman:
Ab Jamaata Hai Hasan Us Ki Gali Meiñ Bistar
Khoobruyoñ Ka Mahboob Hai Pyaara Tera
shers.english:
In His Sacred Lane, His Humble Bed, Hasan Has Now Arranged,
Who Is The Beloved of The Beloveds, And Your Most Beloved

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JINN O INSAAN O MALAK KO HAI BHAROSA TERA

shers.roman:
Jinn o Insaan o Malak Ko Hai Bharosa Tera
Sarwara! Marja’e Kul Hai Dar e Waala Tera
shers.english:
Confidence In You, The Jinns, Humans And Angels Are Having,
Your Majestic Court, Is The Sanctuary For All, O My Grand King!

shers.roman:
Waah! Ay ‘Itr e Khuda-Saaz Mahakna Tera
Khoobru Maltay Haiñ Kap’roñ Meiñ Pasina Tera
shers.english:
Wow! O Allah Gifted Fragrance, So Fragrant You Are Being,
On Their Clothes, Your Perspiration, The Beloveds Are Applying

shers.roman:
Dahr Meiñ Aat’h Pahar Bat’ta Hai Baar’a Tera
Waqf Hai Maangne Waaloñ Pe Khazaana Tera
shers.english:
Day And Night, In The Universe, Your Alms You Are Distributing,
Granted To Your Mendicants, Your Generous Treasures Are Being

shers.roman:
Laa Makaañ Meiñ Nazar Aata Hai Ujaala Tera
Door Pahunchaaya Tere Husn Ne Shohra Tera
shers.english:
Beyond Time And Space, Your Blessed Radiance Is Seen Glowing,
In The Great Heights, By Your Splendour, Renowned You Are Being

shers.roman:
Jalwa e Yaar Idhar Bhi Koyi Pheyra Tera
Hasrateñ Aat’h Pahar Takti Haiñ Rasta Tera
shers.english:
O Ray of The Beloved! In Our Direction, Also Be Passing,
Day And Night, Your Arrival, Our Yearning Is Anticipating

shers.roman:
Ye Nahiñ Hai Ke Faqat Hai Ye Madina Tera
Too Hai Mukhtar, Do ‘Aalam Pe Hai Qabza Tera
shers.english:
It Does Not Mean, That Only This Madina, Yours Is Being,
You Are The Vested, In Your Control, Both Worlds Are Being

shers.roman:
Kya Kahe Wasf Koyi Dasht e Madina Tera
Phool Ki Jaan e Nazaakat Meiñ Hai Kaanta Tera
shers.english:
O Desert of Madina! Your True Description Who Can Be Giving?
When In The Essence of The Flower’s Elegance, Your Thorn Is Being

shers.roman:
Kis Ke Daaman Meiñ Ch’hupay, Kis Ke Qadam Pe Laut’ay
Tera Sag Jaaye Kahaañ Ch’hor Ke ‘Tukr’a Tera
shers.english:
In Whose Mantle Should I Hide, Whose Feet Should I Be Revisiting?
Leaving Your Blessed Morsel, Where Else Can Your Dog Be Going?

shers.roman:
Khusru e Kaun o Makaañ Awr Tawaazu’ Aisi
Haath Takya Hai Tera, Khaak Bichauna Tera
shers.english:
You Are The King of Both The Worlds, Yet So Humble You Are Being,
You Are Using Your Hand As Your Pillow; Your Bed, The Dust Is Being

shers.roman:
Khoobruyaan e Jahaañ Tujh Pe Fida Hote Haiñ
Wo Hai Ay Maah e ‘Arab Husn e Dil-Aara Tera
shers.english:
Sacrificed Upon You, The World’s Most Beautiful Ones Are Being,
O Arabian Moon! So Splendid, Your Heart Adorning Beauty Is Being

shers.roman:
Dasht e Pur-Hawl Meiñ Gheyra Hai Darindoñ Ne Mujhe
Ay Mere Khizr Id’har Bhi Koyi Pheyra Tera
shers.english:
In The Dreadful Wilderness, Surrounded By Beasts, I Am Being,
O My Saviour! For Your Blessed Arrival Here, I Am Now Waiting

shers.roman:
Baadshahaan e Jahaañ Bahr e Gadaayi Aayeñ
Dene Par Aaye Agar Maangne Waala Tera
shers.english:
To Them, As Mendicants, The Worldly Kings Are Coming,
When Your Blessings, Your Mendicants, Start Distributing

shers.roman:
Dushman o Dost Ke Muñh Par Hai Kushaada Yaksaañ
Roo e Aa-ina Hai Maula Dar e Waala Tera
shers.english:
Alike, The Faces of The Adversaries And Lovers Are Happily Smiling,
Your Grand Court Is A Radiant Reflecting Mirror, O’ My Beloved King!

shers.roman:
Paaoñ Majruh Haiñ Manzil Hai Kar’i Boj Bahut
Aah! Gar Aise Meiñ Paaya Na Sahaara Tera
shers.english:
My Feet Are Wounded, The Destination Is Far, Heavy My Burden Is Being,
How Unfortunate I Am, If In This State, Your Support I Am Not Receiving!

shers.roman:
Neyk Ach’che Haiñ Ke A’maal Haiñ Un Ke Ach’che
Ham Badoñ Ke Liye Kaafi Hai Bharosa Tera
shers.english:
The Pious Are Virtuous, Because Virtuous Their Deeds Are Being,
But Sufficient For Us Sinners, Your Blessed Assurance Is Being

shers.roman:
Aafatoñ Meiñ Giriftaar Hai Ghulaam e ‘Ajami
Ay ‘Arab Waale Id’har Bhi Koyi Pheyra Tera
shers.english:
Arrested In Difficulties, Your Non-Arab Slave, Is Being,
Please Pass In My Direction As Well, O My Arabian King!

shers.roman:
Oonche, Oonchoñ Ko Tere Saamne Saajid Paaya
Kis Tarah Samjhe Koyi Rutba e Aala Tera
shers.english:
In Adoration Before You, The Most Elite Ones, I Found Bowing,
Your True Status, How Then, Can Anyone Ever Be Understanding?

shers.roman:
Khaar e Sahra e Nabi, Paaoñ Se Kya Kaam Tujhe
Aa Meri Jaan, Meri Dil Meiñ Hai Rasta Tera
shers.english:
O Thorn of The Nabi’s Desert! My Feet Why Are You Seeking?
Come To Me O Beloved! My Heart, Your Real Pathway Is Being

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Na Ho Naaz Mujhe Apne Muqad’dar Pe Ke Huñ
Sag Tera, Banda Tera, Maangne Waala Tera
shers.english:
A Sense of Pride Over My Destiny, Why Shouldn’t I Be Feeling,
When Your Dog, Your Slave, And Your Mendicant, I Am Being

shers.roman:
Ach’che, Ach’che Haiñ Tere Dar Ki Gadaayi Karte
Oonche, Oonchoñ Meiñ Bat’a Karta Hai Sadqa Tera
shers.english:
As Mendicants At Your Court, The Very Best Are Begging,
Amongst The Most Elite, Distributed Your Alms, Are Being

shers.roman:
Bheek Be Maange Faqeeroñ Ko Jahaañ Milti Hai
Donoñ ‘Aalam Meiñ Wo Darwazah Hai Kis Ka, Tera!
shers.english:
Without Even Asking, From Where, Are The Destitute Receiving?
In Both The Worlds, Whose Gateway Is This? Only Yours, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Taman’na Meri Maayoos Ho Ay Abr e Karam?
Sookhay Dhaanoñ Ka Madad-Gaar Hai Cheeñt’a Tera
shers.english:
O Cloud of Generosity! Disillusioned, Why Should My Hope Be Feeling?
When The Dry Rice Fields Are Aided, By The Showers of Your Blessing

shers.roman:
Haaye! Phir Khanda e Be Jaa Mere Lab Par Aaya
Haaye! Phir Bhool Gaya Raatoñ Ka Rona Tera
shers.english:
Alas! Upon My Lips, An Unnecessary Smile Is Appearing,
Alas! Again, I Have Forgotten, Your Nights-long Weeping

shers.roman:
Hashr Ke Pyaas Se Kya Khauf Gunahgaaroñ Ko
Tishna Kaamoñ Ka Khareedaar Hai Darya Tera
shers.english:
Why Should The Sinners, Fear Being Thirsty, On The Day of Reckoning?
The Thirsty And Hopeless Ones, Your Sacred Ocean Will Be Securing

shers.roman:
Sauzan e Gum-Shudah Milti Hai Tabassum Se Tere
Shaam Ko Subh Banaata Hai Ujaala Tera
shers.english:
A Hidden Needle Is Found, Whilst You Are Radiantly Smiling,
By Your Sacred Radiance, Evening, Is Transformed Into Morning

shers.roman:
Sidq Ne Tujh Meiñ Yahaañ Tak To Jagah Paayi Hai
Keh Nahiñ Sakte Ulush Ko Bhi To Jhoot’a Tera
shers.english:
To Such A Point, In You, Truth Has Found A Place, So Amazing
That As Jhoot’a, To The Food You Leave, We Cannot Be Referring

shers.roman:
Khaas Bandoñ Ke Tasad’duq Meiñ Rihaayi Paaye
Aakhir Us Kaam Ka To Hai, Ye Nikam’ma Tera
shers.english:
By The Sacrifices of The Chosen Servants, Freedom We Are Acquiring,
Ultimately, This Is All, That Your Worthless Servant, Can Be Doing

shers.roman:
Band e Gham Kaat’ Diya Karte Haiñ Tere Abru
Pheyr Deta Hai Balaawoñ Ko Ishaara Tera
shers.english:
The Shackles of Anguish, Your Sacred Eyebrows Are Cutting,
Your Blessed Gesture, Causes All Calamities To Be Retreating

shers.roman:
Hashr Ke Roz Hañsaayega Khata Kaaroñ Ko
Mere Gham-Khwaar Dil e Shab Meiñ Ye Rona Tera
shers.english:
On The Day or Reckoning, It Will Leave The Sinners Smiling,
O My Consoler! In The Midst of Night, Such Was Your Weeping

shers.roman:
‘Amal e Neyk Kahaañ Naama e Bad-Kaaroñ Meiñ
Hai Ghulaamoñ Ko Bharosa Mere Aaqa Tera
shers.english:
In The Sinner’s Register, Virtuous Deeds, Where Will You Be Finding?
O My Grand King! Only Upon You, Will Your Slaves Be Depending

shers.roman:
Behr e Deedaar Jhuk Aaye Haiñ Zameeñ Par Taare
Waah Ay Jalwa e Dil-Daar Chamakna Tera
shers.english:
To See Your Countenance, Over The Earth, The Stars Are Bowing,
O How Radiantly, The Bright Lustres of My Beloved Are Glowing!

shers.roman:
Oonchi Ho Kar Nazar Aati Hai Har Ik Shay Ch’hot’i
Jaa Ke Khursheed Bana Charkh Pe Zar’ra Tera
shers.english:
From A Height, Very Miniscule, Everything Below Is Appearing,
Yet As A Speck of Your Blessings, In The Sky, The Sun Is Being

shers.roman:
Ay Madina Ki Hawa! Dil Mera Afsurdah Hai
Sookhi Kaliyoñ Ko Khila Jaata Hai J’hoñka Tera
shers.english:
O Breeze of Madina! Dejected My Heart Is Feeling,
Yet, By Your Single Gust, Dead Buds Start Blooming

shers.roman:
Mere Aaqa Haiñ Wo Abr e Karam, Ay Sauz e Alam
Aik Ch’heente Ka Bhi Hoga Na Ye Dahra Tera
shers.english:
O Burning Grief! That Cloud of Mercy, My King Is Being,
By His Single Droplet, This Pond Will Be Overflowing

shers.roman:
Ab Hasan! Manqabat e Khwaja e Ajmer Suna
Tab’ Pur-Josh Hai, Rukta Nahiñ Khaama Tera
shers.english:
O Hasan! A Tribute, To The Khwaja of Ajmer, Now Do Be Rendering,
Your Pen Is Not Pausing, For Your Spiritual Sentiments Are Surging

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KHWAJA E HIND WO DARBAAR HAI AA’LA TERA

shers.roman:
Khwaja e Hind Wo Darbaar Hai Aa’la Tera
Kabhi Mahroom Nahiñ Maangne Waala Tera
shers.english:
O Khwaja e Hind! Your Blessed Court Is So Exalted
At Your Court, Never Is Your Mendicant, Ever Rejected

shers.roman:
Maa e Sar Josh Dar Aaghosh Hai Sheesha Tera
Be Khudi Ch’haaye Na Kyuñ Pee Ke Pyaala Tera
shers.english:
Your Sacred Bottle Is Under My Arm, I Am Spiritually Intoxicated
After Sipping From Your Sacred Goblet, Why Shouldn’t I Be Elated?

shers.roman:
Khuftgaan e Shab e Ghaflat Ko Jaga Deta Hai
Saal-haa Saal Wo Raatoñ Ka Na Sona Tera
shers.english:
Those Who Sleep Heedlessly Throughout The Night, Are Now Jolted
By Your Sleepless Nights, Year After Year, Totally Uninterrupted

shers.roman:
Hai Teri Zaat Ajab Bahr e Haqeeqat Pyaare
Kisi Tayraak Ne Paaya Na Kinaara Tera
shers.english:
Your Personality Is An Amazing Ocean of Haqeeqat, Manifested
The Real Shores of Your Vast Ocean, No Swimmer Has Detected

shers.roman:
Jaur e Paamaali e ‘Aalam Se Usay Kya Matlab
Khaak Meiñ Mil Nahiñ Sakta Kabhi Zar’ra Tera
shers.english:
About The Tyranny of The World, Why Should He Be Disquieted?
He, Who Is Your Speck, In The Dust, Can Never Be Incorporated

shers.roman:
Kis Qadar Josh e Tahay’yur, Ke ‘Ayaañ Haiñ Aasaar
Nazar Aaya Magar Aa-ina Ko Talwa Tera
shers.english:
Such Is The Ecstasy of Amazement, Yet The Signs Are Clearly Reflected
Even When It Did See, The Mirror Only Saw Your Sacred Soles Exhibited

shers.roman:
Gulshan e Hind Se Shaadaab Kaleje ‘Thand’ay
Waah! Ay Abr e Karam Zor Barasna Tera
shers.english:
Through The Gardens of Hind, We Are Fresh, Our Hearts Are Contented
Wow! O Cloud of Generosity, Your Showers Are Pouring Uninterrupted

shers.roman:
Kya Mahak Hai Ke Mu’at’tar Hai Dimaagh e ‘Aalam
Takhta e Gulshan e Firdaus Hai Rauza Tera
shers.english:
So Superb Is Your Scent, That The Mind of The World Became Scented
A Flowerbed of The Heavenly Gardens, Is Your Holy Grave, So Scented

shers.roman:
Tere Zar’ra Pe Ma’aasi Ki Ghat’a Ch’haayi Hai
Is Taraf Bhi Kabhi Ay Mahr Ho Jalwa Tera
shers.english:
Upon This Speck of Yours, Dark Clouds of Sins, Now Hover Unabated
O Radiant Sun! Toward Me Occasionally, May Your Rays Be Directed

shers.roman:
Tujh Meiñ Haiñ Tarbiyat e Khizr Ke Paida Aasaar
Bahr o Bar Meiñ Hameñ Milta Hai Sahaara Tera
shers.english:
In You, The Signs of Being Taught By Khizr, Are Exhibited
In The Oceans, And On The Land, By You, We Are Assisted

shers.roman:
Phir Mujhe Apna Dar e Paak Dikha De Pyaare
Aankheñ Pur-Noor Hoñ Phir Dekh Ke Jalwa Tera
shers.english:
O Beloved! Once More, May I See Your Court, So Consecrated
Again, May My Eyes Glow, After Seeing Your Rays, So Illuminated

shers.roman:
Zil’l e Haq Ghaus Pe, Hai Ghaus Ka Saaya Tujh Par
Saaya Gustar Sar e Khud’daam Pe Saaya Tera
shers.english:
Ghaus Has Allah’s Refuge, By Ghaus e Paak’s Shade, You Are Protected
By Your Considerate Shade Over Our Heads, Your Devotees Are Protected

shers.roman:
Tujh Ko Baghdad Se Haasil Huwi Wo Shaan e Rafi’
Dang Rah Jaate Haiñ Sab Dekh Ke Rutba Tera
shers.english:
From Baghdad, You Have Received A Blessed Station, So Venerated
Astonished Are All Those, Who Observe Your Status, So Elevated

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Na Baghdad Meiñ Jaari Ho Tera Chashma e Faiz
Bahr e Baghdad Hee Ki Nahr Hai Darya Tera
shers.english:
In Baghdad, Why Shouldn’t Your Blessed Fountain, Flow Unrestricted?
From The Oceans of Baghdad, As A Tributary, Your River Was Created

shers.roman:
Kursi ‘Daali Teri, Takht e Shah e Jilaañ Ke Huzoor
Kitna Ooncha Kiya Allah Ne Paaya Tera
shers.english:
Before The Throne of The King of Baghdad, Your Chair Was Located,
Your Magnificent Position, Almighty Allah, Has Made So Exalted

shers.roman:
Rashk Hota Hai Ghulaamoñ Ko Kahiñ Aaqa Se?
Kyuñ Kahuñ Rashk Dah e Badr Hai Talwa Tera
shers.english:
Have You Ever Seen A Devotee Envy The Master, If He Is Devoted?
Why Should I Say, The Envy of The Moon, Are Your Soles, Elevated

shers.roman:
Bashar Afzal Haiñ Malak Se Yuñh Madh Karuñ
Na Malak Khaas Bashar Karte Haiñ Mujra Tera
shers.english:
I Will Praise You In This Manner, For Above The Angels, Man Is Exalted
Not Only By The Angels, But By The Elite Humans, You Are Celebrated

shers.roman:
Jab Se Tu Ne Qadam e Ghaus Liya Hai Sar Par
Awliya Sar Pe Qadam Lete Haiñ Shaaha Tera
shers.english:
Ever Since, On Your Head, The Foot of The Ghaus, You Have Accepted
Your Sacred Foot Upon Their Heads, All The Awliya Have Accepted

shers.roman:
Muhiyud’deeñ Ghaus Haiñ Awr Khwaja Mu’eenud’deeñ Hai
Ay Hasan Kyuñ Na Ho Mahfooz Aqida Tera
shers.english:
The Reviver of The Deen Is Ghaus, By Khwaja, The Deen Is Assisted,
O Hasan! Why Then, Will Your Aqida (Creed) Not Be Protected?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AASMAAÑ GAR TERE TALWOÑ KA NAZAARA KARTA

shers.roman:
Aasmaañ Gar Tere Talwoñ Ka Nazaara Karta
Roz Ik Chaand Tasad’duq Meiñ Utaara Karta
shers.english:
If The Sacred Soles of Your Feet, The Sky Were To See,
As An Offering, A Moon It Would Sacrifice Upon It Daily

shers.roman:
Tauf e Rauza Hee Pe Chakraaye Thay Kuch Na-Waaqif
Meiñ To Aapay Meiñ Na Tha Awr Jo Sajdah Karta
shers.english:
Just By Me Circling The Rauza, Some Ignorant Ones Were Dazed Totally,
I Wasn’t Even In My Senses, So What If I Had Prostrated Uncontrollably?

shers.roman:
Sarsar e Dasht e Madina Jo Karam Farmaati
Kyuñ Meiñ Afsurdagi e Bakht Ka Parwa Karta
shers.english:
If The Swift Flowing Wind of Madina’s Desert, Were To Bless Me,
Why Then, Would I Ever Bother, About The Sadness of My Destiny?

shers.roman:
Ch’hup Gaya Chaand Na Aayi Tere Deedaar Ki Taab
Awr Agar Saamne Rehta Bhi To Sajdah Karta
shers.english:
The Moon Vanished, It Couldn’t Bear To See Your Countenance Directly,
And Even If It Were In Front of You, It Would Have Prostrated Instantly

shers.roman:
Ye Wohi Haiñ Ke Giro Aap Awr Un Par Machlo
Ult’i Baatoñ Pe Kaho, Kaun Na Seedha Karta
shers.english:
This Is The Same, As Sinking Yourself, And Then Insisting Tearfully,
Thereafter, To Say To The Contrary, There Was None To Rectify Me

shers.roman:
Ham Se Zar’roñ Ki To Taqdeer Hee Chamka Jaata
Mahr Farma Ke Wo Jis Raah Se Nikla Karta
shers.english:
Specks Like Us, Would Have Had Our Destiny Glowing Brightly,
Which Route Is He Departing Through, O Sun! Do Tell Me

shers.roman:
‘Dhoom Zar’roñ Meiñ ‘Anash Shams’ Ki Par’ Jaati Hai
Jis Taraf Se Hai Guzar Chaand Hamaara Karta
shers.english:
Each Speck Would Have Echoed, ‘I Am The Sun’ Ecstatically,
When Our Moon Passed, Through Any Dimension, Radiantly

shers.roman:
Aah! Kya Khoob Tha Gar Haazir e Dar Hota Maiñ
Un Ke Saaye Ke Talay Chain Se Soya Karta
shers.english:
O How Blessed It Would Be, If I Could Visit The Court of My Nabi
Under His Blessed Shade, I Would Have Fallen Asleep, So Peacefully

shers.roman:
Shauq o Aadaab Baham Garm e Kashakash Rehte
‘Ishq e Gum Kardah Tuwaañ ‘Aql Se Uljha Karta
shers.english:
Desire And Decorum Would Clash With One Other, In A State of Perplexity,
With The Strong Intellect, The Deeply Absorbed Love, Will Argue Intensely

shers.roman:
Aankh Uth’ti To Maiñ Jhunjlaa Ke Palak See Leta
Dil Bigar’ta To Maiñ Ghabra Ke Sambhala Karta
shers.english:
If My Eyes Were Raised, I Would Stitch My Eyelids, Irritably,
And If My Heart Were To Stray, I Would Control It, Anxiously

shers.roman:
Be-Khudaana Kabhi Sajdah Maiñ Soo e Dar Girta
Jaanib e Qibla Kabhi Chonk Ke Palt’a Karta
shers.english:
In An Elated State, Facing Your Gate, I Would Have Prostrated Sporadically,
Startled, As I Regained My Senses, I Would Turn To The Qibla Immediately

shers.roman:
Baam Tak Dil Ko Kabhi Baal e Kabootar Deta
Khaak Par Gir Ke Kabhi, Haaye! Khudaaya Karta
shers.english:
To Soar Aloft, A Pigeon’s Wings, I Would Give My Heart Occasionally,
At Times I Would Fall To The Dust, Proclaiming, O Allah Almighty!

shers.roman:
Gaahe Marham Nahi Zakhm e Jigar Meiñ Rehta
Gaahe Nashtar Zani Khoon e Taman’na Karta
shers.english:
In The Wounds of My Heart, The Ointment of Relief, Remains Rarely,
Sometimes, The Yearning Is Eliminated, By This Form of Phlebotomy

shers.roman:
Hamrah e Mahr Kabhi Gird e Khateerah Phirta
Saaya Ke Saath Kabhi Khaak Pe Laut’a Karta
shers.english:
With The Sun, I Would Have Revolved Around The Noble One Occasionally,
Along With The Shadow, I Would Have Rolled On The Ground Occasionally

shers.roman:
Sohbat e Daagh e Jigar Se Kabhi Jhee Behlaata
Ulfat e Dast o Girebaañ Ka Tamaasha Karta
shers.english:
In The Company of Sorrows, I Would Comfort My Heart Occasionally,
The Love Between The Hand And Collar, I Would Witness Ecstatically

shers.roman:
Dil e Hayraañ Ko Kabhi Zauq e Tapish Par Laata
Tapish e Dil Ko Kabhi Hausla-Farsa Karta
shers.english:
I Would Let The Stunned Heart, Feel My Fluttering Desire, Occasionally,
Whilst I Would Discourage, My Already Fluttering Heart, Occasionally

shers.roman:
Kabhi Khud Apne Tahay’yur Pe Hayraañ Rehta
Kabhi Khud Apne Samajhne Ko Na Samjha Karta
shers.english:
I Would Be Amazed, By My Very Own Amazement, Occasionally,
I Would Fail To Understand, My Own Perception Occasionally

shers.roman:
Kabhi Kehta Ke Ye Kya Bazm Hai Kaisi Hai Bahaar
Kabhi Andaaz e Tajaahul Se Maiñ Tauba Karta
shers.english:
At Times I Would Say, What Is This Assembly, What Is This Superb Beauty?
Whilst From This Oblivious Manner, I Would At Times Repent Sincerely

shers.roman:
Kabhi Kehta Ke Ye Kya Josh e Junooñ Hai Zaalim
Kabhi Phir Gir Ke Tar’apne Ki Taman’na Karta
shers.english:
At Times I Would Say, O Tyrant! Explain This Heightened Ecstasy?
At Times I Would Yearn, To Simply Collapse, In A State of Anxiety

shers.roman:
Suthri, Suthri, Wo Faza Dekh Ke Maiñ Gharq e Gunaah
Apni Aankhoñ Meiñ Khud Us Bazm Meiñ Khat’ka Karta
shers.english:
I Sink Into The Thought of My Sins, As This Magnificent Setting, I See,
Within My Eyes, I Reflect On My State, Whilst Present In That Assembly

shers.roman:
Kabhi Rahmat Ke Tasaw’wur Meiñ Hansi Aati Hai
Paas e Aadaab Kabhi Hontoñ Ko Bakhya Karta
shers.english:
At Times I Begin To Smile, As I Visualise His Special Mercy,
Out of Immense Respect, I Stitch My Lips Shut, Occasionally

shers.roman:
Dil Agar Ranj e Ma’aasi Se Bigar’ne Lagta
Afw Ka Zikr Suna Kar Meiñ Sambhala Karta
shers.english:
Due To The Grief of My Sins, When My Heart Starts To Feel Uneasy,
I Give Solace To It, By Telling It, About His Forgiveness And Mercy

shers.roman:
Ye Mazay Khoobi e Qismat Se To Paaye Hote
Sakht Diwaana Tha, Gar Khuld Ki Parwa Karta
shers.english:
This Pleasure, You Would Have Got, Due To Your Fortunate Destiny,
If You Cared Only About Paradise, You Would Have Been Utterly Crazy

shers.roman:
Maut Us Din Ko, Jo Phir Naam o Watan Ka Leta
Khaak Us Sar Pe Jo Us Dar Se Kinaara Karta
shers.english:
Death To That Day, Which Again Reminds You, of Your Status And Country,
Cursed Is That Person, Who Stays Away, From That Holy Court Deliberately

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan! Qasd e Madina Nahiñ, Rona Hai Yahi
Awr Maiñ Aap Se Kis Baat Ka Shikwaa Karta
shers.english:
O Hasan! Not Journeying To Madina, Is My Only Agony,
To You, About What Else, Should I Complain, In Reality?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ‘AASIYOÑ KO DAR TUMHAARA MIL GAYA

shers.roman:
‘Aasiyoñ Ko Dar Tumhaara Mil Gaya
Be ‘Thikaanoñ Ko ‘Thikhaana Mil Gaya
shers.english:
Your Sacred Gateway, The Sinners Have Attained
A Place of Sanctuary, The Destitute Have Attained

shers.roman:
Fazl e Rab’b Se Phir Kami Kis Baat Ki
Mil Gaya Sab Kuch Jo Taibah Mil Gaya
shers.english:
By The Divine Grace of Allah, Now, What Shortage Is There?
We Have Attained Everything, If Taibah We Have Attained

shers.roman:
Kashf e Raaz e ْ رàðي Yuñ Huwa
Tum Milay To Haq Ta’aala Mil Gaya
shers.english:
The Secret In ‘Whoever Saw Me’, In This Way Was Revealed,
By Reaching You, Nearness To Almighty Allah, Was Attained

shers.roman:
Be-Khudi Hai Baa’is e Kashf e Hijaab
Mil Gaya Milne Ka Rasta Mil Gaya
shers.english:
Spiritual Ecstasy Is The Path, To Raising The Veil of Secrecy,
When It Was Attained, The Path To Him, Was Attained

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dar Ne Sab Se Mustaghni Kiya
Be Talab Be Khwaahish Itna Mil Gaya
shers.english:
His Sacred Court Made Me Independent of Everyone,
Without Even Asking or Desiring, So Much I Have Attained

shers.roman:
Naa-Khudaayi Ke Liye Aaye Huzoor
‘Doobto Niklo Sahaara Mil Gaya
shers.english:
Indeed, As Our Saviour, The Beloved Nabi Arrived,
Surface, O Drowning Ones, For Relief You Have Attained

shers.roman:
Donoñ ‘Aalam Se Mujhe Kyuñ Kho Diya
Nafs e Khud-Matlab, Tujhe Kya Mil Gaya
shers.english:
Why Have You Alienated Me, From Both The Worlds,
O Selfish Inner Desire! What Have You Really Attained?

shers.roman:
Aankheñ Pur-Nam Ho Gayeeñ Sar Jhuk Gaya
Jab Tera Naqsh e Kaf e Paa Mil Gaya
shers.english:
As Tears Filled My Eyes, I Lowered My Head In Humility,
When The Imprint of Your Sacred Footprint, I Attained

shers.roman:
Khuld Kaisa, Kya Chaman, Kis Ka Watan
Mujh Ko Sahra e Madina Mil Gaya
shers.english:
What Will Paradise, Any Garden, Or Any Country, Mean To Me
When The Sacred Desert of Madina, I Have Already Attained

shers.roman:
Hai Muhab’bat Kis Qadr Naam e Khuda
Naam e Haq Se Naam e Waala Mil Gaya
shers.english:
So Much of Love, Through The Name of Allah, Is Exhibited!
Such A Connection To Allah’s Name, Your Name Has Attained

shers.roman:
Un Ke Taalib Ne Jo Chaaha Paa Liya
Un Ke Saa-il Ne Jo Maanga Mil Gaya
shers.english:
Whatever His Sincere Seeker Desired, He Surely Attained,
Whatever His Mendicant Requested, He Certainly Attained

shers.roman:
Tere Dar Ke ‘Tukray Haiñ Awr Maiñ Ghareeb,
Mujh Ko Rozi Ka Thikaana Mil Gaya
shers.english:
Before This Needy One, The Morsels of Your Court Are Served,
The Sacred Station To Secure My Sustenance, I Have Attained

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan! Firdaus Meiñ Jaayeñ Janaab
Ham Ko Sahra e Madina Mil Gaya
shers.english:
O Hasan! Whoever Desires Paradise, Let Him Proceed,
For The Sacred Desert of Madina, We Have Attained

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DIL MERA DUNYA PE SHAIDA HO GAYA

shers.roman:
Dil Mera Dunya Pe Shaida Ho Gaya
Ay Mere Allah Ye Kya Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Upon The World, My Heart Is Obsessed, Completely
How Did This Really Happen? O My Allah Almighty!

shers.roman:
Kuch Mere Bachne Ki Soorat Kijiye
Ab To Jo Hona Tha Maula Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Please Provide Me With A Suitable Means, To Guarantee My Safety
O My Master! What Was Meant To Happen, Has Happened Already

shers.roman:
‘Aib Posh e Khalq Daaman Se Tere
Sab Gunahgaaroñ Ka Parda Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Concealing The Sins of The Creation, Is Your Mantle of Mercy
All The Sins of The Sinful, Have Now Been Shrouded In Secrecy

shers.roman:
Rakh Diya Jab Us Ne Phat’tar Par Qadam
Saaf Ik Aa-ina Paida Ho Gaya
shers.english:
When On A Rock, He Placed His Sacred Foot Gently
It Gave Birth To A Manifest Mirror, Immediately

shers.roman:
Door Ho Mujh Se Jo Un Se Door Hai
Us Pe Maiñ Sadqe Jo Un Ka Ho Gaya
shers.english:
He Who Is Distant From Him, Should Remain Distant From Me,
I Am Sincerely Devoted To Him, Who Is His Sincere Devotee

shers.roman:
Garmi e Baazaar Maula Bar’h Chali
Nirkh e Rahmat Khoob Sasta Ho Gaya
shers.english:
O My Master! The Market Demand, Has Grown Immensely,
Incredibly Inexpensive Has Become, The Price of Real Mercy

shers.roman:
Dekh Kar Un Ka Farogh e Husn e Paa
Mahr Zar’ra, Chaand, Taara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Whilst Clearly Observing, His Beautiful Feet’s Luminosity,
The Sun Became A Speck, A Star, The Moon Became Instantly

shers.roman:
Rab’bi Sal’lim Wo Id’har Kehne Lagay
Us Taraf Paar Apna Bey’ra Ho Gaya
shers.english:
On This End, When He Said, ‘O Allah Grant Them Safety!’
On That End, We Crossed Over, With Complete Security

shers.roman:
Un Ke Jalwoñ Meiñ Haiñ Ye Dil-Chaspiyaañ
Jo Wahaañ Pahuncha Waheeñ Ka Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Such Is The Pleasure, In This Glowing Luminosity,
Whoever Reaches There, Remains There Eternally

shers.roman:
Tere ‘Tukroñ Se Palay Donoñ Jahaañ
Sab Ka Us Dar Se Guzaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
From Your Sacred Morsels, Both The Worlds Attain Prosperity,
From That Blessed Threshold, Everyone Is Living Comfortably

shers.roman:
As Salaam Ay Saakinaan e Koo e Dost
Ham Bhi Aate Haiñ Jo Eema Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Salaams Upon You, O Residents of The Most Beloved’s City,
We Too Would Have Come, Upon The Authorisation of Entry

shers.roman:
Un Ke Sadqe Meiñ Azaaboñ Se Ch’hut’ay
Kaam Apna Naam Un Ka Ho Gaya
shers.english:
We Were Released From Punishment, Through His Mercy
The Actions Were Ours, But His Blessed Name, Set Us Free

shers.roman:
Sar Wahi Jo Un Ke Qadmoñ Se Laga
Dil Wahi Jo Un Pe Shaida Ho Gaya
shers.english:
A True Head Is One, Which Is Attached To His Feet, Sincerely,
A True Heart Is One, Which Is Sacrificed Upon Him, Entirely

shers.roman:
Husn e Yusuf Par Zulaikha Mit’t Gayeeñ
Aap Par Allah Pyaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Upon Yusuf’s Beauty, Zulaikha Was Captivated Totally,
You Are Indeed, The Most Beloved, To Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Us Ko Sheroñ Par Sharaf Haasil Huwa
Aap Ka Dar Ka Jo Kut’ta Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Over The Lions, He Has Indeed Attained Superiority,
The Dog Who Sits At Your Court, In Complete Loyalty

shers.roman:
Zaahidoñ Ki Khuld Par Kya Dhoom Thee
Koyi Jaane Ghar Ye Un Ka Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Such Emphasis, Some Ascetics Gave Over Paradise, Constantly,
Who Knows, If It Really Became, Their Abode Permanently!

shers.roman:
Ghol Un Ke ‘Aasiyoñ Ke Aaye Jab
Ch’hant’ Gayi Sab Bheer’ Rasta Ho Gaya
shers.english:
As The Crowd of His Sinful Slaves Arrived Promptly,
The Throngs Dispersed, The Path Was Cleared Instantly

shers.roman:
Jaa Par’a Jo Dasht e Taibah Meiñ Hasan
Gulshan e Jannat Ghar Us Ka Ho Gaya
shers.english:
To Taibah’s Desert, When Hasan Proceeded, Spontaneously,
The Holy Garden of Paradise, Became His Abode Permanently

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KAHUÑ KYA HAAL ZAAHID GULSHAN E TAIBAH KI NUZHAT KA

shers.roman:
Kahuñ Kya Haal Zaahid Gulshan e Taibah Ki Nuzhat Ka
Ke Hai Khuld e Bareeñ Ch’hota’ Sa ‘Tukr’a Meri Jannat Ka
shers.english:
O Ascetic! How Can I Describe Taibah’s Majestic Garden In Reality?
For Its Highest Heaven, Is Only A Small Part, of My Paradise In Reality

shers.roman:
Ta’aal-Allah Shaukat Tere Naam e Paak Ki Aaqa
Ke Ab Tak ‘Arsh e Aa’la Ko Hai Sakta Teri Haybat Ka
shers.english:
O My Master! To Your Sacred Name, Allah Has Granted Such Majesty,
That Until Now, Due To Your Majesty, The Exalted ‘Arsh Is In Ecstasy

shers.roman:
Wakeel Apna Kiya Hai Ahmad e Mukhtar Ko Maiñ Ne
Na Kyuñ-Kar Phir Rihaayi Meri, Mansha Ho ‘Adaalat Ka
shers.english:
I Have Engaged Ahmad e Mukhtar As My Pleader, Specifically,
So, An Order To Release Me, Why Will The Court Not Decree?

shers.roman:
Bulaate Haiñ Usi Ko Jis Ki Bigr’i Wo Banaate Haiñ
Kamar Bandhna Dayaar e Taibah Ko Khulna Hai Qismat Ka
shers.english:
He Invites Him, Whose Weak Condition, He Intends To Remedy,
Being Prepared To Journey To Taibah, Is To Unlock Your Destiny

shers.roman:
Khuleñ Islam Ki Aankheñ Huwa Saara Jahaañ Roshan
‘Arab Ke Chaand Sadqe Kya Hee Kehna Teri Tal’at Ka
shers.english:
As Islam Opened Its Eyes, The Entire World Glowed Brightly,
O Arabian Moon! Your Blessed Advent, Brought Such Luminosity

shers.roman:
Na Kar Ruswa e Mahshar, Waasta Mahboob Ka Ya Rab’b
Ye Mujrim Door Se Aaya Hai Sun Kar Naam Rahmat Ka
shers.english:
Shame Me Not On Judgment Day, I Beg You, Through Your Beloved Nabi
This Offender Has Come From Afar, After Hearing The Name of Mercy

shers.roman:
Muraadeñ Maangne Se Pehle Milti Haiñ Madina Meiñ
Hujoom e Jood Ne Roka Hai Bar’hna Dast e Haajat Ka
shers.english:
Even Before Asking In Madina, Our Requests Are Fulfilled Completely
Even Before We Raised Our Hands, We Received Your Generous Mercy

shers.roman:
Shab e Asra Tere Jalwoñ Ne Kuch Aisa Samaañ Baandha
Ke Ab Tak ‘Arsh e A’zam Muntazir Hai Teri Rukhsat Ka
shers.english:
On The Eve of Isra, Your Lustres, Created Such An Atmosphere of Ecstasy,
That The Grand ‘Arsh Is Still Awaiting Your Departure, In A State of Ecstasy

shers.roman:
Yahaañ Ke ‘Doobte Dam Meiñ Ud’har Jaa Kar Ub’harte Haiñ
Kinaara Aik Hai Bahr e Nadaamat Bahr e Rahmat Ka
shers.english:
Those Who Already Drowned Here, Proceed To Exit There Immediately,
One, Is The Shore, For The Ocean of Repentance, And The Ocean of Mercy

shers.roman:
Ghani Hai Dil, Bhara Hai Ne’mat e Kaunain Se Daaman
Gada Huñ Maiñ Faqeer e Aastaan e Khud Ba-Daulat Ka
shers.english:
The Lap Is Filled With The Bounties of Both Worlds, The Heart Is Wealthy,
I Am A Slave of Him, Who Is A Mendicant, At The Grand Court of My Nabi

shers.roman:
Tawaaf e Rauza e Maula Pe Na-Waaqif Bigar’te Hai
‘Aqeeda Awr Hee Kuch Hai Adab Daan e Muhab’bat Ka
shers.english:
When I Circle The Rauza of My King, The Ignorant Are Filled With Fury,
The Creed of Him, Who Knows The Language of Love, Is Distinct, Surely

shers.roman:
Khizaan e Gham Se Rakna Door Mujh Ko Us Ke Sadqe Meiñ
Jo Gul Ay Baagh-Baañ Hai ‘Itr Tere Baagh e San’at Se
shers.english:
Save Me From Withering In Grief, Through That Noble Personality,
That Rose, Who Is The Spirit of Your Garden of Creation, O Almighty!

shers.roman:
Ilaahi Ba’ad e Murdan Pardahaaye Haa-il U’th Jaayeñ
Ujaala Mere Marqad Meiñ Ho Un Ki Sham’e Turbat Ka
shers.english:
After I Die, May All The Hindering Veils Be Raised, O Allah Almighty!
By The Lamp of His Shrine’s Radiance, May My Grave Glow Brightly

shers.roman:
Suna Hai Roz e Mahshar Aap Hee Ka Muñh Takeñge Sab
Yahaañ Poora Huwa Matlab Dil e Mushtaaq e Ru’yat Ka
shers.english:
I Have Heard That On Resurrection Day, All Will Gaze At Your Face Only,
The Aim of The Heart, Which Yearns To See You, Is Met Here Perfectly

shers.roman:
Wujoob e Paak Baa’is Khilqat e Makhlooq Ka ‘Tehra
Tumhaari Shaan e Wahdat Se Huwa Iz’haar Kasrat Ka
shers.english:
Your Pure Existence Is The Reason, For Creating The Creation, Surely,
Through Your Grandeur of Singularity, Was Revealed This Plurality

shers.roman:
Hameñ Bhi Yaad Rakhna Saakinaan e Koocha e Jaanaañ
Salaam e Shauq Pahunche Bekasaan e Dasht e Ghurbat Ka
shers.english:
Remember Us As Well, O Residents of The Beloved’s Sacred City!
May The Pure Salaams of The Helpless Foreigners, Reach His Holy City

shers.roman:
Hasan Sarkaar e Taibah Ka ‘Ajab Darbaar e ‘Aali Hai
Dar e Daulat Pe Ik Mela Laga Hai Ahl e Haajat Ka
shers.english:
O Hasan! The Court of The King of Taibah, Is Amazing, Most Certainly,
At His Majestic Gate, A Crowd of Mendicants Is Waiting, Ardently

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TASAW’WUR LUTF DETA HAI DAHAAN E PAAK E SARWAR KA

shers.roman:
Tasaw’wur Lutf Deta Hai Dahaan e Paak e Sarwar Ka
Bhara Aata Hai Paani Mere Muñh Meiñ Hauz e Kawthar Ka
shers.english:
Such Happiness, The Thought of My Nabi’s Sacred Mouth Is Inviting,
That In My Mouth, Starts Flowing, The Water From Kawthar’s Spring

shers.roman:
Jo Kuch Bhi Wasf Ho Un Ke Jamaal e Zar’ra Parwar Ka
Mere Diwaan Ka Matla’ Ho Matla’ Mahr e Anwar Ka
shers.english:
Whatever Traits of His Speck Enhancing Beauty, We Are Praising,
May My Poem’s Opening Verse, Be The Dawn of The Sun’s Shining

shers.roman:
Mujhe Bhi Dekhna Hai Hausla Khursheed e Mahshar Ka
Liye Jaawuñga Ch’hota Sa Koyi Zar’ra Tere Dar Ka
shers.english:
To See The Sun’s Spirit On Judgement Day, I Too Am Waiting,
Only A Tiny Particle, From Your Grand Court, I Will Be Bringing

shers.roman:
Jo Ik Gosha Chamak Jaaye Tumhaare Zar’ra e Dar Ka
Abhi Muñh Dekhta Rah Jaaye Aa-ina Sikandar Ka
shers.english:
If Only A Spot, From A Speck of Your Grand Gate, Starts Glowing,
In Complete Awe, At It, The Mirror of Alexander Will Be Staring

shers.roman:
Agar Jalwa Nazar Aaye Kaf e Paa e Munawwar Ka
Zara Sa Muñh Nikal Aaye Abhi Khursheed e Mahshar Ka
shers.english:
If The Lustres of His Radiant Foot’s Sole, Were To Be Appearing,
Judgement Day’s Sun Will Barely Appear, Its Face, It Will Be Hiding

shers.roman:
Agar Dam Bhar Tasaw’wur Kijiye Shaan e Payambar Ka
Zabaañ Par Shor Ho Be-Saakhta Allahu Akbar Ka
shers.english:
Even For A Moment, If The Nabi’s Grandeur You Are Visualising
‘Allahu Akbar’ Aloud, The Tongue Will Be Ecstatically Proclaiming

shers.roman:
Ujaala Toor Ka Dekheñ Jamaal e Jaañ Fiza Dekheñ
Kaleem Aa Kar Ut’ha Dekheñ Zara Parda Tere Dar Ka
shers.english:
He Saw The Radiance At Toor, Now To See Your Beauty, Invigorating!
The Holy Veil Over Your Grand Gate, The Kaleem Should Now Be Lifting

shers.roman:
Do ‘Aalam Mehmaañ Tu Mezbaañ Khwaan e Karam Jaari
Id’har Bhi Koyi ‘Tukr’a, Maiñ Bhi Kut’ta Huñ Tere Dar Ka
shers.english:
Both Worlds Are Guests, You Are That Host, Whose Bounty Is Flowing,
I Am A Dog At Your Sacred Gate, Even A Single Morsel I Am Deserving

shers.roman:
Na Ghar Bayt’hay Milay Johar Safa o Khaaksaari Ke
Mureed e Zar’ra e Taibah Hai Aa-ina Sikandar Ka
shers.english:
Sitting At Home, The Gems of Piety And Humility, You Won’t Be Getting,
A Devotee of Taibah’s Speck, More Than Alexander’s Mirror, Is Glowing

shers.roman:
Agar Us Khanda e Dandaañ Numa Ka Wasf Mauzooñ Ho
Abhi Lehra Chalay Bahr e Sukhan Se Chashma Gohar Ka
shers.english:
If His Most Beautiful Wide Smile, I Had To Be Truly Praising,
From The Ocean of Poetry, A Fountain of Gems Will Be Surging

shers.roman:
Tere Daaman Ka Saaya Awr Daaman Kitne Pyaare Haiñ
Wo Saaya Dasht e Mahshar Ka, Ye Haami Deeda e Tar Ka
shers.english:
Beneath Your Blessed Shade, All The Other Mantles Look So Stunning,
Reckoning Day’s Shade, They Are Being, Weeping Eyes He Is Comforting

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Koocha o Marqad Ke Zaa-ir Ko Muyassar Hai
Nazaara Baagh e Jannat Ka, Tamaasha ‘Arsh e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
This Privilege, The One Who Visits Your City And Shrine, Is Getting,
Heaven’s Garden & The Ecstasy of The Grand Arsh, He Is Witnessing

shers.roman:
Gunahgaaraan e Ummat Un Ke Daaman Par Machalte Hoñ
Ilaahi Chaak Ho Jis Dam Girebaañ Subh e Mahshar Ka
shers.english:
Embracing His Mantle, The Sinners of The Ummat Will Be Weeping,
O Allah! When Morning Breaks Through, On The Day of Reckoning

shers.roman:
Malaa’ik Jinn o Insaañ Sab Usi Dar Ke Salaami Haiñ
Do ‘Aalam Meiñ Hai Ik Shohra Mere Muhtaaj Parwar Ka
shers.english:
At That Grand Gate, The Angels, Jinns And Humans Are Saluting,
Renowned In Both The Worlds, My Benefactor’s Generosity Is Being

shers.roman:
Ilaahi! Tishna Kaam e Hijr Dekha Dasht e Mahshar Meiñ
Barasna Abr e Rahmat Ka Ch’halakna Hauz e Kawthar Ka
shers.english:
O Allah! I Saw Those Yearning With Thirst, On The Plains of Reckoning
I Saw The Clouds of Mercy Pour, And The Pond of Kawthar Overflowing

shers.roman:
Ziyaarat Meiñ Karuñ Awr Wo Shafa’at Meri Farmaayeñ
Mujhe Hangaama e ‘Eidain Ya Rab’b, Din Ho Mahshar Ka
shers.english:
When I Am Blessed To See Him, Whilst For Me, He Is Interceding,
O Allah! Judgement Day For Me, Will Be Like On Both Eids’ Rejoicing

shers.roman:
Naseeb e Dostaañ Un Ki Gali Meiñ Gar Sukoonat Ho
Mujhe Ho Maghfirat Ka Silsila Har Taar Bistar Ka
shers.english:
It Will Be The Destiny of Friends, If Residence In His Lane I Am Getting,
For Every Thread of My Bedding, The Chain of Mercy, May I Be Attaining

shers.roman:
Wo Girya Ustun e Han’naanah Ka Aankhoñ Meiñ Phirta Hai
Huzoori Ne Bar’haaya Tha Jo Paaya Awj e Mimbar Ka
shers.english:
In My Eyes, The Profound Weeping of The Han’naana Pillar Is Revolving,
Due To Its Sincere Service, The Zenith of The Mimbar It Was Surpassing

shers.roman:
Hamesha Rahrawaan e Taibah Ke Zer e Qadam Aaye
Ilaahi Kuch To Ho E’zaaz Mere Kaasa e Sar Ka
shers.english:
Beneath The Feet of Taibah’s Pilgrims, May It Always Be Resting,
O Allah! Such Honour, May My Head’s Begging Bowl, Be Attaining

shers.roman:
Sahaara Kuch Na Kuch Rakhta Hai Har Fard e Bashar Apna
Kisi Ko Neyk Kaamoñ Ka, Hasan Ko Apne Yaawar Ka
shers.english:
To Some Form of Support, Every Human Being Is Firmly Holding,
Some Rely On Good Actions, Upon His Guardian, Hasan Is Relying

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: MUJRIM E HAYBAT-ZADA JAB FARD E ‘ISYAAÑ LE CHALA

shers.roman:
Mujrim e Haybat-Zada Jab Fard e ‘Isyaañ Le Chala
Lutf e Shah Taskeen Deta Pesh Yazdaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Carrying His Book of Sins, As The Offender Proceeded, Apprehensively
Reassuring Him, The King’s Generosity, Took Him Before The Almighty

shers.roman:
Dil Ke Aa-ina Meiñ Jo Tasweer e Jaanaañ Le Chala
Mehfil e Jannat Ki Aara-ish Ka Saamaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
The One Who Carried In His Heart, The Reflection of The Beloved Nabi,
He Has Carried The Adorning Provisions, For The Heavenly Assembly

shers.roman:
Rahraw e Jannat Ko Taibah Ka Bayaabaañ Le Chala
Daaman e Dil Kheeñchta Khaar e Mugheelañ Le Chala
shers.english:
The Heavenly Traveller Was Captivated, By Taibah’s Desert, Entirely,
Penetrating His Entire Heart, The Acacia Thorn, Attracted It Subtly

shers.roman:
Gul Na Ho Jaaye Charaagh e Zeenat e Gulshan Kahiñ
Apne Sar Meiñ, Maiñ Hawa e Dasht e Jaanaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Let Not The Lamp of The Garden’s Beauty, Be Extinguished Entirely,
I Am Carrying In My Head, The Desert Breeze of My Beloved Nabi

shers.roman:
Roo e ‘Aalam Taab Ne Baant’a Jo Baar’a Noor Ka
Maah e Nau Kashti Meiñ Pyaala Mahr e Taabaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
When The World Illuminating Face, Spread Its Offerings of Luminosity,
The Crescent Carried In The Ship, The Goblet of The Sun, Shining Brightly

shers.roman:
Go Nahiñ Rakhte Zamaana Ki Wo Daulat Apne Paas
Par Zamaana Ne’matoñ Se Bhar Ke Daamaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Although For Himself, He Keeps Not The World’s Wealth, Absolutely,
But The World, Has Taken With It, Blessings Which Are Indeed Plenty

shers.roman:
Teri Haybat Se Mila Taaj e Salaateeñ Khaak Meiñ
Teri Rahmat Se Gada Takht e Sulaimaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
The Crowns of Kings Were Reduced To Dust, Due To Your Majesty
A Mendicant Carried Away, The Throne of Sulaiman, By Your Mercy

shers.roman:
Aisi Shaukat Par Ke Ur’ta Hai Pharera ‘Arsh Par
Jis Gada Ne Aarazu Ki Un Ko Mehmaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Such Is Your Grandeur, Your Banner Flies Over The Arsh, Honourably,
Whichever of Your Slaves Wished, As A Guest, You Took Him Willingly

shers.roman:
Dabdaba Kis Se Bayaañ Ho Un Ke Naam e Paak Ka
Sher Ke Muñh Se Salaamat Jaan e Salmaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
To Whom Can I Really Explain, His Sacred Name’s True Majesty,
From The Lion’s Mouth, It Transported Salmaan’s Soul To Safety

shers.roman:
Sadqa Us Rahmat Ke Un Ko Roz e Mahshar Har Taraf
Na-Shikeba Shor e Faryaad e Aseerañ Le Chala
shers.english:
In Every Direction, On The Day of Reckoning, Such Will Be His Mercy,
Towards The Echoes of The Sinner’s Pleas, He Will Go With Urgency

shers.roman:
Saaz o Saamaan e Gada e Koo e Sarwar Kya Kahuñ
Us Ka Mangta Sarwari Ke Saaz o Samaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
What Can I Say About The Provisions, of The Beggar of The King’s City?
His Mendicant Proceeded, Carrying The Provisions of True Royalty

shers.roman:
Do Qadam Bhi Chal Na Sakte Ham Sar e Shamsheer e Tez
Haath Pakr’ay Rab’bi Sal’lim Ka Nigahbaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Not Even Two Steps We Could Take, Over The Sharp Sword’s Extremity
But The Guardian of ‘O Allah! Grant Them Safety’ Guided Us Over Safely

shers.roman:
Dastgeer e Khasta Haalaañ Dastgeeri Kijiye
Paaoñ Meiñ Ra’sha Hai Sar Par Baar e ‘Isyaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
O Saviour of The Distressed! Grant Me Your Special Aid Immediately,
With Shaky Legs, And A Burden of Sins On My Head, I Tread Anxiously

shers.roman:
Waqt e Aakhir Na Umeedi Meiñ Wo Soorat Dekh Kar
Dil Shikasta Dil Ke Har Paarah Meiñ Qur’aañ Le Chala
shers.english:
After Losing Hope In My Final Moments, When That Holy Face I Did See,
In Every Piece of My Broken-Heart, I Took Along The Qur’an, Blissfully

shers.roman:
Qaidiyoñ Ki Jumbish e Abru Se Beyr’i Kaat’ Do
Warna Jurmoñ Ka Tasalsul Soo e Zindaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
By Merely Raising Your Eyebrows, Snap The Prisoner’s Shackles Entirely,
Or Else The Cycle of Our Sins, Will Again Incarcerate Us, Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Roz e Mahshar Shaad Hoñ ‘Aasi Ke Pesh e Kibriya
Rahm Un Ko Ummati Goyaañ o Giryaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
On Judgement Day, The Sinner Will Be Elated, For Before The Almighty,
Due To Him Pleading On The Sinner’s Behalf, He Will Be Shown Mercy

shers.roman:
Shakl e Shabnam Raatoñ Ka Rona Tera Abr e Karam
Subh e Mahshar Soorat e Gul Ham Ko Khandaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Your Weeping At Night, Took The Form of Dewdrops, O Cloud of Mercy!
On Judgement Day, Seeing Your Rosy Face, Will Please Us Immensely

shers.roman:
Kushtgaan e Naaz Ki Qismat Ke Sadqe Jaaiye
Un Ko Maqtal Meiñ Tamaasha e Shaheedaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Upon The Destiny of Those Martyred In True Love, Sacrificed May I Be,
Into The Battlefield, The Pleasure of Martyrdom, Took Them Discreetly

shers.roman:
Akhtar e Islam Chamka, Kufr Ki Zulmat Chañt’i
Badr Meiñ Jab Wo Hilaal e Taygh e Bur’raañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Rupturing The Darkness of Unbelief, The Star of Islam Shone Brightly,
When In Badr, The Crescent of That Sharp Sword, Cut Through Precisely

shers.roman:
Bazm e Khoobaañ Ko Khuda Ne Pehle Di Araa-isheñ
Phir Mere Dulha Ko Soo e Bazm e Khoobaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
The Assembly of The Beloveds, Was First Adorned By Allah Almighty,
Thereafter, My Groom Was Taken, Towards The Beloveds’ Assembly

shers.roman:
Allah, Allah! Sarsar e Taibah Ki Rang Aameziyaañ
Har Bagula Nuzhat e Sarw e Gulistaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Allah! Allah! The Desert Storm of Taibah, Exhibits Such Variability!
The Delight of The Garden’s Stature, Every Whirlwind Does Carry

shers.roman:
Ghamzadoñ Ko Jab Shafa’at Ne Kiya Ummeed-Waar
Afw Khush-Khabri Sunaata, Pesh e Yazdaan Le Chala
shers.english:
When Intercession Gave Hope, To Those Facing Immense Anxiety,
Giving Them Glad-Tidings, ‘Pardon’ Took Them, Before The Almighty

shers.roman:
Qatrah, Qatrah, Un Ke Ghar Se Bahr e ‘Irfaañ Ho Gaya
Zar’ra-Zar’ra, Un Ke Dar Se Mahr e Taabaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
Every Drop, From His Sacred Home, Became An Ocean of Spirituality,
Every Particle, From His Threshold, Became A Sun, Shining Brightly

shers.roman:
Subh e Mahshar Har Ada e ‘Aariz e Roshan Meiñ Wo
Sham’e Noor Afshaañ Pa-e Shaam e Ghareebaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
On Judgment Day, With Each Motion, of His Cheeks Which Glow Brightly,
The Illuminating Lamp, Eliminated The Darkness of Misfortunes Instantly

shers.roman:
Shaafa’e Roz e Qiyaamat Ka Huñ Adna Ummati
Phir Hasan Kya Gham Agar Maiñ Baar e ‘Isyaañ Le Chala
shers.english:
I Belong To The Intercessor of Judgement Day, I Am His Humble Ummati,
Then, If I Took A Burden of Sins, O Hasan! Why Is There Such Anxiety?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: QIBLA KA BHI KAA’BA RUKH E NEEKO NAZAR AAYA

shers.roman:
Qibla Ka Bhi Kaa’ba Rukh e Neeko Nazar Aaya
Kaa’ba Ka Bhi Qibla, Kham e Abru Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Even As The Kaa’ba of The Qibla, His Most Beautiful Face, Is Appearing
Even As The Qibla of The Kaa’ba, His Arched Eyebrows, Are Appearing

shers.roman:
