Mahshar Meiñ Kisi Ne Bhi Meri Baat Na Poochi
Haami Nazar Aaya To Bus Ik Tu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
None Gave Any Attention To Me, On The Day of Reckoning,
When A Protector Came In Sight, Then Only You, I Was Seeing

shers.roman:
Phir Band e Kashakash Meiñ Giriftaar Na Dekhe
Jab Mu’jaza e Jumbish e Abru Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Again, Incarcerated By Perplexities, You Will Not See Me Being,
When I Observe The Miracle, of His Sacred Eyebrows Gesturing

shers.roman:
Us Dil Ke Fida Jo Hai Teri Deed Ki Taalib
Un Aankhoñ Ke Qurbaan Jinheñ Tu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Upon That Heart Which Seeks Your Vision, Sacrificed I Am Being,
Upon Those Eyes Which Have Seen You, Sacrificed I Am Being

shers.roman:
Sultaan o Gada Sab Haiñ Tere Dar Ke Bhikaari
Har Haath Meiñ Darwaaze Ka Baazu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
As Beggars At Your Court, Kings And Mendicants, Are Coming,
To The Door Frame of Your Court, Every Hand, Is Seen Grasping

shers.roman:
Sajdah Ko Jhuka Jaaye Baraheem Meiñ Kaa’ba
Jab Qibla e Kaunain Ka Abru Nazar Aaye
shers.english:
At The Sacred Station of Ibrahim, The Kaa’ba Fell Prostrating,
When The Eyebrows of The Qibla of The Universe, It Was Seeing

shers.roman:
Bazaar e Qiyaamat Meiñ Jinheñ Koyi Na Pooche
Aisoñ Ka Khareedaar Hameñ Tu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Those Who Are Totally Ignored, In The Market Place of Reckoning,
As The Purchaser of Such People, We Only Saw You Appearing

shers.roman:
Mahshar Meiñ Gunahgaar Ka Pal’la Huwa Bhaari
Pal’la Pe Jo Wo Qurb e Taraazu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
The Scale-Pan of The Sinner, Weighed Heavy On The Day of Reckoning,
At The Scale-Pan, And Near The Scale, When He Was Seen Approaching

shers.roman:
Ya Dekhne Waala Tha Tera, Ya Tera Jooya
Jo Ham Ko Khuda-Been o Khuda Joo Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Either He Was Someone Who Already Saw You, Or You, He Was Seeking,
To Us, He Looked Like One Who Saw Allah, Or Allah, He Was Seeking

shers.roman:
Shal Haath Salaateeñ Ke U’thay Bahr e Gadaayi
Darwazah Tera Quw’wat e Baazu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
The Monarchs Raised Their Frozen Hands, To Be Begging,
Seen As Their Arm’s Strength, Your Grand Door Was Being

shers.roman:
Yusuf Se Haseeñ Awr Taman’na e Nazaarah
‘Aalam Meiñ Na Tum Sa Koyi Khush Roo Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Someone As Attractive As Yusuf, Yet To See You, He Is Yearning!
As Attractive As You Are, None In The Universe, Was Ever Seeing

shers.roman:
Faryaad e Ghareebaañ Se Hai Mahshar Meiñ Wo Be-Chain
Kawthar Pe Tha Ya Qurb e Taraazu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Upon The Pleas of The Deprived, He Is Restless On The Day of Reckoning,
He Was Either Seen At Kawthar, Or Near The Scale He Was Seen Standing

shers.roman:
Takleef U’tha Kar Bhi Dua Maangi ‘Adu Ki
Khush Khulq Na Aisa, Koyi Khush Khoo Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
Even Though He Was Persecuted, For His Enemies, He Was Supplicating,
A Polite And Good Natured One Like Him, None Other We Are Seeing

shers.roman:
Zaahir Haiñ Hasan Ahmad e Mukhtar Ke Maa’na
Kaunain Pe Sarkaar Ka Qaabu Nazar Aaya
shers.english:
O Hasan! Very Obvious, The Meaning of Ahmad e Mukhtar Is Being,
Over Both The Worlds, My Master’s Authority, We Are All Witnessing

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AISA TUJHE KHAALIQ NE TARH-DAAR BANAAYA

shers.roman:
Aisa Tujhe Khaaliq Ne Tarh-Daar Banaaya
Yusuf Ko Tera Taalib e Deedaar Banaaya
shers.english:
So Uniquely Handsome, By Your Creator, You Were Created,
As An Admirer, Yearning To See You, Hazrat Yusuf He Created

shers.roman:
Tal’at Se Zamaane Ko Pur-Anwaar Banaaya
Nik’hat Se Gali Koochoñ Ko Gulzaar Banaaya
shers.english:
By Your Appearance, He Caused The Entire Era To Be Illuminated,
By Your Fragrance, He Turned Every Street, Into A Garden, Scented

shers.roman:
Deewaaroñ Ko Aa-ina Banaate Haiñ Wo Jalwe
Aa-inoñ Ko Jinn Jalwaoñ Ne Deewaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Those Rays, Which Caused Walls, To Become Mirrors, Illuminated,
By Those Same Rays, The Mirrors, Became Walls, Illuminated

shers.roman:
Wo Jins Kya Jis Ne Jisay Koyi Na Pooche
Us Ne Hee Mera Tujh Ko Khareedaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Of What Value Is An Article, Which All Have Rejected?
Yet, As My Purchaser, It Is You, Whom He Has Selected

shers.roman:
Ay Nazm e Risaalat Ke Chamakte Huwe Maqte’
Tu Ne Hee Usay Matla’ e Anwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
O Closing Couplets of The Prophetic Poems, Brightly Illuminated,
It Is You, Who Crafted It, Into The Introductory Source, Illuminated

shers.roman:
Kaunain Banaaye Gaye Sarkaar Ki Khaatir
Kaunain Ki Khaatir, Tujhe Sarkaar Banaaya
shers.english:
In The Honour of My Noble Master, Both The Worlds Were Created,
To Grant Honour To Both The Worlds, My Noble Master Was Created

shers.roman:
Kunji Tumheñ Di Apne Khazaanoñ Ki Khuda Ne
Mahboob Kiya Maalik o Mukhtar Banaaya
shers.english:
To You, The Keys To His Majestic Treasures, Allah Almighty Granted
As His Most Beloved, And The Duly Authorised, You He Appointed

shers.roman:
Allah Ki Rahmat Hai Ke Aise Ki Ye Qismat
‘Aasi Ka Tumheñ Haami o Gham-Khwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
It Is Allah’s Mercy, That To One Like Me, Such Good Fortune Was Granted
For A Sinner Like Me, As A Protector And Consoler, You Were Appointed

shers.roman:
Aa-ina e Zaat e Ahadi Aap Hee ‘Tehray
Wo Husn Diya Aisa, Tarh-Daar Banaaya
shers.english:
As The Manifestation of The One Creator, You Alone Were Created,
He Made You Completely Peerless, Such Beauty, You Were Granted

shers.roman:
Anwaar e Tajal’li Se Kuch Hayrateñ Ch’haayeeñ
Sab Aa-inoñ Ko Pusht Ba-Deewaar Banaaya
shers.english:
From The Radiance of His Light, Such Splendours Emanated
That All The Mirrors Were Left, Completely Flabbergasted

shers.roman:
‘Aalam Ke Salaateeñ Bhikaari Hai Bhikaari!
Sarkaar Banaaya Hai, Tumheñ Sarkaar Banaaya
shers.english:
As Beggars Indeed, The Kings of The World Were Presented
The Master You Were Made; As The Master You Were Created

shers.roman:
Gulzaar Ko Aa-ina Kiya Muñh Ki Chamak Ne
Aa-ina Ko Rukhsaar Ne Gulzaar Banaaya
shers.english:
By The Light of His Face, Into A Mirror, The Rose Garden Was Converted
While His Cheeks Transformed The Mirror, Into A Rose Garden, Scented

shers.roman:
Ye Laz’zat e Pa-Bos Ke Phat’tar Ne Jigar Meiñ
Naqsh e Qadam e Sayyid e Abraar Banaaya
shers.english:
As It Kissed His Sacred Feet, The Rock Was Totally Invigorated
The Footprint of The Most Virtuous, In Its Heart, It Implanted

shers.roman:
Khud’daam To Bande Haiñ, Tere Khulq e Hasan Ne,
Pyaare! Tujhe Bad-Khwaah Ka Gham-Khwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Your Servants Are Your Slaves, But Your Character, Is So Exalted,
O Beloved! Even To The Malicious, As A Consoler, You Were Created

shers.roman:
Be Parda Wo Jab Khaak Nasheenoñ Meiñ Nikal Aaye
Har Zar’ra Ko Khursheed e Pur-Anwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
When He Appeared Unveiled, Amongst Those Who Were Rejected,
He Transformed Every Speck, Into A Sun, Completely Illuminated

shers.roman:
Ay Maah e ‘Arab Mahr e ‘Ajam, Maiñ Tere Sadqe
Zulmat Ne Mere Din Ko Shab e Taar Banaaya
shers.english:
O Moon of Arabia! O Sun of Persia! To You I Am Wholly Devoted,
Into A Dark Night, By Oppression, My Day Has Been Converted

shers.roman:
Lillah Karam! Mere Bhi Weeraana e Dil Par
Sahra Ko Tere Husn Ne Gulzaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Have Mercy, For Allah’s Sake, Upon My Heart, Which Is Isolated,
Your Beauty Transformed A Desert, Into A Garden, Sweetly Scented

shers.roman:
Allah Ta’aala Bhi Huwa Us Ka Tarafdaar
Sarkaar Tumheñ, Jis Ne Tarafdaar Banaaya
shers.english:
By Allah Almighty, He Too Was Aided And Protected,
He, Who Made You His Guardian, O My Master Exalted!

shers.roman:
Gulzaar e Jinaañ Tere Liye Haq Ne Banaaya
Apne Liye Tera Gul e Rukhsaar Banaaya
shers.english:
The Heavenly Gardens, For You, Almighty Allah Created,
For Himself, Your Rosy Face, Allah Almighty Created

shers.roman:
Be Yaar o Madadgaar Jinheñ Koyi Na Pooche
Aisoñ Ka Tujhe Yaar o Madadgaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Without Any Friends And Helpers, Those Who Are Rejected,
As The Aid And Ally of Such People, You Were Appointed

shers.roman:
Har Baat Bad-A’maaliyoñ Se Maiñ Ne Bigaar’i
Awr Tum Ne Meri Bigr’i Ko Har Baar Banaaya
shers.english:
Due To My Wrongdoings, All My Matters Were Distorted,
Yet, Whenever I Faced Such Turmoil, By You, I Was Assisted

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dur e Dandaañ Ka Wo Sadqa Tha Jis Ne
Har Qatra e Naisaañ Dur e Shahwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
It Was By The Blessing of Your Pearl Glowing Teeth, So Illuminated,
Into A Pearl Fit For Kings, Every Drop of Spring Rain, Your Converted

shers.roman:
Us Jalwa e Rangeeñ Ka Tasad’duq Tha, Ke Jis Ne
Firdaus Ke Har Takhta Ko Gulzaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Through Those Colourful Glimmers, Which Were Being Distributed,
Into An Entire Garden, Every Heavenly Flowerbed, Was Converted

shers.roman:
Us Rooh e Mujas’sam Ke Tabar’ruk Ne Maseeha
Jaañ Bakhsh Tumheñ Yuñ Dam e Guftaar Banaaya
shers.english:
O Messiah! It Was The Blessing of That Soul, Absolutely Perfected,
Which Granted Your Life, And (In Your Cradle), You Communicated

shers.roman:
Us Chehra e Pur-Noor Ki Wo Bheek Thee Jis Ne
Mahr o Mah o Anjum Ko Pur Anwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
It Was The Benevolence of That Holy Face, So Brightly Illuminated,
By Which The Sun, The Moon, And All The Stars, Were Illuminated

shers.roman:
Un Haathoñ Ka Jalwa Tha Ye, Ay Hazrat e Moosa!
Jis Ne Yad e Baiza Ko Ziya-Baar Banaaya
shers.english:
O Hazrat Moosa! It Was The Radiance of Those Hands, So Illuminated,
Which Caused Your Luminous Hand, To Glow, Completely Illuminated

shers.roman:
Un Ke Lab e Rangeeñ Ke Nichaawar Thee Wo Jis Ne
Phat’tar Meiñ Hasan, La’al e Pur Anwaar Banaaya
shers.english:
Upon His Sacred Rosy Lips, It Was Sacrificed, Entirely Devoted,
O Hasan! In A Rock, A Luminous Red Gem, Which Was Created

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TUMHAARA NAAM MUSIBAT MEIÑ JAB LIYA HOGA

shers.roman:
Tumhaara Naam Musibat Meiñ Jab Liya Hoga
Hamaara Bigr’a Huwa Kaam Ban Gaya Hoga
shers.english:
In Troubled Times, When Your Sacred Name, We Would Be Taking,
Completely Resolved, All Our Impaired Matters, Were Becoming

shers.roman:
Gunahgaar Pe Jab Lutf Aap Ka Hoga
Kiya Baghair Kiya, Be Kiya, Kiya Hoga
shers.english:
When Upon The Sinner, Your Kindness, You Were Showering,
Everything Transpired Smoothly, Without Really Doing Anything

shers.roman:
Khuda Ka Lutf Huwa Hoga Dastgeer Zaroor
Jo Girte, Girte, Tera Naam Liya Hoga
shers.english:
The Divine Grace of Allah Almighty, Would Surely Be Aiding,
The One, Who Took Your Sacred Name, Whilst He Was Falling

shers.roman:
Dikhaayi Jaayegi Mahshar Meiñ Shaan e Mahboobi
Ke Aap Hee Ki Khushi Aap Ka Kaha Hoga
shers.english:
The Beloved’s Grandeur Will Be Revealed, On The Day of Reckoning,
For Only His Pleasure, And His Command, Will Truly Be Prevailing

shers.roman:
Khuda e Paak Ki Chaaheñge Agle Pichle Khushi
Khuda e Paak Khushi Un Ka Chaahta Hoga
shers.english:
To Attain Allah’s Pleasure, The Former And Latter Will Be Yearning,
Yet For Him To Be Absolutely Pleased, Almighty Allah Is Willing

shers.roman:
Kisi Ke Paaoñ Ki Beyr’i Ye Kaat’te Hoñge
Koyi Aseer e Gham Un Ko Pukaarta Hoga
shers.english:
Whilst The Leg Shackles of Someone, He Will Be Cutting
Someone Else, Afflicted By Grief, To Him, Will Be Calling

shers.roman:
Kisi Taraf Se Sada Aayegi, Huzoor Aawo!
Nahiñ To Dam Meiñ Ghareeboñ Ka Faisla Hoga
shers.english:
O My Master, Please Do Come! From One Direction, Will Be Echoing
Or Else, The Judgement Against The Helpless, Will Now Be Happening

shers.roman:
Kisi Ke Pal’lay Pe Ye Hoñge Waqt e Wazn e ‘Amal
Koyi Um’meed Se Muñh Un Ka Tak Raha Hoga
shers.english:
At The Scale Pan of Someone, He Will Be, During The Weighing,
Whilst In Hope, Towards His Face, Someone Else Will Be Gazing

shers.roman:
Koyi Kahega Duhaayi Hai Ya Rasool’Allah!
To Koyi Thaam Ke Daaman Machal Raha Hoga
shers.english:
Someone Will Say, Ya Rasool’Allah! Your Special Aid I Am Seeking,
Whilst Someone Else Will Hold Onto His Robes, Tearfully Supplicating

shers.roman:
Kisi Ko Le Ke Chaleñge Farishtay Soo e Jaheem
Wo Un Ka Raasta Phir, Phir, Ke Dekhta Hoga
shers.english:
When Towards Hell-Fire, Someone, The Angels Will Be Taking,
Constantly Turning Around, His Arrival, He Will Be Expecting

shers.roman:
Shikasta Paa Huñ Mere Haal Ki Khabar Kar Do
Koyi Kisi Se Ye Ro-Ro Ke Keh Raha Hoga
shers.english:
Inform Him of My Condition, Totally Helpless I Am Being,
Whilst Weeping; To Someone, Someone Else Will Be Saying

shers.roman:
Khuda Ke Waaste Jald Un Se ‘Arz e Haal Karo
Kisay Khabar Hai Ke Dam Bhar Meiñ Haaye Kya Hoga
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake! Swiftly Inform Him, About What I Am Facing,
What Will Happen In A Moment; Alas! None Is Really Knowing

shers.roman:
Pakar’ Ke Haath Koyi Haal e Dil Sunaayega
To Ro Ke Qadmoñ Se Koyi Lipat’ Gaya Hoga
shers.english:
Whilst Holding His Hand, His Heart’s Grief, Someone Will Be Stating,
Whilst Already Clinging To His Feet, Someone Else Will Be Weeping

shers.roman:
Zabaan Sookhi Dikha Kar Koyi Lab e Kawthar
Janaab e Paak Ke Qadmoñ Pe Gir Gaya Hoga
shers.english:
Whilst His Parched Tongue, At Kawthar’s Edge, Someone Is Showing,
Upon The Sacred Feet of The Beloved Nabi, He Will Be Seen Falling

shers.roman:
Nishaan e Khusru e Deeñ Dawr Ke Ghulaamoñ Ko
Liwa e Hamd Ka Parcham Bata Raha Hoga
shers.english:
The Sign of The King of The Deen, Whilst Towards His Slaves Running,
All of Them, Towards The Grand Flag of Praise, It Will Be Directing

shers.roman:
Koyi Qareeb e Taraazu, Koyi Lab e Kawthar
Koyi Siraat Par Un Ko Pukaarta Hoga
shers.english:
Near The Scale, One Will Call, At Kawthar’s Edge, Another Will Be Calling,
Whilst Upon The Bridge of Siraat, To Him, Someone Else, Will Be Calling

shers.roman:
Ye Be Qaraar Karegi Sada Ghareeboñ Ki
Muqad’das Aankhoñ Se Taar Ashk Ka Bandha Hoga
shers.english:
Upon The Pleas of The Helpless Ones, Restless He Will Be Feeling,
From His Sacred Eyes, A String of Tears, Will Be Constantly Flowing

shers.roman:
Wo Paak Dil, Ke Nahiñ Jis Ko Apna Andesha
Hujoom e Fikr o Tarad’dud Meiñ Ghir Gaya Hoga
shers.english:
That Pure Hearted One He Is, Even About Himself, He Is Not Caring,
Totally Absorbed In Our Condition, And In Our Well-Being, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Hazaar Jaan Fida Narm, Narm, Paaoñ Se
Pukaar Sun Ke Aseeroñ Ki Daur’ta Hoga
shers.english:
Upon His Soft And Gentle Feet, A Thousand Lives May We Be Sacrificing,
On Hearing The Pleas of The Helpless, Upon Them, He Will Come Running

shers.roman:
‘Azeez Bach’cha Ko Maañ Jis Tarah Talaash Kare
Khuda Gawah Yahi Haal Aap Ka Hoga
shers.english:
Like For Her Most Beloved Child, A Mother Is Seen Searching,
Allah Is Witness! In This Troubled State, He, Will Be Appearing

shers.roman:
Khudaayi Bhar Inheeñ Haathoñ Ko Dekhti Hogi
Zamaana Bhar Inheeñ Qadmoñ Pe Laut’ta Hoga
shers.english:
Towards His Sacred Hands, The Entire Creation Will Be Looking,
Towards His Sacred Feet, The Entire Creation, Will Be Returning

shers.roman:
Nabi Hai, Dam Pe Duhaayi Hai Taaj Waale Ki
Ye Ghul, Ye Shor, Ye Hangaama, Jaa Baja Hoga
shers.english:
He Is The Nabi; In A Moment, Aid, The Grand King, Can Be Giving,
From Everywhere, These Sounds And Restless Pleas, Will Be Echoing

shers.roman:
Maqaam Faasiloñ Par, Kaam Mukhtalif Itne
Wo Din Zuhoor e Kamaal e Huzoor Ka Hoga
shers.english:
There Are Many Tasks, Whilst Distant, The Destination Is Being,
On That Day, The Marvels of My Beloved Master, Will Be Appearing

shers.roman:
Kaheñge Awr Nabi ‘Idh-haboo Ilaa Ghayri’
Mere Huzoor Ke Lab Par ‘Ana Lahaa’ Hoga
shers.english:
Go To Someone Else! All The Other Nabis Will Be Saying,
Upon The Lips of My Nabi, Will Be, ‘For This I Am Being’

shers.roman:
Dua e Ummat e Badkaar Wird e Lab Hogi
Khuda Ke Saamne Sajdah Meiñ Sar Jhuka Hoga
shers.english:
From His Sacred Lips, Duas For His Sinful Ummah, Will Be Flowing,
While Before Almighty Allah, His Blessed Head, He Will Be Prostrating

shers.roman:
Ghulaam Un Ki ‘Inaayat Se Chain Meiñ Hoñge
‘Adu Huzoor Ka Aafat Meiñ Mubtala Hoga
shers.english:
By His Blessings, In Comfort, His Slaves Will Be Reclining,
Whilst Stricken By Misery, His Enemies Will Be Suffering

shers.roman:
Mei ñ Un Ke Dar Ka Bhikaari Huñ Fazl e Maula Se
Hasan Faqeer Ka Jannat Meiñ Bistara Hoga
shers.english:
By The Grace of Allah Almighty, A Beggar At His Court, I Am Being,
On His Bed In Holy Paradise, Hasan The Mendicant, Will Be Resting

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: YE IKRAAM HAI MUSTAFA PAR KHUDA KA

shers.roman:
Ye Ikraam Hai Mustafa Par Khuda Ka
Ke Sab Kuch Khuda Ka Huwa Mustafa Ka
shers.english:
Upon Mustafa, Such Is The Special Grace of Allah Almighty,
Everything Belongs To Mustafa, Which Belongs To Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Ye Bayt’ha Hai Sikka Tumhaari ‘Ata Ka
Kabhi Haath Ut’hne Na Paaya Gada Ka
shers.english:
Already Established, Is Your Holy Seal of Generosity,
The Mendicant Needed Not Raise His Hand Even Slightly

shers.roman:
Chamakta Huwa Chaand Thawr o Hira Ka
Ujaala Huwa Burj e ‘Arsh e Khuda Ka
shers.english:
As The Radiant Moon of Thawr And Hira, Glowed Brightly,
He Illuminated The Towering Throne, of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Lahad Meiñ ‘Amal Ho Na Deo e Bala Ka
Jo Ta’weez Meiñ Naqsh Ho Naqsh e Paa Ka
shers.english:
In The Grave, From The Evil of The Devil, There Will Be Safety
If On My Tombstone, His Holy Footprint, Is Engraved Perfectly

shers.roman:
Jo Banda Khuda Ka Wo Banda Tumhaara
Jo Banda Tumhaara Wo Banda Khuda Ka
shers.english:
Whoever Is Allah’s True Slave, Is Your Slave, Most Certainly
Whoever Is Your True Slave, Is The Slave of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Mere Gaysuwoñ Waale Meiñ Tere Sadqe
Ke Sar Par Hujoom e Bala Hai Bala Ka
shers.english:
O You With Sacred Tresses! Upon You, I Am Sacrificed Entirely,
For Scores of Disasters, Are Looming Over My Head Currently

shers.roman:
Tere Zer e Paa Masnad e Mulk e Yazdaañ
Tere Farq Par Taaj Mulk e Khuda Hai
shers.english:
Beneath Your Sacred Feet, Lies Almighty Allah’s Kingdom, Entirely
Upon Your Head, Rests The Crown of The Kingdom of The Almighty

shers.roman:
Sahaara Diya Jab Mere Na Khuda Ne
Huwi Naaw Seedhi, Phira Rukh Hawa Ka
shers.english:
When My Majestic Commander, Came To My Support, Promptly
My Ship Sailed On Course, The Wind’s Direction Changed Instantly

shers.roman:
Kiya Aisa Qaadir Qaza o Qadr Ne
Ke Qudrat Meiñ Hai Pheyr Dena Qaza Ka
shers.english:
He Who Decrees Fate And Destiny, Has Granted You Such Authority,
To Restore What Has Already Expired, Is Within Your Grand Authority

shers.roman:
Agar Zer e Deewaar e Sarkaar Bayt’huñ
Mere Sar Pe Saaya Ho Fazl e Khuda Ka
shers.english:
If I Am Seated, Beneath The Wall of My Beloved Nabi,
The Shade of Almighty Allah’s Grace, Over My Head Will Be

shers.roman:
Adab Se Liya Taaj e Shaahi Ne Sar Par
Ye Paaya Hai Sarkaar Ke Naqsh e Paa Ka
shers.english:
The Crown of Royalty, Carried It Upon Its Head, Respectfully,
It Is The Pedestal of The Holy Footprint of My Beloved Nabi

shers.roman:
Khuda Karna Hota Jo Taht e Mashiy’yat
Khuda Ho Kar Aata Ye Banda Khuda Ka
shers.english:
If To Make Anyone A Deity, Were Within The Divine Will of The Almighty,
This Chosen Servant of Allah Almighty, Would Have Come Down As A Deity

shers.roman:
Azaañ Kya, Jahaañ Dekho Imaan Waalo
Pas e Zikr e Haq, Zikr Hai Mustafa Ka
shers.english:
Not Only In The Azaan, O Believers! Wherever You May See,
After Allah’s Remembrance, Mustafa’s Remembrance Will Be

shers.roman:
Ke Pehle Zabaañ Hamd Se Paak Ho Le
To Phir Naam Le Wo Habeeb e Khuda Ka
shers.english:
So, That You May First Purify Your Tongue, Praising Allah Almighty,
Only Then, May You Take The Name of The Beloved of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Ye Hai Tere Eemaa e Abru Ka Sadqa
Hadaf Hai Asar Apne Teer e Dua Ka
shers.english:
By The Blessing of Your Eyebrow’s Gesture, It Is In Reality,
That The Arrow of Our Dua, Reaches The Objective Perfectly

shers.roman:
Tera Naam Le Kar Jo Maange Wo Paaye
Tera Naam Lewa Hai Pyaara Khuda Ka
shers.english:
He Will Get What He Asks For, If He Takes Your Name Sincerely,
A Devotee Who Takes Your Name, Is Beloved To Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Na Kyuñ Kar Ho Us Haath Meiñ Sab Khudaayi
Ke Ye Haath To Haath Hai Kibriya Ka
shers.english:
In That Sacred Hand, Why Will The Entire Creation Not Be?
For This Sacred Hand, Manifests The Power of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Jo Sahra e Taibah Ka Sadqa Na Milta
Khilaata Hee Na Phool J’hoñka Saba Ka
shers.english:
Had It Not Received The Special Blessings of Taibah’s Sacred Charity
By The Easterly Breeze, The Flowers Would Not Blossom, So Blissfully

shers.roman:
‘Ajab Kya Nahiñ Gar Saraapa Ka Saaya
Saraapa, Saraapa, Hai Saaya Khuda Ka
shers.english:
It Will Not Be Unexpected, If His Shadow, From Head To Foot Entirely,
Would Not Completely Manifest, The Divine Shade of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Khuda Madh-Khwaañ Hai, Khuda Madh-Khwaañ Hai,
Mere Mustafa Ka, Mere Mustafa Ka
shers.english:
My Mustafa Is Indeed Being Praised, By Allah Almighty,
My Mustafa Is Indeed Being Praised, By Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Khuda Ka Wo Taalib, Khuda Us Ka Taalib
Khuda Us Ka Pyaara, Wo Pyaara Khuda Ka
shers.english:
He Loves Allah Almighty Profoundly, He Is Truly Loved By Allah Almighty
Beloved To Him Is Allah Almighty, He Is The Beloved of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Jahaañ Haath Phayla De Mangta Bhikaari
Wahi Dar Hai Daata Ki Daulat Sara Ka
shers.english:
Wherever The Beggars And Mendicants, Stretch Their Hands Out Sincerely,
That Place Becomes The Grand Palace of Our Benefactor, Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Tere Rutbe Meiñ Jis Ne Choon o Chara Ki
Na Samjha Wo Bad-bakht Rutba Khuda Ka
shers.english:
Whomsoever Disputed And Doubted Your Nobility And Dignity,
That Wretched One, Has Not Understood, Allah’s Divine Majesty

shers.roman:
Tere Paaoñ Ne Sar Bulandi Wo Paayi
Bana Taaj e Sar ‘Arsh Rab’b e ‘Ulaa Ka
shers.english:
Your Sacred Feet, Have Attained Such Eminence And Such Majesty,
They Became The Crown On The Head of The Arsh of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Kisi Ke Jigar Meiñ To Sar Par Kisi Ke
‘Ajab Martaba Hai Tere Naqsh e Paa Ka
shers.english:
It Lies In The Heart of Someone, Whilst On The Head of Somebody,
Your Sacred Footprint Is Honoured, With Such Remarkable Dignity

shers.roman:
Tera Dard e Ulfat Jo Dil Ki Dawa Ho
Wo Be Dard Hai Naam Le Jo Dawa Ka
shers.english:
When The Pain of Your Pure Love, Becomes The Heart’s Remedy,
Indeed, Heartless Is The One, Who Mentions Any Alternate Remedy

shers.roman:
Chalay Aawo Mujh Jaañ-Balab Ke Kinaare
Ke Sab Dekh Leñ Phir Ke Jaana Qaza Ka
shers.english:
As I Am About To Die, Come And Stand Beside Me,
So, When Death Turns Away, You Are All Able To See

shers.roman:
Bhala Hai Hasan Ka Janaab e Raza Se
Bhala Ho Ilaahi Janaab e Raza Ka
shers.english:
By The Virtue of The Noble Raza, Hasan Is Blessed, Truly,
May The Noble Raza Remain Blessed, O Allah Almighty!

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SAR SUBH E SA’ADAT NE GIREBAAÑ SE NIKAALA

shers.roman:
Sar Subh e Sa’adat Ne Girebaañ Se Nikaala
Zulmat Ko Mila ‘Aalam e Imkaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
From Its Skyline, Emerged The Edge, of The Dawn of Felicity,
As Obscurity Was Obliterated, From The World Completely

shers.roman:
Paida-ish e Mahboob Ki Shaadi Meiñ Khuda Ne
Mud’dat Ke Giraftaaroñ Ko Zindaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Upon The Birth of His Beloved, In Happiness, Allah Almighty,
Released Those, Who For Ages, Were Confined To Captivity

shers.roman:
Rahmat Ka Khazaana Pa-e Taqseem e Gadayaañ
Allah Ne Teh-Khaana e Pinhaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Amongst The Mendicants, To Distribute The Treasures of Mercy,
From The Special Secret Vault, It Was Revealed, By Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Khushboo Ne ‘Anaadil Se Chur’aaye Chaman o Gul
Jalwe Ne Patangoñ Ko Shabistaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
From The Gardens And Flowers, The Fragrance Set The Nightingales Free,
The Moths Were Drawn Out of Their Dark Chambers, By This Luminosity

shers.roman:
Hai Husn e Guloo e Mah e Bat-ha Se Ye Roshan
Ab Mahr Ne Sar Un Ke Girebaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
The Beauty of The Meccan Moon’s Throat, Demonstrates Very Clearly,
That The Sun’s Edge Now Rises, From His Neck Line of Luminosity

shers.roman:
Parda Jo Tere Jalwa e Rangeeñ Ne Ut’haaya
Sarsar Ka ‘Amal Sahn e Gulistaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
When The Veil Was Lifted, From The Shades of Your Luminosity,
Like The Wind, The Garden’s Courtyard, Began Swirling, Ecstatically

shers.roman:
Us Maah Ne Jab Mahr Se Ki Jalwa Numaayi
Taareekiyoñ Ko Shaam e Ghareebaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
When Before The Sun, That Moon, Displayed Its Radiant Beauty,
From The Evening Filled With Mishaps, It Eliminated The Obscurity

shers.roman:
Ay Mahr e Karam Teri Tajal’li Ki Ada Ne
Zar’roñ Ko Bala e Shab e Hijraañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
The Manifestation of Your Radiance, O Moon of Generosity!
Freed The Particles, From The Eve of Separation’s Calamity

shers.roman:
Sadqe Tere, Ay Mardumak e Deeda e Ya’qoob
Yusuf Ko Teri Chaah Ne Kan’aañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
O Radiant Pupil of Ya’qoob’s Eye! Upon You, Sacrificed May We Be,
Your True Love For Yusuf, Isolated Him From Palestine, Ultimately

shers.roman:
Ham ‘Doobne Hee Ko Thay Ke Aaqa Ki Madad Ne
Girdaab Se Kheencha Hameñ, Toofaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
We Were About To Sink, When The Special Aid of Our Nabi,
Extracted Us From The Vortex; From The Storm, He Set Us Free

shers.roman:
Ummat Ke Kaleje Ki Khalish Tum Ne Mit’aayi
‘Toot’ay Huwe Nashtar Ko Rag e Jaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
From The Spirit of The Ummah, You Obliterated All Their Anxiety,
From The Jugular Vein, The Broken Lancet, You Extracted Neatly

shers.roman:
In Haathoñ Ke Qurbaan Ke In Haathoñ Se Tum Ne
Khaar e Rah e Gham, Paa e Ghareebaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Upon These Hands May We Be Sacrificed, For With These Hands, Perfectly,
You Protected The Beggars’ Feet, From The Thorns, On The Path of Agony

shers.roman:
Armaan Zadoñ Ki Haiñ Taman’naayeñ Bhi Pyaari
Armaan Nikaala To Kis Armaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Those Who Are Yearning, Also Have Wishes Which Are Very Lovely,
So, When He Fulfilled Their Wishes, He Fulfilled Them So Perfectly

shers.roman:
Ye Gardan e Pur-Noor Ka Phayla Hai Ujaala
Ya Subh Ne Sar Un Ke Girebaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Is It The Radiance of His Radiant Neck, Which Is Extending So Radiantly?
Or Has True Dawn Started Rising, Through His Neckline, In Reality?

shers.roman:
Gulzaar e Baraheem Kiya Naar Ko Jis Ne
Us Ne Hee Hameñ Aatish e Souzaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
He Who Turned The Fire of Ibrahim, Into A Garden Instantly,
From The Raging Inferno, It Is He, Who Truly Set Us Free

shers.roman:
Deni Thee Jo ‘Aalam Ke Haseenoñ Ko Malaahat
Thor’a Sa Namak Un Ke Namak-Daañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
To Give The World’s Most Dazzling, A Unique Flavour of Beauty,
From His Salt Cellar, A Little Seasoning, He Sprinkled Precisely

shers.roman:
Qur’aañ Ki Hawaashi Pe Jalaalain Likhi Hai
Mazmoon Ye Khat e ‘Aariz e Jaanaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
On The Margin of The Qur’an, Is Written Jalaalain’s Commentary,
From The Hairline On The Beloved’s Face, Is Derived This Sagacity

shers.roman:
Qurbaan Huwa Bandagi Pe Lutf e Rihaayi
Yuñ Banda Bana Kar Hameñ Zindaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Upon His Devotion, I Sacrificed The Pleasure of Being Free,
So, He Accepted Me As His Slave, Freeing Me From Captivity

shers.roman:
Ay Aah! Mere Dil Ki Lagi Awr Na Bujhti
Kyuñ Tu Ne D’huwaañ Seena e Sauzan Se Nikaala
shers.english:
O Alas! In My Heart, The Raging Flames of Grief, Still Rage Endlessly,
Why Did You Release The Smoke, From This Chest Engulfed In Agony

shers.roman:
Madfan Nahiñ, Phenk Aayeñge Ahbaab Gar’hay Meiñ
Taaboot Agar Koocha e Jaanaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Not Into A Grave, But Into A Pit, My Loved Ones Will Throw Me,
If My Funeral Bier Is Removed, From My Beloved’s Holy City

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Shor Hai, Kya Hashr Ka Hangaama Bapaa Hai
Ya Tum Ne Qadam Gor e Ghareebaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
Why All This Commotion? Has The Day of Reckoning Unfolded Already?
Or Have Your Sacred Feet, Passed By The Strangers’ Graves, Suddenly

shers.roman:
Laakhoñ Tere Sadqe Meiñ Kaheñge Dam e Mahshar
Zindaañ Se Nikaala Hameñ, Zindaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
On Judgement Day, Millions Will Be Proclaiming, Through Your Mercy,
He Did Free Us From Incarceration, From Incarceration, He Set Us Free!

shers.roman:
Jo Baat Lab e Hazrat e Esa Ne Dikhaayi
Wo Kaam Yahaañ Jumbish e Daamaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
By The Lips of Hazrat Esa, That Miracle, Which Came To Be,
With Only A Sway of His Mantle’s Edge, Here, It Came To Be

shers.roman:
Munh Maangi Muraadoñ Se Bhari Jeyb e Do ‘Aalam
Jab Dast e Karam Aap Ne Daamaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
With All That They Desired, He Filled The Purses of Both Worlds Entirely,
From Beneath His Sacred Mantle, When He Lifted His Hand of Generosity

shers.roman:
Kaañta Gham e ‘Uqba Ka Hasan Apne Jigar Se
Ummat Ne Khayaal e Sar e Mizhgaañ Se Nikaala
shers.english:
O Hasan! They Pulled From Their Hearts, The Thorn of Hereafter’s Agony,
The Ummah Did So, Whilst Visualising, The Sacred Eyelashes of The Nabi

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AGAR QISMAT SE MAIÑ UN KI GALI MEIÑ KHAAK HO JAATA

shers.roman:
Agar Qismat Se Maiñ Un Ki Gali Meiñ Khaak Ho Jaata
Gham e Kaunain Ka Saara Bakher’a Paak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If I Were To Become The Dust, In His Sacred Lane, By My Good Destiny,
The Endless Grief of Both Worlds, Would Have Been Cleansed Instantly

shers.roman:
Jo Ay Gul Jaama e Hasti Teri Poshaak Ho Jaata
To Khaar e Nestee Se Kyuñ Ulajh Kar Chaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
O Flower! If The Attire of Life, Had Become Your Attire, Genuinely,
You Wouldn’t Have Withered, By Tangling With The Thorn of Mortality

shers.roman:
Jo Wo Abr e Karam Phir Aabru e Khaak Ho Jaata
To Us Ke Do Hee Cheent’oñ Meiñ Zamaana Paak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If Once Again, The Honour of Dust, That Holy Cloud of Mercy, Were To Be,
Then, With Just Two Drops From It, The World Would Have Attained Purity

shers.roman:
Hawa e Daaman e Rangeeñ Jo Weeraane Meiñ Aa Jaati
Libaas e Gul Meiñ Zaahir Har Khas o Khaashaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
When His Mantle’s Vibrant Breeze, Blows Through Any Barren Vicinity,
All The Dry Leaves And Grass, Appear In The Flower’s Attire, Stunningly

shers.roman:
Lab e Jaañ Bakhsh Ki Qurbat Hayaat e Jaavedaañ Deti
Agar ‘Daura Nafas Ka Resha e Miswaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
Nearness To His Life Endowing Lips, Would Have Given A Life of Eternity,
If The Thread of The Soul, Had Become, The Miswaak’s Fibre, In Reality

shers.roman:
Hawa Dil Sokhtoñ Ko Chaahiye Thee Un Ke Daaman Ki
Ilaahi Subh e Mahshar Ka Girebaañ Chaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
For His Mantle’s Breeze, If The Heartbroken Ones Yearned Desperately,
The Skyline On Judgment Day, Would Have Surely Split, O Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Agar Do Boond Paani Chashma e Rahmat Se Mil Jaata
Meri Na-Paakiyoñ Ke Meyl Dhulte, Paak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If I Were To Get Just Two Drops of Water, From The Fountain of Mercy,
The Grime of My Impurities Would Be Cleansed, Purified I Would Be

shers.roman:
Agar Paiwand e Malboos e Payambar Ke Nazar Aate
Tera Ay Hul’la e Shaahi Kaleja Chaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If The Patches You Were To See, On The Sacred Clothes of My Nabi,
Your Heart Would Have Been Ripped Apart, O Robes of Royalty!

shers.roman:
Jo Wo Gul Soongh Leta Phool Murjhaaya Huwa Bulbul
Bahaar e Taazgi Meiñ Sab Chaman Ki Naak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
O Nightingale! If The Withered Flower, Had Only Smelt That Rose Truly,
The Pride It Would Have Been, of The Entire Garden, Blooming Freshly

shers.roman:
Chamak Jaata Muqad’dar Jab Dur e Dandaañ Ki Tal’at Se
Na Kyuñ Rishta Gohar Ka Resha e Miswaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
When The Radiance of His Glowing Teeth, Illuminates Our Destiny,
A String of Pearls, Why Won’t His Blessed Miswaak’s Fibre Be!

shers.roman:
‘Adu Ki Aankh Bhi Mahshar Meiñ Hasrat Se Na Muñh Takti
Agar Tera Karam Kuch Ay Nigaah e Paak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
On The Last Day, Even The Rivals Eyes Wouldn’t Be Gazing Regretfully,
O Pure Sight! If Only, You Had Showered Upon Them, Some Mercy

shers.roman:
Bahaar e Taaza Rehteeñ Kyuñ Khizaañ Meiñ Dhaj’jiyaañ Ur’teeñ
Libaas e Gul Jo Un Ki Malgiji Poshaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
In Winter, They Would Be Blooming Freshly, Withered They Wouldn’t Be,
If, Into The Rose’s Attire, They Had Changed Their Soiled Attire, Promptly

shers.roman:
Kamaandaar e Nubuw’wat Qaadir Andaazi Meiñ Yakta Haiñ
Do ‘Aalam Kyuñ Na Un Ka Basta e Fitraak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
The Archer of Prophethood Is Matchless, In Firing Most Accurately,
The Game In His Saddle Strap, Why Then Would Both Worlds Not Be?

shers.roman:
Na Hoti Shaaq Gar Dar Ki Judaayi Tere Zar’ra Ko
Qamar Ik Awr Bhi Roshan Sar e Aflaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If Leaving Your Holy Court, Would Not Have Caused Your Speck Agony,
In The High Skies, Another Moon, Would Have Been Glowing Brightly

shers.roman:
Teri Rahmat Ke Qabza Meiñ Hai Pyaare Qalb e Maahiy’yat
Mere Haq Meiñ Na Kyuñ Zahr e Gunah Tiryaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
O Beloved! The Alteration of A Natural State, Is Controlled By Your Mercy,
Why Then, Can The Poison of My Sins, Not Become The Antidote For Me?

shers.roman:
Khuda Taar e Rag e Jaañ Ki Agar ‘Izzat Bar’ha Deta
Shiraak e Na’al e Paak e Sayyid e Lau-Laak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If The Cord of My Jugular Vein, Were To Be Elevated By Allah Almighty,
The Strap of The Sacred Footwear of My Beloved Nabi, It Would Be

shers.roman:
Tajal’li Gaah e Jaanaañ Tak Ujaale Se Pahunch Jaate
Jo Tu Ay Tausan e ‘Umr e Rawaañ Chaalaak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
You Would Have Reached The Beloved’s Bright Court, By Its Luminosity,
O Steed of This Transient Life! If Only You Were A Bit More Witty

shers.roman:
Agar Teri Bharan Ay Abr e Rahmat Kuch Karam Karti
Hamaara Chashma e Hasti Ubal Kar Paak Ho Jaata
shers.english:
If I Were Blessed By Some of Your Merciful Showers, O Cloud of Mercy!
The Fountain of My Existence Would Have Overflowed, Thus Purifying Me

shers.roman:
Hasan! Ahl e Nazar ‘Izzat Se Aankhoñ Meiñ Jaga Dete
Agar Ye Musht e Khaak Un Ki Gali Ki Khaak Ho Jaaye
shers.english:
O Hasan! The Pious Would Have Kept You In Their Eyes, With Dignity,
The Dust of His Sacred Pathway, If This Handful of Dust, Were To Be

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DUSHMAN HAI GALAY KA HAAR AAQA

shers.roman:
Dushman Hai Galay Ka Haar Aaqa
Lut’tee Hai Meri Bahaar Aaqa
shers.english:
O My Master! A Noose Around My Neck, The Enemy Is Being,
O My Master! Plundered, My Flourishing Blossom Is Being

shers.roman:
Tum Dil Ke Liye Qaraar Aaqa
Tum Raahat e Jaan e Zaar Aaqa
shers.english:
O My Master! For The Heart, Indeed, Tranquillity You Are Being,
O My Master! For The Aggrieved Soul, Comfort You Are Being

shers.roman:
Tum ‘Arsh Ke Taajdaar Maula
Tum Farsh Ke Ba-Waqaar Aaqa
shers.english:
O My King! The Crown of The Exalted Arsh, You Are Being
O My Master! The Most Honourable On Earth, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Daaman, Daaman, Hawa e Daaman
Gulshan, Gulshan, Bahaar Aaqa
shers.english:
In Every Sacred Mantle, Your Sacred Mantle’s Breeze Is Flowing,
O My Master! In Every Garden, Your Blooms Are Blossoming

shers.roman:
Bande Haiñ Gunahgaar Bande
Aaqa Haiñ Karam Shi’aar Aaqa
shers.english:
Even Though Sinful Servants, We Servants Are Being,
Renowned For His Generosity, Our Master Is Being

shers.roman:
Is Shaan Ke Ham Ne Kya, Kisi Ne
Dekhe Nahiñ, Zi-Nihaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Not Only Have We Not Seen Anyone, So Amazing,
None Has Ever Seen, A Master Like You, So Amazing

shers.roman:
Bandoñ Ka Alam Ne Dil Dukhaaya
Awr Hogaye Be-Qaraar Aaqa
shers.english:
Due To The Agony of His Slaves, His Heart Was Hurting,
And Extremely Uneasy, Our Master Was Becoming

shers.roman:
Aaraam Se So-eñ Ham Kameene
Jaaga Kareñ Ba-Waqaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Whilst Shameless Ones Like Us, Are Comfortably Sleeping
Awake At Night, Our Honourable Master, Is Remaining

shers.roman:
Aisa To Kahiñ Suna, Na Dekha
Bandoñ Ka Ut’haaye Baar Aaqa
shers.english:
Nowhere Have We Ever Heard, Or Seen Such A Thing,
Where The Burden of The Slaves, The Master Is Carrying

shers.roman:
Jinn Ki Koyi Baat Tak Na Pooche
Un Par Tumheñ Aaye Pyaar Aaqa
shers.english:
After Those, Whom None Is Asking Or Bothering,
O My Master! Towards Them, Love You Are Showing

shers.roman:
Paakeeza Diloñ Ki Zeenat e Imaañ
Imaan Ki Tum Singaar Aaqa
shers.english:
The Adornment of Faith, In Pure Hearts, You Are Being,
O My Master! The True Beauty of Imaan, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Sadqa Jo Bat’ay Kaheñ Salaateeñ
Ham Bhi Haiñ Ummeed-waar Aaqa
shers.english:
When Your Alms Are Being Distributed, The Kings Are Saying,
O Our Noble Master! Extremely Hopeful, Even We Are Being

shers.roman:
Chakra Gayi Naaw Bekaso Ki
Aana Mere Gham-Gusaar Aaqa
shers.english:
The Ship of The Helpless Ones, Has Lost Its Bearings,
O My Master! O My Consoler, Please Do Be Coming

shers.roman:
Allah Ne Tum Ko De Diya Hai
Har Cheez Ka Ikhtiyaar Aaqa
shers.english:
To You, Almighty Allah Has Indeed, Granted Everything,
O My Master! He Granted You, Authority Over Everything

shers.roman:
Hai Khaak Pe Naqsh e Paa Tumhaara
Aa-ina e Be-Ghubaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Upon The Dust, Your Sacred Footprint Is Being,
O My Master! Like A Spotless Mirror, It Is Glowing

shers.roman:
‘Aalam Meiñ Haiñ Sab Bani Ke Saathi
Big’ri Ke Tumheeñ Ho Yaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Friends of The Prosperous, In This World, Everyone Is Being,
O My Master! The Supporter of The Needy, Only You Are Being

shers.roman:
Sarkaar Ke Taajdaar Bande
Sarkaar Haiñ Taajdaar Aaqa
shers.english:
The Slaves of The King, Kings Are Being,
The King of Kings, My Master Is Being

shers.roman:
De Bheek Agar Jamaal e Rangeeñ
Jannat Ho Mera Mazaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Charity, From Your Vibrant Beauty, If Only, I Were To Be Receiving,
O My Master! Into A Heavenly Garden, My Shrine Will Be Transforming

shers.roman:
Aankhoñ Ke Khand’ar Bhi Ab Basa Do
Dil Ka Tu Huwa Waqaar Aaqa
shers.english:
The Ruined Caves of My Eyes, Now Please Do Be Occupying,
O My Master! For The Honour of My Heart, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Imaan Ki Taak Meiñ Hai Dushman
Aawo Dam e Ihtizaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Waiting To Ambush My Imaan, The Enemy Is Prowling,
O My Master! The Pangs of Death, I Am Now Facing

shers.roman:
Ho Sham’e Shab e Siyaah Bakhtaañ
Tera Rukh e Noor-Baar Aaqa
shers.english:
May The Dark Nights of The Unfortunate Ones, Start Glowing,
O My Master! By The Light, Which Your Bright Face Is Scattering

shers.roman:
Tu Rahmat e Be-Hisaab Ko Dekh
Jurmoñ Ka Na Le Shumaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Only At Your Endless Mercy, Do Be Looking,
O My Master! My Sins, Do Not Be Counting

shers.roman:
Deedaar Ki Bheek Kab Bat’egi
Mangta Hai Ummeed-waar Aaqa
shers.english:
The Charity of Your Blessed Vision, When Will You Be Distributing?
O My Noble Master! In Anticipation, Your Lowly Slave Is Yearning

shers.roman:
Bandoñ Ki Hansi Khushi Meiñ Guzre
Is Gham Meiñ Hoñ Ashk-Baar Aaqa
shers.english:
So That In Comfort And Joy, His Slaves May Be Living,
Due To His Concern Over This, Our Master Is Weeping

shers.roman:
Aati Hai Madad, Balaa Se Pehle
Karte Nahiñ Intizaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Even Before The Calamity Comes, His Special Help Is Coming,
Without The Slightest Delay, My Beloved Master Is Acting

shers.roman:
Saaye Meiñ Tumhaari Donoñ ‘Aalam
Tum Saaya e Kirdgaar Aaqa
shers.english:
In Your Blessed Shadow, Both The Worlds Are Residing,
O My Master! The Shadow of Allah’s Mercy, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Jab Fauj e Alam Kare Char’haayi
Ho Awj e Karam Hisaar Aaqa
shers.english:
When Upon Us, Its Invasion, The Army of Grief Starts Launching,
O My Master! In The Fortress of Your Grand Grace, Us, Be Taking

shers.roman:
Har Milk e Khuda Ke Sach’che Maalik
Har Mulk Ke Shahr-Yaar Aaqa
shers.english:
The True Owner of Allah’s Entire Kingdom, You Are Being,
O My Noble Master! Of Every Realm, You Are The True King

shers.roman:
Maana Ke Meiñ Huñ Zaleel Banda
Aaqa Tu Hai Ba-Waqaar Aaqa
shers.english:
A Humiliated Slave I Am, This I Am Fully Admitting,
O My Master! An Honourable Master, You Are Being

shers.roman:
T’oot’ay Huwe Dil Ko, Do Sahaara
Ab Gham Ki Nahiñ Sahaar Aaqa
shers.english:
To The Broken Heart, Your Blessed Support, Do Be Granting,
O My Master! For Much Longer, This Grief, I Can’t Be Enduring

shers.roman:
Milti Hai Tumheeñ Se Daad Dil Ki
Sunte Ho Tumheeñ Pukaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Consolation To The Heart, Only You Are Giving,
O My Master! Our Pleas, Only You Are Hearing

shers.roman:
Teri ‘Azmat Wo Hai, Ke Tera
Allah Kare Waqaar Aaqa
shers.english:
So Majestic, Your Grand Excellence, Is Being,
Honoured By Allah Almighty, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Allah Ke Laakhoñ Kaar-Khaane
Sab Ka Tumheñ Ikhtiyaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Countless Assemblies of Allah Almighty, Are Existing,
O My Master! Under Your Authority, They All Are Being

shers.roman:
Kya Baat Tumhaare Naqsh e Paa Ki
Hai Taaj e Sar e Waqaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Indeed, Magnificent, Your Sacred Footprint Is Being,
O My Master! The Crown of Noble Heads, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Khud Bheek Do, Khud Kaho Bhala Ho
Is Dayn Ke Maiñ Nisaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Stay Blessed, You Say, After Alms You Are Granting,
O My Master! Upon Such Grace, Sacrificed I Am Being

shers.roman:
Wo Shakl Hai Wo Adaa Tumhaari
Allah Ko Aaye Pyaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Your Blessed Appearance, Is So Marvellously Outstanding,
O My Master! The Most Beloved of Allah, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Jo Mujh Se Mujhe Ch’hupaaye Rakhe
Wo Jalwa Kar Aashkaar Aaqa
shers.english:
That Which Conceals Me, From My Own Being,
O My Master! That Lustre, Allow Me To Be Seeing

shers.roman:
Jo Kehte Haiñ Be-Zabaañ Tumhaare
Goongoñ Ki Suno Pukaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Kindly Listen To That, Which Your Voiceless Slaves Are Saying,
O My Noble Master! To The Pleas of The Mute, Do Be Listening

shers.roman:
Wo Dekh Le Karbala Meiñ, Jis Ne
Dekhe Na Ho, Jaañ Nisaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Those Who Saw Not; On Karbala’s Plains, They Should Be Seeing,
O My Master! How Their Lives, The Truly Devoted Were Sacrificing

shers.roman:
Aaraam Se Shash-Jihat Meiñ Guzre
Gham e Dil Se Na Ho Do-Chaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Through All Six Directions, With Safety I Should Be Traversing,
O My Master! The Agony of My Heart, I Should Not Be Facing

shers.roman:
Ho Jaan e Hasan Nisaar Tujh Par
Ho Jaawuñ Tere Nisaar Aaqa
shers.english:
Upon You, His Life, May Hasan Be Totally Sacrificing,
O My Master! His Life, To You, May He Be Devoting

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: WAAH KYA MARTABA HUWA TERA

shers.roman:
Waah Kya Martaba Huwa Tera
Tu Khuda Ka, Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Wow, So Exalted, Is Your Grand Station of Dignity,
You Are Almighty Allah’s, Yours Is Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Taaj Waale Hoñ Is Meiñ Ya Muhtaaj
Sab Ne Paaya, Diya Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Whether Included In This, Are The Kings Or The Needy,
All Have Received, Whatever You Granted In Reality

shers.roman:
Haath Khaali Koyi Phira Na Phiray
Hai Khazaana Bhara Huwa Tera
shers.english:
None Has Left, Or Will Ever Leave, With His Hands Empty
Your Abundant Treasures Are Always Flowing Abundantly

shers.roman:
Aaj Sunte Haiñ Sun’ne Waale, Kal
Dekh Leñge Kaha Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Today, Those Who Hear, Are Hearing Constantly,
Whatever You Decreed, Tomorrow, They Will See

shers.roman:
Usay Tu Jaane Ya Khuda Jaane
Pesh e Haq Rutbah Kya Huwa Tera
shers.english:
It Is Indeed, Only Known To You, And To Allah Almighty
Whatever Is Your Real Status, Before Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Ghar Haiñ Sab Band, Dar Haiñ Sab Tayghay
Aik Dar Hai Khula Huwa Tera
shers.english:
All The Homes Are Closed, All The Courts Are Guarded Strictly,
It Is Only Your Blessed Court, Which Is Opened Unrestrictedly

shers.roman:
Kaam Tauheen Se Hai Najdi Ko
Tu Huwa Ya Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
The Real Purpose of The Najdi, Is To Always Spew Blasphemy,
Be This Against You, Or Against Your Creator, Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Taajdaaroñ Ka Taajdaar Bana
Ban Gaya Jo Gada Huwa Tera
shers.english:
The King of Kings, He Became Most Certainly,
He Who Became Your Beggar, Became Royalty

shers.roman:
Awr Maiñ Kya Likhuñ Khuda Ki Hamd
Hamd Usay, Wo Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
And What Can I Ever Write, In Praise of The Almighty,
All Praise Be To Him, He Is Your Creator, The Almighty

shers.roman:
Jo Tera Ho Gaya Khuda Ka Huwa
Jo Khuda Ka Huwa, Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Whoever Is Beloved To You, Is Beloved To Allah Almighty,
Whoever Is Beloved To Allah, Is Your Beloved Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Hausleñ Kyuñ Ghateñ Ghareeboñ Ke
Hai Iraadah Bar’ha Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Why Should The Spirits of The Poor Be Broken Entirely?
When Your Strong Resolve, Remains Firm And Steady

shers.roman:
Zaat Bhi Teri Intikhaab Huwi
Naam Bhi Mustafa Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Indeed, Specially Chosen, Was Your Noble Ancestry,
You Were Named ‘Mustafa’, ‘The Chosen One’ Suitably

shers.roman:
Jisay Tu Ne Diya, Khuda Ne Diya
Dayn Rab’b Ka, Diya Huwa Tera
shers.english:
To Whomsoever You Gave, It Was Given By The Almighty,
Whatever Allah Has Given, Is Presented By You, In Reality

shers.roman:
Aik ‘Aalam Khuda Ka Taalib Hai
Awr Taalib Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
An Entire Universe Is Seeking, The Love of Allah Almighty,
And You Are Chosen As The Most Beloved, of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Bazm e Imkaañ Tere Naseeb Khulay
Ke Wo Dulha Bana Huwa Tera
shers.english:
O The Assembly of This World, Radiant Is Your Destiny,
For, As Your Groom, He Has Been Chosen, Perfectly

shers.roman:
Meri Taa’at Se Mere Jurm Fuzooñ
Lutf Sab Se Bar’ha Huwa Tera
shers.english:
More Than My Acts of Devotion, Are My Sins, Most Certainly,
But Above Them All, Is Your Immense Kindness And Generosity

shers.roman:
Khauf e Wazn e ‘Amal Kisay Ho, Ke Hai
Dil Madad Par Tula Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Regarding The Weighing of Our Deeds, Who Should We Worry?
When To Grant Us Your Blessed Aid, Your Heart Is Intent Already

shers.roman:
Kaam Big’ray Huwe Bana Dena
Kaam Kis Ka Huwa, Huwa Tera
shers.english:
For Our Impaired Affairs, To Grant A Remedy,
Whose Resolve Is This? Only Yours It Can Be

shers.roman:
Har Ada Dil Nasheeñ Bani Teri
Har Sukhan Jaañ Fiza Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Your Every Holy Action, Pleases The Heart Completely,
Your Every Word, Refreshes The Soul, Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Aashkaara Kamaal e Shaan e Huzoor
Phir Bhi Jalwa Chupa Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Manifest Are Your Splendours, O My Beloved Nabi
Yet, Still Very Concealed, Is Your Splendid Luminosity

shers.roman:
Parda Daar e Ada Hazaar Hijaab
Phir Bhi Parda U’tha Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Behind A Thousand Veils, Your Elegance Hides Secretly,
But Your Magnificence Is Totally Manifest, For All To See

shers.roman:
Bazm e Dunya Meiñ Bazm e Mahshar Meiñ
Naam Kis Ka Huwa, Huwa Tera
shers.english:
In The Assembly of The World, Or In Hereafter’s Assembly,
Who Is The Most Prominent? It Is You, My Beloved Nabi

shers.roman:
ْ
رàðيْ
shers.english:
را ْ
اْ

shers.roman:
Husn Ye, Haq Numa Huwa Tera
Whoever Saw Me, Has Seen Allah Almighty,

Baar e ‘Isyaañ Saroñ Se Pheñkega
Pesh e Haq Sar Jhuka Huwa Tera
shers.english:
From Over Our Heads, The Burden of Sins, He Will Cast Away Entirely,
Whilst His Sacred Head, He Sincerely Prostrates, Before Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Yam e Jood e Huzoor Pyaasa Huñ
Yam Ghat’a Se Bar’ha Huwa Tera
shers.english:
For The Ocean of My Nabi’s Compassion, I Am Thirsty,
Instead of Receding, Your Grand Ocean, Rises Constantly

shers.roman:
Wasl e Wahdat, Phir Us Pe Ye Khalwat
Tujh Se Saaya Juda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Such Nearness To Allah, Yet With It, This Mystery,
From You, Your Shadow, Has Separated Completely

shers.roman:
San’e Khaaliq Ke Jitne Khaake Haiñ
Rang Sab Meiñ Bhara Huwa Tera
shers.english:
In The Designs of The Creator’s Creation, Entirely,
Your Shades Are Flowing, In All of Them, Perfectly

shers.roman:
Arz e Taibah Qudoom e Waala Se
Zar’ra-Zar’ra Sama Huwa Tera
shers.english:
On The Sacred Land of Taibah, By The Arrival of My Nabi,
Every Particle Therein, Is Fully Absorbed In You, My Nabi

shers.roman:
Ay Jinaañ! Mere Gul Ke Sadqe Meiñ
Takhta, Takhta, Basa Huwa Tera
shers.english:
O Heavens! It Is Through My Beloved Rose’s Beauty,
That All Your Flowerbeds Are Blooming Fragrantly

shers.roman:
Ay Falak! Mahr e Haq Ke Baar’ay Se
Kaasa, Kaasa, Bhara Huwa Tera
shers.english:
O Sky! Through The Sun of Truth’s Generous Charity,
Your Every Heavenly Region, Is Glowing Constantly

shers.roman:
Ay Chaman! Bheek Hai Tabassum Ki
Ghuncha, Ghuncha, Khila Huwa Tera
shers.english:
O Garden! Through His Sacred Smile’s Charity,
All Your Buds, Are Indeed, Blooming Beautifully

shers.roman:
Aisi Shaukat Ke Taajdaar Kahaañ
Takht, Takht e Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Where Else Is There A King, With Such Dignity?
Your Throne, Is The Throne of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Is Jalaalat Ke Shahr-Yaar Kahaañ
Mulk, Mulk e Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Where Else Is There An Emperor, With Such Glory?
Your Kingdom, Is The Kingdom of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Is Wajaahat Ke Baadshaah Kahaañ
Hukm, Hukm e Khuda Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Where Else Is There A King, With Such Authority?
Your Command, Is The Command of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Khalq Kehti Hai La-Makaañ Jis Ko
Shah Nasheeñ Hai Saja Huwa Tera
shers.english:
To That, Which People Say, ‘From Time And Space Is Free’
It Is Splendidly Adorned, As Your Grand Throne of Royalty

shers.roman:
Zeest Wo Hai Ke, Husn e Yaar Rahe
Dil Meiñ ‘Aalam Basa Huwa Tera
shers.english:
True Life Is That, In Which Resides, The Beloved’s Beauty,
Whilst Your Holy Realm Is Occupying My Heart, Completely

shers.roman:
Maut Wo Hai, Ke Zikr e Dost Rahe
Lab Pe Naqsha Jama Huwa Tera
shers.english:
True Death, Is While Remembering My Beloved Nabi,
Resolutely Upon My Lips, Your Blessed Name May Be

shers.roman:
Hoñ Zameeñ Waale Ya Falak Waale
Sab Ko Sadqa ‘Ata Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Be It The Earthly Beings, O Those In The Heavenly Galaxy,
All of Them Have Attained, The Blessings of Your Generosity

shers.roman:
Har Ghar’i Ghar Se Bheek Ki Taqseem
Raat Din Dar Khula Huwa Tera
shers.english:
He Distributed Alms, From His Blessed Abode, Munificently
Always Opened, Night And Day, Are Your Gates of Generosity

shers.roman:
Na Kahiñ Do-Sara Meiñ Tujh Sa Hai
Na Koyi Doosra Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Nowhere In Both Worlds, Like You, Is There Anybody,
Absolutely Peerless Like You, None Other Can Ever Be

shers.roman:
Sookhay Ghaat’oñ Mera Utaar Ho Kyuñ
Ke Hai Darya Char’ha Huwa Tera
shers.english:
On The Receding Shoreline, Why Should My Landing Be?
Whilst Your Grand Ocean, Is Rising Boundlessly

shers.roman:
Sookhay Dhaanoñ Ki Bhi Khabar Le-Le
Ke Hai Baadal Ghira Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Upon The Dried Grains, Place Your Sight of Mercy
For Your Clouds Are Now Gathering Abundantly

shers.roman:
Mujh Se Kya Le Sakay ‘Adu Imaañ
Awr Wo Bhi, Diya Huwa Tera!
shers.english:
How Can The Enemy, Take My Imaan Away From Me?
When It Is You, In Reality, Who Granted It To Me

shers.roman:
Le Khabar Ham Tabaah-Kaaroñ Ki
Qaafila Hai Lut’a Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Help Those of Us, Who Have Fallen Into Ruin Entirely,
For This Caravan of Yours, Has Been Pillaged Completely

shers.roman:
Mujhe Wo Dard De Khuda, Ke Rahe
Haath Dil Pe, Dhara Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Such Pain, May Almighty Allah Grant Me,
That, Resting On My Heart, Your Hand May Be

shers.roman:
Tere Sar Ko Tera Khuda Jaane
Taaj e Sar Naqsh e Paa Huwa Tera
shers.english:
The Majesty of Your Head, Your Creator Knows In Reality,
For The Crown of My Head, Is Your Footprint, So Holy

shers.roman:
Bigr’i Baatoñ Ki Fikr Kar Na Hasan
Kaam Sab Hai Bana Huwa Tera
shers.english:
Concerning Your Impaired Affairs, Hasan, Do Not Worry,
All Your Affairs, Have Already, Been Resolved Perfectly

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: MU’TIY E MATLAB TUMHAARA HAAR ISHAARA HO GAYA

shers.roman:
Mu’tiy e Matlab Tumhaara Haar Ishaara Ho Gaya
Jab Ishaara Ho Gaya, Matlab Hamaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
The Granter of All Our Wishes, Your Every Gesture Was Being,
The Moment You Gestured, Fulfilled, All Our Wishes Were Being

shers.roman:
‘Doobtoñ Ka Ya Nabi Kehte Hee, Ber’a Paar Tha
Gham Kinaare Ho Gaya, Paida Kinaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Immediately On Saying ‘Ya Nabi’, Those Who Were Sinking, Started Sailing,
All Their Difficulties Disappeared, The Shore’s Safety, They Were Locating

shers.roman:
Teri Tal’at Se Zameeñ Ke Zar’ray Mah-Paare Banay
Teri Haybat Se Falak Ka Mah Do Paarah Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Upon Your Advent, Like Moon Pieces, The Earth’s Particles Were Glowing,
By Your Grand Majesty, Into Two Pieces, The Sky’s Moon, Was Splitting

shers.roman:
Allah, Allah! Mahw e Husn e Roo e Jaanaañ Ke Naseeb
Band Kar Leñ Jis Ghar’i, Aankheñ, Nazaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
O My Allah! Lost In The Beauty of The Beloved’s Face, He, Who Is Being,
Such Is His Destiny, That When He Closes His Eyes, The Nabi, He Is Seeing

shers.roman:
Yuñ To Sab Paida Huwe Haiñ Aap Hee Ke Waaste
Qismat Us Ki Hai Jisay Keh Do, Hamaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Even Though To Honour You, Allah Created Every Single Being,
Fortunate Is The One, To Whom You Say, ‘Mine, You Are Being’

shers.roman:
Teeragi Baatil Ki Ch’haayi Thee Jahaañ Taareek Tha
Ut’th Gaya Parda Tera Haq Aashkaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
As The Obscurity of Falsehood Spread, Dark, The World Was Becoming,
But When Your Veil Was Lifted, Manifest The Truth Was Becoming

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Na Dam Deñ Marne Waale, Murg e ‘Ishq e Paak Par
Jaan Di Awr Zindagaani Ka Sahaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Upon The Bird of Pure Love, Why Must The Dying One, Not Be Dying,
As Soon As He Gave His Life, The Approval of True Life, He Was Receiving

shers.roman:
Naam Tera, Zikr Tera, Tu, Tera Pyaara Khayaal
Na-Tawaanoñ, Be-Sahaaroñ, Ka Sahaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Your Name, Your Memory, Imagining You, And Your Beauty, Glowing,
For The Helpless And The Feeble Ones, Their Shield, It Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Zar’ra e Koo e Habeeb, Allah Re, Tere Naseeb
Paaoñ Par’ Kar ‘Arsh Ki Aankhoñ Ka Taara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
O Holy Dust Particle of The Beloved’s Path! Truly Fortunate, You Are Being,
The Darling of The Arsh You Became, Whilst His Feet, You Were Touching

shers.roman:
Tere Saane’ Se Koyi Pooche Tera Husn o Jamaal
Khud Banaaya Awr Bana Kar, Khud Hee Pyaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
To Your Creator, About Your Grace & Beauty, Someone Should Be Asking,
After Creating You By Himself, As His Most Beloved, You, He Was Choosing

shers.roman:
Ham Kameenoñ Ka Unheñ Aaraam Tha Itna Pasand
Gham Khushi Se Dukh Tah e Dil Se Gawaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
About The Comfort of Ignoble Ones Like Us, So Deeply He Was Caring,
From The Depths of His Heart, For Our Comfort; Hardships He Was Facing

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Na Ho Tum Maalik e Mulk e Khuda, Milk e Khuda
Sab Tumhaara Hai, Khuda Hee Jab Tumhaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Over Allah’s Entire Kingdom, Why Shouldn’t You Be The King?
Everything Is Indeed Yours, When Yours, Allah Almighty Is Being

shers.roman:
Roz e Mahshar Ke Alam Ka Dushmanoñ Ko Khauf Ho
Dukh Hamaara Aap Ko, Kis Din Gawaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
The Agony of The Day of Reckoning, The Enemies Should Be Fearing,
When Will You Ever Bear To See Us, Enduring Any Form of Suffering!

shers.roman:
Jo Azal Me Thee, Wahi Tal’at Wahi Tanweer Hai
Aa-ina Se Ye Huwa, Jalwa Do Baara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
The Same Ray, The Same Refulgence, Which Manifested In The Beginning,
From That Manifestation It Appeared, Once More, It Was Manifesting

shers.roman:
Tu Ne Hee To Misr Meiñ, Yusuf Ko Yusuf Kar Diya
Tu Hee To Ya’qoob Ki Aankhoñ Ka Taara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
In Egypt, It Is You, Who Elevated Yusuf, To Be Yusuf, The Noble King,
As The Bright Star of Ya’qoob’s Eyes, It Was You, Who Was Glittering

shers.roman:
Ham Bhikaari, Kya Hamaari Bheek Kis Ginti Meiñ Hai
Tere Dar Se Badshahoñ Ka Guzaara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
Beggars We Are, In Getting Our Charity, What Standing Are We Having?
When Through The Alms of Your Court, Even The Kings Are Surviving

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan Qurbaan Jaawoñ Us Jamaal e Paak Par
Señkr’oñ Pardoñ Meiñ Rah Kar ‘Aalam Aara Ho Gaya
shers.english:
O Hasan! Upon That Purely Radiant Beauty, Sacrifice Your Entire Being,
Even After Residing Behind A Hundred Veils, World Adorning He Is Being

shers.roman:
Bayaañ Ho Kis Zabaañ Se, Martaba Siddique e Akbar Ka
Hai Yaar e Ghaar, Mahboob e Khuda, Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
With Which Tongue Can I Describe The Distinction of Siddique e Akbar
In The Cave, Allah’s Beloved, Is The Companion of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Ilaahi Rahm Farma, Khaadim e Siddique e Akbar Huñ
Teri Rahmat Ke Sadqe, Waasta Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
O Allah! Have Mercy, I Am A Servant, In Devotion of Siddique e Akbar
Through Your Divine Mercy, And The Mediation of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Rusul Awr Ambia Ke Ba’ad, Jo Afzal Ho ‘Aalam Se
Ye ‘Aalam Meiñ Hai Kis Ka Martaba, Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
In The World, After The Rasools & Ambia, The One With Highest Position
In The World, Who Holds This Status? It Is The Position of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Gada Siddique e Akbar Ka, Khuda Se Fazl Paata Hai
Khuda Ke Fadhl Se, Maiñ Huñ, Gada Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
From Allah, The Mendicant of Siddique e Akbar, Receives Distinction
By Allah’s Divine Grace, I Am A Beggar, At The Station of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Nabi Ka Awr Khuda Ka, Madh-Go Siddique e Akbar Hai
Nabi Siddique e Akbar Ka, Khuda Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
The One Who Praises Almighty Allah And His Nabi, Is Siddique e Akbar
The Nabi Is Siddique e Akbar's, Almighty Allah Is Siddique e Akbar's

shers.roman:
Zia Meiñ, Mahr e ‘Aalam-Taab Ka Yuñ Naam Kab Hota
Na Hota Naam Gar Wajh e Zia Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
When Would The World Illumining Sun, Be Known For His Illumination?
If The Reason For Brilliance, Were Not The Appellation of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Za’eefi Meiñ Ye Quw’wat Hai, Za’eefoñ Ko Qawi Kar Deñ
Sahaara Leñ Za’eef o Aqwiya Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
He Was So Strong In His Old-Age, To The Weak He Gave Fortification
O’ Weak & Strong Ones! Take The Strong Protection of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Khuda Ikraam Farmaata Hai, اْƸٰي Keh Ke Qur’añ Meiñ
Kareñ Phir Kyuñ Na Ikraam, Atqiya Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
In The Holy Qur’an, Allah Honours Him, By Saying, ‘The Most Pious Person’
Why Then Should The Pious, Not Show Veneration To Siddique e Akbar?

shers.roman:
Safaa Wo Kuch Mili, Khaak e Sar e Koo e Payambar Se
Musaf’fa Aa-ina Hai, Naqsh e Paa Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
From The Dust On The Step of The Nabi’s Court, He Got Such Illumination
A Radiant Glowing Mirror, Is The Sacred Foot Imprint of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Huwe Farooq o Uthman o Ali Jab Daakhil e Bay’at
Bana Fakhr e Salaasil, Silsila Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
Into The Oath of Allegiance, When Farooq, Uthman & Ali Took Admission
The Pride of All Spiritual Chains, Became The Chain of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Maqaam e Khwaab e Raahat, Chain Se Aaraam Karne Ko
Bana Pehlu e Mahboob e Khuda Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
In Order To Rest Peacefully, In His Comfortable Dream Station
Alongside Allah’s Beloved, Became This Station of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Ali Haiñ Us Ke Dushman, Awr Wo Dushman Ali Ka Hai
Jo Dushman Aql Ka, Dushman Huwa Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
Maula Ali Is His Enemy, He Has Become Maula Ali’s Open Opposition
The Adversary of Intellect, Became The Opposition of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Lut’aaya Raah e Haq Meiñ, Ghar Ka-ee Baar, Is Muhab’bat Se
Ke Lut’ Lut’ Kar Hasan, Ghar Ban Gaya, Siddique e Akbar Ka
shers.english:
Many Times, In The True Path, He Sacrificed His Home In Love & Devotion
Hasan! So Many Sacrifices Gave Birth, To The Mansion of Siddique e Akbar

shers.roman:
Nahiñ Khush Bakht Muhtajaan e ‘Aalam Meiñ Koyi Ham Sa
Mila Taqdeer Se Haajat Rawa Farooq e A’zam Saa
shers.english:
Amongst The World’s Destitute, Like Us, None Has Such A Bright Destiny,
We Have Been Blessed With An Aid, Like Farooq e A’zam In Our Destiny

shers.roman:
Tera Rishta Bana Shiraaza e Jam’eey’yat e Khaatir
Par’a Tha Daftar e Deen e Kitaabullah Barham Saa
shers.english:
Your Connection Became The Resource, For Gathering It Meticulously,
Somewhat Strewn, Were The Scrolls, of The Deeni Book of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Muraad Aayi Muraadeñ Milne Ki Pyaari Ghar’i Aayi
Mila Haajat Rawa Ham Ko Dar e Sultaan e ‘Aalam Saa
shers.english:
The Blessed Moment To Fulfil Our Wishes, Has Arrived Finally,
At The Door of The King of The World, Fulfilled Was Our Plea

shers.roman:
Tere Jood o Karam Ka Koyi Andaaza Kare Kyunkar
Tera Ik, Ik, Gada Faiz o Sakhaawat Meiñ Hai Haatim Saa
shers.english:
How Will Anyone Really Understand Your True Generosity?
Like The Generous Haatim, Your Every Servant Bestows Kindly

shers.roman:
Khudara Mehr Kar Ay Zar’ra Parwar Mehr e Nooraani
Siyaah Bakhti Se Hai Roz e Siyaah Mera Shab e Gham Saa
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake, O Consoler of The Frail, Shine Your Radiant Generosity,
Due To My Misfortunes, My Dark Days Are Like My Nights, Full of Misery

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Dar Se Jholi Bhar Muraadeñ Le Ke U’thenge
Na Koyi Baadshaah Tum Saa, Na Koyi Be-Nawa Ham Saa
shers.english:
We Will Rise From Your Court, With Our Wishes Granted Completely,
Like You, There Is No King, Beggars Like Us, None Others Can Be

shers.roman:
Fida Ay Umm e Kulthum, Aap Ki Taqdeer e Yaawar Ke
‘Ali Baba Huwa, Dulha Huwa, Farooq e Akram Sa
shers.english:
May I Be Sacrificed, O Umm e Kulthum, Upon Your Glowing Destiny,
Your Father Was Maula Ali, Your Groom Was Farooq, Full of Dignity

shers.roman:
Ghazab Meiñ Dushmanoñ Ki Jaan Hai Taygh e Sar Afgan Se
Khurooj o Rafz Ke Ghar Meiñ Na Kyuñ Barpa Ho Maatam Saa
shers.english:
Before His Sharp Sword, The Enemies’ Souls Are Trembling Hysterically,
Why Won’t There Be Mourning, In The Homes of Every Kharji & Raafzi?

shers.roman:
Shayaateeñ Muzmahil Haiñ Tere Naam e Paak Ke Dar Se
Nikal Jaaye Na Kyuñ Raf’faz e Bad-Atwaar Ka Dam Saa
shers.english:
Due To The Fear of Your Blessed Name, The Devils Are Exhausted Entirely,
Why Doesn’t The Soul of The Wretched Raafzis, Leave Them Immediately

shers.roman:
Manaayeñ ‘Eid Jo Zil-Hijjah Meiñ Teri Shahaadat Ki
Ilaahi Roz o Maah o San Unheñ Guzre Muharram Saa
shers.english:
Upon Your Martyrdom, Those Who Celebrate Eid In Zil-Hijjah, Happily,
May Their Every Day, Month & Year, Be Like Their Muharram, O Almighty

shers.roman:
Hasan Dar ‘Aalam e Pasti, Sar e Rif’at Agar Daari
Biya Farq e Iraadat Bar Dar e Farooq e A’zam Ka
shers.english:
O Hasan! In Your Weak State, If You Truly Desire Nobility,
Lower Your Head At The Court of Farooq e A’zam, Devotedly

shers.roman:
Allah Se Kya Pyaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
Mahboob e Khuda Yaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
Indeed, Amazing Is Uthman e Ghani’s Love, For Allah Almighty,
The Beloved of Uthman e Ghani, Is The Beloved of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Rangeen Wo Rukhsaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
Bulbul Gul e Gulzaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
The Handsome Face of Uthman e Ghani, Is So Vibrant And So Lovely,
The Nightingale Is Uthman e Ghani’s, And So Is The Garden of Beauty

shers.roman:
Garmi Pe Ye Bazaar Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
Allah Khareedaar e Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
This Marketplace of Uthman e Ghani, Is Sold Out Already,
The Majestic Purchaser of Uthman e Ghani, Is Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Kya La’al Shakar-Baar Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
Qand Aik Namak Khwaar Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
So Sweet Are The Lips of Uthman e Ghani, Bursting With Beauty,
A Mere Slave of Uthman e Ghani, Is The Sweetest Sugar Candy

shers.roman:
Sarkaar ‘Ata-Paash Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
Darbaar, Dur-Baar Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
The Most Beloved Nabi Blessing Uthman e Ghani, So Abundantly,
The Royal Court of Uthman e Ghani, Is Scattering Pearls of Generosity

shers.roman:
Dil Sokhto! Him’mat, Jigar Ab Hote Haiñ Than’de
Wo Saaya e Deewaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
O Aggrieved Ones, Have Courage! Your Hearts Will Be Pleased Shortly,
In The Shade of Uthman e Ghani’s Wall, You Will Soon Find Sanctuary

shers.roman:
Jo Dil Ko Zia De, Jo Muqad’dar Ko Jilaa De
Wo Jalwa e Deedaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
That Which Illuminates The Heart, And Which Brightens My Destiny
Is The Lustre of Uthman e Ghani’s Countenance, Shining So Brightly!

shers.roman:
Jis Aa-ina Meiñ Noor e Ilaahi Nazar Aaye
Wo Aa-ina, Rukhsaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
That Bright Mirror In Which Is Visible, The Light of The Almighty
That Mirror Is Uthman e Ghani’s Face, Reflecting It Beautifully

shers.roman:
Sarkaar Se Paayeñge Muraadoñ Pe Muraadeñ
Darbaar Ye Dur-Baar Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
You Will Get Whatever You Wished For, And Even More From My Nabi
This Royal Court of Uthman e Ghani, Is Scattering Pearls of Generosity

shers.roman:
Azaad, Giraftaar e Balaa e Do Jahaañ Hai
Azaad, Giraftaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
The One Who Is Free of Him, Is Seized In Both The Worlds By Calamity
The One Captivated By Uthman e Ghani, Is Free From Every Calamity

shers.roman:
Bimaar Hai Jis Ko Nahiñ Aazaar e Muhab’bat
Ach’cha Hai Jo Bimaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
The One Who Is Not Love Sick, Is The One Who Is Ailing In Reality
The One Ailing In Uthman e Ghani’s Love, Is The One Who Is Healthy

shers.roman:
Allahu Ghani, Had Nahiñ In’aam o ‘Ata Ki
Wo Faiz Pe Darbaar Hai Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
His Bounties And Blessings Are Boundless, Without Want Is Allah Almighty,
The Royal Court of Uthman e Ghani, Is Thriving From The Grants of Plenty

shers.roman:
Ruk Jaaye Mere Kaam, Hasan, Ho Nahiñ Sakta!
Faizaan Madadgaar Hai, Uthman e Ghani Ka
shers.english:
O Hasan! For My Work To Be Stopped, Is Not Even A Possibility
For The Generosity of Uthman e Ghani, Is Aiding Me Constantly

shers.roman:
Ay Hub’b e Watan Saath Na Yuñ Soo e Najaf Jaa
Ham Awr Taraf Jaate Haiñ Tu Awr Taraf Jaa
shers.english:
O Love For My Country, In This Manner, Towards Najaf Do Not Follow Me,
We Are Going In Another Direction, You Take Another Direction, Entirely

shers.roman:
Chal Hind Se, Chal Hind Se, Chal Hind Se Ghaafil
Ut’h Soo e Najaf, Soo e Najaf, Soo e Najaf Jaa
shers.english:
Let’s Leave Hind, Let’s Leave Hind, O Idle One, Let’s Leave Hind Swiftly,
Towards Najaf, Towards Najaf, Towards Najaf, Let’s Go Immediately!

shers.roman:
Phansta Hai Wabaaloñ Me ‘Abas Akhtar e Taale’
Sarkaar Se Paayega Sharaf, Bahr e Sharaf Jaa
shers.english:
O Star of Fortune! Why Are You Falling Into Misfortunes, Unnecessarily,
From Our Nabi, You Will Attain Dignity, Go Towards The Ocean of Dignity

shers.roman:
Aankhoñ Ko Bhi Mahroom Na Rakh Husn e Zia Se
Ki Dil Meiñ Agar Ay Mah e Be Daagh o Kalaf Jaa
shers.english:
Do Not Further Deprive The Eyes of The Radiance of This Beauty,
If In The Heart, O Spotless Moon! You Wish To Enter Graciously

shers.roman:
Ay Tal’at e Shah, Aa! Tujhe Maula Ki Qasam Aa!
Ay Zulmat e Dil Jaa, Tujhe Us Rukh Ka Halaf Jaa
shers.english:
O Countenance of My King, Come! By My Master’s Oath, Come Swiftly!
O Darkness of My Heart, Go! By The Oath of That Face, Go Swiftly!

shers.roman:
Ho Jalwa Fiza Saahib e Qausain Ke Naa’ib
Haañ Teer e Dua, Bahr e Khuda, Soo e Hadaf Jaa
shers.english:
Do Grace Us With Your Arrival, O The Arched Brow One’s Emissary!
For Allah’s Sake, O Arrow of My Dua! Towards The Target, Go Perfectly

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Gharq e Alam Hai, Durr e Maqsood Se Muñh Bhar
Neesaan e Karam Ki Taraf, Ay Tishna Sadaf Jaa
shers.english:
In Grief, Why Are You Sinking, Fill Your Mouth With The Pearl of Destiny,
O Thirsty Oyster Shell! Swiftly Go, Towards The Showers of Generosity

shers.roman:
Jilaañ Ke Sharaf Hazrat Maula Ke Khalaf Haiñ
Ay Na Khalaf Ut’h! Jaanib e Ta’zeem e Khalaf Jaa
shers.english:
The Noble One of Jilaan, Is The Descendant of Hazrat Maula Ali,
Rise O Ignoble One! Go Towards Honouring His Blessed Progeny

shers.roman:
Tafzeel Ka Jooyaañ Na Ho Maula Ki Wila Meiñ
Yuñ Ch’hor’ Ke Gohar Ko, Na Tu Bahr e Khazaf Jaa
shers.english:
Do Not Seek Pre-Eminence, In The Love of Hazrat Maula Ali,
Do Not Chase A Piece of Stone, By Ignoring The Pearl Entirely

shers.roman:
Maula Ki Imaamat Se Muhab’bat Hai To Ghaafil
Arbaab e Jama’at Ki Na Tu Ch’hor’ Ke Saff Jaa
shers.english:
O Heedless One! If You Truly Love The Imaamat of Hazrat Maula Ali,
Go Not, Leaving The Ranks of Those, Following The Jama’at Righteously

shers.roman:
Keh De Koyi, Gheyra Hai Balaaoñ Ne Hasan Ko
Ay Sher e Khuda, Bahr e Madad, Taygh e Ba Kaf Jaa
shers.english:
Hasan Is Surrounded By Calamities, So, Say To Him Somebody,
With Sword In Hand, Go To His Aid, O Lion of Allah Almighty!

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DARD E DIL KAR MUJHE ‘ATA YA RAB’B

shers.roman:
Dard e Dil Kar Mujhe ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
De Mere Dard Ki Dawa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Do Grant My Heart Love’s True Pain, O My Creator!
Then Grant Me The Cure For This Pain, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Laaj Rakh Le Gunahgaaroñ Ki
Naam Rahmaan Hai Tera Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Please Do Preserve The Sinners’ Dignity And Honour
Rahmaan Is Your Name of Divine Mercy, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
‘Aib Mere Na Khol Mahshar Meiñ
Naam Sat’taar Hai, Tera Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
My Faults, On The Day of Redemption, Do Not Uncover
Sat’taar Is Your Name of Divine Compassion, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Be Sabab Bakhsh De, Na Pooch ‘Amal
Naam Ghaf’faar Hai Tera Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Over My Deeds, Probe Me Not, For Nothing Should I Answer,
Ghaf’faar Is Your Divine Name of Clemency, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Zakhm Gehra Saa, Taygh e Ulfat Ka
Mere Dil Ko Bhi Kar ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
The Gaping Wound, Which The Sword of Love, Does Deliver
To My Heart, Also Grant This Wound of Love, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Yuñ Gumuñ Maiñ Ke Tujh Se Mil Jaawuñ
Yuñ Guma, Is Tarah Mila Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May I Lose Myself So Profoundly, That, To You, I Become Closer,
To Be Closer To You, May I Be Profoundly Absorbed, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Bhool Kar Bhi Na Aaye Yaad Apni
Mere Dil Se Mujhe Bhula Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Even By Error, Myself, I Should Never Remember,
Let My Heart Forget Me Forever, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Khaak Kar Apne Aastaane Ki
Yuñ Hameñ Khaak Meiñ Mila Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Make Me The Dust of Your Majestic Court of Honour,
Forever, Let Me Blend With The Dust, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Meri Aankheñ Mere Liye Tarseñ
Mujh Se Aisa Mujhe Ch’hupa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May My Eyes Search For Me, Yearning Forever,
From Myself, In This Way, Hide Me, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
T’ees Kam Ho Na Dard e Ulfat Ki
Dil Tar’apta Rahe Mera Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May The Throbbing Pain of Love, Linger Forever,
May My Heart Continue Yearning, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Na Bhareñ Zakhm e Dil, Haray Ho Kar
Rahe Gulshan Hara Bhara Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May The Wounds of My Heart, Remain Unhealed Forever,
Blooming With Pain, May This Garden Remain, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Teri Jaanib Ye Musht e Khaak Ur’ay
Bhej Aisi Koyi Hawa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Towards You, May This Handful of Dust, Soar,
Do Send Such A Powerful Gust, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Daagh e Ulfat Ki Taazgi Na Ghat’ay
Baagh Dil Ka Rahe Hara Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May The Brilliance of The Spot of Love Never Taper,
May The Heart’s Garden Bloom Forever, O My Creator!

shers.english:

shers.roman:
Jab Se Tu Ne Suna Diya Ya Rab’b
‘My Divine Mercy Precedes My Divine Ire’,
shers.english:
Ever Since This, You Did Declare, O My Creator!
Aasra Ham Gunahgaaroñ Ka

shers.roman:
Awr Mazboot Ho Gaya Ya Rab’b
The Hope of Us Sinners, Seeking Shelter,
shers.english:
Has Become Even Stronger, O My Creator!
ا

shers.roman:

ْي ْ æيHai
shers.english:
Mere Har Dard Ki Dawa Ya Rab’b
‘I Am To My Servant, As He Considers Me’ I Declare,

shers.roman:
Is The Remedy, To My Every Disorder, O My Creator!!
Tu Ne Mere Zaleel Haathoñ Meiñ
shers.english:
Daaman e Mustafa Diya Ya Rab’b
In My Despicable Hands, Which Have No Honour,

shers.roman:
Tu Ne Dee Mujh Ko Ne’mat e Islam
Phir Jama’at Meiñ Le Liya Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
The Great Gift of Islam, To Me, You Granted, Full of Honour
Then, Into The Ahle Sunnat, You Included Me, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Kar Diya Tu Ne Qaadiri Mujh Ko
Teri Qudrat Ke Meiñ Fida Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
You Made Me A Qaadiri, Granting Me This Great Honour,
Sacrificed Upon Your Power I Am Being, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Daulateñ Aisi, Ne’mateñ Itni
Be Gharaz Tu Ne Keeñ ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Such An Abundance of Blessings, And Fortunes So Dear,
Without Want, You Gave Me Such Blessings, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
De Ke Lete Nahiñ Kareem Kabhi
Jo Diya Jis Ko De Diya Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Whatever The Generous Give, They Do Not Take It Back Ever,
Whatever They Have Given To Whomsoever, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Tu Kareem Awr Kareem Bhi Aisa
Ke Nahiñ Jis Ka Doosra Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
You Are The Most Generous, And That Divine Benefactor,
That, You Are Absolutely Free From Any Partner, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Zan Nahiñ Balke Hai Yaqeen Mujhe
Wo Bhi Tera Diya Huwa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
I Know It With Certainty, And It Is Not Just A Conjecture,
For Even That, You Have Bestowed Upon Me, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Hoga Dunya Meiñ Qabr o Mahshar Meiñ
Mujh Se Ach’cha Mu’aamila Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
In The World, On Reckoning Day, And In The Hereafter,
I Wil Be Treated Justly In Everything, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Is Nikam’may Se Kaam Le Aise
Ye Nikam’ma Ho Kaam Ka Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
In True Work, Bless This Sluggish One, To Truly Endeavour,
May This Sluggish One, Become Truly Worthy, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Mujhe Aise ‘Amal Ki De Taufeeq
Ke Ho Raazi Teri Raza Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Guide Me Towards Such Deeds, By Your Divine Favour,
So That I May Attain Your True Pleasure, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Jis Ne Apne Liye Buraayi Ki
Hai Ye Naadaan, Wo Bura, Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
As For The One, Who Has Harmed Himself Altogether,
This Foolish Person, Is That Transgressor, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Har Bhalay Ki Bhalaayi Ka Sadqa
Is Buray Ko Bhi Kar Bhala Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Through The Virtue of Every Virtuous Believer,
Grant Devoutness To This Sinner, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Maiñ Ne Banti Huwi Bigaar’i Baat
Baat Bigr’i Huwi Bana Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
My Successful Matters, I Have Ruined Altogether,
Do Resolve All My Ruined Matters, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Meiñ Ne ٰ رæي اْƻٰي
Khaak Par Rakh Ke Sar, Kaha Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Glory Be To Allah, The Most Exalted, I Did Declare,
Whilst Keeping My Head On The Dust, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Sadqa Is Di Huwi Bulandi Ka
Pastiyoñ Se Mujhe Bacha Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
By The Sacred Virtue of This Exalted Stature,
Save Me, From An Inferior State, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Bonay Waale Jo Boyeñ Wo Kaat’eñ
Ye Huwa To Maiñ Mar Mit’a Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
If Those Who Sow, Will Only Reap What They Scatter,
If This Really Happens, Then I Am Over, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Aah! Jo Bo Chuka Huñ Waqt e Darow
Hoga Hasrat Ka Saamna Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Alas! As For That Which I Did Sow Or Scatter,
I Will Face Regret In The Hereafter, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Sadqa Maah e Rabi’ ul Awwal Ka
Geyhuñ Is Khet Se Ugaa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
By The Month of Rabi ul Awwal’s True Splendour,
In This Field, Let Some Wheat Appear, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Paak Hai Durd o Dard Se Jo Mai
Jaam Is Ka Mujhe Pila Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
From Any Alcohol or Anguish, That Drink Which Is Pure,
A Goblet of That Sacred Drink, Let Me Sip, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Kar Ke Gustarda Wo Khwaan e ادْْðي
Tu Ne Bandoñ Ko Di Salaa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
By Spreading That Spread of ‘Supplicate To Me’, O Divine Sustainer!
An Open Invitation To Your Servants, You Have Granted, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Aastaañ Par Tere, Tera Mangta
Sun Ke Aaya Hai Ye Sada, Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Present At Your Most Exalted Court, Is Your Humble Beggar,
He Has Arrived, After Heeding This Directive, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Ne’mat e ْاْ Se Paaye Bheek
Haath Phayla Huwa Mera Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Through The Blessings of ‘I Will Accept’ Your Prayer,
My Hands Are Humbly Extended In Prayer, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Tujh Se Wo Maanguñ Meiñ Jo Behtar Ho
Mud’da’i Ho Na Mud’da’a Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May I Always Beseech You For That, Which Is Truly Better,
As The Seeker, And Not By What Is Sought, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Mujhe Donoñ Jahaañ Ke Gham Se Bacha
Shaad Rakh, Shaad Daaima Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
From All The Sorrows of Both The Worlds, Protect Me Forever,
Forever Keep Me Satisfied And Delighted, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Mujh Par Awr Mere Donoñ Bhaiyoñ Par
Saaya Ho Tere Fazl Ka Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Upon Me, And Upon Both of My Brothers,
May The Shade of Your Mercy Remain, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
‘Aish Teenoñ Gharoñ, Ke Teenoñ Ko
Apni Rahmat Se Kar ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Bless All Three Houses With Comfort Forever,
Bless All Three, With Your Mercy, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Mere Farooq o Haamid o Hasnain
Dard o Gham Se Raheñ Juda Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May My Farooq, Haamid And Hasnain, Remain Secure,
From Sorrow And Grief, May They Be Away, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Lakht e Dil, Mustafa, Husain e Raza
Har Jagah Paayeñ Martaba Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Mustafa And Husain Raza, My Children, So Dear,
Everywhere, May They Attain Honour, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Saaya e Panj-Tan Ho Paanchoñ Par
Daaima Ho Teri ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Upon All Five, May The Shade of ‘The Five Virtuous Ones’ Linger,
May Your Blessings Remain Over Them Forever, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Donoñ ‘Aalam Ki Ne’mateñ Paaye
Murtaza Bahr e Mustafa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
The Bounties of Both Worlds, May Murtaza Also Acquire,
Through The Special Blessings of Mustafa, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
‘Ilm o ‘Umr o ‘Amal, Faraakh e Ma’aash
Mujtaba Ko Bhi Kar ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Knowledge, Long-Life, Good Deeds, And An Income, Secure,
Also Bestow Upon My Beloved Mujtaba, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Kar De Fazl o Ne’am Se Maala Maal
Gham, Alam Se Inheñ Bacha Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Your Grace And Favours, Upon Them Do Shower,
From Grief And Sorrows Protect Them, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
In Ke Dushman Zaleel o Khwaar Raheñ
Rad’d Rahe In Ki Har Bala Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Disgrace And Humiliation, May Their Enemies Suffer,
May All Their Catastrophes Be Repulsed, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Baal Beeka Kabhi Na Ho In Ka
Bol Baala Ho Daaima Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
No Harm Or Injury, From Anyone, May They Suffer,
Forever, Grant Them True Honour, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Meri Maañ, Meri Bahneñ, Bhanje Sab
Paayeñ Aaraam e Do Sara Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
May My Mother, My Sister, And The Sons of My Sisters,
Be Blessed With Comfort In The Both Worlds, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Awr Bhi Jitne Mere Pyaare Haiñ
Haajateñ Sab Ki Hoñ Rawa Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
And To Me, All The Others, Who Are Very Dear
May All Their Wishes Be Fulfilled, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Mere Ahbaab Par Bhi Fazl Rahe
Tera Tere Habeeb Ka Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
And Upon All My Acquaintances, Who Are Near And Dear
Shower Yours And Your Beloved’s Mercy, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Ahl e Sunnat Ki Har Jama’at Par
Har Jagah Ho Teri ‘Ata Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Upon Every Assembly of The Ahle Sunnat, Everywhere,
Please Shower Your Special Blessings, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Dushmanoñ Ke Liye Hidaayat Ki
Tujh Se Karta Huñ Iltija Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
For The Guidance of My Enemies, Is My Prayer,
For This, I Am Supplicating To You, O My Creator!

shers.roman:
Tu Hasan Ko U’tha Hasan Kar Ke
Ho Ma’al Khayr Khaatima Ya Rab’b
shers.english:
Let Hasan Rise, In The Most Beautiful Manner,
Bless Him With A Virtuous End, O My Creator!

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SAR SE PAA TAK HAR ADA HAI LA JAWAAB

shers.roman:
Sar Se Paa Tak Har Ada Hai La Jawaab
Khubrooyoñ Meiñ Nahiñ Tera Jawaab
shers.english:
From Head To Foot, Peerless, Your Entire Posture Is Being,
