Amongst The Most Stunning, Peerless Like You, None Is Being

shers.roman:
Husn Hai Be-Misl, Soorat La Jawaab
Meiñ Fida, Tum Aap Ho, Apna Jawaab
shers.english:
Your Beauty Is Matchless, Peerless Your Countenance Is Being,
Sacrificed I Am! The Parallel To Yourself, Only You Are Being

shers.roman:
Pooche Jaate Haiñ ‘Amal, Maiñ Kya Kahuñ?
Tum Sikha Jaawo Mere Maula Jawaab
shers.english:
What Should I Now Say? About My Deeds, They Are Constantly Asking,
O My Master! Teach Me The Answers, To The Questions They Are Asking

shers.roman:
Meri Haami Hai Teri Shaan e Kareem
Pursish e Roz e Qiyaamat Ka Jawaab
shers.english:
My Special Support, Your Gracious Magnificence Is Being,
This Is My Answer To The Inquiries, On The Day of Reckoning

shers.roman:
Hai Dua-eñ Sang Dushman Ka ‘Iwaz
Is Qadr Narm, Aise Phat’tar Ka Jawaab
shers.english:
To The Stones of The Enemies, With Duas, You Were Responding,
So Gentle And Forgiving, To Such Stones, Your Response Was Being

shers.roman:
Paltay Haiñ Ham Se Nikam’may Be-Shumaar
Haiñ Kahiñ Is Aastaane Ka Jawaab!
shers.english:
For Countless Lethargic Ones Like Us, You Are Caring,
Parallel To This Grand Court, None Other Is Being

shers.roman:
Roz e Mahshar Aik Tera Aasra
Sab Sawaaloñ Ka Jawaab e La Jawaab
shers.english:
Only Your Refuge And Protection On The Day of Reckoning,
The Unique Solution To Every Question, My Solution Is Being

shers.roman:
Maiñ Yad e Baiza Ke Sadqe, Ay Kaleem!
Par Kahaañ Un Ke Kaf e Paa Ka Jawaab
shers.english:
Upon Your Glowing Hand, O Kaleem! Sacrificed I Am Being,
But Equal To The Soles of His Feet, No Equal There Is Being?

shers.roman:
Kya ‘Amal Tu Ne Kiye, Is Ka Sawaal
Teri Rahmat Chaahiye, Mera Jawaab
shers.english:
When I Am Questioned, About The Deeds Which I Was Performing,
My Only Answer Will Be, Your Special Mercy I Am Seeking

shers.roman:
Mahr o Mah Zar’ray Haiñ Un Ki Raah Ke
Kaun De Naqsh e Kaf e Paa Ka Jawaab
shers.english:
Particles of His Sacred Path, The Sun And The Moon Are Being,
Anything Equal To His Sacred Footprint, Who Can Ever Bring?

shers.roman:
Tum Se Us Bimaar Ko Sehat Milay
Jis Ko De Deñ Hazrat e Esa Jawaab
shers.english:
From You, Complete Cure, That Ailing One Was Receiving,
Whereas As For Him, Certain Death, Hazrat Esa Was Predicting

shers.roman:
Dekh Rizwaañ, Dasht e Taibah Ki Bahaar
Meri Jannat Ka Na Paayega Jawaab
shers.english:
O Rizwaan! The Blooms of Taibah’s Desert, Do Be Observing,
Equal To A Perfect Paradise Like Mine, You Will Not Be Finding

shers.roman:
Shor Hai Lutf o ‘Ata Ka Shor Hai
Maangne Waala Nahiñ Sunta Jawaab
shers.english:
The Distinction of His Favours And Grace, Are Constantly Echoing,
A Negative Response, The Sincere Mendicant, Is Never Hearing

shers.roman:
Jurm Ki Paadaash Paate Ahl e Jurm
Ult’i Baatoñ Ka Na Ho Seedha Jawaab
shers.english:
The Penalties For Their Sins, The Sinners Would Have Been Facing,
To Warped Words, The Straight Answer, None Would Be Getting

shers.roman:
Par Tumhaare Luft Aar’ay Aa Gaye
De Diya Mahshar Meiñ Pursish Ka Jawaab
shers.english:
But, As A Shield, Your Benevolence, Was Then Appearing,
It Responded To All The Inquiries, On The Day of Reckoning

shers.roman:
Hai Hasan Mahw e Jamaal e Roo e Dost
Ay Nakeerain! Is Se Phir Lena Jawaab
shers.english:
In The Beauty of His Beloved’s Face, Absorbed, Hasan Is Being,
O Angels of The Grave! At Another Time, Let Him Be Answering

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JAANIB E MAGHRIB WO CHAMKA AAFTAAB

shers.roman:
Jaanib e Maghrib Wo Chamka Aaftaab
Bheek Ko Mashriq Se Nikla Aaftaab
shers.english:
In The West’s Direction, That Sun Shone Brightly,
As It Emerged From The East, Spreading Its Charity

shers.roman:
Jalwa Farma Ho Jo Mera Aaftaab
Zar’ra-Zar’ra, Se Ho Paida Aaftaab
shers.english:
If My Sun, Were To Shine Its Glowing Luminosity,
From Every Particle, A New Sun, Would Glow Brightly

shers.roman:
‘Aariz e Pur-Noor Ka Saaf Aa-ina
Jalwa e Haq Ka Chamakta Aaftaab
shers.english:
The Glowing Reflection of His Clear Face, Shining Brightly,
Is The Radiant Sun of The Manifestation of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Ye Tajal’li Gaah e Zaat e Baht Hai
Zulf e Anwar Hai Shab Aasa Aaftaab
shers.english:
This Is The Radiant Realm of The Light of Allah Almighty,
Resembling The Sun, At Night, Is His Hair Shining Brightly

shers.roman:
Dekhne Waaloñ Ke Dil Thanday Kiye
‘Aariz e Anwar Hai Thanda Aaftaab
shers.english:
The Hearts of Those Who Saw It, Attained Tranquillity,
His Radiant Cheek, Is The Glowing Sun of Tranquillity

shers.roman:
Hai Shab e Daijoor, Taibah Noor Se
Ham Siyah-Kaaroñ Ka Kaala Aaftaab
shers.english:
With The Sun And Moon In Conjunction, Taibah Glows Brightly,
The Sun of Sinful Ones Like Us, Is Blackened With Obscurity

shers.roman:
Bakht Chamka De Agar Shaan e Jamal
Ho Meri Aankhoñ Ka Taara Aaftaab
shers.english:
If My Fortune Is Made To Glow, By The Splendour of His Beauty,
As The Glowing Star of My Eye, The Sun Will Glow Radiantly

shers.roman:
Noor Ke Saanche Meiñ D’haala Hai Tujhe
Kyuñ Tere Jalwoñ Ka D’halta Aaftaab
shers.english:
In The Mould of Light, You Were Moulded Radiantly,
Why Will The Sun of Your Effulgence, Decline Really?

shers.roman:
Na-Khudaayi Se Nikaala Aap Ne
Chashma e Maghrib Se Dooba Aaftaab
shers.english:
You Brought To Rise, By Your Magnificent Authority,
The Sun, Which Had Set, In The West’s Fount Already

shers.roman:
Zar’ra Ki Taabish Hai Un Ki Raah Meiñ
Ya Huwa Hai, Gir Ke, Thanda Aaftaab
shers.english:
Is It The Dust Particle of His Path, Glowing So Brightly,
Or Has The Sun Fallen Down, Submitting Completely?

shers.roman:
Garmiyoñ Par Hai Wo Husn e Be Zawaal
Dhoondta Phirta Hai Saaya Aaftaab
shers.english:
That Non-Declining Radiant Sun, Is Now Glowing So Brightly,
The Sun Is Wandering About, In Search of Shade Desperately

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dar Ke Zar’ra Se Kehta Hai Mahr
Hai Tumhaare Dar Ka Zar’ra Aaftaab
shers.english:
To The Dust Particles of His Court, The Sun Is Saying Clearly,
A Dust Particle of Your Grand Court, Is A Sun, Glowing Brightly

shers.roman:
Shaam e Taibah Ki Tajal’li Dekh Kar
Ho Teri Taabish Ka Tad’ka Aaftaab
shers.english:
Whilst Observing The Evening of Taibah, Glowing Radiantly,
O Sun! The Splendour of Radiance, Will Dampen, Instantly

shers.roman:
Roo e Maula Se Agar Ut’hta Niqaab
Charkh Khaa Kar Ghash Meiñ Girta Aaftaab
shers.english:
If The Veil Were To Be Lifted, From The Face of My Master Entirely,
Whirling Whilst Revolving, The Sun Would Have Collapsed Dizzily

shers.roman:
Keh Rahi Hai Subh e Maulid Ki Zia
Aaj Andhere Se Hai Nikla Aaftaab
shers.english:
The Glow, On The Morning of His Glorious Birth, Said Ecstatically,
From Obscurity And Darkness, The Sun Has Appeared, Ultimately

shers.roman:
Wo Agar Deñ Nik’hat o Tal’at Ki Bheek
Zar’ra-Zar’ra Ho Mahakta Aaftaab
shers.english:
If He Grants The Charity of His Fragrance, And His Face’s Beauty,
Every Particle Will Be Transformed, Into A Sun, Smelling Fragrantly

shers.roman:
Talwe Awr Talwe Ke Jalwe Par Nisaar
Pyaara, Pyaara, Noor Pyaara Aaftaab
shers.english:
Sacrificed I Am Upon His Soles, And His Sole’s Luminosity,
So Superbly Beautiful, Is This Stunning Sun, Shining Brightly

shers.roman:
Ay Khuda! Ham Zar’roñ Ke Bhi Din Phireñ
Jalwa Farma Ho Hamaara Aaftaab
shers.english:
O Allah! Even Insignificant Ones Like Us, Will Be Granted Prosperity,
If Our Bright Sun Were To Appear, With All Its Glowing Luminosity

shers.roman:
Un Ke Zar’ra Ke Na Sar Char’h Hashr Meiñ
Dekh Ab Bhi Hai Sawera Aaftaab
shers.english:
On Judgment Day, Do Not Overwhelm His Slaves, So Quickly,
Behold, O Sun! There Is Sufficient Time, It Is Still Very Early

shers.roman:
Jis Se Guzre Ay Hasan, Wo Mahr e Husn
Us Gali Ka Ho Andhera Aaftaab
shers.english:
O Hasan! Through Whichever Place, Passes The Sun of Beauty,
That Radiant Sun of That Pathway, Disappears Completely

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: PUR NOOR HAI ZAMAANA SUBH E SHAB E WILAADAT

shers.roman:
Pur Noor Hai Zamaana Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
Parda Ut’ha Hai Kis Ka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
The Entire Universe Is Luminously Glowing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
As The Veils Are Lifted, Who Is Appearing?
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Jalwa Hai Haq Ka Jalwa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
Saaya Khuda Ka Saaya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Allah’s Divine Manifestation, Is Manifesting
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
The Divine Shade of Allah, Is Manifesting,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Fazl e Bahaar Aayi Shakl e Nigaar Aayi
Gulzaar Hai Zamaana Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
The Special Favours Are Abundantly Blooming,
The Countenance of The Beloved Is Appearing

shers.roman:
A Beautiful Garden, The Universe Is Becoming,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Phooloñ Ne Baagh Mahkay Shaakhoñ Pe Murgh Chahkay
‘Ahd e Bahaar Aaya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
With Fragrant Flowers, The Garden Is Blooming,
On The Branches, The Birds Are Chirping
shers.english:
The Most Glorious Period, Is Now Appearing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming,

shers.roman:
Pazh-Murdah Hasratoñ Ke Sab Khet Lahlahaaye
Jaari Huwa Wo Darya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
The Withered Fields of Those Who Are Yearning,
Are All Splendidly, Blooming And Flourishing

shers.roman:
That Enormous River Is Vigorously Flowing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Gul Hai Charaagh e Sar-Sar Gul Se Chaman Mu’at’tar
Aaya Kuch Aisa J’hoñka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
A Lamp In The Boisterous Wind, The Flower Is Being,
By This Fragrant Flower, Fragrant The Garden Is Being
shers.english:
Such A Perfumed Gust of Wind Is Blustering,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Qatra Meiñ Laakh Darya Gul Meiñ Hazaar Gulshan
Nashw o Numa Hai Kya-Kya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
In A Single Drop, Millions of Oceans Are Seen Flowing,
In A Single Rose, Thousands of Gardens Are Blooming

shers.roman:
Countless Elegant Adornments, Are Emerging,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Jannat Ke Har Makaañ Ki Aa-ina Bandiyaañ Haiñ
Aaraasta Hai Dunya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Adorned, Every Mansion of Paradise Is Being,
Like Glowing Mirrors, All Its Decorations Are Glowing
shers.english:
Beautifully Decorated, The Entire World Is Being,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Dil Jagmaga Rahe Haiñ Qismat Chamak Ut’hi Hai
Phayla Naya Ujaala Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
All The Hearts Are Lustrously Shining,
Their Destinies Are Radiantly Glowing

shers.roman:
A Fresh Illumination, Is Now Spreading,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Chikt’ay Huwe Diloñ Ke Mud’dat Ke Meyl Ch’hootay
Abr e Karam Wo Barsa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
In Grime, Those Hearts Which Were Soaking,
After Many Years, Purified, They Are Becoming
shers.english:
The Cloud of His Generous Mercy, Began Raining,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Bulbul Ka Aashyaana Ch’haaya Gaya Guloñ Meiñ
Qismat Ne Rang Badla Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
The Nest of The Nightingale Was Blooming,
Superbly Adorned By Flowers, It Was Being

shers.roman:
Transformed, The Colour of Destiny Was Being,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Arz o Sama Se Mangta Dawr’ay Haiñ Bheek Lene
Baañtega Kaun Baar’a Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
From The Earth And The Skies, Swiftly Advancing,
To Collect Their Charity, The Mendicants Are Coming
shers.english:
This Generous Offering, Who Will Be Distributing?
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Anwaar Ki Ziya-eñ Phayli Haiñ Shaam Hee Se
Rakhti Hai Mahr Kaisa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
Already, Since That Blessed Evening,
Luminous Lustres, It Is Now Spreading

shers.roman:
With Such Splendour, The Sun Is Shining,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Makkah Meiñ Shaam Ke Ghar Roshan Haiñ Har Nigah Par
Chamka Hai Wo Ujaala Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
In Makkah, The Devoted Eyes, Are All Witnessing,
The Mansions of Syria, From Here They Are Seeing
shers.english:
Such Powerful Radiances, Are Lustrously Shining,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Shaukat Ka Dabdaba Hai Haybat Ka Zalzala Hai
Shaq Hai Makaan e Kisra Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
By His Unique Grandeur, Which Is Awe Inspiring,
Due To His Power, Earthquakes Are Happening

shers.roman:
The Palace of Chosroe, Was Disintegrating,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Khutbah Huwa Zameeñ Par Sikkah Par’a Falak Par
Paaya Jahaañ Ne Aaqa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
On The Earth, Sermons of Praise, Were Echoing,
Established In The Sky, His Authority Was Being
shers.english:
The Universe Was Blessed, With A Noble King
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Aayi Nayi Hukoomat Sikkah Naya Chalega
‘Aalam Ne Rang Badla Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
A New Reign Is Now Commencing,
A New Currency Will Now Be Rotating

shers.roman:
Its Colour, The Entire Universe, Was Changing
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Rooh ul Ameeñ Ne Gaar’a Kaa’be Ki Ch’hat Pe Jhand’a
Taa ‘Arsh Ur’a Pharera Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
On The Roof of The Kaa’ba, Jibreel Was Descending,
A Consecrated Banner, There, He Was Hoisting
shers.english:
Upto The Grand ‘Arsh The Banner Was Flying,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Donoñ Jahaañ Ki Shaahi Naa-Khatkhuda Dulhan Thee
Paaya Dulhan Ne Dulha Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
The Royalty of Both Worlds Was Shining,
Like A Naive Young Bride, Newly Blooming

shers.roman:
Such A Joyful Groom, The Bride Was Receiving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Par’the Haiñ ‘Arsh Waale Sunte Haiñ Farsh Waale
Sultaan e Nau Ka Khutbah Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Those In The Heights of The ‘Arsh Are Reciting,
Whilst Those On Earth, Are Carefully Listening
shers.english:
To The Sacred Sermon, Praising The New King,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Chaandi Hai Muflisoñ Ki Baandi Hai Khush Naseebi
Aaya Karam Ka Daata Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
Truly Wealthy, The Beggars Are Becoming,
Their Handmaid, Good Fortune Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Their Generous Benefactor, Was Now Arriving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
‘Aalam Ke Daftaroñ Meiñ Tarmeem Ho Rahi Hai
Badla Hai Rang e Dunya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
In The World’s Official Record Keeping,
Some Vital Changes Are Now Happening
shers.english:
The System of The Universe Was Changing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Zulmat Ke Sab Registar Harf e Ghalat Huwe Haiñ
Kaat’a Gaya Siyaahaa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
All The Registers of Tyranny Were Fading,
Erased, All The Unjust Orders Were Being

shers.roman:
Completely Erased, The Inventory Was Being,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Mulk e Azal Ka Sarwar Sab Sarwaroñ Ka Afsar
Takht e Abad Pe Bayt’ha Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
The Very First King of The Kingdom, He Is Being,
The King of All The Kings, It Is He, Who Is Being
shers.english:
On The Throne of The Final Reign, He Was Sitting,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Sookha Par’a Tha Saawa Darya Huwa Samaawa
Hai Khushk o Tar Pe Qabza Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
Completely Parched, Lake Saawa Was Being,
Into A Huge Lake, Samaawa Was Transforming

shers.roman:
He Was Blessed With Control Over Everything,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Naw’waabiyaañ Sid’haareñ Jaari Haiñ Shaahi Aayeñ
Kach’cha Huwa ‘Ilaaqa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Their Unjust Kingship Was Finally Ending,
The Unjust Kings Were Now Lamenting
shers.english:
Totally Humiliated, They Were All Becoming,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Din Phir Gaye Hamaare Sotay Naseeb Jaaga
Khursheed Hee Wo Chamka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
After Adversity, We Are Finally Thriving,
Our Sleeping Destiny, Is Now Brightly Shining

shers.roman:
It Is Through The Radiant Sun, Which Is Shining,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Qurbaan Ay Do-Shamba Tujh Par Hazaar Jum’ay
Wo Fazl Tu Ne Paaya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
O Monday! Upon Your Magnificent Standing,
Sacrificed, A Thousand Friday’s Are Being
shers.english:
Such A Grand Position You Were Attaining,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Pyaare Rabi’ ul Awwal Teri Jhalak Ke Sadqe
Chamka Diya Naseeba Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
O Rabi’ ul Awwal! So Splendid You Are Being,
Through Your Healthy Splendour’s Blessing

shers.roman:
By Your Splendour, Our Destiny Started Glowing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Wo Mahr, Mahr Farma Wo Maah e ‘Aalam Aara
Taaroñ Ki C’haawoñ Aaya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
That Sun, Which Is Radiantly Commanding,
That Moon, Which Is World Luminating
shers.english:
In The Glittering of The Stars, He Is Arriving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Nausha Banaawo Un Ko Dulha Banaawo Unko
Hai ‘Arsh Tak Ye Shohra Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
Adorn Him As The Newly Arriving Young King,
As The Blessed Groom, Him, Do Be Adorning

shers.roman:
Upto The Grand Arsh, This Call Is Reverberating,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Shaadi Rachi Huwi Hai Bajtay Haiñ Shaadyaane
Dulha Bana Wo Dulha Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Everyone Is Ecstatically Celebrating,
The Sounds of Rejoicing Are Resounding
shers.english:
Such A Groom, That Blessed Groom Is Becoming,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Mahroom Rah Na Jaayeñ Din Raat Barkatoñ Se
Is Waaste Wo Aaya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
So That Deprived They Shouldn’t Be Remaining,
His Special Blessings, They Should Be Attaining

shers.roman:
This Is Why, The Beloved Nabi Was Arriving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
‘Arsh e ‘Azeem Jhoomay Kaa’ba Zameen Choomay
Aata Hai ‘Arsh Waala Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
The Magnificent ‘Arsh Was Ecstatically Swaying,
The Sacred Ground, The Holy Kaa’ba Was Kissing
shers.english:
The Splendour of The Grand ‘Arsh Is Arriving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Hoshyaar Hoñ Bhikaari Nazdeek Hai Sawaari
Ye Keh Raha Hai ‘Danka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
O Mendicant! Alert, You Should Be Enduring,
Very Close, His Conveyance, Is Approaching

shers.roman:
This Is What, The Broadcaster, Was Broadcasting,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Bandoñ Ko ‘Aish o Shaadi A’da Ko Na-Muraadi
Kar’kait Ka Hai Kar’ka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
For The True Slaves, There Is Comfort And Rejoicing,
For The Enemies, There Is Misfortune And Failing
shers.english:
The Stimulation of War, The Herald, Is Heralding,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Taare ‘Dhalak Kar Aaye Kaasay Kat’oray Laaye
Yaa’ni Bat’ega Sadqa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
All The Stars Are Now Gently Descending,
Their Vessels And Goblets, They Are Bringing

shers.roman:
The Distribution of Charity, Will Be Flowing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Aamad Ka Shor Sun Kar Ghir Aaye Haiñ Bhikaari
Gheyray Khar’ay Hai Rasta Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Upon Hearing The Exciting News of His Coming,
Together, The Mendicants Are Swiftly Gathering
shers.english:
The Entire Street, They Are Surrounding,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Har Jaan Muntazir Hai Har Deeda Rah Nigar Hai
Ghogha Hai Marhaba Ka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
Every Soul Is Enthusiastically Waiting,
Towards That Route, Every Eye Is Looking

shers.roman:
Welcome! Welcome! Everyone Is Proclaiming,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Jibreel Sar Jhukaaye Qudsi Paray Jamaaye
Haiñ Sarwe Qad Sitaadah Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
His Blessed Head, Jibreel e Ameen Is Bowing,
Their Wings, Dutifully, The Angels Are Folding,
shers.english:
Humbly, All The Illustrious Ones Are Standing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Kis Daab Kis Adab Se Kis Josh Kis Tarab Se
Par’hte Hai Un Ka Kalma Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
With Etiquette And Respect, They Are Standing,
With Enthusiasm And Devotion, They Are Standing

shers.roman:
His Blessed Kalima They Are All Proclaiming,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Haañ Deen Waalo Ut’ho Ta’zeem Waaloñ Ut’ho
Aaya Tumhaara Maula Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Now, O Genuinely Religious Ones! Do Be Rising,
Those Who Sincerely Honour Him! Do Be Rising
shers.english:
Your Magnificent And Noble King Is Arriving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Ut’ho Huzoor Aaye Shaah e Ghayoor Aaye
Sultaan e Deen o Dunya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
Rise! For Your Most Beloved Master, Is Arriving,
The One, With A Great Sense of Honour Is Arriving

shers.roman:
The King of The Religion And The World Is Arriving,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Ut’ho Malak Ut’hay Haiñ ‘Arsh o Falak U’thay Haiñ
Karte Haiñ Un Ko Sajdah Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Rise! For Now, The Angels Are All Rising,
The ‘Arsh And The Skies Are All Rising,
shers.english:
Before Him, All of Them Are Prostrating,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Aawo Faqeero Aawo Muñh Maangi Aas Paawo
Baab e Kareem Hai Waa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
O Mendicants! Come Swiftly, Without Delaying,
Proceed To Attain Whatever You Are Desiring

shers.roman:
Opened, The Door of The All Generous, Is Being
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Sookhi Zabaanoñ Aawo Ay Jalti Jaanoñ Aawo
Lehra Raha Hai Darya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
O Parched Tongues! Swiftly, Do Be Coming,
O Burning Souls! Swiftly, Do Be Coming,
shers.english:
The Ocean’s Waves Are Constantly Rising,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Murj’haayi Kaliyoñ Aawo Kumh’laaye Phooloñ Aawo
Barsa Karam Ka Jhaala Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
O Shrivelled Buds! Do Be Proceeding,
O Withered Flowers, Do Be Proceeding

shers.roman:
His Generous Rains, Are Now Pouring,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Teri Chamak Damak Se ‘Aalam Chamak Raha Hai
Mere Bhi Bakht Chamka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Through Your Grandeur, Radiantly Glowing,
The Entire Universe Is Luminously Shining
shers.english:
May My Destiny Also, Be Radiantly Glowing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Taareek Raat Gham Ki Laayi Bala Sitam Ki
Sadqa Tajal’liyoñ Ka Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
The Dark Night of Sorrow And Grieving,
The Wickedness of Tyranny, It Is Bringing

shers.roman:
By Your Radiant Rays, Bless Us With Wellbeing,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming
shers.english:
Laaya Hai Sheer Tera Noor e Khuda Ka Jalwa
Dil Kar De Doodh Dhoya Subh e Shab e Wilaadat

shers.roman:
Your Sacred Milk Has Brought This Blessing,
The Rays of Allah’s Light, It Is Manifesting
shers.english:
So, Purify My Heart, And Let It Be Glowing
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

shers.roman:
Baant’a Hai Do Jahaañ Meiñ Tu Ne Ziya Ka Baar’a
De-De Hasan Ka His’sa Subh e Shab e Wilaadat
shers.english:
In Both The Worlds, You Are Indeed, Distributing,
The Contributions of Radiance, You Are Dispensing

shers.roman:
To Hasan, His Humble Share, Do Be Granting,
On The Dawn, Gracing The Eve of His Coming

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JAAÑ BALAB HUÑ AA MERI JAAÑ AL GHIYAATH

shers.roman:
Jaañ Balab Huñ Aa Meri Jaañ Al Ghiyaath
Hote Haiñ Kuch Awr Saamaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O My Beloved, Do Come! I Am Dying, Please Help!
Even More Provisions I Am Needing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Dard-Mandoñ Ko Dawa Milti Nahiñ
Ay Dawa e Dard-Mandaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
No Remedy At All, The Ailing Ones Are Finding,
O Remedy For Those Who Are Ailing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Jaan Se Jaate Haiñ Be-Chaare Ghareeb
Chaara Farmaaye Ghareebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
The Abandoned And Poverty-Stricken Ones Are Suffocating,
A Solution To Their Poverty, Whilst Giving, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Had Se Guzre Dard Ki Be Dardiyaañ
Dard Se Be-Had Huñ Naalaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
All The Limits, The Brutalities of Agony Are Transgressing,
Due To This Agony, Discouraged I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Be-Qaraari Chain Leti Hee Nahiñ
Ay Qaraar e Be Qaraarañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Even For A Single Moment, Their Anxiety Is Not Subsiding,
O Peace of Those, Who Are Anxiously Waiting, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Hasrateñ Dil Meiñ Bahut Be Chain Haiñ
Ghar Huwa Jaata Hai Zindaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Due To My Heart’s Immense Yearning, Restless I Am Feeling,
Into A Prison, My House, Is Now Transforming, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Khaak Hai Paamaal Meri Koo Ba Koo
Ay Hawa e Koo e Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Everywhere, Completely Ruined, My Dust Is Being,
O Breeze of The Lane, of My Beloved King! Please Help!

shers.roman:
Al Madad Ay Zulf e Sarwar Al Madad
Huñ Balaawoñ Meiñ Pareshaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Please Help! O Sacred Tresses of My King, Please Help!
Trapped By Many Misfortunes I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Dil Ki Ulj’han Door Kar Gaisoo e Paak
Ay Karam Ke Sumbulistaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Tresses! My Heart’s Uneasiness, Do Be Removing,
O Sacred Hyacinth Garden of Generous Blessings, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Sar e Purnoor Ay Sirr e Khuda
Huñ Saraseema Pareshaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Radiant Head! O Almighty Allah’s Secret, You Are Being,
Extremely Confused, And Troubled I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ghamzadoñ Ki Shaam Hai Taareek Raat
Ay Jabeeñ Ay Maah e Taabaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
A Very Dark Night, The Evening of The Distressed Is Being,
O Forehead! O Radiant Moon, Brightly Glowing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Abru e Shah Kaat’ De Zanjeer e Gham
Tere Sadqe Tere Qurbaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Cut Through The Shackles of Grief, O Brow of My Noble King!
Upon You, Devoted And Sacrificed I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Dil Ke Har Pehlu Meiñ Gham Ki Phaans Hai
Maiñ Fida Mizhgaan e Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Entirely Ensnared By Grief, Every Part of The Heart Is Being,
Sacrificed Upon My Beloved’s Brows, I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Chashm e Rahmat Aa Gaya Aankhoñ Meiñ Dam
Dekh Haal e Khasta Haala Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Special Eyes of Mercy! Alive Once Again, My Eyes Are Becoming,
Whilst The Weak One’s Condition You Are Observing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Mardumak Ay Mahr e Noor e Zaat Baht
Haiñ Siyah Bakhti Ke Saamaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Pupil of The Eye! O Moon! In Which Allah’s Light Is Manifesting,
The Means To Remove My Misfortunes, You Are Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Tere Gham Ke Dil Meiñ Ch’hid Kar Rah Gaye
Ay Nigaah e Mahr e Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
After Your Grief Pierced My Heart, Therein It Is Now Residing,
O Sight of The Radiant Sun of My Beloved King! Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Karam Ki Kaan Ay Gosh e Huzoor
Sun Le Faryaad e Ghareebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Mine of Generosity, O Sacred Ears of My Beloved King!
As You Listen To The Pleas of Those Suffering, Please Help!

shers.roman:
‘Aariz e Rangeeñ Khizaañ Ko Door Kar
Ay Jinaañ Aara Gulistaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Glowing Cheeks! The Autumn Shades, Do Be Dispelling,
Heaven’s Gardens, O You Who Is Beautifying, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Beeni e Purnoor Haal e Maa Ba Babeeñ
Naak Meiñ Dam Hai Meri Jaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Luminous Sight! Our Weak Condition, Do Be Observing,
O My Beloved! Exhausted My Patience Is Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Jaañ Balab Huñ Jaañ Balab Par Rahm Kar
Ay Lab Ay Esa e Dauraañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
At The Threshold of Death, I Am, Have Mercy On The Dying,
O Lips! The Messiah of The Era You Are Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Tabassum Ghunchaha e Dil Ki Jaañ
Khil Chaleñ Murj’haayi Kaliyaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Smile! The Soul of The Heart’s Bud You Are Being,
For My Withered Buds, To Start Blossoming, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Dahan Ay Chashma e Aab e Hayaat
Mar Mit’ay De Aab e Haywaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Mouth! O Fountain of The Blessed Water of Living!
Grant Us That Nectar, For Ruined We Are Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Durr e Maqsad Ke Liye Huñ Gharq e Gham
Gohar e Shaadaab e Dandaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
To Acquire The Pearl of Destiny, In Grief I Am Drowning,
O Pearl of Those Brightly Glowing Teeth, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Zabaan e Paak Kuch Keh De Ke Ho
Rad Balaa e Be Zabaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred And Pure Tongue! Please Do Pronounce Something,
For The Distress of The Voiceless To Be Averting, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Kalaam Ay Raahat e Jaan e Kaleem
Kalma Go Hai Gham Se Naalaañ Ay Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Those Blessed Words! By Which The Kaleem’s Heart Was Soothing,
Extremely Distressed, The Muslims Are Now Lamenting, Please Help

shers.roman:
Kaam e Shah Ay Kaam Bakhsh e Kaam e Dil
Huñ Maiñ Na Kaami Se Giryaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O King of Our Actions! O You Who Grants What My Heart Is Desiring,
Due To All My Disappointments, I Am Bitterly Weeping, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Chaah e Gham Meiñ Huñ Giriftaar e Alam
Chaah e Yusuf Ay Zanakhdaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
In The Well of Grief, Completely Trapped, I Am Being,
O Well of Yusuf! O Sacred Chin’s Blessing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Reesh e At’har Sumbul e Gulzaar e Khuld
Reesh e Gham Se Huñ Pareshaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Beard! The Hyacinth of Paradise You Are Being,
By The Strands of Grief, Troubled I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Guloo Ay Subh e Jannat Sham’e Noor
Teera Hai Shaam e Ghareebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Throat! O Dawn of Heaven, O Radiant Evening!
Very Dark, The Evening of Calamities Is Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Gham Se Huñ Hamdosh Ay Dosh Al Madad
Dosh Par Hai Baar e ‘Isyaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Shoulder Please Help! Attached To Sorrows, I Am Being,
For The Burden of Sins, My Shoulders Are Carrying, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Baghal! Ay Subh e Kaafoor e Bahisht
Mahr Bar Shaam e Ghareebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Armpit! O Camphor Like Fragrance of Heaven’s Morning,
As You Shine Your Radiance, Upon Our Eve of Suffering, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ghuncha e Gul ‘Itr Daan e ‘Itr e Khuld
Boo e Gham Se Huñ Pareshaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O My Rose Bud! The Perfume Box of Heaven’s Scent, You Are Being,
Through The Odour of My Heartache I Am Agonising, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Baazu e Shah Dastgeeri Kar Meri
Ay Tuwaan e Na-Tuwaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Please Come To My Aid, O Sacred Shoulder of My King!
O Prevailing Strength of Every Weakling, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Dast e Aqdas Ay Mere Naisaan e Jood
Gham Ke Haathoñ Se Huñ Giryaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Hands! O My Showers of Generous Blessings,
Stuck In The Hands of Grief, I Am Lamenting, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Kaf e Dast Ay Yad e Baiza Ki Jaañ
Teera Dil Huñ Noor Afshaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Palm of The Sacred Hand! The Soul of The Hand Which Was Glowing,
Grant Me Your Radiant Light, For Dark Hearted I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ham Siyah Naamoñ Ko Ay Tahreer e Dast
Tu Ho Dastawez e Ghufraañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
To Those of Us With Sinful Registers, O Sacred Hand’s Writing,
The Certificate of Salvation, Only You Are Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Phir Bahaayeñ Ungliyaañ Anhaar e Faiz
Pyaas Se Hont’oñ Pe Hai Jaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Again, From Your Fingers, May Rivers of Blessings Be Flowing,
Due To Thirst, Upto My Lips, My Soul Is Reaching, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Bahr e Haq Ay Naakhun Ay ‘Uqdah Kusha
Mushkileñ Ho Jaayeñ Aasaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake! O Sacred Finger Nails! The Solver of Knots You Are Being
May All Our Adversities And Difficulties, Start Easing, Please Help

shers.roman:
Seena e Purnoor Sadqa Noor Ka
Be-Ziya Seena Hai Weeraañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Radiantly Glowing Chest! Grant Us Your Light’s Blessing,
Entirely Empty, This Lightless Heart Is Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Qalb e Anwar Tujh Ko Sab Ki Fikr Hai
Kar De Be-Fikri Ke Saamaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Radiant Heart! About Everyone You Are Always Worrying,
Whilst Granting Me A Means, To Avoid Stressing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Jigar Tujh Ko Ghulaamoñ Ka Hai Dard
Mere Dukh Ka Bhi Ho Darmaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Heart! Concerned About Your Slaves, You Are Being,
The Therapy For My Agony, I Am Expecting, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Shikam Bhar Peyt’ Saqda Noor Ka
Peyt’ Bhar Ay Kaan e Ehsaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Stomach! Grant Me That Light, Which Is Entirely Satisfying,
O Mine of Beneficence! With Blessings Truly Satisfying, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Pusht e Waala Meri Pushti Par Ho Tu
Roo Ba Roo Haiñ Gham Ke Saamaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Back of My Master! Your Support, Do Be Granting,
Before Me, Is The Means To End My Suffering, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Tere Sadqe Ay Kamar Basta Kamar
T’oot’i Kamroñ Ka Ho Darmaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Fortified Sacred Waist! Through Your Special Blessings,
For Broken Backs, As You Become Their Healing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Mohr e Pusht e Paak Maiñ Tujh Par Fida
De-De Azaadi Ka Farmaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Holy Seal On The Sacred Back! Upon You, Sacrificed I Am Being,
Whilst The Mandate of Freedom You Are Authorising, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Paa e Anwar Ay Sar Afraazi Ke Jaañ
Maiñ Shikasta Paa Huñ Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Luminous Feet! O Soul of Distinction, You Are Being,
O Beloved! Helplessly Broken Footed I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Naqsh e Paa Ay Nau Gul e Gulzaar e Khuld
Ho Ye Ujr’a Ban Gulistaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Foot Imprint! O New Rose, In Heaven’s Garden, Budding,
As A Garden, Let This Desolate Jungle Be Blooming, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Saraapa! Ay Saraapa Lutf e Haq!
Huñ Saraapa Jurm o ‘Isyaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Most Perfect One! O The Perfect Favour of Allah, Who Is Being
From Head To Foot, In Faults And Sins I Am Soaking, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay ‘Imaama Daur e Gardish Door Kar
Gird Phir-Phir Kar Huñ Qurbaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Turban! May This Era of Misfortune Be Rescinding,
Whilst Going In Circles, Sacrificed I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Neeche-Neeche Daamanoñ Waali ‘Abaa
Khwaar Hai Khaak e Ghareebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
The Lower Edge of The Sacred Mantle, Which Is Elegantly Hanging,
Humiliated, The Dust of The Poverty-Stricken Is Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Par’ Gayi Shaam e Alam Mere Galay
Jalwa e Subh e Girebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
An Exasperation, The Eve of Grief, Is Now Becoming,
O Luminance of The Skyline’s Morning, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Khol Mushkil Ki Girah Band e Qabaa
Band e Gham Meiñ Huñ Pareshaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Knot of The Robe! The Knots of My Worries, Do Be Opening,
Troubled By The Hindrances of Grief, I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Aasteeñ Naqd e ‘Ataa Dar Aasteeñ
Be Nawa Haiñ Ashk e Rezaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sleeve! The Gem of Generosity, Which Within You Is Hiding,
The Impoverished Ones Are Bitterly Weeping, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Chaak Ay Chaak e Jigar Ke Bakhya Gar
Dil Hai Gham Se Chaak Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sanctified Tear! The Tear of My Broken Heart, Do Be Healing,
O Beloved! Due To Heartache, My Heart Is Splitting, Please Help!

shers.roman:
‘Aib Khulte Haiñ Gada Ke Roz e Hashr
Daaman e Sultaan e Khoobaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
The Faults of The Beggar, Are Being Exposed On The Day of Reckoning,
O Blessed Edge of The Sacred Mantle, of My Beloved King, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Daur e Daaman Daur Daura Hai Tera
Door Kar Doori Ka Dauraañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
The Front Edge of The Garb, As Your Circuit of Rule, Is Flowing,
The Era of Immense Distance, Do Be Distancing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Huñ Fasurda Khaatir Ay Gulgoñ Qaba
Dil Khila Deñ Teri Kaliyaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Red Coloured Apparel! In A State of Frustration, I Am Being,
Let Your Buds, Allow My Heart To Be Blooming, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Dil Hai ‘Tukr’ay ‘Tukr’ay Paiwand e Libaas
Ay Panaah e Khasta Haalaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Like Patches On A Garment, Shattered My Heart Is Being,
O Refuge of Those, Who Are Always Worrying, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Hai Phat’ay Haaloñ Mera Rakht e ‘Amal
Ay Libaas e Paak e Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Completely Disintegrated, All My Deeds Are Becoming,
O My Most Beloved’s Sacred Clothing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Na’al Shah ‘Izzat Hai Meri Tere Haath
Ay Waqaar e Taaj e Shaahaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Sacred Footwear of My King! In Your Hand, My Honour Is Being,
O Honour And Dignity of The Crown, of Every King, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Ay Shiraak e Na’al e Paak e Mustafa
Zer e Nashtar Hai Rag e Jaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Strap of Mustafa’s Holy Footwear! Flowing With Blessings,
Under The Blade, My Jugular Vein Is Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Shaana e Shah Dil Hai Gham Se Chaak-Chaak
Ay Anees e Seena Chaakaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
My Heart Is Completely Shredded, O Shoulder of My King!
O Comrade of The Chest, Which Is Shredding, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Surma Ay Chashm o Charaagh e Koh e Toor
Hai Siyah Shaam e Ghareebaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Collyrium! O Apple of The Eye of The Mount Toor, You Are Being,
Completely Dark, The Evening of Calamity Is Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
‘Toot’ta Hai Dam Meiñ ‘Dawra Saans Ka
Reesha e Miswaak e Jaanaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
In A Short Moment, My Asthmatic Attack Will Be Subsiding,
O Strands of My Beloved’s Miswaak’s Blessing, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Aa-ina Ay Manzil e Anwaar e Quds
Teera Bakhti Se Huñ Hayraañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
O Reflection! O Station of The Angels, Brilliantly Glowing,
Distraught Due To My Dark Destiny, I Am Being, Please Help!

shers.roman:
Sakht Dushman Hai Hasan Ki Taak Meiñ
Al Madad Mahboob e Yazdaañ Al Ghiyaath
shers.english:
Under The Surveillance of A Dangerous Enemy, Hasan Is Being,
O Almighty Allah’s Beloved! To My Aid Do Be Coming, Please Help!

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: PAR’AY MUJH PAR NA KUCH UFTAAD YA GHAUS

shers.roman:
Par’ay Mujh Par Na Kuch Uftaad Ya Ghaus
Madad Par Ho Teri Imdaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
May I Never Face Any Grief Or Calamity, O Ghaus!
Your Aid Should Always Be My Sanctuary, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Ur’ay Teri Taraf Ba’ad e Fana, Khaak
Na Ho Mit’ti Meri Barbaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
After Dying, May My Dust Fly Towards You Instantly,
My Dust Should Not Be Wasted Ultimately, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Mere Dil Meiñ Baseñ Jalwe Tumhaare
Ye Weerana Banay Baghdad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
May My Heart Be Filled With Your Lustres of Luminosity,
Into Baghdad, Convert My Heart, Which Is Empty, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Na Bhooluñ Bhool Kar Bhi Yaad Teri
Na Yaad Aaye Kisi Ki Yaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
Your Remembrance I Should Never Forget, Even Forgetfully,
Nothing Else I Should Remember, In My Memory, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
‘Mureedi Laa Takhaf’ Farmaate Aawo
Balaawoñ Meiñ Hai Ye Naa-Shaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
Proclaiming ‘O My Disciple, Fear Not’, Come Instantly,
Due To Facing Calamities, I Am Very Unhappy, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Galay Tak Aa Gaya Seylaab Gham Ka
Chala Meiñ Aaiye Faryaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
The Floods of Grief Have Reached My Throat Already,
I Am Now Waning, I Need Your Aid Promptly, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Nashaiman Se U’ra Ka Bhi Na Ch’hor’a
Abhi Hai Ghaat’ Meiñ Say’yaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
After Causing Me to Fly From The Nest Forcefully,
The Hunter Is Still Waiting To Snare Me, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Khameeda Sar Giriftaar e Qaza Hai
Kasheeda Khanjar e Jal’laad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
With My Head Lowered In Shame, I Am Bound By Destiny,
The Sword of The Executioner Is Extended Already, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Andheri Raat Jangal Meiñ Akela
Madad Ka Waqt Hai, Faryaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
It Is A Dark Night, In The Wilderness, I Am Lonely,
It Is Time For Your Help, Please Aid Me, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Khila De Ghuncha e Khaatir Ke Tum Ho
Bahaar e Gulshan e Eejaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
Cause The Bud of My Heart To Blossom Attractively,
To The World’s Garden, You Are Its Glory, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Mere Gham Ki Kahaani Aap Sun Leñ
Kahuñ Maiñ Kis Se Ye Roodaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
Please Do Listen To This Story of My Grief And Agony,
To Whom Else Can I Narrate My Life Story, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Rahuñ Azaad e Qaid e ‘Ishq Kab Tak
Karo Is Qaid Se Azaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
From The True Bond of Love, Until When, Must I Be Free,
Set Me Completely Free, From Such Captivity, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Karoge Kab Tak Ach’cha Mujh Buray Ko,
Mere Haq Meiñ Hai Kay Irshaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
When Will You Bless A Sinner Like Me, With True Piety,
What Is Your Directive of Guidance For Me, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Gham e Dunya, Gham e Qabr o Gham e Hashr
Khudara Kar Do Mujh Ko Shaad Ya Ghaus!
shers.english:
The Grief of The World, The Grave And Reckoning Day’s Agony,
Set Me Free From It, And Bless Me With Being Happy, O Ghaus!

shers.roman:
Hasan Mangta Hai, De-De Bheek Daata
Rahe Ye Raaj-Paat’ Aabaad Ya Ghaus
shers.english:
O My Benefactor! Hasan Is Your Mendicant, Grant Him Charity,
May This Throne of Your Royalty, Flourish Continuously, O Ghaus

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KYA MUZHDA E JAAÑ-BAKHSH SUNAAYEGA QALAM AAJ

shers.roman:
Kya Muzhda e Jaañ-Bakhsh Sunaayega Qalam Aaj
Kaaghaz Pe Jo Sau Naaz Se Rakhta Hai Qadam Aaj
shers.english:
Today, What Life-Reviving, Glad-Tidings, Will The Pen Render,
Today, As It Very Gracefully Commences, Writing On The Paper

shers.roman:
Aamad Hai Ye Kis Baadshaah e ‘Arsh e Makaañ Ki
Aate Haiñ Falak Se Jo Haseenaan e Iram Aaj
shers.english:
Which Grand King Is Now Arriving, From The Heavenly Sphere?
That Today, From The Sky, Heavenly Beauties, Are Arriving Here

shers.roman:
Kis Gul Ki Hai Aamad Ke Khizaañ Deeda Chaman Meiñ
Aata Hai Nazar Naqsha e Gulzaar e Iram Aaj
shers.english:
This Autumn Withered Garden, Is Being Graced By Which Flower?
That Today, The Heavenly Garden’s Resemblance Is Seen Here

shers.roman:
Nazrana Meiñ Sar Dene Ko Haazir Hai Zamaana
Is Bazm Meiñ Kis Shah Ki Aate Haiñ Qadam Aaj
shers.english:
Their Heads, The Entire World, Is Waiting Ready To Offer,
Today, The Sacred Feet of Which King, Is Gracing This Sphere

shers.roman:
Baadal Se Jo Rahmat Ke Sar e Shaam Ghiray Haiñ
Barsega Magar Subh Ko Baaraan e Karam Aaj
shers.english:
Over The Evening Sky, The Clouds of Mercy Which Gather,
But Today, It Will Shower Its Blessings, When Dawn Is Near

shers.roman:
Kis Chaand Ki Phayli Hai Ziya, Kya Ye Samaañ Hai
Har Baam Pe Hai Jalwa Numa Noor e Qadam Aaj
shers.english:
Which Moon Spreads Its Glow, Illuminating The Entire Atmosphere?
Today, Upon Every Terrace, Is Glowing, His Radiant Foot’s Splendour

shers.roman:
Khulta Nahiñ, Kis Jaan e Maseeha Ki Hai Aamad
But’t Bolte Haiñ Qaalib e Be Jaañ Meiñ Hai Dam Aaj
shers.english:
Which Soul of The Messiah Is Arriving, Why Isn’t It So Clear?
Today, As The Idols Speak, There Is Life In The Lifeless Figure

shers.roman:
But’t-Khaanoñ Meiñ Wo Qahr Ka Kohraam Par’a Hai
Mil-Mil Ke Galay Rotay Haiñ Kuffaar o Saman Aaj
shers.english:
In The Temple of Idols, There Is Lamenting And Weeping In Anger,
Embracing Today, The Infidels And The Idols Are Crying Together

shers.roman:
Kaa’ba Ka Hai Naghma Ke Huwa Lawth Se Meiñ Paak
But’t Niklay Ke Aaye Mere Maalik Ke Qadam Aaj
shers.english:
The Kaa’ba Is Humming, I Have Been Cleansed From The Impure,
Get Out Today O Idols! I Am Welcoming, The Feet of My Master

shers.roman:
Tasleem Meiñ, Sar Wajd Meiñ, Dil Muntazir, Aankheñ
Kis Phool Ke Mushtaq Haiñ Murghaan e Haram Aaj
shers.english:
As I Pay Reverence, My Head Is In Rapture, My Heart & Eyes Are Eager,
Today, The Birds of The Haram Are Longing, To Welcome Which Flower?

shers.roman:
Ay Kufr Jhuka Sar, Wo Shah e But’t Shikan Aaya
Gardan Hai Teri Dam Meiñ Tah e Taygh e Do-Dam Aaj
shers.english:
O Unbelief! Lower Your Head, The Great Idol Destroyer Is Here,
Today, Under A Double-Edged Sword, Your Neck Is Under Pressure

shers.roman:
Kuch Ro’ab e Shahanshah Hai, Kuch Walwala e Shauq
Hai Turfa, Kashakash Meiñ Dil e Bayt o Haram Ka
shers.english:
It Is Partially His Magnificent Awe, And Partially The Spirit of Desire,
Today, The Bayt And Haram’s Hearts, Are Locked In Battle Very Rare

shers.roman:
Purnoor Jo Zulmat Kada e Dahr Huwa Hai
Roshan Hai Ke Aata Hai Wo Mahtaab e Karam Aaj
shers.english:
The Darkest Places On Earth, Are Now Glowing Full of Light And Lustre,
It Is Clear Today, That Moon of Mercy Has Appeared, Full of Splendour

shers.roman:
Zaahir Hai Ke Sultaan e Do ‘Aalam Ki Hai Aamad
Kaa’ba Pe Huwa Nasb Jo Ye Sabz, ‘Alam Aaj
shers.english:
It Is Obvious, That The Grand Emperor of Both Worlds Is To Appear,
So, Today, On The Kaa’ba, Has Been Hoisted, The Holy Green Banner

shers.roman:
Gar ‘Aalam e Hasti Meiñ Wo Mah Jalwa Figan Hai
To Saaya Ke Jalwa Pe Fida Ahl e ‘Adam Aaj
shers.english:
If In The Realm of Existence, That Radiant Moon, Did Finally Appear,
Devoted Today, Upon The Shadow’s Light, Are People of Another Sphere

shers.roman:
Haañ Mufliso Khush Ho Ke Mila Daaman e Daulat
Tar Daamano, Muzhda, Wo Ut’ha Abr e Karam Aaj
shers.english:
O Destitute Ones, Rejoice, You Have Acquired The Mantle of Treasure,
Today, That Cloud of Mercy Has Risen, Giving Glad-tidings To Every Sinner

shers.roman:
Ta’zeem Ko Ut’hay Haiñ Malak Tum Bhi Khar’ay Ho
Paida Huwe Sultaan e ‘Arab Shah e ‘Ajam Aaj
shers.english:
You Too Stand Up, For The Angels Are Now Standing In His Honour,
Born Today, Is The Arabian King, And The None-Arab Region’s Emperor

shers.roman:
Kal Naar e Jahannam Se Hasan Amn o Amaañ Ho
Us Maalik e Firdaus Pe Sadqe Hoñ Jo Ham Aaj
shers.english:
O Hasan! Tomorrow, We Will Have Safety And Security, From Hell-Fire
If Today, We Are Sincerely Sacrificed, Upon That Heaven’s Noble Master

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DASHT E MADINA KI HAI ‘AJAB PUR BAHAAR SUBH

shers.roman:
Dasht e Madina Ki Hai ‘Ajab Pur Bahaar Subh
Har Zar’ra Ki Chamak Se ‘Ayaañ Haiñ Hazaar Subh
shers.english:
Amazing Is The Desert of Madina’s Radiantly Sparkling Morning,
In The Glow of Every Speck, Visible Are A Thousand Mornings

shers.roman:
Munh Dho Ke Joo e Sheer Meiñ Aaye Hazaar Subh
Shaam e Haram Ki Paaye Na Hargiz Bahaar Subh
shers.english:
Without Hope, To Achieve A Daunting Task, Came A Thousand Mornings,
The Glory of The Haram’s Evening, Can Never Be Attained By Any Morning

shers.roman:
Lil’Laah Apne Jalwa e ‘Aariz Ki Bheek De
Kar De Siyaah Bakht Ki Shab Haaye Taar Subh
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake, As Charity, Grant Us Your Cheek’s Radiant Blessings,
Transform The Night of The Unfortunate Ones, Into A Bright Morning

shers.roman:
Roshan Hai Un Ke Jalwa e Rangeeñ Ki Taabisheñ
Bulbul! Haiñ Jam’ Aik Chaman Meiñ Hazaar Subh
shers.english:
The Splendours of His Radiant Countenance, Are Now Radiantly Glowing,
O Nightingale! In A Single Garden, Gathered Are A Thousand Mornings

shers.roman:
Rakhti Hai Shaam e Taibah Kuch Aisi Tajal’liyaañ
Sau Jaan Se Ho Jis Ki Ada Par Nisaar Subh
shers.english:
Such Astonishing Splendours, Taibah’s Evening Is Possessing,
Upon Its Perfection, With All Its Heart, Sacrificed Is The Morning

shers.roman:
Nisbat Nahiñ Sahar Ko Girebaan e Paak Se
Josh e Farogh Se Hai Yahaañ Taar-Taar Subh
shers.english:
To His Sacred Collar, No Comparison Daybreak Is Having,
In The Fervour of Brilliance, Here, Shredded Is The Morning

shers.roman:
Aate Haiñ Paasbaan e Dar e Shah, Falak Se Roz
Sat’tar Hazaar Shaam To Sat’tar Hazaar Subh
shers.english:
Daily From The Heavens, Sentries of The King’s Court, Are Descending,
Seventy Thousand In The Evening, Then, Seventy Thousand In The Morning

shers.roman:
Ay Zar’ra e Madina Khudara Nigaah e Mahr
Tar’ke Se Dekhti Hai Tera Intizaar Subh
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake! O Particle of Madina, With Love, At Us Be Glancing,
Ever Since Dawn, Anticipating Your Blessed Arrival, Is The Morning

shers.roman:
Zulf e Huzoor o ‘Aariz e Purnoor Par Nisaar
Kya Noor Baar Shaam Hai Kya Jalwa Baar Subh
shers.english:
Sacrificed Upon My Nabi’s Tresses, And Radiant Cheeks, I Am Being,
What A Light Scattering Evening, What A Splendour Filled Morning!

shers.roman:
Noor e Wilaadat e Mah e Batha Ka Faiz Hai
Rehti Hai Jannatoñ Meiñ Jo Layl o Nahaar Subh
shers.english:
The Blessings of The Radiant Birth of The Meccan Moon, It Is Being,
That In The Heavens, Day And Night, It Is Always A Bright Morning

shers.roman:
Har Zar’ra e Haram Se Numaayaañ Hazaar Mahr
Har Mahr Se Tuloo’ Kunaañ Be Shumaar Subh
shers.english:
In Every Particle of The Haram, A Thousand Suns, Are Seen Glowing,
From Every Sun, Noticeably Rising, Are Countless Radiant Mornings

shers.roman:
Gaisoo Ke Ba’ad Yaad Ho Rukhsaar e Paak Ki
Ho Mushk-Baar Shaam Ki Kaafoor Baar Subh
shers.english:
After Admiring His Tresses, His Sacred Cheeks, I Am Remembering,
May The Musk Fragranced Evening, Be A Camphor Emitting Morning

shers.roman:
Kya Noor e Dil Ko Najdi e Teera Darooñ Se Kaam
Taa Hashr Shaam Se Na Milay Zin-Haar Subh
shers.english:
To The Heart’s Glow, What Connection Are The Evil Spirited Najdis Having?
Until Qiyaamat, May Their Evening, Never Meet The Refuge of Morning

shers.roman:
Husn e Shabaab e Zar’ra e Taibah Kuch Awr Hai
Kya Kor e Baatin Aa-ina Kya Sheer Khwaar Subh
shers.english:
Unique, The Pinnacle of The Beauty, of Taibah’s Particle Is Being,
What Comparison Does The Benighted Spirit Have To A Pure Morning!

shers.roman:
Bas Chal Sakay To Shaam Se Pehle Safar Kare
Taibah Ki Haaziri Ke Liye Be Qaraar Subh
shers.english:
If It Is In Your Power, Then Try To Journey Before Evening,
To Present Itself In Madina Shareef, Restless, Is The Morning

shers.roman:
Maayoos Kyuñ Ho Khaak Nasheeñ Husn e Yaar Se
Aakhir Ziya e Zar’ra Ki Hai Zimma-Daar Subh
shers.english:
Deprived of The Beloved’s Beauty, Why Should The Modest Be Feeling?
For Ultimately, The Particle’s Glow, Is The Responsibility of The Morning

shers.roman:
Kya Dasht e Paak e Taibah Se Aayi Hai Ay Hasan
Laayi Jo Apni Jeyb Meiñ Naqd e Bahaar Subh
shers.english:
O Hasan! From Taibah’s Consecrated Desert, What Is Now Coming?
The Wealth of Beauty, In Its Pocket, Which Was Brought By The Morning

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JO NOOR BAAR HUWA AAFTAAB E HUSN E MALEEH

shers.roman:
Jo Noor Baar Huwa Aaftaab e Husn e Maleeh
Huwe Zameen o Zamaañ Kaamiyaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
When It’s Light Was Scattered, By The Sun of His Charming Beauty
Space And Time Became The Triumphs of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Zawaal Mahr Ko Ho Maah Ka Jamaal Ghat’ay
Magar Hai Awj e Abad Par Shabaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
The Moon Is Seen Waning, Reduced, Becomes The Sun’s Beauty
But Forever At Its Zenith, Is The Pinnacle of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Zameeñ Ke Phool Girebaañ Dareeda e Gham e ‘Ishq
Falak Pe Badr e Dil-Afgaar Taab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
The Earthly Flowers, Are Now Ripping Their Receptacles, In Love’s Agony
The Heartbroken Moon In The Sky, Is The Lustre of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Diloñ Ki Jaan Hai Lutf e Sabaahat e Yusuf
Magar Huwa Hai Na Hoga Jawaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
The Pure Essence of The Heart, Is Yusuf’s Attractive Graceful Beauty
But Neither Was, Nor Will There Be, A Parallel To His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Ilaahi Maut Se Yuñ Aaye Mujh Ko Meet’hi Neend
Rahe Khayaal Ki Raahat, Ho Khwaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
By Way of Death, Grant Me Such A Peaceful Sleep, O Allah Almighty!
With The Comfort of Thoughts, As I Dream of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Jamaal Waaloñ Meiñ Hai Shor e ‘Ishq, Awr Abhi
Hazaar Pardoñ Meiñ Hai Aab o Taab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
The Most Beautiful Ones Are Already Overwhelmed, By Love’s Ecstasy
Yet Still Behind A Thousand Veils, Is The Glory of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Zameen e Shor Banay Takhta e Gul o Sumbul
‘Araq Fishaañ Ho Agar Aab o Taab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Non-Fertile Land Will Become A Bed of Roses And Hyacinths Instantly,
If Graced By The Perspiration, of The Splendour of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Nisaar e Daulat e Bedaar o Taali-e’ Azwaaj
Na Dekhi Chashm e Zulaikha Ne Khwaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Upon The Good-Fortune of His Children And His Wives, Sacrificed Are We
Even In Her Dream, Zulaikha’s Eyes, Did Not See Such Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Tajal’liyoñ Ne Namak Bhar Diya Hai Aankhoñ Meiñ
Malaahat Aap Huwi Hai, Hijaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Like Salt In The Eyes, His Lustres, Enhanced My Longing Instantly
Captivation Itself, Became The Veil, of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Namak Ka Khaasa Hai Apne Kaif Par Laana
Har Aik Shay Na Ho Kyuñ Bahra Yaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Enhancing Its Individual Essence, Is Salt’s Extraordinary Quality,
Why Should Every Entity Not Benefit, From His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
‘Asal Ho Aab Baneñ Koozaha e Qand Habaab
Jo Bahr e Shor Meiñ Ho ‘Aks e Aab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Water Will Turn To Honey, Becoming Foam, Filled With Sugar Candy,
If In The Salty Ocean, Reflects The Sparkle, of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Dil e Sabaahat e Yusuf Meiñ Sauz e ‘Ishq e Huzoor
Nabaat o Qand Huwe Haiñ Kabaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
In The Heart of Yusuf’s Desirability, Is The Burning Love of My Nabi,
Sweets And Sugar Are Sizzling Like Kebabs, In His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Sabeeh Hoñ Ke Sabaahat Jameel Hoñ Ke Jamaal
Gharaz Sabhi Haiñ Namak Khwaar e Baab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Be It The Attractive Or Its Attraction, Be It The Beautiful Or Its Beauty
Ultimately All Are Slaves, At The Holy Gate of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Khulay Jab Aankh Nazar Aaye Wo Malaahat e Paak
Bayaaz e Subh Ho Ya Rab’b Kitaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
When I Ultimately Open My Eyes, May I See His Pure Captivating Beauty
O Allah! May The Light of Dawn, Be The Book of His Captivating Beauty

shers.roman:
Hayaat e Be-Maza Ho Bakht e Teera Meedaaram
Ba-Taab Ay Mah e Gardooñ Janaab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
An Unhappy Life, Filled With Misfortunes, I Am Facing Constantly,
Shine Upon Me, O Heavenly Moon! O Master of Captivating Beauty!

shers.roman:
Hasan Ki Pyaas Buj’ha Kar Naseeb Chamka De
Tere Nisaar Maiñ, Ay Aab o Taab e Husn e Maleeh
shers.english:
Whilst Quenching Hasan’s Thirst, Please Brighten His Destiny
I Am Sacrificed Upon You, O The Glory of His Captivating Beauty

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SAHAAB E RAHMAT E BAARI HAI BAARHWEEÑ TAARIKH

shers.roman:
Sahaab e Rahmat e Baari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
Karam Ka Chashma e Jaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
The Sacred Cloud of Almighty Allah’s Mercy, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being
A Constantly Flowing Fountain of Generosity, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Hameñ To Jaan Se Pyaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
‘Adu Ke Dil Ko Kat’aari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
More Precious To Us Than Our Own Lives, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being
Like A Dagger To The Heart of The Enemy, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Isi Ne Mausam e Gul Ko Kiya Hai Mausam e Gul
Bahaar e Fasl e Bahaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
It Is This, Which Made The Spring Season, A Season of Blooming
The Flourishing of The Spring Season, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Nabi Hai Surma e Chashm e Baseerat o Imaañ
Ut’hi Jo Gard e Sawaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
The Collyrium of Pure Foresight And True Faith, Our Nabi Is Being
When The Dust of His Procession Rose, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Hazaar ‘Eid Hoñ Aik-Aik Lahza Par Qurbaañ
Khushi Diloñ Pe Wo Taari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
Upon Its Every Moment, Sacrificed, A Thousand Eids Are Being
When Our Hearts Are Immersed In Joy, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Falak Pe ‘Arsh Bareeñ Ka Gumaan Hota Hai
Zameen e Khuld Ki Kyaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
Upon The Heavens, About The Highest Heaven, We Are Thinking
The Flower Garden of Heaven on Earth, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Tamaam Ho Gayi Meelad e Ambia Ki Khushi
Hamesha Ab Teri Baari Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
Completed, The Joy of The Sacred Births, of All The Nabis Is Being
Now, Forever It Is Your Turn, Our Nabi’s Twelfth You Are Being

shers.roman:
Diloñ Ke Meyl Dhulay, Gul Khilay, Suroor Milay
‘Ajeeb Chashma e Jaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
The Heart’s Stains Are Waning, Flowers Are Blooming, Joy Is Spreading
Such A Spectacular Flowing Fountain, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Char’hi Hai Awj Pe Taqdeer Khaaksaaroñ Ki
Khuda Ne Jab Se Utaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
Upto Its Zenith, The Destiny of The Humble Slaves Is Reaching
Ever Since, Sent By Allah Almighty, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Khuda Ke Fazl Se Imaan Meiñ Haiñ Ham Poore
Ke Apni Rooh Meiñ Saari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
By The Grace of Allah, In Our Imaan, Successful We Are Being
For Constantly Flowing In Our Soul, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Wilaadat e Shah e Deeñ Har Khushi Ki Baa’is Hai
Hazaar ‘Eid Se Bhaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
Every Joy, The Blessed Birth of The Noble King of Deen, Is Bringing
More Precious Than A Thousand Eids, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Hamesha Tu Ne Ghulaamoñ Ke Dil Kiye T’hand’ay
Jalay Jo Tujh Se Wo Naari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
To The Hearts of Your True Slaves, Always Solace You Are Granting
He Is An Inmate of Hell, If An Enemy of Our Nabi’s Twelfth, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Khushi Hai Ahl e Sunan Meiñ Magar ‘Adu Ke Yahaañ
Fughaan o Shewan o Zaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
The Ahl e Sunnat Are Rejoicing, But Amongst The Enemies, We Are Seeing,
Weeping, Mourning And Wailing, Because, Our Nabi’s Twelfth It Is Being

shers.roman:
Jid’har Gaya, Suni Aawaaz Ya Rasool’Allah!
Har Ik Jagah Usay Khwaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
Wherever The Deviant Goes, The Echoes of ‘Ya Rasool’Allah’ He Is Hearing
No Matter Where He Goes, Anguish For Him, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
‘Adu Wilaadat e Shaitaañ Ke Din Manaaye Khushi
Ke ‘Eid ‘Eid Hamaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
On The Day Shaitaan Was Created, The Enemies Are Celebrating
Our Day of Rejoicing And Celebrating, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

shers.roman:
Hasan Wilaadat e Sarkaar Se Huwa Roshan
Mere Khuda Ko Bhi Pyaari Hai Baarhweeñ Taarikh
shers.english:
O Hasan! The Blessed Birth of The Beloved Nabi, Is Illustrating
Even Beloved To My Almighty Creator, Our Nabi’s Twelfth Is Being

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ZAAT E WAALA PE BAAR-BAAR DUROOD

shers.roman:
Zaat e Waala Pe Baar-Baar Durood
Baar-Baar Awr Be-Shumaar Durood
shers.english:
Upon The Most Noble Personality, Continuous Benedictions
Continuous Benedictions, And Countless Benedictions

shers.roman:
Roo e Anwar Pe Noor Baar Salaam
Zulf e At’har Pe Mushk-Baar Durood
shers.english:
Upon His Glowing Face, Light Scattering Salutations
Upon His Fragrant Tresses, Scent Scattering Benedictions

shers.roman:
Us Mahak Par Shameem Bez Salaam
Us Chamak Pe Farogh-Baar Durood
shers.english:
Upon That Fragrance, Fragrance Scattering Salutations
Upon That Pure Lustre, Radiance Scattering Benedictions

shers.roman:
Un Ke Har Jalwa Par Hazaar Salaam
Un Ke Har Lam’a Par Hazaar Durood
shers.english:
Upon His Every Splendour, Thousands of Salutations
Upon His Every Lustre, Thousands of Benedictions

shers.roman:
Un Ki Tal’at Par Jalwa-Rez Salaam
Un Ki Nak’hat Pe ‘Itr-Baar Durood
shers.english:
Upon His Holy Countenance, Manifest Salutations
Upon His Every Scent, Perfume Scattering Benedictions

shers.roman:
Jis Ki Khushboo Bahaar e Khuld Basaaye
Hai Wo Mahboob e Gul-‘Izaar Durood
shers.english:
The One, Whose Fragrance, Is The Heavenly Bloom’s Fusion
He Is The Rosy Cheeked Beloved, Upon Him Benedictions

shers.roman:
Sar Se Paa Tak Karor Baar Salaam
Awr Saraapa Pe Be-Shumaar Durood
shers.english:
From His Sacred Head To His Holy Feet, Billions of Salutations
And Upon His Completely Perfect Body, Countless Benedictions

shers.roman:
Dil Ke Hamrah Hoñ Salaam Fida
Jaan Ke Saath Ho Nisaar Durood
shers.english:
Together With My Heart, Sacrificed Are The Salutations
Together With My Devoted Soul, Offered Are Benedictions

shers.roman:
Chaara e Jaan Dard-Mand Salaam
Marham e Seena e Figaar Durood
shers.english:
The Ultimate Remedy, For The Soul of The Agonising, Salutations
The Ointment For The Sad Lover’s Wounded Chest, Benedictions

shers.roman:
Be ‘Adad Awr Be ‘Adad Tasleem
Be-Shumaar Awr Be-Shumaar Durood
shers.english:
Limitless Humble Benedictions, Limitless More Respectful Salutations
Countless Humble Salutations, Further Countless Humble Benedictions

shers.roman:
Bayt’h-te Ut’h-te Jaagte Sotay
Ho Ilaahi Mera Shi’aar Durood
shers.english:
While Sitting And Standing, While Awake And In The Sleeping Position
O Allah Almighty! May My Reverential Manner, Be Benedictions

shers.roman:
Shahr-Yaar e Rusul Ki Nazr Karuñ
Sab Duroodoñ Ki Taajdaar Durood
shers.english:
To The Great King of The Rasools, I Should Offer With Devotion
The Honourable King of All Salutations, Very Special Benedictions

shers.roman:
Gor e Bekas Ko Shama’ Se Kya Kaam
Ho Charaagh e Sar e Mazaar Durood
shers.english:
What Is The Need For A Lamp, In The Grave of A Helpless Person?
At My Shrine’s Edge, May ‘Durood’ Be The Source of Illumination

shers.roman:
Qabr Meiñ Khoob Kaam Aati Hai
Bekasoñ Ki Hai Yaar e Ghaar Durood
shers.english:
In The Grave, It Will Be Extremely Beneficial To That Person
For The Destitute, The Companion of The Grave, Are Benedictions

shers.roman:
Unheñ Kis Ke Durood Ka Parwa
Bheje Jab Un Ka Kirdgaar Durood
shers.english:
What Need Does He Have, For Anyone’s Benedictions
When Upon Him, His Creator, Is Sending Benedictions

shers.roman:
Hai Karam Hee Karam Ke Sunte Haiñ
Aap Khush Ho Ke Baar-Baar Durood
shers.english:
It Is Mercy Upon Mercy, That, As Soon As He Hears Our Salutations
He Becomes Very Pleased, Upon Receiving Continuous Benedictions

shers.roman:
Jaan Niklay To Is Tarah Niklay
Tujh Pe Ay Ghamzadoñ Ke Yaar Durood
shers.english:
When My Soul Departs, Then It Should Depart In This Condition
Upon You, O Beloved of The Helpless, He Should Send Benedictions

shers.roman:
Dil Meiñ Jalwe Basay Huwe Tere
Lab Se Jaari Ho Baar-Baar Durood
shers.english:
My Heart Should Be Graced By The Rays of Your Illumination
And With My Lips, I Should Continuously, Recite Benedictions

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan! Khaar e Gham Ko Dil Se Nikaal
Ghamzadoñ Ki Hai Gham-Gusaar Durood
shers.english:
O Hasan! From Your Heart, Remove The Thorn of Affliction
The Consoler And Reliever To The Aggrieved, Is Benedictions

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: RANG E CHAMAN PASAND NA PHOOLOÑ KI BOO PASAND

shers.roman:
Rang e Chaman Pasand Na Phooloñ Ki Boo Pasand
Sahra e Taibah Hai Dil e Bulbul Ko Tu Pasand
shers.english:
Neither The Garden’s Colour, Nor The Flower’s Fragrance, It Favours
O Madina’s Desert! It Is You, Whom The Nightingale’s Heart Favours

shers.roman:
Apna ‘Azeez Wo Hai Jisay Tu ‘Azeez Hai
Ham Ko Hai Wo Pasand Jisay Aaye Tu Pasand
shers.english:
Whomsoever Takes You As Their Beloved, As Our Beloved, We Favour
The One Who Loves You Truly, Is The One Whom We Truly Favour

shers.roman:
Maayoos Ho Ke Sab Se Meiñ Aaya Huñ Tere Paas
Ay Jaan Kar Le ‘Toot’ay Huwe Dil Ko Tu Pasand
shers.english:
After Losing Hope In All Others, I Have Come To You, My Master
O My Beloved! The One With The Broken Heart, Please Do Favour

shers.roman:
Haiñ Khaana-Zaad Banda e Ehsaañ To Kya Ajab
Teri Wo Khoo Hai, Karte Haiñ Jis Ko ‘Adu Pasand
shers.english:
It Is Not Astounding, If A Slave Child, Is A Servant of Your Favour
Such Is Your Blessed Nature, Which Even Your Enemies Favour

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Kar Na Chaaheñ Teri Gali Meiñ Huñ Mit’t Ke Khaak
Dunya Meiñ Aaj Kis Ko Nahiñ Aabru Pasand
shers.english:
To Die In Your Lane, And To Become Dust, Why Shouldn’t I Desire
In This World Today, Honour And Esteem, Who Does Not Favour?

shers.roman:
Hai Khaak-Saar Par Karam e Khaas Ki Nazar
‘Aajiz Nawaaz Hai Teri Ay Khoobru Pasand
shers.english:
Upon This Humble Sinner, Is The Sight of Your Special Favour
Your Courtesy To Even A Stranger, O Beloved! We Favour

shers.roman:
Qul Keh Kar Apni Baat Bhi Lab Se Tere Suni
Allah Ko Hai Itni Teri Guftagu Pasand
shers.english:
By Saying, ‘You Say’, From Your Lips, His Word, He Willed To Hear
This Is How Much, Your Eloquent Conversation, Allah Does Favour

shers.roman:
Hoor o Farishtay Jinn o Bashar Sab Nisaar Haiñ
Hai Do Jahaañ Meiñ Qabza Kiye Chaar-Soo Pasand
shers.english:
Heavenly Maidens, Jinns And Humans, Are Sacrificed Altogether,
Over Both The Worlds Is Your Control, But This World, You Favour

shers.roman:
Un Ke Gunahgaar Ki Um’meed ‘Afw Ko
Pehle Karegi Aayat e Řْْا Pasand
shers.english:
To Seek Forgiveness, When His Sinful Followers Do Aspire
Them, The Verse ‘Do Not Be Disillusioned’ Will First Favour

shers.roman:
Taibah Meiñ Sar Jhukaate Haiñ Khaak e Niyaaz Par
Kaunain Ke Bar’ay Se Bar’ay Aabru Pasand
shers.english:
On The Land of Devotion, In Taibah, Their Heads They Lower
They Are Chiefs In Both Worlds, Yet This Honour They Favour

shers.roman:
Hai Khwaahish e Wisaal Dar e Yaar Ay Hasan
Aaye Na Kyuñ Asar Ko Meri Aarazu Pasand
shers.english:
O Hasan! To Merge With The Beloved’s Door, I Desire
Why Won’t My Desire, Give The Result, Which I Favour?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HO AGAR MADH E KAF E PAA SE MUNAWWAR KAAGHAZ

shers.roman:
Ho Agar Madh e Kaf e Paa Se Munawwar Kaaghaz
‘Aariz e Hoor Ki Zeenat Ho Saarasar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
If The Praise of His Feet’s Sacred Soles, Illuminates Any Paper
The Beauty of The Hoor’s Cheeks, Will Seem Blank, Like Paper

shers.roman:
Sifat e Khaar e Madina Meiñ Karuñ Gul-Kaari
Daftar e Gul Ka ‘Anaadil Se Manga Kar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
To Adorn The Qualities of Madina’s Thorn, Whilst Praising Its Splendour
Through The Nightingale I Will Be Requesting, The Rose Diary’s Paper

shers.roman:
‘Aariz e Paak Ki Ta’reef Ho Jis Parche Meiñ
Sau Siyah Naama Ujaala Wo Munawwar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
If The Noble Praise of His Sacred Cheeks, Is Written On Any Paper
A Hundred Dark Journals, Will Be Illuminated, By That Glowing Paper

shers.roman:
Shaam e Taibah Ki Tajal’li Ka Kuch Ahwaal Likhuñ
De Bayaaz e Sahar Ik Aisa Munawwar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
So That I May Pen Something, About The Evening of Taibah’s Splendour
O Radiance of Dawn! Do Present Me, With Such A Shimmering Paper

shers.roman:
Yaad e Mahboob Meiñ Kaaghaz Se To Dil Kam Na Rahe
Ke Juda Naqsh Se Hota Nahiñ Dam Bhar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
In The Beloved’s Memory, Your Heart, Shouldn’t Be Outdone By Paper
For, Even For A Moment, From Its Print, Never Separated, Is The Paper

shers.roman:
Warq e Mahr! Usay Khat’t e Ghulaami Likh De
Ho Jo Wasf e Rukh e Purnoor Se Anwar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
Write For It, A Certificate of Devotion, O The Sun’s Luminous Layer!
If The Description of His Glowing Face, Is Illuminating That Paper

shers.roman:
Tere Bande Haiñ Talabgaar Teri Rahmat Ke
Sun Gunaahoñ Ke Na Ay Daawar e Mahshar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
Your Divine Mercy, Your Humble Servants, Sincerely Desire
O Allah! On Judgment Day, Overlook Their Sin-Filled Paper

shers.roman:
Lab e Jaañ Bakhsh Ki Ta’reef Agar Ho Tujh Meiñ
Ho Mujhe Taar e Nafas Har Khat e Mistar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
If In You, The Holy Praises of Those Life-Giving Lips, Do Appear
Then For Me, A Breath of True Life, Is Every Line, On That Paper

shers.roman:
Madh e Rukhsaar Ke Phooloñ Meiñ Basa Luñ Jo Hasan
Hashr Meiñ Ho Mere Naama Ka Mu’attar Kaaghaz
shers.english:
O Hasan! If I Infuse It In The Flowers, Which Praise His Cheek’s Splendour
On Judgment Day, In My Journal of Deeds, Perfumed Will Be Its Paper

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AGAR CHAMKA MUQAD’DAR KHAAK E PAA E RAHRAWAAÑ HO KAR

shers.roman:
Agar Chamka Muqad’dar Khaak e Paa e Rahrawaañ Ho Kar
Chaleñge Bayt’hte Ut’hte Ghubaar e Kaarwaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
As The Dust Under The Pilgrim’s Feet, If My Destiny Starts Glowing
Continuously, As The Sacred Caravan’s Dust, I Will Be Journeying

shers.roman:
Shab e Me'raj Wo Dam Bhar Meiñ Palt’ay Laa Makaañ Ho Kar
Bahaar e Hasht Jannat Dekh Kar, Haft Aasmaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
In A Moment, On The Me’raj Eve, From Beyond Space, He Was Returning
After The Glory of The Eight Heavens, And The Seven Skies, He Was Seeing

shers.roman:
Chaman Ki Seyr Se Jalta Hai Jee Taibah Ki Furqat Meiñ
Mujhe Gulzaar Ka Sabza Rulaata Hai D’huwaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
Being Away From Taibah, Breaks My Heart, When A Garden I Am Touring
Just Like Smoke, The Foliage of The Garden, Causes Me To Be Weeping

shers.roman:
Tasaw’wur Us Lab e Jaañ Bakhsh Ka Kis Shaan Se Aaya
Diloñ Ka Chain Ho Kar Jaan Ka Aaraam e Jaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
With Such Grandeur, Those Life-Giving Lips, I Am Now Remembering
As The Heart’s Solace, And The Tranquillity of My Soul, It Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Karen Ta’zeem Meri Sang e Aswad Ki Tarh Momin
Tumhaare Dar Pe Reh Jaawuñ Jo Sang e Aastaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
The Believers Will Revere Me, Like The Holy Black Stone They Are Revering
Whilst Becoming A Stone At Your Majestic Court, If There, I Am Remaining

shers.roman:
Dikha De Ya Khuda Gulzaar e Taibah Ka Samaañ Mujh Ko
Phiruñ Kab Tak Pareshaañ Bulbul e Be Aashyaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
O Allah! The Ambience of Taibah’s Garden, Allow Me To Be Seeing
As A Troubled Nest-less Nightingale, Until When Must I Be Wandering

shers.roman:
Huwe Yumn e Qadam Se Farsh o ‘Arsh o Laa Makaañ Zinda
Khulasa Ye Ke Sarkaar Aaye Haiñ Jaan e Jahaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
By His Holy Feet, The ‘Arsh, The Earth, And Beyond Space, Are Existing
As The Soul of The Universe, Our Master Came; The Essence, This Is Being

shers.roman:
Tere Dast e ‘Ata Ne Daulateñ Deen Dil Kiye T’hand’ay
Kahiñ Gohar Fishaañ Ho Kar Kahiñ Aab e Rawaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
Whilst Your Generous Hand Enriched Us, Our Hearts It Was Comforting
Somewhere Scattering Pearls, And Elsewhere, As An Ocean It Was Flowing

shers.roman:
Fida Ho Jaaye Ummat Is Himaayat Is Muhab’bat Par
Hazaaroñ Gham Liye Haiñ Aik Dil Pur Shaadmaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
Sacrificed The Ummah Should Be, Upon This Aid And This Caring
To Bear Countless Concerns, Truly Pleased, That One Heart Is Being

shers.roman:
Jo Rakhte Haiñ Salaateeñ Shaahi Jaaved Ki Khwaahish
Nishaañ Qaaim Kareñ Un Ki Gali Meiñ Be-Nishaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
Those Kings, Who Are Wishing For A Sovereignty, Which Is Undying
By Losing Themselves In His Lane, Their Mark, They Should Be Leaving

shers.roman:
Wo Jis Rah Se Guzarte Haiñ Basi Rehti Haiñ Mud’dat Tak
Naseeb Us Ghar Ke Jis Ghar Meiñ Wo 'Tahreñ Mehmaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
Filled With Scent For Ages, Becomes The Path, By Which He Is Passing
How Fortunate Is That House, Wherein As A Guest, He Is Residing

shers.roman:
Hasan Kyun Paaoñ Tor’ay Bayt’hay Ho, Taibah Ka Rasta Lo
Zameen e Hind Sargardaañ Rakhegi Aasmaañ Ho Kar
shers.english:
O Hasan! Why Have You Lost Hope, To Taibah, Do Be Journeying
Becoming The Sky, The Land of Hind, Will Leave You Wandering

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: MARHABA ‘IZZAT O KAMAAL E HUZOOR

shers.roman:
Marhaba ‘Izzat o Kamaal e Huzoor
Hai Jalaal e Khuda Jalaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
Amazing Is The Grandeur And Perfection of My Honourable Nabi
The Grand Majesty of Allah, Is The Majesty of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Un Ki Qadmoñ Ki Yaad Meiñ Mariye
Kijiye Dil Ko Paa-imaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
Die, Whilst His Sacred Feet, You Are Remembering Sincerely
Place Your Heart, Under The Sacred Feet of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Dasht e Ayman Hai Seena e Momin
Dil Meiñ Hai Jalwa e Khayaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
The Believer’s Chest Is Indeed, Ayman’s Desert of Sanctuary
My Heart Is Filled With Radiant Thoughts of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Aafreenish Ko Naaz Hai Jis Par
Hai Wo Andaaz e Be Misaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
That, Which The Entire Creation Is Admiring In Ecstasy
Is The Peerless And Unique Manner of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Maah Ki Jaan, Mahr Ka Imaañ
Jalwa e Husn e Be Zawaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
The Soul of The Moon, And The Sun’s Faith, It Is Most Certainly
The Lustre of The Non-Declining Beauty of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Husn e Yusuf Kare Zulaikhaayi
Khwaab Meiñ Dekh Kar Jamaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
Falling Profoundly In Love, Will Be Hazrat Yusuf’s Beauty
If In Its Dream, It Sees The Beauty of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Waqf Injaah e Maqsad e Khud'daam
Har Shab o Roz o Maah o Saal e Huzoor
shers.english:
Dedicated To Safeguarding, His Servant’s Every Purpose, Constantly
Is Every Day And Night, Every Month And Year, of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Sik’ka Raaij Hai Hukm Jaari Hai
Donoñ ‘Aalam Haiñ Milk o Maal e Huzoor
shers.english:
Approved Are His Commands, In Circulation Is His Royal Currency
Both Worlds Are The Kingdom And The Wealth of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Taab e Deedar Ho Kisay, Jo Na Ho
Parda e Ghaib Meiñ Jamaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
Who Would Possess The Capability, To See His Countenance In Reality?
If Not Hidden In The Unseen Veil, Was The Beauty of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Jo Na Aayi Nazar, Na Aaye Nazar
Har Nazar Meiñ Hai Wo Misaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
That Which Was Not Seen, And Remains Hidden Endlessly
In Every Sight, Is That Manifestation of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Unheñ Nuqsaan De Nahiñ Sakta
Dushman Apna Hai Bad-Sigaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
No Destruction To Them, Can Be Caused By The Enemy
For, Our Enemy Is An Adversary of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Durrat-ud Taaj Farq e Shaahi Hai
Zar’ra e Shaukat e Ni’aal e Huzoor
shers.english:
It Is The Precious Pearl of The Crown, Which Is On The Heads of Royalty
This Is An Iota of The Glory, of The Holy Footwear of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Haal Se Kashf e Raaz e Qaal Na Ho
Qaal Se Kya ‘Ayaañ Ho Haal e Huzoor
shers.english:
The Secrets of His Words, His Condition Does Not Reveal, In Reality
From Words, Who Can Know, The Real State of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Manzil e Rushd Ke Nujoom, Ashaab
Kashti e Khayr o Amn Aal e Huzoor
shers.english:
The Stars of The Galaxy of Guidance, Are The Companions of The Nabi
The Ark of Virtue And Safety, Is The Noble Family of My Honourable Nabi

shers.roman:
Hai Mas e Qalb Ke Liye Ikseer
Ay Hasan Khaak e Paa-imaal e Huzoor
shers.english:
For Applying To The Ailing Heart, It Is The Most Effective Remedy
O Hasan! It Is The Dust, From Beneath The Feet of My Honourable Nabi

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SEYR E GULSHAN KAUN DEKHE DASHT E TAIBAH CH’HOR’ KAR

shers.roman:
Seyr e Gulshan Kaun Dekhe Dasht e Taibah Ch’hor’ Kar
Soo e Jannat Kaun Jaaye, Dar Tumhaara Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
Whilst Abandoning Taibah’s Desert, To Tour Paradise, Who Is Seeking?
Whilst Leaving Your Blessed Court, To Go To Heaven, Who Is Seeking?

shers.roman:
Sar Guzishte Gham Kahuñ Kis Se Tere Hote Huwe
Kis Ke Dar Par Jaawuñ Tera Aastaana Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
To Whom Shall I Narrate My Sorrows, Whilst Present You Are Being?
If I Leave Your Sacred Threshold, To Whose Court Can I Be Going?

shers.roman:
Be Liqaa e Yaar Un Ko Chain Aa Jaata Agar
Baar-Baar Aate Na Yuñ Jibreel Sidra Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
Without Meeting His Beloved, If Truly Comfortable He Was Being
By Repeatedly Leaving Sidra This Way, Jibreel Would Not Be Coming

shers.roman:
Kaun Kehta Hai Dil e Be Mud’da’a Hai Khoob Cheez
Maiñ To Kor'i Ko Na Luñ Un Ki Taman’na Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
Who Says That A Heart Without A Desire, Is A Really Good Thing?
I Would Not Take, Even A Single Coin, To Abandon His Pure Yearning

shers.roman:
Mar Hee Jaawuñ Maiñ Agar Us Dar Se Jaawuñ Do Qadam
Kya Bache Bimaar e Gham Qurb e Maseeha Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
Even If I Took Two Steps, Away From That Grand Court, I Would Be Dying
How Will A Love Sick One Survive, If The Messiah’s Proximity, He Is Leaving

shers.roman:
Kis Taman’na Par Jiyeñ Ya Rab’b Aseeraan e Qafas
Aa Chuki Baad e Saba Baagh e Madina Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
O Allah! Upon What Hope, Should The Caged Captives Be Living?
The Morning Breeze Has Come, After Madina’s Garden, Leaving

shers.roman:
Bakhshwaana Mujh Se ‘Aasi Ka Rawa Hoga Kisay
Kis Ke Daaman Meiñ Chupuñ Daaman Tumhaara Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
To Seek Pardon For A Sinner Like Me, Who Would Be Bothering?
In Whose Mantle Shall I Be Hiding, If Your Mantle I Am Leaving?

shers.roman:
Khuld Kaisa Nafs e Sarkash, Jaawuñga Taibah Ko Maiñ
Bad-Chalan Hat’ Kar Khar’a Ho Mujh Se Rasta Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
What Heaven! O Defiant Inner-self! To Madina I Will Be Going
O Wicked One! Move Away From Me, My Path Do Be Leaving

shers.roman:
Aise Jalwe Par Karuñ Maiñ Laakh Hooroñ Ko Nisaar
Kya Gharaz Kyuñ Jaawuñ Jannat Ko Madina Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
Upon Such Lustres, Millions of Heavenly Maidens, I Will Be Sacrificing
What For And Why Must I Go To Jannat? Madina, Why Must I Be Leaving?

shers.roman:
Hashr Meiñ Aik-Aik Ka Muñh Taktay Phirtay Haiñ ‘Adu
Aafatoñ Meiñ Phañs Gaye Un Ka Sahaara Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
On Judgement Day Gazing At Each Other, The Enemies Are Wandering
They Have Been Seized By Calamity, For His Help, They Were Abandoning

shers.roman:
Mar Ke Jeete Haiñ Jo Un Ke Dar Pe Jaate Haiñ Hasan
Jee Ke Martay Haiñ Jo Aate Haiñ Madina Ch’hor’ Kar
shers.english:
O Hasan! For Those Who Visit His Sacred Court, It Is Like Living, After Dying
As For Those Who Depart From Madina, It Is Like Dying, After Living

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JITNA MERE KHUDA KO HAI MERE NABI ‘AZEEZ

shers.roman:
Jitna Mere Khuda Ko Hai Mera Nabi ‘Azeez
Kaunain Meiñ Kisi Ko Na Hoga Koyi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
To Almighty Allah, As Much As My Nabi Is Beloved
To None In Both Worlds, Is Anyone Else, So Beloved

shers.roman:
Khaak e Madina Par Mujhe Allah Maut De
Wo Murda Dil Hai Jis Ko Na Ho Zindagi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
May Allah Grant Me Death, On Madina’s Dust, So Celebrated
A Dead Heart He Is Having, To Whom True Life Is Not Beloved

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Jaayeñ Ham Kahiñ, Ke Ghani Tum Ne Kar Diya
Ab To Ye Ghar Pasand, Ye Dar, Ye Gali ‘Azeez
shers.english:
Why Should We Go Elsewhere, When By You, We Are Truly Enriched?
Now, This House We Prefer; To Us, This Court And This Lane Is Beloved

shers.roman:
Jo Kuch Teri Raza Hai Khuda Ki Wahi Khushi
Jo Kuch Teri Khushi Hai, Khuda Ko Wahi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
Whatever Pleases You, With That, Allah Almighty Is Pleased
Whatever Makes You Happy, To Allah, That Is Most Beloved

shers.roman:
Go Ham Namak-Haraam Nikam’may Ghulaam Haiñ
Qurbaan! Phir Bhi Rakhti Hai Rahmat Teri ‘Azeez
shers.english:
Even Though, As Ungrateful And Useless Slaves, We Are Regarded
Sacrificed, I Am Upon You; Your Mercy Still Considers Us So Beloved

shers.roman:
Shaan e Karam Ko Ach’che Buray Se Gharaz Nahiñ
Us Ko Sabhi Pasand Haiñ, Us Ko Sabhi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
Whether We Are Good Or Bad, His Merciful Grandeur, Is Not Bothered
He Truly Cherishes Every One of Us, To Him, We Are All Very Beloved

shers.roman:
Mangta Ka Haath Ut’ha To Madina Hee Ki Taraf
