Tera Hee Dar Pasand, Teri Hee Gali ‘Azeez
shers.english:
When The Beggar Raises His Hands, Only Towards Madina, It Is Directed
It Is Your Grand Court Which He Loves, Only Your Lane, Is Truly Beloved

shers.roman:
Us Dar Ki Khaak Par Mujhe Marna Pasand Hai
Takht e Shahi Pe Kis Ko Nahiñ Zindagi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
To Finally Die On The Dust of That Holy Court, To Me, Is Beloved
While Sitting On A Royal Throne, To Whom Is Life Not Beloved?

shers.roman:
Kaunain De Diye Haiñ Tere Ikhtiyaar Meiñ
Allah Ko Bhi Kitni Hai Khaatir Teri ‘Azeez
shers.english:
In Your Complete Control, Both The Worlds, He Has Granted
Your Complete Pleasure, To Almighty Allah Is Very Beloved

shers.roman:
Mahshar Meiñ Do Jahaañ Ko Khuda Ki Khushi Ki Chaah
Mere Huzoor Ki Hai Khuda Ko Khushi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
On Reckoning Day, Both The Worlds, Want Allah To Be Pleased
Yet To Allah Almighty, My Nabi’s Happiness Is Most Beloved

shers.roman:
Qur’aan Kha Raha Hai Isi Khaak Ki Qasam
Ham Kaun Hai? Khuda Ko Teri Gali ‘Azeez
shers.english:
The Holy Qur’aan Is Taking An Oath, Upon This Dust, So Sacred
Who Are We? When To Allah, Your Sacred Lane, Is So Beloved

shers.roman:
Taibah Ki Khaak Ho, Ke Hayaat e Abad Milay
Ay Jaañ Balab Tujhe Hai, Agar Zindagi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
Get The Dust of Taibah, And An Everlasting Life, You Will Be Granted
O’ One On The Verge of Death, If True Life To You, Is Truly Beloved

shers.roman:
Sang e Sitam Ke Ba’ad Dua e Falaah Ki
Bande To Bande Haiñ, Tumheñ Haiñ Mud’da’i ‘Azeez
shers.english:
After Being Stoned Unjustly, For Their Salvation, You Supplicated
Leave Alone Your True Slaves, The Claimants Are Even Beloved

shers.roman:
Dil Se Zara Ye Keh De Ke Un Ka Ghulaam Huñ
Har Dushman e Khuda Ho Khuda Ko Abhi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
If One Just Says To His Heart, That I Am Now His Slave, Entirely Devoted
Even If He Was Allah’s Enemy Before, To Allah, He Will Now Be Beloved

shers.roman:
Taibah Ke Hotay Khuld e Bareeñ Kya Karuñ Hasan?
Mujh Ko Yahi Pasand, Mujh Ko Yahi ‘Azeez
shers.english:
O Hasan! What Will I Do With Heaven, When Taibah I Have Acquired?
This Alone, Is Most Treasured To Me; To Me, This Alone, Is Beloved

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HOÑ JO YAAD E RUKH E PURNOOR MEIÑ MURGHAAN E QAFAS

shers.roman:
Hoñ Jo Yaad e Rukh e Purnoor Meiñ Murghaan e Qafas
Chamak Ut’hay Chah e Yusuf Ki Tarah Shaan e Qafas
shers.english:
If In The Remembrance of His Radiant Face, The Caged Birds Are Living
Like The Well of Nabi Yusuf, The Splendour of The Cage Will Be Glowing

shers.roman:
Kis Bala Meiñ Haiñ Giriftaar Aseeraan e Qafas
Kal Thay Mehmaan e Chaman, Aaj Haiñ Mehmaan e Qafas
shers.english:
By Which Form of Calamity, Are The Captives of The Cage Suffering?
Yesterday, The Garden They Visited, Today, The Cage They Are Visiting

shers.roman:
Haif Dar Chashm e Zadan Sohbat e Yaar Aakhir Shud
Ab Kahaañ Taibah, Wahi Ham, Wahi Zindaan e Qafas
shers.english:
Alas! In The Blink of An Eye, With My Beloved, Ended My Meeting
Now Where Is Taibah? Still Enclosed There, In The Cage, We Are Being

shers.roman:
Roo e Gul Seer Na-Deedaim Wa Bahaar Aakhir Shud
Haaye! Kya Qahr, Kya Ulfat e Yaaraan e Qafas
shers.english:
We Barely Embraced The Roses Beauty, And Already Gone Is The Spring
Oh! Such Anguish, Such Deep Love, The Caged Friends Are Experiencing

shers.roman:
Nauhagar Kyuñ Na Rahe Murgh e Khush Ilhaan e Chaman
Baagh Se Daam Mila, Daam Se Zindaan e Qafas
shers.english:
Why Would The Garden’s Sweet Chirping Bird, Not Be Sadly Lamenting?
From The Garden To The Trap, And From The Trap, To The Cage It Is Going

shers.roman:
Paayeñ Sahra e Madina To Gulistaañ Mil Jaaye
Hind Hai Ham Ko Qafas, Ham Haiñ Aseeraan e Qafas
shers.english:
If One Reaches The Desert of Madina, The Garden He Is Reaching
For Us, India Is The Cage, The Captives of The Cage, We Are Being

shers.roman:
Zakhm e Dil Phool Banay, Aah! Ki Chalti Hai Naseem
Roz Afzooñ Hai Bahaar e Chamanistaan e Qafas
shers.english:
Like Flowers, The Heart’s Wounds Bloom, A Sigh, The Breeze Is Carrying
Every Day, The Splendour of The Cage’s Garden, Is Splendidly Flourishing

shers.roman:
Qaafila Dekhte Haiñ Jab Soo e Taibah Jaate
Kaisi Hasrat Se Tar’aptay Aseeraan e Qafas
shers.english:
In The Direction of Madina, When They See The Convoy Departing
In A Sense of Deprivation, The Captives of The Cage Are Agonising

shers.roman:
Tha Chaman Hee Hameñ Zindaañ Ke Na Tha Wo Gul e Tar
Qaid Par Qaid Huwa, Awr Ye Zindaan e Qafas
shers.english:
For Us, The Garden Was A Prison, For In It, The Fresh Rose Was Not Being
Custody Upon Custody, And Now In The Prison of This Cage, We Are Being

shers.roman:
Dasht e Taibah Meiñ Hameñ Shakl e Watan Yaad Aayi
Bad-Naseebi Se Huwa Baagh Meiñ Armaan e Qafas
shers.english:
Even In Taibah’s Desert, Our Country’s Image, We Were Remembering
Unfortunately, While In The Garden, For The Cage We Were Yearning

shers.roman:
Ab Na Aayeñge Agar Khul Gayi Qismat Ki Girah
Ab Girah Baandh Liya Ham Ne Ye Paimaan e Qafas
shers.english:
If The Knot of Destiny Is Now Opened, We Shall Not Be Returning
We Have Now Firmly Intended It, The Pledge of The Cage, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Hind Ko Kaun, Madina Se Palat’na Chaahe
‘Aish e Gulzaar Bhula De Jo Na Dauraan e Qafas
shers.english:
To India, From Madina, Who Would Wish To Be Returning!
As If The Garden’s Bliss, The Time In The Cage, Is Not Erasing

shers.roman:
Chahchahe Kis Gul e Khoobi Ki Sana Meiñ Haiñ Hasan
Nik’hat e Khuld Se Mahaka Hai Jo Zindaan e Qafas
shers.english:
O Hasan! In The Praise of Which Elegant Rose, Are You Chirping?
That A Heavenly Scent, Even The Prison of The Cage, Is Emitting

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JANAAB E MUSTAFA HOÑ JIS SE NA KHUSH

shers.roman:
Janaab e Mustafa Hoñ Jis Se Na Khush
Nahiñ Mumkin Ke Ho Us Se Khuda Khush
shers.english:
If With Someone, Our Honourable Mustafa Is Unhappy
It Is Impossible, That With Him, Allah Almighty Is Happy

shers.roman:
Shah e Kaunain Ne Jab Sadqa Baant’a
Zamaane Bhar Ko Dam Meiñ Kar Diya Khush
shers.english:
When The King of Both Worlds, Distributed His Charity
In A Moment, He Made The Entire World Truly Happy

shers.roman:
Salaateeñ Maangte Haiñ Bheek Us Se
Ye Apne Ghar Se Hai Un Ka Gada Khush
shers.english:
From Him, Even The Kings, Are Pleading Humbly
With His Own House, His Mendicant Is Very Happy

shers.roman:
Pasand e Haq Ta’aala Teri Har Baat
Tere Andaaz Khush Teri Ada Khush
shers.english:
Your Every Blessed Word, Is Beloved To Allah Almighty
Your Every Manner Is Pleasant, As You Proceed Gracefully

shers.roman:
Mit’eñ Sab Zaahir o Baatin Ke Amraaz
Madina Ki Hai Ye Aab o Hawa Khush
shers.english:
All Our Apparent And Hidden Ailments, Will Be Cured Instantly
This Sacred Water And The Air of Madina, Is Indeed, Very Healthy

shers.roman:
ÖÚْýٰي Ki Muhab’bat Ka Taqaaza
Ke Jis Se Aap Khush, Us Se Khuda Khush
shers.english:
The Love In ‘Soon You Will Become Happy’ Mandates Directly
That, With Whomsoever You Are Happy, Almighty Allah Is Happy

shers.roman:
Hazaaroñ Jurm Karta Huñ Shab o Roz
Khusha Qismat, Nahiñ Wo Phir Bhi Na Khush
shers.english:
For Thousands of Sins, Day And Night, I Am Indeed Guilty
Yet, It Is My Good-Fortune, With Me, He Is Still Not Unhappy

shers.roman:
Ilaahi De Mere Dil Ko Gham e ‘Ishq
Nishaat e Dahr Se Ho Jaawuñ Na Khush
shers.english:
Grant Me The Heartache of Love, O Allah Almighty!
With The Worldly Pleasures, May I Become Unhappy

shers.roman:
Nahiñ Jaateñ Kabhi Dasht e Nabi Se
Kuch Aisi Hai Bahaaroñ Ko Fiza Khush
shers.english:
It Never Departs, From The Desert of The Beloved Nabi
With Its Pure Atmosphere, The Spring Breeze Is So Happy

shers.roman:
Madine Ki Agar Sarhad Nazar Aaye
Dil e Naashaad Ho Be Intiha Khush
shers.english:
When I Am Finally Able To See Madina’s Boundary
My Unhappy Heart, Will Become Extremely Happy

shers.roman:
Na Le Aaraam Dam Bhar Be Gham e ‘Ishq
Dil e Muztar Meiñ Khush, Mera Khuda Khush
shers.english:
I Will Be Unable To Rest For A Moment, Without Love’s Agony
In My Restless Heart I Am Happy, That My Creator Is Happy

shers.roman:
Na Tha Mumkin Ke Aisi Ma’siyat Par
Gunahgaaroñ Se Ho Jaata Khuda Khush
shers.english:
Upon Such Sins, It Was Impossible, Most Certainly,
With The Sinners, For Allah Almighty, To Be Happy

shers.roman:
Tumhaari Roti Aankhoñ Ne Hañsaaya
Tumhaare Ghamzada Dil Ne Kiya Khush
shers.english:
Your Weeping Eyes, Brought Me To Smile Happily
Your Grieving Heart, Allowed Me To Be Happy

shers.roman:
Ilaahi! Dhoop Ho Un Ki Gali Ki
Mere Sar Ko Nahiñ Zil’l e Huma Khush
shers.english:
May The Sunlight of His Lane Shine Upon Me, O Allah Almighty!
The Shade of Huma, The Bird of Royalty, Does Not Make Me Happy

shers.roman:
Hasan Na’at o Chuneeñ Shireeñ Bayaani
Tu Khush Baashi Ke Kar Di Waqt e Maa Khush
shers.english:
O Hasan! You Have Rendered The Prophetic Praises, So Eloquently
That You Brought Pure Joy To Our Era; May You Always Be Happy!

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KHUDA KE KHALQ MEIÑ SAB AMBIA KHAAS

shers.roman:
Khuda Ke Khalq Meiñ Sab Ambia Khaas
Giroh e Ambia Meiñ Mustafa Khaas
shers.english:
From Amongst Almighty Allah’s Creation, The Prophets Are Peerless
From Amongst The Assembly of The Prophets, Mustafa Is Peerless

shers.roman:
Niraala Husn, Andaaz o Ada Khaas
Tujhe Khaasoñ Meiñ Haq Ne Kar Liya Khaas
shers.english:
In Your Beauty You Are Outstanding, In Your Manner, You Are Peerless
Amongst All The Peerless Ones, Almighty Allah Made You Peerless

shers.roman:
Teri Ne’mat Ke Saa-il Khaas Taa ‘Aam
Teri Rahmat Ke Taalib ‘Aam Taa Khaas
shers.english:
Seekers of Your Benedictions, Extend From The Peerless Upto The Masses
Seekers of Your Mercy, Extend From The Laymen Upto The Peerless

shers.roman:
Shareek Us Meiñ Nahiñ Koyi Payambar
Khuda Se Hai Jo Tujh Ko Waasta Khaas
shers.english:
No Other Noble Prophet, Is An Equal, In This Special Uniqueness
To Almighty Allah, You Have A Connection, Which Is Indeed, Peerless

shers.roman:
Gunahgaaro! Na How Maayoos e Rahmat
Nahiñ Hoti Kareemoñ Ki ‘Ata Khaas
shers.english:
O Sinners! From His Mercy, Do Not Feel Deprived of Access
The Favours of The Generous, Are Not Only For The Peerless

shers.roman:
Gadaahoñ Khaas Rahmat Se Milay Bheek
Na Meiñ Khaas Awr Na Meri Iltija Khaas
shers.english:
O Mendicants! I Have Received Charity, By His Unique Kindness
Neither Is My Request Special, Nor Am I, In Any Way Peerless

shers.roman:
Mila Jo Kuch Jisay Wo Tum Se Paaya
Tumheeñ Ho Maalik e Mulk e Khuda Khaas
shers.english:
Whoever Got, Whatever He Got, From You, Is This Bliss
You Are That Ruler of Allah’s Kingdom, You Are Peerless

shers.roman:
Ghareeboñ Be Nawaawoñ Be Kasoñ Ko
Khuda Ne Dar Tumhaara Kar Diya Khaas
shers.english:
For The Poor, The Destitute And Those Who Are Helpless
Allah Has Made Your Gateway, One Which Is Peerless

shers.roman:
Jo Kuch Paida Huwa Donoñ Jahaañ Meiñ
Tasad’duq Hai Tumhaari Zaat Ka Khaas
shers.english:
In Both The Worlds, Whatever Has Come Into Existence
Everything, Is A Blessing of You Being So Peerless

shers.roman:
Tumhaari Anjuman Aara-iyoñ Ko
Huwa Hangaama e ƻٰي ْا Khaas
shers.english:
To Honour Your Noble Presence, In The Assembly of Gracefulness
The Assembly Wherein ‘They All Said, Most Certainly!’ Was Peerless

shers.roman:
Nabi Ham Paaya Hoñ Kya Tu Ne Paaya
Nubuw’wat Ki Tarah Har Mu’jaza Khaas
shers.english:
Any Prophet Have You Found, Who Like Him, Is Peerless?
Similar To His Prophethood, His Every Miracle, Is Peerless

shers.roman:
Jo Rakhta Hai Jamaal e ْرàðي ْ
Usi Muñh Ki Sifat Hai Wad-Duha Khaas
shers.english:
The Splendour of ‘He Who Has Seen Me’ The One Who Possesses
‘By The Glow of The Morning Sun’ Is The Trait of That Face, So Peerless

shers.roman:
Na Bheyjo Awr Darwaazoñ Par Is Ko
Hasan Hai Aap Ke Dar Ka Gada Khaas
shers.english:
Send Him Not, To The Doors of Others, In Distress
As A Mendicant of Your Court, Hasan Is Peerless

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SUN LO KHUDA KE WAASTE APNE GADA KI ‘ARZ

shers.roman:
Sun Lo Khuda Ke Waaste Apne Gada Ki ‘Arz
Ye ‘Arz Hai Huzoor Bar’ay Be Nawa Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
For Allah's Sake! Please Listen To Your Servant’s Plea
This Plea, O My Master! Is A Very Destitute One’s Plea

shers.roman:
Un Ke Gada Ke Dar Pe Hai Yuñ Baadshaah Ki ‘Arz
Jaise Ho Baadshaah Ke Dar Pe Gada Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
At The Court of His Slave, Such, Is A King’s Plea
Like At The Court of The King, Is A Slave’s Plea

shers.roman:
‘Aajiz Nawaaziyoñ Pe Karam Hai Tula Huwa
Wo Dil Laga Ke Sunte Haiñ Har Be Nawa Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
His Generosity Is Ever-ready, To Assist Those Who Are Needy,
With All His Heart, He Listens, To Every Destitute One’s Plea

shers.roman:
Qurbaan Un Ke Naam Ke Be Un Ke Naam Ke
Maqbool Ho Na Khaas Janaab e Khuda Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
Sacrificed We Are Upon His Name, For Without His Name, Surely
In The Divine Court of Allah Almighty, Rejected Will Be Our Plea

shers.roman:
Gham Ki Ghat’aayeñ Ch’haayi Haiñ Mujh Teera Bakht Par
Ay Mahr Sun Le Zar’ra e Be Dast Paa Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
The Clouds of Grief Are Hanging Over Me, Due To My Dark Destiny
O Radiant Sun! Listen To This Helpless And Crippled One’s Plea

shers.roman:
Ay Bekasoñ Ke Haami o Yaawar Siwa Tere
Kis Ko Gharaz Hai, Kaun Sunay Mubtala Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
O Guardian, And Protector of Those Who Are Truly Needy!
Who Else Bothers To Listen, To The Distressed One’s Plea?

shers.roman:
Ay Kimiya e Dil Maiñ Tere Dar Ki Khaak Huñ
Khaak e Dar e Huzoor Se Hai Kimiya Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
The Dust of Your Sacred Court I Am, O My Heart’s Alchemy!
To The Sacred Dust of My Nabi’s Court, Is The Alchemy’s Plea

shers.roman:
Ulj’han Se Door, Noor Se Ma’moor Kar Mujhe
Ay Zulf e Paak! Hai Ye Aseer e Bala Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
Remove Me From Dilemma, With Your Pure Light, Illuminate Me
I Am One Arrested By Calamity, O Sacred Tresses! This Is My Plea

shers.roman:
Dukh Meiñ Rahe Koyi, Ye Gawaara Nahiñ Unheñ
Maqbool Kyuñ Na Ho Dil e Dard Aashna Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
He Can Never Bear To See Anyone Afflicted By Calamity
So, Why Wouldn’t He Accept, The Grieving Heart’s Plea?

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Tool Dooñ, Huzoor Ye Deñ Ye ‘Ataa Kareñ
Khud Jaante Haiñ Aap Mere Mud’da’a Ki ‘Arz
shers.english:
Why Should I Emphasise, Give Me This Or That, My Beloved Nabi
For You Are Already Fully Aware, What Is The Purpose of My Plea

shers.roman:
Daaman Bhareñge Daulat e Fazl e Khuda Se Ham
Khaali Kabhi Gayi Hai Hasan, Mustafa Ki ‘Arz!
shers.english:
We Will Be Filling Our Mantles, With The Treasure of Allah’s Mercy
O Hasan! Gone Unanswered, Have You Ever Seen, Mustafa’s Plea?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: CHASHM E DIL, CHAAHE JO ANWAAR SE RABT

shers.roman:
Chashm e Dil, Chaahe Jo Anwaar Se Rabt
Rakhe Khaak e Dar e Dildaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
To Radiance, If The Eye of The Heart Wishes To Be Connected
To The Dust of The Beloved’s Court, It Should Be Connected

shers.roman:
Unki Ne’mat Ka Talabgaar Se Meyl
Unki Rahmat Ka Gunahgaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
To The Seeker, His Pure Blessings Are Connected
To The Sinner, His Special Mercy Is Connected

shers.roman:
Dasht e Taibah Ki Jo Dekh Aayeñ Bahaar
Ho ‘Anaadil Ko Na Gulzaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
After Having Seen Taibah’s Splendour, And After It Returned
To The Garden, The Nightingale, Will No Longer Be Connected

shers.roman:
Ya Khuda Dil Na Milay Dunya Se
Na Ho Aa-ina Ko Zangaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
O Allah! To This World, My Heart Should Never Become Attached
To Any Form of Corrosion, Let Not This Mirror Be Connected

shers.roman:
Nafs Se Meyl Na Karna Ay Dil
Qahr Hai Aise Sitam-Gaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
O My Heart! To The Evil Inner-self, Never Be Attracted
To Such A Blatant Tyrant, It Is Tyranny, To Be Connected

shers.roman:
Dil e Najdi Meiñ Ho Kyuñ Hub’b e Huzoor?
Zulmatoñ Ko Nahiñ Anwaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
In The Najdi’s Heart, Why Should The Nabi’s Love Be Located?
When To Pure Radiances, Darknesses, Can Never Be Connected

shers.roman:
Talkhi e Naza’ Se Us Ko Kya Kaam
Ho Jisay La’al e Shakar Baar Se Rabt
shers.english:
By The Difficulty, At The Time of Death, How Can He Be Affected
When To The Beloved’s Enchanting Sweet Lips, He Is Connected

shers.roman:
Khaak Taibah Ki, Agar Mil Jaaye
Aap Sehat Kare, Bimaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
To Acquire The Sacred Dust of Taibah, If Ever I Am Blessed
Health And Well-Being Itself, To The Ill, Will Be Connected

shers.roman:
Un Ke Daamaan e Gohar Baar Ko Hai
Kaasa o Dast e Talabgaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
His Sacred Mantle, Upon Which, Pearls of Tears Are Scattered
To The Begging Bowl, And Hand of The Seeker, It Is Connected

shers.roman:
Kal Hai Ijlaas Ka Din, Awr Hameñ
Meyl ‘Amala Se Na Darbaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
Tomorrow, The Day of Judgement Will Surely Be Established
Yet, Neither to Any Official, Nor To The Court, Are We Connected

shers.roman:
‘Umr Yuñ Un Ki Gali Meiñ Guzre
Zar’ra-Zar’ra Se Bar’hay Pyaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
In His Most Sacred Street, In This Way, May My Life Be Lived
To True Love, More Profoundly, May Every Speck Be Connected

shers.roman:
Sar e Shorida Ko Hai Dar Se Meyl
Kamar e Khasta Ki Diwaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
To The Sacred Court, The Lover’s Head Is Truly Connected
(And) To The Sacred Wall, His Weak Back Is Connected

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan! Khayr Hai, Kya Karte Ho
Yaar Ko Ch’hor Ke, Aghyaar Se Rabt
shers.english:
O Hasan! What Are You Doing, When All Is Well Settled?
Leaving The Beloved; To Strangers, Why Be Connected

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KHAAK E TAIBAH KI AGAR DIL MEIÑ HAI WAQ’AT MAHFOOZ

shers.roman:
Khaak e Taibah Ki Agar Dil Meiñ Hai Waq’at Mahfooz
Aib Kori Se Rahe Chashm e Baseerat Mahfooz
shers.english:
If In The Heart, The Honour of Taibah’s Sacred Dust Is Preserved
From Finding Faults, The Sight of Pure Insight, Will Be Preserved

shers.roman:
Dil Meiñ Roshan Ho Agar, Shama’e Wala e Maula
Duzd e Shaitaañ Se Rahe Deen Ki Daulat Mahfooz
shers.english:
If In The Heart, The Pure Light of The Master’s Love Is Illuminated
From Shaitaan’s Thieves, The Treasure of Deen, Will Be Preserved

shers.roman:
Ya Khuda Mahw e Nazaara Hoñ Yahaañ Tak Aankheñ
Shakl e Qur’aan Ho, Mere Dil Meiñ Wo Soorat Mahfooz
shers.english:
O Allah! To Such An Extent, In His Love, May My Eyes Be Captivated
Like The Qur’aan, In My Heart, May That Countenance, Be Preserved

shers.roman:
Silsila Zulf e Mubaarak Se Hai Jis Dil Ko
Har Balaa Se Rakhe, Allah Ki Rahmat Mahfooz
shers.english:
To His Sacred Tresses, That Heart Which Is Truly Connected
From Every Calamity, Allah’s Mercy, Will Keep Him Preserved

shers.roman:
Thee Jo Us Zaat Se Takmeel Faraameeñ Manzoor
Rakhi Khaatim Ke Liye Mohr e Nubuw’wat Mahfooz
shers.english:
When To Complete The Command, That Divine Being Willed
For The Final One, He Kept The Seal of Prophethood Preserved

shers.roman:
Ay Nigahbaañ Mere Tujh Pe Salaat Awr Salaam
Do Jahaañ Meiñ Tere Bande Hai Salaamat Mahfooz
shers.english:
Salutations And Peace Be Upon You, O My Guardian, Exalted
In Both The Worlds, Your Humble Slaves, Are Safe And Preserved

shers.roman:
Waasta Hifz e Ilaahi Ka Bacha Rahzan Se
Rahe Imaan e Ghareebaañ Dam e Rahlat Mahfooz
shers.english:
For The Sake of Allah’s Protection, From The Bandits Keep Us Protected
During Their Final Moments, May The Imaan of The Beggars Be Preserved

shers.roman:
Shaahi Kaun o Makaañ Aap Ko Di Khaaliq Ne
Kanz e Qudrat Meiñ Azal Se Thee Ye Daulat Mahfooz
shers.english:
As The King of Both The Worlds, By The Creator, You Are Appointed
From Eternity, In Allah’s Treasures, This Treasure Was Kept Preserved

shers.roman:
Tere Qanoon Meiñ Gunja-ish e Tabdeel Nahiñ
Naskh o Tarmeem Se Hai Teri Shari’at Mahfooz
shers.english:
In Your Rule of Law, There Is No Room For It To Be Altered
From Abrogation And Changes, Your Shari’at Is Preserved

shers.roman:
Jisay Azaad Kare Qaamat e Shah Ka Sadqa
Rahe Fitnoñ Se Wo Taa Roz e Qiyaamat Mahfooz
shers.english:
By The Grace of The King’s Eminence, The One Who Is Emancipated
From All Forms of Strife, Until The Day of Judgement, He Is Preserved

shers.roman:
Us Ko A’daa Ki ‘Adaawat Se Zarar Kya Pahunche
Jis Ke Dil Meiñ Ho Hasan Un Ki Muhab’bat Mahfooz
shers.english:
From The Hostility of The Adversaries, How Can He Be Harmed
O Hasan! When He Is One, In Whose Heart, His Love Is Preserved

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: MADINA MEIÑ HAI WO SAAMAAN E BARGAAH E RAFI’

shers.roman:
Madina Meiñ Hai Wo Saamaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
‘Urooj o Awj Haiñ Qurbaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
In Madina, Are Those Provisions of The Magnificent Court
Glory And Rank Are Sacrificed Upon The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Nahiñ Gada Hee Sar e Khwaan e Bargaah Rafi’
Khaleel Bhi To Hai Mehmaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Not Only Is The Beggar, At The Spread of The Magnificent Court
Even The Khaleel, Is A Humble Guest, At The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Banaaye Donoñ Jahaañ Mujra-ee Usi Dar Ki
Kiya Khuda Ne Jo Saamaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Both Worlds Were Made Subordinates of That Magnificent Court
Such, Has Allah Set, The Holy Provisions of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Zameen e ‘Ijz Pe Sajdah Karaayeñ Shaahoñ Se
Falak Janaab e Ghulaamaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Kings Were Made To Prostrate, On The Land of Devotion
The Skies Themselves Are Slaves of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Hai Intiha e ‘Ula Ibtida e Awj Yahaañ
Wara Khayaal Se Hai Shaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Here The Pinnacle of Distinction, Is The Beginning of Elevation
Beyond Our Imagination, Is The Excellence of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Kamand Rishta e ‘Umr e Khizr Pahunch Na Sakay
Buland Itna Hai Aywaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
It Cannot Even Be Reached, By The Aspiration of Khidr’s Long Life
So Immensely Glorious, Is The Grand Palace of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Wo Kaun Hai Jo Nahiñ Faiz-Yaab Is Dar Se
Sabhi Haiñ Banda e Ehsaan e Bargaah e Rafi'
shers.english:
Who Is It, That Has Not Been Blessed From This Court?
All Are Slaves of The Favours of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Nawaazay Jaate Haiñ Ham Se Namak Haraam Ghulaam
Hamaari Jaan Ho Qurbaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Ungrateful Servants Like Us, Are Still Getting Constant Blessings
May Our Lives Be Entirely Sacrificed, Upon The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Muti’ Nafs Haiñ Wo Sar Kashaan e Jinn o Bashar
Nahiñ Jo Taabe’ Farmaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Slaves of Their Desires, Are The Rebellious Jinns And Humans
For They Are Disobeying, The Directives of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Salaa e ‘Aam Haiñ, Mehmaañ Nawaaz Haiñ Hai Sarkaar
Kabhi Ut’ha Hee Nahiñ Khwaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Truly Hospitable Is Our Nabi; There, Stands An Open Invitation
Never Ever Lifted, Was The Spread of That Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Jamaal e Shams o Qamar Ka Singaar Hai Shab o Roz
Farogh e Shamsa e Aywaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
Day And Night, The Radiance of The Sun And The Moon Is Being Adorned
By The Illumination of The Glowing Bastion of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Mala’ika Haiñ Faqat Daab e Saltanat Ke Liye
Khuda Hai Aap Nigahbaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
The Angels Are Only Present There, For The Protocol of The Court
Almighty Allah Himself, Is The Protector of The Magnificent Court

shers.roman:
Hasan! Jalaalat e Shaahi Se Kyuñ Jhijakta Hai
Gada Nawaaz Hai Sultaan e Bargaah e Rafi’
shers.english:
O Hasan! Why Are You Hesitating, Due To His Magnificent Grandeur,
A Benefactor of The Mendicants, Is The King of This Magnificent Court

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KHUSHBOO E DASHT E TAIBAH SE BAS JAAYE GAR DIMAAGH

shers.roman:
Khushboo e Dasht e Taibah Se Bas Jaaye Gar Dimaagh
Mahkaaye Boo e Khuld Mera Sar Basar Dimaagh
shers.english:
If In The Mind, The Fragrance of Taibah’s Desert, Becomes Settled
By The Fragrance of Paradise, My Entire Mind Will Be Perfumed

shers.roman:
Paaya Hai Paaye Saahib e Me’raj Se Sharaf
Zar’raat e Koo e Taibah Ka Hai ‘Arsh Par Dimaagh
shers.english:
By The Sacred Feet of The Master of Me’raj, Honour They Attained
The Minds of The Dust Particles of Taibah’s Lane, Are Proudly Elevated

shers.roman:
Momin Fida e Noor o Shameem e Huzoor Meiñ
Har Dil Chamak Raha Hai Mu’attar Hai Har Dimaagh
shers.english:
Upon My Nabi’s Radiance And Fragrance, The Believers Are Sacrificed
Every Heart Is Glowing Brightly, Every Mind Is Completely Perfumed

shers.roman:
Aisa Basay Ke Boo e Gul e Khuld Se Basay
Ho Yaad Naqsh e Paa e Nabi Ka Jo Ghar, Dimaagh
shers.english:
It Will Be Filled, As If, With The Scent of Heaven’s Rose, It Is Filled
If In The Mind, The Memory of The Nabi’s Footprint, Has Resided

shers.roman:
Aabaad Kar Khuda Ke Liye Apne Noor Se
Weeraan Dil Hai Dil Se Zyaada Khand’ar Dimaagh
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake, With Your Glowing Light, Let It Be Illuminated
The Heart Is Empty, But More Than The Heart, The Mind Is Ruined

shers.roman:
Har Khaar e Taibah Zeenat e Gulshan Hai ‘Andaleeb
Naadaan! Aik Phool Par Itna Na Kar Dimaagh
shers.english:
O Nightingale! By Every Thorn of Taibah, Heaven’s Garden, Is Decorated
O Foolish One! Over A Single Flower, Do Not Lose Your Mind, So Inebriated

shers.roman:
Zaahid! Hai Mustahiq’q e Karaamat Gunahgaar
Allahu Akbar! Itna Mizaaj, Is Qadr Dimaagh
shers.english:
O Ascetic! For A Sinner; Is A Miracle, So Well Deserved?
Allah Is The Greatest! Such Pride, And A Mind So Conceited!

shers.roman:
Ay ‘Andaleeb! Khaar e Haram Se Misaal e Gul
Bak-Bak Ke Har Zah Goyi Se Khaali Na Kar Dimaagh
shers.english:
O Nightingale! Bring Forth A Rose, Like The Haram’s Thorn, So Sacred
With Futile Chatter, Do Not Beat Your Mind, Becoming Irritated

shers.roman:
Be Noor Dil Ke Waaste Kuch Bheek Maangte
Zar’raat e Khaak e Taibah Ka Milta Agar Dimaagh
shers.english:
For Your Dark Heart, Some Charity, You Should Have Requested
If A Mind, Like The Particles of Taibah, You Would Had Acquired

shers.roman:
Har Dam Khayaal e Paak Iqaamat Guzeeñ Rahe
Ban Jaaye Ghar Dimaagh Na Ho Rah-Guzar Dimaagh
shers.english:
May His Pure Remembrance Reside Therein, Uninterrupted
May The Mind Be His Home, And Not A Transit Point, Deserted

shers.roman:
Shaayad Ke Wasf e Paa e Nabi Kuch Bayaañ Kare
Poori Taraq’qiyoñ Pe Rasa Ho Agar Dimaagh
shers.english:
The Traits of The Nabi’s Feet, It Would Have Possibly Described
To Reach Great Heights, Had The Mind Successfully Progressed

shers.roman:
Us Bad-Lagaam Ko Khar e Daj’jaal Jaaniye
Munh Aaye Zikr Paak Ko Sun Kar Jo Khar Dimaagh
shers.english:
As The Donkey of Daj’jaal, That Impudent One, Should Be Recognised
The Dim-wit, Who Taunts Upon Hearing The Name of The Most Beloved

shers.roman:
Un Ke Khayaal Se Wo Milay Amn Ay Hasan
Sar Par Na Aaye Koyi Bala Ho Sipar Dimaagh
shers.english:
O Hasan! By His Blessed Thought, Such Peace I Have Attained
The Mind Serves As A Shield, By No Calamity, I Am Approached

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KUCH GHAM NAHIÑ AGAR CHE ZAMAANA HO BAR KHILAAF

shers.roman:
Kuch Gham Nahiñ Agar Che Zamaana Ho Bar Khilaaf
Un Ke Madad Rahe To Kare Kya Asar Khilaaf
shers.english:
I Am Not Bothered, If The Entire World Is Against Me
Nothing Can Negatively Affect Me, If His Aid Is With Me

shers.roman:
Un Ka ‘Adu Aseer e Bala e Nifaaq Hai
Us Ki Zabaan o Dil Meiñ Rahe ‘Umr Bar Khilaaf
shers.english:
Imprisoned By The Calamity of Hypocrisy, Is His Every Enemy
Upon His Tongue And Heart, All His Life, There Will Be Hostility

shers.roman:
Karta Hai Zikr e Paak Se Najdi Mukhalifat
Kam-Bakht, Bad-Naseeb Ki Qismat Hai Bar Khilaaf
shers.english:
The Blessed Remembrance of My Nabi, Is Opposed By The Najdi
Totally Obscure, Is That Despicable And Ill-Fated One’s Destiny

shers.roman:
Un Ki Wajaahatoñ Meiñ Kami Ho Muhaal Hai
Bil-Farz Ik Zamaana Ho Un Ke Agar Khilaaf
shers.english:
Any Waning In His Grand Dignity, Is An Absolute Impossibility
Hypothetically, Even If An Entire Era, Opposes Him Entirely

shers.roman:
Ut’huñ Jo Khwaab e Marg Se Aaye Shameem e Yaar
Ya Rab’b Na Subh e Hashr Ho Baad e Sahar Khilaaf
shers.english:
As I Awaken From Death’s Slumber, May I Sense The Scent of My Nabi
O Allah! On Judgment Day, The Dawn Breeze, Shouldn’t Blow Against Me

shers.roman:
Qurbaan Jaawuñ Rahmat e ‘Aajiz Nawaaz Par
Hoti Nahiñ Ghareeb Se Un Ki Nazar Khilaaf
shers.english:
Upon His Kindness Towards The Mendicants, Sacrificed May I Be
For He Never Turns His Sight Away, From Those Who Are Needy

shers.roman:
Shaan e Karam Kisi Se ‘Iwaz Chaahati Nahiñ
Laakh Imtisaal e Amr Meiñ Dil Ho Id’har Khilaaf
shers.english:
No Return Is Sought From Anyone, By The Grace of His Generosity
Yet So Often, In Obeying His Orders, Here, The Heart Acts Defiantly

shers.roman:
Kya Rahmateñ Haiñ Lutf Meiñ Phir Bhi Kami Nahiñ
Karte Rahe Haiñ Hukm Se Ham ‘Umar Bhar Khilaaf
shers.english:
There Is No Shortage, Even Though He Ardently Showers His Mercy
Yet, Against His Commands, All Our Lives We Acted Contrarily

shers.roman:
Ta’meel e Hukm e Haq Ka Hasan Hai Agar Khayaal
Irshaad e Paak Sarwar e Deeñ Ka Na Kar Khilaaf
shers.english:
O Hasan! If You Want To Obey The Commands of Allah Almighty
Against The Word of The Leader of Deen, Never Act Contrarily

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: RAHMAT NA KIS TARAH HO GUNAHGAAR KI TARAF?

shers.roman:
Rahmat Na Kis Tarah Ho Gunahgaar Ki Taraf?
Rahmaan Khud Hai Mere Tarafdaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Towards The Sinner, How Could Mercy, Not Be Extending
When On My Guardian’s Side, Rahmaan Himself Is Being

shers.roman:
Jaan e Jinaañ Hai Dasht e Madina Teri Bahaar
Bulbul Na Jaayegi Kabhi Gulzaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
O Madina’s Desert! The Heavens’ Soul, Your Pure Bloom Is Being
Never Again, Towards The Garden, Will The Nightingale Be Going

shers.roman:
Inkaar Ka Wuqoo’ To Kya Ho Kareem Se
Maa-il Huwa Na Dil Kabhi Inkaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Leave Alone The Occurrence of Denial From My Generous King
Even In The Direction of Denial, His Heart Was Never Inclining

shers.roman:
Jannat Bhi Lene Aaye To Ch’horeñ Na Ye Gali
Munh Pheyr Bayt’heñ Ham Teri Diwaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Even If Heaven Comes To Get Us, This Lane We Shall Not Be Leaving
We Have Turned Our Faces Away, Facing Your Wall, We Are Sitting

shers.roman:
Muñh Us Ka Dekhti Haiñ Bahaareñ Bahisht Ki
Jis Ki Nigaah Hai Tere Rukhsaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
At The Face of That Person, The Blooms of Paradise Are Gazing
Towards Your Sacred Face, Directed The One Whose Sight Is Being

shers.roman:
Jaañ Bakhshiyaañ Maseeh Ko Hayrat Meiñ ‘Daalteeñ
Chup Bayt’hay, Dekhte, Teri Raftaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
By His Life-Giving Pardons, Astounded, The Messiah Is Being
Silently He Is Seated, Towards Your Swiftness, He Is Gazing

shers.roman:
Mahshar Meiñ Aaftaab Ud’har Garm, Awr Id’har
Aankheñ Lagi Haiñ Daaman e Dildaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
The Sun’s Heat Will Be Intense, There, On The Day of Reckoning
And Here, Towards The Beloved’s Mantle, Fixed Our Eyes Are Being

shers.roman:
Phayla Huwa Hai Haath Tere Dar Ke Saamne
Gardan Jhuki Huwi Teri Diwaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Before Your Consecrated Court, Our Hands We Are Spreading
Whilst Towards Your Sacred Wall, Our Necks We Are Lowering

shers.roman:
Go Be-Shumaar Jurm Hoñ, Go Be ‘Adad Gunaah
Kuch Gham Nahiñ Jo Tum Ho Gunahgaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Even Though, Countless Faults, And Numerous Sins, I Am Having
If You Are On The Side of This Sinner, No Grief He Will Be Having

shers.roman:
Yuñ Mujh Ko Maut Aaye, To Kya Poochna Mera!
Maiñ Khaak Par, Nigaah Dar e Yaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
O How Fortunate I Would Be, If In This Condition, I Were To Be Dying!
As I Lay On The Dust, Towards The Beloved’s Court, My Eyes Are Gazing

shers.roman:
Kaa’be Ke Sadqe, Dil Ki Tamanna Magar Ye Hai
Marne Ke Waqt Muñh Ho Dar e Yaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Great Indeed, Is The Kaa’ba, But For This, My Heart Is Yearning
At The Time of My Death, The Beloved’s Court, I Should Be Facing

shers.roman:
De Jaate Haiñ Muraad, Jahaañ Maangiye Wahaañ
Munh Hona Chaahiye Dar e Sarkaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
From Wherever You Are Requesting, Your Wishes He Is Granting
But Your Face Should Be Directed, Towards The Court of The King

shers.roman:
Rokegi Hashr Meiñ Jo Mujhe Paa Shikastagi
Dawr’eñge Haath Daaman e Dildaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
When My Defeated Feet, Will Hinder Me On The Day of Reckoning
Towards The Mantle of My Beloved, My Hands Will Be Hastening

shers.roman:
Aaheñ Dil e Aseer Se Lab Tak Na Aayi Theeñ
Awr Aap Dawr’eñ Aaye Giriftaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
The Sighs of The Detainee’s Heart, His Lips, Were Still Not Reaching
And Immediately, Towards The Detainee, My Nabi Came Rushing

shers.roman:
Dekhi Jo Bekasi To Unheñ Rahm Aa Gaya
Ghabra Ke Ho Gaye Wo Gunahgaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
He Instantly Felt Pity, When Our Helplessness, He Was Seeing
Immediately In Support of The Sinners, Present He Was Being

shers.roman:
Bat’ti Hai Bheek Dawr’tay Phirtay Haiñ Be-Nawa
Dar Ki Taraf Kabhi, Kabhi Diwaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
The Destitute Are Running Around, Whilst Distributed, Alms Are Being
At Times, Towards His Court, At Times, Towards His Wall, They Are Going

shers.roman:
‘Aalam Ke Dil To Bhar Gaye Daulat Se, Kya ‘Ajab
Ghar Dawr’ne Lageeñ Dar e Sarkaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
Already Tired of All The Wealth, The Heart of The World Is Being
If The House Runs To My Master’s Court, It Won’t Be Astounding

shers.roman:
Aankheñ Jo Band Hoñ To Muqad’dar Khulay Hasan
Jalwe Khud Aayeñ Taalib e Deedaar Ki Taraf
shers.english:
O Hasan! As My Eyes Close, My Good Times Should Be Approaching
Towards The Seeker of His Vision, His Lustres, Should Itself Be Coming

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TERA ZUHOOR HUWA CHASHM E NOOR KI RONAQ

shers.roman:
Tera Zuhoor Huwa Chashm e Noor Ki Ronaq
Tera Hee Noor Hai Bazm e Huzoor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
To The Light of The Eyes, Your Advent Brought True Radiance
To The Assembly of Light, Your Luminance, Is Pure Radiance

shers.roman:
Rahe Na Afw Meiñ Phir Aik Zar’ra Shak Baaqi
Jo Un Ki Khaak e Qadam Ho Quboor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
An Aorta of Doubt Will Not Remain, In Me Attaining Deliverance
If The Holy Dust of His Sacred Feet, Becomes My Grave’s Radiance

shers.roman:
Na Farsh Ka Ye Tajam’mul, Na ‘Arsh Ka Ye Jamaal
Faqat Hai Noor o Zuhoor e Huzoor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
Neither Is It By The Earth’s Splendour, Nor By The Throne’s Elegance
It Is Only His Light And His Advent, That Has Brought This Radiance

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Noor Se Roshan Huwe Zameen o Falak
Yahi Jamaal Hai, Nazdeek o Door Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
The Earth And The Sky, Were Illuminated By Your Luminance
From Near Or Afar, Same Is The Splendour of Your Radiance

shers.roman:
Zabaan e Haal Se Kehte Haiñ Naqsh e Paa Un Ke
Hameeñ Haiñ Chehra e Ghilmaan o Hoor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
In Its Own Unspoken Tongue, His Sacred Footprints Announce
We Alone, Are The Heavenly Maidens’ And Servants’ Radiance

shers.roman:
Tere Nisaar, Tera Aik Jalwa e Rangeeñ
Bahaar e Jannat o Hoor o Qusoor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
Such Is Your Splendour! That By A Single Shade of Your Luminance
All The Heavenly Blooms, Maidens And Palaces, Attained Radiance

shers.roman:
Zia Zameen o Falak Ki Hai Jis Tajal’li Se
Ilaahi Ho Wo Dil e Na Saboor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
The Light, By Which The Earth And The Sky Attained Luminance
O Allah! May It Also Become, My Impatient Heart’s Radiance

shers.roman:
Yahi Farogh To Zeb e Safa o Zeenat Hai
Yahi Hai Husn o Tajal’li o Noor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
The Elegance And The Beauty of Pure Virtue, Is By This Luminance
The Splendour of Beauty, Brilliance And Light, Is By This Radiance

shers.roman:
Huzoor! Teera o Taarik Hai Ye Phat’tar Dil
Tajal’liyoñ Se Huwi Koh e Toor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
O My Nabi! This Stone Heart, Is Dark And Void of Luminance
By The Radiance of Your Lustres, Was Mount Sinai’s Radiance

shers.roman:
Saji Hai Jinn Se Shabistaan e ‘Aalam e Imkaañ
Wahi Haiñ Majlis e Roz e Nushoor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
By Whom, The Chamber of The Existing Universe, Attained Brilliance
It Is He Alone, Who Is The Assembly of Judgement Day’s Radiance

shers.roman:
Kareñ Diloñ Ko Munawwar Siraaj 1 Ke Jalwe
Farogh e Bazm e ‘Awaarif Hai Noor 2 Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
By Way of This Bright Lamp, May The Hearts Attain Radiance
The Splendour of The Assembly of Gnostics, Is This Radiance

shers.roman:
Dua Khuda Se Gham e ‘Ishq e Mustafa Ki Hai
Hasan Ye Gham Hai Nashaat o Suroor Ki Ronaq
shers.english:
To Allah, Is My Supplication, For The Sorrow of Love’s Presence
O Hasan! This Sorrow, Adorns Delight And Ecstasy With Radiance

shers.roman:
1. Refers To Siraaj ul ‘Awaarif, A Book of Tasawwuf Written By Hazrat Abul
Husain Ahmad e Noori Radi Allahu Anhu
shers.english:
2. Portion of The Pen Name of Hazrat Sayyiduna Abul Husain Ahmad e Noori
Radi Allahu Anhu

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JO HO SAR KO RASAA-I UN KE DAR TAK

shers.roman:
Jo Ho Sar Ko Rasaa-i Un Ke Dar Tak
To Pahunche Taaj e ‘Izzat Apne Sar Tak
shers.english:
If His Sacred Court, My Humble Head Were To Be Reaching
Then To My Head, The Crown of Honour, Would Be Reaching

shers.roman:
Wo Jab Tashreef Laaye Ghar Se Dar Tak
Bhikaari Ka Bhara Hai Dar Se Ghar Tak
shers.english:
From His Sacred Chambers, To His Court, When He Is Appearing
From The Sacred Court, Upto His Home, The Beggar Is Receiving

shers.roman:
Duhaa-i Na Khuda e Bekasaañ Ki
Ke Seylaab e Alam Pahuncha Kamar Tak
shers.english:
O Saviour of The Helpless, Your Special Aid I Am Seeking
For, Upto My Waist, The Flood of Grief, Is Now Reaching

shers.roman:
Ilaahi Dil Ko De Wo Sauz e Ulfat
Phunkay Seena Jalan Pahunche Jigar Tak
shers.english:
O Allah Almighty! To My Heart, That Burning Love, Do Be Granting
As My Chest Explodes; Upto My Heart, The Burn Should Be Reaching

shers.roman:
Na Ho Jab Tak Tumhaara Naam Shaamil
Dua-eñ Jaa Nahiñ Sakteeñ Asar Tak
shers.english:
Genuinely Included, Until Your Blessed Name, Is Not Being
The True Sense of Acceptance, Supplications Cannot Be Reaching

shers.roman:
Guzar Ki Raah Nikli Rah-Guzar Meiñ
Abhi Pahunche Na Thay Ham Un Ke Dar Tak
shers.english:
From Within The Passage, A Passageway Was Emerging
Yet His Sacred Court, Until Now, We Were Not Reaching

shers.roman:
Khuda Yuñ Un Ki Ulfat Meiñ Guma De
Na Paaoñ Phir Kabhi Apni Khabar Tak
shers.english:
So Profoundly In His Love, O Allah! Let Me Be Submerging
That Never Again, My Own Identity, I Should Be Discovering

shers.roman:
Bajaaye Chashm e Khud Ut’hta Na Ho Aar’
Jamaal e Yaar Se Teri Nazar Tak
shers.english:
Apart From My Own Eyes, The Screen Is Not Rising
From The Beloved’s Beauty, Upto Your Sight, Gracing

shers.roman:
Teri Ne’mat Ke Bhookay Ahl e Daulat
Teri Rahmat Ka Pyaasa (Hai) Abr Tak
shers.english:
Starving For Your Blessings, The Wealthy Are Being
Thirsty For Your Mercy, Even The Clouds Are Being

shers.roman:
Na Hoga Do Qadam Ka Faasla Bhi
Ilaahabaad Se Ahmad Nagar Tak
shers.english:
Even The Distance of Two Steps Will Not Be Existing
Between Ilaahabaad And Ahmed Nagar, Such It Is Being

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Husn Ke Baar’ray Ke Sadqe
Namak Khwaar e Malaahat Hai Qamar Tak
shers.english:
By The Benedictions of Your Beauty’s Generous Blessings
Your Captivating Beauty, Even The Radiant Moon Is Seeking

shers.roman:
Shab e Me’raj Thay Jalwe Pe Jalwe
Shabistaan e Danaa Se Un Ke Ghar Tak
shers.english:
On The Eve of The Ascension, Lustres Upon Lustres Were Descending
From The Domain of Nearness, Upto His Home, They Were Reaching

shers.roman:
Balaa e Jaan Hai (Ab) Weeraani e Dil
Chalay Aawo Kabhi Is Ujr’ay Ghar Tak
shers.english:
The Tragedy of Life, My Empty Heart Is Now Being
Into This Ruined House, Sometimes, Do Be Coming

shers.roman:
Na Khol Aankheñ Nigaah e Shauq e Naaqis
Bahut Parday Haiñ Husn e Jalwagar Tak
shers.english:
O Gaze of Imperfect Yearning, Your Eyes, Do Not Be Opening
Upto The Manifest Beauty, Many Veils Are Still Remaining

shers.roman:
Jahannam Meiñ Dhakeleñ Najdiyoñ Ko
Hasan Jhoot’oñ Ko Yuñ Pahunchaayeñ Ghar Tak
shers.english:
Into Hell-Fire, The Malicious Najdis, You Should Be Thrusting
O Hasan! To Their Abode, In This Way, The Liars Do Be Sending

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TOOR NE TO KHOOB DEKHA JALWA E SHAAN E JAMAAL

shers.roman:
Toor Ne To Khoob Dekha Jalwa e Shaan e Jamaal
Is Taraf Bhi Ik Nazar Ay Barq e Taabaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The Lustre of Beauty’s Grandeur, Mount Sinai Saw Very Clearly
Cast A Glance This Way As Well, O Dazzling Lightning of Beauty!

shers.roman:
Ik Nazar Be Parda Ho Jaaye Jo Lam’aan e Jamaal
Mardum e Deeda Ki Aankhoñ Par Jo Ehsaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
If Even Unveiled For A Single Glance, Is A Slight Flash of His Pure Beauty
Upon The Pupil of The Beholder’s Eye, Will Be The Favour of His Beauty

shers.roman:
Chal Gaya Jis Raah Meiñ Sarw e Khiraamaan e Jamaal
Naqsh e Paa Se Khil Gaye Laakhoñ Gulistaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Upon Whichever Pathway, Passed The Height of The Beloved’s Beauty
Through His Holy Footprints, Blossomed Millions of Gardens of Beauty

shers.roman:
Hai Shab e Gham Awr Giraftaaraan e Hijraan e Jamaal
Mahr Kar Zar’roñ Pe Ay Khursheed e Taabaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
It Is The Night of Grief, And The Captives Are Separated From His Beauty
Upon The Dust Particles, Shine Your Glimmers, O Glowing Sun of Beauty!

shers.roman:
Kar Gaya Aakhir Libaas e Laalah o Gul Meiñ Zuhoor
Khaak Meiñ Milta Nahiñ Khoon e Shaheedaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
In The Garb of The Tulip And The Rose, He Has Manifested Finally
Never Ruined In The Dust, Is The Blood of The Martyrs of Beauty

shers.roman:
Zar’ra-Zar’ra Khaak Ka Ho Jaayega Khursheed e Hashr
Qabr Meiñ Le Jaayeñge ‘Aashiq Jo Armaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Every Speck of This Dust, Will Become The Sun on Judgement Day
The Lover Will Be Guided To His Grave, By His Longing For Beauty

shers.roman:
Ho Gaya Shaadaab ‘Aalam, Aa Gayi Fasl e Bahaar
Ut’h Gaya Parda, Khila Baab e Gulistaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The World Began Flourishing, The Spring Season Arrived Promptly
As The Veil Was Raised, Radiantly Bloomed The Gateway of Beauty

shers.roman:
Jalwa e Moo e Mahaasin Chehra e Anwar Ke Gird
Aabnoosi Rahl Par Rakh’kha Hai Qur’aan e Jamaal
shers.english:
His Glowing Face Is Encircled, By The Glow of His Beard, Perfectly
As If Kept On A Black Ebony Stand, Is The Scripture of Beauty

shers.roman:
Us Ke Jalwe Se Na Kyuñ Kaafoor Hoñ Zulmaat e Kufr
Pesh-Gaah e Noor Se Aaya Hai Farmaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
By His Lustres, Why Shouldn’t The Darkness of Unbelief Decline Entirely?
From The Grand Court of Light, Has Come The Manifest Directive of Beauty

shers.roman:
Kya Kahuñ Kitna Hai Un Ki Rah-Guzar Meiñ Josh e Husn
Aashkaara Zar’ra-Zar’ra Se Hai Maidaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Upon His Sacred Pathway, I Cannot Explain The Passion of Beauty
For Every Dust Particle, Manifests The Sacred Sphere of His Beauty

shers.roman:
Zar’ra e Dar Se Tere Hamsar Hoñ Kya Mahr o Qamar
Ye Hai Sultaan e Jamaal Awr Wo Gadayaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Equal To The Dust of Your Court, How Can The Sun And Moon Be?
He Is The Emperor of Beauty, Whilst They Are The Slaves of Beauty

shers.roman:
Kya Mazay Ki Zindagi Hai Zindagi ‘Ush’shaaq Ki
Aankheñ Un Ki Justuju Meiñ Dil Meiñ Armaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The Life of The True Lovers, Is A Life, Filled With Immense Beauty
As My Eyes Search For Him, My Heart Yearns To See His Beauty

shers.roman:
Roo Siyaahi Ne Shab e Daijoor Ko Sharma Diya
Munh Ujaala Kar De Ay Khursheed e Taabaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Due To My Dark Sins, The Dark Night Was Embarrassed Completely
Cause My Face To Glow As Well, O Radiant Sun of His Glowing Beauty

shers.roman:
Abru e Pur Kham Se Paida Hai Hilaal e Maah e ‘Eid
Matla’e ‘Aariz Se Roshan Badr e Taabaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
His Perfectly Arched Eye-Brows, Resemble The Eid Crescent Clearly
His Bright Rosy Cheeks, Manifest The Moon of His Radiant Beauty

shers.roman:
Dil-Kashi e Husn e Jaanaañ Ka Ho Kya ‘Aalam Bayaañ
Dil Fida e Aa-ina, Aa-ina Qurbaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
How Can I Truly Explain, The Pure Attraction In My Beloved’s Beauty
In The Mirror, The Heart Is Lost, And The Mirror Is Lost In His Beauty

shers.roman:
Pesh e Yusuf Haath Kaat’ay Haiñ Zanaan e Misr Ne
Teri Khaatir Sar Kat’a Bayt’hay Fidayaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
In Yusuf’s Presence, The Egyptian Women, Cut Their Hands Instinctively
Heads Were Given In Your Love, By The Devotees of Your Pure Beauty

shers.roman:
Tere Zar’ray Par Shab e Gham Ki Jafaayeñ Taa Bakay
Noor Ka Tar’ka Dikha Ay Mahr e Taabaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Until When, Must Your Slaves, Endure The Injustices of This Agony?
Show Us The Dawn of Radiance, O Glowing Sun of Perfect Beauty

shers.roman:
Itni Mud’dat Tak Ho Deed e Mushaf e ‘Aariz Naseeb
Hifz Kar Luñ Naazirah Par’h-Par’h Ke Qur’aan e Jamal
shers.english:
With The Sight of Your Luminous Face, May I Be Blessed So Extensively
Beauty

shers.roman:
Ya Khuda Dil Ki Gali Se Kaun Guzra Hai Ke Aaj
Zar’re-Zar’re Se Hai Taale’ Mahr e Taabaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Who Has Passed By My Heart’s Lane Today, O Allah Almighty?
For Every Particle Is Now Reflecting, The Radiant Sun’s Beauty

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dar Par Is Qadr Bat’ta Hai Baar’a Noor Ka
Jholiyaañ Bhar-Bhar Ke Laate Haiñ Gadayaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
At His Sacred Court, The Alms of Light, Is Distributed So Generously
Filling Their Begging Pouches Very Tightly, Are The Slaves of Beauty

shers.roman:
Noor Ki Baarish Hasan Par Ho Tere Deedaar Se
Dil Se Dhul Jaaye Ilaahi Daagh e Hirmaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
By Your Holy Vision, Upon Hasan, Shower The Rains of Luminosity
O Allah Almighty! Erase The Scar, of Being Deprived of This Beauty

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: BAZM E MAHSHAR MUN’AQID KAR MEER E SAAMAAN E JAMAAL

shers.roman:
Bazm e Mahshar Mun’aqid Kar Meer e Saamaan e Jamaal
Dil Ke Aa-inoñ Ko Mud’dat Se Hai Armaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Convene The Day of Reckoning, O Master of The Provisions of Beauty
The Mirrors of The Heart Are Yearning, For A Long Time, For His Beauty

shers.roman:
Apna Sadqa Baant’ta Aata Hai Sultaan e Jamaal
Jholiyaañ Pheylaaye Dawr’eñ Be-Nawayaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Distributing His Blessings As He Arrives, Is The Emperor of Beauty
Rushing With Their Open Satchels, Are The Needy Seekers of Beauty

shers.roman:
Jis Tarh Se ‘Aashiqoñ Ka Dil Hai Qurbaan e Jamaal
Hai Yuñhi Qurbaan Teri Shakl Par Jaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Just As The Hearts of The Lovers, Are Sacrificed Upon Your Beauty
Similarly Sacrificed Upon Your Countenance, Is The Soul of Beauty

shers.roman:
Be-Hijaabaana Dikha Do Ik Nazar Aan e Jamaal
Sadqe Honay Ke Liye Haazir Haiñ Khwahaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Show Us Just A Glimpse of The Splendour, of Your Unveiled Beauty
For, Willing To Sacrifice Their Lives, Are The True Seekers of Beauty

shers.roman:
Teri Hee Qaamat Ne Chamkaaya Muqad’dar Husn Ka
Bus Usi Ik’kay Se Roshan Hai Shabistaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
It Is Your Grand Stature, Which Illuminated The Destiny of Beauty
It Is Only By That Lamp, That, Radiant Is The Chamber of Beauty

shers.roman:
Rooh Legi Hashr Tak Khushboo e Jannat Ke Mazay
Gar Basaa Dega Kafan ‘Itr e Girebaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Until The Day of Reckoning, Heaven’s Scent, The Soul Will Enjoy
If The Shroud Will Imbue In It, The Perfume of His Collar’s Beauty

shers.roman:
Mar Gaye ‘Ush’shaaq Lekin Waa Hai Chashm e Muntazir
Hashr Tak Aankheñ Tujhe ‘Dhoond’eñgi Ay Jaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Even Though The Lovers Have Died, Their Open Eyes, Are Waiting Patiently
Until Judgment Day, Their Eyes Will Search For You, O Soul of Beauty!

shers.roman:
Peshgi Hee Naqd e Jaañ Dete Chalay Haiñ Mushtari
Hashr Meiñ Kholega Ya Rab’b Kaun Duk’kaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
In Advance, The Price of Their Souls, The Buyers Have Paid Already
O Allah! On Reckoning Day, Who Will Open The Store of Beauty?

shers.roman:
‘Aashiqoñ Ka Zikr Kya Ma’shooq ‘Aashiq Ho Gaye
Anjuman Ki Anjuman Sadqe Hai Ay Jaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Leave Alone The Lovers, The Beloveds Have Become Lovers Already
Galaxies Upon Galaxies, Are Sacrificed Upon You, O Soul of Beauty!

shers.roman:
Teri Zur’riy’yat Ka Har Zar’ra Na Kyuñ Ho Aaftaab
Sar Zameen e Husn e Se Nikli Hai Ye Kaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
A Radiant Sun, Why Shouldn’t Your Every Family Member Be?
When From The Land of Beauty, Arose These Mines of Beauty

shers.roman:
Bazm e Mahshar Meiñ Haseenaan e Jahaañ Sab Jama’ Haiñ
Par Nazar Teri Taraf Ut’hti Hai Ay Jaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The World’s Most Beautiful, Are Gathered For Judgement Day’s Assembly
But All Their Gazes Are Only Directed Towards You, O Soul of Beauty!

shers.roman:
Aa Rahi Hai Zulmat e Shab, Haaye! Gham Peecha Kiye
Noor e Yazdaañ Ham Ko Le-Le Zer e Daamaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The Darkness of Night Is Approaching; Alas, I Am Followed By Agony
O Light of Allah Almighty! Please Shade Us In Your Mantle of Beauty

shers.roman:
Wus’at e Baazaar e Mahshar Tang Hai Us Ki Huzoor
Kis Jaga Kholay Kisi Ka Husn Duk’kaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Before Him, The Vast Bazaar of Reckoning Day, Constricted Will Be
So, Where Can Anyone Else, Manage To Open Their Store of Beauty

shers.roman:
Khoobruyaan e Jahaañ Ko Bhi Yahi Kehte Suna
Tum Ho Shaan e Husn e Jaan e Husn e Imaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The Most Beautiful In The World, Were Heard Proclaiming Ecstatically
You Are The Glory of Beauty, The Soul of Beauty, The Faith of Beauty

shers.roman:
Teera o Taarik Rehti Bazm e Khoobaan e Jahaañ
Gar Tera Jalwa Na Hota Sham’e Aywaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The Assembly of The World’s Fairest, Would Have Been Dark Entirely
Had Your Radiant Lustre, Not Been The Lamp of The Fortress of Beauty

shers.roman:
Maiñ Tasad’duq Jaawuñ Ay Shams-ud Duha Badr-ud Duja
Is Dil e Taarik Par Bhi Koyi Lam’aan e Jamaal
shers.english:
O Illuminating Sun! O Moon Eradicating Darkness! Sacrificed May I Be
Upon This Very Dark Heart, Also Shine A Ray of Your Radiant Beauty

shers.roman:
Sab Se Pehle Hazrat e Yusuf Ka Naam e Paak Luñ
Maiñ Ginaawoñ Gar Tere Um’meed-Waaraan e Jamaal
shers.english:
The Blessed Name of Hazrat Yusuf, I Would Have Mentioned Foremostly
If I Were To Make A List, of All Those, Who Are Yearning For Your Beauty

shers.roman:
Be-Basar Par Bhi Ye Un Ki Husn Ne Daala Asar
Dil Meiñ Hai Phoot’i Huwi Aankhoñ Pe Armaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Even Upon The Blind Person, Such Is The Effect of His Beauty
The Heart Still Hopes, That His Blind Eyes, Will See His Beauty

shers.roman:
‘Aashiqoñ Ne Razm-Gaahoñ Meiñ Galay Kat’wa Diye
Waah! Kis-Kis Lutf Se Ki ‘Eid e Qurbaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Even In The Battlefields, The True Lovers, Sacrificed Their Lives Devotedly
Wow! With Such Pleasure, They Rejoiced Their Sacrifices Upon His Beauty

shers.roman:
Ya Khuda Dekhuñ Bahaar e Khanda e Dandaañ Numa
Barsay Kisht e Aarazu Par Abr e Naisaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
O Allah! May I See His Glowing Teeth, As He Smiles Beautifully
Upon The Meadow of My Hopes, Shower The Rains of His Beauty

shers.roman:
Zulmat e Marqad Se Andesha Hasan Ko Kuch Nahiñ
Hai Wo Mad’daah e Haseenaañ Manqabat Khwaan e Jamaal
shers.english:
Concerning The Darkness of The Grave, Hasan Has No Real Worry
For He Praises The Beautiful Ones, Paying Tribute To True Beauty

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AY DEEN E HAQ KE RAHBAR TUM PAR SALAAM HAR DAM

shers.roman:
Ay Deen e Haq Ke Rahbar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
Mere Shafi’ e Mahshar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
O Majestic Guide of The True Religion, Salutations Upon You Forever
My Intercessor On The Day of Reckoning, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Is Bekas o Hazeeñ Par Jo Kuch Guzar Rahi Hai
Zaahir Hai Sab Wo Tum Par, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Upon This Helpless And Aggrieved One, Whatever Does Transpire
Upon You, Manifest Is Everything, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Dunya o Aakhirat Meiñ Jab Maiñ Rahuñ Salaamat
Pyaare Par’huñ Na Kyuñkar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
When I Am To Remain Safe In The World, And In The Hereafter
O Beloved! Why Shouldn’t I Recite, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Dil Taftagaan e Furqat Pyaase Haiñ Mud’datoñ Se
Ham Ko Bhi Jaam e Kawthar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Thirsty For A Long Time, Are These Hearts Which Burn In Despair
Also, Grant Us Kawthar’s Goblet, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Banda Tumhaare Dar Ka, Aafat Meiñ Mubtala Hai
Rahm Ay Habeeb e Daawar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
This Humble Slave of Your Holy Court, Is Facing Severe Disaster
O Most Beloved of The Creator! Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Be Waarisoñ Ke Waaris, Be Waaliyoñ Ke Waali
Taskeen e Jaan e Muztar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
The Master To The Heirless, To The Unprotected, Their Protector
The Comfort To The Troubled Souls, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Lil’Laah Ab Hamaari, Faryaad Ko Pahunchiye
Be Had Hai Haal Abtar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
For Almighty Allah’s Sake! To My Pleas, I Beg You To Hear
Very Anxious I Am Being, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Jal’laad e Nafs e Bad Se, Dijay Mujhe Rihaayi
Ab Hai Galay Pe Khanjar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Please Have Me Released, From The Evil Inner-self’s Executioner
Over My Neck A Sword Is Hanging, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Daryooza-Gar Huñ Maiñ Bhi, Adna Saa Us Gali Ka
Lutf o Karam Ho Mujh Par, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
At That Most Exalted Court, Even I Am A Humble Beggar
Grant Me Your Love & Mercy, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Koyi Nahiñ Hai Mera, Maiñ Kis Se Daad Chaahuñ
Sultaan e Banda-Parwar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
None I Am Having, Justice From Whom, Will I Now Secure?
O King of All The Benefactors, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Gham Ki Ghat’aayeñ Ghir Kar, Aayi Haiñ Har Taraf Se
Ay Mahr Zar’ra Parwar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
From All Directions, The Clouds of Anguish, Have Started To Gather
O Sun, That Brightens The Particles! Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Bulwa Ke Apne Dar Par, Ab Mujh Ko Dijay ‘Iz’zat
Phirta Huñ Khwaar Dar-Dar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Please Invite Me To Your Exalted Court, And Bless Me With Honour
From Pillar To Post I Am Wandering, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Muhtaaj Se Tumhaare, Sab Karte Haiñ Kinaara
Bas Ik Tumheeñ Ho Yaawar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Everyone Is Keeping Aloof, From Your Humble Beggar
You Alone Are My Guardian, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Behr e Khuda Bachaawo, In Khaar-Haa e Gham Se
Ik Dil Hai Laakh Nashtar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
For Almighty Allah’s Sake, Save Me From These Thorns of Despair
In One Heart, Are A Million Lancets, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Koyi Nahiñ Hamaara, Ham Kis Ke Dar Pe Jaayeñ
Ay Bekasoñ Ke Yaawar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Alone I Am Being, Towards Whose Court, Should I Wander
O Guardian of The Helpless! Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Kya Khauf Mujh Ko Pyaare, Naar e Jaheem Se Ho
Tum Ho Shafi’ e Mahshar, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
O Most Beloved! From The Fire of Hell, Why Should I Have Any Fear
You Are The Intercessor of Reckoning Day, Salutations Upon You Forever

shers.roman:
Apne Gada e Dar Ki, Lijay Khabar Khudaara
Kijay Karam Hasan Par, Tum Par Salaam Har Dam
shers.english:
Please Come To My Aid, For At Your Grand Court, I Am A Beggar
Upon Hasan, Shower Your Mercy, Salutations Upon You Forever

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AY MADINAY KE TAAJDAAR SALAAM

shers.roman:
Ay Madinay Ke Taajdaar Salaam
Ay Ghareeboñ Ke Gham-Gusaar Salaam
shers.english:
Upon You, O Grand King of Madina! Salutations
Upon You, O Consoler of The Poor! Salutations

shers.roman:
Teri Ik, Ik Ada Par Ay Pyaare
Sau Duroodeñ Fida, Hazaar Salaam
shers.english:
O Beloved! Upon Every One of Your Blessed Gesticulations
I Offer A Hundred Duroods, And Thousands of Salutations

shers.roman:
Rab’b e Sal’lim Ke Kehne Waale Par
Jaan Ke Saath Huñ Nisaar Salaam
shers.english:
Upon Him, Who Says, ‘O Allah! Grant Them Safe Migration’
From My Soul, I Convey Upon Him, Offerings of Salutations

shers.roman:
Mere Pyaare Pe Mere Aaqa Par
Meri Jaanib Se Lakh Baar Salaam
shers.english:
Upon My Most Beloved, Upon My Master, Full of Affection
From Myself I Am Offering, A Hundred Thousand Salutations

shers.roman:
Meri Bigr’i Banaane Waale Par
Bhej Ay Mere Kirdgaar Salaam
shers.english:
Upon The One Who Assists Me During Every Difficult Situation
O My Almighty Creator! Please Do Send, Exalted Salutations

shers.roman:
Us Panaah e Gunahgaaraañ Par
Ye Salaam Awr Karor Baar Salaam
shers.english:
Upon The Sinful One’s, Sanctuary And Refuge Station
This Salaam, And Together With It, Billions of Salutations

shers.roman:
Us Jawaab e Salaam Ke Sadqe
Taa Qiyaamat Hoñ Be Shumaar Salaam
shers.english:
By The Special Blessings, of That Response To Salutations
Until The Last Day, May There Be Countless Salutations

shers.roman:
Un Ki Mehfil Meiñ Saath Le Jaayeñ
Hasrat e Jaan e Be-Qaraar Salaam
shers.english:
To His Blessed Gathering, Take With You This Benediction
From The Restless And Anxious Heart, Sincere Salutations

shers.roman:
Parda Mera Na Faash Hashr Meiñ Ho
Ay Mere Haq Ke Raaz-Daar Salaam
shers.english:
Do Not Expose My Reality On The Day of Resurrection
O The Secret-Bearer of My Almighty Creator! Salutations

shers.roman:
Wo Salaamat Raha Qiyaamat Meiñ
Par’h Liya Jis Ne Dil Se Chaar Salaam
shers.english:
He Will Indeed, Be Safe on The Day of Resurrection
If He Truly Recited From His Heart, Four Salutations

shers.roman:
Arz Karta Hai Ye Hasan Tera
Tujh Pe Ay Khuld Ki Bahaar Salaam
shers.english:
Your Hasan Is Stating With Complete Devotion
Upon You, O Splendour of Paradise, Salutations

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TERE DAR PE SAAJID HAI SHAAHAAN E ‘AALAM

shers.roman:
Tere Dar Pe Saajid Hai Shaahaan e ‘Aalam
Tu Sultaan e ‘Aalam Hai Ay Jaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
At Your Holy Court, Prostrating, Are The Kings of The World
You Are The Grand King of The World, O Soul of The World!

shers.roman:
Ye Pyaari Adaa-eñ Ye Neechi Nigaaheñ
Fida Jaan e ‘Aalam Ho Ay Jaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
These Beautiful Gestures, These Humbly Lowered Gazes
Sacrificed Upon The Soul of The World, O Soul of The World!

shers.roman:
Kisi Awr Ko Bhi Ye Dawlat Mili Hai?
Gada Kis Ke Dar Par Haiñ Shaahaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
As Great As This, Has Anyone Else Attained Such A Treasure?
Mendicants, At Whose Threshold, Are The Kings of The World?

shers.roman:
Maiñ Dar-Dar Phiruñ Ch’hor Kar Kyuñ Tera Dar
Ut’haaye Bala Meri Ehsaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Leaving Your Court, Why Should I Wander Everywhere
Remove All My Misfortunes, O Benefactor of The World

shers.roman:
Maiñ Sarkaar e ‘Aali Ke Qurbaan Jaawuñ
Bhikaari Haiñ Us Dar Ke Shaahaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
May I Be Sacrificed Upon The Court of My Exalted Master
Beggars of That Grand Court, Are The Kings of The World

shers.roman:
Mere Dabdaba Waale Maiñ Tere Sadqe
Tere Dar Ke Kut’tay Haiñ Sheraan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
I Am Entirely Sacrificed Upon You, O My Majestic Master!
Mere Dogs At Your Holy Court, Are The Lions of The World

shers.roman:
Tumhaari Taraf Haath Phaylay Hai Sab Ke
Tumheeñ Poore Karte Haiñ Armaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Towards You, All Are Stretching Their Hands, My Master!
It Is You Who Truly Fulfils, All The Wishes of The World

shers.roman:
Mujhe Zinda Kar De, Mujhe Zinda Kar De
Mere Jaan e ‘Aalam, Mere Jaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Bring Me Back To Life, Do Bring Me Back To Life!
O My Soul of The World! O My Soul of The World!

shers.roman:
Musalmaañ, Musalmaañ Haiñ Tere Sabab Se
Meri Jaan Tu Hee Hai Imaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Muslims Are Only Muslims, Through Your Blessings
O My Beloved! You Alone, Are The Faith of The World

shers.roman:
Mere Aan Waale Mere Shaan Waale
Gadaayi Tere Dar Ki Hai Shaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
O My Splendid Master! O My Honourable Master!
Mendicity At Your Court, Is The Honour of The World

shers.roman:
Tu Bahr e Haqeeqat Tu Darya e ‘Irfaañ
Tera Aik Qatrah Hai ‘Irfaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
You Are The Ocean of Reality, You Are The Sea of Mystical Awareness
In Your Single Drop, Is The Mystical Awareness of The Entire World

shers.roman:
Koyi Jalwa Mere Bhi Roz e Siyaah Par
Khuda Ke Qamar, Mahr e Taabaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Grace My Dark Day As Well, With A Blessed Lustre
O Allah’s Moon! O Glowing Sun of The World

shers.roman:
Bus Ab Kuch ‘Inaayat Huwa, Ab Mila Kuch
Unheñ Taktay Rehna Gadayaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Soon You Will Be Gifted, Soon You Will Get Something
Keep On Looking At Him, O Mendicants of The World!

shers.roman:
Wo Dulha Hai Saari Khudaayi Baaraati
Unheeñ Ke Liye Hai Ye Saamaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
He Is The Groom, The Entire Creation Is the Procession
In Reality, For Him, Is This Arrangement of This World

shers.roman:
Na Dekha Koyi Phool Tujh Sa Na Dekha
Bahut Ch’haan ‘Daale Gulistaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
No Flower I Have Seen, Which Is As Beautiful As You, My Master!
I Have Searched Meticulously, Through The Gardens of The World

shers.roman:
Tere Kooche Ki Khaak ‘Tehri Azal Se
Meri Jaañ, ‘Ilaaj e Mareezaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
From The Very Beginning, The Sacred Dust of Your Lane Was Being,
O My Beloved! The Genuine Remedy, For The Ailing of The World

shers.roman:
Koyi Jaan e ‘Esa Ko Jaa Kar Khabar De
Maray Jaate Haiñ Dard-Mandaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
To The Soul of Hazrat ‘Esa, Someone Should Go And Say
Dying In Anguish, Are The Aggrieved Ones of The World

shers.roman:
Abhi Saare Bimaar Hote Haiñ Ach’che
Agar Lab Hila De, Wo Darmaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
Instantly All The Ailing Ones, Will Be Completely Cured
If Only The Sacred Lips Move, of That Relief of The World

shers.roman:
Samee’an Khudaara Hasan Ki Bhi Sun Le
Balaa Meiñ Hai Ye Lawth Daamaan e ‘Aalam
shers.english:
O You Who Is Hearing! Listen To Hasan’s Plea As Well
For Polluted In Calamities, Is The Shroud of The World

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JAATE HAIÑ SOO E MADINA GHAR SE HAM

shers.roman:
Jaate Haiñ Soo e Madina Ghar Se Ham
Baaz Aaye Hind e Bad Akhtar Se Ham
shers.english:
Towards Madina, From Our Home, We Are Departing
Away From The Mischievous Hind, We Are Navigating

shers.roman:
Maar Daale Be Qaraari Shauq Ki
Khush To Jab Hoñ Is Dil e Muztar Se Ham
shers.english:
We Should Execute The Restlessness of This Yearning
Content Only Then, With This Heart, We Are Being

shers.roman:
Be-‘Thikaanoñ Ka ‘Thikaana Hai Yahi
Ab Kahaañ Jaayeñ Tumhaare Dar Se Ham
shers.english:
For The Homeless, Home Indeed, This Court Is Being
Now Where Will We Go, If Your Court We Are Leaving?

shers.roman:
Tishnagi e Hashr Se Kuch Gham Nahiñ
Haiñ Ghulaamaan e Shah e Kawthar Se Ham
shers.english:
Unfazed We Are, About Being Thirsty On The Day of Reckoning
For of The Grand King of Kawthar’s Humble Slaves We Are Being

shers.roman:
Apne Haathoñ Meiñ Hai Daamaan e Shafi’
‘Dar Chukay Bus Fitna e Mahshar Se Ham
shers.english:
In Our Hands, The Mantle of The Intercessor, We Are Having
The Strife On The Day of Reckoning, We Are No Longer Fearing

shers.roman:
Naqsh e Paa Se Jo Huwa Hai Sarfaraz
Dil Badal ‘Daaleñge Us Phat’tar Se Ham
shers.english:
Whoever Received His Sacred Footprint’s Blessing
With That Stone; Hearts, We Will Be Transforming

shers.roman:
Gardan e Tasleem Kham Karne Ke Saath
Pheñkte Haiñ Baar e ‘Isyaañ Sar Se Ham
shers.english:
Whilst Our Heads In His Grand Honour, We Are Bowing
From Our Heads, The Burden of Sins We Are Hurling

shers.roman:
Gaur Ki Shab Taar Hai Par Khauf Kya
Lau Lagaaye Haiñ Rukh Anwar Se Ham
shers.english:
The Grave’s Eve Is Dark, But Why Should We Be Fearing?
Towards His Glowing Face, Our Hearts We Are Directing

shers.roman:
Dekh Lena Sab Muraadeñ Mil Gayeeñ
Jab Lipat’ Kar Roye Un Ke Dar Se Ham
shers.english:
Whatever We Have Desired, We Will Surely Be Attaining
Whilst Weeping; As His Threshold, We Were Embracing

shers.roman:
Kya Band’ha Ham Ko Khuda Jaane Khayaal
Aankheñ Maltay Haiñ Jo Har Phat’tar Se Ham
shers.english:
Only Almighty Allah Knows, What We Are Really Thinking
When Against Every Stone, Our Eyes, We Are Rubbing

shers.roman:
Jaane Waale Chal Diye Kab Ke Hasan
Phir Rahe Haiñ Aik Bas Muztar Se Ham
shers.english:
It Is A While, O Hasan! Since The Pilgrims Were Departing
Only I Have Been Left Behind, Purposelessly Wandering

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ALLAH BARA E GHAUS E AZAM

shers.roman:
Allah Bara e Ghaus e Azam
De Mujh Ko Wila e Ghaus Azam
shers.english:
For The Sake of Ghaus e Azam, O Allah Almighty
Closeness To Ghaus e Azam, Please Do Grant Me

shers.roman:
Deedaar e Khuda Tujhe Mubaarak
Ay Mahw e Liqaa e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
May You See The Manifestation of Allah Almighty
O You Who Is Absorbed, In Ghaus e Azam Entirely

shers.roman:
Wo Kaun, Kareem Saahib e Jood
Maiñ Kaun, Gada e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Who Is He? He Is Considerate, A Master of Generosity
Who Am I? Ghaus e Azam’s Mendicant, I Am Surely

shers.roman:
Sookhi Huwi Kheytiyaañ Hari Kar
Ay Abr e Sakha e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Allow Our Dry Meadows, To Bloom Instantly
O Ghaus e Azam! The Cloud of Generosity!

shers.roman:
Um’meedeñ Naseeb, Mushkileñ Hal
Qurbaan ‘Ata e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
My Hopes Have Been Fulfilled, Alleviated Are My Calamities
Upon Ghaus e Azam’s Special Blessings, Sacrificed May I Be

shers.roman:
Kya Tezi e Mahr e Hashr Se Khauf
Haiñ Zer e Liwa e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
On Judgement Day, Why Should I Fear The Sun’s Intensity
When Under Ghaus e Azam’s Blessed Banner, I Will Be

shers.roman:
Wo Awr Haiñ, Jinn Ko Kahiye Muhtaaj
Ham To Haiñ Gada e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Those Recognised As Simple Beggars, Others May Be
Ghaus e Azam’s Mendicants, We Are, Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Haiñ Jaanib e Naala e Ghareebaañ
Gosh e Shanwa e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Listening Carefully, To The Destitute One’s Pleas
Is Ghaus e Azam’s Attentive Ear, Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Ham Ko Sataaye Naar e Dozakh
Kyuñ Rad’d Ho Dua e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
About The Fire of Hell, Why Should We Be Weary?
Rejected, Why Will Ghaus e Azam’s Invocation Be?

shers.roman:
Be-Gaanay Bhi Ho Gaye Yagaanay
Dil-Kash Hai Ada e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Even Those Who Are Mere Strangers, Became His Devotees
Attracting Their Hearts, Are Ghaus e Azam’s Acts of Mercy

shers.roman:
Aankhoñ Meiñ Hai Noor Ki Tajal’li
Phayli Hai Zia e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
In My Eyes, Flow The Lustres of His Luminosity
Expansive Is Ghaus e Azam’s Radiant Luminosity

shers.roman:
Jo Dam Meiñ Ghani Kar De Gada Ko
Wo Kya Hai, ‘Ata e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
In A Moment, How Did A Beggar Become So Wealthy?
It Is Through The Blessings of Ghaus e Azam’s Generosity

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Hashr Ke Din Ho Faash Parda
Haiñ Zer e Qaba e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
On Judgement Day, Exposed, Why Will I Be?
When Under Ghaus e Azam’s Robes, I Will Be

shers.roman:
Aa-ina Roo e Khoobruyaañ
Naqsh e Kaf e Paa e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
The Mirror of Those, Who Are Blessed With Beauty
Is The Imprint of Ghaus e Azam’s Foot, In Reality

shers.roman:
Ay Dil Na Dar In Balaawoñ Se Ab
Wo Aayi Sada e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
O My Heart, Now Fear Not, Any of These Calamities!
From Ghaus e Azam Originated, This Special Decree

shers.roman:
Ay Gham Jo Sataaye Ab Tu Jaanuñ
Le Dekh Wo Aaye, Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Now O Grief, Be Careful! If You Trouble Me
Look! Ghaus e Azam Has Arrived Promptly

shers.roman:
Taar e Nafs e Mala’ika Hai
Har Taar e Qaba e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
To The Angels, The Thread of This Spiritual Connectivity
Manifests In Every Strand, of Ghaus e Azam’s Robe Clearly

shers.roman:
Sab Khol De ‘Uqdahaa e Mushkil
Ay Naakhun e Paa e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
Open All The Knots of My Troubles Completely
O Sacred Nail of Ghaus e Azam’s Feet, So Holy

shers.roman:
Kya Un Ki Sana Likhuñ Hasan Maiñ
Jaañ Baad Fida e Ghaus e Azam
shers.english:
O Hasan! How Can I Compose His Tribute In Reality?
Devoted To Ghaus e Azam, May My Soul Always Be

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ASEEROÑ KE MUSHKIL KUSHA GHAUS E A’ZAM

shers.roman:
Aseeroñ Ke Mushkil Kusha Ghaus e A’zam
Faqeeroñ Ke Haajat Rawa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
The Saviour of Those In Captivity, Ghaus e A’zam
The Helper of Those Who Are Needy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Ghira Hai Balaawoñ Meiñ Banda Tumhaara
Madad Ke Liye Aawo Ya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Your Servant Is Surrounded By Grief And Calamity,
Come To His Aid Immediately, O Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Tere Haath Meiñ Haath Maiñ Ne Diya Hai
Tere Haath Hai Laaj Ya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
In Your Hand, I Have Given My Hand Devotedly
Your Hand Is My Honour And Dignity, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Mureedoñ Ko Khatra Nahiñ Bahr e Gham Se
Ke Ber’ay Ke Haiñ Nakhuda Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Your Disciples Have No Fear, From The Ocean of Agony,
For The Captain of Our Flotilla, You Are Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Tumheeñ Dukh Suno Apne Aafat Zadoñ Ka
Tumheeñ Dard Ki Do Dawa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Personally, Listen To Your Servants, Who Are Facing Adversity,
For This Illness, Personally Give Us The Remedy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Bhañwar Meiñ Phañsa Hai Hamaara Safina
Bacha Ghaus e A’zam, Bacha Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
In A Whirlpool, Our Vessel Is Now Trapped, Completely,
Rescue Us Ghaus e A’zam, Grant Us Safety, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Jo Dukh Bhar Raha Huñ Jo Gham Seh Raha Huñ
Kahuñ Kis Se Tere Siwa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
The Distressful Situation, Which I Am Facing With Agony,
To Whom Else Can I Divulge This, Willingly, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Zamaane Ke Dukh Dard Ki Ranj o Gham Ki
Tere Haath Meiñ Hai Dawa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
For The Woes of This Era, And For All The Pain And Agony,
In Your Blessed Hand, Is The Remedy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Agar Saltanat Ki Hawas Ho Faqeero
Kaho ‘Shay-al Lillah’ Ya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
O Mendicants! If It Is An Empire, Which You Desire Discreetly,
Say, Grant It To Me, By The Will of The Almighty, O Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Nikaala Hai Pehle Tu Doobe Huwoñ Ko
Awr Ab ‘Doobtoñ Ko Bacha Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
You Have Already Extracted Those, Who Had Sunk, Previously
And Now Save Those, Who Are Sinking Currently, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Jisay Khalq Kehti Hai Pyaara Khuda Ka
Usi Ka Hai Tu Laad’la Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
The One Whom The Creation Calls, ‘The Beloved of Allah Almighty’
The Beloved of That Beloved Personality, You Are Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Kiya Ghaur Jab Gyarhweeñ Baarhweeñ Meiñ
Mu’ammah Ye Ham Par Khula Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Over The Eleventh And The Twelfth, When We Pondered Wisely,
We Completely Understood, This Amazing Mystery, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Tumheeñ Wasl e Be Fasl Hai Shaah e Deeñ Se
Diya Haq Ne Ye Martaba Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
To The King of The Deen, You Are Connected Inseparably,
Allah Has Granted You This Rank of Nobility, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Phañsa Hai Tabaahi Meiñ Ber’a Hamaara
Sahaara Laga Do Zara Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
We Are Now Shipwrecked, We Are Now Trapped In Adversity,
Assist Us To Reach The Shores, With Safety, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Masha’ikh Jahaañ Aayeñ Bahr e Gadaayi
Wo Hai Teri Daulat Sara Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Where The Spiritual Masters, Come To Serve Devotedly
That Is Your Blessed Court of Bounty, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Meri Mushkiloñ Ko Bhi Aasaan Keeje
Ke Haiñ Aap Mushkil Kusha Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
For All My Complications, Do Grant Me An Easy Remedy,
For You Are The Saviour of Those In Difficulty, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Wahaañ Sar Jhukaate Haiñ Sab Oonche, Oonche
Jahaañ Hai Tera Naqsh e Paa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
All The Noble Ones, Lower Their Heads There Respectfully,
Where Your Foot’s Impression Lies, Perfectly, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Qasam Hai Ke Mushkil Ko Mushkil Na Paaya
Kaha Ham Ne Jis Waqt ‘Ya Ghaus e A’zam’
shers.english:
By Allah! We Never Felt The Severity of Any Calamity,
Whenever We Exclaimed Sincerely, ‘O Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Mujhe Phayr Meiñ Nafs e Kaafir Ne ‘Daala
Bata Jaaiye Raasta Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
The Impious Inner Self, Has Caused Us Uncertainty,
Guide Us To The Path of Certainty, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Khila De Jo Murj’haayi Kaliyaañ Diloñ Ki
Chala Koyi Aisi Hawa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Cause The Withered Buds of The Hearts, To Bloom Superbly,
Allow Such A Breeze, To Flow Instantly, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Mujhe Apni Ulfat Meiñ Aisa Guma De
Na Paa-oñ Phir Apna Pata Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Allow Me To Be Absorbed, In Your Love, So Profoundly,
That I Am Unable To Find My Own Identity, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Bacha Le Gulaamoñ Ko Majbooriyoñ Se
Ke Tu Abd e Qaadir Hai Ya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Protect Your Disciples, From A State of Vulnerability,
For You Are The Servant of The Almighty, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Dikha De Zara Mahr e Rukh Ki Tajal’li
Ke Ch’haayi Hai Gham Ki Ghat’a Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
The Reflection of Your Sun Glowing Face, Show Us Even Slightly,
For We Are Overcome By The Clouds of Agony, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Giraane Lagi Hai Mujhe Laghzish e Paa
Sambhalo Za’eefoñ Ko Ya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
My Trembling Feet Are Causing Me To Fall Uncontrollably,
Protect The Feeble, With Your Safety, O’ Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Lipat’ Jaayeñ Daaman Se Us Ke Hazaaroñ
Pakar’ Le Jo Daaman Tera Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
To The Edge of His Mantle, Thousands Will Hold Tightly,
If He Holds Onto Your Mantle of Mercy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Saroñ Pe Jisay Lete Haiñ Taaj Waale
Tumhaara Qadam Hai, Wo Ya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Upon Their Heads, That Which The Kings Take Honourably,
It Is Indeed Your Foot, Which Is So Holy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Dawa e Nigaahe ‘Ataa e Sakhaaye
Ke Shud Dard e Maa Laa Dawa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
I Seek A Remedy, From Your Sight, Bounty And Generosity,
For Incurable Has Become, My Agony, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Zi-Har Roo o Har Raah Raweem Ba-Gardaañ
Soo e Khaish Raaham Numa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
In Every Direction, And On All Paths, We Are Roaming Aimlessly,
Towards Your Sacred Path, Guide Us Directly, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Aseer e Kamande Hawaayam Kareema
Ba Bakhsa e Bar Haal e Maa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
O My Kind Master! My Desires Have Roped Me Into Captivity,
Upon My Pathetic State, Have Some Mercy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Faqeer e Tu Chashm e Karam Az Tu Daarad
Nigaahe Ba Haal e Gada Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Your Mendicant Is Seeking From You, Your Sight of Mercy,
Upon This Beggar, Direct Your Sight of Mercy, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Gadaayam Magar Az Gadayaan e Shaahe
Ke Goyand She Ahl e Safa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
I Am A Beggar, But A Beggar of Your Slaves I Am, O Excellency!
Those Who Are Known As ‘The Men of Piety’, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Kamar Bast Bar Khoon e Man Nafs e Qaatil
Aghithni Baraaye Khuda Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
To Slay Me, My Evil Inner-Self, Is Waiting Entirely Ready,
Assist Me, For The Sake of Allah Almighty, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Ad’har Meiñ Piya Moori ‘Dawlat Hai Nay’ya
Kahuñ Kaa Se Apni Bipa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
O Beloved! In The Ocean’s Midst, My Ship Is Swaying Helplessly,
To Whom Else, Can I Now Report My Difficulty, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Bipat Meiñ Kat’i Moori Sagri Umarya
Karo Mau Pe Apni Daya Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Most of My Life, I Have Spent, Facing Adversity,
Do Bless Me With Your Generosity, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Bhayo Do Jo Bekhant’h Bagdaad Tu Se
Kaho Moori Nagri Bhi Aa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
Baghdad Reflects Bliss, Through Your Noble Personality,
Say, ‘I Am Inviting You To My Holy City’, Ghaus e A’zam

shers.roman:
Kahe Kis Se Jaa Kar Hasan Apne Dil Ki
Sunay Kaun Tere Siwa Ghaus e A’zam
shers.english:
To Whom Shall Hasan Go, To Narrate His Heart’s Story?
Apart From You, Who Will Listen Attentively, Ghaus e A’zam?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KAUN KEHTA HAI KE ZEENAT KHULD KI ACH’CHI NAHIN

shers.roman:
Kaun Kehta Hai Ke Zeenat Khuld Ki Ach’chi Nahiñ
Lekin Ay Dil! Furqat e Koo e Nabi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
Who Is Saying That The Attractiveness of Paradise, Is No Good?
But Then, O Heart! Separation Form The Nabi’s Street, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Rahm Kar Sarkaar Maiñ Pursish Hai Aisoñ Ki Bahut
Ay Dil Ach’cha Hai Agar Haalat Meri Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
Have Mercy, For At The Holy Court, Those Like Us, Face Many Queries
O My Heart! Do You Think It Is Good, If My Condition, Is No Good?

shers.roman:
Teera Dil Ko Jalwa e Maah e ‘Arab Darkaar Hai
Chawdhweeñ Ke Chaand Teri Chaandni Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
The Lustres of The Moon of Arabia, The Dark Heart, Is Needing
O Full Moon of The Fourteenth! Your Moonlight, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Kuch Khabar Hai Maiñ Bura Huñ Kaise Ach’che Ka Bura
Mujh Buray Par Zaahido, Taa’na Zanni Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
Do You Know, How A Sinner Like Me, Is A Sinner Belonging To The Pious?
O Devout Ones! Even To Taunt A Sinful One Like Myself, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Us Gali Se Door Reh Kar, Kya Mareñ Ham Kya Jiyeñ
Aah! Aisi Maut, Aisi Zindagi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
How Can We Truly Live or Die, Whilst Living Away From That Lane?
Regrettably! This Kind of Life, And This Kind of Death, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dar Ki Bheek Ch’hor’ay Sarwari Ke Waaste
Un Ke Dar Ki Bheek Ach’chi Sarwari Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
Should I Abandon The Charity of His Court, For The Sake of Royalty?
The Charity of His Court Is Good, Royalty In Comparison, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Khaak Un Ke Aastaane Ki Manga De Chaara-Gar
Fikr Kya Haalat Agar Bimaar Ki Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
O Physician! Bring From His Sacred Threshold, Some Sacred Dust
What Does It Matter, If The State of The Ailing One, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Saaya e Diwaar e Jaanaañ Meiñ Ho Bistar Khaak Par
Aarazu e Taaj o Takht e Khusrawi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
May My Bed Be In The Dust, In The Shade of The Beloved’s Wall
Yearning For The Crown And The Throne of Royalty, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Dard e ‘Isyaañ Ki Taraq’qi Se Huwa Huñ Jaañ Balab
Mujh Ko Ach’cha Kijiye, Haalat Meri Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
As The Agony of My Sins Increased, I Reached The Verge of Death
Please Make Me Good; For My Condition, Is Definitely No Good

shers.roman:
Zar’ra e Taibah Ki Tal’at Ke Maqaabil, Ay Qamar!
Ghat’ti Bar’hti Chaar Din Ki Chaandni Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
In Comparison To The Lustre of Taibah’s Dust Particle, O Moon!
Your Waxing And Waning, Transient Moonlight, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Mausam e Gul Kyuñ Dikhaaye Jaate Haiñ Ye Sabz Baagh
Dasht e Taibah Jaayeñge Ham, Rahzani Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
Why Are We Being Shown, These Lush Green Pastures, O Spring Season?
We Will Proceed To The Sacred Desert of Taibah, Banditry, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Bekasoñ Par Mehrbaañ Hai Rahmat e Bekas Panaah
Kaun Kehta Hai Hamaari Bekasi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
The Patron of The Destitute, Is Compassionate Upon The Destitute
Who Said, That Our Destitute And Helpless Condition, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Banda e Sarkaar Ho, Phir Kar Khuda Ki Bandagi
Warna Ay Banda, Khuda Ki Bandagi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
First Become The Nabi’s Slave, Then Worship Allah Almighty
Otherwise O Servant! Worshipping Allah This Way, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Roo Siyaah Huñ Muñh Ujaala Kar De Ay Taibah Ke Chaand
Is Andhere Paakh Ki, Ye Teergi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
A Dark Faced, Disgraced One I Am, Brighten My Face O Taibah’s Moon!
The Obscurity of This Darkness, After The Moon’s Fifteenth, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Khaar-haa e Dasht e Taibah Chubh Gaye Dil Meiñ Mere
