‘Aariz e Gul Ki Bahaar e ‘Aarizi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
The Thorns of Taibah’s Wilderness, Have Already Pierced My Heart
So, This Temporary Blossoming of The Rose’s Petals, Is No Good

shers.roman:
Subh e Mahshar Chauñk Ay Dil! Jalwa e Mahboob Dekh
Noor Ka Tar’ka Hai Pyaare, Kaahili Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
O Heart! Be Alert On Judgment Day, Seek Out The Radiance of The Beloved
My Dear! It Is The Dawn of True Radiance, So Being Lethargic, Is Not Good

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dar Par Maut Aa Jaaye, To Jee Jaawuñ Hasan
Un Ke Dar Se Door Reh Kar Zindagi Ach’chi Nahiñ
shers.english:
O Hasan! I Would Live An Undying Life, If Death Came To Me At His Gate
Living So Distant From His Most Sacred Court, Life Is No Good

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: NIGAAH E LUTF KI UM’MEED-WAAR HAM BHI HAIÑ

shers.roman:
Nigaah e Lutf Ki Um’meed-Waar Ham Bhi Haiñ
Liye Huwe Ye Dil e Be Qaraar Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
To Receive Your Affectionate Glance, Hopeful, We Too Are Being
Carrying With Us, This Apprehensive Heart, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Hamaare Dast e Tamanna Ki Laaj Bhi Rakhna
Tere Faqeeroñ Meiñ Ay Shahr-Yaar Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
The Honour of Our Hopeful Hands, Also Be Preserving
O King! Amongst Your Mendicants, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Id’har Bhi Tausan e Aqdas Ke Do Qadam Jalwe
Tumhaari Raah Meiñ Musht e Ghubaar Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
A Step Or Two This Way, Let Your Blessed Steed Be Advancing
In Your Holy Pathway, A Handful of Dust, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Khila Do Ghuncha e Dil Sadqa Baad e Daaman Ka
Um’meed-Waar e Naseem e Bahaar Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
Through Your Mantle’s Breeze, Allow Our Heart’s Bud, To Be Blooming
Hopeful of Receiving This Sacred Spring Breeze, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Tumhaari Aik Nigaah e Karam Meiñ Sab Kuch Hai
Par’ay Huwe To Sar e Rah Guzaar, Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
In Your Single Sight of Generosity, Indeed, Everything Is Being
Faithfully Lying On Your Sacred Pathway, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Jo Sar Pe Rakhne Ko Mil Jaaye Na’al e Paak e Huzoor
To Phir Kaheñge Ke, Haañ! Taajdaar Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
If To Keep His Sacred Footwear On Our Heads, We Are Getting
Then Indeed, We Will Say: Venerable Kings, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Ye Kis Shahanshah e Waala Ka Sadqa Bat’ta Hai
Ke Khusruwoñ Meiñ Par’i Hai Pukaar, Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
Distributed Presently, Which Grand King’s Charity Is Being?
That Amid The Kings, It Is Echoing, Present We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Hamaari Bigr’i Bani Un Ke Ki Ikhtiyaar Meiñ Hai
Supurd Unheeñ Ke Haiñ Sab Kaarobaar, Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
In His Complete Control, Our Misfortunes And Fortunes Are Being
Entrusted To Him, Together With All Our Matters, We Too Are Being

shers.roman:
Hasan Hai Jin Ki Sakhaawat Ki Dhoom ‘Aalam Meiñ
Unheeñ Ke Tum Bhi Ho, Ik Reza-Khwaar Ham Bhi Haiñ
shers.english:
O Hasan! Renowned In The Universe, He, Whose Kindness Is Being
You Too Are His; And One Surviving On His Morsels, I Too Am Being

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KYA KAREÑ, MEHFIL E DIL-DAAR KO KYUÑKAR DEKHEÑ

shers.roman:
Kya Kareñ, Mehfil e Dil-Daar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
Apne Sarkaar Ke Darbaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
What Can We Do, At The Beloved’s Assembly, How Will We Be Looking?
Towards The Grand Court of Our Beloved King, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Taab e Nazaara To Ho, Yaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
Aankheñ Milti Nahiñ Deedaar Ko Kyuñ Kar Dekheñ
shers.english:
The Power To See Is Needed, Or Else, At Him, How Will We Be Looking?
When His Vision, Our Eyes Cannot Even Meet, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Dil e Murda Ko Tere Koocha Meiñ Kyuñkar Le Jaayeñ
Asar e Jalwa e Raftaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
In Your Sacred Lane, Our Dead Hearts, How Will We Be Carrying?
At The Effects of The Lustres of His Pace, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Jin Ki Nazroñ Meiñ Hai Sahra e Madina Bulbul
Aankh Ut’ha Kar Tere Gulzaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
O Nightingale! In Their Sights, Madina’s Desert, Those Who Are Having
Towards Your Garden With Raised Eyes, How Will They Be Looking?

shers.roman:
‘Iwaz e Afw Gunah Biktay Haiñ, Ik Majma’ Hai
Haaye! Ham Apne Khareedaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
In Lieu of Pardon, Sins Are Being Sold, In This Huge Gathering
Alas! Here, At Our Noble Purchaser, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Ham Gunahgaar Kahaañ Awr Kahaañ Rooyat e ‘Arsh
Sar Ut’ha Kar Teri Diwaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
We Sinners Are So Low; And So High, The Vision of The Arsh Is Being?
With Raised Heads, At Your Blessed Wall, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Awr Sarkaar Banay Haiñ To Unheeñ Ke Dar Se
Ham Gada Awr Ki Sarkaar Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
All Others Who Became Kings, Through His Court, They Were Ascending
We Are Mere Slaves, So Towards Other Kings, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Dast e Say’yaad Se Aahoo Ko Ch’hur’aaye Jo Kareem
Daam e Gham Meiñ Wo Giriftaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
When From A Hunter’s Hand, A Deer, Our Generous Master Is Freeing
At Those, Snared In The Trap of Anguish, How Will He Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Taab e Deedaar Ka Da’wa Hai Jinheñ, Saamne Aayeñ
Dekhte Haiñ Tere Rukhsaar Ko, Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
Come In Front, O Those, Who Claim To Have The Capacity of Seeing!
We Will See, Towards Your Radiant Face, How They Will Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Dekhiye Koocha e Mahboob Meiñ Kyuñkar Pahuncheñ
Dekhiye Jalwa e Deedaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
Let’s Now See, How At The Court of The Beloved, We Are Reaching
Let’s Now See, At The Lustres of His Vision, How Will We Be Looking?

shers.roman:
Ahl-Kaaraan e Saqar Awr Iraadah Se Hasan
Naaz-Parwarda e Sarkaar Ko Kyuñkar Dekheñ
shers.english:
O Hasan! With Hostile Intentions, The Officials of Hell Are Knowing
Towards Those Nurtured By Our King, How Will They Be Looking?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: NA KYUÑ AARA-ISHEÑ KARTA KHUDA DUNYA KE SAAMAAÑ MEIÑ

shers.roman:
Na Kyuñ Aara-isheñ Karta Khuda Dunya Ke Saamaañ Meiñ
Tumheñ Dulha Bana Kar Bhejna Tha Bazm e Imkaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
The Provisions of The World, Why Would Allah Not Be Adorning
When To Send You As The Groom of The Universe, He Was Willing

shers.roman:
Ya Rangeeñi Ye Shaadaabi Kahaañ Gulzaar e Rizwaañ Meiñ
Hazaaroñ Jannateñ Aa Kar Basi Haiñ Koo e Jaanaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
In The Garden of Rizwaan, Where Is Such Colourful Brilliance Blooming?
In The Holy Lane of My Beloved, A Thousand Jannats Are Now Residing

shers.roman:
Khizaañ Ka Kis Tarh Ho Dakhl Jannat Ke Gulistaañ Meiñ
Bahaareñ Bus Chuki Haiñ Jalwa e Rangeen e Jaanaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Into The Garden of Paradise, How Can The Autumn Effect Be Entering?
In The Shiny Lustres of The Beloved, Spring Blooms Are Already Blooming

shers.roman:
Tum Aaye Roshni Phayli Huwa Din Khul Gayi Aankheñ
Andhera Saa Andhera Ch’haa Raha Tha Bazm e Imkaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Upon Your Arrival, Light Spread, Daylight Appeared, Eyes Were Opening
Whereas, Shrouded In Total Darkness, The World’s Assembly Was Being

shers.roman:
Thaka Maanda Wo Hai Jo Paaoñ Apne Tor’ Kar Bayt’ha
Wahi Pahuncha Huwa ‘Tehra Jo Pahuncha Koo e Jaanaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Weary Is The One Who Is Sits Indolently, Doing Absolutely Nothing
Accomplished Is The One, Who Reaches The Lane of The Beloved King

shers.roman:
Tumhaara Kalimah Par’hta Ut’hay Tum Par Sadqe Hone Ko
Jo Paa e Paak Se ‘Thokar Laga Do Jism e Be Jaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
To Be Sacrificed Upon You, While Reciting Your Kalima, He Will Be Rising
If With Your Sacred Feet, His Lifeless Body, You Were To Be Striking

shers.roman:
‘Ajab Andaaz Se Mahboob e Haq Ne Jalwa Farmaaya
Suroor Aankhoñ Meiñ Aaya, Jaan Dil Meiñ, Noor Imaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
In An Amazing Manner, His Countenance, Allah’s Beloved Was Revealing
Delight To The Eyes, Life To The Heart & Light To Imaan, He Was Bringing

shers.roman:
Fida e Khaar-Haa e Dasht e Taibah Phool Jannat Ke
Ye Wo Kaañt’ay Haiñ Jin Ko Khud Jagah Deñ Gul Rag e Jaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Sacrificed Upon The Thorns of Taibah’s Desert, Heaven’s Flowers Are Being
To These Thorns, In Its Main Root; A Special Place, The Rose Will Be Giving

shers.roman:
Har Ik Ki Aarazu Hai Pehle Mujh Ko Zabh Farmaayeñ
Tamaasha Kar Rahe Haiñ Marne Waale ‘Eid e Qurbaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
To Be The First To Be Sacrificed, Each One of Them Was Wishing
During The Eid of Sacrifice, Each One Is Strutting, Before Dying

shers.roman:
Zuhoor e Paak Se Pehle Bhi Sadqe Thay Nabi Tum Par
Tumhaare Naam Hee Ki Roshni Thee Bazm e Khoobaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Even Before Your Advent, Devoted To You, All The Nabis Were Being
Only By Your Radiance, The Assembly of The Beloveds, Was Glowing

shers.roman:
Kaleem Aasaa Na Kyuñkar Ghash Hoñ Un Ke Dekhne Waale
Nazar Aate Haiñ Jalwe Toor Ke Rukhsaar e Taabaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Like The Kaleem, Why Wouldn’t Those Who See Him, Be Fainting
Seen In His Glowing Cheeks, The Lustres of Mount Toor, Are Shining

shers.roman:
Hawa Badli, Ghiray Baadal, Khilay Gul, Bulbuleñ Chahkeñ
Tum Aaye Ya Bahaar e Jaañ Fiza Aayi Gulistaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Winds Changed, Clouds Gathered, Flowers Bloomed, Nightingales Are Chirping
Have You Entered The Garden, Or Is The Life-Giving Spring Bloom Arriving

shers.roman:
Kisi Ko Zindagi Apni Na Hoti Is Qadr Meet’hi
Magar Dh’howan Tumhaare Paaoñ Ka Hai Sheera e Jaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
So Sweetly Pleasing To Some, Even Their Own Lives, Are Not Being
Like In The Spirit of Life, The Water From Your Sacred Feet Is Being

shers.roman:
Usay Qismat Ne Us Ke Jeete Jee Jannat Meiñ Pahunchaaya
Jo Dam Lene Ko Bayt’ha Saaya e Diwaar Jaanaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
In His Lifetime, Entrance Into Paradise, By His Destiny, He Is Getting
If In The Shade of The Beloved, To Take A Fresh Breath, He Is Sitting

shers.roman:
Kiya Parwaanoñ Ko Bulbul Niraali Sham’a Laaye Tum
Giray Par’tay Thay Jo Aatish Pe Wo Pahunche Gulistaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Moths You Turned To Nightingales, A Unique Lamp, You Were Bringing
Those, Once Drawn To The Flame, In The Garden, They Are Now Residing

shers.roman:
Naseem e Taibah Se Bhi Sham’a Gul Ho Jaaye Lekin Yuñ
Ke Gulshan Phooleñ Jannat Lahlaha Ut’hay Charaaghaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
By Taibah’s Breeze, Even The Lamp May Be Extinguished, In This Meaning
That, The Garden Will Bloom, And Jannat Will Blossom, Brightly Shining

shers.roman:
Agar Dood e Charaagh e Bazm e Shah Ch’hoo Jaaye Kaajal Se
Shab e Qadr e Tajal’li Ka Ho Surmah Chashm e Khoobaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
If Kaajal Is Touched By The Smoke, From The Gathering of Our Noble King
Like Laylatul Qadr’s Lustres, Surma, To The Eyes of The Beloveds, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Karam Farmaaye Gar Baagh e Madina Ki Hawa Kuch Bhi
Gul e Jannat Nikal Aayeñ Abhi Sarw e Charaaghaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
If By The Breeze of Madina’s Garden, Even Slightly Blessed, They Are Being
From The Display of Lamps On Trees, Heavenly Roses, Will Be Blooming

shers.roman:
Chaman Kyuñkar Na Mahkeñ Bulbuleñ Kyuñkar Na ‘Aashiq Ho
Tumhaara Jalwa e Rangeeñ Bhara Phooloñ Ne Daamaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Fragrant Why Shouldn’t Gardens Be; With Nightingales, Lovers Becoming
When In Their Petals, Your Colourful Lustres, The Flowers Are Gathering

shers.roman:
Agar Dood e Charaagh e Bazm e Waala Mas Karay Kuch Bhi
Shameem e Mushk Bas Jaaye Gul e Sham’e Shabistaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
Even If It Is Slightly Touched, By The Smoke, From The Beloved’s Gathering
In The Candle of The Nocturnal Chamber, A Musk Breeze Will Be Flowing

shers.roman:
Yahaañ Ke Sang-rezoñ Se Hasan Kya Laa’l Ko Nisbat
Ye Un Ki Rah-Guzar Meiñ Haiñ Wo Phat’tar Hai Badakhshaañ Meiñ
shers.english:
To The Sacred Pebbles Here, O Hasan! No Comparison Rubies Are Having
In His Path These Are Lying, Only Pebbles of Badakhshan They Are Being

shers.roman:
Translator’s Note: Badakhshan is a place in Afghanistan, which is very
famous for its priceless rubies. Here, Ustaaz e Zaman is saying that, the
shers.english:
pebbles on the Sacred Pathway of Nabi are the real gems, and those
rubies of Badakhshan are mere stones. So, they cannot be compared.

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ‘AJAB KARAM SHAH E WAALA TABAAR KARTE HAIÑ

shers.roman:
‘Ajab Karam Shah e Waala Tabaar Karte Haiñ
Ke Na-Umeedoñ Ko Um’meed-Waar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Upon His Nation, How Amazing Is The Kindness of The Exalted King
To Those, Who Have Lost All Hope, Renewed Hope, He Is Giving

shers.roman:
Jama Ke Dil Meiñ Safeñ Hasrat o Tamanna Ki
Nigaah e Lutf Ka Ham Intizaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
In The Heart, After Arranging, Rows of Expectations And Yearning
For Your Blessed Affectionate Glance, We Are Patiently Waiting

shers.roman:
Mujhe Fusurdagi e Bakht Ka Alam Kya Ho
Wo Aik Dam Meiñ Khizaañ Ko Bahaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Due To My Disappointing Fortunes, Why Should I Be Grieving?
When, In A Single Moment, He Transforms Autumn Into Spring

shers.roman:
Khuda Sagaan e Nabi Se Ye Mujh Ko Sunwa De
Ham Apne Kut’toñ Meiñ Tujh Ko Shumaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
From The Nabi’s Loyal Dogs, May Allah Let Me Be Hearing
Among Our Personal Loyal Dogs, You Too We Are Counting

shers.roman:
Mala’ika Ko Bhi Haiñ Kuch Fazilateñ Ham Par
Ke Paas Rehte Haiñ Tauf e Mazaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Above Us, Some Outstanding Virtues, Even The Angels Are Having
They Encircle His Sacred Shrine, Whilst So Near They Are Descending

shers.roman:
Jo Khush-Naseeb Yahaañ Khaak e Dar Pe Bayt’hay Haiñ
Juloos e Masnad e Shaahi Se ‘Aar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
On The Dust of His Threshold, Those Fortunate Ones, Who Are Sitting
From Sitting On The Thrones of Kings, They Are Completely Desisting

shers.roman:
Hamaare Dil Ki Lagi Bhi Wahi Bujha Deñge
Jo Dam Meiñ Aag Ko Baagh o Bahaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Even The Flames of Our Heart, He Will Surely Be Extinguishing
In A Moment, He Turns Fire, Into A Garden Superbly Blooming

shers.roman:
Ishaara Kar Do To Baad e Khilaaf Ke J’hoñkay
Abhi Hamaare Safinay Ko Paar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Towards The Gusts of The Opposing Winds, If He Is Gesturing
Instantly, Towards Safe Shores, Our Ship, He Will Be Guiding

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Dar Ke Gadaawoñ Ki Shaan ‘Aali Hai
Wo Jis Ko Chaahate Haiñ Taajdaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
An Exalted Status, The Mendicants of Your Court Are Having
To Whomsoever They Desire, Kingship They Are Granting

shers.roman:
Gada, Gada Hai, Gada Wo To Kya Hee Chaahe Adab
Bar’ay, Bar’ay Tere Dar Ka Waqaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
A Beggar Is A Beggar, But What Respect Will That Beggar Be Needing?
When Your Holy Threshold, The Greatest of The Great, Are Honouring

shers.roman:
Tamaam Khalq Ko Manzoor Hai Raza Jin Ki
Raza Huzoor Ki Wo Ikhtiyaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
The Ones’ Whose Pleasure The Entire Creation Is Choosing
The Pleasure of The Beloved Rasool, They Are Choosing

shers.roman:
Suna Ke Wasf e Rukh e Paak ‘Andaleeb Ko Ham
Raheen e Aamad e Fasl e Bahaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
When The Beloved’s Sacred Face, To The Nightingale, We Are Describing
The True Arrival of The Beautiful Spring Bloom, To It, We Are Promising

shers.roman:
Hawa Khilaaf Ho Chakraaye Naaw Kya Gham Hai
Wo Aik Aan Meiñ Bey’ra Ko Paar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Why Worry If Our Ship Is Swirling, And Opposing Winds Are Blowing
For, In A Moment, Towards Safe Shores, Our Ship, He Will Be Guiding

shers.roman:
‘Ana Lahaa’ Se Wo Baazaar e Kasm-Pursaañ Meiñ
Tasal’li e Dil e Be Ikhtiyaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
By Saying ‘I Am Here For This’, In The Already Distressed Gathering
To The Already Distraught Hearts, Genuine Consolation He Is Giving

shers.roman:
Banaayi Pusht Na Kaa’ba Ki Un Ke Ghar Ki Taraf
Jinheñ Khabar Hai Wo Aisa Waqaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Facing His Home, The Back of The Kaa’ba, They Were Not Building
For Those Who Truly Comprehend, Such Honour They Are Having

shers.roman:
Kabhi Wo Taajwaraan e Zamaana Kar Na Sakeñ
Jo Kaam Aap Ke Khidmat-Guzaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
The Great Kings of The World, Could Never Be Accomplishing
The Tasks Which His Blessed Servants Are Accomplishing

shers.roman:
Hawa e Daaman e Jaanaañ Ke Jaañ Fiza J’hoñkay
Khizaañ Raseedoñ Ko Baagh o Bahaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
From The Beloved’s Mantle, The Refreshing Breeze, Which Is Flowing
To Those Struck By The Autumn Climate, Into Full Bloom, It Is Bringing

shers.roman:
Sagaan e Koo e Nabi Ke Naseeb Par Qurbaañ
Par’ay Huwe Sar e Raah Iftikhaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Upon The Destiny of The Dogs of My Nabi’s Lane, Sacrificed I Am Being
Whilst Lying On The Sacred Pathway, Distinct Honour They Are Getting

shers.roman:
Koyi Ye Pooche Mere Dil Meri Hasrat Se
Ke ‘Toot’ay Haal Meiñ Kya Gham-Gusaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
To My Heart And To My Yearning, Someone Should Be Asking
That In This Totally Broken State, What Consolation He Is Giving

shers.roman:
Wo Un Ke Dar Ke Faqeeroñ Se Kyuñ Nahiñ Kehte
Jo Shikwa e Sitam Roz-Gaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
To The Mendicants of His Sacred Court, Why Are They Not Mentioning
About The Poor State of Their Livelihood, Those Who Are Complaining

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Hijr Ke Sadmoñ Ki Taab Kis Ko Hai
Ye Chaub e Khushk Ko Bhi Be Qaraar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
The Anguish of Being Distant From You, Who Can Be Enduring?
Even This Dead Tree Stump, Extremely Restless, It Was Making

shers.roman:
Kisi Balaa Se Unheñ Pahunche Kis Tarah Aaseyb?
Jo Tere Naam Se Apna Hisaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
How Can They Be Affected By The Evil Spirit of Any Thing
When With Your Name, Themselves, They Are Fortifying

shers.roman:
Ye Narm Dil Haiñ Wo Pyaare Ke Sakhtiyoñ Par Bhi
‘Adu Ke Haq Meiñ Dua Baar-Baar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
So Gentle Is My Beloved’s Heart, Even When Trials He Is Facing
For The Guidance of His Adversaries, He Is Always Supplicating

shers.roman:
Kushood e ‘Uqda e Mushkil Ki Kyuñ Meiñ Fikr Karuñ
Ye Kaam To Mere Taibah Ke Khaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
In Seeking Solutions To My Tough Matters, Why Should I Be Bothering
This Matter of Mine, The Sacred Thorns of Taibah Are Effortlessly Solving

shers.roman:
Zameen e Koo e Nabi Ke Jo Lete Haiñ Bosay
Farishtagaan e Falak, Un Ko Pyaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
The Sacred Ground of My Nabi’s Lane, Those Who Are Kissing
Immense Love For Them, The Angels of The Skies Are Having

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Dar Pe Gada Bhi Haiñ Haath Pheylaaye
Tumheeñ Se ‘Arz e Dua Shahr Yaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Our Hands At Your Threshold, Even Us Beggars Are Stretching
Our Invocations Before You, My Grand King, We Are Presenting

shers.roman:
Kisay Hai Deed e Jamaal e Khuda Pasand Ki Taab
Wo Poore Jalwe Kahaañ Aashkaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Who Has The Power To See That Beauty, Which Is Allah Pleasing?
His Completely Unveiled Beauty, When Is He Ever Manifesting?

shers.roman:
Hamaare Nakhl e Taman’na Ko Bhi Wo Phal Deñge
Darakht e Khushk Ko Jo Baar-Daar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
To Our Tree of Expectation, Fruits, He Will Also Be Blessing
Even A Completely Dead Tree, Fruit-Bearing, He Is Making

shers.roman:
Par’ay Haiñ Khwaab e Taghaaful Meiñ Ham Magar Maula
Tarah-Tarah Se Hameñ Hoshyaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
In An Oblivious Slumber, Fast Asleep We Are Being
But In Every Way, By Our King, Alerted, We Are Being

shers.roman:
Suna Na Marte Huwe Aaj Tak Kisi Ne Unheñ
Jo Apne Jaan o Dil Un Par Nisaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Upto Today, Never Have We Heard, of Them Forever Dying
Upon Him, Their Hearts And Souls, Those Who Are Sacrificing

shers.roman:
Unheeñ Ka Jalwa Sar e Bazm Dekhte Haiñ Patang
Unheeñ Ki Yaad Chaman Meiñ Hazaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
It Is His Lustres, Which The Moths Are Seeing In The Gathering
In His Remembrance, The Birds, In The Garden Are Chirping

shers.roman:
Mere Kareem Na Aahoo Ko Qaid Dekh Sakay
‘Abas Aseer e Alam Intishaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
A Deer In Captivity, My Generous Master, Couldn’t Bear Seeing
So, For No Reason, Those Seized By Afflictions, Are Really Worrying

shers.roman:
Jo Zar’ray Aate Haiñ Paa e Huzoor Ke Neeche
Chamak Ke Mahr Ko Wo Sharmsaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Under My Nabi’s Sacred Feet, Those Dust Particles Which Are Coming
They Even Put The Sun To Shame, As They Are Luminously Sparkling

shers.roman:
Jo Moo e Paak Ko Rakhte Haiñ Apni Topi
Shujaa’ateñ Wo Dam e Kaar-Zaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
In Their Topis (Caps), His Sacred Hair, Those Who Are Keeping
On The Battlefield, Unparalleled Valour, They Are Exhibiting

shers.roman:
Jid’har Wo Aate Haiñ Ab Us Meiñ Dil Hoñ Ya Raaheñ
Mahak Se Gaysuwoñ Ki Mushkbaar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Be It On The Pathways Or In The Heart, Wherever He Is Appearing
With The Fragrance of His Tresses; To It, Fragrance He Is Granting

shers.roman:
Hasan Ki Jaan Ho Us Wus’at e Karam Pe Nisaar
Ke Ik Jahaan Ko Um’meed-Waar Karte Haiñ
shers.english:
Sacrificed Upon That Endless Generosity, Hasan’s Life Is Being
To An Entire Universe, Renewed Hope, He Is Indeed Granting

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SUN LO MERI ILTIJA ACH’CHE MIYAÑ

shers.roman:
Sun Lo Meri Iltija Ach’che Miyañ
Meiñ Tasad’duq Meiñ Fida Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
To My Invocation, Please Be Listening, Ach’che Miyañ
Most Sincerely, Sacrificed I Am Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Ab Kami Kya Hai, Khuda De Banda Le
Maiñ Gada Tu Baadshaah Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Now What Is Missing? The Creator Is Giving, The Slave Is Taking
I Am A Humble Mendicant, And You Are A King Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Deen o Dunya Meiñ Bahut Ach’cha Raha
Jo Tumhaara Ho Gaya, Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
In The World And In The Hereafter, Very Well, He Is Being
Your Sincere Servant Who Was Becoming, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Is Buray Ko Aap Ach’cha Kijiye
Aap Ach’che Maiñ Bura Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Into A Man of Piety, Transform This Wretched Being
You Are Pious, Wretched I Am Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Aise Ach’che Ka Bura Huñ Maiñ Bura
Jin Ko Ach’choñ Ne Kaha Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
To Such A Pious One, A Wretched One Like Me, Is Belonging
When Addressing Him, The Pious Are Saying, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Maiñ Hawaale Kar Chuka Huñ Aap Ke
Apna Sab Ach’cha Bura, Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
To You, I Am Now Completely Surrendering
My Good And Bad, Everything, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Aap Jaaneñ Mujh Ko Is Ki Fikr Kya
Maiñ Bura Huñ Ya Bhala Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
You Already Know What Is Best, I Am Thus Not Worrying
Wretched I Am, Virtuous You Are Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mujh Buray Ke Kaise Ach’che Haiñ Naseeb
Maiñ Bura Huñ Aap Ka Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
How Blessed, The Destiny of A Wretched One Like Me Is Being
Even Though I Am Wretched, Yours I Am Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Apne Mangta Ko Bula Kar Bheek Di
Ay Maiñ Qurbaan e ‘Ata Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
To Bless Him With Assistance, Your Beggar, You Were Calling
Upon Your Kind Grants, Sacrificed I Am Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mushkileñ Aasaan Farma Dijiye
Ay Mere Mushkil Kusha Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
All My Hardships, Easy, Please Do Be Making
O Eradicator of All Our Suffering, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Meri Jholi Bhar Do Dast e Faiz Se
Haazir e Dar Hai Gada Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
With Your Consecrated Hand, My Begging Pouch, Do Be Filling
Present At Your Threshold, Your Beggar Is Waiting, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Dam Qadam Ki Khayr Mangta Huñ Tera
Dam Qadam Ki Khayr Laa Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Good Health And Strength, Through You I Am Seeking
Good Health And Strength, Do Be Bringing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Jaañ Balab Huñ Dard ‘Isyaañ Se Huzoor
Jaañ Balab Ko Do Shifa Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Due To The Agony of My Sins, At The Verge of Death I Am Being
Please Grant A Remedy, To The One Who Is Dying, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Dushmanoñ Ki Hai Char’haayi Al-Ghiyaath
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Please Grant Us Assistance, For The Enemies Are Attacking
The Time For Assistance, This Is Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Nafs e Sarkash Dar Pa-e Aazaar Hai
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
My Rebellious Inner-Self, Intends To Cause Suffering
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Shaam Hai Nazdeek Sahra Haulnaak
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Evening Is Approaching, The Wilderness Is Frightening
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Naza’ Ki Takleef Ighwa e ‘Adu
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
To Abduct Me, During The Pangs of Death, The Enemy Is Trying
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Wo Sawaal e Qabr Wo Shakl e Muheeb
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
The Questioning of The Grave, Their Appearance, So Terrifying
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Pursish e A’maal Awr Mujh Saa Aseem
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
To A Sinner Like Me, About My Deeds They Are Asking
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Baar e ‘Isyaañ Sar Pe, Ra’sha Paaoñ Meiñ
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
With The Burden of Sins On My Head, My Legs Are Trembling
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Khaali Haath Aaya Bharay Baazaar Meiñ
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
In A Busy Marketplace, Empty Handed I Am Arriving
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mujrim e Naakaara o Diwaan e ‘Adl
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
As A Useless Offender, Before The Court I Am Standing
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Poochte Haiñ, Kya Kaha Tha, Kya Kiya
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
They Asked Me, What Did You Say, What Were You Doing?
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Paa Shikasta Awr ‘Uboor e Pul Siraat
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Paralysed I Am, The Bridge of Siraat, I Need To Be Crossing
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Khaa-in o Khaati Se Lete Haiñ Hisaab
Hai Madad Ka Waqt Ya Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Being Held To Account, The Deceitful And Sinful Are Being
The Time For Assistance, It Is Now Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Bhool Jaawuñ Maiñ Na Seedhi Raah Ko
Mere Ach’che Rahnuma Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
The Straight Path, May I Never Be Forgetting
My True Guide You Are Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Tum Mujhe Apna Bana Lo Behr e Ghaus
Maiñ Tumhaara Ho Chuka Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Through The Ghaus, Make Me Yours, I Am Pleading,
Indeed, Yours, I Am Already Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Kaun De Mujh Ko Muraadeñ, Aap Deñ
Maiñ Huñ Kis Ka Aap Ka Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Who Will Grant My Wishes? You Will Be Granting
Whose Am I? Yours I Am Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Ye Ghat’a Gham Ki Ye Roz e Siyaah
Mahr Farma Mah-Laqaa Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
These Clouds of Agony, These Darks Days, I Am Facing
O Moon Faced One! Mercy Do Be Having, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Ahmad e Noori Ka Sadqa Har Jagah
Munh Ujaala Ho Mera Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Through Hazrat Ahmad e Noori’s Special Blessings
All over, May My Face Be Glowing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Aankh Neechi Donoñ ‘Aalam Meiñ Na Ho
Bol Baala Ho Mera Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
In Both Worlds, Humiliation I Shouldn’t Be Facing
True Success May I Be Achieving, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mere Bhaayi Jin Ko Kehte Haiñ Raza
Jo Haiñ Is Dar Ke Gada Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Recognised As Ahmed Raza, My Brother, Who Is Being
The Mendicant of This Court, He Is Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
In Ki Muñh Maangi Muraadeñ Hoñ Husool
Aap Farmaayeñ ‘Ata Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Whatever He Wishes For, May He Be Receiving
Afford Him With This Blessing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
‘Umr Bhar Maiñ In Ke Saaye Meiñ Rahuñ
In Pe Saaya Aap Ka Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
All My Life, In His Shade, I Should Be Remaining
For Upon Him, Your Shade Is Being, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mujh Ko Mere Bhaayi-oñ Ko Hashr Tak
Ho Na Gham Ka Saamna Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
My Brothers and I, Until The Day of Reckoning
No Grief Should We Be Facing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mujh Pe Mere Bhaayi-oñ Pe Har Ghar’i
Ho Karam Sarkaar Ka Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Upon Myself And Upon My Brothers, I Am Requesting
Shower The Mercy of My Grand King, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Mujh Pe Mere Bhaayi-oñ Se Door Ho
Dukh Maraz, Har Qism Ka Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
From My Brother And I, As A Distance Do Be Keeping
All Forms of Ailments And Any Suffering, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Meri Mere Bhaayi-oñ Ki Haajateñ
Fazl Se Kijay Rawa Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
For Mine, And For All My Brother’s Needs, I Am Beseeching
Approve Them, Through Your Special Blessing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Ham Ghulaamoñ Ke Jo Haiñ Lakht e Jigar
Khush Raheñ Sab Daaima Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
All The Children of These Slaves, Those Who Are Being
Blissfully, May All of Them Be Prospering, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Panjtan Ka Saaya Paanchoñ Par Rahe
Awr Ho Fazl e Khuda, Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Upon Us Five, May The Shade of The Five Souls Be Remaining
And Upon All of Us, Allah’s Special Blessing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Sab Azeezoñ Sab Qareeboñ Par Rahe
Saaya e Fazl e ‘Ata Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
Upon All Our Relatives, And All The Near Ones, Do Be Keeping
The Shade of Your Special Mercy And Blessing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Ghaus e A’zam Qutb e ‘Aalam Ke Liye
Rad’d Na Ho Meri Dua Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
For The Sake of Ghaus e A’zam, The World’s Spiritual King
Reject Not The Duas, Which I Am Seeking, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Ho Hasan Sarkaar e Waala Ka Hasan
Kijiye Aisi ‘Ata Ach’che Miyañ
shers.english:
May Hasan Become Your Virtuous Slave, O My King!
Bestow Upon Him Such A Blessing, Ach’che Miyañ

shers.roman:
Translator’s Note: Shamsud’deen Abul Fadhl Hazrat Sayyid Shah Aale
Ahmed Ache Mia Marahrawi Ȇننہ ال رǷض ی is one of the Grand Masha’ikh of the
shers.english:
Barkaati Spiritual Dynasty. He is the 36th Imam and Shaykh of The Silsila
Aaliyyah Qaadiriyyah Barakaatiyyah Razviyyah Nooriyyah. He was

shers.roman:
affectionately known as Ach’che Miyañ (i.e. The Virtuous Personality). I
have thus used the actual epithet, Ach’che Miyañ, in the entire Kalaam for

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DIL MEIÑ HO YAAD TERI GOSHA E TANHAAYI HO

shers.roman:
Dil Meiñ Ho Yaad Teri Gosha e Tanhaayi Ho
Phir To Khalwat Meiñ ‘Ajab Anjuman Aaraayi Ho
shers.english:
In My Heart, Whilst Remembering You; In Privacy, I Should Be
Then, In This Privacy, A Splendid Gathering, Will Be Transpiring

shers.roman:
Aastaane Pe Tere, Sar Ho Ajal Aayi Ho
Awr Ay Jaan e Jahaañ, Tu Bhi Tamaashaayi Ho
shers.english:
With My Head On Your Threshold, Death Should Come To Me
And, O Soul of The Universe! This Sight, You Too Should See

shers.roman:
Khaak e Paamaal Ghareeboñ Ko Na Kyuñ Zinda Kare
Jis Ke Daaman Ki Hawa Baad e Maseehaayi Hai
shers.english:
By The Dust Under His Feet, Revived, Why Won’t The Destitute Be?
When His Sacred Mantle’s Breeze, Is The Breath of Life, In Reality

shers.roman:
Us Ki Qismat Pe Fida Takht e Shahi Ki Raahat
Khaak e Taibah Pe Jisay Chain Ki Neend Aayi Ho
shers.english:
The Royal Throne’s Luxury, Is Sacrificed Upon That Lucky One’s Destiny
He, Who Has Fallen Asleep, On The Sacred Dust of Taibah, Peacefully

shers.roman:
Taaj Waaloñ Ki Ye Khwaahish Hai Ke Un Ke Dar Par
Ham Ko Haasil Sharaf e Naasiyah Farsaayi Ho
shers.english:
At His Sacred Threshold, Is The Wish of Those Crowned With Glory
May We Also Be Blessed, With Bowing Our Heads Here, Respectfully

shers.roman:
Ik Jhalak Dekhne Ki Taab Nahiñ ‘Aalam Ko
Wo Agar Jalwa Kareñ Kaun Tamaashaayi Ho
shers.english:
Even A Glimpse of His Reality, The Universe Cannot Bear To See
If He Truly Reveals His Countenance, Him, Who Will Bear To See?

shers.roman:
Aaj Jo ‘Aib Kisi Par Nahiñ Khulnay Dete
Kab Wo Chaaheñge Meri Hashr Meiñ Ruswaayi Ho
shers.english:
Even Today, My Deficiencies, He Does Not Allow Anyone To See
Totally Humiliated On Reckoning Day, How Will He Let Me Be?

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Kareñ Bazm e Shabistaan e Jinaañ Ki Khwaahish
Jalwa e Yaar Jo Sham’e Shab e Tanhaayi Ho
shers.english:
The Assembly of Heaven’s Chambers, Why Should I Wish To See?
When In The Lamp of The Eve of Secrecy, Is My Beloved’s Luminosity

shers.roman:
Khil’at e Maghfirat Us Ke Liye Rahmat Laaye
Jis Ne Khaak e Dar e Shah, Jaa e Kafan Paayi Ho
shers.english:
For Him, Mercy Will Bring, The Mantle of Pardon And Clemency
In The Dust of The King’s Threshold, One Who Was Shrouded Finally

shers.roman:
Yahi Manzoor Tha Qudrat Ko Ke Saaya Na Banay
Aise Yakta Ke Liye Aisi Hee Yaktaayi Ho
shers.english:
Him, Not Having A Shadow, Was The Divine Will of The Almighty
Truly Deserving of Such Distinction, Is Such A Peerless Personality

shers.roman:
Zikr e Khud’daam Nahiñ, Mujh Ko Bata Deñ Dushman
Koyi Ne’mat Bhi Kisi Awr Se Gar Paayi Ho
shers.english:
Leave Alone The Servants, Even The Enemies Should Tell Me
If From Anyone Else They Have Received, Any Such Bounty?

shers.roman:
Jab Ut’hay Dast e Ajal Se Meri Hasti Ka Hijaab
Kaash Is Pardah Ke Andar Teri Zaibaayi Ho
shers.english:
When By The Hand of Death, The Veil of My Life Is Lifted Finally
O How I Wish, Within This Veil, Your Radiant Beauty, I May See

shers.roman:
Dekheñ Jaañ Bakhshi e Lab Ko To Kaheñ Khizr o Maseeh
Kyuñ Maray Koyi Agar Aisi Maseehaayi Ho
shers.english:
Khizr And Esa Would Say, If Your Lip’s Life-Giving Power, They Could See
Why Should Anyone Even Die, If They Will Be Blessed With Such Remedy

shers.roman:
Kabhi Aisa Na Huwa, Un Ke Karam Ke Sadqe
Haath Ke Pheylnay Se Pehle Na Bheek Aayi Ho
shers.english:
Never, Did It Happen Such, Through The Blessings of His Generosity
That Before My Hands I Even Extended, I Did Not Receive My Charity

shers.roman:
Band Jab Khwaab e Ajal Se Hoñ Hasan Ki Aankheñ
Us Ki Nazroñ Meiñ Tera Jalwa e Zaibaayi Ho
shers.english:
In The Slumber of Death, When Hasan’s Eyes Close Eventually
Before His Sight, May Your Radiant Beauty, Appear Distinctly

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AY RAAHAT E JAAÑ! JO TERE QADMOÑ SE LAGA HO

shers.roman:
Ay Raahat e Jaañ! Jo Tere Qadmoñ Se Laga Ho
Kyuñ Khaak Basar Soorat e Naqsh e Kaf e Paa Ho
shers.english:
O Tranquillity of My Soul! To Your Sacred Feet, The One Who Is Clinging
As The Outline of His Footprint, Why Should He Be Aimlessly Wandering

shers.roman:
Aisa Na Koyi Hai, Na Koyi Ho, Na Huwa Ho
Saaya Bhi To Ik Misl Hai, Phir Kyuñ Na Juda Ho
shers.english:
Like Him, There Is None Other, None Will Be, And None Was Ever Being
Even The Shadow Is A Resemblance, Thus, Shadow-less He Is Being

shers.roman:
Allah Ka Mahboob Banay Jo Tumheñ Chaahe
Us Ka To Bayaañ Hee Nahiñ Kuch, Tum Jisay Chaaho
shers.english:
The One Who Truly Loves You, Allah’s Beloved He Is Becoming
As For The One Whom You Love, We Cannot Really Be Describing

shers.roman:
Dil Sab Se Ut’ha Kar, Jo Par’a Ho Tere Dar Par
Uftaad e Do ‘Aalam Se, Ta’al’luq Usay Kya Ho
shers.english:
He Who Lies At Your Threshold, After Detaching His Heart From Everything
To The Misfortunes of This Mundane World, What Connection Is It Having?

shers.roman:
Us Haath Se Dil-Sokhta Jaanoñ Ke Haray Kar
Jis Se Rutab e Sokhta Ki Nasho o Numa Ho
shers.english:
With That Sacred Hand, The Aggrieved Souls, Do Be Reviving
By Which, Even Scorched Dates, Are Beautifully Flourishing

shers.roman:
Har Sans Se Niklay Gul e Firdaus Ki Khushboo
Gar ‘Aks e Figan Dil Meiñ Wo Naqsh e Kaf e Paa Ho
shers.english:
The Fragrance of Heavenly Roses, Every Breath Will Be Emitting
If The Imprint of His Sacred Foot, In Their Hearts, Is Reflecting

shers.roman:
Us Dar Ki Taraf Is Liye Mezaab Ka Muñh Ho
Wo Qibla e Kaunain Hai, Ye Qibla Numa Ho
shers.english:
This Is Why, His Threshold, The Opening of The Mezaab, Is Facing
He Is The Qibla of Both The Worlds, And The Compass, This Is Being

shers.roman:
Be-Chain Rakhe Mujh Ko Tera Dard e Muhab’bat
Mit’t Jaaye Wo Dil Phir Jisay Armaan e Dawa Ho
shers.english:
This Pain of Your True Love, Should Keep Me Forever Pining
The Heart Seeking A Remedy, Should No Longer Be Existing

shers.roman:
Ye Meri Samajh Meiñ Kabhi Aa Hee Nahiñ Sakta
Imaan Mujhe Pheyrne Ko Tu Ne Diya Ho
shers.english:
This Is Something, That I Can Never Really Be Understanding
That You Gave Me Imaan, So That Astray I May Be Going!

shers.roman:
Us Ghar Se ‘Ayaañ Noor e Ilaahi Ho Hamesha
Tum Jis Meiñ Ghar’i Bhar Ke Liye Jalwa Numa Ho
shers.english:
From That House, The Glowing Light of Allah, Will Always Be Manifesting
If Even For A Moment, With Your Presence, That House, You Are Gracing

shers.roman:
Maqbool Haiñ Abru Ke Ishaare Se Dua-eñ
Kab Teer Kamaandaar e Nubuw’wat Ka Khata Ho
shers.english:
Supplications Are Truly Accepted, By His Blessed Eyebrow’s Gesturing
Its Target, The Chief Archer of The Nabis’ Arrow, Is Never Missing?

shers.roman:
Ho Silsila Ulfat Ka Jisay Zulf e Nabi Se
Uljhay Na Koyi Kaam Na Paaband e Bala Ho
shers.english:
To The Nabi’s Sacred Tresses, A Bond of Love, One Who is Having
Neither Will His Affairs Be Tangled, Nor Will Calamity, He Be Facing

shers.roman:
Shukr Aik Karam Ka Bhi Ada Ho Nahiñ Sakta
Dil Un Pe Fida, Jaan e Hasan Un Pe Fida Ho
shers.english:
I Am Unable To Show True Gratitude, Even For A Single Blessing
Completely Sacrificed Upon Him, Hasan’s Heart And Soul Is Being

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TUM ZAAT E KHUDA SE NA JUDA HO NA KHUDA HO

shers.roman:
Tum Zaat e Khuda Se Na Juda Ho Na Khuda Ho
Allah Ko Ma’loom Hai, Kya Jaaniye Kya Ho
shers.english:
Neither Apart From Allah’s Being, Nor Allah, You Are Being
Allah Almighty Alone Knows, What You Are Genuinely Being

shers.roman:
Ye Kyuñ Kahuñ Mujh Ko Ye ‘Ata Ho Ye ‘Ata Ho
Wo Do Ke Hamesha Mere Ghar Bhar Ka Bhala Ho
shers.english:
Grant Me This, Grant Me This, Why Should I Be Constantly Saying
Give Me That Which Is The Best, For My Entire Family’s Well-Being

shers.roman:
Jis Baat Me Mash’hoor e Jahaañ Hai Lab e ‘Esa
Ay Jaan e Jahaañ Wo Teri ‘Thokar Se Ada Ho
shers.english:
For That, Which The Sacred Lips of Hazrat Esa, Renowned Are Being
O Soul of The Universe! By The Strike of Your Foot, It Is Happening

shers.roman:
‘Toot’ay Huwe Dam e Josh Pe Toofaan e Ma’aasi
Daaman Na Milay Un Ka To Kya Jaaniye Kya Ho
shers.english:
Apart From Our Broken Spirit, Dazed By The Storm of Sins, We Are Being
What Would Have Happened To Us, If His Mantle, We Weren’t Getting?

shers.roman:
Yuñ Jhuk Ke Milay Ham Se Kameenoñ Se, Wo Jis Ko
Allah Ne Apne Hee Liye, Khaas Kiya Ho
shers.english:
With Lowly Ones Like Us, With Such Humility, He Is Meeting
Yet, The Most Chosen One of Allah, Definitely, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Mit’ti Na Ho Barbaad Pas e Marg Ilaahi
Jab Khaak Ur’ay Meri Madine Ki Hawa Ho
shers.english:
O Allah! My Dust Shouldn’t Go To Waste, After I Am Dying
In The Sacred Winds of Madina, My Dust Should Be Soaring

shers.roman:
Mangta To Haiñ Mangta Koyi Shaahoñ Meiñ Dikha De
Jis Ko Mere Sarkaar Se ‘Tukr’a Na Mila Ho
shers.english:
Beggars Are Beggars, Amongst Kings, To Me, Be Showing
Who Did Not Receive A Morsel, From My Honourable King!

shers.roman:
Qudrat Ne Azal Meiñ Likha Un Ki Jabeeñ Par
Jo In Ki Raza Ho, Wahi Khaaliq Ki Raza Ho
shers.english:
By Divine Will, On His Forehead, It Was Written, Since The Beginning
Whatever Pleases Him, By That Alone, Pleased, The Creator Is Being

shers.roman:
Har Waqt Karam Banda-Nawaazi Pe Tula Hai
Kuch Kaam Nahiñ, Is Se, Bura Ho Ke Bhala Ho
shers.english:
Constantly Inclined To Showering His Slaves, His Generosity Is Being
He Does Not Really Bother, If Sinful Or Virtuous, They Are Being

shers.roman:
Sau Jaañ Se Gunahgaar Ka Ho Rakht e ‘Amal Chaak
Parda Na Khulay Gar Tere Daaman Se Bandha Ho
shers.english:
Ripped Apart Meticulously, Even if The Sinner’s Bag of Deeds, Is Being
Its Secrets Will Not Be Exposed, If Bound To Your Mantle, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Abraar, Niko-Kaar, Khuda Ke Haiñ Khuda Ke
Un Ka Hai Wo Un Ka Hai, Jo Bad Ho, Jo Bura Ho
shers.english:
The Saintly And Virtuous Ones Are Allah’s, Indeed, Allah’s They Are Being
Indeed, They Belong To Him, Even If Sinful And Guilty, They Are Being

shers.roman:
Ay Nafs Unheñ Ranj Diya Apni Badi Se
Kya Qahr Kiya Tu Ne Aray, Tera Bura Ho
shers.english:
O Evil Inner-Self! You Have Aggrieved Him, Due To Your Sinning
Ruined May You Be! Upon Yourself, Such Wrath You Are Inviting

shers.roman:
Allah! Yuñhi ‘Umar Guzar Jaaye Gada Ki
Sar Kham Ho Dar e Paak Par, Awr Haath Ut’ha Ho
shers.english:
O Allah! His Entire Life, In This Manner, May This Beggar Be Spending
With Head Bowed And Hands Raised, At His Gate, May He Be Begging

shers.roman:
Shaabaash Hasan! Awr Chamakti See Ghazal Par’h
Dil Khol Kar Aa-ina e Imaañ Ko Jila Ho
shers.english:
Well Done To You, O Hasan! Another Brilliant Ode, Do Be Reciting
Please Do So Ardently, Whilst The Mirror of Imaan, You Are Reviving

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DIL DARD SE BISMIL KI TARAH LAUT’ RAHA HO

shers.roman:
Dil Dard Se Bismil Ki Tarah Laut’ Raha Ho
Seene Pe Tasal’li Ko Tera Haath Dhara Ho
shers.english:
When Like A Wounded Creature, In Pain, The Heart Is Writhing
For Solace, Upon My Chest, Your Hand, You Should Be Placing

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Apni Gali Meiñ Wo Rawa-Daar e Sada Ho
Jo Bheek Liye Raah e Gada Dekh Raha Ho
shers.english:
In His Own Street, The Sound of Pleas, Why Will He Be Accepting
When Bearing The Charity, For The Beggar, He Is Already Waiting

shers.roman:
Gar Waqt e Ajal, Sar Teri Chaukat’ Pe Jhuka Ho
Jitni Ho Qaza, Aik Hee Sajde Meiñ Ada Ho
shers.english:
If At The Time of Death, At Your Threshold, Bowed, My Head Is Being
In A Single Prostration, Fulfilled, All My Expired Prayers Are Being

shers.roman:
Ham-Saaya e Rahmat Hai Tera Saaya e Diwaar
Rutba Se Tanaz’zul Kare To Zil’l e Huma Ho
shers.english:
Under The Same Shade of Mercy, The Shade of Your Wall Is Being
If It Declines From Its Position, The Royal Bird’s Shadow, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Mauqoof Nahiñ Subh e Qiyaamat Hee Pe Ye ‘Arz
Jab Aankh Khulay Saamne Tu Jalwa Numa Ho
shers.english:
This Appeal Is Not Only Reserved, For Judgement Day’s Morning
Whenever I Open My Eyes, Before Me, Your Face, May I Be Seeing

shers.roman:
De Us Ko Dam e Naza’ Agar Hoor Bhi Saaghar
Munh Pheyr Le Jo Tishna e Deedar Tera Ho
shers.english:
If At The Time of Death, To Him, A Goblet, The Hoor Is Offering
He Will Turn His Face Away, If Thirsty For Your Vision, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Firdaus Ke Baaghoñ Se Idhar Mil Nahiñ Sakta
Jo Koyi Madinay Ke Bayaabaañ Meiñ Guma Ho
shers.english:
With The Gardens of Heaven, Here, He Shall Not Be Connecting
If Completely Lost In The Wilderness of Madina, He Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Dekha Unheñ Mahshar Meiñ To Rahmat Ne Pukaara
Azaad Hai Jo Aap Ke Daaman Se Bandha Ho
shers.english:
Upon Seeing Him On Judgment Day, Mercy Was Announcing
Free Is The One, Who Attached To Your Mantle, Is Being

shers.roman:
Aata Hai Faqeeroñ Pe Unheñ Pyaar Kuch Aisa
Khud Bheek Deñ Awr Khud Kaheñ Mangta Ka Bhala Ho
shers.english:
Towards The Mendicants, Such Special Affection, He Is Exhibiting
Whilst Himself Giving Alms, For The Beggar’s Well-Being, He Is Praying

shers.roman:
Weeraañ Hoñ Jab Aabaad Makaañ Subh e Qiyaamat
Ujr’a Huwa Dil Aap Ke Jalwoñ Se Basa Ho
shers.english:
When Occupied Homes Will Be Desolate, On The Morning of Reckoning
May This Broken Heart Be Filled, With Your Lustres, Radiantly Glowing

shers.roman:
‘Dhoond’a Hee Kareñ Sadr e Qiyaamat Ki Siphaahi
Wo Kis Ko Milay, Jo Tere Daaman Meiñ Ch’hupa Ho
shers.english:
The Soldiers of The Master of Reckoning Day, May Continue Searching
But, How Will Anyone Find Him, Who In Your Sacred Mantle, Is Hiding?

shers.roman:
Jab Dene Ko Bheek Aaye Sar e Koo e Gadayaañ
Lab Par Ye Dua Thee Mere Mangta Ka Bhala Ho
shers.english:
When To Grant Charity, In The Mendicants’ Street, He Was Appearing
May My Mendicants Remain Well! From His Lips, This Dua Was Echoing

shers.roman:
Jhuk Kar Unheñ Milna Hai Har Ik Khaak Nasheeñ Se
Kis Waaste Neecha Na Wo Daamaan e Qaba Ho
shers.english:
To Meet With Every Servant, They Will Have To Be Bending
So Why Should His Sacred Robes, Not Be Elegantly Hanging?

shers.roman:
Tum Ko To Ghulaamoñ Se Hai Kuch Aisi Muhab’bat
Hai Tark e Adab Warna Kaheñ Ham Pe Fida Ho
shers.english:
For Your Sincere Slaves, Such Amazing Affection, You Are Having
If It Weren’t Rude, I Would Say, Devoted Upon Us, You Are Being

shers.roman:
De ‘Daaliye Apne Lab e Jaañ Bakhsh Ka Sadqa
Ay Chaara e Dil, Dard e Hasan Ki Bhi Dawa Ho
shers.english:
Bestow Upon Us, The Alms of Your Lips, Which Are Life-Giving
O Healer of The Heart! The Cure For Hasan’s Pain, Also Be Giving

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ‘AJAB RANG PAR HAI BAHAAR E MADINA

shers.roman:
‘Ajab Rang Par Hai Bahaar e Madina
Ke Sab Jannateñ Haiñ Nisaar e Madina
shers.english:
Absolutely Spectacular Is The Splendour of Madina
All The Heavens Are Profoundly In Love With Madina

shers.roman:
Mubaarak Rahe ‘Andaleeboñ Tumheñ Gul
Hameñ Gul Se Behtar Hai Khaar e Madina
shers.english:
O Nightingales! May You Be Satisfied With Your Flowers
To Us, Better Than Flowers, Are The Thorns of Madina

shers.roman:
Bana Shah-Nasheeñ Khusru e Do Jahaañ Ka
Bayaañ Kya Ho 'Iz’z o Waqaar e Madina
shers.english:
The Royal Throne of The King of Both The Worlds, You Are
How Can We Describe The Honour And Majesty of Madina

shers.roman:
Meri Khaak Ya Rab’b Na Barbaad Jaaye
Pas e Marg Kar De Ghubaar e Madina
shers.english:
My Dust Should Not Go To Waste, O Almighty Allah!
Transform It, After My Death, Into The Dust of Madina

shers.roman:
Kabhi To Ma’aasi Ke Khirman Meiñ Ya Rab’b
Lagay Aatish e Laalah-Zaar e Madina
shers.english:
Some Day, May The Harvest of My Sins, O Almighty Allah!
Be Set Ablaze, By The Bright Rays, of The Tulips of Madina

shers.roman:
Rag e Gul Ki Jab Naazuki Dekhta Huñ
Mujhe Yaad Aate Haiñ Khaar e Madina
shers.english:
When I Look At The Delicate Nature of The Rose’s Vein
I Immediately Remember, The Sacred Thorns of Madina

shers.roman:
Malaa’ik Lagaate Haiñ Aankhoñ Me Apni
Shab o Roz, Khaak e Mazaar e Madina
shers.english:
To Their Eyes, The Blessed Angels Are Meticulously Applying
Day And Night, The Sacred Dust, of The Shrine of Madina

shers.roman:
Jid’har Dekhiye Baagh e Jannat Khila Hai
Nazar Meiñ Haiñ Naqsh o Nigaar e Madina
shers.english:
Wherever You May Be Looking, The Garden of Heaven Is Blooming
Each Gaze Beholds, The Embellishments And The Visages of Madina

shers.roman:
Raheñ Un Ke Jalwe, Baseñ Un Ke Jalwe
Mera Dil Baneñ Yaad-Gaar e Madina
shers.english:
May His Lustres Remain, May His Lustres Reside Therein
May My Heart Become A Treasured Monument of Madina

shers.roman:
Haram Hai Usay Saahat e Har Do ‘Aalam
Jo Dil Ho Chuka Hai Shikaar e Madina
shers.english:
The Holy Haram Is The Safe Haven of Both The Worlds
For Him, Whose Heart Has Been Captured By Madina

shers.roman:
Do ‘Aalam Meiñ Bat’ta Hai Sadqa Yahaañ Ka
Hameeñ Ik Nahiñ Reza Khwaar e Madina
shers.english:
The Charity From Here, Is Distributed In Both The Worlds
We Are Not The Only Ones, Eating The Morsels of Madina

shers.roman:
Bana Aasmaañ Manzil e Ibn e Maryam
Gaye Laa Makaañ Taajdaar e Madina
shers.english:
The Sky Became The Destination of Maryam’s Noble Son
Beyond Time And Space, Went The Noble King of Madina

shers.roman:
Muraad e Dil e Bulbul e Be Nawa De
Khudaaya Dikha De Bahaar e Madina
shers.english:
The Wish of The Helpless Nightingale, Do Be Granting
O Allah Almighty, Let Me See The Splendour of Madina

shers.roman:
Sharaf Jin Se Haasil Huwa Ambia Ko
Wahi Haiñ Hasan, Iftikhaar e Madina
shers.english:
Due To Him, Eminence, All The Ambia Are Receiving
O Hasan! He Alone, Is The Grand Honour of Madina

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: NA HO AARAAM JIS BIMAAR KO SAARE ZAMAANE SE

shers.roman:
Na Ho Aaraam Jis Bimaar Ko Saare Zamaane Se
Ut’ha Le Jaaye Thor’i Khaak Un Ke Aastaane Se
shers.english:
If No Solace In The Entire World, The Ailing Soul Is Finding
From His Sacred Threshold, Some Dust He Should Be Taking

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Dar Ke ‘Tukr’on Se Par’a Palta Hai Ik ‘Aalam
Guzaara Sab Ka Hota Hai Isi Muhtaaj Khaane Se
shers.english:
From The Morsels of Your Court, An Entire Universe Is Thriving
By The Blessings of This House of Alms, Everyone Is Surviving

shers.roman:
Shab e Asra Ke Dulha Par Nich’haawar Hone Waali Thee
Nahiñ To Kya Gharaz Thee Itni Jaanoñ Ke Banaane Se
shers.english:
All Was To Be Sacrificed, Upon The Groom, of The Ascension Evening
Otherwise, To Create So Many Souls, What Reason Was There Being?

shers.roman:
Koyi Firdaus Ho Ya Khuld Ho Ham Ko Gharaz Matlab
Lagaaya Ab To Bistar Aap Hee Ke Aastaane Se
shers.english:
Be It The Heavenly Garden, Or The Eternal Garden, Our Aim Is Prevailing
Only At Your Sacred Threshold, My Humble Bed, I Am Now Setting

shers.roman:
Na Kyuñ Un Ki Taraf Allah Sau-Sau Pyaar Se Dekhe
Jo Apni Aankheñ Maltay Haiñ Tumhaare Aastaane Se
shers.english:
With Complete Love, Towards Them, Why Should Allah Not Be Looking?
Against Your Sacred Threshold, Their Eyes, Those Who Are Rubbing

shers.roman:
Tumhaare To Wo Ehsaañ Awr Ye Na Farmaaniyaañ Apni
Hameñ To Sharm See Aati Hai Tum Ko Muñh Dikhaane Se
shers.english:
Abundant Are Your Great Favours, Yet So Disobedient We Are Being
To Reveal Our Faces Before You, A Sense of Shame, We Are Feeling

shers.roman:
Bahaar e Khuld Sadqe Ho Rahi Hai Roo e ‘Aashiq Par
Khili Jaati Haiñ Kaliyaañ Dil Ki Tere Muskuraane Se
shers.english:
Upon The True Lover’s Face, Heavenly Splendours Are Descending
Through Your Lovely Smile, The Buds of The Heart Are Now Blooming

shers.roman:
Zameeñ Thor’i Si De-De Bahr e Madfan Apne Kooche Meiñ
Laga De Mere Pyaare Meri Mit’ti Bhi Thikaane Se
shers.english:
A Small Piece of Land, To Be Buried In Your Vicinity, I Am Requesting
O My Beloved, Its Final Destination, Allow My Dust To Be Reaching

shers.roman:
Palat’ta Hai Jo Zaa-ir, Us Se Kehta Hai Naseeb Us Ka
Aray Ghaafil Qaza Behtar Hai Yaañ Se Phir Ke Jaane Se
shers.english:
To The Pilgrim Who Is Departing, His Destiny Is Announcing
O Oblivious One! For You To Die Here, Is Better Than Returning

shers.roman:
Bula Lo Apne Dar Par Ab To Ham Khaana-Badoshoñ Ko
Phireñ Kab Tak Zaleel o Khwaar Dar- Dar Be Thikaane Se
shers.english:
To Your Majestic Court, Us Vagrants, Please Do Be Inviting
Humiliated Until When, Must We Be Aimlessly Wandering

shers.roman:
Na Pahunche Un Ke Qadmoñ Tak Na Kuch Husn e ‘Amal Hee Hai
Hasan Kya Poochte Ho, Ham Gaye Guzre Zamaane Se
shers.english:
Neither Have We Reached His Feet, Nor Any Good Deeds Are We Having
O Hasan! What Are You Asking? In This Era, We Are Good For Nothing

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: MUBAARAK HO WO SHAH PARDAY SE BAAHAR AANE WAALA HAI

shers.roman:
Mubaarak Ho Wo Shah Parday Se Baahar Aane Waala Hai
Gadaayi Ko Zamaana Jis Ke Dar Par Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Glad-Tidings! From Behind The Veils, That King, Is Soon To Appear
At Whose Court, As Mendicants, The Entire Era, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Chakoroñ Se Kaho Maah e Dil Aara Hai Chamakne Ko
Khabar Zar’roñ Ko Do Mahr e Munawwar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Tell The Partridges, The Radiant Moon, Is Soon To Appear
Tell The Dust Particles, The Glowing Sun, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Faqeeroñ Se Kaho Haazir Hoñ Jo Maangeñge Paayeñge
Ke Sultaan e Jahaañ Muhtaaj Parwar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Ask The Mendicants To Come, They Will Get What They Desire
For The King of The Universe, Their Benefactor Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Kaho Parwaanoñ Se Sham’e Hidaayat Ab Chamakti Hai
Khabar Do Bulbuloñ Ko Wo Gul e Tar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Tell The Moths, The Light of Guidance, Will Now Shine, With Splendour
Notify The Nightingales, That The Fresh Budding Rose, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Kahaañ Haiñ T’oot’i Um’meedeñ Kahaañ Haiñ Be Sahaare Dil
Ke Wo Faryaad-Ras Bekas Ka Yaawar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Where Are The Shattered Hopes, Where Are The Hearts In Despair?
For The Helper And Patron, of The Sad And Helpless, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
‘Thikaana Be ‘Thikaanoñ Ka Sahaara Be Sahaaroñ Ka
Ghareeboñ Ki Madad Bekas Ka Yaawar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
The Refuge For The Destitute, To The Troubled, Their Supporter
The Aid To The Poor, The Patron of The Helpless, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Bar Aayeñgi Muraadeñ Hasrateñ Ho Jaayengi Poori
Ke Wo Mukhtaar e Kul ‘Aalam Ka Sarwar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
All Their Wishes Will Be Granted, Fulfilled Will Be Every Pure Desire
For The Peerless Authority, The King of The World, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Mubaarak Dard-Mandoñ Ko Ho Muzhda Be Qaraaroñ Ko
Qaraar e Dil Shakeb e Jaan e Muztar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Congratulations To The Aggrieved Ones, Glad-tidings To Those In Despair
The Relief To The Hearts, The Comfort To Restless Souls, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Gunahgaaroñ Na Ho Maayoos Tum Apni Rihaayi Se
Madad Ko Wo Shafi’ e Roz e Mahshar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
O Sinners! Concerning Your Deliverance, Do Not Be In Despair
To Aid You, The Intercessor of Judgement Day, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Jhuka Laaye Na Kyuñ Taaroñ Ko Shauq e Jalwa e ‘Aariz
Ke Wo Maah e Dil Aara Ab Zameeñ Par Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Why Wouldn’t The Stars Be Attracted, Towards His Cheek’s Splendour
For Upon The Earth, The Brilliantly Glowing Moon, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Kahaañ Haiñ Baadshahaan e Jahaañ? Aayeñ Salaami Ko
Ke Ab Farmaañ Rawa e Haft Kishwar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
Where Are The Kings of The World? To Pay Tribute, Let Them Appear
For Now, The Sovereign Ruler of The Seven Realms, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Salaateen e Zamaana Jis Ke Dar Par Bheek Maangeñge
Faqeeroñ Ko Mubaarak Wo Tawangar Aane Waala Hai
shers.english:
To Supplicate At This Majestic Court, The Kings of The Era Will Appear
Compliments To The Mendicants, That Generous One, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Ye Saamaañ Ho Rahe Thay Mud’datoñ Se Jiski Aamad Ke
Wohi Naushah Ba-Sad Shaukat o Far’r Aane Wala Hai
shers.english:
For Whose Grand Arrival, Arrangements Were Being Made, In Every Era
With Complete Grandeur And Splendour, That Groom, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Wo Aata Hai Ke Hai Jis Ka Fidaayi ‘Aalam e Bala
Wo Aata Hai Ke Dil ‘Aalam Ka Jis Par Aane Wala Hai
shers.english:
He Will Soon Arrive, Sacrificed Upon Whom, Is The Entire Heavenly Sphere
The One With Whom, The World Will Fall In Love, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Na Kyuñ Zar’roñ Ko Ho Farhat, Ke Chamka Akhtar e Qismat
Sahar Hoti Hai Khursheed e Munawwar Aane Wala Hai
shers.english:
The Star of Their Destiny Is Shining, So Why Won’t The Specks Cheer?
The Break of Dawn Is Glowing, For The Glowing Sun, Is Soon To Appear

shers.roman:
Hasan Keh De U’theñ Sab Ummati Ta’zeem Ki Khaatir
Ke Apna Peshwa Apna Payambar Aane Wala Hai
shers.english:
O Hasan! Ask The Entire Ummah, To Stand In Respect And Honour
For Our Noble Leader, And Our Noble Messenger, Is Soon To Appear

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JAAYEGI HAÑSTI HUWI KHULD MEIÑ UMMAT UN KI

shers.roman:
Jaayegi Hañsti Huwi Khuld Meiñ Ummat Un Ki
Kab Gawaara Huwi Allah Ko Riq’qat Un Ki
shers.english:
Into Paradise, His Ummat Will Enter, Smiling Cheerfully
When Did Almighty Allah Ever Accept, His State of Worry

shers.roman:
Abhi Phat’tay Haiñ Jigar Ham Se Gunahgaaroñ Ke
‘Toot’ay Dil Ka Jo Sahaara Na Ho Rahmat Un Ki
shers.english:
Now, Us Sinners, Would Have Been Heart-Broken Entirely
If Our Broken-Hearts Were Not Comforted By His Mercy

shers.roman:
Dekh! Aankheñ Na Dikha Mahr e Qiyaamat Ham Ko
Jin Ke Saaye Meiñ Haiñ Ham, Dekhi Hai Soorat Un Ki
shers.english:
Be Cautious! O Sun of Reckoning Day, Stare Not At Us, So Harshly
In Whose Shade We Are Residing, His Countenance, Did You See?

shers.roman:
Husn e Yusuf Dam e ‘Esa Pe Nahiñ Kuch Mauqoof
Jis Ne Jo Paaya Hai Paaya Hai Ba-Daulat Un Ki
shers.english:
Nothing Is Founded Upon Yusuf’s Beauty, And Esa’s Breath, In Reality
Whoever Attained Anything, He Attained It, Through My Nabi

shers.roman:
Un Ka Kehna Na Kareñ Jab Bhi Wo Ham Ko Chaaheñ
Sar-Kashi Apni To Ye Awr Wo Chaahat Un Ki
shers.english:
We Do Not Do What He Says, But Still, He Loves Us So Dearly
This Is Our Defiant Behaviour, That Is The Love of Our Nabi

shers.roman:
Paar Ho Jaayega Ik Aan Meiñ Ber’a Apna
Kaam Kar Jaayegi Mahshar Meiñ Shafa’at Un Ki
shers.english:
In An Instant, We Will All Attain Deliverance, Undoubtedly
On Reckoning Day, His Intercession, Will Guide Us To Safety

shers.roman:
Hashr Meiñ Ham Se Gunahgaar Pareshaañ Khaatir
Afw Rahman o Raheem Awr Shafa’at Un Ki 1
shers.english:
Whilst On Reckoning Day, Us Sinners, Will Be Overcome By Anxiety
We Trust Rahmaan & Raheem’s Pardon, And The Intercession of Our Nabi

shers.roman:
Khaak e Dar Teri Jo Chehroñ Pe Malay Phirtay Haiñ
Kis Tarah Bhaaye Na Allah Ko Soorat Un Ki
shers.english:
Those Who Rub On Their Faces, His Threshold’s Dust, Sincerely
How Will Their Glowing Faces, Not Please Allah Almighty?

shers.roman:
Aasiyo Kyuñ Gham e Mahshar Meiñ Maray Jaate Ho
Sunte Haiñ Banda Nawaazi To Hai ‘Aadat Un Ki
shers.english:
O Sinners! Why Are You In Trauma, Due To Reckoning Day’s Worry?
We Have Heard That, Considering His Servants, Is His Natural Tendency

shers.roman:
Jalwa e Shaan e Ilaahi Ki Bahaareñ Dekho
‘Qad Ra Al Haqq’ Ki Hai Sharh Ziyaarat Un Ki
shers.english:
Look At The Radiant Manifestation of The Grandeur of Allah Almighty
To See Him, Is The Commentary of ‘Certainly He Saw Allah Almighty’

shers.roman:
Baagh e Jannat Meiñ Chalay Jaayeñge Be Pooche Ham
Waqf Hai Ham Se Masaakeen Pe Daulat Un Ki
shers.english:
Without Questioning, Into Heaven’s Garden, We Will Enter, Comfortably
Endowed Upon Us Poverty-Stricken Ones, His Treasures Are Certainly

shers.roman:
Yaad Karte Haiñ ‘Adu Ko Bhi Dua Hee Se Wo
Saari Duniya Se Niraali Hai Ye ‘Aadat Un Ki
shers.english:
With Supplications As Well, He Remembers His Adversary
Outstanding In The Entire World, Is This Trait of His Humility

shers.roman:
Ham Hoñ Awr Un Ki Gali, Khuld Meiñ Waa’iz Hee Raheñ
Ay Hasan Un Ko Mubaarak Rahe Jannat Un Ki
shers.english:
May We Remain In His Lane, To Paradise, The Orator Can Journey
O Hasan! Congratulations To Them, Upon Their Abode, Heavenly

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HAM NE TAQSEER KI ‘AADAT KAR LI

shers.roman:
Ham Ne Taqseer Ki ‘Aadat Kar Li
Aap Apne Pe Qiyaamat Kar Li
shers.english:
We Have Made It A Habit, To Commit Acts of Sin
Upon Ourselves, We Have Thus, Invited Destruction

shers.roman:
Main Chala Hee Tha Mujhe Rok Liya
Mere Allah Ne Rahmat Kar Li
shers.english:
I Was Already Going, But, Halted Was My Motion
My Allah Showered Me, With His Merciful Compassion

shers.roman:
Zikr e Shah Sun Ke Huwe Bazm Meiñ Mahw
Ham Ne Jalwat Meiñ Bhi Khalwat Kar Li
shers.english:
Hearing About Our Master In The Assembly, Led Us Into Absorption
Even In The Congregation, We Entered A State of Spiritual Seclusion

shers.roman:
Naar e Dozakh Se Bachaaya Mujh Ko
Mere Pyaare Bar’i Rahmat Kar Li
shers.english:
From The Raging Fire of Hell, He Granted Us Protection
My Beloved Showered Upon Us, His Merciful Compassion

shers.roman:
Baal Beeka Na Huwa Phir Us Ka
Aap Ne Jis Ki Himaayat Kar Li
shers.english:
A Single Hair of His Was Unharmed, Under Any Condition
To The One, Whom You Blessed, With Your Special Validation

shers.roman:
Rakh Diya Sar Qadam e Jaanaañ Par
Apne Bachne Ki Ye Soorat Kar Li
shers.english:
Upon The Feet of The Beloved, I Kept My Head In Devotion
I Chose This, As The Best Way, For Me To Attain Salvation

shers.roman:
Ne’mateñ Ham Ko Khilaayeñ Awr Aap
Jau Ki Roti Pe Qana’at Kar Li
shers.english:
You Fed Us With Bounties, But Such Was Your Condition
In Eating Raw Barley Bread, You Found Total Satisfaction

shers.roman:
Us Se Firdaus Ki Soorat Poocho
Jis Ne Taibah Ki Ziyaarat Kar Li
shers.english:
About The Exalted Heaven’s Real Condition
Ask Him, Who Saw Taibah’s Grand Station

shers.roman:
Shaan e Rahmat Ke Tasad’duq Jaawuñ
Mujh Se ‘Aasi Ki Himaayat Kar Li
shers.english:
Sacrificed May I Be, Upon His Merciful Compassion
To A Mendicant Like Me, He Has Granted His Validation

shers.roman:
Faaqah Mastoñ Ko Shikam Ser Kiya
Aap Faaqah Pe Qana’at Kar Li
shers.english:
He Satiated Those Who Contentedly Faced Starvation
Without Eating, He Was Content, Even In This Situation

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan Kaam Ka Kuch Kaam Kiya
Ya Yuñhi Khatm Pe Rukhsat Kar Li
shers.english:
O Hasan! Did You Truly Accomplish Any Worthwhile Mission?
Or When Your End Came, Did You Simply Depart This Station?

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KYA KHUDA-DAAD AAP KI IMDAAD HAI

shers.roman:
Kya Khuda-Daad Aap Ki Imdaad Hai
Ik Nazar Meiñ Shaad Har Naa-Shaad Hai
shers.english:
By The Grace of Allah Almighty, Such Is Your Assistance Being
In Just One Glance, Happy, The Unhappy Ones Are Becoming

shers.roman:
Mustafa To Bar-Sar e Imdaad Hai
Afw Tu Keh, Kya Tera Irshaad Hai
shers.english:
To Be of Assistance, Mustafa Is Always Ever-Willing
O Forgiveness! Now Say, What Are You Commanding?

shers.roman:
Ban Par’i Hai Nafs e Kaafir-Kaish Ki
Khel Bigr’a Lo Khabar Faryaad Hai
shers.english:
The Inner-self Prone To Betrayal, In Trouble, Is Being
The Game Is Ruined, Help Me! To You, I Am Now Pleading

shers.roman:
Is Qadar Ham Un Ko Bhoolay Haaye! Haaye!
Har Ghar’i Jin Ko Hamaari Yaad Hai
shers.english:
Alas! O Alas! To Such An Extent, Him We Are Forgetting
Yet In Every Moment, Concerned About Us, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Nafs e Am’maara Ke Haathoñ Ay Huzoor
Daad Hai Be-Daad Hai Faryaad Hai
shers.english:
O My Master! At The Hand of The Evil Inner-self, Ruined I Am Being
For Justice I Am Appealing, To You, The Tortured One Is Pleading

shers.roman:
Phir Chali Baad e Mukhalif, Lo Khabar
Naaw Phir Chakra Gayi Faryaad Hai
shers.english:
Come To My Aid, For Again, The Opposing Winds Are Blowing
Again, My Ship Is Out of Control; For Your Aid, I Am Pleading

shers.roman:
Khel Bigr’a Naaw ‘Toot’i Maiñ Chala
Ay Mere Waali Bacha Faryaad Hai
shers.english:
The Game Is Ruined, My Ship Is Wrecked, Ruined I Am Being
Save Me, O My Beloved Guardian! To You, I Am Pleading

shers.roman:
Raat Andheri, Meiñ Akela, Ye Ghat’a
Ay Qamar Ho Jalwagar Faryaad Hai
shers.english:
On A Dark Night, Under These Dark Clouds, Alone I Am Being
O Moon! Glow With Your Full Glory, To You, I Am Pleading

shers.roman:
‘Ahd Jo Un Se Kiya Roz e Alast
Kyuñ Dil e Ghaafil Tujhe Kuch Yaad Hai
shers.english:
On The Day of The Covenant, To Him, That Which You Were Pledging
O Oblivious Heart! That Pledge, Why Aren’t You Now Remembering?

shers.roman:
Maiñ Huñ! Maiñ Huñ! Apni Ummat Ke Liye
Kya Hee Pyaara-Pyaara Ye Irshaad Hai
shers.english:
I Am Here! I Am Here, For My Ummah, Present, I Am Being
What A Beautiful And Wonderful, Declaration This Is Being

shers.roman:
Wo Shafa’at Ko Chalay Haiñ Pesh e Haq
‘Aasiyo Tum Ko Mubaarak-Baad Hai
shers.english:
To Intercede, Before Allah Almighty, He Is Proceeding
O Sinful Ones! For You, A Glad-Tiding, This Is Being

shers.roman:
Kaun Se Dil Meiñ Nahiñ Yaad e Habeeb
Qalb e Momin, Mustafa Abaad Hai
shers.english:
Devoid of The Beloved’s Remembrance, Which Heart Is Being?
In The Heart of A True Believer, My Beloved Mustafa Is Residing

shers.roman:
Jis Ko Us Dar Ki Ghulaami Mil Gayi
Wo Gham e Kaunain Se Azaad Hai
shers.english:
To Serve At His Holy Threshold, Blessed Whoever Is Being
Free From The Distresses of The World, He Is Always Being

shers.roman:
Jin Ke Ham Bande Wohi ‘Tehray Shafi’
Phir Dil e Be-Taab Kyuñ Naashaad Hai
shers.english:
The One Whose Slaves We Are, Our Intercessor, He Is Being
O Restless Heart! So Apprehensive, Why Are You Then Being

shers.roman:
Un Ke Dar Par Gir Ke Phir Ut’ha Na Jaaye
Jaan o Dil Qurbaan Kya Uftaad Hai
shers.english:
After Falling At His Threshold, Again, If I Am Unable To Be Rising
May My Heart And Soul Be Sacrificed! How Tragic Is This Feeling!

shers.roman:
Ye ‘Ibaadat Zaahido Be Hub’b e Dost
Muft Ki Mehnat Hai, Sab Barbaad Hai
shers.english:
O Worshippers! Devoid of The Beloved, That Worship Which Is Being
In Vain, Is This Worthless Effort, Completely Ruined, All of It Is Being

shers.roman:
Ham Safeeroñ Se Mileñ Kyuñ Kar Hasan
Sakht Dil Awr Sang-Dil Say’yaad Hai
shers.english:
O Hasan! With Chirping Birds Like Ourselves, How Will We Be Meeting?
When, Extremely Heartless And Stone-Hearted, The Hunter Is Being

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AAP KE DAR KI ‘AJAB TAUQEER HAI

shers.roman:
Aap Ke Dar Ki ‘Ajab Tauqeer Hai
Jo Yahaañ Ki Khaak Hai Ikseer Hai
shers.english:
Exceptionally Revered, Your Sacred Threshold Is Being
An All-Cure Remedy, The Sacred Dust, From Here, Is Being

shers.roman:
Kaam Jo Un Se Huwa Poora Huwa
Un Ki Jo Tadbeer Hai Taqdeer Hai
shers.english:
Accomplished Perfectly, Is Every Task, Which He Is Undertaking
Indeed, Destiny Itself, Every One of His Blessed Strategies Is Being

shers.roman:
Jis Se Baateñ Ki Unheeñ Ka Ho Gaya
Waah! Kya Taqreer e Pur Taaseer Hai
shers.english:
With Whomsoever He Conversed, Sincerely His, He Is Becoming
Wow! How Perfectly Impressive, His Every Discourse Is Being

shers.roman:
Jo Lagaaye Aankh Meiñ Mahboob Ho
Khaak e Taibah Surma e Taskheer Hai
shers.english:
Beloved He Becomes, Who In His Eyes, Is Applying
The Dust of Taibah; Which Is A Collyrium, Captivating

shers.roman:
Sadr e Aqdas Hai Khazeena Raaz Ka
Seena Ki Tahreer Meiñ Tahreer Hai
shers.english:
A Treasure-Chest of Secrets, His Sacred Chest Is Being
Within The Writings of His Chest, Other Scripts Are Hiding

shers.roman:
Zar’ra-Zar’ra Se Hai Taale’ Noor e Shah
Aftaab e Husn ‘Aalam-Geer Hai
shers.english:
From Every Dust Particle, Rises The Radiance of My Grand King
The Entire Universe, The Sun of True Beauty, Is Illuminating

shers.roman:
Lutf Ki Baarish Hai, Sab Shaadaab Haiñ
Abr e Jood e Shah ‘Aalam-Geer Hai
shers.english:
His Generous Showers Are Descending, Everything Is Now Blooming
Over The Universe, The Clouds, of My King’s Kindness Are Gathering

shers.roman:
Mujrimo Un Ke Qadam Par Laut’ Jaaow
Bas Rihaayi Ki Yahi Tadbeer Hai
shers.english:
O Offenders! Fall At His Feet, Sincerely Submitting
The Pure Strategy For Salvation, Only This Is Being

shers.roman:
Ya Nabi Mushkil Kushaayi Kijiye
Banda e Dar Be-Dil o Dil-Geer Hai
shers.english:
O My Beloved Nabi! All My Adversities, Please Do Be Alleviating
Heart-Broken And Aggrieved, This Slave At Your Threshold, Is Being

shers.roman:
Wo Saraapa Lutf Haiñ Shaan e Khuda
Wo Saraapa Noor Ki Tasweer Hai
shers.english:
The Epitome of Grace He Is, The Grandeur of Allah, He Is Being
The Perfect Illustration, of The Epitome of Light, He is Being

shers.roman:
Kaan Haiñ Kaan e Karam Jaan e Karam
Aankh Hai Ya Chashma e Tanweer Hai
shers.english:
His Ears Are Mines of Kindness, The Souls of Kindness, They Are Being
Are Those Eyes, Or Are They Fountains, From Which Light Is Flowing?

shers.roman:
Jaane Waale Chal Diye Ham Reh Gaye
Apni-Apni Ay Hasan Taqdeer Hai
shers.english:
All The Pilgrims Have Departed, We Are Now Remaining
O Hasan! Bound By His Own Destiny, Every One Is Being

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: NA MAAYOOS HO MERE DUKH DARD WAALE

shers.roman:
Na Maayoos Ho Mere Dukh Dard Waale
Dar e Shah Pe Aa, Har Maraz Ki Dawa Le
shers.english:
Do Not Be Despondent, If You Are Facing Any Grief And Agony
Come To My King’s Threshold; For Every Illness, Take A Remedy

shers.roman:
Jo Bimaar e Gham Le Raha Ho Sambhaale
Wo Chaahe To Dam Bhar Meiñ Us Ko Sambhaale
shers.english:
The One Who Is Carrying The Burden of Grief, Take It Easy
If He Wishes, Then In A Moment, His Grief, He Can Remedy

shers.roman:
Na Kar Is Tarah Ay Dil e Zaar Naale
Wo Haiñ Sab Ki Faryaad Ke Sun’ne Waale
shers.english:
O Afflicted Heart! In This Way, Do Not Complain Constantly
He Is The One, Who Really Listens To Everyone’s Sincere Plea

shers.roman:
Koyi Dam Meiñ Ab Doobta Hai Safina
Khudaara Khabar Meri Ay Nakhuda Le
shers.english:
Any Moment Now, My Ship, Will Be Sinking Completely
O My Saviour! Help Me, For The Sake of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Safar Kar Khayaal e Rukh e Shah Meiñ Ay Jaañ
Musaafir Nikal, Jaa Ujaale-Ujaale
shers.english:
O My Soul! In The Thought of My King’s Face, Embark On A Journey
O Traveller, Proceed Towards This Radiance, Into This Luminosity

shers.roman:
Tehi Dast o Sauda e Bazaar e Mahshar
Meri Laaj Rakh Le Mere Taaj Waale
shers.english:
How Will I Trade In Reckoning Day’s Market, When My Hands Are Empty?
O My Majestic King! Please Do Preserve My Honour And My Dignity

shers.roman:
Zahe Shaukat e Aastaan e Mu’alla
Yahaañ Sar Jhukaate Haiñ Sab Taaj Waale
shers.english:
How Marvellous, Is Your Exalted Threshold’s Sacred Glory
For, Here All The Kings, Are Lowering Their Heads Humbly

shers.roman:
Siwa Tere Ay Nakhuda e Ghareebañ
Wo Hai Kaun Jo Doobtoñ Ko Nikaale
shers.english:
Apart From You, O The Honourable Saviour of The Needy!
Who Else Will Rescue Those, Who Are Drowning Completely?

shers.roman:
Yahi ‘Arz Karte Haiñ Sheraan e ‘Aalam
Ke Tu Apne Kut’toñ Ka Kut’ta Bana Le
shers.english:
The Lions of The World, Are Making This Humble Plea
A Loyal Dog of Your Loyal Dogs, Please Do Make Me!

shers.roman:
Jisay Apni Mushkil Ho Aasaan Karni
Faqeeraan e Taibah Se Aa Kar Dua Le
shers.english:
If Anyone Wishes To Really Alleviate, His Every Difficulty
Come To Taibah’s Dervishes, Seeking Their Duas, Sincerely

shers.roman:
Khuda Ka Karam Dastgeeri Ko Aaye
Tera Naam Le Leñ Agar Girnay Waale
shers.english:
To Their Special Aid, Will Come, The Mercy of Allah Almighty
If Those Who Are Falling, Take Your Blessed Name Sincerely

shers.roman:
Dar e Shah Par Ay Dil Muraadeñ Mileñgi
Yahaañ Bayt’h Kar Haath Sab Se Ut’ha Le
shers.english:
O My Heart! At My King’s Court, Your Wishes Will Be Fulfilled, Surely
Take A Seat Here, And Divorce Yourself From Everyone, Completely

shers.roman:
Ghira Huñ Maiñ Isyaañ Ki Taareekiyoñ Meiñ
Khabar Meri Ay Mere Badrud-Duja Le
shers.english:
The Darkness of My Sins, Has Surrounded Me, Completely
O Radiant Moon of The Dark Night! Please Do Help Me

shers.roman:
Faqeeroñ Ko Milta Hai Be Maange Sab Kuch
Yahaañ Jaante Hee Nahiñ ‘Taale Baale
shers.english:
Without Even Asking, The Mendicants Get Everything Easily
Here, They Know Not, How To Reject Your Sincere Plea

shers.roman:
Lagaaye Haiñ Paiwand Kapr’oñ Meiñ Apne
Ur’haaye Faqeeroñ Ko Tum Ne Do-Shaale
shers.english:
You Sew Patches, To You Own Sacred Clothing, Personally
Yet, You Adorn The Mendicants, In Mantles of Pure Luxury

shers.roman:
Mit’a Kufr Ko, Deen Chamka De Apna
Baneñ Masjideñ, ‘Toot’ Jaayeñ Shiwaale
shers.english:
Destroy Unbelief, Grant Your Deen Further Luminosity
May Masjids Be Constructed, Ruined May Temples Be

shers.roman:
Jo Pesh e Sanam Sar Jhukaate Thay Apne
Banay Teri Rahmat Se Allah Waale
shers.english:
Before Idols, Those Who Once Bowed Their Heads Blindly
True Servants of Allah, They Became, By Virtue of Your Mercy

shers.roman:
Nigaah e Ze-Chashm e Karam Bar Hasan Kun
Bakooyat Raseedast Aa-Shuftah Haale
shers.english:
Please Place Upon Hasan, A Glance of Your Generosity
At Your Threshold, An Aggrieved Soul, Has Come, Humbly

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: NAHIÑ WO SADMAH YE DIL KO, KIS KA KHAYAAL E RAHMAT THAPAK RAHA HAI

shers.roman:
Nahiñ Wo Sadmah Ye Dil Ko, Kis Ka Khayaal e Rahmat Thapak Raha Hai
Ke Aaj Ruk-Ruk Ke Khoon e Dil, Kuch Meri Mizha Se ‘Tapak Raha Hai
shers.english:
This Heart Is Not Feeling Any Sadness, Even Slightly
For, Whose Thought of Mercy, Is Tapping It Gently

shers.roman:
For Today, Even From My Eyelashes, Very Visibly
My Heart’s Blood of Grief, Is Trickling Gradually
shers.english:
Liya Na Ho Jis Ne Unka Sadqa, Mila Na Ho Jis Ko Unka Baar’a
Na Koyi Aisa Bashar Hai Baaqi Na Koyi Aisa Malak Raha Hai

shers.roman:
Who Is It, That Has Not Been Blessed With His Charity?
Who Is It, That Has Not Received His Distinct Generosity?
shers.english:
Neither Is There Such A Human, Remaining In Reality
Nor Is There Such An Angel, Which Is Existing In Reality

shers.roman:
Kiya Hai Haq Ne Kareem Tum Ko, Id’har Bhi Lil’Laah Nigaah Kar Lo
Ke Der Se Be-Nawa Tumhaara, Tumhaare Haathoñ Ko Tak Raha Hai
shers.english:
You Have Been Blessed To Be Generous, By Allah Almighty
For Allah’s Sake, Place Upon Us, Your Blessed Sight of Mercy

shers.roman:
For Very Long Now, The Destitute, Are Yearning Sincerely
Towards Your Sacred Hands, They Are Gazing, Very Eagerly
shers.english:
Hai Kis Ke Gaisoo e Mushk-Bu Ki, Shameem Ambar Fishaaniyoñ Par
Ke Jaa e Naghma Safeer e Bulbul, Se Mushk e Aazfar ‘Tapak Raha Hai

shers.roman:
Whose Musk Like Fragrant Tresses Are Emitting, So Sweetly
The Amber Like Fragrance, Which Is Scattering Fragrantly
shers.english:
From The Spot Where The Nightingale Chirps Melodiously
The Purest Musk, Is Now Trickling Out, So Fragrantly

shers.roman:
Ye Kis Ke Roo e Niko Ke Jalwe, Zamaane Ko Kar Rahe Haiñ Roshan
Ye Kis Ke Gaisoo e Mushk-Bu Se, Mashaam e ‘Aalam Mahak Raha Hai
shers.english:
Whose Beaming Sacred Face, Is Emitting Such Luminosity?
Due To Which, The Entire Universe, Is Now Glowing Brightly

shers.roman:
Whose Musk Like Fragrant Tresses, Are Releasing So Fragrantly
A Scent, By Which The World’s Essence, Is Perfumed, So Sweetly
shers.english:
Hasan ‘Ajab Kya Jo Un Ke Rang e Maleeh Ki Tah Hai Pairahan Par
Ke Rang e Pur Noor e Mahr Gardooñ, Ka-ee Falak Se Chamak Raha Hai

shers.roman:
O Hasan! Why Is It Surprising, If The Shade of His Captivating Beauty
Manifests Upon His Sacred Robe, Reflecting Through It, So Clearly?
shers.english:
For The Luminous Rays of The Sun, Which Is Shining So Luminously
From The Celestial Region, Shines Through So Many Skies, So Visibly

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: MURAADEÑ MIL RAHI HAIÑ SHAAD-SHAAD UN KA SAWAALI HAI

shers.roman:
Muraadeñ Mil Rahi Haiñ Shaad-Shaad Un Ka Sawaali Hai
Laboñ Par Iltija Hai, Haath Meiñ Rozay Ki Jaali Hai
shers.english:
As Wishes Are Being Bestowed, The Supplicant Is Ecstatically Rejoicing
Upon His Lips Are Prayers, In His Hand, The Raudha’s Lattice He Is Holding

shers.roman:
Teri Soorat Teri Seerat Zamaane Se Niraali Hai
Teri Har-Har Ada Pyaare Daleel e Be-Misaali Hai
shers.english:
In The Entire Creation, Peerless, Your Countenance And Character Is Being
O Beloved! Your Noble Distinction, Your Every Blessed Action, Is Proving

shers.roman:
Bashar Ho Ya Malak, Jo Hai, Tere Dar Ka Sawaali Hai
Teri Sarkaar Waala Hai Tera Darbaar ‘Aali Hai
shers.english:
Be They Humans, Or Angels, At Your Threshold, All Supplicants, Are Being
Whilst Your Court Is Most Exalted, Honourable, Your Holy Shrine Is Being

shers.roman:
Wo Jag Daata Ho Tum Sansaar Baar’e Ka Sawaali Hai
Daya Karna Ke Is Mangta Ne Bhi Gudri Bicha Li Hai
shers.english:
Whilst He Gives To The World, For Worldly Things, You Are Supplicating
Have Pity On The Mendicant, For His Tattered Sack, He Is Now Spreading

shers.roman:
Munawwar Dil Nahiñ Faiz e Qudoom e Shah Se Rauza Hai
Mushab’bak Seena e ‘Aashiq Nahiñ Rauze Ki Jaali Hai
shers.english:
The Heart Is Not Glowing, But By The King’s Arrival, The Raudha Is Glowing
It Is Not The Lover’s Perforated Chest, The Raudha’s Lattice, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Tumhaara Qaamat e Yakta Hai Ik’ka Bazm e Wahdat Ka
Tumhaari Zaat e Be-Hamta Misaal e Be-Misaali Hai
shers.english:
The Lamp of The Assembly of Oneness, Your Unique Stature Is Being
The Illustration of Being Peerless, Your Peerless Personality, Is Being

shers.roman:
Farogh e Akhtar e Badr, Aftaab e Jalwa e ‘Aariz
Zia e Taale’ e Badr Un Ka Abru e Hilaali Hai
shers.english:
The Radiance of The Moon’s Star, His Radiant Cheek’s Sun, Is Being
The Glow of The Moon’s Destiny, In His Crescent-Like Brows, Is Resting

shers.roman:
Wo Haiñ Allah Waale Jo Tujhe Waali Kaheñ Apna
Ke Tu Allah Waala Hai Tera Allah Waali Hai
shers.english:
Those Who Call You Their Guardian, Allah’s True Servants They Are Being
For, You Are Allah’s Chosen Servant, Your Divine Guardian, Allah Is Being

shers.roman:
Sahaare Ne Tere Gaisoo Ke Pheyra Hai Balaa-oñ Ko
Ishaare Ne Tere Abru Ke Aayi Maut ‘Taali Hai
shers.english:
The Support of Your Tresses, Caused Our Misfortunes, To Be Diverting
The Gesturing of Your Eyebrows, Caused Certain Death, To Be Passing

shers.roman:
Nigah Ne Teer Zahmat Ke Dil e Ummat Se Kheeñchay Haiñ
Mizha Ne Phaañs Hasrat Ki Kaleja Se Nikaali Hai
shers.english:
From The Ummat’s Heart, The Arrow of Agony, His Gaze Was Extracting
From The Heart, The Splinter of Anguish, His Eyelashes, Were Removing

shers.roman:
Faqeero Be-Nawao Apni-Apni Jholiyaañ Bhar Lo
Ke Baar’a Bat’t Raha Hai Faiz Par Sarkaar e ‘Aali Hai
shers.english:
O Dervishes! O Destitute Ones! Each of Your Pouches, Start Filling
Alms Are Being Distributed, The Grand King’s Favours, Are Flowing

shers.roman:
Tujhi Ko Khil’at e Yaktaayi e ‘Aalam Mila Haq Se
Tere Hee Jism Pe Mauzooñ Qaba e Be-Misaali Hai
shers.english:
The Unique Robe of Honour, Exclusively To You, Allah Was Granting
Only Your Most Blessed Body, That Blessed Robe, Is Perfectly Fitting

shers.roman:
Nikaala Kab Kisi Ko Bazm e Faiz e ‘Aam Se Tum Ne
Nikaali Hai To Aane Waaloñ Ki Hasrat Nikaali Hai
shers.english:
Anyone, From Your Universal Blessings, When Were You Ever Removing?
If You Removed Anything, Then The Pilgrims’ Grief, You Were Removing

shers.roman:
Bar’he Kyuñ Kar Na Phir Shakl e Hilaal Islam Ki Ronaq
Hilaal e Aasman e Deeñ Teri Taygh e Hilaali Hai
shers.english:
Once Again, Why Will The Crescent Symbol of Islam, Not Be Thriving?
For The Sky of Deen’s Crescent, Your Crescent-Shaped Sword Is Being

shers.roman:
Faqat Itna Sabab Hai In’iqaad e Bazm e Mahshar Ka
Ke Un Ki Shaan e Mahboobi Dikhaayi Jaane Waali Hai
shers.english:
The Only Reason, For Convening The Assembly of The Day of Reckoning
Is To Reveal That, The Most Beloved, In The Divine Court, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Khuda Shaahid Ke Roz e Hashr Ka Khat’ka Nahiñ Rehta
Mujhe Jab Yaad Aata Hai Ke Mera Kaun Waali Hai
shers.english:
Allah Is My Witness, I Feel No Anxiety, About The Day of Reckoning
As I Contemplate About Who My Blessed Guardian Is Really Being

shers.roman:
Utar Sakti Nahiñ Tasweer Bhi Husn e Saraapa Ki
Kuch Is Darja Taraq’qi Par Tumhaari Be-Misaali Hai
shers.english:
The Reality of Your Perfect Beauty, Even An Image Cannot Be Capturing
To Such Magnificent Heights, Your Unsurpassed Magnificence, Is Excelling

shers.roman:
Nahiñ Mahshar Meiñ Jis Ko Dastaras Aaqa Ke Daaman Tak
Bharay Bazaar Meiñ Us Be-Nawa Ka Haath Khaali Hai
shers.english:
He, Who Cannot Reach Our Master’s Mantle, On The Day of Reckoning
In A Crowded Assembly, Empty-Handed, That Destitute One Is Being

shers.roman:
Na Kyuñ Ho It’tihaad e Manzilat Makkah Madina Meiñ
Wo Basti Hai Nabi Waali, To Ye Allah Wali Hai
shers.english:
Union In Their Rank, Why Shouldn’t Makkah And Madina Be Sharing
That City, Is The Holy City of The Nabi; To Allah, This City Is Belonging

shers.roman:
Sharaf Makkah Ki Basti Ko Mila Taibah Ki Basti Se
Nabi Waali Hee Ke Sadqe Meiñ Wo Allah Waali Hai
shers.english:
Through The City of Madina, Virtue, The City of Makkah Is Receiving
The Holy City of Allah, By The Blessings of The Nabi’s City, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Wohi Waali Wohi Aaqa Wohi Waaris Wohi Maula
Maiñ Un Ke Sadqe Jaawuñ Awr Mera Kaun Waali Hai
shers.english:
My Guardian, My Master, My Protector, My King, He Is Being
Sacrificed Upon Him May I Be, My Guardian, Who Else Is Being

shers.roman:
Pukaar Ay Jaan e ‘Esa Sun Lo Apne Khasta Haaloñ Ki
Maraz Ne Dard-Mandoñ Ki Ghazab Meiñ Jaañ Daali Hai
shers.english:
O Soul of Esa! To The Pleas of Your Stricken Slaves, Do Be Listening
Thrown Into Distress, By Their Ailment, The Afflicted Ones Are Being

shers.roman:
Muraadoñ Se Tumheeñ Daaman Bharoge Na-Muraadoñ Ke
Ghareeboñ Bekasoñ Ka Awr Pyaare Kaun Waali Hai
shers.english:
