With Their Wishes, The Mantles of The Despairing, Only You Will be Filling
O My Beloved! The Guardian of The Poor And Needy, Who Else Is Being?

shers.roman:
Hamesha Tum Karam Karte Ho Bigr’e Haal Waaloñ Par
Bigar’ Kar Meri Haalat Ne Meri Bigr’i Bana Li Hai
shers.english:
You Always Shower Your Blessings, Upon Those Who Are Suffering
Due To My Troubled State, My Situation Has Now Started Improving

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Dar Tumhaare Aastaañ Se Maiñ Kahaañ Jaawuñ
Na Mujh Sa Koyi Bekas Hai Na Tum Sa Koyi Waali Hai
shers.english:
From Your Threshold And From Your Holy Court, Where Can I Be Going?
Like Me, There Is No Other Destitute, And Like You, No Guardian Is Being

shers.roman:
Hasan Ka Dard Dukh Mauqoof Farma Kar Bahaali Do
Tumhaare Haath Meiñ Dunya Ki Mauqoofi Bahaali Hai
shers.english:
Suspend Hasan’s Pain And Suffering, By Restoring His Well-Being
Suspending And Restoring The World’s Affairs, In Your Hand Is Being

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: KARE CHAARA-SAAZI ZIYAARAT KISI KI

shers.roman:
Kare Chaara-Saazi Ziyaarat Kisi Ki
Bharay Zakhm Dil Ke Malaahat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
When The Peerless One Is Visited, It Will Lead To Healing And Remedy
The Heart’s Wounds Will Be Filled, By The Peerless One’s Pure Beauty

shers.roman:
Chamak Kar Ye Kehti Hai Tal’at Kisi Ki
Ke Deedar e Haq Hai Ziyaarat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
The Countenance of The Peerless One, Declares, Whilst Glowing Brightly,
To See The Peerless One’s Countenance, Is The Vision of Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Na Rehti Jo Pardoñ Meiñ Soorat Kisi Ki
Na Hoti Kisi Ko Ziyaarat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
If The Sacred Face of That Peerless One, Were Not Veiled In Reality
The Peerless One’s Countenance, None Would Ever Bear To Really See

shers.roman:
‘Ajab Pyaari-Pyaari Hai Soorat Kisi Ki
Hameñ Kya, Khuda Ko Hai Ulfat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
The Countenance of The Peerless One, Is Indeed So Lovely
Not Just Us, But Allah, Loves The Peerless One, Profoundly

shers.roman:
Abhi Paar Hoñ Doobne Waale Ber’ay
Sahaara Laga De Jo Rahmat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
My Sinking Ship, Will Immediately, Cross Over Safely
If It Is Truly Guided, By The Peerless One’s Special Mercy

shers.roman:
Kisi Ko Kisi Se Huwi Hai Na Hogi
Khuda Ko Hai Jitni Muhab’bat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
No One Has Ever Loved, Or Will Ever Love Anybody
Like The Peerless One Is Loved, By Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Dam e Hashr ‘Aasi Mazay Le Rahe Haiñ
Shafa’at Kisi Ki Hai Rahmat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
On The Day of Reckoning, The Sinners Are In A State of Ecstasy
The Peerless One’s Intercession, Invites The Divine One’s Mercy

shers.roman:
Rahe Dil Kisi Ki Muhab’bat Meiñ Har Dam
Rahe Dil Meiñ Har Dam Muhab’bat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
In The Peerless One’s Love, The Heart Should Remain Constantly
In The Heart, The Peerless One’s Love, At All Times, Should Be

shers.roman:
Tera Qabza Kaunain o Ma-Feehima Sab Par
Huwi Hai, Na Ho Yuñ, Hukoomat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Over Both The Worlds, And Whatever Is In Them, Is Your Authority
Such Control By Anybody, Neither Was There, No Will There Be

shers.roman:
Khuda Ka Diya Hai Tere Paas Sab Kuch
Tere Hote Kya Ham Ko Haajat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
With You Is Everything, Which Has Been Given By The Almighty
When You Are With Us, What Need Do We Have For Anybody

shers.roman:
Zamaana Ki Daulat Nahiñ Paas Phir Bhi
Zamaana Meiñ Bat’ti Hai Daulat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
The Wealth of The World, He Does Not Accumulate, Yet In Reality
Distributed In The World, Is The Peerless One’s Treasures, Entirely

shers.roman:
Na Pahuncheñ Kabhi ‘Aql e Kul Ke Farishtay
Khuda Jaanta Hai Haqeeqat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Even The Wise Angel Jibra’eel, Cannot Comprehend His Reality
Only Allah Almighty Really Knows, The Peerless One’s Reality

shers.roman:
Hamaara Bharosa Hamaara Sahaara
Shafa’at Kisi Ki Himaayat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Our Complete Trust And Our Total Reliance, Most Certainly
Is In The Peerless One’s Intercession, And Protection In Reality

shers.roman:
Qamar Ik Ishaare Meiñ Do Tukr’e Dekha
Zamaane Pe Roshan Hai Taaqat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
In A Moment, The Moon Was Split Into Two Pieces, Perfectly
The Power of The Peerless One, The World Has Seen Clearly

shers.roman:
Hameñ Haiñ Kisi Ki Shafa’at Ki Khaatir
Hamaari Hee Khaatir Shafa’at Kisi Ki
shers.english:
The Peerless One’s Intercession, We Need Most Certainly
The Peerless One Offers His Intercession, For Us, In Reality

shers.roman:
Musibat Zado Shaad Ho Tum, Ke Un Se
Nahiñ Dekhi Jaati Musibat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
O Aggrieved Ones! Rejoice And Become Happy!
For The Grief of Anybody, He Cannot Bear To See

shers.roman:
Na Pahuncheñge Jab Tak Gunahgaar Un Ke
Na Jaaye Gi Jannat Meiñ Ummat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Until His Sinful Followers, Do Not Reach Heaven Safely
Into Jannah, The Ummah of None Other, Will Get Entry

shers.roman:
Ham Aise Gunahgaar Haiñ Zuhd Waalo
Hamaari Madad Par Hai Rahmat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
O Ascetics! We Are All Such Sinners In Reality
Aiding Us In Reality, Is The Peerless One’s Mercy

shers.roman:
Madina Ka Jungle Ho Awr Ham Hoñ Zaahid
Nahiñ Chaahiye Ham Ko Jannat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
O Ascetic! In The Wilderness of Madina, We Will Be
We Do Not Really Desire, The Heaven of Anybody

shers.roman:
Hazaaroñ Hoñ Khursheed e Mahshar To Kya Gham
Yahaañ Saaya Gustar Hai Rahmat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Even If There Are Thousands of Suns On Reckoning Day, Why Worry!
Granting Us Shade And Protection Here, Is The Peerless One’s Mercy

shers.roman:
Bharay Jaayeñge Khuld Meiñ Ahl e ‘Isyaañ
Na Jaayegi Khaali Shafa’at Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Into Paradise, The Once Sinful Ones, Will Also Be Given Entry
Rejected, The Intercession of The Peerless One, Will Never Be

shers.roman:
Wahi Sab Ke Maalik Unheeñ Ka Hai Sab Kuch
Na ‘Aasi Kisi Ke Na Jannat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
He Is Indeed The Master of All, Everything Belongs To Him, In Reality
Neither Are The Sinners Anyones, Nor Is Paradise, Any Other’s Entity

shers.roman:
ذْک ک رْ Par Tasad’duq
Sab Oonchoñ Se Oonchi Hai Rif’at Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Upon, ‘We Have Exalted For You, Your Remembrance’, Devoted Are We
Above The Eminence of The Eminent, Is The Peerless One’s Grand Dignity

shers.roman:
Utarne Lagay َ رَ َ ᘮَ ᘍَُ
Char’hi Aisi Zoroñ Pe Taaqat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
When It Was Revealed, ‘You Threw Not, It Was The Hand of The Almighty’
Then, The Strength of The Peerless One, Reached A Height, So Mighty

shers.roman:
Gada Khush Hoñ ជ᠐َᣂی Ki Sada Hai
Ke Din Dooni Bar’hti Hai Daulat Kisi Ki
shers.english:
Upon The Message In ‘Best For You’ O Mendicants, Be Happy!
For The Plentiful Wealth of The Peerless One, Is Increasing Daily

shers.roman:
ٰض
ᣂت َْᣔ Ne Daali Hai Baaheñ Galay Meiñ
shers.english:
Ke Ho Jaaye Raazi Tabi’at Kisi Ki
The Neck Was Embraced By, ‘You Will Surely Be Happy’

shers.roman:
So That, The Peerless One, Feels Completely Happy
Khuda Se Dua Hai Ke Hangaam e Rukhsat
shers.english:
Zabaan e Hasan Par Ho Madh Kisi Ki
It Is My Dua To Allah Almighty, That, During My Final Journey

shers.roman:
On Hasan’s Tongue, The Praises of The Peerless One Should Be
Note: ‘Hand of Allah’ as mentioned in the Qur’anic verse, and in such
shers.english:
instances, does not refer to a physical hand, but it refers to the Divine Power
of Allah Almighty, for Almighty Allah is free from all physical attributes and

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: JAAN SE TANG HAIÑ QAIDI GHAM E TANHAAYI KE

shers.roman:
Jaan Se Tang Haiñ Qaidi Gham e Tanhaayi Ke
Sadqe Jaawuñ Meiñ Teri Anjuman Aaraayi Ke
shers.english:
Weary of Their Lives, Is The One Imprisoned, By The Grief of Isolation
Sacrificed I Am, Upon The Assembly, In The Beloved’s Preparation

shers.roman:
Bazm e Aara Hoñ Ujaale Teri Zaibaayi Ke
Kab Se Mushtaaq Haiñ Aa-ina e Khud Aaraayi Ke
shers.english:
May The Assembly of Your Beauty, Glow, Full of Illumination
For Long Now, The Mirror Is Yearning, For Pure Self-Decoration

shers.roman:
Ho Ghubaar e Dar e Mahboob Ke Gard e Rah e Dost
Juzw e A’zam Haiñ Yahi Surma e Beenaayi Ke
shers.english:
Be It The Dust of The Beloved’s Gate, Or Dust From His Devotee’s Location
This Is The Grand Portion; It Is This, Which Is the Collyrium, of Our Vision

shers.roman:
Khaak Ho Jaaye Agar Teri Taman’nawoñ Meiñ
Kyuñ Mileñ Khaak Meiñ Armaan Taman’naayi Ke
shers.english:
If He Were To Turn To Dust, Whilst Truly Yearning, In Your Admiration
Why Will The Desirous One’s Hope, Become Dust; Reaching Annihilation

shers.roman:
ذْک ورْک Ke Chamakte Khursheed
Laa-Makaañ Tak Haiñ Ujaale Teri Zaibaayi Ke
shers.english:
O Radiant Sun of, ‘And We Have Exalted For You, Your Celebration’
Even Beyond Time And Space, Glows Your Beautiful Illumination

shers.roman:
Dil e Mushtaaq Meiñ Armaan e Liqaa Aankheñ Band
Qaabil e Deed Haiñ Andaaz Taman’naayi Ke
shers.english:
With Closed Eyes, The Yearning Heart, Yearns For Your Union
Indeed, A Sight To Behold, Is This Stunning Form of Anticipation

shers.roman:
Lab e Jaañ Bakhsh Ki Kya Baat Hai Subhaan’Allah
Tum Ne Zinda Kiye I’jaaz Maseehaayi Ke
shers.english:
Glory Be To Allah! About Your Life-Giving Lips, What Can I Mention
You Revived The Miracle of The Messiah, With Such Distinction

shers.roman:
Apne Daaman Meiñ Ch’hupaayeñ Wo Mere Aiboñ Ko
Ay Zah e Bakht Meri Zil’lat o Ruswaayi Ke
shers.english:
In His Sacred Mantle, My Vulnerabilities, He Has Completely Hidden
O My Good Fortune! Even In The Face of My Shame And Humiliation

shers.roman:
Dekhne Waale Khuda Ke Haiñ Khuda Shaahid Hai
Dekhne Waale Tere Jalwa e Zaibaayi Ke
shers.english:
Allah Is Witness! Blessed With Seeing Allah’s Manifestation
Are Those, Who Are Blessed, With Seeing Your Radiant Vision

shers.roman:
Jab Ghubaar e Rah e Mahboob Ne Iz’zat Bakhshi
Aa-ina Saaf Huwe Ainak e Beenaayi Ke
shers.english:
When The Sacred Dust of The Beloved’s Lane, Granted Them Distinction
The Lenses of Vision, Began To Sparkle, After Attaining Decontamination

shers.roman:
Baar Sar Par Hai Naqaahat Se Gira Jaata Huñ
Sadqe Jaawuñ Tere Baazu Ki Tawanaayi Ke
shers.english:
In My Feeble State, I Am Falling, Due To My Head’s Weighty Burden
May I Be Sacrificed, Upon Your Shoulder’s Powerful Determination

shers.roman:
Aalim ul Ghaib Ne Har Ghaib Se Aaga Kiya
Sadqe Us Shaan Ki Beenaayi o Daanaayi Ke
shers.english:
The Knower of The Unseen, Blessed With All The Unseen Information
May I Be Sacrificed, Upon Such Powerful Vision, And Great Erudition

shers.roman:
Dekhne Waale Tum Ho Raat Ki Tareeki Meiñ
Kaan Meiñ Sam’ Ke Awr Aankh Meiñ Beenaayi Ke
shers.english:
In The Darkness of Night, You Are, The One With Clear Vision
For Our Hearing In Our Ears, And In Our Eyes, Its Clear Vision

shers.roman:
Aibi Nutfe Haiñ Wo Be Ilm Janam Ke Andhe
Jin Ko Inkaar Haiñ Is Ilm o Shanasaayi Ke
shers.english:
Defective Offspring, Ignorant, Blind From Birth, Without Vision
Are Those Who Reject This Knowledge, And The True Revelation

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan Kaa’ba Hee Afzal Sahi Is Dar Se Magar
Ham To Khoogar Haiñ Yahaañ Naasiyah Farsaayi Ke
shers.english:
O Hasan! Even Though, Above That Gate, The Kaa’ba Has Distinction
We Habitually Lower Our Humble Heads Here, In Sincere Devotion

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: PARDAY JIS WAQT UT’HEÑ JALWA E ZAIBAAYI KE

shers.roman:
Parday Jis Waqt Ut’heñ Jalwa e Zaibaayi Ke
Wo Nigahbaan Raheñ Chashm e Taman’naayi Ke
shers.english:
When The Veils Are Lifted, From His Magnificent Beauty
Totally Protected By Them, The Yearning Eyes, Will Be

shers.roman:
Dhoom Hai Farsh Se Ta ‘Arsh Teri Shaukat Ki
Khutbay Hotay Haiñ Jahaañ-Baani o Daaraayi Ke
shers.english:
From The Earth, To The ‘Arsh, Celebrated Is Your Grand Majesty
Sermons Are Being Delivered, About Your Kingship And Royalty

shers.roman:
Husn e Rangeeni o Tal’at Se Tumhaare Jalwe
Gul o Aa-ina Banay Mehfil o Zaibaayi Ke
shers.english:
By Its Amazing Vibrance And Appearance, Your Beaming Beauty
Became The Flowers And Mirrors, of The Assembly And Its Beauty

shers.roman:
Zar’ra e Dasht e Madina Ki Zia Mahr Kare
Ach’chi Saa’at Se Phireñ Din Shab e Tanhaayi Ke
shers.english:
May The Radiance From Madina’s Speck of Dust, Shine Brightly
Turning The Days of My Lonely Nights, Into Moments of Felicity

shers.roman:
Pyaar Se Le Liye Aaghosh Meiñ Sar Rahmat Ne
Paaye In’aam Tere Dar Ki Jabeeñ Saayi Ke
shers.english:
With Immense Love, My Head, Was Embraced By Your Mercy
As An Award, For Bowing My Forehead At Your Gate, Humbly

shers.roman:
Laash Ahbaab Isi Dar Par Pari Rehne Deñ
Kuch To Armaan Nikal Jaayeñ Jabeeñ Saayi Ke
shers.english:
Allow My Corpse To Remain At This Threshold, O My Family!
My Desire To Lower My Forehead, Somewhat Fulfilled Will Be

shers.roman:
Jalwagar Ho Jo Kabhi Chashm e Taman’naayi Meiñ
Parday Aankhoñ Ke Hoñ Parday Teri Zaibaayi Ke
shers.english:
If Ever, In My Yearning Eyes, Appears Your Radiant Beauty
The Veils of My Eyes, Will Become The Veils of Your Beauty

shers.roman:
Khaak e Paamaal Hamaari Bhi Pari Hai Sar e Raah
Sadqe Ay Rooh e Rawaañ Teri Maseehaayi Ke
shers.english:
Upon The Pathway, Also Lies Our Dust, Trampled Completely
O My Beloved! Upon Your Healing Power, Sacrificed May I Be

shers.roman:
Kyuñ Na Wo Toot’ay Diloñ Ke Khand’ar Aabaad Kareñ
Ke Dikhaane Haiñ Kamaal Anjuman Aaraayi Ke
shers.english:
The Ruins of Broken Hearts, Why Wouldn’t He Restore Completely
For They Will Display Their Greatness, In Adorning The Assembly

shers.roman:
Zeenatoñ Se Haiñ Haseenaan e Jahaañ Ki Zeenat
Zeenateñ Paati Haiñ Sadqe Teri Zaibaayi Ke
shers.english:
The Splendours of The World Are Adorned By Your Marvellous Beauty
Adornments Themselves, Are The Blessings of Your Radiant Beauty

shers.roman:
Naam e Aaqa Huwa Jo Lab Se Ghulaamoñ Ke Buland
Baala-Baala Gaye Gham Aafat e Balaayi Ke
shers.english:
When The Slaves’ Lips, Announced Their Master’s Name, With Sincerity
The Highest Forms of Anguish And Calamity, Were Alleviated Completely

shers.roman:
‘Arsh Pe Kaa’ba o Firdaus o Dil e Momin Meiñ
Sham’a Afroz Haiñ Ik’kay Teri Yaktaayi Ke
shers.english:
Upon The ‘Arsh, The Kaa’ba, In Heaven, And In The Believer’s Heart, Truly
The Bright Flame of The Lamp of Your Distinction, Is Glowing Radiantly

shers.roman:
Tere Muhtaaj Ne Paaya Hai Wo Shaahaana Mizaaj
Us Ki Gudri Ko Bhi Paiwand Hoñ Daraayi Ke
shers.english:
Your Mendicant Has Attained A Temperament, So Princely
Even His Tattered Mantle, Bears Patches of True Royalty

shers.roman:
Apne Zar’roñ Ke Siyaah Khaanoñ Ko Roshan Kar Do
Mahr Ho Tum Falak e Anjuman Aaraayi Ke
shers.english:
Brighten The Dark Chambers of Your Insignificant Slaves, Entirely
For You Are The Luminous Sun, of The Sky’s Galaxy of Beauty

shers.roman:
Poore Sarkaar Se Ch’hotay Bar’ay Armaan Hoñ Sab
Ay Hasan Mere, Mere Ch’hotay Bar’ay Bhaay Ke
shers.english:
Through Our Master, Fulfilled, May Our Big And Small Wishes Be
O Hasan! Mine, And My Younger And My Elder Brothers, Entirely

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: DAM E IZTIRAAB MUJH KO JO KHAYAL E YAAR AAYE

shers.roman:
Dam e Iztiraab Mujh Ko Jo Khayal e Yaar Aaye
Mere Dil Meiñ Chain Aaye To Usay Qaraar Aaye
shers.english:
When In The State of Anxiety, My Beloved I Am Remembering
When My Heart Becomes Relaxed, Then Ease, He Is Feeling

shers.roman:
Teri Wahshatoñ Se Ay Dil Mujhe Kyuñ Na Aar Aaye
Tu Unheeñ Se Door Bhaage Jinheñ Tujh Pe Pyaar Aaye
shers.english:
Due To Your Wildness, O My Heart! Ashamed Why Shouldn’t I Be Feeling?
From The Ones Who Offer You True Love, You Are Constantly Fleeing

shers.roman:
Mere Dil Ko Dard e Ulfat Wo Sukoon De Ilaahi
Meri Be Qaraariyoñ Ko Na Kabhi Qaraar Aaye
shers.english:
O Allah! Such Serenity To My Heart, May The Pain of Love, Be Giving
That The Tranquillity For This Anxiety, Never May I Be Receiving

shers.roman:
Mujhe Naz‘a Chain Bakhshe Mujhe Maut Zindagi De
Wo Agar Mere Sirhaane Dam e Ihtizaar Aaye
shers.english:
Death’s Agony Will Bring Me Peace, To Me, Life, Death Will Be Bringing
Whilst Facing The Pangs of Death, If At My Head-Side, He Is Appearing

shers.roman:
Sabab e Wufoor e Rahmat Meri Be Zabaaniyaañ Haiñ
Na Fughaañ Ke Dhang Jaanuñ Na Mujhe Pukaar Aaye
shers.english:
The Reason For This Abundant Mercy, My Speechlessness Is Being
Neither Do I Know How To Complain, Nor The Manner of Beckoning

shers.roman:
Khileñ Phool Us Phaban Ke Khuleñ Bakht Is Chaman Ke
Mere Gul Pe Sadqe Ho Kar Jo Kabhi Bahaar Aaye
shers.english:
The Flowers of Grace Will Be Blooming, The Garden’s Destiny Blossoming
If After Being Sacrificed Upon My Rose, The Spring Breeze Will Be Blowing

shers.roman:
Na Habeeb Se Muhib Ka Kaheeñ Aisa Pyaar Dekha
Wo Banay Khuda Ka Pyaara Tumheñ Jis Pe Pyaar Aaye
shers.english:
Never Have I Seen The One Who Loves, His Beloved So Deeply Loving
The Beloved of Allah He Becomes, If Your Beloved He Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Mujhe Kya Alam Ho Gham Ka Mujhe Kya Ho Gham Alam Ka
Ke Ilaaj e Gham Alam Ka Mere Gham-Gusaar Aaye
shers.english:
Over My Sorrows, Why Be Grieving, Over My Grief Why Be Mourning
When The Remedy of My Sorrows And Grief, My Consoler Is Coming

shers.roman:
Jo Ameer o Baadshaah Haiñ Isi Dar Ke Sab Gada Haiñ
Tumheeñ Shahr-Yaar Aaye Tumheeñ Taajdaar Aaye
shers.english:
Whether They Are Rulers or Kings, Beggars At This Door, They Are Being
Only You Arrived As The True Ruler, Only You Came As The True King

shers.roman:
Jo Chaman Banaaye Ban Ko Jo Jinaañ Kare Chaman Ko
Mere Baagh Meiñ Ilaahi Kabhi Wo Bahaar Aaye
shers.english:
He Who Turns Deserts Into Gardens, Into Heavens, Gardens, He Is Turning
O Allah! Someday Over My Garden, May That Spring Breeze Be Blowing

shers.roman:
Ye Kareem Haiñ Wo Sarwar Ke Likha Huwa Hai Dar Par
Jisay Lene Hoñ Do Alam Wo Um’meed-Waar Aaye
shers.english:
This Generous One, Is That Grand King, Written On His Door, It Is Being
Whoever Desires Both The Worlds, That Supplicant Should Be Coming

shers.roman:
Tere Sadqe Jaaye Shaha Ye Tera Zaleel Mangta
Tere Dar Pe Bheek Lene Sabhi Shahr-Yaar Aaye
shers.english:
Upon You, Sacrificed I Am Being! Your Lowest Mendicant, I Am Being
To Receive Your Charity At Your Threshold, All The Rulers Are Coming

shers.roman:
Chamak Ut’hay Khaak e Teera Banay Mahr Zar’ra-Zar’ra
Mere Chaand Ki Sawaari Jo Sar e Mazaar Aaye
shers.english:
Like The Sun, As My Dark Dust Glows, Every Speck Will Be Glowing
If The Conveyance of My Beloved Moon, Close To My Shrine, Is Passing

shers.roman:
Na Ruk Ay Zaleel o Ruswa Dar e Shahr-Yaar Par Aa
Ke Ye Wo Nahin Haiñ Haasha Jinheñ Tujh Se Aar Aaye
shers.english:
Delay Not, O Low And Humiliated One, Approach The Door of Your King!
For He Is Not One, To Treat You With Shame, If Him, You Are Approaching

shers.roman:
Teri Rahmatoñ Se Kam Haiñ Mere Jurm, Is Se Zaayid
Na Mujhe Hisaab Aaye Na Mujhe Shumaar Aaye
shers.english:
My Sins Are Far Less Than Your Mercy; Beyond This I Am Not Knowing
Neither Can I Present Any Statistics, Nor Submit Any Actual Counting

shers.roman:
Gul e Khuld Le Ke Zaahid Tumheñ Khaar e Taibah De Duñ?
Mere Phool Mujh Ko Dijay, Bar’ay Hoshyaar Aaye
shers.english:
O Ascetic! Gifting You Taibah’s Thorns, Heaven’s Rose Should I Be Taking?
You Are Trying To Be Very Smart; Now My Flower, Please Be Returning

shers.roman:
Banay Zar’ra-Zar’ra Gulshan To Ho Khaar-Khaar Gulbun
Jo Hamaare Ujr’ay Ban Meiñ Kabhi Wo Nigaar Aaye
shers.english:
If Each Speck Becomes A Garden, Into A Rose, Each Thorn Will Be Budding
Into Our Abandoned Forest, If Someday, The Most Beloved One Is Coming

shers.roman:
Tere Sadqe Tera Sadqa Hai Wo Shaandaar Sadqa
Wo Waqaar Le Ke Jaaye Jo Zaleel o Khwaar Aaye
shers.english:
Your Grand Blessing, Is Such A Blessing, Sacrificed Upon It, I Am Being
Whilst Acquiring Dignity, The Humiliated And Shamed, Are Returning

shers.roman:
Tere Dar Ke Haiñ Bhikaari Milay Khayr Dam Qadam Ki
Tera Naam Sun Ke Daata Ham Ummeed-waar Aaye
shers.english:
We Are Beggars At Your Door, Constantly, Your Blessings We Are Seeking
O Benefactor! Upon Hearing Your Name, Feeling Hopeful, We Are Coming

shers.roman:
Hasan Unka Naam Le Kar Tu Pukaar Dekh Gham Meiñ
Ke Ye Wo Nahin Jo Ghaafil Pas e Intizaar Aaye
shers.english:
O Hasan! With His Name, In Grief, Call Upon Him, And You Will Be Seeing
That He Is Not One Who Is Oblivious, Who Only Comes After Delaying

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: TUM HO HASRAT NIKAALNE WAALE

shers.roman:
Tum Ho Hasrat Nikaalne Waale
Na-Muraadoñ Ke Paalne Waale
shers.english:
The Fulfiller of All My Desires, You Are Being
The Nurturer of The Disenchanted, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Mere Dushman Ko Gham Ho Bigr’i Ka
Aap Haiñ Jab Sambhaalne Waale
shers.english:
Over Their Misfortunes, Let My Enemies Be Lamenting
Whilst Your Blessed Support To Me, You Are Granting

shers.roman:
Tum Se Muñh Maangi Aas Milti Hai
Awr Hotay Haiñ ‘Taalne Waale
shers.english:
From You, Whatever We Request, We Are Getting
Yet Others, Are Those, Who Are Simply Deferring

shers.roman:
Lab e Jaañ Bakhsh Se Jila Dil Ko
Jaan Murday Meiñ Daalne Waale
shers.english:
By Your Life-Giving Lips, Our Hearts, Do Be Reviving
Life Into The Dead, O You, Who Are Breathing

shers.roman:
Dast e Aqdas Bujha De Pyaas Meri
Mere Chashme Ubaalne Waale
shers.english:
O Blessed Hand! My Thirst, Do Be Quenching
O My Beloved! Who Causes Fountains To Spring

shers.roman:
Haiñ Tere Aastaañ Ke Khaak Nasheeñ
Takht Par Khaak Daalne Waale
shers.english:
On The Dust of Your Threshold, They Are Sitting
Their Thrones, Those, Who Have Been Forsaking

shers.roman:
Roz e Mahshar Bana De Baat Meri
Dhali Bigr’i Sambhaalne Waale
shers.english:
Please Resolve All My Matters, On The Day of Reckoning
My Fading And Flawed Affairs, O You, Who Are Resolving!

shers.roman:
Bheek De Bheek Apne Mangta Ko
Ay Ghareeboñ Ke Paalne Waale
shers.english:
Always To Your Mendicants, Alms Do Be Granting
The Needy Ones, O You, Who Is Always Sustaining

shers.roman:
Khatm Kar Di Hai Un Pe Mauzooni
Waah Saañche Meiñ Dhaalne Waale
shers.english:
The Most Perfect Precision, With Him, You Were Sealing
Wow! With Divine Precision, O You, Who Are Moulding

shers.roman:
Un Ka Bachpan Bhi Hai Jahaañ Parwar
Ke Wo Jab Bhi Thay Paalne Waale
shers.english:
Even In His Childhood, The World He Was Nurturing
Even Then, Towards Others, He Was Constantly Caring

shers.roman:
Paar Kar Naaw Ham Ghareeboñ Ki
Doobtoñ Ko Nikaalne Waale
shers.english:
The Ship of Us Weak Travellers, To Safety, Do Be Guiding
O Blessed Rescuer of Those, Who Are Already Drowning

shers.roman:
Khaak e Taibah Meiñ Be Nishaañ Ho Ja
Aray Aw Naam Uch’haalne Waale
shers.english:
Without Trace, With Taibah’s Dust, Do Be Mixing
O You, Who For Name And Fame, Are Always Boasting

shers.roman:
Kaam Ke Hoñ Ke Ham Nikam’may Hoñ
Wo Sabhi Ke Haiñ Paalne Waale
shers.english:
Whether Beneficial Or Useless, We Are Being
All of Us, It Is He, Who Is Constantly Nurturing

shers.roman:
Zañg Se Paak Saaf Kar Dil Ko
Andhe Sheeshe Ujaalne Waale
shers.english:
The Impurities of My Heart, Do Be Cleansing
Obscure Mirrors, O You, Who Is Brightening

shers.roman:
Khaar e Gham Ka Hasan Ko Khat’ka Hai
Dil Se Kaañt’a Nikaalne Waale
shers.english:
By The Thorn of Grief, Bothered, Hasan Is Being
The Thorn of The Heart, O You, Who Is Removing

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ALLAH, ALLAH! SHAH E KAUNAIN JALAALAT TERI

shers.roman:
Allah, Allah! Shah e Kaunain Jalaalat Teri
Farsh Kya, ‘Arsh Pe Jaari Hai Hukoomat Teri
shers.english:
Allah, Allah! O King of Both Worlds! So Grand Is Your Majesty
Not Only Upon The Earth, But, Over The Arsh Is Your Authority

shers.roman:
Jholiyaañ Khol Ke, Be Samjhe, Nahiñ Daur’ Aaye
Hameñ Ma’loom Hai Daulat Teri ‘Aadat Teri
shers.english:
Opening Our Pouches, We Did Not Simply Rush To You Aimlessly
We Know Well, About Your Treasures, And Your Habit of Generosity

shers.roman:
Tu Hee Hai Mulk e Khuda Milk e Khuda Ka Maalik
Raaj Tera Hai Zamaane Meiñ Hukoomat Teri
shers.english:
Only You, Are The Owner of The Domain And Kingdom of Allah Almighty
Over Every Period You Are Reigning, Universal Is Your Grand Authority

shers.roman:
Tere Andaaz Ye Kehte Haiñ Ke Khaaliq Ko Tere
Sab Haseenoñ Meiñ Pasand Aayi Hai Soorat Teri
shers.english:
Your Gracious Mannerism Says, That, To Your Creator Almighty
Your Countenance He Chose, Over All The Possessor’s of Beauty

shers.roman:
Us Ne Haq Dekh Liya Jis Ne Id’har Dekh Liya
Keh Rahi Hai Ye Chamakti Huwi Tal’at Teri
shers.english:
Whoever Looked This Way, Saw The Rays of The Almighty
This Is What Is Being Proclaimed, By Your Radiant Beauty

shers.roman:
Bazm e Mahshar Ka Na Kyuñ Jaaye Bulaawa Sab Ko
Ke Zamaane Ko Dikhaani Hai Wajaahat Teri
shers.english:
Why Won’t All Be Receiving The Invite, To Judgement Day’s Assembly?
For The Entire Creation, Will Be Shown, Your Magnificent Respectability

shers.roman:
‘Aalam e Rooh Pe Hai ‘Aalam e Ajsaam Ko Naaz
Chaukhtay Meiñ Hai Anaasir Ke Jo Soorat Teri
shers.english:
The Mortal World Looks Upon The Realm of The Souls, Proudly
The Essence of Your Countenance, Which Is Framed So Perfectly

shers.roman:
Jin Ke Sar Meiñ Hai Hawa Dasht e Nabi Ki Rizwaañ
Un Ke Qadmoñ Se Lagi Phirti Hai Jannat Teri
shers.english:
O Rizwaan! In Whose Head, Swirls The Desert Breeze of My Nabi
Clinging To His Feet, Your Paradise, Is Swirling Around Ecstatically

shers.roman:
Tu Wo Mahboob Hai Ay Raahat e Jaañ Dil Kaise
Haizam e Khushk Ko Tar’pa Gayi Furqat Teri
shers.english:
How Does The Heart Cope? For You Are That Beloved, O Soul’s Tranquillity
That Your Separation, Caused Even A Dry Piece of Wood, So Much Agony

shers.roman:
Mah o Khursheed Se Din Raat, Zia Paate Haiñ
Mah o Khursheed Ko Chamkaati Hai Tal’at Teri
shers.english:
From The Moon And The Sun, Day And Night, Attain Luminosity
To The Sun And The Moon, Your Countenance, Grants Luminosity

shers.roman:
Gat’h-r’iyaañ Bandh Gayeeñ Par Haath Tera Band Nahi
Bhar Gaye Dil Na Bhari Dene Se Niyyat Teri
shers.english:
Even After We Packed Up, Your Hands Did Not Cease Giving Generously
Hearts Were Content, But Unfulfilled, Was Your Intent To Give Generously

shers.roman:
Maut Aa Jaaye Magar Aaye Na Dil Ko Aaraam
Dam Nikal Jaaye Magar Niklay Na Ulfat Teri
shers.english:
Even Though, Death May Come, My Heart Will Not Attain Tranquillity
Even Though My Soul May Leave, Your True Love, Will Never Leave Me

shers.roman:
Dekhne Waale Kaha Karte Haiñ Allah! Allah!
Yaad Aata Hai Khuda Dekh Ke Soorat Teri
shers.english:
Those Who See Him, Start Proclaiming, The Name of Allah Almighty
Looking At His Countenance, Causes One To Remember The Almighty

shers.roman:
Majma’e Hashr Meiñ Ghabraayi Huwi Phirti Hai
Dhoondhne Nikli Hai Mujrim Ko Shafa’at Teri
shers.english:
Through The Crowds of Reckoning Day, It Is Rushing Around Anxiously
Seeking Out The Offenders, Your Intercession, Is Surveying Carefully

shers.roman:
Na Abhi ‘Arsa e Mahshar Na Hisaab e Ummat
Aaj Hee Se Hai Kamar Basta Himaayat Teri
shers.english:
Neither Is It Reckoning Day, Nor The Ummat’s Accountability
Yet Your Blessed Support, Is Waiting Prepared, And Fully Ready

shers.roman:
Tu Kuch Aisa Hai, Ke Mahshar Ki Musibat Waale
Dard Dukh Bhool Gaye Dekh Ke Soorat Teri
shers.english:
You Are Such, That On Judgment Day, All Those Who Are In Agony
Upon Seeing Your Sacred Face, They Forgot Their Grief And Agony

shers.roman:
‘Topiyaañ Thaam Ke Gar ‘Arsh e Bareeñ Ko Dekheñ
Oonche-Oonchoñ Ko Nazar Aaye Na Rif’at Teri
shers.english:
Whilst Holding Onto Our Hats, If We Look Towards The Highest Assembly
Even The Most Majestic Ones, Are Unable To See Your Majestic Dignity

shers.roman:
Husn Hai Jis Ka Namak Khwaar Wo ‘Aalam Tera
Jis Ko Allah Kare Pyaar Wo Soorat Teri
shers.english:
Such Is Your Beauty, That Beauty Itself, Is A Slave of Your Beauty
Your Countenance Is That, Which Is Beloved To Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
Donoñ ‘Aalam Ke Sab Armaan Nikaale Tu Ne
Nikli Is Shaan e Karam Par Bhi Na Hasrat Teri
shers.english:
All The Wishes of Both The Worlds, You Fulfilled Completely
Yet Even By Such Kindness, Unexhausted Was Your Generosity

shers.roman:
Chain Paayeñge Tar’aptay Huwe Dil Mahshar Meiñ
Gham Kisay Yaad Rahe Dekh Ke Soorat Teri
shers.english:
On Judgement Day, Agonising Hearts, Will Attain True Tranquillity
Upon Seeing Your Countenance, Who Will Remember Their Agony?

shers.roman:
Ham Ne Maana Ke Gunaahoñ Ki Nahiñ Had Lekin
Tu Hai Un Ka, To Hasan, Teri Hai Jannat Teri
shers.english:
We Acknowledge, That We Have Indeed Sinned Immeasurably
O Hasan! You Are Theirs; So, Paradise Is Yours, Most Certainly

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: BAAGH E JANNAT MEIÑ NIRAALI CHAMAN AARAAYI HAI

shers.roman:
Baagh e Jannat Meiñ Niraali Chaman Aaraayi Hai
Kya Madina Pe Fida Ho Ke Bahaar Aayi Hai
shers.english:
In Heaven’s Garden, Splendidly Adorned, Everything Is Blooming
After Having Been Sacrificed Upon Madina, Is This Breeze Returning?

shers.roman:
Un Ke Gaisoo Nahiñ Rahmat Ki Ghat’a Ch’haayi Hai
Un Ke Abru Nahiñ Do Qibloñ Ki Yak-Jaayi Hai
shers.english:
These Are Not Just His Sacred Tresses, Clouds of Mercy They Are Being
These Are Not Just His Brows, They Are Two Qiblas, As One, Assembling

shers.roman:
Sang-Rezoñ Ne Hayaat e Abadi Paayi Hai
Naakhunoñ Meiñ Tere I’jaaz e Maseehaayi Hai
shers.english:
An Everlasting Life, Even The Pebbles Were Receiving
The Power of Granting Life, Your Finger Nails Are Having

shers.roman:
Sar e Baaleeñ Unheñ Rahmat Ki Ada Laayi Hai
Haal Bigr’a Hai To Bee maar Ki Ban Aayi Hai
shers.english:
By The Special Grace of Mercy, At His Head-Side, It Was Appearing
As The Sick One Deteriorated, Upon Him, Good-Fortune Was Smiling

shers.roman:
Jaan Guftaar To Raftaar Huwi Rooh e Rawaañ
Dam Qadam Se Tere I’jaaz e Maseehaayi Hai
shers.english:
When His Words Are The Soul of Speech, The Spirit, His Motion Is Being
From Your Every Step, The Miraculous Healing Touch, Is Emanating

shers.roman:
Jis Ke Haathoñ Ke Banaaye Huwe Haiñ Husn o Jamaal
Ay Haseeñ Teri Ada Us Ko Pasand Aayi Hai
shers.english:
The One, Whose Divine Power, Created Your Splendour And Beauty
O Most Beautiful! To Him, Your Blessed Elegance, Is Most Pleasing

shers.roman:
Tere Jalwoñ Meiñ Ye ‘Aalam Hai Ke Chashm e ‘Aalam
Taab e Deedaar Nahiñ Phir Bhi Tamaashaayi Hai
shers.english:
In Your Lustres Is This World, But Such Are The Eyes of The World Being
Your True Vision It Cannot See, But As A Spectator, It Is Still Observing

shers.roman:
Jab Teri Yaad Meiñ Duniya Se Gaya Hai Koyi
Jaan Lene Ko Dulhan Ban Ke Qaza Aayi Hai
shers.english:
When In Your Love, From This World, Anyone Is Departing
To Retrieve His Soul, Adorned As A Bride, Death Is Appearing

shers.roman:
Sar Se Paa Tak Teri Soorat Pe Tasad’duq Hai Jamaal
Us Ko Mauzooni e A’zaa Ye Pasand Aayi Hai
shers.english:
Upon Your Countenance, From Head To Foot, Sacrificed, Beauty Is Being
The Amazing Perfection of Your Blessed Limbs, It Is Devotedly Admiring

shers.roman:
Tere Qadmoñ Ka Tabar’ruk Yad e Baiza e Kaleem
Tere Haathoñ Ka Diya Fazl e Maseehaayi Hai
shers.english:
By The Blessings of Your Feet, The Kaleem’s Glowing Hand, Was Glowing
Awarded By Your Sacred Hands, The Grandeur of The Messiah Is Being

shers.roman:
Dard e Dil Kis Ko Sunaawuñ Meiñ Tumhaare Hote
Bekasoñ Ki Isi Sarkaar Meiñ Sunwaayi Hai
shers.english:
In Your Presence, My Heart's Grief, With Whom Else Can I Be Sharing?
Heard Only At This Court, The Cases of The Grief-Stricken, Are Being

shers.roman:
Aap Aaye To Munawwar Huweeñ Andh’i Aankheñ
Aap Ki Khaak e Qadam Surma e Binaayi Hai
shers.english:
Upon Your Blessed Arrival, The Blind Eyes Started Seeing
The Collyrium of Vision, The Dust of Your Sacred Feet Is Being

shers.roman:
Na-Tawaani Ka Alam Ham Zu’afa Ko Kya Ho
Haath Pakr’ay Huwe Maula Ki Tawanaayi Hai
shers.english:
Over Our Weakness, Why Should Us Weak Ones Be Grieving?
When Our Weak Hands, Our Master’s Strength Is Reinforcing

shers.roman:
Jaan Di Tu Ne Maseeha o Maseehaayi Ko
Tu Hee To Jaan e Maseeha o Maseehaayi Hai
shers.english:
You Granted Life To The Messiah, And To His Power of Healing
You Are The Soul of The Messiah, You Are His Power of Healing

shers.roman:
Chashm e Be-Khwaab Ke Sadqe Meiñ Haiñ Bedaar Naseeb
Aap Jaage To Hameñ Chain Ki Neend Aayi Hai
shers.english:
Through Your Wakeful Eyes, Awakened Our Destiny Is Being
By You Remaining Awake, Peaceful Sleep, We Were Getting

shers.roman:
Baagh e Firdaus Khila Farsh Bicha Arsh Saja
Ek Tere Dam Ki Ye Sab Anjuman Aaraayi Hai
shers.english:
Heaven’s Garden Bloomed, The Stage Was Set, The ‘Arsh Was Gleaming
For Your Blessed Arrival, Decorated, This Entire Assembly Was Glowing

shers.roman:
Khet Sar Sabz Huwe Phool Khilay Meyl Dhulay
Awr Phir Fazl Ki Ghan’ghor Ghat’a Ch’haayi Hai
shers.english:
Fields Flourished, Flowers Bloomed, Washed Away, Dirt Was Being
And Thereafter, The Powerful Clouds of Mercy Started Gathering

shers.roman:
Haath Pheylaaye Huwe Daur’ Par’ay Haiñ Mangta
Mere Daata Ki Sawaari Sar e Hashr Aayi Hai
shers.english:
With Their Hands Outstretched, The Mendicants Started Running
On Reckoning’s Plain, My Benefactor’s Conveyance Was Arriving

shers.roman:
Na-Umeedo Tumheñ Muzhda Ke Khuda Ki Rahmat
Unheñ Mahshar Meiñ Tumhaare Hee Liye Laayi Hai
shers.english:
Glad-tidings To You, O Despairing Ones! For On The Day of Reckoning
Particularly For You, His Blessed Presence, Allah’s Mercy Is Bringing

shers.roman:
Farsh Se ‘Arsh Tak Ek Dhoom Hai Allah, Allah!
Awr Abhi Señkr’oñ Pardoñ Meiñ Wo Zaibaayi Hai
shers.english:
Allah! Allah! From The Earth To The Sky, His Praises Are Echoing
Yet, Still Hidden Within Hundreds of Veils, His True Beauty Is Being

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan Husn e Jahaañ-Taab Ke Sadqe Jaawuñ
Zar’re-Zar’re Se ‘Ayaañ Jalwa e Zaibaayi Hai
shers.english:
O Hasan! Be Sacrificed Upon That Beauty, Which Is World Illuminating
From Every Particle, The Traces of His Radiant Beauty Is Emanating

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HUZOOR E KAA’BA HAAZIR HAIÑ, HARAM KI KHAAK PAR SAR HAI

shers.roman:
Huzoor e Kaa’ba Haazir Haiñ, Haram Ki Khaak Par Sar Hai
Bar’i Sarkaar Meiñ Pahunche, Muqad’dar Yaawari Par Hai
shers.english:
Before The Glorious Kaa’ba, Present We Are Being
On The Haram’s Dust, Our Heads, We Are Placing

shers.roman:
The Most Majestic Court We Are Now Reaching
Truly Powerful, Our Destiny, Is Now Becoming
shers.english:
Na Ham Aane Ke Laa-iq Thay, Na Qaabil Muñh Dikhaane Ke
Magar Un Ka Karam Zar’ra Nawaaz o Banda Parwar Hai

shers.roman:
Neither Were We Worthy of Ever Coming
Nor To Show Our Faces, Are We Deserving
shers.english:
Still Us Specks, His Generosity Is Rewarding
For Indeed, The Divine Cherisher, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Khabar Kya Hai Bhikaari Kaisi, Kaisi Ne’mateñ Paayeñ
Ye Ooncha Ghar Hai Is Ki Bheek Andaaza Se Baahar Hai
shers.english:
Are The Mendicants Actually Realising,
What Great Blessings They Are Attaining?

shers.roman:
That Great And Majestic Court, This Is Being
Its Blessings, We Can Never Be Calculating

Tasad’duq Ho Rahe Haiñ Laakhoñ Banday, Gird Phir, Phir Kar
Tawaaf e Khaana e Kaa’ba, ‘Ajab Dil-Chasp Manzar Hai
shers.english:
Devoted, Millions of Servants Are Being
As They Go Around, Circumambulating

shers.roman:
As The Kaa’ba, They Are Circumambulating
Behold! It Is A Sight, Which Is Truly Amazing
shers.english:
Khuda Ki Shaan, Ye Lab Awr Bosa Sang e Aswad Ka
Hamaara Muñh Awr Is Qaabil ‘Ata e Rab’b e Akbar Ka

shers.roman:
It Is By Almighty Allah’s Grace And Divine Blessing
With These Lips, The Sang e Aswad We Are Kissing
shers.english:
The Fact, That Our Mouths Are Deemed Deserving
Is Indeed, Our Majestic Creator’s Special Blessing

shers.roman:
Jo Haybat Se Rukay Mujrim, To Rahmat Ne Kaha Bar’h Kar
Chale Aawo, Chale Aawo! Ye Ghar Rahmaan Ka Ghar Hai
shers.english:
When In Awe The Sinners Were Hesitating
Then His Divine Mercy Declared, Advancing

shers.roman:
Proceed Towards It, Continue Proceeding,
The Most Compassionates House, This Is Being
shers.english:
Maqaam e Hazrat e Khul’lat, Pidar Sa Mehrbaañ Paaya
Kaleja Se Lagaane Ko Hateem Aghosh e Maadar Hai

shers.roman:
At Hazrat Ibrahim’s Station of Blessing
The Warmth of A Father, We Were Feeling
shers.english:
When The Hateem, We Were Embracing
Like A Mother’s Embrace, It Was Feeling

shers.roman:
Lagaata Hai Ghilaaf e Paak Koyi Chasm e Pur-Nam Se
Lipat’ Kar Multazam Se, Koyi Mahw e Wasl e Dilbar Hai
shers.english:
Against His Eyes, From Which Tears Are Flowing
The Ghilaaf of The Kaa’ba, Someone Is Rubbing

shers.roman:
Totally Absorbed, In Their Creator, Someone Is Being
Whilst The Holy Multazam, Someone Is Embracing
shers.english:
Watan Awr Us Ka Tar’ka Sadqe Is Shaam e Ghareebi Par
Ke Noor e Rukn e Shaami, Roo Kash e Subh e Munawwar Hai

shers.roman:
Upon The Foreign Traveller’s Deserted Evening
Our Country And Its Morning, We Are Sacrificing
shers.english:
For, When The Rukn e Shaami Started Glowing
With The Radiant Morning, It Began Competing

shers.roman:
Huwe Imaan Taaza Bosa e Rukn e Yamaani Se
Fida Ho Jaawuñ Yumn o Aymani Ka Paak Manzar Hai
shers.english:
Completely Invigorated, Our Imaan Was Becoming
As The Sacred Rukn e Yamaani, We Were Kissing

shers.roman:
Upon The Sight of That Auspicious Blessing
Completely Sacrificed, We Were Becoming
shers.english:
Ye Zam-Zam Is Liye Hai, Jis Liye Us Ko Piyay Koyi
Isi Zam-Zam Meiñ Jannat Hai, Isi Zam-Zam Meiñ Kawthar Hai

shers.roman:
For Whatever Reason Zam-Zam, You Are Drinking
Indeed, For That Very Purpose, It Is Really Being
shers.english:
In This Very Zam-Zam, Heaven Is Being
In This Very Zam-Zam, Kawthar Is Being

shers.roman:
Shifa Kyuñkar Na Paayeñ Neem Jaañ, Zehr e Ma’aasi Se
Ke Naz’zaara Iraqi Rukn Ka Tiryaaq e Akbar Hai
shers.english:
From The Deadly Poison, Caused Due To Sinning
Cure, How Will The Dying Lover, Not Be Receiving

shers.roman:
For When At The Rukn e Iraqi, He Starts Looking
The Most Potent Antidote, He Will Be Acquiring
shers.english:
Safa e Qalb Ke Jalwe ‘Ayaañ Haiñ Sa’ee Mas’aa Se
Yahaañ Ki Be-Qaraari Bhi, Sukoon e Jaan e Muztar Hai

shers.roman:
When At Mas’aa, Sincerely, The Sa’ee We Are Performing
The Lustres of The Heart’s Purification, We Are Observing
shers.english:
For Our Anxiety, Here, Tranquillity, We Are Finding
True Comfort Here, The Restless Soul Is Receiving

shers.roman:
Huwa Hai Peer Ka Hajj, Peer Ne Jin Se Sharaf Paaya
Unheeñ Ke Fazl Se Din Jumu’ah Ka, Har Din Se Behtar Hai
shers.english:
On A Glorious Monday, Our Hajj We Were Performing
Due To Whom, Its Honour, The Monday Was Receiving

shers.roman:
It Is By His Special Grace, The Friday Is Outstanding
This Is Why, Better Than The Other Days, It Is Being
shers.english:
Nahiñ Kuch Jumu’ah Par Mauqoof, Afzaal o Karam Un Ke
Jo Wo Maqbool Farma Leñ, To Har Hajj, Hajj e Akbar Hai

shers.roman:
Not Only Limited To A Friday, Is This Blessing
So Immense, His Special Grace And Mercy Is Being
shers.english:
If By His Grace, Acceptance He Is Granting
Then The Hajj e Akbar, Every Hajj Is Being

shers.roman:
Hasan! Hajj Kar Liya, Kaa’ba Se Aankhoñ Ne Zia Paayi
Chalo Dekheñ Wo Basti Jis Ka Rasta Dil Ke Andar Hai
shers.english:
O Hasan! Your Hajj, You Have Completed Performing
Through The Holy Kaa’ba, Your Eyes Are Now Glowing

shers.roman:
Now Let’s Go And Admire, That Holy City of Blessing
The Sacred Pathway To Which, In Our Hearts Is Residing

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SAHAR CHAMKI JAMAAL E FASL E GUL ARAA-ISHOÑ PAR HAI

shers.roman:
Sahar Chamki Jamaal e Fasl e Gul Araa-ishoñ Par Hai
Naseem e Rooh Parwar Se Mashaam e Jaañ Mu’attar Hai
shers.english:
At Day-Break, Adorned Beautifully, The Spring Blossoms Are Blooming
By The Soul-Invigorating Breeze, Perfumed, The Minds Are Becoming

shers.roman:
Qareeb e Taibah Bakhshe Haiñ Tasaw’wur Ne Mazay Kya, Kya
Mera Dil Hai Madina Meiñ, Madina Dil Ke Andar Hai
shers.english:
Being So Close To Madina, Has Granted Me Such Blissful Thinking
My Heart Is Residing In Madina, In My Heart, Madina Is Residing

shers.roman:
Malaa’ik Sar Jahaañ Apna Jhijakte Darte Rakhte Haiñ
Qadam Un Ke Gunahgaaroñ Ka Aisi Sar Zameeñ Par Hai
shers.english:
Hesitantly And In Awe, Their Heads, Where The Angels Are Placing
Upon That Sacred Land, Their Feet, His Sinful Slaves, Are Placing

shers.roman:
Aray O Sonay Waale Dil! Aray O Sonay Waale Dil!
Sahar Hai, Jaag Ghaafil, Dekh Tu ‘Aalam Munawwar Hai
shers.english:
O Slumbering Heart! O My Heart, Which Is So Heedlessly Sleeping!
O Idle One! It Is Dawn, Rise And Look At The World Radiantly Glowing

shers.roman:
Suhaani Tarz Ki Tal’at, Niraali Rang Ki Nik‘hat
Naseem e Subh Se Mahaka Huwa, Pur Noor Manzar Hai
shers.english:
In A Charming Manner, It Is Rising, A Unique Fragrance Is Emanating
Perfumed By The Morning Breeze, The Entire Atmosphere Is Glowing

shers.roman:
Ta’aal-Allah Ye Shaadaabi, Ye Rangeeni Ta’aal-Allah
Bahaar e Hasht Jannat, Dasht e Taibah Par Nich’haawar Hai
shers.english:
Glory Be To Allah Almighty! Such Brilliance, With Shades, So Amazing
Sacrificed Upon Taibah’s Desert, The Seven Heaven’s Blooms, Are Being

shers.roman:
Hawa-eñ Aa Rahi Haiñ Koocha e Pur Noor e Jaanaañ Ki
Khili Jaati Haiñ Kaliyaañ, Taazgi Dil Ko Muyassar Hai
shers.english:
From The Glowing Lane of The Beloved, As The Winds Are Arriving
The Pure Buds Start Blooming, Reinvigorated, The Heart Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Munawwar Chashm e Zaa-ir Hai Jamaal e ‘Arsh e Azam Se
Nazar Meiñ Sabz Qub’ba Ki Tajal’li Jalwa Gustar Hai
shers.english:
By The Beauty of The Grand Throne, The Pilgrim’s Eyes Are Glowing
In Their Sights, The Radiance of The Holy Green Dome Is Manifesting

shers.roman:
Ye Rif’at Dargah e ‘Arsh Aastaañ Ke Qurb Se Paayi
Ke Har-Har Saañs, Har-Har Gaam Par Me’raj e Digar Hai
shers.english:
Being So Close To His Heavenly Shrine, This Nobility We Were Receiving
With Every Breath, And Every Step, Another Blessed Ascension, It Is Being

shers.roman:
Muharram Ki Naweeñ Taarikh, Baara Manzileñ Kar Ke
Wahaañ Pahunche Wo Ghar Dekha Jo Ghar Allah Ka Ghar Hai
shers.english:
On The Ninth of Muharram, After Twelve Milestones, We Were Navigating
After Reaching There, That House We Saw, Which Allah’s House Is Being

shers.roman:
Na Poocho Ham Kahaañ Pahunche Awr In Aankhoñ Ne Kya Dekha
Jahaañ Pahunche Wahaañ Pahunche, Jo Dekha Dil Ke Andar Hai
shers.english:
Do Not Ask Us Where We Reached, And What These Eyes Were Seeing
We Reached, Wherever We Reached, What We Saw, In The Heart Is Being

shers.roman:
Hazaaroñ Be-Nawaawoñ Ke Haiñ Jamghat’ Aastaana Par
Talab Dil Meiñ Sada e Ya Rasool’Allah Lab Par Hai
shers.english:
At His Grand Court, Thousands of Destitute Ones, Are Seen Flocking
With Desires In Their Hearts, Ya Rasool’Allah, Their Lips Are Chanting

shers.roman:
Likha Hai Khaama e Rahmat Ne Dar Par Khat’t e Qudrat Se
Jisay Ye Aastaana Mil Gaya, Sab Kuch Muyassar Hai
shers.english:
On His Gate, These Lines of Destiny, The Pen of Mercy, Was Inscribing
Whoever Reaches This Sacred Threshold, Everything He Is Acquiring

shers.roman:
Khuda Hai Is Ka Maalik, Ye Khudaayi Bhar Ka Maalik Hai
Khuda Hai Is Ka Maula, Ye Khudaayi Bhar Ka Sarwar Hai
shers.english:
Allah Is His Divine Sovereign, The King of The Rest of Creation, He Is Being
Allah Is His Divine Guardian, The Ruler of The Rest of Creation, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Zamaana Is Ke Qaabu Mein, Zamaane Waale Qaabu Meiñ
Ye Har Daftar Ka Haakim Hai, Ye Har Haakim Ka Afsar Hai
shers.english:
Under His Control Is The World, The World’s People, He Is Controlling
He Is The Superior of Every Office, Every Superior’s Superior, He Is Being

shers.roman:
‘Ata Ke Saath Hai Mukhtar, Rahmat Ke Khazaanoñ Ka
Khudaayi Par Hai Qaabu, Bas Khudaayi Is Se Baahar Hai
shers.english:
Over The Treasures of Mercy, The Duly Authorised One, He Is Being
Over Allah’s Kingdom He Has Power, Beyond Him, Only Divinity Is Being

shers.roman:
Karam Ke Josh Haiñ, Bazl o Ne’am Ke Daur-Daure Haiñ
‘Ata e Ba-Nawa Har Be-Nawa Se Sheer o Shak’kar Hai
shers.english:
It Is A Time of Immense Blessings, His Generosity Is Constantly Flowing
In Receiving His Blessings, United, The Endowed And The Needy Are Being

shers.roman:
Koyi Lipt’a Hai Fart e Shauq Meiñ Rozay Ki Jaali Se
Koyi Gardan Jhukaaye Ro’ab Se Ba Deeda e Tar Hai
shers.english:
In A State of Spiritual Ecstasy, To His Raudha’s Lattice, Someone Is Clinging
Whilst In A State of Awe, Someone Is Bowing His Head, With Eyes Weeping

shers.roman:
Koyi Mashghool e Arz e Haal Hai Yuñ Shaadmaañ Ho Kar
Ke Ye Sab Se Bar’i Sarkaar Hai Taqdeer Yaawar Hai
shers.english:
In Presenting His Humble Plea, Ecstatically Absorbed, Someone Is Being
For The Magnificent Court This Is Being; So Very Fortunate, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Kameena Banda e Dar ‘Arz Karta Hai Huzoori Meiñ
Jo Mauroosi Yahaañ Ka Madh Gustar Hai Sana-Gar Hai
shers.english:
In Your Noble Court, His Humble Plea, This Lowly Slave Is Presenting
I Have Inherited The Honour Here, of Truly Praising And Eulogising

shers.roman:
Teri Rahmat Ke Sadqe, Ye Teri Rahmat Ka Sadqa Tha
Ke In Na Paak Aankhoñ Ko Ye Naz’zaara Muyassar Hai
shers.english:
I Am Sacrificed Upon Your Mercy, Your Mercy’s Blessing, This Is Being
That The Honour To Perceive This Sight, These Impure Eyes Are Getting

shers.roman:
Zaleeloñ Ki To Kya Ginti, Salaateen e Zamaana Ko
Teri Sarkaar Aali Hai, Tera Darbaar Bar-tar Hai
shers.english:
Us Lowly Ones Do Not Even Count, The Kings of The Era Are Admitting
Your Grand Court Is Exalted, Incomparable, Your Holy Shrine Is Being

shers.roman:
Teri Daulat, Teri Sarwat, Teri Shaukat, Jalaalat Ka
Na Hai Koyi Zameeñ Par, Awr Na Koyi Aasmaañ Par Hai
shers.english:
To Your Wealth, Your Majesty, Your Dignity, And Splendour, Comparing
Neither Is There Anyone On The Earth, Nor Is Anyone In The Sky Existing

shers.roman:
Mataaf o Kaa’ba Ka ‘Aalam Dikhaaya Tu Ne Taibah Meiñ
Tera Ghar Beech Meiñ, Chaaroñ Taraf Allah Ka Ghar Hai
shers.english:
The Ambiance of The Mataaf And The Kaa’ba, In Taibah You Are Exhibiting
Your Holy Abode Stands In The Center, All Around It, Allah’s House Is Being

shers.roman:
Tajal’li Par Teri Sadqe Hai Mehr o Maah Ki Taabish
Pasinay Par Tere Qurbaan Rooh e Mushk o Ambar Hai
shers.english:
Sacrificed Upon Your Luminosity, The Sun And Moon’s Radiance Is Being
Sacrificed Upon Your Perspiration, The Purity of Musk And Amber Is Being

shers.roman:
Gham o Afsos Ka Daafi’ Ishaara Pyaari Aankhoñ Ka
Dil e Maayoos Ki Haami Nigaah e Banda Parwar Hai
shers.english:
By The Gesture of Your Beautiful Eyes, Dispelled Grief And Regret Is Being
Strengthening The Slave’s Dejected Heart, Is Your Holy Sight, Full of Caring

shers.roman:
Jo Sab Ach’choñ Meiñ Hai Ach’cha, Jo Har Behtar Se Behtar Hai
Tere Sadqe Se Ach’cha Hai, Tere Sadqe Meiñ Behtar Hai
shers.english:
He Who Is The Best of The Best, Better Than All Others, Who Is Being
He Is The Best By Your Blessing, He Is Better Than All, By Your Blessing

shers.roman:
Rakhuñ Maiñ Haaziri Ki Sharm In ‘Aamaal Par Kyuñkar
Mere Imkaan Se Baahar, Meri Qudrat Se Baahar Hai
shers.english:
How Can I Come Before You, When Such Shameful Deeds, I Am Having?
To Do So, Is Crossing My Limitations, Beyond My Capacity, This Is Being

shers.roman:
Agar Shaan e Karam Ko Laaj Ho Mere Bulaane Ki
To Meri Haaziri Donoñ Jahaañ Meiñ Meri Yaawar Hai
shers.english:
If You Only Consider Inviting Me, By Your Compassion And Caring
Then, As My Aid In Both The Worlds, This Presence, Will Be Serving

shers.roman:
Mujhe Kya Ho Gaya Hai, Kyuñ Maiñ Aisi Baateñ Karta Huñ
Yahaañ Bhi Yaas o Mahroomi, Ye Kyun Kar Ho, Ye Kyuñ Kar Hai
shers.english:
What Has Happened To Me, Such Words, Why Am I Even Uttering?
Even Here, Feeling Sad And Deprived, How Can It Be, How Is It Being?

shers.roman:
Bula Kar Apne Kut’tay Ko Na Deñ, Chamkaar Kar ‘Tukr’a
Phir Is Shaan e Karam Par Fahm Se Ye Baat Baahar Hai
shers.english:
To Call Your Dog, And Show It A Morsel; Then Deprive It, After Offering
As Per Your Majestic Generosity, Impossible, This Thought Is Being

shers.roman:
Tazab’zub Maghfirat Meiñ Kyuñ Rahe Is Dar Ke Zaa-ir Ko
Ke Ye Dargah e Waala, Rahmat e Khaalis Ka Manzar Hai
shers.english:
About His Forgiveness, Why Should The Pilgrim of His Court Be Doubting?
For At This Exalted Court, The Manifestation of Mercy Is Purely Reflecting

shers.roman:
Mubaarak Ho Hasan Sab Aarazu-eñ Ho Gayeeñ Poori
Ab Un Ke Sadqe Meiñ ‘Aish e Abad Tujh Ko Muyassar Hai
shers.english:
Congratulations, O Hasan! Fulfilled All Your Wishes Are Being!
Everlasting Bliss, Through His Blessings, You Are Now Receiving

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: BAHAAROÑ PAR HAIÑ AAJ AARAYISHEÑ GULZAAR E JANNAT KI

shers.roman:
Bahaaroñ Par Haiñ Aaj Aarayisheñ Gulzaar e Jannat Ki
Sawaari Aane Waali Hai Shaheedaan e Muhab’bat Ki
shers.english:
Today, Heaven’s Gardens Are Even More Luminously Blooming
The Royal Parade of The Martyrs of Love, Will Soon Be Arriving

shers.roman:
Khilay Haiñ Gul Bahaaroñ Par Hai Phulwaari Jaraahat Ki
Fiza Har Zakhm Ke Daaman Se Waabasta Hai Jannat Ki
shers.english:
The Flowers Are In Full Bloom, A Flowerbed of Wounds Is Flowing
Connected To The Heavenly Environment, Every Wound Is Being

shers.roman:
Gala Kat’wa Ke Beyr’i Kaat’ne Aaye Haiñ Ummat Ki
Koyi Taqdeer To Dekhe Aseeraan e Musibat Ki
shers.english:
To Cut The Ummat’s Chains, After Cutting Their Throats, They Are Coming
The Destiny of The Captives of Grief, Someone Should Surely Be Admiring

shers.roman:
Shaheed e Naaz Ki Tafreeh Zakhmoñ Se Nah Kyuñkar Ho
Hawaa-eñ Aati Haiñ Un Khir’kiyoñ Se Baagh e Jannat Ki
shers.english:
Through Their Wounds, Why Shouldn’t The Faithful Martyrs, Be Rejoicing?
Through Those Windows, The Sweet Breeze of Paradise Is Now Blowing

shers.roman:
Karam Waaloñ Ne Dar Khola To Rahmat Ne Samaa Baandha
Kamar Baandhi To Qismat Khol Di Fazl e Shahaadat Ki
shers.english:
When The Kind Ones Opened The Door, It’s Ambience, Mercy Was Setting
As They Stood Resolutely, The Virtue of Martyrdom, Destiny Was Opening

shers.roman:
Ali Ke Pyaare Khaatoon e Qiyaamat Ke Jigar Paare
Zameeñ Se Aasmaañ Tak Dhoom Hai In Ki Siyaadat Ki
shers.english:
The Beloved of Ali, A Portion of The Heavenly Queen’s Heart, He Is Being
From The Earth Upto The Sky, The Praises of His Pure Nobility Is Echoing

shers.roman:
Zameen e Karbala Par Aaj Majma’ Hai Haseenoñ Ka
Jami Hai Anjuman Roshan Haiñ Sham’eñ Noor o Zulmat Ki
shers.english:
Today, On Karbala’s Plains, All The Most Beautiful Ones, Are Gathering
The Assembly Is In Session, The Lamps of Light & Darkness Are Burning

shers.roman:
Ye Wo Sham’eñ Nahiñ Jo Phoonk Deñ Apne Fidaayi Ko
Ye Wo Sham’eñ Nahiñ Ro Kar Jo Kaateñ Raat Aafat Ki
shers.english:
These Are Not Those Lamps, Which Its True Lovers Are Extinguishing
These Are Not Those Lamps, Which Spend The Dark Nights Weeping

shers.roman:
Ye Wo Sham’eñ Haiñ Jin Se Jaan Taaza Paayeñ Parwaane
Ye Wo Sham’eñ Haiñ Jo Hañs Kar Guzaareñ Shab Musibat Ki
shers.english:
These Are The Lamps, By Whose Brilliance, The Lover’s Souls Are Reviving
These Are Those Lamps, Which Spend The Nights of Calamity Smiling

shers.roman:
Ye Wo Sham’eñ Nahiñ Jin Se Faqat Ik Ghar Munawwar Ho
Ye Wo Sham’eñ Haiñ Jin Se Rooh Ho Kaafoor Zulmat Ki
shers.english:
These Are Not Those Lamps, By Which Only A Single House Is Glowing
These Are Those Lamps, By Which, The Soul of Darkness Is Vanishing

shers.roman:
Dil e Hoor o Malaa’ik Rah Gaya Hayrat Zada Ho Kar
Ke Bazm e Gul-Rukhaañ Meiñ Le Balaa-eñ Kis Ki Soorat Ki
shers.english:
The Hearts of The Heavenly Maidens & Angels, Were Left In Awe, Reeling
For In The Assembly of The Beautiful, Whose Face Will They Be Admiring?

shers.roman:
Juda Hoti Haiñ Jaaneñ Jism Se Jaanaañ Se Miltay Haiñ
Huwi Hai Karbala Meiñ Garm Majlis Wasl o Furqat Ki
shers.english:
As The Souls Separate From The Body, With The Beloved They Are Meeting
In Karbala, A Fervent Assembly of Union and Separation, Was Transpiring

shers.roman:
Isi Manzar Pe Har Jaanib Se Laakhoñ Ki Nigaaheñ Haiñ
Isi ‘Aalam Ko Aankheñ Tak Rahi Haiñ Saari Khalqat Ki
shers.english:
From Every Direction, Millions of Eyes Are Now Fixed Upon This Setting
It Is This Sight, Towards Which, The Eyes of The Entire World Is Looking

shers.roman:
Huwa Chir’khaaw Paani Ki Jagah Ashk e Yateemaañ Se
Bajaaye Farsh Aankheñ Bich Gayeeñ Ahle Baseerat Ki
shers.english:
Instead of Water, The Tears of The Orphans, Were Used For Sprinkling
In Place of Rugs, Spread Out, Are The Eyes of The Men of Understanding

shers.roman:
Hawa e Yaar Ne Pankhe Banaaye Par Farishtoñ Ke
Sabeeleñ Rakh’khi Haiñ Deedar Ne Khud Apne Sharbat Ki
shers.english:
Into Fans, The Wings of The Angels, The Beloved’s Breeze Was Crafting
Fountains of Its Pure Potion, Vision Itself, Was Personally Establishing

shers.roman:
Ud’har Aflaak Se Laaye Farishtay Haar Rahmat Ke
Idhar Saaghar Liye Hooreñ Chali Aati Haiñ Jannat Ki
shers.english:
There, From The Skies, The Garlands of Mercy, The Angels Were Bringing
Here, Carrying Heavenly Goblets, The Heavenly Maidens Were Descending

shers.roman:
Sajay Haiñ Zakhm Ke Phooloñ Se Wo Rangeen Guldastay
Bahaar e Khush Numaayi Par Hai Sadqe Rooh Jannat Ki
shers.english:
Adorned With Flowers of Wounds, Those Colourful Bouquets, Were Being
Upon This Arrangement of Thriving Beauty, Its Spirit, Heaven Is Sacrificing

shers.roman:
Hawa-eñ Gulshan e Firdaus Se Bas-Bas Kar Aati Haiñ
Niraali ‘Itr Meiñ Doobi Huwi Hai Rooh Nik’hat Ki
shers.english:
After Soaking In The Gardens of Paradise, The Winds Were Now Arriving
In A Uniquely Rare Fragrance, The Soul of Fragrance Itself Is Submerging

shers.roman:
Dil e Pur Soz Ke Sulgay Agar Soz Aisi Kasrat Se
Ke Pahunchi ‘Arsh o Taiba Tak Lipat’ Soz e Muhab’bat Ki
shers.english:
If An Elegy Is Kindled With Richness, From That Heart, Which Is Burning
Right Upto The Arsh And Taibah, Its Fragrant Flame of Love Is Reaching

shers.roman:
Ud’har Chilman Ut’hi Husn e Azal Ke Paak Jalwoñ Se
Id’har Chamki Tajal’li Badr e Taabaan e Risaalat Ki
shers.english:
From The Lustres of Pure Eternal Beauty, There, The Veils Were Lifting
Here, From Risaalat’s Bright Moon, The Manifestations Were Reflecting

shers.roman:
Zameen e Karbala Par Aaj Aisa Hashr Barpa Hai
Ke Khiñch-Khiñch Kar Mit’i Jaati Haiñ Tasweereñ Qiyaamat Ki
shers.english:
Today On Karbala’s Plains, A Reckoning Day Like Situation Is Developing
After Being Illustrated; Erased, The Depictions of The Last Day Are Being

shers.roman:
Ghata-eñ Mustafa Ke Chaand Par Ghir-Ghir Kar Aati Haiñ
Siya-Kaaraan e Ummat Teera Bakhtaan e Shaqaawat Ki
shers.english:
Over The Moon of Mustafa, The Dark Clouds Are Now Swiftly Gathering
By The Sins of The Ill-Fated Ones of The Ummah, Obscured They Are Being

shers.roman:
Ye Kis Ke Khoon Ke Pyaase Haiñ Us Ke Khoon Ke Pyaase
Buj’hegi Pyaas Jis Se Tishna Kaamaan e Qiyaamat Ki
shers.english:
Whose Blood Are They Thirsty For? For His Blood, Thirsty They Are Being
By Whom The Thirsty’s Thirst, Will Be Satiated On The Day of Reckoning

shers.roman:
Akele Par Hazaaroñ Ke Hazaaroñ Waar Chalte Haiñ
Mit’a Di Deen Ke Hamraah Iz’zat Sharm o Ghairat Ki
shers.english:
Upon The Unaided One, Thousands of Strikes Are Now Raining
With Their Deen; Honour, Shame And Modesty They Were Erasing

shers.roman:
Magar Sher e Khuda Ka Sher Jab Biphra Ghazab Aaya
Paray Toot’ay Nazar Aane Lagi Soorat Hazeemat Ki
shers.english:
But When The Lion of ‘The Lion of Allah’, Came Out Furiously Charging
Scattered, In A Shattered State, Oppression Could Be Seen Agonising

shers.roman:
Kaha Ye Bosa De Kar Haath Par Josh e Dileeri Ne
Bahadur Aaj Se Khaayeñge Qasmeñ Is Shuja’at Ki
shers.english:
After Kissing Him On His Hand, To Him, The Fervour of Valour Was Saying
From Today, The Oath of This Gallantry, The Brave Ones Will Be Swearing

shers.roman:
Tasad’duq Ho Gayi Jaan e Shuja’at Sach’che Tewar Ke
Fida Sheraana Hamloñ Ki Ada Par Rooh Jur’at Ki
shers.english:
Sacrificed Upon This True Manner, The Spirit of Bravery Was Being
Upon The Style of His Lion-Like Attacks, Its Spirit, Valour Was Sacrificing

shers.roman:
Na Hote Gar Husain Ibn e Ali Is Pyaas Ke Bhookay
Nikal Aati Zameen e Karbala Se Nahr Jannat Ki
shers.english:
For This Thirst of Martyrdom, If Husain Ibn e Ali Was Not Yearning
From The Plains of Karbala, The River of Jannat Would Be Bursting

shers.roman:
Magar Maqsood Tha Pyaasa Gala Hee Un Ko Kat’waana
Ke Khwaahish Pyaas Se Bar’hti Rahe Rooyat Ke Sharbat Ki
shers.english:
But, To Have His Throat Severed, While Thirsty, Was His Real Yearning
So, His Desire To Sip The Potion of His Creator’s Vision, May Be Increasing

shers.roman:
Shaheed e Naaz Rakh Deta Hai Gardan Aab e Khanjar Par
Jo Mawjeñ Baar’h Par Aa Jaati Haiñ Darya e Ulfat Ki
shers.english:
On The Blade of The Dagger, His Head, The Martyr of Love Is Placing
When Over The Edge, The Waves of The Ocean of Love, Starts Rising

shers.roman:
Ye Waqt e Zakhm Nikla Khoon Uch’hal Kar Jism e At’har Se
Ke Roshan Ho Gayi Mash’al Shabistaan e Muhab’bat Ki
shers.english:
As He Was Wounded, From His Pure Body, The Blood Flowed Out, Gushing
For The Lamp of The Pure Chamber of Love, Was Now Radiantly Glowing

shers.roman:
Sar e Be-Tan, Tan e Aasaani Ko Shahr e Taiba Meiñ Pahuncha
Tan e Be Sar Ko Sardaari Mili Mulk e Shahaadat Ki
shers.english:
To The City of Madina, Painlessly, The Bodiless Head Was Easily Reaching
Kingship In The Domain of Martyrdom, The Bodiless Head, Was Receiving

shers.roman:
Hasan Sunni Hai Phir Ifraat o Tafreet Is Se Kyuñkar Ho
Adab Ke Saath Rehti Hai Rawish Arbaab e Sunnat Ki
shers.english:
Hasan Is A Sunni, So Biased Extremes, How Will He Be Adopting?
The Way of The Followers of The Sunnah, Is Respectfully Prevailing

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: NAJDIYA SAKHT HEE GANDEE HAI TABI’AT TERI

shers.roman:
Najdiya Sakht Hee Gandee Hai Tabi’at Teri
Kufr Kya Shirk Ka Fuzla Hai Najaasat Teri
shers.english:
O Najdi! Indeed, Extremely Filthy, Your Demeanour Is Being
The Filth of Disbelief And Polytheism, Your Impurity Is Being

shers.roman:
Khaak Muñh Meiñ Tere Kehta Hai Kisay Khaak Ka Dheyr
Mit’t Gaya Deen Mili Khaak Meiñ Izzat Teri
shers.english:
Dust In Your Face! A Heap of Dust Whom Are You Calling?
Your Faith Is Ruined, Mixed In Dust, Your Integrity Is Being

shers.roman:
Tere Nazdeek Huwa Kizb e Ilaahi Mumkin
Tujh Pe Shaitaan Ki Phit’kaar Ye Him’mat Teri
shers.english:
According To You, For Allah To ‘Lie’, Possible, It Is Being
Shaitaan’s Curse Upon You, Such Audacity You Are Having!

shers.roman:
Balke Kaz’zaab Kiya Tu Ne To Iqraar e Wuqu’
Uf Re Na-Paak Yahaañ Tak Hai Khabaasat Teri
shers.english:
In Fact, O Liar! To The Occurrence of Lies, You Are Admitting
Alas! O Impure One! So Disgusting Your Evil Ways Are Being!

shers.roman:
Ilm e Shaitaañ Ka Huwa Ilm e Nabi Se Zaayid
Par’huñ Laa Hawl Na Kyuñ Dekh Ke Soorat Teri
shers.english:
Exceeding The Nabi’s Knowledge, The Devil’s Knowledge, You Are Viewing
Why Then Should I Not Recite ‘Laa Hawl’, When Your Face, I Am Seeing?

shers.roman:
Bazm e Meelad Ho ‘Kaana’ Ke Janam Se Bad-tar
Aray Andhe Aray Mardood Ye Jur-at Teri
shers.english:
Worse Than The Birth of ‘Kaana’, You Regard The Meelad Gathering!
O Blind One! O Condemned One! Such, Is Your Impudence Really Being

shers.roman:
Ilm e Ghaibi Meiñ Majaaneen o Bahaa-im Ka Shumool
Kufr Aamez Junooñ Zaa Hai Jihaalat Teri
shers.english:
In Unseen Knowledge, The Insane Ones And Beasts, You Are Including
Your Ignorance Is Infused In Unbelief, Such Insanity, It Is Inducing

shers.roman:
Yaad e Khar Se Ho Namaazoñ Meiñ Khayaal Un Ka Bura
Uf Jahannam Ke Gadhe Uf Ye Khuraafat Teri
shers.english:
To Think of Him In Namaaz, Worse Than Thinking of An Ass, You Are Saying
Oh, Donkey of Hell-Fire! Oh, So Appalling Your Preposterousness, Is Being

shers.roman:
Un Ki Ta’zeem Karega Na Agar Waqt e Namaaz
Maari Jaayegi Tere Muñh Pe Ibaadat Teri
shers.english:
If You Do Not Truly Honour Him, Whilst Namaaz, You Are Praying
Completely Rejected, Will Be, All The Worship You Are Performing

shers.roman:
Hai Kabhi Boom Ki Hil’lat To Kabhi Zaagh Halaal
Jeefa Khwaari Ki Kahiñ Jaati Hai ‘Aadat Teri
shers.english:
At Times The Owl Is Lawful, At Times, Halaal, The Crow Is Being
Is Your Filthy Routine of Consuming The Carrion, Never Ending?

shers.roman:
Hans Ki Chaal To Kya Aati, Gayi Apni Bhi
Ijtihaadoñ Hee Se Zaahir Hai Himaaqat Teri
shers.english:
You Couldn’t Even Imitate A Swan’s Walk, Even Your Own, You Are Losing
Your Foolishness Is Now Apparent, From Your (So-Called) Own Reasoning

shers.roman:
Khulay Lafzoñ Meiñ Kahe Qazi e Shawkaañ Madad De
Ya Ali Sun Ke Bigar’ Jaaye Tabi’at Teri
shers.english:
Openly, From Qazi Shawkaani, His Assistance, You Are Seeking
Yet, You Become Totally Troubled, When ‘Ya Ali’ You Are Hearing

shers.roman:
Teri At’ke To Wakeeloñ Se Kare Istimdaad
Awr Tabeeboñ Se Madad Khwaah Ho ‘Il-lat Teri
shers.english:
When You Are In Trouble, Then For Help, To Lawyers, You Are Turning
And When You Are Ill, Then From Doctors, Their Help, You Are Seeking

shers.roman:
Ham Jo Allah Ke Pyaaroñ Se I’aanat Chaaheñ
Shirk Ka Chirk Ugalne Lagay Millat Teri
shers.english:
From The Beloveds of Allah, When Their Special Aid, We Are Seeking
The Filthy Accusations of Polytheism, Your Community Is Spewing

shers.roman:
Abd e Wah’haab Ka Beta Huwa Shaikh e Najdi
Us Ki Taqleed Se Saabit Hai Zalaalat Teri
shers.english:
The Shaikh of Najd, The Son of Abdul Wah’haab Was Becoming
By Following Him, Clearly Proven, Your Misguidance Is Being

shers.roman:
Usi Mushrik Ki Hai Tasneef ‘Kitaab-ut Tauheed’
Jis Ke Har Fiqra Pe Hai Mohr e Sadaaqat Teri
shers.english:
The Book Kitaab-ut Tauheed, That Same Polytheist, Was Authoring
Yet Upon Its Every Statement, Your Seal of Approval, You Are Placing

shers.roman:
Tarjama Is Ka Huwa ‘Tafwiyat ul Imaañ’ Naam
Jis Se Be Noor Huwi Chashm e Baseerat Teri
shers.english:
The Translation of The Kitaab-ut Tauheed, Tafwiyat ul Imaan Is Being
Through Which Your Mental Perception, Entirely Blinded, Was Becoming

shers.roman:
Waaqif e Ghaib Ka Irshaad Sunaawuñ Jis Ne
Khol Di Tujh Se Bahut Pehle Haqeeqat Teri
shers.english:
The Words of The Knower of Unseen, To You, Should I Be Narrating,
Long Before You, The Reality About You, He Was Clearly Exposing

shers.roman:
Zalzalay Najd Meiñ Paida Hoñ Fitne Barpa Hoñ
Yaa’ni Zaahir Ho Zamaane Meiñ Sharaarat Teri
shers.english:
Earthquakes Will Flare up In Najd, Mischief Will Start Spreading
In Other Words, In This Era, Your Maliciousness, Will Be Opening

shers.roman:
Ho Isi Khaak Se Shaitaan Ki Sangat Paida
Dekh Le Aaj Hai Maujood Jamaat Teri
shers.english:
From This Very Land of Najd, The Comrades of The Devil, Will Be Rising
Observe And You Will Notice, That Present There, Your Sect Is Being

shers.roman:
Sar Mund’ay Hoñge To Paa-Jaame Ghut’ne Hoñge
Sar Se Paa Tak Yahi Poori Hai Shabaahat Teri
shers.english:
Having Shaven Heads, Their Pants, Upto Their Knees, They Will Be Wearing
Indeed, From Head To Foot, Your Unmistakable Description, This Is Being

shers.roman:
Id-da’a Hoga Hadithoñ Pe Amal Karne Ka
Naam Rakhti Hai Yahi Apna Jama’at Teri
shers.english:
To Be Acting In Accordance With The Hadith, They Will Be Claiming
This Is The Name By Which Your Sect, To Themselves, Are Referring

shers.roman:
Un Ke A’maal Pe Rashk Aaye Musalmaanoñ Ko
Is Se To Shaad Huwi Hogi Tabi’at Teri
shers.english:
At Times, Their Actions, The Muslims Will Be Envying And Admiring
To Your Disposition, Some Form of Delight, This Is Probably Bringing

shers.roman:
Lekin Utrega Na Qur’aañ Galoñ Se Neeche
Abhi Ghabra Nahiñ, Baaqi Hai Hikaayat Teri
shers.english:
However, Beyond Their Throats, The Qur’an Will Not Be Passing
Do Not Stress! All Your Stories, I Haven’t Yet Finished Exposing

shers.roman:
Nikleñge Deen Se Yuñ Jaise Nishaana Se Teer
Aaj Is Teer Ki Nakh-Cheer Hai Sangat Teri
shers.english:
They Will Leave The Deen, Like Through Game, An Arrow Is Passing
Today, The Prey Targeted By This Arrow, Your Comrades Are Being

shers.roman:
Apni Haalat Ko Hadithoñ Se Mutaabiq Kar Le
Aap Khul Jaayegi Phir Tujh Pe Khabaasat Teri
shers.english:
In Accordance With The Ahadith, Your Condition, Do Be Aligning
Then Exposed Upon You, Your Own Impudence, You Will Be Seeing

shers.roman:
Ch’hor’ Kar Zikr Tera Ab Hai Khitaab Apnoñ Se
Ke Hai Mabghooz Mujhe Dil Se Hikaayat Teri
shers.english:
Leaving Aside Your Allusion, My Own, I Am Now Addressing
For To Narrate Your Accounts, From My Heart, I Am Detesting

shers.roman:
Mere Pyaare Mere Apne Mere Sunni Bhai
Aaj Karni Hai Mujhe Tujh Se Shikaayat Teri
shers.english:
My Beloveds, My Own, My Sunni Brothers, Those Who Are Being
Regarding You, To You, Today, I Really Wish To Be Complaining

shers.roman:
Tujh Se Jo Kehta Huñ Tu Dil Se Sun Insaaf Bhi Kar
Kare Allah Ki Taufiq Himaayat Teri
shers.english:
From My Heart, To You, Honestly Listen To What I Am Saying
May The Divine Guidance of Allah, Support You In Everything

shers.roman:
Gar Tere Baap Ko Gaali De Koyi Be Tahzeeb
Ghussa Aaye Abhi Kuch Awr Ho Haalat Teri
shers.english:
If At Your Noble Father, Some Uncivilised Person, Is Openly Swearing
You Will Instantly Become Furious, Your Temperament Will Be Changing

shers.roman:
Gaaliyaañ Deñ Unheñ Shaitaan e La’een Ke Payru
Jin Ke Sadqe Meiñ Hai Har Daulat o Ne’mat Teri
shers.english:
Against Him, The Followers of Shaitaan The Accursed, Are Blaspheming
Through The Blessings of Whom, Your Wealth And Bounties, Are Flowing

shers.roman:
Jo Tujhe Pyaar Kareñ Jo Tujhe Apna Farmaayeñ
Jin Ke Dil Ko Kare Be-Chain Aziy’yat Teri
shers.english:
He Is The One, Who Truly Loves You; As His Own, To You, He Is Referring
He Is The One, Whose Heart Becomes Restless, Because of Your Suffering

shers.roman:
Jo Tere Waaste Takleefeñ Ut’haayeñ Kya-Kya
Apne Aaraam Se Pyaari Jinheñ Raahat Teri
shers.english:
For Your Sake, So Many Hardships, He Has Been Constantly Enduring
More Precious Than His Own Rest, Your Comfort, To Him, Is Being

shers.roman:
Jaag Kar Raateñ ‘Ibaadat Meiñ Jinhoñ Ne Kaat’eeñ
Kis Liye, Is Liye Kat’ Jaaye Musibat Teri
shers.english:
He Is The One Who Stayed Awake, Spending Entire Nights, Praying
Why Did He Do This, It Was To Alleviate, The Trials You Were Facing

shers.roman:

To Be Greater Than Him, Your Noble Father, Are You Regarding
