shers.english:
O My Soul’s Desire, Turn Not, The Face of Your Mercy, Away From Me
Through The Honour of The Nabi’s Soul, Cast A Single Glance Upon Me

shers.roman:
Haiñ Kamar-Basta ‘Adaawat Par Bahut Ahl e Zaman
Aik Jaan e Naa-Tuwaañ, Laakhoñ Alam, Laakhoñ Mehan
shers.english:
Sun Le Faryaad e Hasan Farma De Imdaad e Hasan
Subh e Mahshar Tak Rahe Aabaad Teri Anjuman

shers.roman:
Roo e Rahmat Bar Mataab Ay Kaam e Jaañ Az Roo e Man
Hurmat e Rooh e Payambar Yak Nazar Kun Soo e Man

Many of The World’s People, Are Standing Firmly, In Their Enmity
A Single Weak Soul, Is Facing Countless Trials of Pain And Misery
shers.english:
Please Listen To Hasan’s Plea! To Hasan, Grant Your Aid Instantly!
Until Reckoning Day, May Your Sacred Assembly Flourish Constantly

shers.roman:
O My Soul’s Desire, Turn Not, The Face of Your Mercy, Away From Me
Through The Honour of The Nabi’s Soul, Cast A Single Glance Upon Me
shers.english:
Hai Tere Altaaf Ka Charcha Jahaañ Meiñ Chaar Soo
Shohra e Aafaaq Haiñ Ye Khaslateñ Ye Neyk Khoo

shers.roman:
Hai Gada Ka Haal Tujh Par Aashkaara Moo Ba-Moo
Aaj Kal Gheyray Huwe Haiñ Chaar Jaanib Se ‘Adoo
shers.english:
Roo e Rahmat Bar Mataab Ay Kaam e Jaañ Az Roo e Man
Hurmat e Rooh e Payambar Yak Nazar Kun Soo e Man

shers.roman:
Resonating In All Directions, Is The Illustriousness of Your Generosity
Renowned In The Universe, Are Your Traits, And Your Nature of Nobility
shers.english:
The Condition of This Mendicant’s Every Hair, Is Manifest To You, Entirely
Nowadays, From All Four Directions, The Enemies Have Surrounded Me

shers.roman:
O My Soul’s Desire, Turn Not, The Face of Your Mercy, Away From Me
Through The Honour of The Nabi’s Soul, Cast A Single Glance Upon Me
shers.english:
Shaam Hai Nazdeek, Manzil Door Maiñ, Gum-Karda Raah
Har Qadam Par Par’hte Haiñ Is Dasht Meiñ Khas-Posh Jaah

shers.roman:
Koyi Saathi Hai Na Rahbar Jis Se Haasil Ho Panaah
Ashk Aankhon Meiñ, Qalaq Dil Meiñ, Laboñ Par Aah-Aah
shers.english:
Roo e Rahmat Bar Mataab Ay Kaam e Jaañ Az Roo e Man
Hurmat e Rooh e Payambar Yak Nazar Kun Soo e Man

shers.roman:
The Evening Is Near, The Destination Is Far, I Have Lost My Way Clearly
At Every Step In This Wilderness, Some Concealed Places, I Can See
shers.english:
No Companion Or Guide I Am Having, From Whom I May Seek Safety
With Teary Eyes, And An Anxious Heart, My Lips Are Echoing My Agony

shers.roman:
O My Soul’s Desire, Turn Not, The Face of Your Mercy, Away From Me
Through The Honour of The Nabi’s Soul, Cast A Single Glance Upon Me

Taaj Waaloñ Ko Mubaarak, Taaj e Zar, Takht e Shahi
Baadshaah Laakhoñ Huwe, Kis Par Phali, Kis Ki Rahi
shers.english:
Maiñ Gada Thaharuñ Tera Meri Isi Meiñ Hai Bahi
Zil’l e Daaman, Khaak e Dar, Daiheem o Afsar Hai Yahi

shers.roman:
Roo e Rahmat Bar Mataab Ay Kaam e Jaañ Az Roo e Man
Hurmat e Rooh e Payambar Yak Nazar Kun Soo e Man
shers.english:
To The Kings, All The Best, Upon Your Golden Crowns & Thrones of Royalty
Countless Kings Came, Who Thrived; But Whose Reign Stayed Ultimately?

shers.roman:
May I Always Remain Your True Mendicant, In This, Is My Real Prosperity
Your Mantle’s Shade And Your Court’s Dust, Are My Crown And Nobility
shers.english:
O My Soul’s Desire, Turn Not, The Face of Your Mercy, Away From Me
Through The Honour of The Nabi’s Soul, Cast A Single Glance Upon Me

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HUWA HUÑ DAAD E SITAM KO MAIÑ HAAZIR E DARBAAR MANQABAT HAZRAT SHAH BADI’UD’DEEN MADAAR Ȇننہ ال رǷض ی

shers.roman:
Huwa Huñ Daad e Sitam Ko Maiñ Haazir e Darbaar
Gawah Haiñ Dil e Mahzoon o Chashm e Darya Baar
shers.english:
Tarah-Tarah Se Sataata Hai Zumra e Ashraar
Badi’ Bahr e Khuda Hurmat e Shah e Abraar

shers.roman:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Ze-Man Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar
shers.english:
I Have Presented Myself At Your Court, Seeking Justice Against Tyranny
My Grieving Heart And Weeping Eyes, Have Come As Witnesses For Me

shers.roman:
In Numerous Ways, I Am Being Tormented, By The Seditious Assembly
For Allah’s Sake, And The Honour of The Leader of The Pious, O Badi’
shers.english:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity

shers.roman:
Ud’har Aqaarib ‘Aqaarib ‘Adu Ajaanib Khesh
Id’har Huñ Josh e Ma’aasi Ke Haath Se Dil Resh
shers.english:
Bayaan Kis Se Karuñ Haiñ Jo Aafateñ Dar Pesh
Phañsa Hai Sakht Balaawoñ Meiñ Ye Aqeedat Kesh

shers.roman:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Zaman Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar
shers.english:
On That Side, Relatives Are Like Scorpions, Enemies, Strangers And Family
On This Side, Due To The Surge of My Sins, My Heart Is Wounded Severely

shers.roman:
To Whom Can I Truly Explain, The Miseries, Which I Am Facing Currently
Entrapped In A State of Disastrous Misfortunes, Is This Humble Devotee
shers.english:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity

shers.roman:
Na Huñ Maiñ Taalib e Afsar Na Saa-il e Daiheem
Ke Sang Manzil e Maqsad, Hai Khwaahish e Zar o Seem
shers.english:
Kiya Hai Tum Ko Khuda Ne Kareem Ibn e Kareem
Faqat Yahi Hai Shaha Aarzoo e ‘Abd e Aseem

shers.roman:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Zaman Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar
shers.english:
Neither Am I Seeking Authority, Nor Crowns Do I Pursue In Reality
For Desiring Gold And Silver, A Rock, On The Path of Resolve, Will Be

shers.roman:
The Generous, The Son of The Generous, You Were Made By The Almighty
O My King, In Reality, This Is The Only Wish of Your Sinful Devotee
shers.english:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity

shers.roman:
Huwa Hai Khanjar e Afkaar Se Jigar Ghaa-il
Nafas-Nafas Hai ‘Ayaañ Dam Shumaari e Bismil
shers.english:
Mujhe Ho Marhamat Ab Daaru e Jaraahat e Dil
Na Khaali Haath Phiray Aastaañ Se Ye Saa-il

shers.roman:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Zaman Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar
shers.english:
By The Dagger of Apprehensions, My Heart, Has Been Wounded Severely
With Every Breath Is Observable, The Slaughtered One’s Breaths of Agony

shers.roman:
For My Wounded Heart, May I Now Be Granted, The Drink of Remedy
From Your Holy Court, May Your Mendicant Not Return Entirely Empty
shers.english:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity

shers.roman:
Tumhaare Wasf o Thana Kis Tarah Se Hoñ Marqoom
Ke Shaan e ‘Arfa o A’laa Kisay Nahiñ Ma’loom
shers.english:
Hai Zer e Taygh e Alam Mujh Ghareeb Ka Hulqoom
Huwi Hai Dil Ki Taraf Yurish e Sipaah e Humoom

shers.roman:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Zaman Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar

How Can We Ever Write Down, Your Every Praiseworthy Quality?
For Who Knows Not, Your Rank of Excellence And Superiority?
shers.english:
The Throat of This Mendicant, Is Underneath The Sword of Agony
Directed Towards My Heart, Is The Offensive of Sorrow’s Army

shers.roman:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity
shers.english:
Huwa Hai Banda Giriftaar Panja e Say’yaad
Haiñ Har Ghar’i Sitam Ijaad Se Sitam Ijaad

shers.roman:
Huzoor Par’ti Hai Har Roz Ik Nayi Uftaad
Tumhaare Dar Pe Maiñ Laaya Huñ Jaur Ki Faryaad
shers.english:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Zaman Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar

shers.roman:
In The Trap of The Hunter, Ensnared Is Your Humble Devotee
In Every Moment The Tyrant, Devises A New Form of Tyranny
shers.english:
On A Regular Basis, I Am Faced, By A New Form of Calamity
At Your Threshold, I Have Brought My Plea, Against Calamity

shers.roman:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity
shers.english:
Tamaam Zar’roñ Pe Kash-Shams Haiñ Ye Jood o Nawaal
Faqeer Khasta Jigar Ka Bhi Rad’d Na Kijay Sawaal

shers.roman:
Hasan Huñ Naam Ko Par Huñ Maiñ Sakht Bad-Af’aal
‘Ataa Ho Mujh Ko Bhi Ay Shaah e Jins Husn e Ma-aal
shers.english:
Madaar Chashm e ‘Inaayat Zaman Dareegh Madaar
Nigaah e Lutf o Karam Az Hasan Dareegh Madaar

shers.roman:
Upon All The Specks, Like The Sun, Shines Your Kindness And Generosity
Therefore, Do Not Reject, The Broken-Hearted Mendicant’s Sincere Plea
shers.english:
Even Though My Name Is Hasan, My Deeds Are Extremely Unworthy
Grant Me A Beautiful End As Well, O Blessed King of This Assembly

shers.roman:
Please Do Not Turn Your Generous Gaze Away From My State of Agony
Please Do Not Deny Hasan, Your Blessed Sight of Kindness And Generosity

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: AS SALAAM AY KHUSRU E DUNYA O DEEÑ

shers.roman:
As Salaam Ay Khusru e Dunya o Deeñ
As Salaam Ay Raahat e Jaan e Hazeeñ
shers.english:
O King of The World And This Deen, Salaam Upon You
O Comfort To The Distressed Hearts, Salaam Upon You

shers.roman:
As Salaam Ay Baadshaah e Do Jahaañ
As Salaam Ay Sarwar e Kaun o Makaañ
shers.english:
O Grand King of Both The Worlds, Salaam Upon You
O King of The Universe And Beyond, Salaam Upon You

shers.roman:
As Salaam Ay Noor e Imaañ As Salaam
As Salaam Ay Raahat e Jaañ As Salaam
shers.english:
Salaam Upon You, O Radiant Light of Imaan, Salaam Upon You
Salaam Upon You, O Tranquillity of The Heart, Salaam Upon You

shers.roman:
Ay Shakeb e Jaan e Muztar As Salaam
Aftaab e Zar’ra Parwar As Salaam
shers.english:
O Pure Patience of The Restless Heart, Salaam Upon You
O Sun, Which Brightens The Particles, Salaam Upon You

shers.roman:
Dard o Gham Ke Chaara Farma As Salaam
Dard Mandoñ Ke Maseeha As Salaam
shers.english:
O You Who Provides Solutions, Salaam Upon You
O Messiah of The Aggrieved Ones, Salaam Upon You

shers.roman:
Ay Muraadeñ Dene Waale As Salaam
Donoñ ‘Aalam Ke Ujaale As Salaam
shers.english:
O You Who Grants Our Wishes, Salaam Upon You
The Radiance of Both The Worlds, Salaam Upon You

shers.roman:
Dard o Gham Meiñ Mubtala Hai Ye Ghareeb
Dam Chala Teri Duhaayi Ay Tabeeb
shers.english:
Afflicted By Agony And Grief, This Mendicant Is Being
O My Physician, Help Me, For Rapid Is My Breathing

shers.roman:
Nabzeñ Saaqit Rooh Muztar Ji Nid’haal
Dard e ‘Isyaañ Se Huwa Hai Ghayr Haal
shers.english:
Pulses Are Dropping, The Soul Is Restless, Weary My Heart Is Being
Due To The Agony of My Sins, Unbearable My Condition Is Becoming

shers.roman:
Be-Sahaaroñ Ke Sahaara Haiñ Huzoor
Haami o Yaawar Hamaare Haiñ Huzoor
shers.english:
The Support of The Troubled, My Beloved Nabi Is Being
Our Assurance And True Aid, Our Beloved Nabi Is Being

shers.roman:
Ham Ghareeboñ Par Karam Farmaaiye
Bad-Naseeboñ Par Karam Farmaaiye
shers.english:
Upon Us Weak Mendicants, Mercy, Do Be Having
Upon Us Unfortunate Ones, Mercy, Do Be Having

shers.roman:
Be-Qaraaroñ Ke Sirhaane Aaiye
Dil Figaaroñ Ke Sirhaane Aaiye
shers.english:
At The Head-Side of The Restless Ones, Do Be Appearing
At The Head-Side of The Heartbroken, Do Be Appearing

shers.roman:
Jaañ Ba-Lab Ki Chaara Farmaayi Karo
Jaan e ‘Esa Ho Maseehaayi Karo
shers.english:
Please Present A Solution, For The One Who Is Now Dying
You Are The Soul of Esa, Please Use Your Power of Healing

shers.roman:
Shaam Hai Nazdeek, Manzil Door Hai
Paawuñ Kaise Jaan Tak Ranjoor Hai
shers.english:
The Evening Is Near, But Distant, My Destination Is Being
How Will I Ever Reach It, When Even My Soul Is Suffering

shers.roman:
Maghribi Goshoñ Meiñ Phoot’i Hai Shafaq
Zardi e Khursheed Se Hai Rang Faq
shers.english:
From The Eastern Horizons, Twilight Is Now Appearing
By The Yellowness of The Sun, Pale, It’s Shades Are Being

shers.roman:
Raah Na Ma’loom, Sahra Pur Khatar
Koyi Saathi Hai Na Koyi Raahbar
shers.english:
The Path Is Unknown, Dangerous The Desert Is Being
Neither Any Companion, Nor Any Guide, Am I Having

shers.roman:
Taairoñ Ne Bhi Basera Le Liya
Khwaahish e Parwaaz Ko Rukhsat Kiya
shers.english:
Even The Birds Have Perched, For Their Nightly Lodging
Their Desire To Fly, They Are Completely Abandoning

shers.roman:
Har Taraf Karta Huñ Hayrat Se Nigaah
Par Nahiñ Milti Kisi Soorat Se Raah
shers.english:
In Every Direction, I Am Frantically Searching
But The Pathway, I Am Unable To Be Locating

shers.roman:
Sau Balaa-eñ Chashm e Tar Ke Saamne
Yaas Ki Soorat Nazar Ke Saamne
shers.english:
Before My Moist Eyes, Hundreds of Calamities Are Appearing
A State of Dejection, Before My Eyes, I Am Now Witnessing

shers.roman:
Dil Pareshaañ Baat Ghabraayi Huwi
Shakl Par Afsurdagi Ch’haayi Huwi
shers.english:
My Heart Is Troubled, My Words Appear To Be Trembling
Over My Face, The Signs of Depression, Are Now Appearing

shers.roman:
Zulmateñ Shab Ki Ghazab ‘Dhaanay Lageeñ
Kaali-Kaali Badliyaañ Ch’haanay Lageeñ
shers.english:
By The Rage of The Night’s Obscurities, Ruined I Am Being
The Extremely Dark Clouds, Have Now Started Gathering

shers.roman:
In Balaa-oñ Meiñ Phañsa Hai Khaana-Zaad
Aafatoñ Meiñ Mubtala Hai Khaana-Zaad
shers.english:
In Such Misfortunes, Captured, This Domestic Slave Is Being
Trapped Within These Hardships, This Domestic Slave Is Being

shers.roman:
Ay Arab Ke Chaand Ay Mahr e ‘Ajam
Ay Khuda Ke Noor Ay Shama’ e Haram
shers.english:
O Arabian Moon, O Sun of The Non-Arab World, Radiantly Glowing
O The Radiant Light of Allah! The Haram’s Lamp, Brightly Glowing

shers.roman:
Farsh Ki Zeenat Hai Dam Se Aap Ke
‘Arsh Ki Iz’zat Qadam Se Aap Ke
shers.english:
By Your Very Breath, The Beautification of The Earth Is Being
By The Grace of Your Feet, Honour, The ‘Arsh Is Receiving

shers.roman:
Aap Se Hai Jalwa e Haq Ka Zahoor
Aap Hee Haiñ Noor Ki Aankhoñ Ke Noor
shers.english:
Through You, The Lustres of The Almighty Are Manifesting
The Radiance In The Vision of Our Eyes, Only You Are Being

shers.roman:
Aap Se Roshan Huwe Kaun o Makaañ
Aap Se Pur Noor Hai Bazm e Jahaañ
shers.english:
Through You, The Universe And Beyond, Is Radiantly Glowing
Through You, The Assembly of The World Is Radiantly Glowing

shers.roman:
Ay Khudawand e ‘Arab Shaah e Ajam
Kijiye Hindi Ghulaamoñ Par Karam
shers.english:
You Are The Master of Arabia, The Non-Arab World’s King
Upon Your Indian Slaves, Do Shower Your Special Blessing

shers.roman:
Ham Siyaah-Kaaroñ Pe Rahmat Kijiye
Teera Bakhtoñ Ki Shafa’at Kijiye
shers.english:
Upon Us Sinful Ones, Your Special Mercy Do Be Showering
To The Unfortunate Souls, Your Intercession, Do Be Granting

shers.roman:
Apne Bandoñ Ki Madad Farmaaiye
Pyaare Haami Muskuraate Aaiye
shers.english:
To The Aid of Your True Slaves, Pease Do Be Coming
O Our Beloved Guardian! Please Do Come, Smiling

shers.roman:
Ho Agar Shaan e Tabassum Ka Karam
Subh Ho Jaaye Shab e Daijoor e Gham
shers.english:
If We Are Ever Blessed, By Your Smile’s Special Blessing
The Dark Evening of Grief, Will Become A Bright Morning

shers.roman:
Zulmatoñ Meiñ Gum Huwa Hai Raasta
Al Madad Ay Khanda e Dandaañ-Numa
shers.english:
In The Immense Darkness, Totally Lost The Path Is Being
Please Assist Me, O Sacred Teeth, Beautifully Smiling

shers.roman:
Haañ Dikha Jaana Tajal’li Ki Ada
Thokreñ Khaata Hai Pardesi Tera
shers.english:
Your Radiant Grace, Please Allow Me To Be Seeing
From Pillar To Post, This Visitor of Yours Is Going

shers.roman:
Dekhiye Kab Tak Chamakte Haiñ Naseeb
Der Se Hai Lau Lagaaye Ye Ghareeb
shers.english:
Let’s Now See, When My Destiny Will Start Truly Glowing
For A Long Time Now, This Mendicant, Is Eagerly Waiting

shers.roman:
Multaji Huñ Maiñ ‘Arab Ke Chaand Se
Apne Rab’b Se, Apne Rab’b Ke Chaand Se
shers.english:
Before The Radiant Arabian Moon, I Am Now Sincerely Pleading
Before My Creator, And My Creator’s Moon, I Am Supplicating

shers.roman:
Maiñ Bhikaari Huñ Tumhaara Tum Ghani
Laaj Rakh Lo Mere Phaylay Haath Ki
shers.english:
I Am Your Mendicant, You Are My Magnificent King
Keep The Honour To My Hands, Which I Am Spreading

shers.roman:
Tang Aaya Ho Dil e Na-Kaam Se
Is Nikam’may Ko Laga Do Kaam Se
shers.english:
Dejected Due To My Unsuccessful Heart, I Am Becoming
To This Insignificant One, Success, Please Be Granting

shers.roman:
Aap Ka Darbaar Hai ‘Arsh Ishtibaah
Aap Ki Sarkaar Hai Be-Kas Panaah
shers.english:
Free From Uncertainty, Your Grand Court Is Being
A Sanctuary For The Needy, Your Sacred Court Is Being

shers.roman:
Maangte Phirte Haiñ Sultaan o Ameer
Raat Din Pheyri Lagaate Haiñ Faqeer
shers.english:
The Kings And Leaders Are Seen Going Around Seeking
Day And Night, The Mendicants Are Seen Wandering

shers.roman:
Ghamzadoñ Ko Aap Kar Dete Haiñ Shaad
Sab Ko Mil Jaati Hai Muñh Maangi Muraad
shers.english:
To Those Who Are Grieving, Happiness, You Are Granting
Whatever Every Person Is Asking, He Is Certainly Getting

shers.roman:
Maiñ Tumhaara Huñ Gada e Be-Nawa
Kijay Apne Be-Nawaawoñ Par ‘Ata
shers.english:
Your Feeble And Destitute Mendicant, I Am Being
Upon Your Weak Mendicants, Shower Your Blessing

shers.roman:
Maiñ Ghulaam e Haich-Kaara Huñ Huzoor
Haich Kaaroñ Par Karam Hai Pur Zaroor
shers.english:
O My Nabi ! Your Unsuccessful And Ineffective Slave, I Am Being
Desperately Needed, By Your Ineffective Slaves, Is Your Blessing

shers.roman:
Ach’che Ach’choñ Ke Haiñ Gaahak Har Kaheeñ
Ham Badoñ Ki Hai Khareedaari Yaheeñ
shers.english:
For Those Who Are Best, Purchasers, Are Always Waiting
Purchased Only Here, Wretched Ones Like Us, Are Being

shers.roman:
Kijiye Rahmat Hasan Par Kijiye
Donoñ ‘Aalam Ki Muraadeñ Dijiye
shers.english:
Upon Hasan, Your Special Mercy, Please Do Be Showering
His Requests For Both The Worlds, To Him, Do Be Granting

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HUB’B E AAL E RASOOL BAHR E ‘IRFAAÑ
kalams.intro_note: These are chronological couplets commemorating the Wisaal Year of our Revered Leader and Master, Hazrat Sayyid Shah Aal e Rasool رَǷض ِىي َ اȲˢƊ ُ͚ نتََاَى Ȇَتضْهُ وَ نضَوƊرَ اȲˢƊ ُ͚ ɅَرْȎتَدَه. Each couplet encodes the year of his passing through the numerical values of the Urdu letters, following the traditional Abjad system used in classical poetry. رَǷض ِىي َ اȲˢƊ ُ͚ نتََاَى Ȇَتضْهُ وَ ننَوƊرَ اȲˢƊ ُ͚ ɅَرْȎقَدَه

shers.roman:
Hub’b e Aal e Rasool Bahr e ‘Irfaañ
Ronaq Dih Khandaan e Barakaat
shers.english:
The Love For Aal e Rasool Is The Ocean of Spirituality
The Brilliant Splendour of The Noble Barkaati Dynasty

shers.roman:
Wo Waaqif e Ramz e Laa Wa Il’la
Wo Kaashif e Sir’r e Nafi o Ithbaat
shers.english:
He Understood The Secrets of ‘No’ And ‘Except’ Most Certainly
The Secrets of ‘Negation’ And ‘Affirmation’, He Expounded Clearly

shers.roman:
‘Aazim Huwe Soo e Daar e ‘Uqba
Us Gham Ki Ghat’a Se Din Huwa Raat
shers.english:
Towards The Abode of The Hereafter, He Set Out On His Journey
The Day Transformed To Night, Under The Clouds of Immense Agony

shers.roman:
Rizwaañ Ne Kahi Hasan Se Taarikh
Ab Khuld Meiñ Dekhiye Karaamaat
shers.english:
The Angel Rizwaan, Said To Hasan, About This Chronology
Now The Miraculous Splendours, In Paradise You Will See

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: ACH’CHE KE PYAARE, MERE SAHAARE
kalams.intro_note: This is a further Kalaam, with chronological couplets commemorating the Wisaal Year of our Revered Leader and Master, Hazrat Sayyid Shah Aal e Rasool (Radi Allahu Anhu).
kalams.footnote: The Hijri year 1296 is derived from this couplet, which also encodes the Wisaal

shers.roman:
Ach’che Ke Pyaare, Mere Sahaare
Baahar Haiñ Bayaañ Se, Un Ke Manaaqib
shers.english:
My Support, The Beloved of The Truly Virtuous
Beyond Description, Are His Traits, Virtuous

shers.roman:
Wo Awr Shari’at Wo Awr Tariqat
Do Dil Yak Armaañ Yak Jaañ Do Qaalib
shers.english:
Him (Shah Aal e Rasool) And The Shari’at, Him And The Tariqat
Like Two Hearts, One Wish And One Soul, Into Two Moulds, Split

shers.roman:
‘Abd o Khuda Meiñ Maanind e Barzakh
Maqsood o Qaasid, Matloob o Taalib
shers.english:
Like A Veil Between The Servant And The Almighty Creator
The Beloved And The Loved, The Sought And The Seeker

shers.roman:
Darya e Rahmat Gulzaar Raafat
Jaan e Maraahim, Kaan e Mawaahib
shers.english:
The River of Mercy, The Garden of Clemency
The Soul of Blessings, The Mine of Generosity

shers.roman:
Najm e Manaazil Shama’e Mahaafil
Mahr e Mashaariq Maah e Maghaarib
shers.english:
A Star of The Terminuses, The Lamp of The Gatherings
A Sun of The East, A Moon of The West, He Is Being

shers.roman:
Khalq e Khuda Ke Kyuñ Na Hoñ Rahbar
Haiñ Mustafa Ke Farzand o Naa’ib
shers.english:
A Guide To Allah’s Creation Why Won’t He Be
He Is Mustafa’s Descendent, And His Emissary

shers.roman:
Hai Un Ki Dam Se Iz’zat Ki Iz’zat
Taaj e Maraatib Raas e Manaasib
shers.english:
By His Breath, Is The Honour of True Dignity
The Crown of Rank, The Summit of Nobility

shers.roman:
Jab Us Qamar Ne Lee Raah e Jannat
Thee Ashk Afshaañ Chashm e Kawaakib
shers.english:
When Towards Heaven, That Moon Did Journey
The Eyes of The Stars, Were Left Entirely Teary

shers.roman:
Meiñ Ne Kahi Ye Taareekh e Rahlat
Qutb e Masha’ikh, Asl e Mataalib
shers.english:
This Date of His Passing, Has Been Derived By Me
The Spiritual Pole of The Mystics, Our Desire’s Reality

shers.roman:
Date of the Grand Spiritual Master, Hazrat Sayyid Shah Aal-e-Rasool (Radi Allahu Anhu)
through the numerical values of its letters.

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HO GAYA KHATM YE RISAALA AAJ
kalams.intro_note: The date of the publication and composition of the short treatise, Nigaaristaan e Lataafat, which was personally authored by the writer, is derived through numerical calculation.
kalams.footnote: The year derived from the couplet represents the year of completion, which The year derived from these couplets also represents the year of completion,

shers.roman:
Ho Gaya Khatm Ye Risaala Aaj
Shukr e Khaliq Kareñ Na Kyuñkar Ham
shers.english:
San e Taaleef Ay Hasan Sun Le
Mamba’ e Wasf Shahr-Yaar e Haram

shers.roman:
Completed Today, Was This Concise Religious Paper
How Then, Can We Not Offer Gratitude, To The Creator
shers.english:
Attentively Listen, O Hasan! To Its Compilation Year
A Fountain Superbly Praising, The Haram’s Master

shers.roman:
is 1302 Hijri.
An Additional Chronological Date Marking The Publication And
shers.english:
Composition of ‘Nigaaristaan e Lataafat’:
Ye Chand Warq Na’at Ke Laaya Hai Ghulaam Aaj

shers.roman:
In’aam Kuch Is Ka Mujhe Ay Bahr e Sakha Do
Maiñ Kya Kahuñ Meri Hai Ye Hasrat Ye Tamanna
shers.english:
Maiñ Kya Kahuñ Mujh Ko Ye Silaa Do Ye Silaa Do
Today, A Few Pages of Prophetic Praise, This Devotee Is Bringing

shers.roman:
A Reward For This, O Ocean of Generosity! Please Do Be Granting
What More Can I Say, Except That, This Is My Desire And Yearning

Tum Aap Mere Dil Ki Muraadoñ Se Ho Waaqif
Khayraat Kuch Apni Mujhe Ay Bahr e ‘Ataa Do
shers.english:
Haiñ Ye San e Taaleef Faqeeraana Sada Meiñ
Waali Maiñ Tasad’duq Mujhe Mid’hat Ka Jaza Do

shers.roman:
Already You Are Well Aware, of What My Heart’s Desires Are Being
O Ocean of Blessings! From Your Blessings, Grant Me Some Blessing
shers.english:
This Is The Compilation Year, Which Very Humbly, I Am Mentioning
O My Guardian, Reward Me For This Praise, Sacrificed I Am Being!

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: HAI YE DIWAAN USKI MID’HAT MEIÑ
kalams.intro_note: The Publication Date of The Poetry Collection of Aala Hazrat Imam Ahmed Khan Bareilvi (Radi Allahu Anhu) is derived through numerical calculations from the following Kalaam:
kalams.footnote: The year derived from these couplets also represents the year of completion

shers.roman:
Hai Ye Diwaan Uski Mid’hat Meiñ
Jis Ki Har Baat Hai Khuda Ko Qubool
shers.english:
This Is A Poetic Collection, In Which He Is Being Celebrated
Whose Every Word, In The Court of The Creator, Is Accepted

shers.roman:
Jis Ke Qabze Meiñ Do Jahaañ Ka Mulk
Jis Ke Bandoñ Meiñ Taajdaar Shumool
shers.english:
Under Whose Control, The Realms of Both Worlds, Are Directed
Amongst Whose Servants, Even The Great Kings, Are Included

shers.roman:
Jis Pe Qurbaañ Jinaañ, Jinaañ Ke Chaman
Jis Pe Pyaara Khuda, Khuda Ke Rasool
shers.english:
Upon Whom, The Heaven, And Heaven’s Gardens Are Devoted
He, Who Is Allah’s Beloved, And To The Rasools, He Is Beloved

shers.roman:
Jis Ke Sadqe Meiñ Ahl e Imaañ Par
Har Ghar’i Rahmat e Khuda Ka Nuzool
shers.english:
Through Whose Blessings, The True Believers Are Truly Blessed
Due To Him, Every Moment, Allah’s Mercy Descends Unrestricted

shers.roman:
Jis Ki Sarkaar Qaazi e Haajaat
Jis Ka Darbaar Mu’ti e Maamool
shers.english:
He, Whose Grand Court Fulfils, The Needs Which Are Desired
He, Whose Grand Court Grants You, Whatever You Expected

shers.roman:
Ye Ziya-eñ Usi Ke Dam Ki Haiñ
Ye Sakha-eñ Usi Ke Haiñ Ma’mool
shers.english:
By His Blessed Countenance, These Radiances Are Manifested
These Generosities, Are The Blessings of His Habit, Celebrated

shers.roman:
Din Ko Milta Hai Roshni Ka Chiraagh
Shab Ko Khilta Hai Chaandni Ka Phool
shers.english:
From Him, The Day Receives The Radiant Lamp, Illuminated
Through Him, At Night, The Flowers of Moonlight, Flourished

shers.roman:
Us Ke Dar Se Milay Gada Ko Bheek
Us Ke Ghar Se Milay Dua Ko Qubool
shers.english:
From His Grand Threshold, Alms To The Mendicants, Is Granted
From His Blessed Chambers, Supplications Are Truly Accepted

shers.roman:
Ay Hasan, Kya Hasan Hai Misra’ e Saal
Baagh e Islam Ke Khilay Kya Phool
shers.english:
O Hasan! How Beautifully In This Poetic Line, The Year Is Depicted
Such Beautiful Flowers of The Garden of Islam, Have Now Budded

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SHAYKH E ZAMAANA HAZRAT E SAYYID ABUL HUSAIN
kalams.intro_note: A Chronological Strophe Depicting The Wisaal Date of His Eminence, The Blessed Personality, My Leader And Refuge, My Spiritual Master, And My Great Guide, The Renowned Grand Master, Hazrat Sayyid Shah Abul Husain Ahmad e Noori Miyañ (Radi Allahu Anhu) تای Ȇننہ.
kalams.footnote: The Hijri year 1324 is derived from this couplet, which also encodes the Wisaal

shers.roman:
Shaykh e Zamaana Hazrat e Sayyid Abul Husain
Jaan e Murad Kaan e Huda Shaan e Ihtidaa
shers.english:
Hazrat Sayyidi Abul Husain, The Spiritual Master of The Era, You Are Being
The Soul of Wishes, The Mine of Guidance, The Guiding Path You Are Being

shers.roman:
Noor e Nigaah Hazrat e Aal e Rasool Ke
Ach’che Miyañ Ke Lakht e Jigar Aankhoñ Ki Ziya
shers.english:
The Most Precious In The Holy Sight of Hazrat Aal e Rasool, You Are Being
The Beloved, And The Radiance of Ach’che Miyañ’s Eyes, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Khud Ain e Noor Sayyidi Aini Ke Noor e Ain
Ishqi Ke Dil Ke Chain Mere Dard Ki Dawa
shers.english:
You Have Eyes of Light, The Glow of Sayyidi Aini’s Eyes You Are Being
The Tranquillity of Hazrat Ishqi’s Heart, The Pain’s Relief, You Are Being

shers.roman:
Mere Buzurg Bhi Isi Dar Ke Ghulaam Haiñ
Maiñ Bhi Kameena Banda Isi Bargaah Ka
shers.english:
The True Disciples of This Court, Even My Pious Predecessors Are Being
An Unworthy And Lowly Slave of This Illustrious Court, Even I Am Being

shers.roman:
Maa Banda e Qadeem o Tu-ee Khwaja e Kareem
Parwarda e Tau Aim Bi-Yafza e Qadr e Maa
shers.english:
Your Old Devotees We Are Being, Our Generous Benefactor, You Are Being
By You, We Are Being Nurtured, So Our Worth, Please Do Be Enhancing

shers.roman:
Jaan e Zuhoor Ab Koyi Ikhfa Ka Waqt Hai
Haa-il Jo Parda Beech Meiñ Tha Wo Bhi Ut’h Gaya
shers.english:
O Soul of Manifestation! Is This The Appropriate Time To Be Veiling?
For Even The Veil Which Was Between Us, Now Raised That Veil Is Being

shers.roman:
Asraar Ka Zuhoor Ho Shaan e Zuhoor Se
Astaar Se Ut’ha-iye Ab Parda e Khafa’
shers.english:
Through The Grandeur of Manifestation, The Secrets Do Be Revealing
Now After Raising The Veils, The Concealed Secrets, Do Be Revealing

shers.roman:
E’laan Se Dikhaaiye Wo Qaadiri Kamaal
Izhaar Kijay Shaukat e Qudrat Ka Bar-Mala
shers.english:
By Making The Announcement, The Qaadiri Splendour Do Be Revealing
The Splendour of Your Amazing Power, Now Publicly, Do Be Revealing

shers.roman:
Darwaaze Khol Dijiye Imdaad e Ghaib Ke
Kaasay Liye Khar’ay Haiñ Bahut Der Se Gada
shers.english:
The Blessed Doors of Your Unseen Aid, Now Please Do Be Opening
With Begging Bowls In Their Hands, For Long, The Beggars Are Waiting

shers.roman:
Ya Sayyidi Maiñ Keh Ke Pukaaruñ Balaa Ke Waqt
Tum ‘Laa Takhaf’ Sunaate Huwe Aawo Sarwara
shers.english:
I Should Call Out, Saying, O My Master! When Calamities I Am Facing
Responding With ‘Fear Not’, Come Towards Me, O My Noble King!

shers.roman:
Daata Mera Sawaal Suno Mujh Ko Bheek Do
Mangta Tumhaara Tum Ko Tumhi Se Hai Mangta
shers.english:
O My Benefactor, Listen To My Plea! To Me, Charity Do Be Granting
From You, In Reality It Is You, Whom Your Humble Disciple Is Seeking

shers.roman:
Aaya Hai Door Se Yahi Sunta Huwa Faqeer
Baar’a Bat’ega Hazrat e Noori Ke Noor Ka
shers.english:
From Far Away Your Mendicant Came, For This, He Has Been Hearing
The Alms of Hazrat Noori’s Light, He Will Be Generously Distributing

shers.roman:
Mujh Sa Koyi Saqeem Na Tum Sa Koyi Kareem
Meri Talab-Talab Hai Tumhaari ‘Ata-‘Ata
shers.english:
There Is None Weaker Than Me, Like You, Kind-Hearted, None Is Being
Whilst I Am Continuously Seeking, You Are Always Generously Giving

shers.roman:
Lil’Laah Nigaah e Mehr Ho Mujh Teera Bakht Par
Aankhoñ Ko Noor Dil Ko Inaayat Karo Jila
shers.english:
For Allah’s Sake! Upon A Mendicant Like Me, Your Sight Do Be Placing
To My Eyes, Grant Radiance, To My Heart, A Fresh Life Do Be Granting

shers.roman:
Daarain Meiñ ‘Ulu e Maraatib Karo ‘Ata
Tum Mazhar e ‘Ali Ho ‘Ali Mazhar e ‘Ala
shers.english:
To Me, In Both The Worlds, A Splendid Rank, Please Do Be Granting
You Are Ali’s Reflection, The Manifestation of Splendour Ali Is Being

shers.roman:
Khush-Baash Ay Hasan Tere Dushman Malool Hoñ
Jis Ka Gada Hai Tu Wo Hai Gham Khwaar e Be-Nawa
shers.english:
O Hasan! Live In Comfort, For Dejected, Your Adversaries Are Being
You Are The Slave of Him, The Consoler of The Destitute, Who Is Being

shers.roman:
Taareekh Ab Wisaal e Muqad’das Ki ‘Arz Kar
Haasil Ho Poore She’r Se Khaatir Ka Mud’da’a
shers.english:
Now The Date of His Sacred Passing Away, I Want To Be Mentioning
From The Entire Couplet, May The Objective of The Heart, Be Echoing

shers.roman:
Wo Sayyid e Waala Gaye Jab Bazm e Quds Meiñ
Ach’che Miyañ Ne U’th Ke Galay Se Laga Liya
shers.english:
When Towards The Angelic Assembly, That Noble Sayyid, Was Journeying
In Order To Embrace Him, Hazrat Ach’che Miyan Was Instantly Standing

shers.roman:
Date of the Grand Spiritual Master, Hazrat Sayyid Shah Abul Husain Ahmad e
Noori (Radi Allahu Anhu) through the numerical values of its letters.

kalams.author: Ustaaz-e-Zaman Allama Hasan Raza Khan
kalams.title: SHUKR KHAALIQ KIS TARAH SE HO ADA
kalams.intro_note: A Poem Celebrating The Blessed Birth of The Noble Grandson of My Elder Brother, The Great Scholar of The Ahl e Sunnat, Hazrat Maulana Haji Muhammad Ahmed Raza Khan Qaadiri (Maddazilluhu) , Born In The Home of His Son, Maulavi Haamid Raza Khan (Rahmatullah Alaih). Note: The son of Huzoor Hujjatul Islam (Radi Allahu Anhu) being mentioned here is Huzoor Sayyidi Mufas’sir e Azam Hind Allama Ash Shah Ibrahim Raza Khan Jilani Miyañ (Radi Allahu Anhu) who is the Noble Father of Murshid e Kareem Huzoor Sayyidi Taajush Shariah Hazrat Allama Imam Mufti Mohammed Akhtar Raza Khan Qaadiri (Radi Allahu Anhu).
kalams.footnote: The Year 1325 Hijri Is Derived From This Poem As The Year of Birth of Huzoor

shers.roman:
Shukr Khaaliq Kis Tarah Se Ho Ada
Ek Zabaañ Awr Ne’mateñ Be Intiha
shers.english:
How Can I Express Gratitude To My Almighty Creator, Truly
I Have Only One Tongue, And His Blessings Have No Boundary

shers.roman:
Phir Zabaañ Bhi Kis Ki? Mujh Na-Cheez Ki
Wo Bhi Kaisi? Jis Ko ‘Isyaañ Ka Mazaa
shers.english:
Then Too, Whose Tongue Is It? That of A Worthless One Like Me
And That Too, A Tongue, Which Has Tasted Sins, Unfortunately

shers.roman:
Ay Khuda Kyuñkar Likhuñ Teri Sifat
Ay Khuda Kyuñkar Kahuñ Teri Thana
shers.english:
How Can I Truly Write Your Divine Attributes, O Allah Almighty!
How Can I Truly Praise Your Divine Majesty, O Allah Almighty!

shers.roman:
Gin’nay Waale Gintiyaañ Mahdoood Haiñ
Tere Altaaf o Karam Be-Intiha
shers.english:
For Those Who Intend Counting, The Numbers Are Limited, Certainly
Immeasurable And Boundless Are Your Favours, And Your Divine Mercy

shers.roman:
Sab Se Bar’h Kar Fazl Tera Ay Kareem
Hai Wujood e Aqdas e Khayr ul Wara
shers.english:
O Most Generous One! The Greatest of All Your Favours, Most Certainly
Is The Blessed Existence of The Best Amongst The Creation, Most Certainly

shers.roman:
Har Karam Ki Wajh Ye Fazl e ‘Azeem
Sadqa Haiñ Sab Ne’mateñ Is Fazl Ka
shers.english:
This Great Blessing Is The Means For Every Bounty
The Means To All Blessings, Is This Great Bounty

shers.roman:
Fazl Awr Phir Wo Bhi Aisa Shaandaar
Jis Pe Sab Afzaal Ka Hai Khaatima
shers.english:
A Grand Blessing, And That Too, One So Full of Glory
Upon Which, All Other Favours, Are Concluded Entirely

shers.roman:
Awliya Is Ke Karam Se Khaas e Haq
Ambia Is Ki 'Ata Se Ambia
shers.english:
Through This Blessing, The Saints, Are Selected By Allah Almighty
Through This Special Blessing, Every Nabi, Is Indeed A Nabi

shers.roman:
Khud Karam Bhi, Khud Karam Ki Wajh Bhi
Khud ‘Ata, Khud Baa-is e Jood o ‘Ata
shers.english:
He Himself Is That Special Mercy, And Even The Means To Mercy
He Himself Is The Bounty, And The Means To Mercy And Generosity

shers.roman:
Is Karam Par, Is ‘Ata o Jood Par
Aik Meri Jaan Kya, ‘Aalam Fida
shers.english:
Upon This Grand Blessing, And Upon Such Favours And Generosity
Let Alone My Own Soul, The Universe Is Sacrificed, Completely

shers.roman:
Kar De Ek Nam Se Jahaañ Seyraab e Faiz
Josh-Zan Chashma e Karam Ke Meem Ka
shers.english:
The Entire World He Blesses, By His Single Drop of Mercy
Which Is Gushing Out, From The Holy Fountain of Mercy

shers.roman:
Jaan Kehna Mubtazil Tashbeeh Hai
Allah, Allah! Is Ke Daaman Ki Hawa
shers.english:
To Refer To Him As ‘The Soul’, Is A Very Frequently Used Simile
Allah, Allah! Even His Mantle’s Breeze, Has Such A Blessed Quality

shers.roman:
Jaan Di Murdoñ Ko Esa Ne Agar
Is Ne Khud Esa Ko Zinda Kar Diya
shers.english:
If Esa Granted Life To Those Who Died Already
It Is He, Who Truly Granted Esa Life, Personally

shers.roman:
Be-Sabab Is Ki ‘Ata-eñ Be Shumaar
Be-Gharaz Is Ke Karam Be-Intiha
shers.english:
Without Reason They Are, His Countless Blessings Have No Boundary
Without Expecting Any Return, Is His Vast And Endless Generosity

shers.roman:
Baadshaah Ho Ya Gada Ho Koyi Ho
Sab Ko Is Sarkaar Se Sadqa Mila
shers.english:
Be He A King Or A Beggar, No Matter Whoever He May Be
From This Grand Court, Everyone Has Received His Charity

shers.roman:
Sab Ne Is Dar Se Muraadeñ Paayi Haiñ
Awr Isi Dar Se Mileñgi Daaima
shers.english:
From This Exalted Court, All Have Attained Their Wishes, Successfully
And From This Threshold, They Will Attain Their Wishes Continuously

shers.roman:
Jood Darya-Dil Ke Sadqa Se Bar’he
Bar’hte Baadal Ko Ghata Kehna Khata
shers.english:
By The Blessings of His Kind Heart, Expansive Is His Generosity
To Refer To A Growing Cloud, As A Dark Cloud, Is An Inaccuracy

shers.roman:
ْ رàðي Waale Rukh Ne Bheek Di
Kyuñ Na Gulshan Ki Sifat Ho Dil-Kasha
shers.english:
The Face which Proclaimed ‘Whoever Saw Me’ Granted This Charity
Why Then, Should The Feature of This Garden Not Manifest Beauty?

shers.roman:
Jalwa e Paa e Munawwar Ke Nisaar
Mahr o Maah Ko Kitna Ooncha Kar Diya
shers.english:
May We Be Sacrificed Upon His Feet, Which Glow Radiantly
To The Sun And Moon, He Granted Such An Exalted Destiny

shers.roman:
Apne Bandoñ Ko Khuda e Paak Ne
Is Ke Sadqe Meiñ Diya Jo Kuch Diya
shers.english:
Upon His Servants, Allah Almighty Bestowed His Special Mercy
He Gave Them Whatever He Gave Them, Through His Mercy

shers.roman:
Mustafa Ka Fazl Hai Masroor Haiñ
Ne'mat e Taaza Se ‘Abdul Mustafa
shers.english:
By The Favours of Mustafa, We Are All Very Happy
By This Fresh Blessing, The Slave of Mustafa Is Happy

shers.roman:
Aalim e Deeñ Muqtada e Ahl e Haq
Sunniyoñ Ke Peshwa Ahmed Raza
shers.english:
The Great Scholar of The Deen, The Leader of The Righteous, Truly
He Is Ahmed Raza, The Great Leader of The Sunni Muslim Community

shers.roman:
Fazl e Haq Se Haiñ Faqeer e Qaadiri
Is Faqeeri Ne Unheñ Sab Kuch Diya
shers.english:
By The Grace of Allah Almighty, I Am A True Qaadiri Devotee
Everything Was Bestowed Upon Me, Through This Mendicancy

shers.roman:
Lakht e Dil Haamid Miyañ Ko Shukr Hai
Haq Ne Bet’a Bakhsha Jeeta-Jaagta
shers.english:
For Our Beloved Haamid Miyañ, We Are Grateful Undoubtedly
That, Almighty Allah Has Given Him A Son, Who Is Healthy

shers.roman:
Maiñ Dua Karta Huñ Ab Allah Se
Awr Dua Bhi Wo Jo Hai Dil Ki Dua
shers.english:
I Am Now Supplicating, In The Court of Allah Almighty
And That Too, A Dua Which Is From My Heart, Sincerely

shers.roman:
Waasta Deta Huñ Maiñ Tera Tujhe
Ay Khuda Az Fazl Tu Haajat Rawa
shers.english:
I Am Now Supplicating To You, By Invoking Your Mercy
By Your Grace, Grant Me All My Wishes, O Allah Almighty

shers.roman:
‘Aafiyat Se Qibla o Kaa’ba Raheñ
Ham Ghulaamoñ Ke Saroñ Par Daaima
shers.english:
May The Blessings of This Revered One Remain Securely
As A Shade of Blessing, Over Our Heads, Continuously

shers.roman:
Daulat e Kaunain Se Hoñ Bahra-war
Akh e A’zam Mustafa, Haamid Raza
shers.english:
By The Treasures of Both The Worlds, Enriched May He Be
The Elder Brother of Mustafa Raza, Haamid Raza, Is He

shers.roman:
Ne’mat e Taaza Ko De Wo Ne’mateñ
Keeñ Jo Tu Ne Khaas Bandoñ Ko 'Ata
shers.english:
Upon This Fresh Blessing, Grant That Special Blessing And Mercy
Upon Your Special Servants, Which You Bestowed Generously

shers.roman:
Dost Un Sab Ke Raheñ Abaad o Shaad
Dushman e Bad-Khwaah Gham Meiñ Mubtala
shers.english:
May All Their Beloveds Remain Prosperous And Happy
Aggrieved May All Their Enemies And Ill-Wishers Be

shers.roman:
Aafreeñ Tab’e Rawaañ Ko Ay Hasan
Qat’a Likhna Tha Qasida Ho Gaya
shers.english:
O Hasan! Applauded Your Creative Flowing Expression Should Be
An Ode You Have Written, A Quatrain, Which Was Meant To Be

shers.roman:
San Wilaadat Ke Dua’iya Likho
‘Ilm o ‘Umr Iqbal o Taali’ De Khuda
shers.english:
Now Write Down The Duas For His Birth Year, Meticulously
O Allah! Grant Him Knowledge, Long Life, And A Bright Destiny
